 Employment: Full-time 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a dynamic and professionally presentable IT Procurement professional to manage procurement operations for a leading global professional services organisation in Gurgaon. 
 The selected candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, suppliers and internal procurement teams to manage end-to-end IT procurement activities. 
 The role requires excellent communication skills, strong coordination abilities and practical knowledge of IT procurement processes. 
 Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end procurement activities for IT-related products and services. Handle procurement requirements related to IT hardware, software, SaaS subscriptions, IT infrastructure, licenses and IT services. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to understand purchase requirements and specifications. Float RFQs/RFPs, invite quotations and coordinate with suppliers for commercial proposals. Prepare comparative statements (CS), evaluate vendor quotations and support commercial negotiations. Identify suitable suppliers, evaluate proposals and recommend cost-effective procurement solutions. Coordinate vendor onboarding, documentation, purchase orders and contract-related activities. Track purchase requisitions, order status, deliveries, renewals and supplier commitments. Maintain procurement MIS, spend reports, savings trackers and other procurement documentation. Ensure adherence to procurement policies, approval workflows and compliance requirements. Coordinate with stakeholders and suppliers to resolve procurement-related issues and ensure timely closure of requirements. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in IT Procurement / IT Sourcing / Indirect Procurement. Hands-on understanding of IT procurement categories such as hardware, software, IT services, SaaS, licenses and IT infrastructure. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong stakeholder management and vendor coordination abilities. Good negotiation, analytical and commercial evaluation skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint. Working knowledge of ERP or e-Procurement platforms such as SAP, Ariba, Coupa or similar systems will be an advantage. Ability to work independently and manage multiple procurement requirements simultaneously. Professional attitude, presentation and interpersonal skills. 
 Candidate Profile We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in: IT/ITES companies Consulting and professional services organisations Large corporates with centralised procurement functions Organisations managing IT hardware, software and technology procurement 
 Important Requirements Excellent communication skills are mandatory. Candidates must be comfortable interacting with senior stakeholders and external vendors. Must be willing to work from the client's office in Gurgaon. Immediate joiners or candidates serving a notice period of up to 15 days will be preferred.

Manage staff scheduling, attendance, grooming and performance. Conduct daily briefings, staff training and performance evaluations. Ensure adequate manpower planning and optimum staff utilisation. Maintain discipline and accountability within the team. 3. Guest Experience & Customer Satisfaction Ensure excellent guest experience and hospitality standards. Personally handle VIP guests, customer feedback and escalated complaints. Ensure timely resolution of guest concerns. Monitor guest reviews and implement improvements. Build strong guest relationships to encourage repeat business. 4. Sales & Revenue Generation Achieve monthly sales and revenue targets. Drive upselling and cross-selling initiatives. Monitor average guest spend, table turnover and occupancy. Implement promotional activities and sales-building strategies. Identify opportunities to increase business and profitability. 5. Profit & Loss (P&L) Management Take complete ownership of the outlet's Profit & Loss (P&L) performance. Prepare, monitor and analyse monthly P&L statements in coordination with the finance team. Achieve monthly revenue, gross profit and net profit targets. Control food cost, beverage cost, manpower cost and other operating expenses. Monitor actual expenses against approved budgets. Maintain food and beverage cost percentages within company-approved targets. Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising guest experience or service quality. Monitor inventory, stock consumption, wastage, pilferage and stock variances. Control complimentary items, discounts, voids and cancellations to prevent revenue leakage. Monitor daily sales, cash flow, billing accuracy and revenue reconciliation. Analyse financial reports and take corrective actions wherever required. Ensure optimum utilisation of resources and maintain overall outlet profitability. Submit regular financial and operational performance reports to management. 6. Inventory & Cost Control Monitor daily stock consumption and maintain proper inventory records. Ensure regular stock audits and reconciliation. Control wastage, breakage and pilferage. Ensure proper requisitioning and purchasing as per company procedures. Maintain coordination with purchase, stores and accounts departments. 7. Hygiene, Safety & Compliance Maintain high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and restaurant presentation. Ensure compliance with food safety, fire safety and company policies. Conduct regular operational inspections. Ensure all licenses, checklists and statutory requirements are followed. 8. Reporting & Administration Prepare daily sales, attendance and operational reports. Review monthly financial performance and P&L reports. Coordinate with HR, Finance, Operations and Management. Ensure proper documentation and adherence to company policies. Report operational challenges and business performance to senior management. PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE Minimum 3–5 years of experience in the hospitality or restaurant industry. Previous experience as a Restaurant Manager or Assistant Restaurant Manager. Strong knowledge of restaurant operations and Food & Beverage service. Proven understanding of P&L management, budgeting and cost control. Experience in managing food cost, beverage cost and manpower cost. Strong leadership, team management and communication skills. Ability to analyse sales reports, financial statements and operational data. Knowledge of POS systems, MS Excel and inventory management. Strong guest-handling and problem-solving abilities. Target-oriented, commercially aware and result-driven personality. Hotel Management or Hospitality Management qualification preferred.  1. PURPOSE OF THE POSITION 
The Area Sales Manager is responsible for achieving assigned sales revenue and margin targets for Refrigerant Gases (Service segment) within a defined territory in North India. This is a direct, field-based sales role focused on acquiring new customers, deepening existing relationships, ensuring collections, and building strong local market presence full alignment with Dew Gases' commercial policies and standards. 
 2. PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES 
 
 Sales Target Achievement: Meet and exceed assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual sales revenue and variable margin targets for Refrigerant Gases within the designated territory, in adherence to company pricing and commercial policies. New Customer Acquisition: Actively prospect, identify, and convert new customers (service segment HVAC, refrigeration, cold chain, automotive AC workshops, etc.) through structured field visits, cold calls, and referral networks. Customer Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with existing customers to ensure repeat business, minimize churn, and expand share of wallet within each account. Territory Coverage & Call Planning: Plan and execute a structured weekly/monthly call plan covering the full territory; maintain updated call records and customer account information in company systems (CRM/reports). Product Knowledge & Application Selling: Develop thorough knowledge of the Refrigerant Gases product portfolio (R-22, R-32, R-410A, R-134A, HFOs, blends, etc.) and use application-based selling techniques to match products to customer needs. Market & Competitor Intelligence: Gather and report on local market trends, competitor pricing, new entrants, and customer feedback to the Regional Manager on a regular basis. Collections & DSO Management: Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments from customers and maintain Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) within the targets set by the company. Compliance & Reporting: Submit accurate and timely sales reports, call reports, forecasts, and expense claims as per company requirements; adhere to all company policies including credit, safety, and regulatory norms. 
 3. KEY INTERFACES 
 
 Reports To (Upward): Regional Manager North India Internal Cross-Functional: Finance (collections/credit), Operations & Distribution (order fulfilment, delivery), Supply Chain Planning External: Service segment customers (HVAC contractors, refrigeration service companies, automotive AC workshops, cold chain operators), distributors/stockists, cylinder tracking agencies 
 4. REQUIRED CRITICAL BEHAVIOURS 
 
 Drive & Ownership 
Takes full ownership of territory performance without needing constant supervision
Self-motivated; proactively seeks new opportunities rather than waiting for leads
Understands the financial impact of discounting and margin leakage
 Customer-Centric Selling 
Listens actively to understand customer needs before proposing solutions
Builds genuine, long-term relationships beyond transactional interactions
Handles objections confidently and professionally
 Influencing & Communication 
Communicates clearly in both local language(s) and English written and spoken
Adapts communication style to customers from small workshops to large service companies
Establishes personal credibility and trust with customers at all levels
 Discipline & Execution 
Follows structured call plans and consistently updates customer records
Meets deadlines on reports, collections, and forecast submissions
Operates within company commercial and compliance policies at all times
 Learning Agility 
Continuously updates product and application knowledge
Open to feedback from the Regional Manager and acts on coaching inputs

description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Role name and description Staff, Financial Crime Compliance - Transaction monitoring Analyst (Staff), EY GDS Consulting Global Delivery Services is one of EYs greatest global assets - a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team! The opportunity The Compliance team at EY GDS partners with other EY offices across the globe to provide an array of compliance solutions to our clients. The team works on short to long term engagements to assist in establishing, maintaining, and reviewing the outputs of business functions and compliance programs. Financial crime risks relating to anti-money laundering (AML), terrorist financing, anti-bribery controls, sanctions compliance and fraud are a high focus for regulated businesses and external scrutiny as regulation and practice continues to evolve. Responsible for developing and overseeing the financial crime and fraud prevention framework, designed to ensure client(s) are compliant, protected from risk and loss from financial crime. As a part of our Global Managed Services Delivery team, you will be working with EY offices across the globe to provide an array of compliance solutions to our clients. The team works on short to long term engagements to provide assistance in establishing, maintaining and reviewing the outputs of business functions and compliance programs. Our Financial Crime Consulting team consists of hundreds of professionals who advise and drive change for the firms banking, capital markets, insurance, and asset management clients in Financial Crime. Our Financial Crime Consulting team specializes in several areas, including: AML transaction monitoring SAR drafting Fraud Investigation Crypto investigation Customer screening Payment screening filtering for Sanctions, PEPs and adverse media KYC Remediation Compliance testing and FATCA Financial crime risk assessment reviews AI Tools Automation Your key responsibilities As a Financial Crime Compliance Analyst, you will predominantly support the compliance team in the financial crime space. You will help businesses comply with financial crime regulations and adhere to relevant client(s) policies and procedures related to anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing. Multi-tasker, learn on the job and work to meet strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment Devising process documentation and translating complex processes into easy-to-follow instructions Coordinating efforts with internal stakeholders as appropriate Work as a member of a team to ensure operational readiness of applications and processes required to conduct AML program requirements Seek to understand the overall process and objective before beginning to work on a task Escalate issues and problems, articulate clearly to leadership, onshore and client team Demonstrate integrity, respect and be able to work collaboratively with team members Apply AI tools and automation techniques to support financial crime compliance workstreams. Proficiency in Transaction Monitoring Space : Customer transactions: Oversee transactions, including transfers, deposits, and withdrawals, to identify suspicious activity Customer Information Review: Assess historical and current customer data and interactions to detect potential financial crime risks Suspicious Activity Reporting (SARs): Investigate and report suspicious activity, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML) concerns, for assigned business units In-depth understanding of Transaction monitoring and risks in each Segment: Wealth Management Risk : Familiarity with the unique risks associated with wealth management, such as high-net-worth client transactions and complex financial instruments Commercial Banking Transactions : An understanding of the risks inherent in commercial banking transactions, including due diligence requirements for loan transactions, deposits, and trade finance activities Corporate Transaction Monitoring : Knowledge of the process for monitoring corporate client transactions, identifying potential risks in business accounts, and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations Correspondent Banking Risk Detection : Familiarity with the risks associated with correspondent banking relationships, including cross-border transactions, and ensuring compliance with international AML standards Skills and attributes for success Time management skills to be able to manage deadlines effectively Exhibit analytical skills and attention to detail while maintaining a holistic view and logical thinking Demonstrate working knowledge of AI-enabled tools and technologies to improve research, analysis, investigation quality and operational efficiency. Proficiency in Generative AI and prompt engineering, with the ability to design effective prompts and leverage AI tools to enhance research, analysis, problem-solving, and operational efficiency. To qualify for the role, you must have Bachelors /Master s degree in finance, accounting, economics, law, or a related field 1-3 years of work experience in AML Transaction Monitoring Demonstrated experience in a consulting role or within a large corporate environment, with a strong understanding of global Financial Crime Compliance practices Good understanding of SAR drafting and AML regulatory reporting. Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex financial data Good understanding of banking industry, its products, and services Experience analysing financial/bank statements Experience in interpreting policy documents Willingness to work from office; 5 days a week Willingness to work on Indian Holidays as per client requirement Willingness to work in shifts, if required Willingness to travel, within the country and internationally as required Proficiency in transaction monitoring systems and other emerging AI capabilities and tools. Ideally, you ll also have Good English communication skills - written as well as verbal Possess energy, enthusiasm, and the courage to lead PC Proficiency, including MS Office applications - Word, Excel, PowerPoint Ability to manage competing priorities and consistently deliver results within strict deadlines Strong organizational and time management skills The ability to work under pressure independently as well as collaboratively with the team What we offer EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. Continuous learning : You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you : We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. Transformative leadership : We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. Diverse and inclusive culture : You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. EY | Building a better working world 
 
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Scientific Account Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 We are seeking a motivated and scientifically knowledgeable Scientific Account Manager to support diagnostic platforms, devices, and products across India. This role combines scientific knowledge, customer relationship management, account management, and operational support. The successful candidate will serve as a key point of contact for partner laboratories and customers, ensuring successful platform adoption, customer satisfaction, and smooth day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate will have a background in biotechnology or life sciences, experience in account or relationship management, and excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
 
 Job Details 
 Location: Ahmedabad or Bhubaneswar Work Model: Hybrid Employment Type: Full-Time Employee Experience: Minimum 3 years 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partner accounts across India. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with customers and laboratory partners. Establish regular communication and follow-up schedules to monitor customer satisfaction and platform utilization. Monitor account performance, testing volumes, and adoption levels, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement. Track account activities, customer feedback, issues, and escalations using CRM tools. Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer concerns and ensure timely follow-through. Participate in account review meetings and provide updates and recommendations. Support customers using diagnostic platforms, devices, and products. Provide training and guidance on laboratory protocols, SOPs, workflows, and equipment. Assist with troubleshooting technical and customer-related inquiries. Support onboarding and training of new laboratory partners and staff. Communicate customer feedback and platform performance observations to the international team. Collaborate with sales, business development, marketing, and product teams to improve customer-facing materials and support processes. Support the launch and implementation of platforms at partner laboratories across India. Coordinate equipment installation, site readiness, and laboratory workflow setup. Assist with inbound and outbound shipments of samples, reagents, and equipment. Coordinate with logistics providers, freight forwarders, and customs brokers when required. Work with international operations, quality, and regulatory teams to support documentation and compliance requirements. Identify operational challenges and recommend process improvements. Represent the organization at relevant industry events, conferences, and trade shows as needed. Support the development of new markets and territories. Travel domestically and internationally when required to support strategic accounts. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Minimum Masters degree (MS) in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or a related scientific field. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience. Background in biotechnology, life sciences, or a related scientific industry. Experience in account management, relationship management, customer success, sales, or business development. Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage confidently with customers and scientific professionals. Understanding of cancer biology, immunology, molecular biology, and cellular biology. Previous laboratory research experience. Strong problem-solving, organizational, and analytical skills. Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate in a dynamic environment. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience in Oncology and/or Immunology. Previous experience with laboratory equipment, particularly Luminex platforms. Experience with HubSpot CRM (other CRM platforms are also acceptable). Experience supporting diagnostic platforms, laboratory products, or biotechnology solutions. Experience working with international customers or cross-functional teams. 
 
 Working Arrangement 
 Fully remote position based in India. Primarily working according to Indian Standard Time (IST). Flexibility to attend occasional meetings with US-based teams outside standard Indian working hours. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally, potentially up to 50%, when required. Remote training and onboarding will be provided. A US B1 business visitor visa may be arranged separately for future business travel. Candidates do not need to have a US visa before starting the position. 
 
 Recruitment Process 
 The selection process consists of three interview stages. Candidates will also be asked to complete a Predictive Index assessment, which is designed to help the hiring team better understand their working style and personality. It is not intended as a disqualifying test. Important: The hiring team is particularly interested in candidates who combine strong communication and relationship-building abilities with a scientific or biotechnology background.

title: Inventory Assistant
description:

The candidate will maintain accurate stock records, verify incoming and outgoing materials, prepare invoices, and coordinate with Accounts, Sales, Purchase, and Dispatch. The ideal candidate should have good organizational skills, basic computer knowledge, numerical accuracy, and the ability to maintain systematic inventory and billing records. Working Hours: 8:50 AM to 6:30 PM Responsibilities A. Stock and Inventory Management - Maintain accurate and updated stock records in the inventory system, Excel, or stock register. Record all stock inward and outward transactions promptly. Verify received materials against purchase orders, invoices, and delivery challans. Ensure materials are issued only against authorized requests or approved documents. Monitor stock availability and identify low-stock items. Conduct periodic physical stock verification and reconcile discrepancies. Maintain records of damaged, returned, rejected, and excess materials. Ensure proper storage, identification, labeling, and organization of materials. B. Billing and Invoice Management - Prepare sales bills and invoices using the companys billing software. Verify product details, quantities, prices, customer information, and applicable taxes. Ensure billing records match the actual materials supplied. Prepare delivery challans and other dispatch-related documents. Maintain invoice records and supporting documentation. Coordinate with the Accounts team to resolve billing discrepancies. Ensure all billing transactions are recorded accurately and on time. C. Goods Receipt and Dispatch Coordination - Receive materials from suppliers and verify quantity and condition. Prepare and maintain Goods Received Notes (GRNs), wherever applicable. Coordinate with the Sales and Dispatch teams for timely material movement. Verify materials before dispatch and ensure the correct quantity is issued. Maintain records of deliveries, returns, replacements, and material transfers. Report shortages, damaged goods, and discrepancies to the reporting manager. D. Documentation and Reporting - Maintain purchase invoices, sales bills, stock registers, delivery challans, and other store documents. Prepare daily stock inward and outward reports. Maintain daily billing summaries and closing stock reports. Prepare low-stock reports and communicate replenishment requirements. Maintain accurate digital and physical records for audits and management reviews. Submit daily and periodic reports within the prescribed timelines. E. Store Maintenance and Coordination - Keep the store clean, organized, and properly maintained. Ensure materials are stored safely and can be easily identified and retrieved. Coordinate with the Purchase team regarding pending supplies and replenishment requirements. Support the Accounts team with billing records and supporting documents. Communicate stock availability and dispatch status to relevant departments. Follow company procedures for inventory control, billing, documentation, and material handling. Requirements Experience Required: 0-3 Years Required Qualifications - Any undergraduate degree. 1-3 years of experience in store keeping, inventory management, billing, or warehouse operations is preferred. Basic computer knowledge and proficiency in MS Excel. Knowledge of invoice preparation, stock registers, and delivery documentation. Familiarity with inventory or billing software is an added advantage. Required Skills Good numerical ability and attention to detail. Strong organizational and record-maintenance skills. Ability to maintain accurate stock and billing records. Good communication and coordination skills. Time management and task prioritization. Ability to identify and report stock discrepancies. Responsible, honest, punctual, and systematic approach to work. Ability to coordinate with multiple departments. Qualifications Immediate joiners preferred. Candidates based in or willing to work from Coimbatore. Candidates with practical experience in inventory, billing, and store operations. Candidates with good documentation and stock-handling abilities.

title: AI Engineer
description:
About Vista Equity Partners Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vistas presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem. Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.
 About Amtech 
 Amtech LLC is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging and manufacturing industries, helping businesses streamline operations, improve productivity, and drive sustainable growth. With a strong focus on innovation and customer success, Amtech continues to expand its global footprint and deliver technology that empowers teams around the world. 
 Our Employee Value Proposition At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can: Purpose Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations. Growth Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths. Culture Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision. Innovation Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business. Role Description 
 Amtech LLC is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to build and scale the Agentic Platform behind Amtech AI Intelligence — a headless, MCP-native intelligence layer across packaging and labels, and data that is callable by any AI, on any screen. This role takes Amtech's first production agent pattern and turns it into a reusable platform component that extends cleanly to EnCore, LabelTraxx, Siteline, Scorekeeper, and future use cases, rather than building a one-off solution per product. This is a senior, largely self-directed role: you'll set technical direction for the platform, make build-vs-buy calls on agent tooling, and be a technical reference point for the Forward Deployed Engineers embedding it into product pods. Curiosity about emerging agentic AI and LLM tooling, and comfort operating close to production systems and governed customer data, are essential. Job Description Headless, MCP-Native Architecture Build business logic that runs independent of any screen — the same capability must work for a person in the UI, an AI agent, or an automated job. Expose Amtech capabilities as MCP-described tools so any AI model can call them. Orchestration and Agent Execution Build and maintain the LLM orchestration layer that turns model output into safe, governed, tool-using actions. Implement and extend agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Retrieval and Model Integration Build and tune RAG pipelines for grounding agent responses in Amtech's own data. Integrate model-agnostic LLM providers — Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and whatever model leads next — via a common provider abstraction, avoiding vendor lock-in. Governed On-Prem Data Access (the Data Agent) Build and maintain the Data Agent — new technology that reads EnCore and other customer data directly for inferencing, with no dependency on legacy point-to-point APIs. Ensure every agent action passes governed approval gates before it executes, with a complete, queryable audit trail — customer data stays in the customer's environment while still enabling cloud-LLM reasoning over it. Building Amtech AI Intelligence Capabilities Extend the platform into concrete delivered capabilities such as Schedule Intelligence (watching schedules, flagging conflicts and trim-loss, proposing re-sequencing), Order & Customer Intelligence (full-context status across specs, history, and dates), Docs & Knowledge (cited, grounded answers with stale-document detection), and Forecast & KPI Intelligence (plain-language questions over throughput, waste, and OTIF). Plugging Into Amtech's Broader Agent Portfolio Amtech already runs 10+ active agents company-wide — this role's platform work is what lets patterns from those efforts be reused instead of rebuilt. Directly support the Utilization mandate to extend engineering's agent-building cadence to Sales, Support, and Customer Success, so new agents in those functions can be built on the same governed orchestration, RAG, and audit foundation rather than one-off tooling. Scaling the Platform Pattern Across Product Lines Turn Amtech's first production agent pattern into a reusable platform component that other product pods can adopt without a rebuild. Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers embedded in product pods to validate the platform against real workflows and feed field learnings back into the roadmap. Deployment, Monitoring, and Cost Control Deploy agents and inference endpoints on AWS (e.g., Lambda, ECS/EKS, SageMaker) and integrate them into existing APIs and microservices. Set up evals, cost controls, and basic observability to catch regressions, drift, or runaway spend before they reach customers. Bridging into ML Engineering and MLOps Bring enough classical ML engineering and MLOps fluency (feature stores, model registries, CI/CD for models, drift monitoring) to partner effectively with the Data Science, ML Engineering, and MLOps functions, not just the agentic/LLM side of the platform. As a senior technical voice on the team, weigh in on production practices — deployment, monitoring, retraining — across both agentic and classical ML workloads as the org scales toward a lead role. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or related field. 6+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years hands-on building production systems with large language models. Demonstrated experience setting technical direction and reviewing the work of other engineers, even if not a formal people-management role. Strong Python programming skills. Practical experience with prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph). Experience integrating at least one major LLM provider API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock). Hands-on AWS experience (e.g., Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) deploying and operating production workloads in the cloud. Experience with model inferencing — real-time and batch — including optimizing latency, throughput, and cost for LLM or ML workloads. Experience building or consuming RAG pipelines and working with vector databases. Working knowledge of classical ML engineering and MLOps practices (e.g., feature stores, model registries, MLflow/Kubeflow-style CI/CD for models) — enough to partner with Data Science, ML Engineering, and MLOps, not necessarily hands-on ownership. Familiarity with Docker and containerized deployment. Working knowledge of Git and CI/CD practices. Preferred Qualifications Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-tool integration standards. Experience building governed, read-only data access layers (audit logging, guardrails, least-privilege access). Exposure to Kubernetes and cloud AI/inferencing platforms (AWS Bedrock, AWS SageMaker); AWS certification is a plus, not a requirement. Experience working with ERP, MES, or other industrial/manufacturing data environments. Prior experience embedding directly with a product team or customer-facing engineering effort. Familiarity with performance monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog). Why Join Amtech At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

title: Associate Product Manager (Systems Thinking)
description:
Job Summary In this role, you turn how a business works into a precise blueprint a tech team can build from. We call this systems thinking: seeing a business as connected parts (people, operations, rules, data and handoffs) and designing how they should work together. The role sits close to a product manager, but starts earlier and goes deeper: on the operations floor. You will sit with operators, managers and finance teams, capture what really happens, and map it as a process. Then you will design the better version: the data it needs, the rules it must enforce, the screens people use, and what happens when something fails. Your output is the PRD, BRD and screen specs our engineers implement. You will do this work with AI as your main tool. Our Process Docs method runs inside Claude Code, and you will use it daily to capture, structure, review and refine documentation. This role suits someone early in their career who wants to learn how real businesses run and how good software is designed for them. Key Responsibilities Observe and capture. Visit client sites, shadow work and interview people. Record each activitys inputs, outputs, people, timing and problems, including the workarounds and exceptions nobody mentions at first. Map processes. Turn observations into step-by-step flows with every handoff, decision point and exception path named. A new employee should be able to follow your map on day one. Analyze and decide. Compare options, dig into the hard parts of a problem, and help settle the tech stack and implementation approach before design begins. Write PRDs and BRDs. Translate processes into requirements with IDs, business rules, data entities and acceptance criteria. Design the improved process, not a digital copy of the old one. Specify screens. For each screen, define entry points, layout, data shown, actions, validations, and empty, loading, error and restricted states. Design for correctness. Define the source of truth for each balance and status. Spell out how the system handles concurrent users, duplicate requests, partial fulfilment, cancellations and integration failures. Write the scope. Produce a self-contained scope document clients can read and sign off without opening anything else. Review and close gaps. Audit documentation for completeness, consistency and depth. Turn every gap into a specific question someone can answer. Stay with the build. Answer engineers questions, review shipped work against acceptance criteria, and keep the PRD in step with what was built. Requirements Mandatory Requirements 0-2 years of work experience. Freshers with strong projects (in intern roles) are welcome. A degree in engineering, computer science or business, or equivalent proof of ability. We care more about how you think than what you studied. Strong critical thinking. You break a problem into parts, test assumptions, and spot what doesnt add up. You think beyond the obvious. You look past the process as described to the exceptions, workarounds and knock-on effects behind it. You ask sharp questions. In a room with a client, you ask the questions that reveal how the business really works: "Who decides that", "Why is it done this way", "What happens when this fails" Strong communication, written and spoken. You can describe a process so someone who wasnt there understands it, and explain a design to a client and an engineer alike. Curiosity to learn, by nature. When something is outside your territory, you dive in with confidence and interest rather than waiting to be taught. Comfort reasoning about state and rules. Given "available = on-hand - held - reserved", you can trace balances through a sequence of actions without error. Basic software building ability. You can build and run a small application with persistent storage, using any stack you can defend. Hands-on use of AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code. You can direct an AI, check its output, and reject a wrong recommendation. Ability to read API contracts, sequence flows and acceptance criteria. Willingness to travel to client sites and spend time on factory floors, warehouses and offices. Good to Have Experience as an Associate Product Manager, or on a team building digital products. This is the strongest signal we look for. An internship in such a role counts. Exposure to operations domains: procurement, inventory, warehousing, sales order management, logistics or finance. An internship or project with a consulting, ERP or operations team. Familiarity with ERPs or low-code platforms such as SAP, Tally, Zoho, Odoo or Mendix, and how they integrate with custom systems. Understanding of transactions, idempotency, concurrency and audit trails in business software. Working knowledge of data modelling: entities, relationships, keys and constraints. You can sketch a schema for orders, stock and dispatches. Experience writing PRDs, user stories, wireframes or test cases. Comfort with Markdown, Git and diagram tools. Hindi, Gujarati or another regional language, for conversations on client sites. What we care about Reality over assumption. We document what actually happens, not what the SOP says. Workarounds and edge cases matter more than the happy path. Honest gaps. "I dont know yet" written down beats a confident guess. We mark unknowns and turn them into answerable questions. Specifics, not adjectives. "3-5 minutes per batch" beats "takes some time". Name the person, the system, the number. Failure is part of the design. A good spec says what happens when the network drops, the request repeats, or two people act at once. Accountability for AI output. AI makes us fast. You own every line it helps you produce, and you verify it. Builds, not decks. Our work is done when an engineer can build from it without guessing. About You You are at the start of your career and hungry to learn how businesses really work.

We move with precision and vitality, relying on strong cross-functional partnerships across product, engineering, sales, customer experience, legal, finance, and operations to achieve business outcomes. We operate with a strong ownership attitude - you build it, you run it - where product leaders are empowered to actively participate in crafting strategy, supporting sophisticated RFP processes, and driving continuous improvement across the product lifecycle. Your Impact Serve as a lead Engineering Product Manager for our Provider mobility business portfolio, you will be driving the strategic roadmap through 5G-to-6G transitions. You will oversee product lifecycles, scale IoT and Edge AI initiatives, and engage executive collaborators to align Cisco's cross-functional capabilities with the customer's long-term business goals. Drive technology evolution from current 5G deployments toward future 5G-Advanced and 6G-ready architectures. Identify and synthesize customer requirements, market opportunities, competitive landscape analysis and set priorities with outstanding transparency, to ensure efficient roadmap execution. Identify and assemble growth opportunities beyond the core contract by developing value propositions in Edge AI, AI inferencing, and mobility infrastructure. Align cross-functional service provider business teams, and broader Cisco product organizations to deliver a unified service provider value proposition. Build data-backed business cases that connect Cisco technology to measurable customer outcomes. Engage with senior customer executives and internal leadership to build strategic positioning and communicate roadmap release plans. Navigate large, matrixed organizations to influence cross-functional teams and align collaborators toward shared achievements. Operate with high autonomy to handle risks and navigate ambiguous, fast-paced environments. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline. Experience with mobility technologies, network functions and standards, such as; 3GPP, LTE/4G, 5G, 5G-Advanced, and evolving 6G concepts. Proven track record in managing product lifecycle, including new product creation, commercial licensing, and feature roadmap execution. Experience supporting strategic customers and translating customer needs into product requirements and business outcomes. Strong experience navigating complex, matrixed organizations to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority. Demonstrated ability to support strategic RFPs and present complex technical roadmaps to senior internal and external stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of Cisco Packet Core network functions, IoT, SaaS offers and large-scale service provider software. title: Paravet (Animal Caretaker) Professional
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a responsible and experienced Para vet (Animal Caretaker) to support daily animal healthcare activities, monitor livestock health, assist veterinarians, and maintain animal health records. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring animal welfare, identifying early signs of illness, supporting routine healthcare activities, and implementing veterinary instructions at the farm. Company: Gramathupaal Department: Animal Healthcare / Farm Operations Location: Coimbatore Reporting To: Farm Manager / Veterinarian Employment Type: Full-Time Responsibilities Monitor the health and general condition of livestock on a daily basis. Observe changes in animal behavior, appetite, movement, and milk production. Identify early signs of illness, injury, or unusual health conditions. Immediately report health concerns to the Veterinarian or Farm Manager. Monitor sick and recovering animals and update their health status. Assist veterinarians during animal examinations and treatments. Support vaccination, dewormed, and routine healthcare programs under veterinary guidance. Assist with medication administration as authorized and supervised. Support post-treatment and post-operative animal care as instructed by the veterinarian. Ensure veterinary instructions are followed properly. Monitor feeding, watering, and general animal hygiene. Ensure sick and recovering animals receive proper care. Assist in maintaining clean and hygienic animal shelters. Support preventive healthcare and disease-control activities. Observe animal comfort and report any welfare concerns. Coordinate with farm staff regarding daily animal care requirements. Coordinate with livestock owners regarding basic animal healthcare needs, where required. Provide basic animal care guidance within the scope of training and authorization. Escalate serious health conditions to qualified veterinarians. Support livestock health awareness and preventive care activities. Maintain individual animal health records. Record vaccination, dewormed, medication, and treatment details. Maintain records of illness, recovery, and veterinary visits. Update daily animal health reports to the Farm Manager. Maintain proper documentation of healthcare activities and schedules. Identify and immediately report emergency health conditions. Provide basic first aid within the scope of training. Coordinate veterinary assistance during emergencies. Follow veterinary instructions for handling sick or injured animals. Ensure timely communication of critical animal health issues. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Daily animal health monitoring and reporting. Timely identification and escalation of health issues. Proper maintenance of animal health records. Timely completion of vaccination and dewormed schedules. Proper implementation of veterinarian instructions. Maintenance of animal hygiene and welfare standards. Timely response to animal healthcare requirements. Working Hours As per farm operational requirements. Requirements Required Qualifications Certificate, Diploma, or relevant training in Veterinary Assistance, Animal Husbandry, Livestock Management, or a related field. 1-3 years of practical experience in cattle and livestock care is preferred. Knowledge of basic animal health monitoring and hygiene practices. Understanding of vaccination, dewormed, and preventive healthcare procedures. Experience working in dairy farms or livestock management is an added advantage. Required Skills Ability to handle cattle and other livestock safely and responsibly. Good observation and animal health monitoring skills. Knowledge of basic veterinary care and animal hygiene. Good communication and reporting skills. Ability to maintain accurate animal health records. Problem-solving and emergency coordination skills. Patience, responsibility, and compassion towards animals. Ability to work independently and coordinate with farm staff. Professional Limitations Responsibilities Must work under the guidance of a qualified Veterinarian wherever required. Must not independently diagnose complex diseases or claim to practice as a licensed Veterinarian. Must not independently prescribe restricted veterinary medicines or perform unauthorized procedures. All treatments, medications, and clinical procedures must follow applicable veterinary regulations and authorized protocols. Must immediately refer serious or complicated cases to a qualified Veterinarian. Preferred Candidate Immediate joiners preferred. Candidates based in or willing to work in Coimbatore. Candidates with practical experience in cattle and dairy farm management. Candidates with a strong interest in animal healthcare and livestock welfare. Candidates willing to work in a farm environment. Benefits Direct full-time employment. Salary based on experience and skill set. Opportunity to work in professional farm operations. Practical exposure to livestock healthcare and animal management. Career growth and learning opportunities.

title: Video Editor Intern
description:
Job Summary 
 Job Title: Video Editor Intern Location: Bangalore Reports to: Head of Brand Term: 3-6 months, with the possibility of a full-time role Requirement: You should already be able to turn raw footage into engaging videos for social media, with a strong sense of pacing, storytelling, sound, and captions. Your portfolio matters more than your degree or previous job titles. You'll work with our creative team in the Bangalore office. We'll provide the tools and help you develop your editing skills, while training you on shoot setup, our content calendar, and publishing. As you grow, you may take greater ownership of video edits and the posting of approved content across our channels. 
 
 Role Overview 
 You'll work under the Head of Brand, editing short-form videos each week and helping plan shoots and manage day-to-day social media tasks for Alt Carbon. Editing is the heart of this role: you'll turn footage into engaging Instagram videos, launch videos, and company content, then refine your cuts based on feedback. We're looking for someone who can use AI tools to work faster without compromising quality. For example, you might use them to create an animation that would take hours to make by hand. Experience using editing apps alongside tools such as Higgsfield, Claude, or ChatGPT is a strong plus. As you deliver consistent work, you may take greater ownership of editing and publishing approved content across our channels, with the possibility of a full-time role. 
 
 What You'll Do 
 Video editing (most of your time) Edit 15-60 second videos for Instagram, YouTube, and other channels using footage from our shoots, existing footage, and stock assets. Help us publish videos consistently each week, with strong pacing, clean audio, captions, and on-screen text. Revise edits based on feedback and prepare final versions for each platform. Organise footage and project files across our online storage and local drives so the team can find and reuse them. Use AI tools where they help you work faster without compromising quality. Support longer videos, such as explainers and mini-documentaries, as you grow into the role. Social media operations Keep the content calendar up to date with post dates, captions, assets, owners, and approval status. Schedule or publish content once it has been approved. Track basic post performance and share useful observations with the team. Find and share examples of content that could inspire our work, based on what performs well on each platform. Shoots and production support Assist with office content shoots: setup, lighting, audio, shot lists and capturing behind-the-scenes footage. Manage and organise footage, files and project folders so the team can find things fast. 
 
 What We're Looking For 
 We care more about the work you can show us than your degree or previous job titles. Please include samples of videos you edited yourself-for a client, an agency, a college project, or your own channel. Editing skills. You can turn raw footage into a finished video with clear storytelling, strong pacing, clean audio, captions, and well-placed text. A feel for short-form video. You understand hooks, jump cuts, and what makes people keep watching on Reels and Shorts. Confidence with editing tools. You\'re comfortable using Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or a similar editor, and can work efficiently. Reliability. You meet deadlines, flag delays early, and keep your files organised. Openness to feedback. You can take notes, make revisions, and improve an edit without losing the story. Fast learning. You pick up new tools and workflows quickly and put what you learn into practice.

title: Brand Associate
description:
Brand Associate Job Category: Agency Job Type: Full Time Job Location: Mumbai As part of our Record Label and Agency business, the Brand Solution Associate, based out of our Mumbai office, will play a critical role in bridging internal creative, strategy, and production teams with external clients and brand partners. This role is pivotal to ensuring the smooth execution of campaigns, managing brand expectations, and delivering high-impact collaborations that reinforce Azadi Records ethos and cultural positioning. Responsibilities: Brand Strategy Identity Development: Assist in building the brand identity of Azadi Records and its brand, ensuring alignment with industry trends and target audience preferences. Contribute to brainstorming sessions for brand strategies, focusing on positioning the label and its artists in innovative and unique ways. Pitch Creation Brand Partnerships: Assist in developing compelling pitches for potential brand partnerships and sponsorships, highlighting the value and unique appeal of the label. Support the preparation of personalised pitches for external brands, ensuring clear communication of the label s values, artist profiles, and potential collaboration ideas. Pitch Deck Development: Work closely with the team to design and create high-quality, visually appealing pitch decks for internal and external presentations. Ensure the decks are visually cohesive, engaging and communicate key brand messaging and partnership opportunities. Research and gather data to support pitch deck content, including audience insights, industry benchmarks, and case studies. Brand Research Targeting: Conduct detailed research to identify brands that align with Azadi Records values and brand aesthetics. Assist in segmenting and prioritising potential brand partnerships based on market trends, brand alignment, and target demographics. Content for Pitch Decks: Collaborate with graphic designers and content creators to generate visuals, infographics, and multimedia content for use in pitch decks. Help draft compelling narratives that clearly articulate the label s brand identity, artist stories, and the mutual value for potential brand partners. Client Servicing: Serve as a liaison between clients, artists, and internal departments to ensure all deliverables and expectations are met on time and to standard. Coordinate communication and workflow between the brand, creative, and production teams, ensuring that client feedback is effectively incorporated. Maintain up-to-date documentation of client requirements, revisions, and final approvals across campaigns and deliverables. Support the Project Manager in overseeing timelines and troubleshooting potential issues to maintain seamless execution. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients by providing proactive updates, solution-oriented communication, and professional support during campaigns and partnerships. Market Audience Research: Assist in researching competitors brand collaborations and emerging trends in the music and branding industries. Gather insights into target audiences and their behaviour to support pitch decks with data-driven solid arguments. Social Media Campaign Integration: Provide ideas for integrating brand partnerships into the label s social media and digital platforms. Collaborate on building case studies from past campaigns for future pitch decks, highlighting successful collaborations and artist engagement. Brand Collaboration Execution: Support the execution of brand partnership campaigns, ensuring that branding guidelines and collaboration terms are met throughout the process. Assist in tracking and reporting on the performance of partnerships, gathering insights to include in future pitches and presentations. Internal Brand Communication: Work closely with the brand and marketing teams to ensure clear communication of pitch strategies, updates, and ongoing brand collaborations. Attend and support internal meetings by taking notes, contributing ideas, and organising materials for pitch meetings. Cold Outreach: Initiate contact with brands through email, phone calls, or social media to introduce the artist and propose collaborations. Follow-Up: Manage follow-ups and continue conversations with brands to keep potential partnerships alive.

Working as an individual contributor under the guidance of the Admin Team Lead, you will execute day-to-day operational tasks to keep our corporate office running smoothly and support our leadership and sales teams. Qualification & Experience Education: Graduate in any discipline. Experience: 14 years of hands-on experience in Office Administration, Front Desk, or Operations Support. Technical Skills: Strong working knowledge of Google Sheets , MS Excel (maintaining trackers, basic formulas), Word, and email communication. Language: Good communication skills in English, Hindi, and Marathi (for coordinating with local vendors and building staff). Key Responsibilities 1. Data Management & Google Sheets Reporting Maintain, update, and organize daily operational data across Google Sheets and Excel trackers (covering travel logs, vendor bills, attendance/visitor logs, data stock records). Ensure accurate data entry, clean documentation, and timely sharing of updated trackers with the Admin TL and Finance team. 2. Daily Office Upkeep & Facility Support Monitor daily housekeeping, pantry services, office hygiene, and basic maintenance at the office. Coordinate directly with building maintenance staff and external technicians (electricians, plumbers, AC/IT support), Mobile recharges, renew lease agreement, handling office documentations to resolve routine facility issues promptly, escalating major repairs to the Admin TL. Prepare workstations, seating, and welcome kits for new joiners in coordination with HR and IT. 3. Travel & Logistics Coordination Book domestic flights, trains, hotels, and local cabs as instructed for senior leadership and sales staff traveling across cities for site visits and developer meetings. Track travel itineraries, assist with last-minute schedule changes, and compile travel bills in Google Sheets for Finance reimbursement. 4. Vendor Coordination & Inventory Tracking Maintain daily stock counts of office stationery, pantry supplies, printing materials, and sales collaterals, alerting the Admin TL when reorders are needed. Coordinate with approved local vendors (couriers, printers, water/pantry suppliers) for timely deliveries. Collect vendor bills, verify delivery challans, and submit verified invoices to the Admin TL / Finance team for payment processing. 5. Visitor Management Greet visiting real estate developers, client . Manage incoming and outgoing couriers, letters, and parcels with proper logbook entries. Assist in arranging refreshments, seating, and basic logistics for internal meetings, interviews, and training sessions. 6. Asset & Record Maintenance Update Google Sheets / Excel trackers for office assets (SIM cards, access cards) issued to employees. Collect company assets and ID cards during employee exits and hand them over to IT/HR. Required Skills Google Sheets & Data Accuracy: Comfortable working daily on Google Sheets, maintaining clean trackers, and handling data entry without errors. Hands-On & Proactive: Willing to roll up your sleeves and execute day-to-day operational tasks accurately. Attention to Detail: Careful with travel dates, booking details, inventory counts, and bill verification. Time Management: Able to prioritize urgent requests (like last-minute flight changes) alongside routine daily checklists. Polite & Approachable: Friendly, helpful attitude when dealing with employees, visitors, and support staff.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Robotics Hardware
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
  
  
**Senior Mechanical Engineer — Robotics Hardware**
**Location**
- Bangalore
  
  
Instawork Robotics Labs is building Instacore, our proprietary five-camera and IMU wearable capture rig. Hundreds of units operate across India every day, collecting real-world data used to train frontier Physical AI models.
  
  
We are looking for a senior, mechanically focused engineer to own the complete hardware lifecycle for Instacore and future hardware products. This person will independently lead design, prototyping, manufacturing, testing, deployment, logistics, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the mechanical design and development of Instacore and other robotics hardware from initial requirements through production and field deployment.
* Create detailed CAD models, assemblies, engineering drawings, bills of materials, and manufacturing documentation.
* Rapidly prototype and validate designs using 3D printing, machining, fabrication, and off-the-shelf components.
* Design durable mounts, enclosures, fixtures, wearable components, packaging, and protective systems.
* Own design for manufacturability, assembly, serviceability, reliability, and cost.
* Improve cable routing, connector retention, strain relief, thermal management, ingress protection, and resistance to vibration and impact.
* Design packaging and logistics processes that prevent damage during storage and transit.
* Establish verification, stress-testing, quality-control, and acceptance-testing procedures.
* Investigate field failures, determine root causes, and implement corrective improvements across the fleet.
* Own the maintenance and repair strategy for deployed hardware, including spare parts, repair documentation, and technician procedures.
* Manage vendors, fabricators, component suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
* Own component sourcing, inventory planning, hardware logistics, and deployment readiness.
* Work closely with robotics, electrical, firmware, software, operations, and field teams to deliver complete systems.
* Build repeatable processes that allow the hardware fleet to scale reliably across India and APAC.
* Mentor technicians and junior engineers while remaining deeply hands-on.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Product Design, Robotics, or a related discipline.
* \*\*Five to seven years of hands-on experience\*\* designing and delivering physical products or robotics hardware.
* Advanced proficiency with CAD, including complex parts, assemblies, drawings, tolerance definition, and revision management.
* Strong experience with rapid prototyping and 3D printing, including material selection, print orientation, tolerances, and design limitations.
* Experience taking products from early prototypes through low-volume or scaled production.
* Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, fasteners, tolerances, load paths, fatigue, vibration, and impact resistance.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose mechanical failures and implement robust, practical solutions.
* Experience working with vendors and managing manufacturing, sourcing, inventory, packaging, or logistics.
* Ability to independently prioritize work, make engineering decisions, and own outcomes with limited oversight.
* Willingness to travel across India and APAC for vendor visits, deployments, and field investigations.

**Good to have**

* Electrical engineering knowledge, particularly wiring, connectors, sensors, cameras, power systems, printed circuit board integration, and basic electronics troubleshooting.
* Experience designing electromechanical or wearable products.
* Programming proficiency in Python, C++, or another relevant language.
* Experience writing scripts for test automation, hardware validation, data analysis, or manufacturing workflows.
* Familiarity with Raspberry Pi, embedded systems, computer vision hardware, or IoT devices.
* Experience managing engineering documentation and product data using version-control or product-lifecycle-management systems.
* Experience building or leading a small hardware engineering function.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Instacore has a clear, reliable, and scalable hardware architecture.
* New designs move efficiently from requirements through prototype, validation, and deployment.
* Field failures, wire breakages, and transit damage decline measurably.
* Manufacturing, repair, inventory, and logistics processes are documented and repeatable.
* Junior engineers and technicians can assemble, test, and repair units using the systems you establish.
* Hardware development no longer depends on day-to-day involvement from the broader team.

**Our Values**

* Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**
Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
  
  
Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
  
  
Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York and Phoenix, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
Job Title: Chief Executive Officer

Location: Bangalore

Reporting to: Group Chief Executive Officer

Experience Required: 18 to 25 Years (At least 3 to 6 Years as CEO or COO or MD)

Candidates from other cities and from overseas who are open to relocating are welcome.

Compensation: Highly competitive and in line with the seniority of the role - 2.5 to 4.0 Cr.

**Role at a glance**

A promoter-led real estate group is appointing its first professional Chief Executive Officer to run an operating Grade-A office portfolio and lead its next phase of growth.

Title: Chief Executive Officer

Location: Bengaluru (relocation supported; candidates from across India and the Gulf welcome)

Reports to: Promoter / Chairman and the Board

Portfolio: 3.0–5.0 million sq ft of operating and under-development Grade-A office space

Direct reports: Heads of Leasing, Asset & Property Management, Projects, Finance, Legal & Secretarial, HR

Mandate: Full P&L, asset value, capital plan and the professional management of the business

Experience: 20+ years in real estate, with at least 5 years leading a business unit or company

**About the opportunity**

The group has built a portfolio of large Grade-A office campuses leased to multinational and Indian occupiers. Until now the promoter family has run it directly. The next phase needs a seasoned operator who can run the platform on institutional lines while keeping the speed and judgement of a founder-led firm.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's. The CEO will set up the management structure, systems and governance that turn a family-run asset owner into a professionally managed real estate company. That company should be ready for institutional capital, a REIT-style platform or strategic partnerships over time.

The CEO works closely with the promoters as a trusted partner. Strategy and capital decisions are shared; execution and day-to-day leadership sit with the CEO.

**Purpose of the role and what success looks like**

The CEO's job is to grow the value and the income of the portfolio, and to build a leadership team and governance that can run it without the promoters in the day-to-day.

* **First 12 months.**
  Take full charge of operations, leasing and finance. Agree a 5-year business plan and annual budget with the Board. Put the senior team in place, filling gaps where needed. Bring in a monthly MIS, delegation-of-authority matrix and asset-level P&L.
* **Years 2–3.**
  Keep occupancy at or above market for comparable Grade-A stock. Deliver the development pipeline on time and on budget. Refinance or restructure debt to lower the cost of capital. Lift net operating income and asset value through renewals, rent escalations and tenant retention. Get the business ready for institutional investors, with clean title, audited asset-level accounts and compliance in order.
* **Beyond.**
  Lead the group's next growth step, whether new campuses, acquisitions, joint ventures or a listed or private investment platform.

**Key responsibilities**

The CEO owns the business end to end. The responsibilities fall into eight areas.

**1. Strategy and business planning**

* Build and own the 5-year strategy and the annual operating plan for the portfolio, and present both to the Board.
* Set targets for occupancy, rent growth, net operating income, development delivery and return on capital.
* Track the office market (supply, absorption, rentals, occupier demand) and turn it into hold, develop, sell or acquire decisions.
* Spot growth options: new land, joint development agreements, acquisitions of leased assets, and new formats such as flex space or data-centre-ready buildings.

**2. Leasing and occupier relationships**

* Lead the leasing strategy for 3.0–5.0 million sq ft: pre-leasing of new buildings, renewals, expansions and backfilling of vacated space.
* Personally lead the relationships and negotiations with large anchor occupiers and global capability centres.
* Manage relationships with the leasing advisory firms and the broker channel.
* Set rent, escalation, lock-in and fit-out terms that protect long-term asset value, and keep tenant concentration in check.
* Run an occupier experience programme that drives retention and renewals.

**3. Asset and property management**

* Run each building as a profit centre, with its own P&L, capital-expenditure plan and value targets.
* Oversee property and facility management across the campuses: maintenance, security, energy, safety and occupier services, whether in-house or outsourced.
* Plan upgrades and repositioning of older buildings to keep them Grade-A.
* Lead the sustainability agenda: green-building certifications, energy and water efficiency, and ESG reporting expected by multinational occupiers and investors.
* Track and recover common area maintenance (CAM) charges, receivables and service-level performance.

**4. Development and projects**

* Own delivery of the development pipeline, from design brief and approvals through construction to handover.
* Appoint and manage architects, project managers and contractors; hold them to cost, time and quality.
* Make sure new supply matches occupier demand and pre-leasing commitments.
* Work with government bodies on approvals, land use and infrastructure.

**5. Finance, capital and investor readiness**

* Own the P&L, cash flow and balance sheet, together with the CFO.
* Plan and raise capital: construction finance, lease rental discounting, refinancing, and in time equity from institutional or strategic partners.
* Bring in institutional-grade reporting: monthly MIS, asset-level accounts, valuations and budget-versus-actual reviews.
* Prepare the platform for a possible REIT, InvIT-style vehicle or platform deal, including due diligence, data rooms and investor relations.

**6. Legal, compliance and governance**

* Make sure title, approvals, leases and statutory filings are complete and clean across every asset.
* Oversee the legal and company secretarial function, including contracts, litigation and regulatory compliance.
* Set up the governance a professional company needs: a delegation-of-authority matrix, Board and committee processes, internal audit and risk management.
* Keep the separation between the business and the promoter family's other interests clear and documented.

**7. People and organisation**

* Design the organisation and hire, develop and keep a strong senior team.
* Build a performance culture with clear goals, reviews and incentives tied to business results.
* Plan succession for key roles and develop the next line of leaders.
* Lead a team that may grow to 150–200 people across leasing, operations, projects and support functions.

**8. Promoter and stakeholder partnership**

* Act as the promoters' trusted partner: keep them informed, seek their input on big decisions, and earn their confidence to delegate.
* Represent the company with occupiers, lenders, investors, government and industry bodies.
* Protect and build the group's reputation as a landlord of choice.

**Candidate profile**

The ideal candidate has already run a large commercial office platform, or a major part of one, with full accountability for results.

**Must have**

* 20+ years in real estate, with at least 5 years as CEO, COO, business head or head of a commercial office vertical.

The package is in the top quartile for CEOs in Indian commercial real estate. It combines fixed pay, an annual performance bonus and a long-term incentive tied to growth in asset value.
