Learn more about us at our website: www.mcfadyen.com
  
  
**Opportunity**
Do you enjoy building an online community from the ground up and watching members become active contributors? McFadyen Digital is seeking an Online Community Manager to launch, grow and lead an affiliated AI best practices community for commerce practitioners. You will shape where the community lives online, what it discusses and how members connect, learn and contribute, while guiding a Research Analyst and keeping every conversation relevant to people applying AI in commerce.
  
  
**Top 5 Responsibilities**

* Grow and engage the online community: Attract, onboard and activate commerce and AI practitioners, growing members, subscribers and active participants against agreed targets.
* Own the community platform and member experience: Manage the community space (such as Circle or Slack), including its structure, onboarding journeys, moderation, community guidelines and recognition programs that keep members returning.
* Lead community programming: Plan and host discussion threads, AMAs, webinars and virtual events that spark participation and peer-to-peer exchange.
* Own the content plan and editorial calendar: Set content priorities for the community, newsletter and social channels, and ensure every piece meets the editorial standard and serves member needs.
* Drive audience growth across digital channels: Plan and optimize organic and paid programs on LinkedIn, Google and other channels, managing budget, targeting and cost per member.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Guide the Research Analyst's priorities and review research and content before publication.
* Run the newsletter and social channels from planning through performance review.
* Identify and develop community advocates, ambassadors, guest contributors and partners.
* Monitor community health and sentiment, moderate discussions and resolve issues in line with community guidelines.
* Track and report on members, subscribers, engagement, retention and content performance, and act on the insights.
* Apply SEO, AEO and GEO best practices so community content is found by people and AI search engines.
* Identify McFadyen-fit members and share them with the McFadyen Demand Generation team according to agreed handoff rules.
* Coordinate with McFadyen marketing on shared campaigns and brand standards.
* Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up content planning, moderation, workflow and analysis.

**Top 5 KPIs**

* Lead generation: Number of qualified leads generated through research and content.
* Subscriber growth: Growth in newsletter and community subscribers.
* Site traffic: Increase in website visits driven by published content.
* Content engagement: Performance of content in driving reader engagement, such as time on page and click-through rates.
* Community engagement: Level of community participation, including comments, discussion threads, and shares.

**Top 5 Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in online community management, audience growth or content marketing, ideally in B2B technology.
* Proven track record of launching or growing an online community, with measurable results in membership and engagement.
* Hands-on experience with community and newsletter platforms such as Circle, Slack, Discord, Discourse, Beehiiv or Substack.
* Experience using Claude or other generative AI tools in daily community or marketing work.
* Analytical and organized, comfortable with GA4 and community analytics, and able to guide others and run several programs at once.

**Additional Qualifications**

* Knowledge of AI, eCommerce or B2B commerce.
* Experience with paid social and paid search, especially LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Google Ads.
* Experience guiding or mentoring a writer, analyst or content specialist.
* Experience planning and hosting webinars, AMAs and virtual events.
* Experience with HubSpot, Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement), Zoho or Salesforce.
* Strong content judgment and excellent writing skills, with experience owning an editorial calendar.
* Fluent English is required.

**What We Can Offer You**

* The opportunity to work with thought leaders who literally wrote the book on Marketplace Best Practices.
* Work in the fast-paced world of retail eCommerce, digital marketplaces and platform businesses.
* Collaboration with first-movers who are deploying new business models and AI strategies worldwide.
* A flat structure without rigid hierarchy and bureaucracy.
* A culture that rewards creativity and innovation, risk-taking and teamwork.

**Additional Information**
**Our Core Values:**

title: Performance Media Buyer
description:
We're growing Zeno Media and looking for someone to join us as we build out our in-house performance marketing team.

We work with businesses across different industries, including education, finance and construction, helping them generate leads and acquire customers through paid advertising.

We're looking for someone who understands the whole process of acquiring a customer, not just running ads.

Someone who can take a new client, understand their business and offer, figure out the right marketing approach, build the campaigns and landing pages, and keep improving things once they're live.

**Here's our ideal candidate:**

* Ideally, you have 2+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience, either at an agency or as a freelancer
* You've managed multiple campaigns, worked with substantial advertising budgets and have results to show for it.
* You're someone who enjoys figuring things out independently. If a campaign isn't working, you don't need someone to tell you to investigate. If a landing page could be better, you'll suggest changes.
* We're also quite big on using AI tools to work faster, whether that's for research, creative production, landing pages or day-to-day workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Paid Advertising & Campaign Management**

* Plan, launch and manage Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns.
* Manage multiple client accounts and advertising budgets.
* Optimise campaigns for CTR, CPL, conversion rates and overall acquisition costs.
* Identify winning campaigns and scale them profitably.
* Conduct audience research, targeting and campaign testing.

**2. Creative Strategy & Production**

* Develop creative strategies and messaging angles for different audiences.
* Ideate high-performing ad creatives for Meta and Google.
* Write compelling ad copy, headlines and hooks.
* Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to produce and iterate on creative assets.
* Coordinate the end-to-end creative process, from ideation to campaign deployment.

**3. Landing Pages & Conversion Optimisation**

* Build and optimise high-converting landing pages using WordPress.
* Understand landing page structure, user experience and conversion psychology.
* Continuously test and improve landing page performance.
* Identify conversion bottlenecks and recommend improvements.

**4. Google Ads & Search Optimisation**

* Conduct keyword research and search intent analysis.
* Build and optimise Google Search campaigns.
* Monitor search terms, keyword performance, bidding and ad relevance.
* Improve campaign efficiency through continuous optimisation.

**5. Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Track campaign performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Analyse CTR, CPC, CPL, conversion rates and cost per acquisition.
* Provide clear performance updates and actionable recommendations.
* Take ownership of campaign outcomes rather than simply reporting metrics.

**Mandatory Application Requirement**

**A portfolio demonstrating previous campaign results is mandatory.**

We want to see:

* Previous campaigns you've managed.
* Advertising budgets and results achieved.
* CTR, CPL and conversion rate improvements.
* Examples of creatives and landing pages you've worked on.
* Your specific contribution to the results.

Applications without a portfolio or demonstrable campaign results will not be considered.

**What We Offer**

* Fully remote working arrangement.
* Flexible part-time commitment of 15-20 hours per week.
* Attractive monthly retainer.
* Opportunity to work across multiple industries and client accounts.
* Ownership of the end-to-end paid acquisition process.

**Interested?**

Apply with your CV and portfolio showcasing your previous campaign results.

We're looking for someone who knows how to turn advertising spend into measurable business growth.

description:
**Why Harvey**
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
  
  
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
  
  
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
  
  
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Technical Customer Experience (CX) Specialist, you will be frontline support within our global support team, reporting to a CX Manager. You’ll help legal, tax, and finance professionals at some of the world’s largest firms get the most out of Harvey, and you’ll own technical issues from first response through root cause. This isn’t a typical SaaS support role: Harvey moves fast, priorities shift often, and you’ll wear multiple hats as the product and team scale. We’re looking for someone who loves problem-solving, thrives with ambiguity, and pairs strong technical instincts with real empathy for enterprise customers.
  
  
**Shift schedules are being finalized and may include hours outside standard local business hours to support our global customers. Specific working hours will be discussed during the interview process and confirmed before an offer is accepted.**
**What You’ll Do**

* Serve as the first point of contact for customer support inquiries, delivering empathetic, accurate, and timely resolutions.
* Juggle multiple competing priorities and tasks, ensuring a high level of service and responsiveness.
* Own technical issues across topics like AI output quality, login and SSO, authentication and tokens, REST API integrations, and error logs, working each to root cause by confirming scope, ruling out configuration and environment, and knowing why a fix will work before sending it.
* Investigate with Datadog (including RUM session replay), Omni, Snowflake, and Auth0, and use Claude Code and the Datadog MCP integration to get to answers faster.
* Maintain a high standard of reliability and accountability, ensuring consistent coverage and follow-through during assigned shifts.
* Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot complex issues, escalating them appropriately when needed.
* Maintain a deep understanding of our products and services to provide knowledgeable support.
* Document customer interactions and feedback to aid in continuous improvement of our services.
* Work closely with other departments to resolve customer issues and contribute to the overall customer experience.
* Collaborate effectively as part of a team while confidently owning and executing tasks independently.
* Stay informed of new product features and updates to provide accurate and current support.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of support processes and materials, such as FAQs and knowledge base articles.

**What You Have**

* 3+ years proven experience in a technical support role, in a fast-paced environment providing “white glove” or “premium support” to large enterprise customers for AI-driven products
* Exceptional empathy and a genuine desire to help and connect with customers.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and resolve complex issues.
* Excellent organisational skills, capable of managing multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment, with a track record of taking ownership
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex information in an understandable manner.
* Understanding of APIs, and ability to explain complex API concepts to both technical and non-technical customers.
* Familiarity with customer support tools and CRM systems; experience with Zendesk, Salesforce is a plus.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and build positive working relationships across departments.
* A passion for learning and personal growth, with a commitment to staying informed about industry trends and best practices.
* Availability to participate in an on-call rotation outside scheduled working hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, in accordance with the company’s on-call policy.

**Additional Information**

* Work eligibility: Must be authorized to work in India. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

title: Sales Systems Analyst – Salesforce Administrator
description:
**Overview**
The Sales Systems Analyst (Salesforce Administrator) will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, configuration, development and ongoing optimization of the company's Salesforce.com environment, ensuring it is a reliable, scalable and accurate system of record for the global sales organization. This role will also support integrations with related sales technologies and will build and maintain the reports and dashboards used for weekly, monthly and quarterly sales reporting. Working closely with Global Sales Operations, Finance, IT and business stakeholders, this role will play a critical part in turning business requirements into practical Salesforce solutions that improve sales productivity, data integrity and forecasting predictability.
  
  
**Key Tasks & Responsibilities**
**Salesforce Administration & Support:**
  
  

+ Perform daily administration of Salesforce.com, including user setup and deactivation, roles, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules and license management
+ Serve as the primary point of contact for Salesforce support requests, triaging, prioritizing and resolving issues in a timely manner
+ Manage sandboxes, seasonal Salesforce releases and change control, testing new functionality and communicating impacts to users
+ Maintain system documentation, including data dictionaries, configuration details and process flows

**Technical Configuration & Development**
  
  

+ Design, build and maintain solutions, including custom objects and fields, page layouts, validation rules, lightning pages and flows
+ Gather and translate business requirements into technical specifications and deliver solutions through a documented build, test and deployment process
+ Review and prioritize enhancement requests with Global Sales Operations and other stakeholders

**Integrations & Data Management**
  
  

+ Support and enhance integrations between Salesforce and other sales technologies and, as needed, assist with administration of those tools, working with IT and vendors
+ Build and maintain integrations using native connectors
+ Ensure data integrity and accuracy within the CRM through data quality rules, duplicate management, routine audits and clean-up
+ Manage data imports, exports, migrations and mass updates

**Reporting & Analytics**
  
  

+ Create, update and maintain reports and dashboards that support weekly, monthly and quarterly sales reporting, pipeline visibility and forecasting.
+ Respond to ad hoc reporting and data requests from sales leadership and cross-functional teams
+ Monitor system usage and adoption metrics and recommend improvements to maximize the return on sales technology investments

**Process Improvement & User Enablement**
  
  

+ Partner with Global Sales Operations to identify opportunities to streamline sales processes and automate manual work within Salesforce
+ Develop user guides and release notes, and deliver training to help the sales team make effective use of Salesforce
+ Collaborate with marketing, proposals and solution consulting teams to align Salesforce processes and data across the go-to-market lifecycle

**Other duties as assigned, including additional sales systems projects and responsibilities as the function evolves**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field and/or equivalent work experience preferred
* 5+ years of hands-on experience administering and configuring Salesforce.com preferred.
* Experience in a life sciences or other regulated industry preferred
* Salesforce Certified Administrator required; Salesforce Platform App Builder and/or Platform Developer I preferred

**Professional Skills**

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users
* Ability to manage multiple and shifting priorities, adapt to evolving processes and work independently in a fast-paced, global environment
* Collaborative approach, with a service mindset toward internal customers

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Salesforce.com configuration, including security model, Flows, validation rules, reports and dashboards
* Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components and Salesforce APIs
* Experience integrating Salesforce with other tools such as Gong and HubSpot
* Experience with data management tools such as Data Loader, and with deployment tools such as change sets, Salesforce CLI or DevOps platforms
* Proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel

**AI Use Statement**
Employees are expected to appropriately leverage company-approved AI tools to improve productivity and quality while adhering to company policies, protecting confidential information, validating AI-generated content, and exercising sound professional judgment. AI is intended to augment—not replace—professional judgment, critical thinking, accountability, and decision-making. Accountability for all work remains with the employee.

Position Overview:
  
  
The Executive/Senior Executive – Sales Support – Branch is responsible for managing end-to-end billing, invoicing, and collections coordination for branch customers, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to contractual and company guidelines.
  
  
The role acts as a key interface between Sales, Finance, and Customers to ensure smooth revenue realization, effective dispute resolution, and strong process discipline at the branch level.
  
  
Job Purpose:
  
  
To ensure accurate and timely billing, efficient collections follow-up, and resolution of customer billing queries, thereby supporting revenue realization, improving receivables performance, and enhancing customer experience.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
Billing & Invoicing Management
  
  
  

* Coordinate with Branch Finance & Accounts teams for timely bill generation
* Validate accuracy of invoices as per contractual terms and company norms
* Ensure customization of invoices as per customer agreements
* Ensure timely dispatch of invoices to customers

Collections & Receivables Management
  
  
  

* Work closely with Sales teams to ensure timely collections
* Follow up on pending, short, or delayed payments
* Track receivables ageing and escalate as per timelines
* Support improvement of DSO at branch level

Customer Query & Dispute Resolution
  
  
  

* Coordinate with Finance and Sales teams to resolve billing disputes
* Ensure closure of disputes before payment due dates
* Maintain proactive customer communication

Reporting & Governance
  
  
  

* Maintain billing, dispatch, and collection MIS
* Share reports with Branch Finance and Sales leadership
* Ensure adherence to SOPs, audit, and documentation standards

Sales & Branch Coordination
  
  
  

* Align billing cycles with contractual agreements
* Support onboarding of customers from billing readiness perspective
* Ensure coordination across Sales, Operations, and Finance

Process Discipline & Continuous Improvement
  
  
  

* Adhere to defined SOPs and processes
* Identify recurring issues and highlight to supervisor
* Suggest improvements to enhance accuracy and turnaround time
* Support automation and process improvement initiatives
* Apply learnings from errors and audit observations

People & Team Support
  
  
  

* Provide operational guidance to branch sales teams
* Ensure process adherence and performance discipline
* Support manpower planning inputs where required

* Experience in billing, invoicing, collections, or sales support roles

* Understanding of billing and invoicing processes

title: Senior Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – GCP
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – GCP builds and runs the foundation of Google Cloud platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.
  
  
This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.

title: Enterprise Architect - Integration
description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
  
  
Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
  
  
The Enterprise Architect - Integration is a senior technology leadership role responsible for defining and governing Empower's enterprise integration strategy across APIs, events, messaging, batch/file transfer, SaaS platforms, cloud-native services, legacy systems, data flows, and partner ecosystems.
  
  
This role partners closely with business and technology teams to create a technology vision and ensure that resulting systems and solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, observable, reusable, and aligned with business capabilities. The architect will develop integration strategies, reference architectures, reusable patterns, roadmaps, standards, and guidance across the IT delivery organization while addressing total cost of ownership, stability, performance, operational efficiency, and risk.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines enterprise-level architecture leadership with practical delivery experience. They can evaluate technology options, influence architecture decisions, explain trade-offs, coach delivery teams, and rapidly prove technical concepts using modern integration platforms, cloud services, automation, and engineering practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and execute a business-aligned integration architecture strategy and vision for Empower.
* Develop, document, and maintain technology roadmaps for enterprise integration capabilities, including API management, event streaming, messaging, iPaaS, data integration, cloud integration, and partner connectivity.
* Create reference architectures, reusable patterns, standards, and decision frameworks for integration across applications, data, SaaS, legacy, and third-party ecosystems.
* Guide teams on when to use synchronous APIs, asynchronous messaging, event-driven architecture, batch/file transfer, data replication, change data capture, or workflow/process orchestration.
* Leverage knowledge of service-oriented architecture, microservices, domain-driven design, APIs, events, and integration patterns to deliver secure and scalable solutions.
* Ensure technology teams understand how to use RESTful APIs, resource-oriented design, OpenAPI, API gateways, event brokers, message queues, schema registries, integration runtimes, and modern authentication patterns.
* Define governance for API and event lifecycles, including design standards, versioning, discoverability, ownership, documentation, reuse, consumer onboarding, and deprecation.
* Design and modernize complex systems into cloud-compatible or cloud-native applications where applicable, including strategies for safely migrating legacy integrations to modern platforms.
* Participate in evaluation of new applications, integration platforms, vendor products, cloud services, and technical options; challenge the status quo and create solid business cases that influence technology direction.
* Develop and implement best practices, standards, guardrails, and guidance, and coach technology teams on adoption.
* Make leadership recommendations regarding strategic architecture considerations related to business process design, workflow orchestration, integration modernization, and platform consolidation.
* Provide leadership and direction in software development, platform engineering, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, test automation, and operational readiness practices as they apply to integration solutions.
* Collaborate with business, application, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, operations, PMO, vendor, and third-party teams on architecture and design decisions.
* Respond to evolving security, privacy, resiliency, regulatory, and operational conditions; recommend and implement integration security guidelines.
* Design for reliability and operational excellence, including retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, correlation IDs, distributed tracing, dead-letter handling, error management, monitoring, alerting, and supportability.
* Provide thought leadership, advocacy, articulation, assurance, and ongoing maintenance of the Enterprise Architecture discipline.

**Required Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience in the development, integration, architecture, and delivery of enterprise software systems.
* 7+ years of experience creating solution architectures and strategies across multiple architecture domains, including business, application, data, integration, infrastructure, cloud, and security.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise integration architecture across APIs, messaging, events, batch/file, SaaS, cloud, legacy, and partner integration scenarios.
* Strong knowledge of RESTful API design, OpenAPI specifications, API gateways, API management, API security, versioning, lifecycle management, and developer experience practices.
* Strong knowledge of event-driven architecture, messaging, publish/subscribe patterns, event streaming, event contracts, schema evolution, idempotency, replay, and eventual consistency.
* Hands-on architecture experience with one or more integration technologies or platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Integration Services, Workato, Informatica, IBM App Connect, SAP Integration Suite, Kafka, Confluent, Solace, AWS integration services, or comparable technologies.
* Experience designing secure integrations using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, mTLS, certificates, secrets management, encryption, least privilege, audit logging, and zero-trust principles.
* Experience with cloud and hybrid integration patterns across SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, container platforms, on-premises systems, private connectivity, and enterprise network boundaries.
* Expertise in architectural cross-cutting concerns and trade-offs, including security, resiliency, performance, scalability, caching, observability, availability, operational support, and total cost of ownership.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling, data contracts, canonical data models where appropriate, schema governance, transformation patterns, and integration data ownership.
* Experience with DevOps processes and tools, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code quality controls, deployment automation, environment strategy, and release management for integration solutions.
* Demonstrated competency applying architecture frameworks, architecture decision records, reference architectures, standards, governance processes, and modern delivery methods.
* Understanding of business process analysis, business process management, workflow orchestration, and process automation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex architecture topics for business, executive, and engineering audiences.
* Demonstrated continuous learning of new technologies and ability to translate emerging technology trends into practical enterprise architecture guidance.
* Self-motivated individual who thrives in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Financial services, retirement services, insurance, investments, asset management, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Strong experience with enterprise API management, AWS, system design.
* Advanced experience with Kafka, Confluent, AWS MSK, MQ, or other event streaming and enterprise messaging platforms.
* Experience with change data capture, event sourcing, stream processing, data replication, ETL/ELT, lakehouse integrations, metadata, data lineage, and operational-to-analytical data flows.
* Experience applying domain-driven design, bounded contexts, domain events, anti-corruption layers, and business capability mapping to integration architecture.
* Experience with platform engineering and self-service integration enablement, including reusable templates, golden paths, shared libraries, policy-as-code, developer tooling, and automated governance.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containerization, ingress patterns, service mesh, cloud-native networking, and workload modernization.
* Experience evaluating and rationalizing integration platform portfolios, including iPaaS, API management, event broker, ESB, managed file transfer, B2B/EDI, workflow, and automation tools.
* Experience with enterprise architecture management tools, architecture repositories, capability maps, application portfolio management, and technology lifecycle management.
* Experience with cost optimization for integration platforms, cloud services, runtime consumption, licensing, API traffic, broker throughput, data egress, and platform consolidation.
* Experience enabling AI, automation, or agentic use cases through governed APIs, events, trusted data access, identity controls, and secure integration patterns.
* Relevant certifications such as TOGAF, cloud architect certifications, Kubernetes, security, API management, Kafka/event streaming, MuleSoft, Boomi, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or equivalent practical experience.

Leadership and Behavioral Skills
  
  

* People skills - interacts effectively with business stakeholders, technology teams, executives, vendors, and third-party integrators.
* Influence and motivation - evangelizes architecture direction, motivates teams, and drives adoption without relying solely on formal authority.
* Negotiation and facilitation - helps teams align on architecture decisions, trade-offs, prioritization, and implementation approaches.
* Problem solving - evaluates complex and unique problems, identifies options, explains trade-offs, and recommends pragmatic solutions.
* Big-picture thinking - avoids tunnel vision and evaluates architecture decisions across business, application, data, integration, security, infrastructure, operations, and cost dimensions.
* Business savvy - understands financial services business capabilities and how technology decisions affect customer experience, operational risk, scalability, compliance, and delivery speed.
* Delivery orientation - balances enterprise standards with practical delivery needs and enables teams to move faster through reusable patterns and clear guardrails.
* Coaching mindset: mentors architects, engineers, product owners, and delivery leaders on integration architecture practices and decision-making.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Why Harvey**
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
  
  
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
  
  
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
  
  
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Harvey is building the infrastructure foundation behind one of the most ambitious AI product companies in the world. Our Core Infrastructure team powers every user interaction across Harvey’s legal AI platform, which already processes billions of prompt tokens and millions of daily requests for leading law firms, enterprises, and other high-stakes customers.
  
  
We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Core Infrastructure from Bengaluru as we scale the platform, the team, and the next generation of Harvey products. This is a high-leverage role for a builder-leader who can grow strong engineers, drive technical execution, and raise the bar on reliability, performance, security, and developer velocity.
  
  
This is not a pure operations role. Core Infrastructure at Harvey is responsible for building new systems as well as hardening existing ones, with an emphasis on architecture, scale, and long-term platform leverage rather than reactive firefighting alone.
  
  
Harvey is in a build era, not a maintenance era. New product surfaces ship rapidly, and India engineering is expected to play a foundational role in shaping the architecture, culture, and roadmap of Harvey’s next decade.
  
  
At Harvey, we value
**Decisiveness**
,
**Simplicity**
, and the mindset that
**Job's Not Finished**
. We move fast, prioritize clarity, and are always striving for excellence. If this resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
Core Backend Infrastructure exists to “deliver core infrastructure that powers our products and teams,” and its current mission is operational excellence at scale. The team serves two critical user groups: external customers who need Harvey to be as reliable as the tools it replaces, and internal product engineering teams who need infrastructure they can build on without firefighting.
  
  
The systems this team owns are directly tied to Harvey’s next wave of growth, including agent infrastructure, database resilience, site reliability, vector search, job execution, regional data residency, and multi-cloud scale.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead, hire, and develop a high-agency infrastructure team in Bengaluru, creating a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and strong mentorship.
* Own delivery for core infrastructure investments spanning cloud infrastructure, observability, container orchestration, reliability, and platform foundations.
* Partner closely with Product Engineering, Security, and adjacent platform teams so infrastructure accelerates product delivery instead of constraining it.
* Guide technical strategy across multi-cloud infrastructure, including Azure- and GCP-based systems, Kubernetes orchestration, networking, container management, and infrastructure as code.
* Drive operational excellence through better observability, incident response, disaster recovery, runbooks, alerting, and recovery tooling.
* Help the organization scale safely by improving system design quality, hardening critical paths, and pushing durable solutions to reliability bottlenecks before they become customer-facing failures.
* Partner with AI and product teams to support Harvey’s next major product surfaces, including agent workflows, model infrastructure, and large-scale document processing systems.
* Contribute as a hands-on technical leader when needed, especially in architecture reviews, incident leadership, prioritization, and high-stakes cross-functional programs.

**Representative Problems You May Lead**

* Hardening the Agent Platform so product teams can ship AI agent experiences with resource isolation, authenticated sandbox access, and resilient execution.
* Improving database resilience and recovery so incidents are mitigated quickly and the main database never becomes the bottleneck during critical events.
* Raising site reliability through stronger alerting, failover strategy, autoscaling, and runbooks so customers are never the first to know Harvey is degraded.
* Scaling vector and retrieval infrastructure that underpins document-heavy workflows and enterprise search, including migrations that improve reliability and unlock new capabilities.
* Building a multi-region, enterprise-grade platform that meets strict data residency, security, and uptime expectations for global customers.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 12+ years of hands-on backend infrastructure or platform engineering experience in production environments
* 5+ years of engineering management experience.
* Deep technical strength across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, observability, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code tooling such as Terraform or Pulumi.
* A track record of designing and scaling reliable distributed systems, with strong judgment around performance, fault tolerance, and operational tradeoffs.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives and translating ambiguous platform needs into clear execution plans and measurable outcomes.
* Strong people leadership: hiring well, coaching engineers, creating accountability, and building a healthy, high-performing team culture.
* Clear communication and calm execution during incidents, escalations, and high-stakes customer-impacting situations.
* A systems mindset, bias for simplicity, and the ability to raise standards while keeping teams moving fast.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, high-throughput inference systems, or model platform reliability.
* Experience operating multi-tenant, security-sensitive platforms for enterprise or regulated customers.
* Familiarity with Azure at scale; GCP or AWS experience also transfers well.
* Experience supporting global, follow-the-sun operations or building teams across regions.

**Additional Information**

* Work eligibility: Must be authorized to work in India. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

description:
**Role: Architect**

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a skilled and driven Architect to join our architectural practice in Bangalore. The role is ideal for professionals with at least 3 years of experience in the design and execution of independent residences, villas (contemporary and classical styles), commercial, and retail projects. Proficiency in interior design will be considered a strong advantage, as the role may involve supporting interior architecture and detailing in parallel with core architectural responsibilities.

description:
**Senior Product Analyst**

**Company:**
Fabriplay – An IIT Madras-Incubated FashionTech Startup

**Location:**
Chennai

**Experience:**
4–7 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**About Fabriplay**

Fabriplay is an IIT Madras-incubated FashionTech startup transforming the global bespoke clothing industry through technology. Our AI-powered SaaS platform helps boutiques, fashion designers, and tailoring businesses digitize their operations, streamline workflows, and improve business efficiency.

We are building the digital operating system for the global custom clothing industry, combining SaaS, AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven insights.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a
**Senior Product Analyst**
to shape product strategy, improve user experiences, and drive AI-powered product innovation.

You will work closely with founders, customers, UI/UX designers, and Engineering teams to understand business challenges, identify product opportunities, and translate them into intuitive, intelligent, and scalable solutions.

We are looking for someone who combines product thinking, user empathy, analytical skills, and technology awareness.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Discovery & User Experience**

* Understand customer needs, user behaviour, and business workflows.
* Design and optimize user journeys and product experiences.
* Work with UI/UX teams on wireframes, prototypes, and intuitive interfaces.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows and improve usability and adoption.

**AI & Product Innovation**

* Identify opportunities to leverage AI, Generative AI, LLMs, and intelligent automation.
* Define AI-driven use cases that improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Collaborate with Engineering teams to translate AI opportunities into product capabilities.
* Evaluate AI feature accuracy, reliability, and user impact.

**Data-Driven Product Decisions**

* Analyze product usage, customer behaviour, and feature adoption.
* Define and monitor product KPIs, dashboards, and success metrics.
* Use data and customer insights to prioritize product enhancements.
* Measure the impact of product releases and continuously improve outcomes.

**Product Development & Execution**

* Develop PRDs, functional specifications, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, and QA teams throughout product development.
* Participate in product planning, backlog prioritization, and release management.
* Ensure delivered features meet functional and user experience expectations.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 4–7 years of experience in Product Analysis, Product Management, Business Analysis, or SaaS product development.
* Strong understanding of product discovery, UX principles, and user journey design.
* Experience translating business problems into product requirements.
* Strong analytical skills and experience with data-driven decision-making.
* Understanding of AI, Generative AI, LLMs, and AI-powered applications.
* Experience with PRDs, user stories, workflows, and product documentation.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies, Jira, Figma, and analytics tools.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred:**
Experience in B2B SaaS, ERP, CRM, workflow automation, AI-powered applications, or retail technology.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Product usability and customer experience improvements.
* Feature adoption and customer engagement.
* Quality of data-driven product decisions.
* Successful product delivery and requirement accuracy.
* Measurable impact of AI features on business efficiency.
* Contribution to customer satisfaction and product growth.

**Why Join Fabriplay?**

* Work with an IIT Madras-incubated startup building a global FashionTech platform.
* Shape AI-powered products and intelligent business workflows.
* Work directly with founders and influence product strategy.
* Take ownership of product initiatives from concept to delivery.
* Exposure to emerging technologies and international markets.
* Opportunity to grow into Product Manager or Product Lead roles.

**Ideal Candidate**

You are passionate about understanding users, creating exceptional product experiences, and exploring how AI can solve real-world business problems.

You use data rather than assumptions to make decisions, challenge conventional workflows, and take ownership of transforming ideas into successful product capabilities.

**Come build intelligent products that simplify businesses and redefine the future of fashion technology.**

title: Internal Audit Executives
description:
**Company Description**
RKVT and Co. is a professional services firm specializing in audit, assurance, and financial compliance for clients across diverse industries. The firm focuses on delivering accurate, reliable, and timely financial insights that support sound business decision-making. RKVT and Co. emphasizes adherence to regulatory standards and best practices, while maintaining strong client relationships built on integrity and transparency. Team members are encouraged to develop their technical expertise and professional judgment in a collaborative work environment. The firm values continuous learning and a detail-oriented approach to financial and audit services.
  
**Role Description**
Internal Audit Executives at RKVT and Co. conduct end-to-end internal audits to assess the effectiveness of controls, processes, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing financial statements, examining supporting documentation, testing internal controls, and identifying process gaps or risks. The role involves preparing clear, accurate audit reports with findings and recommendations, supporting GST and other statutory compliance reviews, and collaborating with client teams to implement corrective actions. Internal Audit Executives will also assist in developing audit plans, performing analytical procedures, and maintaining detailed working papers. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai, requiring regular interaction with clients and internal stakeholders.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Audit Reports and Financial Statements, with the ability to prepare, review, and interpret audit documentation and financial data.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills and Finance knowledge to assess risks, evaluate controls, and understand business and financial processes.
* Candidates should possess working knowledge of Goods and Services Tax (GST) and related compliance requirements, including review of GST records and filings.
* Relevant professional qualifications such as CA, CMA, MBA (Finance), or a degree in Commerce/Accounting are preferred.
* Strong attention to detail, integrity, and adherence to ethical standards, with the ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software, along with clear written and verbal communication skills for client interactions and reporting.
* Experience in internal audit, statutory audit, or risk advisory in a firm or corporate environment is an advantage.

title: Site Civil Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Studio 51 Architects is a multidisciplinary design practice that integrates architecture, engineering, and planning to deliver functional and sustainable built environments. The firm focuses on thoughtful site development, infrastructure planning, and context-sensitive design solutions for urban and semi-urban projects. Studio 51 Architects values collaboration between design and engineering teams to achieve efficient, compliant, and cost-effective outcomes. The organization promotes continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth for team members at all levels.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time hybrid role for a Site Civil Engineer based in Chennai, with a mix of on-site project work and some work-from-home flexibility. The Site Civil Engineer will be responsible for planning, designing, and supervising civil works related to site development, including grading, drainage, roads, utilities, and other infrastructure. Daily tasks include preparing design drawings and reports, coordinating with architects and other consultants, reviewing construction documents, and ensuring compliance with applicable codes and standards. The role involves site visits for monitoring construction progress, conducting inspections, verifying adherence to design specifications, and resolving technical issues with contractors on the ground. The Site Civil Engineer will also support quantity estimation, prepare technical documentation, and contribute to project timelines, quality control, and safety practices.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Civil Engineering Design and Civil Engineering fundamentals.
* Candidates should possess practical experience relevant to Civil Engineers working on site development and infrastructure projects.
* Candidates should possess planning-related skills, including site planning and infrastructure layout.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of Stormwater Management, including drainage design and runoff control.
* Relevant bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* Proficiency in design and drafting software (e.g., AutoCAD, Civil 3D or equivalent) and basic MS Office tools.
* Understanding of local building codes, standards, and regulatory approval processes in Chennai/Tamil Nadu.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with attention to detail and quality.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and communicate clearly with clients and contractors.
* Prior experience in site development, infrastructure, or architectural/engineering firms is an advantage.

title: Chief Technology Officer, Healthcare AI
description:
**Hiring for Moative**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

Moative is an AI company that partners with mid-market businesses in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build industry-specific agentic and machine-learning solutions, then scales them across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models. The founders have built and sold two companies, one of them in AI, and the 20+ person team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and mathematicians comes from IITs, IISc, CERN, UZH and IBM Research. Its healthcare business builds AI agents that run revenue-cycle and administrative work for US healthcare practices.

**About the Role**

As CTO for Moative's healthcare business, you'll lead technology for an AI management services organisation (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices. It combines operational expertise, data infrastructure and AI to manage and improve revenue-cycle and administrative workflows, automating tasks progressively with clear controls and human accountability. You'll own technology strategy, platform architecture and the engineering organisation, and stay hands-on in architecture, prototypes, code reviews and hard production problems. The role is based in Chennai (Bengaluru is possible), hybrid with 3 days a week in person with the founders and the healthcare AI pod.

**What you'll do**

* Own technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering standards for the healthcare AI MSO
* Work with founders, practice owners and billing leaders to assess workflows, set baselines and prioritise by business value and feasibility
* Design solutions across EHRs, practice-management systems, clearinghouses and payer portals, covering payer-portal agents, voice payer follow-up, denial management and payment posting
* Define the practice data architecture: claims, remittances, EOBs and denial codes as validated, traceable data, with isolation between practices and de-identified analytics
* Set healthcare privacy, security and compliance controls, plus production evaluation, monitoring, escalation and release criteria
* Make build-versus-buy, vendor and model decisions, and own engineering and infrastructure budgets
* Hire and develop engineers, data scientists and technical leads, and represent Moative's technology to practice owners, partners and investors

**What you bring**

* 15+ years of engineering and technology leadership, with recent hands-on architecture, prototyping and production troubleshooting
* You've built and scaled a product or technology business as a founder, CTO or senior engineering leader, with clear customer adoption and commercial results
* Experience delivering healthcare or RCM products, with a practical grasp of billing workflows, claim submission, payer interactions, denials, appeals and payment posting
* You've led teams that deploy and support AI in live operations, including LLM applications or agents with evaluation, monitoring and human escalation
* Deep experience integrating and modelling fragmented operational data, including multi-customer platforms with clear data isolation
* Strong Python, SQL and cloud architecture on AWS, Azure or GCP
* Technical controls for sensitive healthcare data: access management, audit trails, secure logging, vendor access and incident response
* Experience owning technology budgets and working directly with CXOs, founders and investors

**Nice to have**

* Building for US outpatient practices, MSOs or RCM companies
* Taking a company through an acquisition, merger or exit, including technical diligence
* Turning services engagements into reusable products
* Healthcare data exchange (claims, remittances, EHR, clearinghouses), process mining, or browser and voice agents for operations

title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
description:
**Job Title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance**
**GCL: D3**
**Introduction To Role**
Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?
  
  
In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide.
  
  
You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities—hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams.
* Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption.
* Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability.
* Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks.
* Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption.
* Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery.
* Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value.
* AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline.
* GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization.
* Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
* Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.
* Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design.
* Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security.
* Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments.
* Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles.
* Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations.
* Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts.
* Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies.
* Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments.
* Familiarity with Azure cloud services.
* Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, .NET, or React.
* Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement.
* Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here, platform engineering meets large-scale impact: you will help put data and technology at the heart of how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines. We bring together unexpected combinations of specialists—engineers, scientists, architects, product leaders—around the same table to unlock aggressive thinking and practical outcomes. You will build from scratch as part of an inclusive group of self-starters who share ideas openly, challenge with respect, and take accountability for making things real. We value patience alongside ambition, learn fast from real-world use, and hold high ethical standards because the stakes are patients’ lives.
  
  
If you’re ready to build the enterprise golden paths that make secure delivery the default and accelerate life-changing science, send us your CV and show us the platform you would create next!

21-Oct-2026

title: Geospatial Manager MAP
description:
**Job Summary**
 Geospatial Manager MAP will design and optimize enterprise geospatial solutions using Veeva advanced configuration to support data driven decisions across multiple business units. The role involves managing complex geospatial data pipelines ensuring data quality and guiding teams in implementing scalable cloud based geospatial platforms in a hybrid work model.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design geospatial solution architectures that integrate Veeva advanced configuration with enterprise systems to support reliable mapping analytics and operational reporting workflows
* Oversee implementation of complex geospatial data models that enable accurate spatial analysis routing optimization and territory management for global stakeholders
* Coordinate with product owners data engineers and application teams to translate business needs into robust geospatial configurations that align with company strategy
* Develop advanced Veeva configuration patterns for geospatial features that improve field productivity compliance tracking and scientific engagement outcomes
* Optimize geospatial data ingestion transformation and enrichment pipelines to ensure high data quality performance and timely availability for analytics and dashboards
* Monitor production geospatial platforms for stability scalability and performance while driving continuous improvement based on usage patterns and feedback
* Guide cross functional teams on best practices for map visualization spatial querying and location intelligence to maximize value from geospatial assets
* Collaborate with security and compliance teams to ensure responsible handling of spatial data including patient provider and territory information in line with corporate policies
* Document geospatial configuration standards design decisions and operational runbooks to support consistent implementation and smoother onboarding of new team members
* Coordinate testing strategies for geospatial features including regression performance and user acceptance tests to ensure reliable releases in day shift operations
* Provide technical mentorship to team members on Veeva advanced configuration and geospatial concepts to build a resilient internal capability over time
* Engage with business stakeholders to measure the impact of geospatial solutions on sales planning resource allocation and service coverage and refine roadmaps accordingly
* Align geospatial initiatives with company sustainability and societal impact goals by enabling better planning of outreach programs healthcare access mapping and resource distribution


**Qualifications**
* Require a degree in engineering computer science geography or a related field with substantial focus on geospatial technologies and enterprise systems
* Require eleven to fourteen years of progressive experience working with geospatial solutions including hands on configuration delivery and platform ownership in large organizations
* Require proven experience with Veeva advanced configuration focusing on data model customization business rules workflows and integrations for field facing applications
* Require strong proficiency in geographic information systems tools spatial databases and spatial analysis techniques applied to real world business scenarios
* Require demonstrated ability to design and operate cloud based geospatial platforms using technologies such as managed databases containerized services and modern data pipelines
* Require solid understanding of data integration concepts including API based integration batch processing and near real time data synchronization for geospatial datasets
* Require experience in collaborating with cross functional teams product management and operations to deliver high impact geospatial features on predictable timelines
* Nice to have familiarity with advanced analytics and data science practices for geospatial data including clustering heat mapping and territory optimization methods
* Nice to have experience working in life sciences or highly regulated industries where geospatial solutions support field engagement compliance and reporting needs
* Nice to have exposure to enterprise scale mapping platforms and visualization tools that support complex layers user personalization and responsive design
* Nice to have background in agile delivery practices including backlog grooming sprint planning and incremental rollout of geospatial capabilities in a hybrid work setup
* Nice to have strong communication and stakeholder management skills to explain complex geospatial concepts in accessible language to non technical audiences

title: Technical Consultant - ERP
description:
**Job Description**
The
**Technical Consultant - ERP**
is responsible for the analysis, design, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support of the company’s on-premise SAP HR/Payroll environment. This role will serve as a subject matter expert for SAP HR/Payroll configuration and processing. This role will collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and other technology partners to define solutions that meet business requirements and organizational objectives.
  
The SAP HR/Payroll Architect will also provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to other team members while ensuring solutions are aligned with established development, change management, security, and support processes.
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and/or support on-premise SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6 EHP8 in a manufacturing environment.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for SAP Payroll with experience in Personnel Administration, Organizational Management, and Benefits configuration.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective SAP HR/Payroll designs and configuration solutions.
* Develop alternative solutions, evaluate options, and present recommendations to business stakeholders and IT management.
* Configure, test, implement, and support SAP HR/Payroll changes within a formal System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and change management methodology.
* Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex SAP HR/Payroll issues.
* Implement, maintain, support, and troubleshoot the Rsite Tax Engine , including coordination with Rimini Street and the application, testing, and validation of tax updates and releases.
* Manage the impact of Rsite Tax Engine updates on SAP Payroll, including payroll configuration, tax calculations, testing, regression testing, and production implementation.
* Partner with Rimini Street and other vendors to investigate and resolve tax engine, payroll, and integration-related issues.
* Support payroll tax compliance activities by ensuring applicable federal, state, and local tax updates are appropriately tested and implemented in the Rsite Tax Engine/SAP Payroll environment.
* Understand and manage integration touchpoints between SAP HR/Payroll, Rsite Tax Engine, SuccessFactors, Kronos Workforce Management, and other downstream or upstream applications.
* Implement and support SaaS solutions and their integrations with SAP HR/Payroll.
* Manage, prioritize, and complete support requests for a large and complex organization.
* Estimate and plan work effort for projects, enhancements, upgrades, tax updates, and production support activities.
* Independently perform technical, configuration, testing, documentation, and process-related activities.
* Develop and maintain appropriate system documentation, configuration documentation, test scripts, and support procedures.
* Work collaboratively across HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendor teams with a focus on overall business success.
* Build strong relationships and trust with business users, IT stakeholders, vendors, and management.
* Provide knowledge transfer and training to team members and end users as appropriate.
* Effectively manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced, and constantly changing environment.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5–8 years of hands-on SAP HR/Payroll experience, including configuration and production support.
* Strong technical and functional knowledge of SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6.
* Strong experience with SAP Payroll including experience with Personnel Administration, , Benefits configuration, and Financial Postings.
* Demonstrated experience supporting payroll tax processing and tax-related configuration.
* Hands-on experience with Rimini Street Rsite Tax Engine, including implementation, configuration/support, testing, and application of tax updates. Other tax engine experience will be considered.
* Experience working with Rimini Street and coordinating the implementation and testing of vendor-provided tax and payroll updates is a plus.
* Understanding of integrations between SAP HR/Payroll and external HR, payroll, tax, and other applications.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience working within a formal SDLC/change management process, including requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, implementation, and documentation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with end users, IT staff, business stakeholders, and management.
* Excellent communication, documentation, collaboration, and knowledge-transfer skills.
* Proactive self-starter with the ability to learn new technologies and business processes and utilize available resources effectively.
* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a complex, fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SAP SuccessFactors.
* Experience with Kronos Workforce Management version 8 or higher.
* Experience with Rsite, BSI TaxFactory/TUBs, and/or other SAP payroll tax solutions.
* Experience with SaaS HR/payroll solutions and enterprise application integrations.
* Experience coordinating with third-party application and managed-service providers.
* Experience with payroll tax compliance, year-end processing, and tax update testing.
* Experience leading SAP HR/Payroll projects, enhancements, or major production initiatives.

* Lead system design, configuration, testing, implementation, troubleshooting, and production support activities for Oracle HRMS in a multinational environment.
* Partner with HR, Payroll, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into scalable Oracle HRMS solutions, and recommend best-practice system designs.

description:

title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
description:
**Job Title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance**
**GCL: D3**
**Introduction To Role**
Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?
  
  
In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide.
  
  
You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities—hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams.
* Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption.
* Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability.
* Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks.
* Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption.
* Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery.
* Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value.
* AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline.
* GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization.
* Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
* Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.
* Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design.
* Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security.
* Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments.
* Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles.
* Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations.
* Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts.
* Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies.
* Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments.
* Familiarity with Azure cloud services.
* Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, .NET, or React.
* Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement.
* Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest.

But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.

* Presentation Skills: Proven ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value for mid-level technical decision-makers (Directors of IT, Network Managers).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Mid-level industry certifications such as Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Security), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, MEF SD-WAN Professional, or equivalent.
* Experience navigating the transition of legacy MPLS networks to modern, internet-first SD-WAN or SASE architectures.
* Experience managing or orchestrating vendor relationships (OEMs) for specific components of a larger deal.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
