Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

description:
**Job Description**
Job Description – Senior Presales Manager
  
  
Job Title
  
  
Senior Presales Manager / Lead Presales Consultant
  
  
Department

Reporting To

**Experience Required**
10–12 years of relevant experience in IT services, technology consulting, solution development, or presales.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Senior Presales Manager will lead the development of customer-centric, technically sound, and commercially competitive solutions for strategic opportunities within the IT services business.
  
  
The role requires strong experience in understanding complex customer requirements, designing end-to-end solutions, leading proposal and bid activities, developing commercial models, and presenting value propositions to senior customer stakeholders.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with sales leaders, solution architects, delivery teams, technology partners, finance, legal, commercial, and executive management teams to improve deal quality, win probability, and business growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Opportunity Qualification and Presales Strategy
* Partner with sales teams to qualify opportunities based on customer needs, strategic fit, competitive positioning, delivery capability, and commercial viability.
* Lead presales planning for strategic and complex opportunities.
* Define the overall solution strategy, win themes, value proposition, and competitive differentiators.
* Identify customer business challenges, technology priorities, decision criteria, and key stakeholders.
* Recommend bid or no-bid decisions based on opportunity assessment, risk, investment, and expected business value.
* Develop account-specific and industry-specific presales strategies.
* Customer Requirement Analysis
* Lead discovery sessions, workshops, and stakeholder discussions to understand customer business and technical requirements.
* Analyse Requests for Proposal, Requests for Information, Requests for Quotation, and other procurement documents.
* Translate customer requirements into clear functional, technical, operational, and commercial solution components.
* Identify gaps, assumptions, dependencies, risks, constraints, and clarification requirements.
* Ensure that proposed solutions address the customer’s current challenges and long-term business objectives.
* Solution Development and Architecture
* Lead the design of end-to-end IT services solutions in collaboration with solution architects and delivery teams.
* Develop solutions covering areas such as application development, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data and analytics, enterprise applications, managed services, automation, and digital transformation.
* Define the solution scope, architecture, operating model, implementation approach, delivery methodology, governance structure, and service management framework.
* Ensure alignment between customer requirements, proposed technologies, delivery capabilities, service levels, and commercial commitments.
* Review and validate solution designs, effort estimates, staffing models, transition plans, and implementation schedules.
* Promote the use of reusable solution components, accelerators, frameworks, and industry best practices.
* Proposal and Bid Management
* Lead the preparation and submission of high-quality technical and commercial proposals.
* Manage cross-functional bid teams involving sales, technology, delivery, finance, legal, procurement, HR, and partner organisations.
* Define proposal structure, response strategy, responsibilities, review cycles, and submission timelines.
* Develop executive summaries, solution narratives, transformation roadmaps, case studies, and differentiators.
* Ensure that all proposal responses are accurate, compliant, consistent, and aligned with customer expectations.
* Conduct solution reviews, proposal reviews, risk reviews, and executive approval sessions.
* Support contract negotiations and clarification discussions until deal closure.
* Commercial Solutioning
* Work with finance and commercial teams to develop competitive and sustainable pricing models.
* Review effort estimates, resource plans, delivery locations, subcontractor costs, technology costs, and risk provisions.
* Support the development of fixed-price, time-and-material, managed services, outcome-based, and consumption-based commercial models.
* Evaluate deal profitability, gross margin, cash flow, investment requirements, and commercial risks.
* Recommend pricing strategies and optimisation opportunities without compromising delivery quality.
* Ensure alignment between solution commitments, pricing assumptions, service levels, and contractual obligations.
* Customer Engagement and Presentations
* Act as a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders throughout the sales cycle.
* Lead customer presentations, solution workshops, technical discussions, and executive briefings.
* Present complex technical solutions in clear business language.
* Articulate the business value, expected outcomes, return on investment, and transformation benefits of the proposed solution.
* Lead or coordinate demonstrations, prototypes, proofs of concept, and solution validation sessions.
* Address customer questions, objections, risks, and concerns with confidence and credibility.
* Build relationships with business leaders, CIOs, CTOs, procurement teams, and technology decision-makers.
* Industry and Technology Leadership
* Maintain a strong understanding of industry trends, emerging technologies, customer priorities, and competitive offerings.
* Provide inputs for service portfolio development, solution innovation, and go-to-market strategies.
* Develop industry-specific and technology-specific solutions, propositions, and sales materials.
* Collaborate with technology partners, cloud providers, software vendors, and alliance organisations.
* Represent the company at customer events, industry forums, webinars, and internal knowledge sessions.
* Support the creation of thought leadership content, case studies, white papers, and solution briefs.
* Sales and Business Development Support
* Support account planning, pipeline development, and opportunity creation.
* Participate in strategic account reviews and business planning sessions.
* Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing customer accounts.
* Support the development of new service offerings and market-entry strategies.
* Provide presales inputs for sales forecasts, revenue planning, and business reviews.
* Track presales performance, opportunity status, proposal progress, and win-loss trends.
* Leadership and Team Development
* Lead, mentor, and guide presales consultants, solution specialists, and bid team members.
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure effective collaboration across distributed teams.
* Review the quality of proposals, presentations, solution documents, and commercial inputs.
* Build presales capabilities through coaching, training, knowledge-sharing, and structured feedback.
* Establish and improve presales processes, templates, governance, and quality standards.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and customer-focused team culture.
* Risk and Governance
* Identify technical, operational, commercial, contractual, and delivery risks during the sales cycle.
* Develop appropriate risk mitigation plans and ensure that risks are clearly documented.
* Ensure that proposed solutions comply with company policies, security standards, regulatory requirements, and contractual guidelines.
* Conduct structured handover sessions from sales and presales teams to delivery teams.
* Ensure that customer commitments, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, and contractual obligations are clearly communicated.
* Support post-deal reviews and capture lessons learned for continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Technology Management, or a related field is preferred.
* 10–12 years of experience in IT services, technology consulting, solution architecture, presales, bid management, or related roles.
* At least 4–5 years of experience leading complex presales engagements or large strategic bids.
* Proven experience in developing end-to-end IT services solutions for enterprise customers.
* Strong understanding of sales cycles, proposal management, commercial modelling, and contract negotiations.
* Experience engaging with senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of one or more technology domains, such as:
* Cloud and infrastructure services
* Application development and maintenance
* Data, analytics, and artificial intelligence
* Cybersecurity
* Enterprise applications
* Digital transformation
* Automation
* Managed services
* Experience working with global delivery models, offshore teams, and distributed stakeholders.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex opportunities under demanding timelines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in one or more industries such as banking, financial services, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, telecommunications, energy, or the public sector.
* Experience working with major cloud platforms, enterprise technology vendors, or strategic technology partners.
* Professional certifications in cloud, enterprise architecture, IT service management, project management, cybersecurity, or relevant technology platforms.
* Experience with structured sales and qualification methodologies.
* Knowledge of ITIL, Agile, DevOps, service integration, and enterprise architecture principles.
* Experience developing managed services, transformation, outsourcing, or outcome-based solutions.
* Exposure to international customers and global sales engagements.

Key Competencies

* Solution orientation
* Commercial awareness
* Customer advisory skills

* Stakeholder management
* Negotiation and influencing
* Proposal and bid leadership
* Analytical and problem-solving ability
* Team leadership

Key Performance Indicators

* Proposal compliance and submission timeliness
* Deal profitability and margin performance
* Accuracy of estimates and commercial assumptions

* Reuse of standard solutions, accelerators, and intellectual property

Career Progression
  
  
**The Role May Progress Into Positions Such As**

What We Offer

title: Business Analyst- Government Projects
description:
**About Niti Aide**

Niti Aide builds AI and digital solutions for government: dashboards for senior officers, citizen-facing WhatsApp and web assistants, and monitoring platforms for departments and public bodies. We are empanelled with NISG and work with bodies such as HMWSSB, GHMC, SERP and TGMSIDC across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. We’re a small, founder-led team, and the work you bring in is the work we build.

**The role**

This is not a desk BA job. You’ll spend 3–4 days a week inside government offices, meeting officers, understanding how departments actually run, and finding problems worth solving. Then you’ll work with our product and tech team to turn those problems into solutions, and follow through until the work order is signed.

You’ll own a set of departments end to end, from first meeting to signed work order, and you’ll be measured on it.

**What you’ll do**

* Visit government offices regularly and build working relationships with officers and their teams
* Run discovery conversations: how the department works, what data it has, which reviews it faces, and where it struggles
* Turn those conversations into clear one-page problem statements
* Co-design solutions with the founders and tech team
* Present concept notes, proposals and demos to officers
* Track tenders, RFPs, empanelments and nomination opportunities
* Follow up persistently on meetings, file movement and approvals until the work order comes through
* Maintain a clean pipeline of departments, stakeholders and next steps

**Who we’re looking for**

* MBA (2024–26 batch), or 1–3 years in B2B, institutional or field sales, or consulting
* Confident, well-presented and mature in conversation. You should be able to hold your own with senior officers, and we’ll coach you on the rest.
* A structured thinker who can turn a messy one-hour meeting into a crisp problem statement
* Fluent in Telugu, with strong spoken and written English
* Comfortable with Docs, Sheets and slides, and curious about AI. No coding needed.
* Willing to travel within Hyderabad and occasionally to districts and Amaravati. A two-wheeler or car is preferred.

**Strong advantages**

* Internship or work experience with a governance consulting firm, govtech company, PMU, or an industry body (CII, FICCI, NASSCOM)
* Any prior exposure to government departments or tenders

**This role is not for you if**

* You want a 10-to-6 desk job
* You’d rather document problems than chase them to a signed work order
* You’re uncomfortable following up five times to get one meeting

**What you get**

* ₹4–8 LPA, depending on experience and how you perform in the interview, plus conveyance and incentives on every work order you help bring in
* A clear path to Senior Business Analyst / Manager within 12–18 months, based on accounts you convert
* Direct work with the founders and real ownership from month one
* A first-hand view of how the state actually runs

**How to apply: walk in**

📅 Wednesday, 21 October (10 AM – 8 PM), or Thursday, 22 October and Friday, 23 October (9 AM – 12 PM)

📍 Niti Aide, 4th Floor, Mr Prime, Kondapur, Hyderabad

Come dressed the way you’d walk into a government office, and bring one idea:

*El Niño has hit this year. Which Telangana government department would you pitch a technology solution to, and what would you pitch?*

One page, your own thinking. That’s your first interview.

Immediate / Short Notice Preferred

**1. About Smartedge Consulting**

Smartedge Consulting is a professional consulting organisation established in 2005, providing services in Management Systems, Quality, Environment, Occupational Health & Safety, ESG & Sustainability, Digital Trust and Business Excellence.

Our philosophy is:

**"Build systems that work – not systems that merely satisfy an audit."**

We are expanding our IMS-QEHS consulting practice and invite experienced professionals who can independently lead consulting assignments, develop management systems and deliver measurable value to clients.

**2. Role Purpose**

To lead and deliver Integrated Management System (IMS) consulting assignments covering:

* ISO 9001 – Quality Management Systems
* ISO 14001 – Environmental Management Systems
* ISO 45001 – Occupational Health & Safety Management Systems

The role involves understanding client operations, identifying system gaps, developing practical management systems, supporting implementation, conducting internal audits and preparing organisations for certification and continual improvement.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. IMS-QEHS Consulting & Implementation**

* Conduct gap assessments and evaluate existing management systems.
* Establish and implement integrated management systems.
* Develop policies, procedures, SOPs, work instructions, formats and process documentation.
* Identify operational risks, environmental aspects and impacts, and occupational health and safety hazards.
* Establish process controls, objectives, KPIs and monitoring mechanisms.
* Guide clients in implementing systems at operational and management levels.

**B. Auditing & Compliance**

* Conduct internal audits and compliance assessments.
* Identify nonconformities and recommend corrective actions.
* Facilitate Management Review Meetings.
* Prepare clients for certification and surveillance audits.
* Support resolution of audit findings and continual improvement initiatives.

**C. Client & Project Management**

* Independently manage assigned consulting projects.
* Interact with CEOs, Plant Heads, Quality Heads, EHS Heads and functional teams.
* Conduct client meetings, training programmes and implementation reviews.
* Monitor project schedules, deliverables and client satisfaction.
* Coordinate with Smartedge's internal team and associate consultants.

**D. Business Development Support**

* Identify additional consulting opportunities within existing clients.
* Support technical discussions and proposal preparation.
* Participate in client presentations and technical meetings.
* Identify opportunities for cross-selling ESG, Safety, Energy and Business Excellence services.

**4. Desired Competencies**

* Strong practical knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001.
* Experience in developing and implementing integrated management systems.
* Good understanding of manufacturing and industrial operations.
* Ability to independently conduct audits and consulting assignments.
* Strong documentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Effective communication, presentation and client-handling capabilities.
* Ability to guide junior consultants and manage multiple assignments.

**5. Qualification & Experience**

* Engineering / Science / Environmental Science / Safety qualification preferred.
* Relevant professional qualifications in Quality, Environment and Occupational Health & Safety.
* Lead Auditor / Auditor qualifications in ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 preferred.
* Minimum 12 years of relevant professional experience preferred.
* Experience in consulting, implementation, auditing or senior industry positions will be considered.

**6. Who Can Apply?**

We particularly welcome applications from:

* Experienced IMS-QEHS consultants currently working with consulting organisations.
* Senior Quality, EHS and IMS professionals from manufacturing and industrial organisations.
* Retired Plant Heads, Quality Heads, EHS Heads and Management Representatives.
* Retired certification body auditors and lead auditors.
* Independent consultants who wish to transition into full-time employment.
* Experienced professionals who have taken a career break but are interested in returning to active professional employment.

**Retired professionals willing to rejoin full-time employment are equally encouraged to apply.**
Age will not be a barrier where the candidate has the required expertise, commitment, health and willingness to undertake client assignments and travel.

**7. Compensation & Employment**

* Annual CTC: Up to ₹10 lakh, based on experience and demonstrated capability.
* Full-time employment with Smartedge Consulting.
* Compensation will be structured based on the candidate's experience, project leadership capabilities and expected contribution.
* Senior professionals with extensive industry or audit experience may be considered for appropriate leadership responsibilities.
* Travel and client-site assignments will form part of the role.

**8. What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work with diverse industries and organisations.
* Independence in managing consulting assignments.
* Opportunity to mentor and develop the next generation of consultants.
* Exposure to IMS-QEHS, ESG, Safety and Business Excellence assignments.
* A professional environment focused on practical implementation and business value.

**9. Application Process**

Interested candidates may share their updated CV along with:

* Total professional experience.
* Relevant IMS-QEHS consulting and auditing experience.
* Certifications and auditor qualifications.
* Key industries and clients served.
* Current / last drawn CTC and expected compensation.
* Availability and willingness to travel.

**Apply to:**
info@smartedgeconsulting.com

**Website:**
www.smartedgeconsulting.com

**Smartedge Consulting**

*Beyond Compliance. Delivering Business Value.*

**About Nasuni**
Nasuni is a profitable, growing SaaS data infrastructure company reinventing enterprise file storage and data management in an AI-driven world. We power the data infrastructure of the world’s most innovative enterprises. Backed by Vista Equity Partners, our engineers are building what’s next with AI. Our platform lets businesses seamlessly store, access, protect, and unlock AI-driven insights from exploding volumes of unstructured file data. As an engineer here, you’ll help build AI-powered infrastructure trusted by 900+ global customers, including Dow, Mattel, and Autodesk.
  
  
Nasuni is headquartered in Boston, USA with offices in Cork-Ireland, London-UK and we are growing our India Innovation Center in Hyderabad India. The company’s recent Annual Revenue is $160M and growing at 25% CAGR.
  
  
We have a hybrid work culture. 3 days a week working from the Hyderabad office during core working hours and 2 days working from home.
  
  
**Senior Data Engineer — Search Platform - Java - OpenSearch - Elasticsearch**
**Role Overview**
Nasuni is building the next generation of enterprise search across massive volumes of unstructured data. As a
**Senior Data Engineer**
on our
**Search Platform team**
, you will own the data ingestion and transformation systems that power search at global scale.
  
  
This role is for engineers who enjoy building
**production-grade data platforms**
, solving
**high-scale indexing challenges**
, and owning systems end-to-end—from source data to search-ready schemas. It is not a role for early-career engineers or purely analytics-focused data roles.
  
  
You will work closely with Search, Platform, and Quality Engineering partners to ensure that data flowing into OpenSearch is reliable, performant, and designed for relevance, experimentation, and long-term scalability.
  
  
**Level & Scope Definition**

* Owns end-to-end ingestion pipelines feeding Nasuni’s search platform
* Operates with high autonomy on design and implementation decisions
* Responsible for schema design, data quality, and indexing performance
* Execution-focused with architectural accountability
* No people management responsibilities
* Collaborates cross-functionally with Search, Platform, and Quality teams

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and operate production-grade ETL/ELT services, primarily in Java, that transform source data into optimized OpenSearch schemas
* Solve large-scale indexing challenges in a multi-tenant, multi-region, multi-cloud SaaS environment
* Build and maintain high-throughput ingestion services using batch and streaming patterns
* Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging to ensure data completeness, accuracy, and operational stability
* Partner with Search leadership on index lifecycle management, re-indexing strategies, and data retention policies
* Build and expose APIs that integrate search ingestion services into Nasuni’s product ecosystem
* Collaborate with Search Quality Engineering to support relevance tuning, experimentation, and A/B testing
* Continuously optimize pipelines for performance, cost efficiency, and scalability

**Qualifications**
**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
* 4+ years owning production data ingestion pipelines for search or similar systems
* Strong proficiency in Java for building high-throughput backend services
* Hands-on experience with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or Solr indexing and mappings
* Advanced SQL skills and strong data modeling fundamentals
* Experience operating data pipelines in production with monitoring and alerting

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or similar
* Experience with streaming data platforms (Kafka, Kinesis, or equivalent)
* Python experience for scripting, data validation, or tooling integration
* Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures

**Ideal Qualifications**

* Direct experience scaling search ingestion for large datasets
* Experience supporting search relevance initiatives or experimentation frameworks
* Background in cost optimization for high-volume data platforms

**Why Work at Nasuni (Hyderabad / India)**
Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams—and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world’s unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform—turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, and AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration.
  
  
With Vista Equity Partners’ backing, our Hyderabad team benefits from access to a global ecosystem of software leaders—cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities—combining the pace of a fast-growing company with the scale and resources of a global technology investor. You’ll innovate at the intersection of cloud, AI, and enterprise data infrastructure, collaborate with talented teams worldwide, and help build platforms trusted by global enterprises.
  
  
**Why Work at Nasuni – Hyderabad?**
**Benefits**
As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers
**competitive benefits**
designed to support every stage of your life and career:
  
  

* Competitive compensation programs
* Flexible time off and leave policies
* Comprehensive health and wellness coverage
* Hybrid and flexible work arrangements
* Employee referral and recognition programs
* Professional development and learning support
* Inclusive, collaborative team culture
* Modern office spaces with team events and perks
* Retirement and statutory benefits as per Indian regulations

*Nasuni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every team member can thrive. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, caste, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, national origin, or any other status protected by applicable laws in India or the country of employment.*
*We celebrate individuality and are committed to building a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know.*

title: Senior Applications Engineer

title: Salesforce Success Architect - Gen AI & Agentforce (EST & PST Timezone)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
At Salesforce, we are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where individuals from all backgrounds are welcomed and valued. We believe that the unique perspectives and skills of diverse candidates greatly contribute to the success of our teams. As an Agentforce + Data Cloud Success Architect, you will play a crucial role in driving successful outcomes for our strategic customers by leveraging your technical expertise in data and analytics.
  
  
Data Cloud supports seamless integration with Salesforce Marketing, Sales, and Service Clouds, enabling Customer 360 use cases. This ensures that businesses can unify customer data across all touchpoints, enhancing AI-driven marketing automation, personalized engagement, and predictive customer insights. By powering hyper-personalized experiences and real-time decision-making, Data Cloud helps organizations maximize customer lifetime value and drive business growth.
  
  
Additionally, Data Cloud is the foundation of Agentforce, enabling real-time, intelligent decision-making by centralizing and harmonizing enterprise data. By leveraging Data Cloud, Agentforce can deliver context-aware AI automation, hyper-personalized customer interactions, and predictive insights, driving greater operational efficiency and business value.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Be a trusted Agentforce + Data Cloud subject-matter expert for the broader Success Architect organization, including how Data Cloud relates to the success of AI
* Engage with our Signature and Strategic customers to evaluate and recommend optimization strategies for technical architecture, dev/ops, performance, and solution design specific to Agentforce + Data Cloud
* Identify and evaluate capability gaps for standard product capability or identify creative Architect solutions through customization
* Facilitate and influence Executive stakeholders while aligning technology strategy to business value and ROI
* Run playbooks aligned with our Success Architect engagement catalog, tailored to the unique needs and opportunities of Agentforce + Data Cloud customers
* Build strong relationships with both internal and external business partners, contributing to broader goals and growth
* Drive thought leadership through mentoring and knowledge sharing
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset — using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi-stakeholder success plans — with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C-level alignment
* Serve as an internal thought leader and practitioner on AI-augmented success practices — defining standards, playbooks, and governance for AI tool usage in partnership with CS leadership

**Your Impact**
As an Agentforce + Data Cloud Success Architect, you will have a significant impact on our customers' success and the growth of our organization. Your expertise and guidance will directly influence the technical architecture, performance optimization, and solution design strategies for our strategic customers, ensuring their success in leveraging Agentforce + Data Cloud's powerful data capabilities. By driving customer satisfaction and delivering exceptional value, you will contribute to the overall growth and reputation of Salesforce as a leader in the industry.
  
  
**Collaboration and Team Work**
Collaboration is at the core of our success, and as an Agentforce + Data Cloud Success Architect, you will have the opportunity to work closely with diverse teams of professionals. You will collaborate with customers, colleagues, and partners to evaluate technical architecture, optimize performance, and design effective solutions. By fostering strong relationships and working collaboratively, you will contribute to the collective success of our teams and the achievement of our goals.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* Minimum 8 years proven experience in enterprise consulting, including implementing enterprise software solutions in the Analytics/CDP spaces
* Minimum 2 development/project implementation lifecycles of Salesforce Data Cloud/CDP + AI
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes focusing on data & integration architecture, with a focus on guiding customers through migration to and optimization of Agentforce + Data Cloud
* Deep understanding of data modeling, integration architectures, and data governance best practices
* Excellent communication skills, and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams from Developer to Executive
* Ability to facilitate discussions and translate technical concepts & solutions into tangible business value and ROI for customers
* Ability to demonstrate basic understanding and stay up-to-date with emerging data-related and AI technologies
* Proactive and self-starting attitude with the ability to manage tasks independently while collaborating remotely with customers and colleagues
* Values the importance of Data Ethics and Privacy by ensuring that customer solutions adhere to relevant regulations and best practices in data security and privacy
* Degree or equivalent experience required. Experience evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. proven behaviors in previous jobs such as extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer-facing role, with hands-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI-powered success platforms
* Ability to synthesize AI-generated insights into executive-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen
* Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to guide enterprise customers on leveraging Salesforce AI capabilities to achieve their own business outcomes and ROI

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in a consulting.implementation Partner for Data Cloud/CDP
* Experience with large data such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud Storage/Big Query, Azure administration or architecture
* Experience with Customer Data platforms such as Segment, Tealium, Adobe Experience Platform, Amperity, Treasure Data, Twilio Segment, Realtio, etc
* Experience implementing Salesforce Clouds, Multi cloud scenarios - Sales, Service, Industries, Marketing or Commerce
* Familiar with at least one of the Salesforce Architecture Domains: Integration, Access and Identity Management, Data Architecture, Sharing and Visibility, Declarative and APEX Development
* Experience in programming languages such as Python, Java, .Net, SQL

**Note:**
This role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to work from the office three days per week.
  
  
**Shifts -**
Candidate should be comfortable working in AMER shifts (6:30 PM - 3:30 AM) as well.
  
  
Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*

title: Community Management Associate, Selling Partner Communities (SPC)
description:
**Description**
The Selling Partner Communities (SPC) organization builds lasting connections with and among our Selling Partners, helps drive their success, and ensures that public perception mirrors the reality that Amazon is a great place for our Selling Partners to build and grow thriving businesses. Amazon Seller Forums are used by over one million Selling Partners to connect with each other and Amazon, to get critical information and advice on how to successfully maintain their Amazon Seller business.
  
  
We are looking for a detail-oriented and motivated Community Management Associate to support our community engagement efforts with Selling Partners across Amazon's Seller Forums and Social Media channels. The ideal candidate follows established processes with accuracy, is eager to learn, and takes pride in delivering high-quality work under guidance. They communicate clearly, are comfortable working within defined workflows, and are excited about contributing to a positive Selling Partner experience.
  
  
This role requires an individual who can follow documented procedures to resolve Seller cases efficiently, escalate appropriately when situations deviate from standard processes, and collaborate effectively within a team-oriented environment.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Resolve Seller cases in Amazon Seller Forums across assigned categories following established SOPs and Playbooks, ensuring timely responses within defined SLAs.
  
  
Handle Social Media cases via Sprinklr following defined triage procedures, routing escalations to senior team members.
  
  
Moderate Forums threads and Social Media channels for community guidelines adherence, flagging policy violations for review.
  
  
Troubleshoot seller issues using internal documentation (Help Hub, SOPs, Wiki). Escalate when actions deviate from available procedures.
  
  
Maintain accurate case annotations, PAA notes, and closure codes for every case - ensuring traceability and seamless handoffs.
  
  
Support community engagement initiatives as directed, contributing to healthy Amazon-Seller conversations across Forums and Social channels.
  
  
Identify recurring seller pain points during daily case work and flag to senior CMs or Category Captains for trend analysis.
  
  
Support program/project activities for launches, announcements, and process changes as directed.
  
  
Participate in knowledge sharing, cross-training, and team meetings to build category expertise.
  
  
Leverage AI-assisted response tools for case efficiency, validating all AI outputs before posting for accuracy.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  

* Spending the majority of the day resolving Seller Forums cases across assigned Seller Journey categories (Account Setup, CML/PSC, Seller Onboarding, etc.) by following documented SOPs and procedures
* Handling Social Media seller cases on Sprinklr following defined workflows
* Participating in team huddles, knowledge sharing sessions, and shift handovers
* Work is reviewed daily by senior CMs or manager for quality and accuracy

**Basic Qualifications**

* 1+ years of sales experience
* Bachelor's degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with industry standard social listening and campaign management tools
* Experience working with fast-moving, high-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments
* Experience in written and spoken English and an ability to compose grammatically correct, concise and accurate written responses
* - Experience troubleshooting issues using documentation and knowledge bases
* - Willingness to learn and adopt new technologies including AI-assisted tools

title: Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant
description:
Position - Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)
  
Exp – 5+ Years
  
Location – Chennai/Hyderabad/Pune/Gurgaon/Bangalore - Hybrid
  
Shift timing - 2.00PM to 11.00PM IST
  
  
About the role: We are seeking an accomplished Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) – Incident to Resolve Functional Consultant for a support engagement. The ideal candidate will have over 5 years of functional experience specifically in EAM and Incident to Resolve processes within the Oracle Fusion Cloud environment. The focus will be on providing business-as-usual (BAU) support, system troubleshooting, ongoing improvements, and user enablement for the EAM suite and related modules across global operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
Application Support & Troubleshooting:
  
Provide comprehensive functional support for Oracle Fusion Cloud EAM, focusing on Incident to Resolve processes, including maintenance requests, work order management, asset tracking, preventive maintenance, and failure analysis.
  
Analyze and resolve user-raised incidents, system issues, and service requests in line with agreed SLAs.
  
Conduct root cause analysis for recurring issues and work with technical teams and Oracle Support for complex/systemic challenges.
  
Support asset lifecycle management, from incident creation and assessment through resolution and closure.
  
  
System Enhancements & Change Management:
  
Assess and implement minor enhancements and configuration updates in line with evolving business requirements.
  
Participate in testing activities (unit, integration, regression, UAT) for Oracle quarterly releases, upgrades, and new feature roll-outs.
  
Support interfaces/integrations with related modules, such as Inventory, Procurement, Projects, and Supply Chain applications.
  
  
Documentation & User Training:
  
Create and maintain user manuals, functional specifications, process documentation, and quick reference guides for Incident to Resolve processes.
  
Lead training sessions and knowledge transfer workshops for business users and support staff.
  
  
Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:
  
Act as the primary contact for business users seeking EAM functional support, ensuring effective communication and follow-up for incident resolution, enhancements, and process queries.
  
Collaborate closely with business process owners, IT, operations, and vendor/partner teams to address issues and ensure end-to-end process efficiency.
  
  
Continuous Improvement & Best Practices:
  
Proactively identify process gaps and system improvement opportunities, leveraging best practices and the latest Oracle Cloud EAM enhancements.
  
Recommend process optimizations for asset reliability, maintenance scheduling, and data quality within the EAM suite.
  
Stay current on Oracle Fusion Cloud updates and their impact on EAM and cross-functional processes.
  
  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Information Technology, or related field.
  
Minimum of 5 years’ hands-on functional experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud EAM, including direct exposure to Incident to Resolve processes.
  
Comprehensive understanding of asset management, maintenance planning & execution, incident management, preventive maintenance, and work order processes.
  
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and documentation skills.
  
Experience working in support engagements or managed services, including incident, problem, and change management.

description:

ADP is hiring a Client Support Specialist.
  
  

* Are you ready to join a company offering career advancement opportunities throughout your career journey?
* Do you want to join a company with award-winning training and world-class service guidelines to help you achieve success, growth, and continued learning?
* Are you looking for an inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?

In this role, you will serve as ADP's front-line for solving clients' challenges including issue resolution, answering questions, helping clients, training their users on ADP technology, and more. You may provide support using any combination of phone, email, or chat-based communication, depending on your specific team or role.
  
  
The nature of what you do every day will not change your #1 goal is to help clients when they reach out. However, every day will be different since questions will vary, and so will each client's solutions. There will be no shortage of questions, which will keep things interesting, and our top-ranked training will help to position you for success!
  
  
Adaptability, empathy, self-motivation, and organization skills are must-haves in this job. You will need to balance your workload, handle back-to-back inquiries, focus on what's important, and stay up-to-date on ADP and external policy changes. In return, you can expect job satisfaction through being that one person who saves the day for our clients. All while advancing your career at a stable, highly respected Fortune 250 company that prides itself on its welcoming, inclusive workplace where you are valued and supported. Things can move fast here, so the pace shouldn't scare you. We still find time for a healthy dose of fun.
  
  
**What You Can Expect On a Typical Day**

. You will build relationships with clients using the phone, email, and/or chat, where you will strive to exceed client expectations in every interaction. You hold yourself to the highest ethical standards and live ADP's core value of "Integrity is Everything."
  
  
**Educate and Provide Recommendations**
. You will leverage your ADP product and services knowledge to solve issues and questions that help clients understand our products' value. You will take client input and turn it into recommendations for your leaders on best practices and solutions training.
  
  
**Organize to**
**Thrive**
. You thrive in a structured environment that requires setting priorities, organizing your day, multi-task, changing direction, and providing prompt follow-up.
  
  
**To Succeed In This Role**
Handle international customer calls, emails, and chats to resolve their queries and concerns.
  
  

* Provide excellent customer service by listening actively, empathizing with customers' issues, and offering solutions promptly.
* Identify opportunities to upsell/cross-sell relevant products or services based on customers' needs.

* Participate in quality audits to ensure adherence to company standards.
* 2-7 years of experience in an International BPO environment handling International Voice process.
* Ability to work flexible shifts including rotational shifts as per business requirements.
* Strong communication skills for effective interaction with customers from diverse cultures.
* Proficiency in CSAT analysis and payroll processing systems.

We are a comprehensive global provider of cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions that unite HR, payroll, talent, time, tax and benefits administration and a leader in business outsourcing services, analytics, and compliance expertise. title: Network Engineer/ Administrator
description:
**Build What Matters At Model N**
At Model N, we help life sciences companies solve complex revenue challenges so they can operate smarter and bring important innovations to market faster. We are looking for people who like practical problem solving, cross-functional work, and seeing the impact of what they build.
  
  
If you enjoy keeping networks fast, secure, and reliable for the people who depend on them, this could be a great fit.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Network Engineer to join our Global Technology team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will
**install, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain network infrastructure across corporate**
and cloud environments. You will work primarily on cloud networking, along with enterprise switching, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, and secure remote access technologies. You will work closely with senior engineers, IT teammates, cross functional teams, customers and vendors to ensure our network environment remains secure, reliable, and highly available.
  
  
This role matters because our employees and customers depend on a fast, secure network to do their work, and reliable network engineering is what keeps everything connected.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure, and maintain cloud network infrastructure, including AWS VPCs, subnets, route tables, Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, Security Groups, NACLs, VPNs, Transit Gateway, and VPC Peering.
* Support and maintain enterprise switching infrastructure, primarily Cisco and Juniper switches, including VLANs, trunking, routing, and network connectivity.
* Support Palo Alto firewalls and Panorama, including firewall rule management, VPN connectivity, traffic analysis, and basic troubleshooting.
* Support Zscaler technologies, including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and troubleshoot connectivity and access-related issues.
* Support Aruba wireless infrastructure, including wireless connectivity, authentication, and troubleshooting.
* Monitor network performance and availability, and respond to alerts and incidents within agreed timelines.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity, routing, switching, DNS, latency, and security issues across corporate and cloud environments, and escalate complex problems to senior engineers when needed.
* Implement network changes through planned change requests, with documented configurations and rollback steps.
* Maintain network documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures, and share knowledge with the team.

**What Success Looks Like**
**First 60 days**

* Learn Model N's network architecture, monitoring tools, and change and incident processes.
* Build working relationships with senior network engineers, IT teammates, and vendors.
* Resolve assigned incidents and perform routine changes with guidance and peer review.

**First 3–6 months**

* Handle routine incidents and planned changes independently, with few escalations.
* Improve network monitoring or documentation to reduce repeat incidents.
* Support projects such as office expansions, network upgrades, or cloud connectivity work.

**How You Will Grow And Make An Impact**
At Model N, our competency model helps us talk about growth, impact, and how work gets done.
  
  

* People Leadership – You take ownership of your development and apply feedback, such as asking senior engineers to review your configurations and acting on their input.
* Problem-Solving Leadership – You solve routine problems independently using standard approaches, such as isolating a DNS or VPN fault during an outage.
* Thought Leadership – You apply growing knowledge to contribute informed ideas, such as noticing a recurring performance issue and sharing the pattern with the team.
* Entrepreneurial Leadership – You take initiative to improve your work, such as documenting a fix so the team can reuse it.
* Operational Leadership – You consistently manage your work and priorities to deliver reliable results, such as meeting incident response timelines.
* AI Leadership – You use AI tools to improve efficiency and quality, such as drafting configuration checks or troubleshooting runbooks.

We do not expect every person to be perfect in every area. We look for strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to keep growing.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Typically 2-4 years of relevant experience.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including OSI and TCP/IP models, IPv4, subnetting, routing, switching, VLANs, and TCP/UDP protocols.
* Good understanding of routing concepts and protocols, including static routing and BGP.
* Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of enterprise network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless networks.
* Good understanding of network security concepts, including firewalls, ACLs, NAT, IPsec VPNs, and network segmentation.
* Working knowledge of DNS, DHCP, ARP, ICMP, and network troubleshooting tools such as Ping, Traceroute, Nslookup, Dig, and Wireshark.
* Good understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPC, subnets, route tables, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway, Security Groups, NACLs, Private link and VPN connectivity.
* Experience with network monitoring tools and incident/change management processes.
* Ability to troubleshoot network connectivity issues methodically and work independently as well as part of a team.
* Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini) to improve productivity, decision-making, or problem solving in a professional or personal context.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Key skills: Network Administration & Troubleshooting
* Cloud Network & Network Security

**Preferred**

* Relevant certifications, such as CCNA or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
* Experience with hybrid cloud connectivity.
* Familiarity with Zscaler ZIA/ZPA
* Scripting experience, such as Python or Terraform, for network automation.
* Interest in leveraging AI, automation, or modern technologies to improve outcomes.

****How We Work****
**Our DARE core values**
-
**D**
REAM
**, A**
LIGN
**, R**
ESPECT, and
**E**
XCEL - shape how we work together.
  
  

* We solve practical problems that matter to our customers and teams.
* We work across functions and value clear, respectful communication.
* We recognize good work and support growth over time.
* We are curious about better ways to work, including thoughtful use of AI and modern tools.

We do not expect every person to be perfect in every area. We look for strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to keep growing.
  
  
**Compensation, Benefits, And Inclusion**
At Model N, your well-being and growth matter. We offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support employees personally and professionally.
  
  
Benefits and compensation for this position will be provided in accordance with Model N’s India programs and applicable local requirements.
  
  
****Bring Your N Factor****
We are not just looking for a checklist of skills. We are looking for people who bring ideas, curiosity, and a point of view.
  
  
If this role sounds interesting and you can see yourself adding value, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**About Model N**
Model N is transforming how Life Sciences companies manage revenue, commercialization, and compliance.
  
  
For more than
**25 years,**
Model N has been the leader in end-to-end commercialization, revenue optimization, and compliance for pharmaceutical and medical technology companies.
  
  
Our intelligent, cloud-based platform combines technology, data, analytics, AI, and industry expertise to help leading Life Sciences organizations
**optimize revenue, navigate complex regulations, improve decision-making,**
and bring life-changing products to market faster.
  
  
Today,
**150+ leading companies**
across the globe trust Model N to optimize growth and transform critical commercial processes. Our solutions manage approximately
**$1.3 trillion in gross revenue**
, helping customers reduce complexity, strengthen compliance, and unlock new opportunities for growth.
  
  
At Model N, we are building the next generation of
**Life Sciences revenue management**
—where technology, data, AI, and human expertise come together to create meaningful business impact.
  
  
Join us to build technology that powers innovation in Life Sciences and makes a difference at global scale.
  
  
For more information, visit www.modeln.com .

title: Creative Designer
description:
**Company Description**
Reddot Food is an Irish food business that mills flours locally and sells Indian pantry staples online and through selected retailers. We are looking for a hands on Creative Designer to own

the quality and consistency of our design across packaging, social media and the online store.

You will update our brand guidelines and act as their steward, help the marketing team plan

and produce campaigns, and design improvements to the website in Figma. You will also

maintain a single design improvement backlog and agree priorities with the teams responsible

for delivering the work.

**Role Description**

**Brand guidelines and stewardship**
Review how the brand is used across packaging, the website, social

media and retail. Work with the founders and marketing team to revise the guidelines, covering typography, colour, photography, layout, logo use and packaging consistency. Maintain the shared design assets and review key materials before they go live or to print.

**Marketing and social media**

Work with the marketing team to turn campaign briefs into creative concepts and finished assets. Build editable templates for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and WhatsApp, including posts, stories, reel covers

and thumbnails. Design ads, email graphics and launch materials. Use campaign results and team feedback to improve future creative.

**Video editing**
Edit product demos, recipe videos, influencer footage and brand stories. Add captions, titles and branded graphics, and produce versions for social media, ads and the website.

**Packaging design**
Design and update labels and packs across the product range. Keep the range recognisable while making each product and variant easy to identify. Work with operations and print suppliers on dielines, proofs and production files. Coordinate final sign off on product information, allergens and claims with the responsible team.

**Website user experience and Figma**
Use customer feedback and available analytics to identify where shoppers struggle. Design mobile first journeys for search, product pages, basket, checkout and repeat orders, including customers arriving from WhatsApp. Maintain reusable Figma components, provide clear handover to developers and review the implemented designs before release.

**Design improvement backlog**
Maintain one backlog for brand, packaging, marketing and website design improvements. Record the problem, expected benefit, dependencies and next action. Agree priorities with the relevant team leads based on customer impact, campaign dates, print deadlines and effort. Track each agreed item through delivery and review.

**What you will bring**

• A portfolio showing strong visual design and work used by real customers. We would like to see examples of brand or campaign design, packaging, video editing and website or e-commerce design.

• Good judgement on typography, layout, image selection and how to make information easy to scan on a pack or a screen.

• Strong Figma skills, including reusable components, responsive layouts, prototypes and developer handover.

• Experience preparing artwork for print and editing short videos for social media.

• The ability to create templates that colleagues can use confidently in Canva or a similar tool.

• Confidence working directly with founders, marketing, operations, developers and suppliers. You can explain design decisions, respond to feedback and manage several deadlines. Experience with food brands, consumer goods, retail or e-commerce is desirable.

**How the role works across teams**

The designer owns design quality, shared design assets and the design improvement backlog. Marketing owns campaign goals and publishing. Operations coordinates packaging production and product information approval. The website team owns technical delivery and coordinates specialist review for changes involving payments or customer data. The designer works with each team from the brief through to final review.

**What success looks like in the first 90 days**

1. Brand and priorities: Review existing materials, agree the highest priority improvements and publish a practical update to the brand guidelines.

2. Marketing and video: Deliver an editable social template kit and support one live campaign with finished graphics and video.

3. Packaging: Review the existing range and take one agreed packaging improvement through to an approved proof, subject to the print schedule.

4. Website: Use customer feedback to choose one priority shopping journey and deliver a mobile first Figma design ready for developer handover.

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
Job Description: Client Experience & Operations Coordinator

**Company:** Furnestry  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Department:** Client Experience & Operations  
**Experience:** 1–3 years preferred

About Furnestry

Furnestry is a bespoke furniture studio specialising in customised furniture and thoughtfully designed spaces. We work closely with clients, architects, interior designers, and skilled artisans to deliver furniture that combines design accuracy, craftsmanship, and functionality.

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented and solution-driven professional who can manage client communication, coordinate across teams, streamline vendor and production follow-ups, and ensure a seamless experience for our clients throughout their journey with Furnestry.

Key Responsibilities1. Client Relationship & Communication Management

* Act as the primary Point of Contact (POC) for clients after onboarding.
* Manage routine client communication and filter, organise and prioritise queries before escalating them to the Founder, Mansi.
* Ensure clients receive timely updates on design progress, production status, delivery schedules and installation.
* Maintain clear records of client discussions, commitments, pending approvals and follow-ups.
* Handle client concerns professionally and proactively, ensuring issues are addressed before they escalate.

2. Design & Project Coordination

* Coordinate between clients, the design team, vendors and production teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Follow up on design approvals, drawings, measurements, material selections and other project dependencies.
* Track project timelines and ensure all stakeholders are aligned on deliverables and deadlines.
* Identify delays or bottlenecks and take timely action to resolve them.

3. Vendor & Production Coordination

* Coordinate with Furnestry’s production team and manufacturing partners in Delhi.
* Place approved orders for raw materials, fabrics, hardware, finishes and other production requirements.
* Follow up with suppliers on material availability, order confirmations, dispatch schedules and delivery timelines.
* Maintain records of purchase orders, material requirements, vendor commitments and pending supplies.
* Ensure the design team and production team have the correct specifications and approved details before execution.

4. Site Visits, Installation & Client Grievance Resolution

* Conduct site visits before or after delivery and installation, as required.
* Inspect completed installations and document any pending work, defects or client concerns.
* Coordinate with the relevant production, installation, polishing, upholstery or repair teams for rectification.
* Schedule site visits and ensure all grievances are tracked through to closure.
* Keep clients informed about resolution timelines and follow up to confirm satisfactory completion.
* Maintain a record of complaints, corrective actions, responsible teams and closure status.

5. Experience Studio & Walk-In Client Management

* Welcome walk-in clients and provide a guided tour of the Furnestry Experience Studio.
* Understand their initial requirements and ensure a warm, professional brand experience.
* Capture basic client details and project requirements.
* Coordinate and schedule appointments with Mansi for detailed consultations.
* Ensure all walk-in enquiries are recorded and followed up appropriately.

6. Content Capture & Marketing Coordination

* Capture short videos, photographs and behind-the-scenes content during site visits, installations and client meetings.
* Share organised raw footage and relevant project updates with the marketing team for reels, social media posts and brand storytelling.
* Coordinate with the marketing team to highlight completed projects, craftsmanship, client interactions and installation journeys.
* Ensure client permission is obtained before capturing or sharing identifiable client or property content.

7. Reporting & Internal Coordination

* Maintain daily trackers for client follow-ups, material orders, production status, site issues and pending rectifications.
* Share regular updates on project progress, delays, urgent requirements and unresolved concerns.
* Ensure every task has a clear owner, deadline and follow-up plan.
* Help establish a structured, accountable and client-focused working process across departments.

Skills & Qualifications

* 1–3 years of experience in client servicing, interior design coordination, furniture operations, project coordination or a similar role.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Confident in dealing with clients, vendors, artisans and internal teams.
* Good follow-up discipline, attention to detail and problem-solving ability.
* Comfortable coordinating with a manufacturing team based in Delhi.
* Basic proficiency in Google Sheets, Excel, WhatsApp Business and task management tools.
* Comfortable recording videos and capturing photographs using a smartphone.
* Willingness to travel for local site visits and installations as required.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Is polite and composed while handling demanding clients.
* Can communicate firmly and professionally with vendors and production teams.
* Is proactive about anticipating delays and resolving problems.
* Can distinguish between routine matters that they can resolve independently and decisions that need the founder’s involvement.
* Is comfortable switching between client conversations, material follow-ups, site visits and studio coordination.
* Understands that the role is not just about coordination, but about ensuring that commitments are fulfilled and clients remain confident in Furnestry.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely and consistent client updates.
* Reduction in unnecessary escalations to the Founder.
* Timely ordering and follow-up of raw materials.
* Adherence to production, delivery and installation timelines.
* Speed of response and closure of post-installation complaints.
* Accurate maintenance of project trackers and follow-up records.
* Professional handling of walk-in clients and appointment scheduling.
* Consistent sharing of useful site and project content with the marketing team.

**How to Apply:** Interested candidates can share their resume along with a brief introduction highlighting their experience in client coordination, operations or project management.

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Famous for its engaging service, awe-inspiring public spaces, locally inspired cuisine, and iconic bars and lounges, Fairmont also takes great pride in its pioneering approach to hospitality and leadership in sustainability and responsible tourism practices. Fairmont is part of Accor, a world leading hospitality group counting over 5,400 properties throughout more than 110 countries, and a participating brand in ALL - Accor Live Limitless – a lifestyle loyalty program providing access to a wide variety of rewards, services and experiences.

+ Coordinate with corporate marketing teams to ensure alignment with global Fairmont branding and promotional guidelines.

* Market Research and Analysis:

+ Conduct thorough market research to understand target demographics, competitors, and market trends in Mumbai’s luxury hospitality sector.
+ Utilize insights to tailor marketing strategies and campaigns effectively.

* Digital and Social Media Marketing:

+ Create and manage engaging content for the hotel’s website, social media channels, and email marketing campaigns.

* Public Relations and Media Outreach:

+ Build and maintain relationships with local, national, and international media to generate buzz and positive coverage for the hotel.
+ Organize and manage press events, media visits, and promotional activities.

* Partnerships and Promotions:

+ Identify and establish strategic partnerships with local businesses, influencers, and travel agencies to enhance visibility and drive bookings.
+ Develop and manage promotional offers and packages to attract and engage potential guests.

* Event Planning and Execution:

+ Plan and execute pre-opening events, such as launch parties, VIP previews, and community engagements, to create excitement and generate media interest.
+ Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure successful event delivery.

* Brand Management:

+ Ensure consistent brand messaging and visual identity across all marketing materials and channels.
+ Monitor and manage brand reputation, addressing any potential issues or negative feedback.

* Performance Tracking and Reporting:

+ Track and analyze the performance of marketing campaigns and activities using relevant metrics and KPIs.
+ Provide regular reports and recommendations to senior management on marketing effectiveness and ROI.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.

VIL is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversifying its workforce.
  
  
**Role**
**GM – Partnerships & Innovation**
**Job Level / Designation**
General Manager / Band M3
  
  
**Function / Department**
Digital – Partnerships & Growth (Partnerships: Integrated Propositions)
  
  
**Location**
Corporate Office, Mumbai
  
  
**Context for the new role**
Integrated Propositions is a strategic growth agenda to bring relevant partner products and services to Vi’s Postpaid and Prepaid customers through integrated propositions, and value add-ons via consumer journeys on the Vi App. The current portfolio includes OTTs for video and audio entertainment as well as quick commerce, device protection, etc. There are new propositions WIP in the digital space.
  
  
Several large digital categories are already bundled by competition at scale. Vi therefore needs propositions that customers value, that clearly differentiate Vi, that are difficult for competition to replicate and that strengthen Brand Vi.
  
  
Partnerships offer the most capital-efficient route, through adopted or co-created propositions.
  
  
The role requires a commercially strong partnerships leader who can combine market scouting, deal-making, innovation management and cross-functional execution with strict cost discipline.
  
  
**Proposal**
We propose to appoint a GM – Partnerships & Innovation to build Vi’s innovation pipeline through partnerships, with integrated and value-added propositions for Vi consumers as the primary focus.
  
  
The incumbent will identify partners with relevant propositions that Vi can adopt, as well as partners with whom customised innovations can be co-created, and will drive marquee partnerships with established brands in the digital space, including for example - AI assistants & products, and other relevant propositions in the digital / adjacent category.
  
  
Each proposition will be evaluated for customer relevance, differentiation, sustainability of advantage, contribution to Brand Vi and cost.
  
  
The individual will own the closure of each partnership end to end, working with the commercial, legal, product integration, brand, digital delivery, GTM and operations teams, and will deliver successful partnerships, new-to-market propositions, active users and ARPU, revenue and retention impact in line with the annual operating plan.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Build and manage Vi’s innovation pipeline through partnerships. Close marquee and new-to-market partnerships that deliver relevant, differentiated and sustainable propositions for Vi consumers, strengthen Brand Vi and drive growth in active users, ARPU, revenue and retention within a disciplined cost framework.
  
  
**Key Result Areas / Accountabilities**
**Innovation and Proposition Development**

* Own the innovation roadmap and partnership pipeline for Integrated Propositions, covering propositions that Vi can adopt directly as well as customised innovations co-created with partners.
* Proactively scout the market to identify partners and propositions across AI assistants and products and other digital categories, and prioritise them on customer value, differentiation, commercial viability and speed to market.
* Evaluate every proposition on relevance and value to Vi consumers, differentiation versus competition, sustainability of the advantage created (for example exclusivity, co-created features, Vi network capabilities or distribution), contribution to Brand Vi and total cost to Vi.
* Focus on integrated and value-added propositions delivered through prepaid packs, postpaid plans, add-ons and journeys via the Vi App.
* Manage a structured innovation process from concept and business case through pilot to scale-up, with clear success measures and timely go / no-go decisions.
* Prepare business cases covering active users, ARPU, revenue, retention and cost, with priority given to propositions that are new to the Indian telecom market.

**Marquee Partnerships & End-to-End Closure**

* Drive marquee partnerships with established brands and propositions in the digital space, including AI assistants & products and products in the larger digital category.
* Own the end-to-end closure of each partnership, from initial engagement to launch, working closely with the commercial, legal, product integration, brand, digital delivery, GTM and operations teams.
* Manage the innovation agenda with strict cost discipline, prioritising partner-funded benefits and revenue-share models over minimum guarantees, releasing investment in stages against results, and discontinuing pilots that do not meet agreed measures.
* Ensure a structured handover of launched propositions to the GTM, integration and partner journey teams, with tracking of active users, activation and repeat usage from launch.

**New Partnerships & Business Development**
Develop and manage relationships with established digital brands, emerging players, startups, accelerators and venture funds.
  
  
Negotiate commercials and contracts, including exclusivity and co-marketing terms where relevant, establish partner governance and performance reviews, and work with the Head of Integrated Propositions on delivery.
  
  
Maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective partners to keep the proposition portfolio relevant and ahead of competition.
  
  
**Other Tasks**
The primary task is to hunt for and close new partnerships. Additionally, for each partnership:
  
  

* Work with Integration and GTM teams to translate new propositions into customer journeys on the Vi App/ Web and other relevant platforms/ channels, platform requirements and a sequenced launch roadmap together with the Integrations team.
* Work with Product, Pricing, CVM and Finance teams – as relevant - on pack design, pricing and offer construct.
* Work with Brand and Marketing to ensure launches build Brand Vi and are positioned as industry firsts where applicable.
* Establish monthly MIS covering pipeline status, pilots, partnerships closed, active users, revenue, costs and partner performance.
* Institute compliance-by-design in all partner integrations in line with data-privacy (DPDP) requirements and Vi policies.
* Track competition and global operator benchmarks, and provide leadership with market intelligence, emerging categories and recommendations.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Partnerships: number of successful partnerships closed and launched, including marquee partnerships.
* Innovation: number of unique and new-to-market propositions within the Indian telecom industry; pilots launched and scaled.
* Customers: active users, activation, repeat usage and NPS.
* Business impact: ARPU, incremental revenue and retention.
* Cost: partner-funded share of benefit cost, cost per active user and spend versus budget.
* Execution: time from signature to launch and SLA adherence.

**Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience**
Demonstrated experience in consumer partnerships and business development, preferably in bundled, integrated or value-added propositions at a telecom operator, OTT or consumer-internet platform.
  
  
Track record of closing partnerships with established digital brands; strong commercial and negotiation capability across revenue-share and minimum-guarantee models, contracting and partner governance and strong cost discipline.
  
  
Ability to identify propositions with clear customer value and differentiation, manage pilots, analyse funnel and cohort data and build business cases with sound unit economics.
  
  
Exposure to AI products, digital platforms and propositions, the startup and venture ecosystem and zero-to-one launches.
  
  
Strong brand orientation and the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive end-to-end execution across cross-functional teams.
  
  
Preferred profile: 8–14 years across telecom, consumer internet, OTT and digital media or consumer technology, with meaningful ownership of consumer partnerships, integrated propositions, product launches or strategic alliances.
  
  
**Must Have Technical / Professional Qualifications**
MBA preferred
  
  
**Years Of Experience**

**Industries to look from**
Telecom, Consumer internet, OTT & digital media, Consumer technology, Startup & venture ecosystem
  
  
**Ideal Organizations to look from**
Airtel, Jio Platforms, JioStar, Spotify, Google, Amazon, Times Internet, CRED, Swiggy etc.

Individual contributor

Join our team, we can make a difference together.
