The Global Business Solutions (GBS) - Valuations Advisory Services teams in India operates as an extension of our global offices and works very closely with their counterparts in the US, APAC and EMEA on diverse nature of valuation engagements across industries. We have multiple Service Lines under VAS – Valuation Services, Real Estate, FAMIS, Tax Services and Alternative Asset Advisory to name a few.
  
  
**Kroll’s Portfolio Valuation**
practice specializes in assisting clients with the valuation of alternative investments, specifically securities and positions for which there are no "active market" quotations such as illiquid securities for hedge funds, private equity funds, business development corporations and fund of funds. Kroll team is looking for consultant who will be involved in providing support to our global valuation practice. The opportunity is ideal for professionals who are interested in learning global best practices, tools and techniques by working on valuation engagements for global clients.
  
  
Kroll is looking for an
**Associate Vice President (equivalent to Manager**
) who will be who will be aligned to the Australia office of Kroll in the Portfolio Valuation Advisory Services team and involved in providing support to our global valuation practice. The opportunity is ideal for professionals who use global best practices, tools and techniques by working on valuation engagements for global clients.
  
  
**Day-to-day Responsibilities**

* Building long-term client relationships through exceptional client service including a deep understanding of the client and their needs, exceptional responsiveness, and the delivery of the highest quality service and work product
* Developing deep technical strength in the valuation of alternative assets, serving as a firm resource for that expertise and sharing that knowledge through training and mentoring
* Team management
* Managing client engagements from day-to-day interaction with the client through to staffing and managing the resources and work plan through to timely completion
* Individuals will be assigned a wide variety of projects and given as much responsibility as their experience and capabilities permit
* Project management including client interviewing, engagement economics, team management, report writing, research and tracking market and industry information
* Model building and reviewing - DCF models, comparable company models, stock option models, financial instrument, and loan valuations

**Essential Traits**

* Minimum of 6- 9 years of valuation-related work experience in financial services
* Master's degree in Finance, Accounting or Economics or equivalent thereof (e.g., CFA); or MBA from an accredited college/university
* Proven technical skills, proven analytical and problem solving skills
* In-depth technical knowledge in corporate finance, valuation methods and accounting.
* Experience of working with investment firms, end clients, PV/VC firms including infrastructure funds etc.” is preferred
* Demonstrated leadership experience including managing and developing client relationships as well as mentoring and developing staff
* Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills, comfortable speaking with senior management and in front of an audience
* Ability to manage confidential, sensitive information

**About Kroll**
Join the global leader in risk and financial advisory solutions—Kroll. With a nearly century-long legacy, we blend trusted expertise with cutting-edge technology to navigate and redefine industry complexities. As a part of One Team, One Kroll, you'll contribute to a collaborative and empowering environment, propelling your career to new heights. Ready to build, protect, restore and maximize our clients’ value? Your journey begins with Kroll.
  
  
*In order to be considered for a position, you must formally apply via*
*careers.kroll.com*

title: Vice President, Asset-Backed Finance
description:
Lincoln International, Inc. (NYSE: LCLN) is a trusted investment banking advisor to business owners and senior executives of leading private equity firms and their portfolio companies and to public and privately held companies. Our services include mergers and acquisitions advisory, private funds and capital markets advisory, and valuations and fairness opinions. The global enterprise is comprised of a tightly integrated team of more than 1,400 professionals in more than 30 offices in 14 countries, offering an unobstructed perspective on the global private capital markets, backed by superb execution and a deep commitment to client success. With extensive industry knowledge and relationships, timely market intelligence and strategic insights, we forge deep, productive client relationships that endure for decades. Connect with us to learn more at www.lincolninternational.com.
  
  
At Lincoln International, we know that the success of our global organization is a direct outcome of the strength of our people. We encourage diversity of thought and create talent density by attracting, retaining and engaging high performers from all demographics, backgrounds and perspectives. We value diversity, equity and inclusion as a catalyst to foster innovation and creative problem solving, access the best candidates and adapt to a highly dynamic, competitive environment. We know that employing a diverse team and valuing the unique perspectives of our people allows us to better understand and serve the needs of our clients.
  
  
Lincoln International is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We encourage you to read more about our commitment to diversity and Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) efforts.
  
  
**Lincoln International follows a hybrid work structure with an emphasis on in office collaboration.**
**Our employees work in office Monday through Thursday each week, with the option to work remotely or from the office on Fridays.**
**Duties & Responsibilities:**
Lincoln International’s Valuations & Opinions Group, is an industry leader in the valuation of alternative and illiquid investments for investment funds, including business development companies (BDCs), hedge funds, and private equity groups. The group also advises on valuation matters for corporate transactions, including acquisitions and divestitures, leveraged buyouts, restructurings, recapitalizations, related party transactions, and for general tax, accounting, litigation, and regulatory purposes.
  
  
Lincoln International is seeking a Vice President to join the Valuations & Opinions Group with fixed income structured product experience. Officers work closely with the firm’s Managing Directors and clients in providing valuation and financial advisory services across multiple engagements and offices. Lincoln International’s practice is growing rapidly, and we are looking to add a talented individual to support our client service and quality control activities, expand our capabilities and bolster our marketing efforts. Responsibilities at Lincoln International are often more entrepreneurial than at other firms providing self-motivated individuals with many opportunities to contribute to a dynamic and growing platform. A successful candidate will be an assertive, motivated self-starter with the desire and potential to succeed in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Prior investment banking and/or transaction experience is preferred but not required.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Leading project teams providing valuation and financial advisory services to clients, including determining appropriate valuation methodologies and reviewing financial models for amongst other things, mortgage whole loans, student loans, consumer loans as well as RMBS, CMBS, CLO, ABS, and other structured finance securities
* Providing quality control oversight to engagement teams
* Managing, training and developing associates and analysts at the firm
* Proactive calling on potential new clients including alternative investment managers (hedge funds, private equity, private credit, BDCs, etc.), financial institutions, privately held business owners and publicly traded companies
* Identifying and communicating potential engagements to management and writing business proposals and engagement letters

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum of five years’ experience in performing business valuations, valuations of illiquid and complex securities, and/or structuring, trading, or whole loan modelling
* Understanding of collateral risk characteristics, deal structures, terms, and conditions
* Experience with third party systems such as Bloomberg and Intex
* Proficiency in designing financial models for discounted cash flow, market multiple, market transaction, and option pricing analyses
* Ability to develop valuation approaches for various forms of securities and unique instruments including equity and debt securities, loans, derivative instruments, structured products and intangible assets
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and ability to critically analyze companies and understand key business issues, including value drivers and investment risks
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Working knowledge of credit markets
* Experience with successfully managing teams of associates and analysts
* Understanding of authoritative guidance related to valuations a plus
* ASC-820 and IFRS 13, valuation industry best practices, and emerging issues
* Ability to act as a primary point of contact with clients
* Ability to effectively multi-task, managing multiple client engagements simultaneously
* Confidently and credibly connect with potential new clients and lead client meetings
* Excellence in MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint
* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Mathematics, Statistics, or Economics or MBA; strong academic record (both undergraduate and graduate)
* Active CPA, ASA and/or CFA preferred but not required

**Additional Information:**
Lincoln International is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status.

title: Analyst, Sustainable Procurement
description:
**Job Summary**
Are you passionate about service excellence? Would you love to work for a global organization that is doing more good for people and planet?
  
  
IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.
  
  
Global Operations: Ensuring excellence in execution—from procurement to supply chain and reliability—delivering quality, safety, efficiency and sustainability across the value chain.
  
  
The role is based either in Hyderabad or Mumbai, India (Hybrid role). Be part of a motivated, passionate, and open-minded team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.
  
  
**Where You’ll Make a Difference**

* Support the execution of IFF's supplier sustainability and responsible sourcing programs.

* Support supplier engagement activities, including onboarding, data collection, sustainability reviews, and follow-up communications.
* Assist with supplier visits and sustainability reviews to validate practices and support continuous improvement efforts.
* Track supplier corrective actions and monitor progress against agreed improvement plans.

* Exposure to supplier assessments, sustainability programs, responsible sourcing initiatives, or data analysis is preferred.
* Experience working with suppliers or supporting cross-functional projects is an advantage.
* Proficiency with Excel is required.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to manage data accurately.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn about sustainability and responsible sourcing practices.
* Team-oriented mindset with strong collaboration skills.

**How Would You Stand Out?**

* Exposure to supplier engagement or experience working with suppliers in Asia (India, Southeast Asia, China) is an advantage.
* Experience with Power BI or similar reporting and visualization tools is a plus.
* Asian languages (Hindi, Mandarin, etc.) are considered a plus.

**Why Choose Us?**

* Multinational and supporting environment
* Training opportunities
* Learning and development programs

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. title: Data Analytics Associate
description:
**Job Description**
You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in
**Financial Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, Data Science (EDA and Modelling) and AI / Gen AI**
. You have found the right team.
  
  
As a Financial Analytics Associate within our Asset and Wealth Management Transformation and Analytics Team, you will define, refine, and deliver strategic goals for our firm by translating complex financial and operational data into actionable insights, predictive models, and AI-promoten solutions that enhance decision-making and promote business performance.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Scope, prioritize and co-ordinate activities with product owners and finance stakeholders. Partner with Finance, Risk and Business teams to identify strategic analytical, data science and AI solutions. Perform in-depth financial analysis including revenue, expense, margin, variance, profitability, product/client profitability and KPI analysis to support business decisions.
* Design, develop and automate management reporting, dashboards and scorecards covering P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, forecasts, budgets, headcount and performance metrics. Drive the annual budgeting, mid-year re-forecast, rolling forecast and multi-year strategic planning cycles in partnership with Business Finance teams.
* Implement exploratory data analysis (EDA) and statistical modelling to identify trends, patterns and drivers of financial performance. Identify key financial and operational data sources that can drive business impact; ensure data quality, reconciliation and audit trails across reporting outputs.
* Design and develop data mining and reporting queries from large data sets (both structured and unstructured) and convert raw financial data into clear information. Build compelling visualizations and storytelling using BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx) that translate financial results and model outputs into clear business narratives for senior leadership.
* Employ scaling and automation to data preparation, consolidation and reporting workflows to improve efficiency and accuracy of recurring financial deliverables. Transform model outputs and analytical results into formats digestible to end users through visualizations, clear tables and thoughtful presentations; assist technical and non-technical stakeholders in interpreting the analysis.
* Leverage AI assistants and copilots (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and in-house Gen AI tooling) to accelerate analytics workflows — code generation, SQL/Python drafting, document summarization, and natural-language querying of financial datasets — while applying firm-approved controls on data confidentiality and model output review.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Self-starter, attention to detail and results oriented, able to work under minimal guidance in a fast-paced environment.
* Uses pertinent financial data and facts to identify and solve a range of business problems within area of expertise.
* Mandatory experience in financial analytics, FP&A, management reporting, variance analysis and KPI/performance measurement. Strong understanding of accounting principles (US GAAP / IFRS), financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow), journal entries, intercompany, allocations, accruals and month-end close processes.
* Working knowledge of profitability and performance metrics: unit economics, gross/operating margin, contribution margin, EBITDA, ROE/ROA, cost-to-income ratio, NIM, fee revenue and AUM-based metrics.
* Mandatory experience in Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), regression and statistical/machine learning modelling applied to financial or business datasets. Hands-on experience with pandas and PySpark/PySQL stack. Experience in building data extraction, transformation and modelling pipelines.
* Strong proficiency in SQL (Snowflake, Databricks) and Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Keras, PySpark/PySQL) for data wrangling, modelling, AI pipelines and automation of financial workflows. Hands-on experience using AI skills / copilots to support analytics work — e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot (Excel, Power BI, Word, PowerPoint), GitHub Copilot, for SQL generation, data summarization and productivity gains in day-to-day financial analytics deliverables; awareness of responsible-AI, data-privacy and model-risk guardrails.
* Working proficiency in data visualization tools; strong experience with BI technologies including but not limited to Tableau, Power BI and Alteryx. Experience in end-to-end implementation of Business Intelligence (BI) reports and dashboards for finance, risk or business performance reporting. Should be good at mathematics, inferential statistics and quantitative analysis as applied to financial data and model building.
* Provides explanations and information to others on topics within area of expertise; strong business partnering skills with Finance and Business stakeholders.
* Experience Required: 5+ years in data/analytics related projects with 2+ years in financial analytics
* Good communication and analytical skills, with the ability to present financial insights, model results and AI-driven outputs clearly to senior stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science or Engineering. A different field of study with significant professional experience in Financial Analytics / BI / Data Science / AI is acceptable. MBA (Finance) is a strong plus.
* Exposure to Asset & Wealth Management / banking products and metrics (AUM, net flows, revenue yield, client profitability, fee waivers) is strongly preferred.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

title: Analyst - Investment Research
description:
**About Us**
WHY LINEDATA ?
  
  
Join us in shaping the fintech of tomorrow.
  
  
With more than 1,350 colleagues across 20 locations worldwide, you'll help build cutting-edge platforms and tailored services that power the daily operations of 700 leading financial institutions. As a global, multicultural company with over 45 nationalities represented and just as many languages spoken, we thrive on diverse perspectives and collaboration. Together, we tackle future-focused topics like Al and the digitalization of finance, delivering smart solutions for our customers.
  
  
Whether you're just beginning your career or are an experienced professional, Linedata offers exposure to large-scale client projects, internal mobility and opportunities to develop your skills alongside leading experts.
  
  
**The Role**
You will join a team that directly caters to the front offices of global asset managers. As a Senior Associate in Linedataʼs Research team, you will work closely with Portfolio Managers and Senior Research Professionals. You will be responsible for providing fundamental research support to buy-side clients. The role spans across various aspects of investment research – initiating/maintaining analysis on the coverage universe, understanding macroeconomic and sectoral trends, tracking corporate events, reviewing the work of co-members, training and mentoring junior analysts, etc. You are also expected to proactively engage with different stakeholders to ensure informed and timely investment decision making by clients. You are required to take complete ownership of the deliverables and demonstrate utmost integrity and commitment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide investment research support to global asset managers investing in credit instruments
* Validate system-generated financial statements and models by testing data extraction accuracy, and ensuring outputs align with reporting and covenant requirements
* Carry out detailed capital structure and covenant analysis
* Review a wide range of financial documents, including but not limited to quarterly/annual reports, lender presentations, compliance certificates, agreements, prospectus, and ad-hoc disclosures to verify data integrity, and refine extraction rules
* Prepare earnings summaries, credit outlook, and writeups on investment pros and cons for companies under coverage
* Prioritize and execute multiple assignments with tight deadlines
* Ensure adherence to high quality standards and industry best practices

**Skills Required**

* Sound experience in credit research (2-5 years)
* Exposure to US/European capital markets
* Deep understanding of capital/corporate structure and various debt documents
* Experience in writing reports
* Strong excel modelling and analytical skills with attention to detail
* Ability to independently execute assignments under tight deadlines
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Team player with professional demeanour Advantageous Skills
* Knowledge of third-party databases such as Bloomberg, CapIQ, Thomson Reuters, etc.

**Academic Requirements**

* MBA or equivalent qualification in finance from a reputed institution / CFA

title: Media Specialist
description:
**Role Overview**

Own hands-on paid media execution and optimization across Meta and Google, with

Amazon PPC experience preferred. Drive efficient acquisition and profitable revenue while

coordinating creative testing and channel transitions.

**Work Schedule**

- Working Days: Monday to Friday

- Working Hours: Aligned with US Business Hours (EST/EDT).

- Work Location: Mumbai, India.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Meta advertising**

 Build, monitor and optimize Meta campaigns, budgets, creative tests and account

structure.

 Partner with the Creative Strategist to turn audience insights and hooks into

measurable tests.

 Track new-customer CAC, conversion, spend efficiency, attribution and contribution

profitability.

**Google advertising**

 Manage Search, Shopping and Performance Max where appropriate, including bids,

keywords and negatives.

 Troubleshoot Google Merchant Center, product feeds, disapprovals and conversion

tracking.

**Performance Media Buyer**

 Optimize budget allocation using incremental performance rather than platform

ROAS alone

 Manage or coordinate Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored

Display campaigns.

 Track ACOS, TACoS, organic ranking, inventory availability, promotions and sell-

through.

 Document a safe transition plan from existing agency support before taking over

execution.

**Reporting and controls**

 Create weekly channel scorecards covering spend, sales, CAC, AOV, contribution

profit and next actions.

 Work within approved budgets and change-control rules; do not modify live

campaigns without authorization during handover.

 Use AI tools for analysis, monitoring and SOPs while verifying recommendations

against source data.

**Required Qualifications**

• 3+ years hands-on paid media management for US DTC e-commerce brands.

• Strong practical Meta Ads and Google Ads experience; Amazon Ads working

knowledge.

• Strong analytics skills with GA4, Shopify and platform reporting.

• Experience making budget and optimization decisions with profitability constraints.

Preferred Qualifications

• Deep Amazon PPC / Seller Central expertise.

• Supplement, wellness or CPG experience.

• Experience with product feeds, attribution, tracking and AI-enabled reporting.

**Success Metrics**

• Blended new-customer CAC and contribution profit.

• Profitable revenue growth and efficient budget utilization.

• Google feed health, Amazon TACoS and organic rank stability.

• Reliable testing, reporting and agency handover.

**First 90 Days**

• Days 1-30: Audit channels and reporting; document current structure and risks.

• Days 31-60: Assume approved Meta/Google execution in stages; coordinate Amazon

with incumbent agency.

• Days 61-90: Own paid media operating cadence and assess Amazon transition

readiness.

title: Associate - WM Client Management - Name Screening and Adhoc updates
description:
**Job Title:**
Associate – WM Client Management - Name Screening & Adhoc Updates
  
  
**Department**
: Wealth Management Operations
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
Wealth Management - Client Management Operations in ISPL started in 2019, provide back office services for BNP WM Singapore and Hong Kong. Processes include Client Reference Data and Reporting (since September 2019)
  
  
**Position Purpose**
Client On-Boarding team’s goal, is to ensure a global and consistent “first service” is rendered to the clients. Ensure practices are adhered to bank’s standard procedures and guidelines with an emphasis in the area of compliance. Keeping abreast with the changes in regulations (site, regional, global, HO), assess its impact.
  
  
Ensure every client, prospect and counter‑party is screened against sanctions, AML/CTF and PEP lists, mitigating regulatory risk and maintaining audit‑ready records while supporting Relationship Managers and Compliance teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Support the execution of controls and tasks required in the Client‑Onboarding – Data‑Maintenance & Banking‑Services process, ensuring that client documentation, data‑capture activities and banking services meet the Bank’s policies, standards and all applicable local legal‑regulatory requirements.
* Perform daily and name‑screening checks (on‑boarding and periodic re‑screening). Keep watch‑lists, match‑thresholds and screening parameters up‑to‑date, investigate alerts, assign risk ratings, document decisions, and promptly escalate high‑risk matches. Maintain complete audit trails and respond to internal‑ and external‑audit queries. Work closely with Relationship Management, Legal and Compliance to resolve exceptions and drive process‑improvement/automation initiatives.
* Provide end‑to‑end support to internal customers for the onboarding of new clients, including linking clients to banking‑service tools (e.g., direct advisory‑desk access, dormant/deceased accounts, block/unblock requests).
* Maintain sound work processes, data‑integrity and the secure storage of client documents (electronic, scanned‑image or paper).
* Stay abreast of regulatory changes (site, regional, global, head‑office) and assess their impact on local workflows (SG/HK).
* Verify that controls are in place for the safe custody of account documentation and for mitigating operational risks arising from user requests to access databases containing sensitive client data, signatures or document images.
* Administer requests from internal regulators and stakeholders in relation to audit reviews; provide timely, confidential handling of client data and information.
* Deliver training on data‑maintenance and banking‑services processes and share knowledge with new team members; act as Level‑2 checker where required.
* Contribute to the design, implementation and continuous improvement of permanent‑control policies, procedures and control‑plans for daily operations; assist with updating SOPs.
* Comply with regulatory requirements, internal guidelines and operational‑risk procedures; promptly escalate incidents to Management, Permanent‑Control or Compliance as appropriate.
* Report all incidents through the Incident‑Management System and help minimise operational failures (including fraud) by applying regular controls.
* Ensure the integrity of client‑data creation and maintenance while meeting SLA/KPI targets; manage account‑closure processes.

title: Senior Research Scientist – Hydrocarbon Chemistry & Catalysis
description:
**AMRI is an emerging research-driven technology company focused on developing next-generation hydrocarbon conversion technologies, advanced catalytic processes, sustainable fuels, and industrial chemical technologies.**

Our research focuses on transforming hydrocarbons into higher-value chemicals, fuels, and industrial products through innovative catalytic and chemical conversion pathways.

Our ambition is to translate fundamental scientific research into commercially viable technologies with applications across the petrochemical, refining, energy, and specialty chemicals industries.

We are building our founding scientific team and are looking for scientists and researchers with strong expertise in hydrocarbon chemistry, catalysis, and chemical reaction engineering who want to move beyond conventional laboratory roles and develop proprietary industrial technologies from the ground up.

**Role Description**

**We are seeking a Senior Research Scientist specializing in Hydrocarbon Chemistry, Catalysis, Petrochemical Processes, or Reaction Engineering to lead our initial research initiatives.**

The ideal candidate will have hands-on research experience in hydrocarbon transformations, catalytic reaction pathways, and chemical process development.

This is an opportunity to establish a new industrial R&D program with significant scientific ownership, access to collaborative research infrastructure, and the freedom to explore promising technological pathways.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Hydrocarbon Conversion Research:**
  Investigate catalytic and chemical pathways for converting hydrocarbons, including alkanes, alkenes, light olefins, and other hydrocarbon feedstocks, into higher-value products.
* **Catalyst Development:**
  Design, synthesize, characterize, and evaluate heterogeneous catalysts for hydrocarbon transformations, including cracking, reforming, dehydrogenation, oligomerization, and related reactions.
* **Reaction Engineering:**
  Design and execute laboratory experiments to study reaction kinetics, mechanisms, selectivity, conversion efficiency, and catalyst performance.
* **Fuel & Petrochemical Technologies:**
  Explore innovative processes for producing fuels, sustainable fuel components, petrochemical intermediates, and specialty chemicals.
* **Experimental Research:**
  Develop laboratory protocols, operate catalytic reactors, analyze reaction products, and optimize experimental conditions.
* **Technology Development & Scale-up:**
  Evaluate technical feasibility, process efficiency, catalyst stability, and opportunities for industrial scale-up.
* **Intellectual Property:**
  Translate scientific findings into proprietary technologies, research milestones, technical reports, and potential patents.
* **Scientific Leadership:**
  Collaborate with academic institutions, laboratories, and industrial research partners while helping establish AMRI's scientific capabilities and future research team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Petrochemical Engineering, Catalysis, or a closely related discipline.**
  Exceptional master's graduates with relevant industrial R&D experience are welcome.
* Approximately
  **3–8 years of relevant research experience**
  , including doctoral or postdoctoral research.
* Strong research background in at least one of the following areas:
* Hydrocarbon chemistry and catalytic transformations.
* Heterogeneous catalysis and catalyst development.
* Petrochemical processing, refining, or hydrocarbon upgrading.
* Light olefin chemistry, oligomerization, cracking, reforming, or dehydrogenation.
* Chemical reaction engineering, reactor design, and reaction kinetics.
* Synthetic fuels, alternative fuels, or hydrocarbon-based fuel technologies.
* Hands-on experience with catalyst synthesis, characterization, laboratory reactors, and chemical product analysis.
* Familiarity with analytical techniques such as GC, GC-MS, HPLC, XRD, BET, FTIR, or other relevant characterization methods.
* Strong foundation in experimental design, scientific data analysis, and independent research problem-solving.
* Experience translating laboratory research into process development, technology validation, or industrial applications is highly desirable.
* Ability to independently lead research projects, prepare technical documentation, and collaborate with multidisciplinary scientific teams.

**We particularly encourage applications from scientists working in hydrocarbon chemistry, petrochemical research, refining technologies, heterogeneous catalysis, and reaction engineering who are interested in building commercially relevant technologies.**

title: Associate , Investment Operations Specialist, SMA (Separately Managed Accounts) Solutions
description:
**About This Role**
**Team Overview**
BlackRock Separately Managed Accounts (SMA) Solutions helps clients customise portfolios for tax efficiency, values alignment, and specific investment exposures across direct indexing, fixed income, active equity, and multi-asset strategies. The Investment Operations team supports the integrity and effective functioning of SMA portfolios through reconciliation, exception management, operational controls, reporting, and close collaboration with investment, technology, custodian, and operations partners.
  
  
**Your Role and Impact**
As an Investment Operations Analyst, you will support middle-office activities across SMA portfolios, with a focus on cash and position reconciliation, exception management, data integrity, risk and control execution, and continuous process improvement. You will apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to manage operational priorities, resolve issues across partners and platforms, and help strengthen the reliability and scalability of portfolio operations.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Perform daily cash and position reconciliations, investigating and resolving breaks and data discrepancies across internal books and records, custodians, and investment platforms.
* Monitor positions, cash, transactions, tax lots, pricing, corporate actions, and other portfolio data, supporting operational reporting, data-integrity monitoring, and post-trade controls.
* Partner with portfolio management, custodians, technology teams, and internal operations partners to resolve exceptions and coordinate timely issue escalation.
* Execute operational controls, maintain complete and audit-ready evidence, and identify and escalate material breaks, data-quality concerns, access issues, control weaknesses, and operational risks.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures, while contributing to cross-training and knowledge sharing that support consistent and resilient operational execution.
* Manage competing priorities, dependencies, operational commitments, and deadlines, communicating risks or delays proactively and providing coverage during periods of increased activity.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and automate manual activities, using operational data to identify recurring breaks, capacity constraints, and errors while supporting testing, documentation, implementation, and control validation.

**Your Experience**

* 3-5 years of experience in investment operations, middle-office operations, portfolio operations, fund accounting, or a related financial-services function; exposure to separately managed accounts or tax-managed investment strategies is preferred.
* Working knowledge of the trade lifecycle, including positions, cash, securities, corporate actions, tax lots, pricing, reconciliation, exception management, and post-trade controls.
* Experience investigating reconciliation breaks and resolving data discrepancies across investment platforms, custodians, and internal books and records.
* Strong risk and control mindset, including experience following Standard Operating Procedures, performing maker-checker reviews, maintaining audit-ready evidence, and handling sensitive portfolio data.
* Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving capabilities, with attention to detail and the ability to independently prioritise multiple deliverables and meet operational deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders across functions and regions.
* Familiarity with investment-management platforms and advanced Excel skills; exposure to VBA, Python, Power BI, workflow tools, automation, and process-improvement initiatives is preferred.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Operations Intern
description:
**About The Team**
Clearwater Analytics' Managed Services team runs the day-to-day middle- and back-office operations — trade operations, NAV accounting, reconciliation, and regulatory reporting, for hedge funds and asset managers operating on the Enfusion platform. MS teams work inside a SOC 1 Type II control environment across break analysis & resolution, daily NAV production, trade affirmation using industry-standard platforms such as CTM, NYFIX, Traiana, and DTCC ALERT. As an intern on this team, you'll get first-hand exposure to how a fund's operations actually run behind the scenes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Reconciliation Support: assist in matching internal transaction records against custodian, broker, and bank statements, and help log discrepancies for the team to investigate.
* Data Entry & Validation: help record investor inflows, redemptions, corporate actions, and trade bookings accurately into the core portfolio accounting system (Enfusion).
* Trade Support: observe and support daily trade affirmation workflows across platforms including CTM, NYFIX, and Traiana.
* NAV & Reporting: shadow the daily NAV process & monthly trial balance reconciliation and help prepare operational reports.
* Records and reports the status of daily and monthly operational delivery.

**What You'll Gain**

* Direct, hands-on exposure to how a real fund's middle and back office runs on a daily market cycle.
* Training on Enfusion and industry-standard platforms — CTM, NYFIX, Traiana, DTCC ALERT, and EMIR reporting tools.
* Mentorship from experienced fund operations professionals across reconciliation, NAV accounting, and trade lifecycle management.
* A front-row seat to how a SOC 1 Type II controlled operating environment is run in practice.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce, Accounting, Business Management, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications (Bonus): Progress toward CFA Level I, NISM, or another relevant local market certification is a plus, though not required.

**Hard Skills**

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills — comfortable with VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and handling large data sets without errors.
* Basic understanding of financial statements, general ledger accounting, and how corporate actions (e.g., stock splits, dividends) affect fund valuations.
* Asset Classes: Intermediate understanding of fixed income and equity investments and a basic knowledge of alternative security types
* Strong accounting and/or finance skills.
* Familiarity with core operational concepts — how NAV is calculated daily, and the trade settlement lifecycle (e.g., clearing, custodian communication, T+1 settlement).

**Soft Skills**

* Hyper-attention to detail — accuracy matters; a single misplaced decimal or swapped account number can cause real compliance and financial issues.
* Clear written and verbal communication for presenting findings and handling internal or client queries.
* Process orientation — able to follow structured SOPs precisely while spotting opportunities to improve them.
* Time management under pressure — comfortable working to firm daily market cut-off times.
* A proactive, eager-to-learn attitude toward new financial software and workflows.

**Job Summary**
Team Member – Credit Risk Modelling will be responsible for the development, enhancement, implementation, and monitoring of Internal Rating Models and Expected Credit Loss (ECL) models under IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 frameworks for wholesale portfolios. The role requires strong expertise in credit risk analytics, statistical modelling, regulatory compliance, and stakeholder management within a banking or NBFC environment.
  
  
The candidate should possess 7–8 years of relevant experience in credit risk modelling, with hands-on exposure to Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), Exposure at Default (EAD), scorecards, internal rating frameworks, and ECL implementation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
***IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 ECL Modelling & Implementation***
Support development and maintenance of Expected Credit Loss (ECL) models under IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 framework.
  
  
Implement staging assessment methodologies, macroeconomic overlays, SICR frameworks, and forward-looking adjustments.
  
  
Monitor model performance and recommend enhancements based on portfolio behavior and economic trends.
  
  
Collaborate with finance, risk, and business teams for smooth implementation of ECL methodologies within the Bank/NBFC systems.
  
  
Support provisioning calculations, management reporting, and audit/regulatory requirements.
  
  
***Data Management & Analytics***
Perform data extraction, cleansing, transformation, and analysis using large datasets from multiple source systems.
  
  
Analyse portfolio trends, credit behaviour, migration patterns, and default characteristics.
  
  
Conduct statistical analysis and model diagnostics using SAS, SQL, Python, R, or similar analytical tools.
  
  
Prepare dashboards and analytical reports for senior management and risk committees.
  
  
***Regulatory & Governance Support***
Ensure compliance with RBI guidelines, Basel framework, IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 standards, and internal model governance policies.
  
  
Prepare model documentation, methodology papers, validation support documents, and regulatory submissions.
  
  
Support internal audit, model risk management, and regulatory inspection requirements.
  
  
***Stakeholder Management***
Work closely with Risk, Finance, Business, IT, and Model Validation teams for implementation and monitoring activities.
  
  
Present model methodologies, assumptions, and performance outcomes to senior stakeholders and committees.
  
  
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution of model-related initiatives.

title: Senior Lead - Product Operations
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.

With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.

Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

**Location: This is a full-time, work-from-office role with a required work-from-office presence five days a week.**

**Role in a Nutshell**

* As a member of our newly established
  **Central Product Excellence & Operations (CPEO) team,**
  you will act as the operational backbone helping our multi-product, enterprise-focused R&D organization scale with consistency, discipline, and execution rigor.
* Serve as the connective tissue uniting Product, Engineering, TPM, and GTM functions - establishing standard frameworks for how we plan, execute, review, and ship products across all lines, including newly acquired platforms.
* Act as a data-driven advisor to Product Leadership by transforming telemetry, user signals, and market intelligence into high-impact insights that directly guide roadmap prioritization and resource allocation.
* Embody CPEO operating principles - Define → Build → Maintain, Single Source of Truth, Simplify before Adding, and Outcome over Activity - while leveraging modern AI-first automation to reduce manual toil for product managers.

**Desired Experience**

* Experience: 6+ years across Product Management, Product Ops, Strategy & Ops, or Technical Program Management, with 3+ years in B2B SaaS or developer tools. Background in multi-product portfolio management or post-acquisition integration is highly desirable.
* Product Operating Models: Proven track record of designing and executing product frameworks (planning cycles, OKRs, PRDs, launch workflows) with a strong emphasis on driving actual team adoption rather than mere process documentation.
* Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in SQL and data visualization (Looker preferred). Deep expertise in defining core product metrics (North Star, adoption, retention) and constructing centralized dashboards trusted by executive leadership.
* Customer & Market Insights: Adept at combining quantitative analytics with qualitative signals (NPS, user feedback, win/loss data, competitive analysis) to deliver actionable inputs for roadmap prioritization.
* Technical Fluency: Solid foundational understanding of APIs, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Agile SDLC methodologies, enabling seamless technical alignment with engineering stakeholders.
* AI-First Mindset: Hands-on experience employing AI models and automated workflows to accelerate operations like insight synthesis, review preparation, and status reporting.
* Education: BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. An MBA is an added advantage.
* Soft Skills: Demonstrated capability to influence senior leadership (Directors, VPs) without direct authority. Excellence in navigating fast-paced, matrixed environments with top-tier structured writing and executive-level communication skills.

**What You Will Do**

* Process Architecture: Architect, roll out, and maintain the company-wide product operating model in Jira and Confluence, keeping autonomous squads aligned with organization-wide OKRs and strategic stack ranks.
* Governance & Review Rigor: Lead high-visibility executive forums (MBRs, planning reviews), establishing standard pre-reads, metrics, and follow-through mechanisms to integrate acquired products into unified operating cadences.
* Data Strategy: Own the Product Intelligence stack by writing complex SQL to merge telemetry with business metrics (iACV, renewal risk), maintaining unified Looker dashboards as the single source of truth for platform health.
* Insights Synthesis: Synthesize customer feedback, NPS, win/loss trends, and competitive dynamics alongside Strategy teams to present decision-ready roadmap recommendations without reinventing core TAM research.
* Strategic Planning: Guide quarterly and annual OKR planning cycles while building financial, capacity, and resource allocation models across business units.
* Launch Excellence: Partner with PMM, Sales, and Solutions Engineering to ensure seamless GTM readiness, managing beta programs, launch criteria, field enablement, and post-launch adoption measurement.
* Tooling & PM Enablement: Manage product tooling (Jira, Confluence, Looker, AI tools), creating automated workflows that reduce administrative overhead while scaling team playbooks and onboarding programs.
* Change Leadership: Champion operational frameworks across business units using a hub-and-spoke model, systematically measuring process efficiency and retiring low-value workflows.

**Benefits:**

In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents-in-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual & Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life-event leaves

title: Ecommerce Executive
description:
Job Description:

Stone Sapphire India Private Limited is looking for a proactive, detail-oriented and performance-driven E-commerce Executive to manage its online merchandising, marketplace operations, product catalogue and e-commerce marketing activities.

The candidate will be responsible for managing product listings, optimising product content, maintaining catalogue accuracy, coordinating marketplace operations and supporting online sales growth across multiple e-commerce platforms, including Shopify, Amazon, Noon, Trendyol and other marketplaces.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in e-commerce operations, product listing, marketplace management, SEO, online merchandising and performance reporting.

Key Job Responsibilities1. E-commerce Merchandising & Content Management

* Create, upload and maintain product listings across marketplaces and the company website.
* Write and optimise product titles, descriptions, bullet points and backend search keywords.
* Ensure product content is accurate, consistent and aligned with brand guidelines.
* Coordinate with designers for product banners, creatives, videos and promotional content.
* Update website content, landing pages, blogs and category pages as required.
* Conduct regular content audits and optimise existing listings to improve visibility and conversions.
* Manage online product presentation, category structure and merchandising standards.

2. Product Listing & Catalogue Management

* Create and manage new SKU listings on Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Noon Seller Lab, Trendyol and other marketplaces.
* Upload product images, specifications, pricing and inventory information.
* Monitor listing health and resolve suppressed listings, content errors and catalogue-related issues.
* Manage product variations, bundles, parent-child relationships and SKU mapping.
* Ensure all product listings comply with marketplace policies and content guidelines.
* Maintain catalogue accuracy across all online sales channels.

3. Marketplace Operations

* Monitor product performance and sales across multiple e-commerce platforms.
* Coordinate with marketplace support teams to resolve listing, content and account-related issues.
* Track Buy Box performance, product rankings and competitive positioning.
* Support promotional campaigns, marketplace deals and seasonal sales events.
* Ensure products remain active, available and discoverable across platforms.
* Monitor order processing, fulfilment status and marketplace operational issues.

4. SEO & Performance Optimisation

* Conduct keyword research for marketplace listings and website content.
* Optimise product listings to improve organic search visibility and conversion rates.
* Analyse traffic, click-through rates (CTR) and conversion performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve product discoverability and listing effectiveness.
* Implement content and keyword optimisation strategies to improve online sales performance.

5. Inventory, Pricing & Merchandise Planning

* Coordinate with operations and warehouse teams to ensure product stock availability.
* Update pricing, discounts and promotional offers across marketplaces.
* Monitor out-of-stock and low-stock products and coordinate corrective actions.
* Verify catalogue inventory and pricing against warehouse records.
* Analyse category-wise sales, SKU performance and product demand.
* Identify best-selling, slow-moving and non-performing products.
* Support merchandise planning, product assortment and inventory coordination.

6. E-commerce Marketing & Campaign Support

* Assist in planning and executing marketplace and website promotional campaigns.
* Support Amazon Advertising, PPC campaigns and marketplace advertising activities.
* Create and schedule promotional content for seasonal sales, product launches and special events.
* Coordinate email marketing, social media and marketplace promotional activities.
* Monitor campaign performance, advertising spend and ROAS.
* Support influencer and affiliate marketing initiatives wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with creative and marketing teams for campaign execution.

7. Reporting & Business Analysis

* Generate weekly and monthly e-commerce performance reports.
* Track and analyse key performance indicators, including:
* Gross Sales and Net Sales
* Website and Marketplace Traffic
* Conversion Rate (CVR)
* Click-Through Rate (CTR)
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Return on Advertising Spend (ROAS)
* SKU and Category-wise Performance
* Listing Health and Buy Box Performance
* Identify sales trends, growth opportunities and underperforming products.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve business performance.

8. Customer Experience & Feedback Management

* Monitor product reviews, ratings and customer feedback across marketplaces.
* Identify recurring product-related complaints and content gaps.
* Coordinate with customer support teams to improve customer experience.
* Recommend product content updates based on customer queries and feedback

Educational Qualifications & Experience

* 1–4 years of experience in E-commerce, Marketplace Operations, Online Merchandising or Retail.
* Graduate in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Advertising, Marketing or Mass Communication will be an added advantage.
* Practical experience managing product listings and catalogues across online marketplaces.
* Experience with Shopify and Amazon Seller Central is preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for an organised, proactive and commercially driven individual who understands the dynamics of online marketplaces and e-commerce merchandising.

The candidate should be comfortable managing multiple product catalogues, handling day-to-day marketplace operations, analysing sales data and coordinating with internal teams. Strong execution capabilities, attention to detail and a willingness to learn are essential for success in this role.

**Compensation:**
₹2.4 LPA – ₹4.23 LPA, depending on relevant experience, marketplace expertise and candidate capabilities.

title: Product Head - Freight
description: Job description: Purpose of the Job The Product Head - Freight is responsible for leading the strategic development, management, and profitability of the company's freight product portfolio across Air, Ocean, and Land Freight services. The role drives product growth, strengthens carrier partnerships, develops competitive service offerings, and ensures alignment between commercial objectives, customer requirements, and operational capabilities. The position is accountable for revenue growth, gross profit performance, product innovation, market competitiveness, and the overall success of the freight product strategy while working closely with Sales, Operations, Procurement, Finance, and Regional Product teams. Job Description Strategic Product Management Develop and execute the country’s freight product strategy aligned with regional and global freight objectives. Define product roadmaps for Air Freight, Ocean Freight, Land Freight, LCL, FCL, and value-added logistics solutions. Identify market opportunities, customer requirements, and emerging industry trends to drive product innovation and growth. Monitor competitor offerings, pricing strategies, and market developments to maintain competitive positioning. Drive new product development initiatives and introduce differentiated freight solutions. Commercial & Financial Performance Own freight product P&L performance and deliver revenue, gross profit, yield, and market share targets. Develop and implement pricing strategies that balance competitiveness and profitability. Support sales teams in customer acquisition, strategic bids, RFQs, and key account development. Establish product performance KPIs and regularly review business performance against targets. Identify opportunities to improve margins, increase conversion rates, and grow shipment volumes. Carrier & Supplier Management Develop strategic relationships with airlines, shipping lines, trucking partners, consolidators, and logistics service providers. Lead procurement negotiations and secure competitive rates, capacity commitments, and service agreements. Manage carrier performance through regular reviews and service-level monitoring. Support procurement strategies for key trade lanes and major customer opportunities. Product Development & Trade Lane Management Design and enhance freight products across key trade corridors. Identify new trade lanes and service solutions to meet customer and market requirements. Collaborate with regional and global product teams on network expansion and product standardization. Ensure optimal routing, transit times, service reliability, and customer experience. Operational Excellence Work closely with freight operations teams to ensure operational feasibility and service excellence. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, productivity, and customer satisfaction. Address operational bottlenecks affecting product performance. Monitor service quality, transit performance, and operational KPIs. Customer & Market Engagement Engage directly with strategic customers and key accounts to understand business needs and identify growth opportunities. Support solution design and customized logistics offerings. Conduct customer reviews and gather market intelligence to improve products and services. Act as the subject matter expert for all freight products. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Lead and develop the freight product team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation. Partner with Sales, Operations, Finance, Procurement, Customer Service, and Regional Product teams to achieve business objectives. Compliance & Risk Management Ensure adherence to freight regulations, trade compliance requirements, customs procedures, and company policies. Monitor industry developments, regulatory changes, and market risks. Support business continuity and risk mitigation initiatives across freight operations. Job Requirements - Experience and Education Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Commerce or related discipline. MBA or master’s degree in supply chain/Logistics preferred. Experience: 10-15 years of freight forwarding and logistics industry experience. Minimum 5 years in product management, freight commercial leadership, procurement, or strategic freight management roles. Strong experience across Air Freight, Ocean Freight, and multimodal logistics solutions. Demonstrated success in P&L management, carrier negotiations, and product development. Experience managing cross-functional stakeholders and leading high-performing teams. Critical success factors Revenue Growth Gross Profit (GP) Growth Product Yield Improvement Trade Lane Profitability RFQ Win Rate Shipment Volume Growth Carrier Performance & Capacity Utilization Customer Retention & Satisfaction Product Margin Enhancement New Product Launch Success Operational Service Quality Metrics Leadership Behaviors Building Outstanding Teams Setting a clear direction Simplification Collaborate & break silos Execution & Accountability Growth mindset Innovation Inclusion External focus Skills Commercial Acumen Communication Skills Decision Making Leadership Skills Stakeholder Management Strategic Thinking Cross Functional Relationship Management Cross-Cultural Competence Interpersonal And Relationship-Building Skills Strong Business Acumen And Industry Knowledge

title: Creative Copywriter
description:
**About The Company**
Global University Systems (GUS) is one of the world’s most dynamic, inclusive, and diverse education organisations. GUS is an international network of higher education institutions, brought together by a shared passion for accessible and industry-relevant qualifications. We deliver a wide variety of programmes, including bachelor’s degree programmes, master’s degree programmes, professional training, English Language training, and corporate & executive education. When someone chooses to study at one of our institutions, whether on campus in Europe, North America, Asia or even in their own home, they are joining a network of over 100,000 students worldwide. When you decide to work with GUS, you will be joining an industry leading, global organisation that has a reach in over 150 different countries.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Are you a gifted wordsmith with a knack for transforming ideas into compelling stories that engage audiences and drive action? As a Creative Copywriter at GUS, you will leverage innovative writing techniques and digital tools to captivate our prospective students and meet our organizational goals. We're looking for creative individuals with a passion for excellence and a drive for results.
  
  
As a Creative Copywriter, you will contribute to GUS' worldwide content initiatives, harnessing the power of technology and digital platforms to create unique and engaging campaigns that resonate with our brand's ethos. Your work will span across various channels, including organic and paid social media, PPC, SEO and local marketing efforts, harmonizing these elements to build a best-in-class content portfolio.
  
  
To excel in this role, you should be an exceptional communicator with a proven ability to conceptualize and implement creative ideas. You should know when to apply technology to accelerate the writing process and when human creativity is essential to the process.
  
  
To be an ideal candidate, you will have had extensive experience producing powerful written content for multinational companies. You should be a natural team player who wants to contribute to a creative environment where everyone can produce their best work.
  
  
If you're a passionate communicator who is excited by the prospect of shaping the future narratives of our brands and making an impact on a global scale, we invite you to apply for this exhilarating opportunity.
  
  
**Key Activities And Responsibilities**
As a Creative Copywriter at GUS, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Developing compelling and creative copy for various organic and paid mediums, including social media, PPC, SEO, print and digital campaigns, and email journeys, while ensuring consistency in tone, style, and voice across all platforms and institutions.
* Utilizing technology and AI tools to enhance the copywriting process, while understanding when a human touch is necessary for the crafting of content.
* Working in alignment with the overall company's goals and marketing strategies, ensuring that your written content supports these objectives and helps to deliver the desired message to the targeted audience.
* Staying up to date on the latest trends in content and copywriting, implementing best practices in daily tasks and continuously seeking innovative ways to improve the quality and impact of written content.
* Working in coordination with the marketing teams to maintain a content calendar that aligns with the company's broader marketing and business goals.
* Ensuring all content and communication efforts take diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) into consideration.
* Contributing to content audits on a regular basis to assess the effectiveness of our copywriting efforts, providing useful recommendations for improvements based on key metrics and analysis.
* Assisting in managing relationships with GUS’ internal brand partners, ensuring clear, persuasive and effective copy is provided for all collaborative efforts.
* Maintaining a high level of quality control to ensure all produced copy aligns with brand guidelines and is free of errors.

**Essential**
**Qualifications and Education**

* Undergraduate level or equivalent work experience

**Desirable**

* Digital marketing qualification
* Writing qualification

**Experience**

* Significant (5+ years) experience in creative copywriting for multiple channels, including social media, PPC, SEO, content marketing and PR.
* Demonstrated experience (2+ years) in a team-oriented environment, with the ability to collaborate and contribute to team projects.
* Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to understand audience sentiment, analyse content performance and optimize copy based on performance data.
* An understanding of, and demonstrated interest in, emerging technologies that may impact copywriting including generative AI, automation tools, and data analytics.
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, while ensuring timely execution.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to effectively present ideas to internal stakeholders and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Proven experience working collaboratively with an international team.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think strategically and creatively to continually improve the company's content and copywriting strategy.
* Expertise in Microsoft Office, particularly Word and PowerPoint.
* Fluency in English with excellent writing and editing skills, with a strong grasp of grammar and style.
* Knowledge of AP Style or other major style guides is a plus.
* A portfolio of work that demonstrates your writing abilities and creative skills.
* A demonstrated passion for the educational space
* Experience with content-related tools and services including SEO tools (such as SEMRush, Ahrefs), social media management tools (such as Buffer, Hootsuite) and content management systems (such as WordPress).
* Experience in digital marketing including SEO, social media advertising and content marketing.

The post holder may be asked to undertake different or additional duties in line with business requirements at the request of their line manager. There is an expectation that all employees will maintain the values of the Group and will comply with the code of conduct as well as equality and diversity, health and safety and safeguarding policies.
  
  
**Other Information**
Please note this position is only available on our Consultancy agreement.
  
  
We acknowledge receipt of your resume for a position at Global University Systems and sincerely appreciate your interest in our company.
  
  
We will screen all applicant CVs and select the candidates whose qualifications and experience meet our requirements. Please note due to the high volume of applications we will only contact you if you are selected to continue for the next stage of the recruitment process. We wish you every success.
  
  
GUS is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, or religion or belief.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Job Title: Relationship Manager**
Department: Medium Enterprises (ME)
  
  
Experience: 3–4 Years
  
  
Grade: Manager to AVP
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Relationship Manager (RM) to join our Medium Enterprises (ME) team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing and managing a portfolio of clients with turnover ranging from ₹100 Cr to ₹500 Cr, maintaining portfolio hygiene, and actively engaging in cross-selling financial products.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client Acquisition (NTB): Source new-to-bank (NTB) clients in the medium enterprise segment with turnover between ₹100 Cr to ₹500 Cr. Identify opportunities through market intelligence, references, and industry networking.
* Portfolio Management: Manage and deepen relationships with the existing client portfolio. Regular engagement with clients to ensure satisfaction and retention.
* Credit Note Preparation: Conduct financial analysis and prepare detailed credit notes for new and existing clients. Evaluate risk and structure proposals in line with bank’s credit policies.
* Sanction Process & Stakeholder Coordination: Liaise with internal credit teams for proposal discussions and approvals. Effectively communicate with clients to understand their financial needs and ensure alignment with product offerings.
* Portfolio Hygiene: Ensure timely renewals, limit compliance, documentation, and monitoring of early warning signals. Maintain high asset quality and minimize delinquencies.
* Cross-Selling: Identify and capitalize on cross-sell opportunities across products like trade finance, treasury, cash management, insurance, and working capital solutions.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Graduate/Postgraduate in Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* 3–4 years of experience in corporate/SME/ME banking.
* Strong understanding of credit analysis and financial statements.
* Excellent relationship management and communication skills.
* Proven ability to drive business and manage risk effectively.

title: IN-Technical Specialist
description:
**Summary**
Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only-at-Apple experience. At Apple, we believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.
  
  
As a Technical Specialist, you offer technical support and skilled troubleshooting for all customers while also generating excitement for Apple’s products and services. You deliver exceptional service and empower customers to get the most out of their Apple products.
  
  
A Technical Specialist also makes sure customers are educated about repair options and Apple products and services.
  
  
**Description**
Develop knowledge and stay up to date on Apple products, services and Genius Bar repair processes to support efficient and high-quality repairs.
  
  
Support customers having Apple product or software issues with care and empathy, using all tools and resources provided by Apple.
  
  
Troubleshoot, diagnose and resolve service concerns for select Apple hardware and software.
  
  
Work with team leaders to identify recurring repair problems and other service concerns, and make sure that feedback is provided to Apple.
  
  
Provide excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting product and service recommendations, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy.
  
  
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to supporting customer-facing activities on or off the sales floor.
  
  
Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other’s differences and having the curiosity to learn.
  
  
Demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* You can:
* Demonstrate technical expertise of Apple products and services.
* Follow troubleshooting steps to identify the root cause of a technical issue in a customer service environment.
* Navigate customer service issues with care and strong interpersonal skills.

* Work in a fast-paced environment and balance multiple tasks at the same time.
* Work well in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
* Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apple’s core values.
* Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.
