title: Vice President - Transactions
description:
**Job Description**
Are you ready to make a significant impact in the world of trading services? At JPMorganChase, we offer an exciting opportunity for career growth and development as a Trading Services Manager. Join us to leverage your skills in automation and data analysis and be part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.
  
  
As a Trading Services Manager within JPMorganChase, you will be a key player in our team, leveraging your deep knowledge of trade activities and market products to ensure seamless order execution and settlement. Your role will involve managing a diverse team, interpreting customer needs, and identifying trends to generate innovative solutions. You will be responsible for end-to-end trade processing control, monitoring asset and cash levels, and driving continuous improvement in our operating platform. Your advanced understanding of automation technologies and data literacy will be crucial in optimizing our systems and making data-driven decisions. As a recognized expert in your field, you will use your strong presentation skills and influence to communicate insights, manage internal stakeholders, and lead your team through change. Your work will have a wide-ranging impact on our operations, financial management, and service delivery, contributing to the overall success of our firm.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Oversee the end-to-end trade processing control, ensuring accurate order entry, trade execution, and settlement in line with operational policies and precedents.
* Utilize advanced knowledge of market products to monitor and manage asset and cash levels, identifying trends and potential risks.
* Implement automation technologies and data analysis techniques to optimize trading systems, enhance efficiency, and inform strategic decisions.
* Lead and manage a diverse team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation in our trading services.
* Engage with internal stakeholders, leveraging strong presentation skills to communicate insights, drive change, and align operations with the firm's strategic objectives.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* 7+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in trading services, specifically in order execution, trade execution, and settlement.
* Demonstrated advanced skills in using automation technologies to optimize trading systems and processes.
* Advanced knowledge of market products, including their definitions, operating procedures, and relevant industry regulations.
* Proven ability to lead and manage a diverse team, with a focus on fostering continuous improvement and innovation.
* Expertise in data analysis techniques, with the ability to communicate data-driven insights effectively to inform strategic decisions.
* Expertise to create presentations across various levels. Ability to deliver in person & virtual presentations to senior management and stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Skilled in leveraging digital literacy to adopt and integrate innovative technologies, enhancing trade services and operational efficiency.
* Capable of utilizing AI and machine learning to enhance trade service processes and improve decision-making, driving data-driven insights and outcomes.

**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

**Our Purpose**
India is in the middle of an extraordinary AI revolution, powered by a young, tech-savvy generation and visionary leaders who see the future in code and creativity. Across industries—from healthcare to finance to education—AI adoption is accelerating at record speed. Over 90% of business leaders are now reimagining their processes through AI, while developers and students across the country are building tools that are transforming the way India works and lives.

With a fully integrated system and deep local market insight, Neysa helps organizations across sectors confidently adopt, accelerate, govern, and scale AI.

**Who We Are**
Co-founded by industry pioneers Sharad Sanghi and Anindya Das, Neysa combines deep expertise in cloud, AI infrastructure, and cybersecurity to empower the builders of the future.
  
Its flagship product, Neysa Velocis, is a full-stack system built for modern AI—from training and fine-tuning to inference. It streamlines compute, orchestration, security, and observability, helping organizations in high-growth markets like India adopt AI faster, safer, and more cost-efficiently.

**The Opportunity**
Join Neysa as a System Engineer – Linux System & Storage, where you will take ownership of advanced system administration, troubleshooting, and infrastructure reliability in a 24×7 environment.
  
You will act as a key escalation point for critical issues, drive resolution of high-severity incidents, and contribute to improving system performance, automation, and operational excellence across data center and office environments.

**What You’ll Achieve In This Role**

* Lead resolution of critical incidents and complex infrastructure issues
* Ensure high availability, performance, and security of Linux and storage systems
* Strengthen operational maturity through process adherence and documentation
* Drive automation and efficiency across infrastructure management
* Act as a technical mentor and escalation point for L1 and L2 teams

**Roles And Responsibilities:
  
As a Senior System Engineer – Linux System & Storage, you will:**

* Perform advanced configuration, administration, and troubleshooting of Linux systems, storage, backup, hardware, and applications
* Provide technical support and guidance to L1 teams and clients across communication channels
* Be available for 24×7 operational support in rotational shifts
* Handle escalations, severity incidents, and critical projects
* Respond to and resolve incidents, requests, changes, and problems within SLA
* Work on service improvement plans (SIPs) and assigned initiatives
* Ensure adherence to defined processes and operational procedures
* Maintain high availability and uptime of infrastructure systems
* Prepare handover checklists, plans of action (POA), shift reports, SOPs, and KEDB documentation
* Ensure all activities are logged and updated in ticketing systems
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive faster resolutions and improvements

**Required Qualifications**

* 4 to 8 years of experience in Linux System Administration & Storage
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field (preferred)
* Strong experience working in enterprise or data center environments
* Proven ability to handle critical incidents and escalations

**Primary Skills (Must Have)**

* Strong expertise in Linux OS and infrastructure management
* In-depth knowledge of networking concepts: DNS, DHCP, SSH, TCP/IP, SMTP, IP, Iptables/Firewalld
* Experience with web servers and load balancers: Apache, Nginx, HAProxy
* Advanced troubleshooting and analytical skills (logs analysis, event correlation)
* Strong knowledge of storage technologies: LVM, RAID, SAN, NAS, iSCSI
* Proficiency in scripting and automation: Python, Shell scripting, Ansible, Terraform
* Experience with containerization and orchestration: Docker, Containers, Kubernetes
* Hands-on experience with backup technologies: Bacula, Commvault, Veeam

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools: Prometheus, Grafana
* Exposure to provisioning tools like Foreman and MAAS
* Understanding of virtualization platforms: KVM, Proxmox
* Basic knowledge of AI model deployment and fine-tuning
* Experience in driving automation and infrastructure optimization initiatives

**Why This Role is a Unique Opportunity at Neysa**

This role offers the opportunity to work on complex, large-scale infrastructure systems that power AI-driven platforms. You will play a critical role in maintaining system reliability, handling high-impact incidents, and shaping operational excellence in a fast-growing AI ecosystem.
  
You’ll gain deep exposure to enterprise infrastructure, automation practices, and next-generation AI workloads while contributing to a high-performance environment.

* Anticipate market shifts in digital advertising, commerce, and platform monetization to proactively shape Meta's partnership positioning

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* 12+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or corporate development with a focus on monetization, advertising, or platform revenue
* Experience structuring and closing complex, multi-party commercial agreements including revenue-sharing, licensing, or platform monetization deals
* Track record of defining and executing partnership strategies that have generated measurable, large-scale revenue impact
* Experience engaging and influencing C-suite and senior executive stakeholders at partner organizations
* Experience operating independently in ambiguous, high-stakes deal environments with accountability for company-level outcomes

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience building and scaling business development functions or establishing new partnership categories from the ground up

title: Sales Manager – Robotics Division
description:
Sales Manager – Robotics Division

Lead robotics sales at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. Building India's robotics market from the front line is a priceless opportunity.

Sell cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka, Unitree and Hiwin Robotics, to manufacturers across India.

Location: Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane) HQ, with PAN India sales responsibility and regular travel to customer sites

Department: Robotics Division – Sales

Reporting to: Head – Sales / Business Head

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 5+ years, preferably in robotics, cobot or industrial automation sales

The Role

You will own sales for Luna's Robotics Division across India. You will build the strategy, grow key accounts and a strong pipeline, and lead a team of sales engineers. Working with our Field Application Engineers and Managers, you will turn customer problems into robot and AMR solutions, from first meeting and demo to order, commissioning and repeat business.

What You Will Do

• Sales strategy: build and run the robotics sales plan, choose target industries and regions, and set the market-entry approach for new products.

• Solution selling: sell robot, cobot, AMR/AGV, humanoid and robot dog solutions to manufacturers, from discovery and application study to proposal, negotiation and closure.

• Key accounts: own relationships with major customers and grow them into long-term partnerships with repeat orders.

• Pipeline: generate leads, qualify opportunities and keep a healthy, well-documented CRM pipeline.

• Demos and commissioning: work with the FAE/FAM team on demos, proof-of-concept trials, feasibility and smooth commissioning and handover.

• Channel partners: build and manage system integrators, distributors and channel partners to extend our reach across India.

• Team leadership: hire, train, set targets for, coach and motivate the robotics sales team, and build a high-performance sales culture.

• Targets: own order booking and revenue targets, track KPIs and take corrective action early.

• Forecasting and reporting: share accurate forecasts, pipeline reviews and sales reports with management.

• Market insight: track trends, competitors and emerging applications, and represent Luna at exhibitions and industry events.

• Collaboration: share field feedback with marketing, product, operations and our in-house robot design team to shape new products and offers.

• Customer success: support customers through the sales cycle and, with service and technical teams, resolve issues quickly.

Applications You Will Sell Into

Welding, laser cutting, palletizing, material handling, machine tending, assembly, gluing, intralogistics and warehouse automation, flexible manufacturing, metal processing, semiconductor, 3C electronics and new retail.

Must Have

• BE / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation or a related discipline.

• 5+ years in B2B technical sales, preferably selling robots, cobots, AMRs or industrial automation.

• Proven record of meeting sales targets and closing solution sales with manufacturing customers.

• Strong understanding of robotics and industrial automation (robot arms, controllers, servo, drives, motion control, PLC, HMI).

• Experience managing key accounts and working with channel partners or system integrators.

• Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills; able to explain technical products in business language.

• Self-motivated, result-oriented and willing to travel across India.

Good to Have

• Experience selling ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV, warehouse automation or intralogistics sales experience.

• Experience leading or mentoring a sales team.

• Existing network among OEMs, automotive, electronics, FMCG, pharma or general manufacturing customers.

• Familiarity with CRM tools and consultative selling methods.

What You Will Learn

Leading a robotics sales team; selling robotic systems, cobots, AMRs and humanoids across real applications; Luna's Solution Finder and consultative selling approach; robotics and laser automation workflows; and end-to-end B2B solution sales, from lead to repeat business.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Sell products built by our own team, alongside Fairino, Yasaka, Unitree and Hiwin Robotics. A priceless opportunity.

• A product range that opens doors: cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, so you can offer every customer a complete solution.

• Real ownership: shape the strategy, build your team and make fast decisions, with direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: as the Robotics Division scales, your role grows into senior sales and business leadership.

• Strong technical backing: a dedicated FAE/FAM team for demos, trials and commissioning, so you can focus on winning business.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, manufacturer certifications, national and international exhibitions, and new tech in mobile robotics, vision and AI.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance-linked incentives, recognition for top performers and a friendly, growing team.

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners. www.luna.co.in

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "Sales Manager – Robotics".

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Area Sales Manager – Mechatronics (Mumbai Region)
description:
Area Sales Manager – Mechatronics (Mumbai Region)

Build Luna's mechatronics business across Mumbai, Thane, Nashik, Kolhapur and Aurangabad, from the first dealer to the biggest OEM account. You will sell HIWIN, Sungil, WON, TPI and YYC precision motion components to OEMs, machine builders, SPM makers and machine tool builders, directly and through a dealer network you build. Based at our Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane) HQ with regular travel across Maharashtra.

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. provides industrial automation, robotics, motion control, mechatronics and pneumatics solutions to OEMs and manufacturers across India. It is headquartered in Navi Mumbai and has offices across the country.

Your Portfolio

• HIWIN: linear guideways, ball screws, single-axis modules (KK / SK series), torque motor rotary tables, crossed roller and ball screw support bearings.

• Sungil: precision couplings, ball screw support units, connecting shafts and A.P. Lock (power lock).

• WON: super linear bushings, linear bushings, cross roller guideways and linear motion shafts.

• TPI: precision angular contact ball bearings (including ceramic), ball screw support bearings, deep groove ball and cylindrical roller bearings.

• YYC: precision racks and pinions, guideway racks, rollers and planetary reducers.

What You Will Do

• Deliver monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets for the Mumbai region.

• Win new OEM, machine builder, SPM and machine tool accounts, and convert existing linear motion installations to Luna's brands.

• Sell the complete axis: guideway, ball screw or rack and pinion, support units and bearings, couplings and reducers in one package.

• Build a dealer and channel network across Mumbai, Thane, Nashik, Kolhapur and Aurangabad: appoint partners, train them and grow their sales.

• Grow key accounts into long-term, multi-product relationships.

• Close deals with application-led proposals, sizing support and techno-commercial negotiation, backed by our product and application teams.

• Run a clean, forecast-ready pipeline in Salesforce and share regular territory and competitor insight.

• Coach sales engineers and dealer sales staff to sell solutions, not just parts.

Must Have

• Degree or diploma in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Production, Electrical or Electronics Engineering.

• 6–10 years of sales in linear motion, precision bearings, power transmission or motion components, including at least 2 years owning a territory, key accounts or channel partners.

• Hands-on selection and sizing of linear guides, ball screws, rack and pinion or precision bearings for real machine applications.

• An active network of OEMs, machine builders, SPM makers and dealers in Mumbai, Thane, Nashik, Kolhapur or Aurangabad.

• Fluent English, and willingness to travel regularly across Maharashtra.

Good to Have

• Experience selling other leading linear motion brands.

• Marathi and Hindi.

• Exposure to CNC machines and machine tools, SPM, packaging, laser / plasma / waterjet cutting, woodworking and router machines, printing, textile, material handling or medical diagnostic equipment.

• Salesforce or similar CRM experience; an MBA in Sales or Marketing.

What We Offer

Ownership of your territory with direct access to leadership, a clear path into Regional and National Sales leadership, principal training and product certifications, performance incentives, travel support as per policy, paid leave, and statutory benefits.

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Senior  Functional Consultant (Talent, Learning, Recruiting) - Workday Success Plans
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Workday Success Plans Delivery Team at Workday plays a crucial role in ensuring customers maximize the value they get from their Workday products. We focus on our customers’ post go-live journey, assuring long-term success. We deliver a variety of programs and services ranging from feature assessments to full feature deployments to support their growing and changing business needs within Workday.
  
  
At Workday, we help the world’s largest organizations adapt to what’s next by bringing finance, HR, and planning into a single enterprise cloud. We work hard, and we’re serious about what we do. But we like to have fun, too! We put people first, celebrate diversity, drive innovation, and prioritize giving back to our communities, demonstrating a commitment to corporate social responsibility. Our dedication to customer success, coupled with a vibrant and inclusive company culture, sets a strong foundation for continued growth and success at Workday.
  
  
**About The Role**
Would you enjoy learning new things in a fast paced environment? Do you have an appetite for variety and challenging business problems to solve? Are you a great communicator who can clearly articulate and demonstrate the value of Workday solutions to our customers? The Workday Success Plans team works directly with customers through targeted micro consulting engagements to help solve their business needs using the Workday application. Responsible for acting as a trusted Workday advisor, you will have the opportunity to assist customers with how-to questions, troubleshoot and guide customers through configuration, and provide feature demonstrations. As a Workday expert, customers will benefit from your knowledge as you share your experience, identify key considerations, and highlight standard methodologies.
  
  
Our team of professionals have a broad and deep understanding of Workday, and enjoy the reward of helping customers solve problems, learn about new features, and find greater value in their Workday investment. So if you are passionate about the value technology can bring to an organization, love learning and want to work directly with some of the greatest companies on the planet, bring your energy and teamwork to the Workday Success Plans team!
  
  
Primary responsibilities of this role include delivering various services to Workday Success Plans customers. To be successful, this requires:
  
  

* Conducting research to ensure understanding of customer questions and related Workday concepts.
* Delivering small scope consulting in response to customer requests; providing configuration guidance, demonstrations, considerations, tips & tricks.
* Troubleshooting product configuration to resolve or provide optimal product configuration to meet customer business requirements.
* Clearly and effectively communicating responses and value to customers.
* Creating and delivering customer presentations on how to use Workday features to achieve business goals (Accelerator Webinars).
* Providing one-on-one consulting guidance to accelerate customer feature adoption (Feature Accelerator).
* Reviewing customer tenants to identify adoption opportunities (Feature Adoption Tenant Reviews).
* Completing and maintaining product expertise and Workday Certification(s) along with familiarity with Workday roadmap.
* Keeping up to date with industry practices and the ability to engage with our customers on those topics.
* Helping drive the creation of new programs to drive customer feature adoption.

In addition to delivering Workday Success Plans services, our Workday professionals will also deliver other Customer Enablement services, such as:
  
  

* Office Hours to conduct appointment-based consulting engagements providing guidance and product expertise to customers
* Perform configuration and business requirements reviews with a detailed deliverable calling out opportunities for optimization
* Provide one-on-one customer configuration designs
* Deployments including full deployment of Workday features
* Ability to travel up to 10%

**About You**
**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of functional experience in one of the following: Talent, Learning or Recruiting on Workday
* 10+ years of IT implementation experience
* 2+ years software consulting experience

**Other Qualifications:**
Workday Certification in HCM and at least one of the following is ideal: Absence, Payroll, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting,
  
  
Ability to gain a thorough understanding of Workday concepts as new features are released
  
  
Ability to distill complex concepts into understandable presentations for our customers
  
  
Ability to multitask and work on multiple engagements and deliverables simultaneously
  
  
Strong critical thinking skills so as to understand complex, technical process issues and facilitate/influence decision making
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  
  
Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience required. Advanced degree preferred
  
  
**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply
**spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field**
with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
  
  
Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.
  
  
Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.
  
  
If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.
  
  
**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.
  
  
Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.
  
  
In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

**Associate - Infrastructure Security - IN**
Professionals in this group engineer, implement and monitor security measures for the protection of physical IT systems, networks and information for the organization infrastructure.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**

* They Identify and define system security requirements, networking threats, storage requirements and design computer security architecture.
* They also develop detailed cyber security designs and prepare and document standard operating procedures and protocols to maintain infrastructure security.

**Educational Requirements**

* University (Degree) Preferred

**Work Experience**

* No Experience Required

**Physical Requirements**

* Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

**Career Level**
7IC
  
  
**Position Summary:**
  
  
The Lead Information Security Engineering job collaborates with various business units and stakeholders across the organization to monitor external and insider threat detection, mitigation, investigation and response efforts. Working under limited supervision, this job develops and implements robust technical solutions and advanced analytics to enable preventive threat detection efforts. This job also conducts and reviews the testing of the current state of the information security architecture and suggests improvement recommendations by gathering key insights found from testing and analyzing the current systems and networks.
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:**
  
  

* Provides operations and engineering support for critical security systems and services including servers, endpoint security, computer forensics, vulnerability/penetration assessment/mitigation, and security event management.

* Reviews technical feasibility of adopting external cloud based IT platform and infrastructure services within the organization.

* Reports identified intrusion or incident paths and methods discovered through testing and evaluation procedures.
* Designs, develops and implements countermeasures, systems integration and tools specific to cyber and information operations.
* Resolves and documents complex malware and intrusion issues within the system as they occur.
* Functions as an internal information security consultant on the standards, complex issues and best practices for the organization.
* Conducts testing and analysis of complex software systems to determine both the functionality and intent of the systems.
* Communicates with cybersecurity risk and security operation teams to enhance the overall security posture of the enterprise.
* Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals to enhance their knowledge and performance related to information technology (IT) Security.

  
  
**QUALIFICATIONS:**
  
  
**Required skills:**
  
  
  
  

* 5 + years of experience in Information Security or IT Technology.
* 3+ years of experience leading complex enterprise-wide integration programs and efforts as an individual contributor.
* 2+ years of self-leadership experience.
* 2+ years of experience writing Python, Rego, YAML, GRAPH (GQL)
* 2+ years of maintaining a CSPM and SSPM tool that assess, detect, and mitigate misconfigurations & vulnerabilities in the cloud. Preferred tools Adaptive shield, Reco.ai, Wiz.io, Sysdig, AWS Config, etc.
* 2+ years of experience working with services in AWS, GCP, OCI, and Azure.
* 2+ years of experience working with Terraform

**Preferred Skills:**
  
  
  
  

* 3+ years of experience in Cloud Security and Vulnerability Management.
* 3+ years of experience in writing requirements for security technologies.
* 3+ years of experience designing engineering solutions.
* Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, AWS Security, SANS, etc.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to influence, partners, stakeholders, and senior leadership.
* Strong customer service.
* Ability to leverage AI and machine learning to enhance threat detection, incident response, and security posture within cloud environments.

Related Skills
  
  
Accountability, Adaptability, Business Continuity Planning, Cloud Computing Security, Collaboration, Communication, Compliance, Consultative Communication, Cybersecurity, Detail-Oriented, General Risk Management, Network Security, Prioritizes Effectively

description:

RASA Life Science Informatics is a contract research organization (CRO) specializing in solutions and services for the life sciences sector. * Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and handle multiple counseling cases with attention to detail.
* Familiarity with life science informatics, bioinformatics, or related disciplines is an advantage.

title: Senior Structural Steel Connection Design Engineer
description:
**Company:**
Telge Projects Ltd.

**Location:**
India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience Required:**
More than 8 years

Telge Projects Ltd. is looking for an experienced
**Senior Structural Steel Connection Design Engineer**
to lead the day-to-day connection design activities for our
**U.S.-based structural steel fabrication projects**
.

The selected engineer will be responsible for designing connections for both
**main structural steel and miscellaneous metals**
, while working closely with our steel detailing teams and U.S.-based fabricators.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design
  **shear, moment, bracing, splice, and base plate connections**
  for main structural steel.
* Design connections for miscellaneous steel items, including
  **stairs, landings, ladders, railings, and platforms**
  .
* Prepare design calculations, connection sketches, and connection schedules based on project loads, structural drawings, and specifications.
* Identify missing, incomplete, or conflicting design information and raise clear technical RFIs.
* Coordinate with steel detailers and U.S. fabricators to resolve connection design and constructability-related queries.
* Review shop drawings to ensure consistency with the approved connection design.
* Independently check connection design software results and clearly explain the applicable load paths and design assumptions.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in
  **Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering**
  .
* More than
  **8 years of hands-on structural steel connection design experience**
  .
* Proven experience working on
  **U.S. structural steel projects**
  .
* Strong experience in both
  **main structural steel and miscellaneous steel connection design**
  .
* Working knowledge of
  **AISC 360**
  , including applicable bolting and welding requirements.
* Experience using
  **IDEA StatiCa, RAM Connection, RISAConnection, SDS2 Connection Design**
  , or similar connection design software.
* Familiarity with
  **Tekla Structures or SDS2 model and drawing workflows**
  will be an added advantage.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently verify software-generated results.
* Clear written and spoken English for preparing RFIs and coordinating with U.S.-based project teams.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may apply through this LinkedIn job listing by submitting their updated résumé.

Along with your application, please include a short description of:

1. One
   **U.S. main structural steel connection package**
   personally designed by you.
2. One
   **U.S. miscellaneous steel connection package**
   personally designed by you.

Please briefly mention the project scope, connection types, applicable design standards, software used, and your individual responsibilities.

**Join Telge Projects Ltd. and contribute to technically challenging U.S. structural steel projects.**

title: Advanced Field Service Engr
description:
**Job Description**
As part of the global Field Service team, the Senior Field Service Engineer provides field and factory support to customers and channel partners while working closely with internal departments to drive continuous improvement in Sundyne pump and compressor products, processes, and service practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Travel to customer sites to support the installation, pre-commissioning, commissioning, troubleshooting, and rebuilding of Sundyne API and non-API equipment in accordance with OEM and API specifications.
* Supervise customer craft personnel during on-site work to ensure activities are completed safely, accurately, and to the required technical standards.
* Prepare thorough field reports and ensure customer and OEM documentation is completed accurately and on time, including time sheets and travel and expense reports.
* Communicate professionally and collaborate effectively with customer personnel, channel partners, and internal Sundyne teams at all levels.
* Provide technical expertise on centrifugal pumps, centrifugal compressors, controls, instrumentation, and complex rotating-equipment failure modes, including mechanical, electrical, and process-related issues.
* Analyze equipment hardware and operating conditions to identify failure modes and confirm whether parts and systems meet OEM requirements.
* Lead Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) activities with internal teams, customers, and channel partners.
* Troubleshoot field units using control-system logic expertise and verify that control systems are configured for proper Sundyne equipment operation.
* Create and manage service cases in Microsoft CRM to respond to customer and channel-partner service requests.
* Perform independent warranty evaluations at customer sites and on returned hardware to determine whether failure modes are warrantable.
* Deliver excellent customer service and maintain a strong focus on customer satisfaction.
* Follow all safety regulations and processes and complete all required Sundyne job-safety training.
* Train customers and channel partners through quarterly factory training courses.
* Mentor and train junior Field Service Engineers to perform service work in the field according to OEM and API specifications.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Experience with PLCs, rotating equipment, or mechanical systems.
* Knowledge of process-control equipment and the ability to read P&ID drawings to troubleshoot field issues.
* Experience working with cause-and-effect diagrams, P&IDs, and API seal plans.
* Ability to read mechanical drawings and use GD&T to confirm that parts meet OEM specifications.
* Previous experience with international travel and field service assignments.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and act professionally in customer-facing environments.
* Self-directed work style, sound judgment, and the confidence to operate independently in the field.
* Ability to train and mentor junior Field Service Engineers.
* Curiosity, willingness to learn new skills, and a strong problem-solving mindset.
* Ability to adapt on customer sites while managing expectations, constraints, and available resources.
* Strong technical writing skills, including the ability to prepare service reports and RCFA documentation.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronic Engineering with at least five years of field experience; or
* Two-year technical degree in a related field with at least seven years of field experience; or
* A minimum of five years of relevant field experience without a degree.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Strong attention to detail and a high level of focus on customer satisfaction.
* Excellent personal organization and time-management skills.
* Flexibility to manage multiple projects at different stages while balancing competing priorities.
* Experience with PLCs and control logic.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with American Petroleum Institute (API) standards.
* Experience with CAD software such as AutoCAD, NX, or SolidWorks.
* Working knowledge of the concepts, practices, and procedures used in the oil and gas, chemical, or related industries.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

description:
**Description and Requirements**
**"At BMC trust is not just a word - it's a way of life!"**
**Hybrid**
Description and Requirements
  
  
BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
  
  
The IZOT product line includes BMC’s Intelligent Z Optimization & Transformation products, which help the world’s largest companies to monitor and manage their mainframe systems. The modernization of mainframe is the beating heart of our product line, and we achieve this goal by developing products that improve the developer experience, the mainframe integration, the speed of application development, the quality of the code and the applications’ security, while reducing operational costs and risks. We acquired several companies along the way, and we continue to grow, innovate, and perfect our solutions on an ongoing basis.
  
  
BMC is looking for an experienced z/OS Systems Programmer with 5 to 10 years of hands-on technical expertise to join our Mainframe Infrastructure team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the stability, security, and high performance of our core IBM Z operating systems and subsystems. While this role relies heavily on traditional, deep systems programming capabilities, the ideal candidate will also have the opportunity to participate in and support our ongoing mainframe modernization
  
  
**Here is how, through this exciting role, YOU will contribute to BMC's and your own success:**

* OS Installation & Maintenance: Lead the installation, configuration, customization, and migration of z/OS operating systems and related IBM software using SMP/E processing.
* System Customization: Manage system initialization (IPL parameters), Parmlib/Proclib configurations, and master catalog management.
* Sysplex Management: Maintain and support Parallel Sysplex environments, including Coupling Facility (CF) structures and Shared DASD configurations.
* Subsystem Support: Provide systems-level administration and configuration for core components, including JES2, DFSMS, TSO/E, and ISPF.
* Automation & Scripting: Develop, debug, and maintain system automation scripts and utilities using Python, Ansible, REXX, CLIST, and JCL.
* Problem Determination: Perform root-cause analysis on system failures.
* Production Support: Participate in an on-call rotation to provide Tier-3 technical support for critical production infrastructure issues.

**To ensure you’re set up for success, you will bring the following skillset & experience:**

* Experience: 5 to 10 years of solid, hands-on experience as a z/OS Systems Programmer in an enterprise production environment.
* Software Management: Proven, deep knowledge of SMP/E for software installation, patching, and maintenance.
* Core Architecture: Comprehensive understanding of z/OS architecture, IPL sequences, and Unix System Services (USS).
* Tooling: Practical experience with system utilities and performance monitoring tools (e.g., BMC AMI tools, RMF, or equivalent).
* Scripting: Strong proficiency in writing and maintaining Python, REXX and JCL.
* Experience with z/OS Management Facility (z/OSMF) workflows and software management deployment.
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation via Ansible for IBM Z or Python on z/OS.
* Knowledge of integrating mainframe environments into modern DevOps CI/CD pipelines

**Whilst these are nice to have, our team can help you develop in the following skills:**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting mind with high attention to operational stability.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical issues during incident bridges.
* Collaborative mindset to work across siloed infrastructure, security, and application engineering teams.

CA-DNP
  
  
**Our commitment to you!**
BMC’s culture is built around its people. We have 6000+ brilliant minds working together across the globe. You won’t be known just by your employee number, but for your true authentic self. BMC lets you be YOU!
  
  
If after reading the above, You’re unsure if you meet the qualifications of this role but are deeply excited about BMC and this team, we still encourage you to apply! We want to attract talents from diverse backgrounds and experience to ensure we face the world together with the best ideas!

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, visit the accommodation request page.

Actual salaries depend on a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training, licensure, and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.
  
  
The salary listed is just one component of BMC's employee compensation package. Other rewards may include a variable plan and country specific benefits.
  
  
We are committed to ensuring that our employees are paid fairly and equitably, and that we are transparent about our compensation practices.

title: Application Development & Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
Senior Application Development Lead
  
  
SCM Technical & Integration
  
  
**Location**
Pune, India
**Employment Type**
Full-Time
  
  
**Experience**
10+ years preferred
**Leadership Scope**
Lead a team of 3 developers
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a senior-level Application Development Lead to join our Supply Chain Management (SCM) technology team in India. This role combines hands-on development, solution design, application support, integration delivery, and people leadership. The successful candidate will lead and mentor a team of three developers while remaining actively involved in the design, development, review, deployment, and support of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), APIs, and related SCM solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate has strong experience across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C), along with advanced Oracle PL/SQL, Oracle APIs, OIC integrations, REST/SOAP services, reporting, DevOps, and production support capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and guide a team of three developers, including work allocation, technical direction, code reviews, quality oversight, and delivery tracking.
* Act as the technical lead for SCM application enhancements, integrations, incident resolution, and production support.
* Partner with solution architects, functional teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors to translate business requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Prepare and review technical solution documents, design specifications, interface mappings, deployment plans, test evidence, support documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Design, develop, and customize Oracle EBS concurrent programs using PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, and Oracle APIs.
* Build and support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, including orchestrations, scheduled integrations, file-based interfaces, error handling, monitoring, and reprocessing.
* Design, develop, secure, test, and document REST and SOAP APIs for internal and external application integrations.
* Develop and maintain custom interfaces, data conversions, and migration scripts using PL/SQL, SQL\*Loader, Oracle APIs, and other approved integration methods.
* Develop operational and analytical reports using Oracle Reports Builder, XML Publisher/BI Publisher, Discoverer, and related reporting tools.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, Drop Ship Orders, supplier transactions, interfaces, and other P2P/O2C process flows.
* Perform root-cause analysis, implement defect fixes and performance improvements, and drive preventive actions for recurring production issues.
* Ensure code quality through development standards, peer reviews, unit testing, debugging, security controls, documentation, and release-readiness checks.
* Support DevOps and release-management activities, including source control, CI/CD pipelines, deployment coordination, rollback planning, and post-deployment validation.
* Provide technical estimates, identify delivery risks and dependencies, communicate status, and escalate issues when required.
* Promote knowledge sharing, reusable integration patterns, coding standards, and continuous improvement across the development team.

**Required Technical Skills**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in Oracle EBS technical development, SCM applications, enterprise integrations, or a comparable application-development environment.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Oracle EBS SCM modules, with working knowledge of P2P and O2C business processes.
* Advanced Oracle SQL and PL/SQL skills, including packages, procedures, functions, triggers, performance tuning, and debugging.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), including adapters, connections, mappings, orchestrations, schedules, fault handling, monitoring, and integration troubleshooting.
* Strong API-development experience using REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, authentication mechanisms, error handling, versioning, and API documentation.
* Experience with Oracle APIs, interface tables, concurrent programs, SQL\*Loader, and data migration/conversion techniques.
* Experience with Oracle Reports Builder, XML Publisher/BI Publisher, and Discoverer or equivalent reporting technologies.
* Experience with DevOps practices, source control, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release-management processes.
* Ability to develop high-quality technical designs and conduct structured code and design reviews.
* Experience creating and maintaining process flows, system integration diagrams, data-flow diagrams, and technical architecture visuals using Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or comparable diagramming tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, production-support, and root-cause-analysis skills.

Leadership & Professional Skills
  
  

* Prior experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a small technical team.
* Ability to balance team leadership responsibilities with hands-on technical delivery.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage priorities, deadlines, risks, and dependencies.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience collaborating across global, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work effectively within Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid delivery models.
* Commitment to documentation, knowledge transfer, operational stability, and continuous improvement.

Tools & Technologies
  
  
**Category**
**Technologies**
**Core Applications**
Oracle E-Business Suite, SCM, P2P, O2C
  
  
**Development**
Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, SQL Developer, Oracle APIs, SQL\*Loader
  
  
**Integration & APIs**
Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, authentication and API documentation tools
  
  
**Reporting**
Oracle Reports Builder, XML Publisher/BI Publisher, Discoverer
  
  
**DevOps & Deployment**
CI/CD pipelines, source control, WinSCP, SBM, Dimensions CM or comparable tools
  
  
**Monitoring & Analytics**
Power BI, DAX, Snowflake, Grafana, Splunk, AppDynamics or similar tools
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle EBS, API, cloud, or DevOps certifications are preferred.
* Experience working in an IT consulting, shared-services, or global enterprise delivery organization.
* Experience supporting supply chain integrations with third-party platforms, suppliers, logistics providers, or enterprise applications.
* Exposure to Power BI, DAX, Snowflake, Grafana, Splunk, AppDynamics, or comparable analytics and monitoring platforms.

title: CTO and Co Founder with Investment
description:
**Company Description**
FlocknGo is a community-first platform designed for organizers who run paid group activities and for professionals who join them. It replaces fragmented tools like messaging apps, forms, and spreadsheets with a single platform where organizers manage discovery, bookings, payments, and member engagement.
  
  
Members can easily find communities that match their interests, book activities in one tap, and receive updates directly on their preferred messaging channels. The platform focuses on building long-term communities rather than just selling tickets, while maintaining strong privacy standards and never sharing phone numbers.
  
  
FlocknGo is trusted by diverse groups including run clubs, farms, board game organizers, cultural clubs, and professional communities.
  
  
**Role Description**
The CTO and Co Founder with Investment role at FlocknGo is location agnostic, but preferably based in the Pune. This role involves leading the technical vision, designing and evolving the platform architecture, and driving end-to-end product development from concept to deployment.
  
  
The ideal candidate comes from startup ecosystem with any recent exits and looking for the next challenge of building a startup in the emerging Experience Economy.
  
  
The individual will oversee software development processes, coordinate with product and business stakeholders, and ensure that technology decisions align with the company’s community-first strategy. Day-to-day activities include hands-on coding, reviewing technical designs, managing technical roadmaps and sprints, and setting standards for security, scalability, and data privacy.
  
  
As a co-founder with investment, the person will also participate in strategic planning, help build and mentor the engineering team, and contribute to fundraising and partner discussions.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong AI First Software Development skills, including experience with modern web technologies, APIs, and cloud-based platforms.
* Proven ability in Architecture and IT Strategy to design scalable, secure, and privacy-focused systems that support community-centric products.
* Experience in Product Development, from discovery and MVP design through iterations, launches, and user feedback integration.
* Project Management capabilities to plan roadmaps, manage sprints, coordinate cross-functional teams, and deliver on time.
* Background in building or scaling SaaS or marketplace products is highly beneficial.
* Comfort with data-driven decision-making, analytics, and experimentation to improve user experience and platform performance.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a startup environment, take ownership, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Relevant degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Compensation is more of equity, so anyone looking for a regular job, please skip. This role is for entrepreneurs at heart looking for the next big challenge and opportunity.

**The Blueprint**
Stack: Python/Django, Flutter, React.js, hosted on AWS.
  
  
Team: Managing 5 developers.
  
  
Location: Remote (Pune preferred for occasional in-person collaboration).
  
  
Commitment: Full-time preferred, but open to part-time for the right architect.
  
  
Upside: Competitive terms with significant equity participation.
  
  
If you are a builder who wants technical autonomy and serious skin in the game.

description:

* Strong knowledge of embedded firmware design, development, integration, and troubleshooting.

description:
Location for this opening: Pune Factory

Field Application Manager – Robotics

Lead field applications at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. It is a priceless opportunity to shape robotics in India.

Own applications, demos and commissioning for cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with regular travel to customer sites

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 6–10 years

The Role

You will lead Luna's Field Application Engineers and own the technical success of every robotics project across our Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree range: industrial robots and cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoid robots and quadruped robot dogs. You will be the senior technical partner for key accounts and the sales team, and set the standards our field team works to.

What You Will Do

• Lead, coach and plan the work of the FAE team across sites.

• Own application success by validating feasibility, cycle time, cell layouts and AMR/AGV fleet concepts before commitment.

• Plan and deliver high-impact demos and proof-of-concept projects for robot arms, mobile robots, humanoids and robot dogs.

• Set and enforce standards for commissioning, programming, service, documentation and handover.

• Act as the senior technical contact for key accounts, and lead escalations to fast resolution.

• Build training programs for FAEs, sales engineers, partners and customer teams.

• Feed field insight to our in-house robot design team, principals and management.

Must Have

• BE/BTech in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical or Automation Engineering.

• 6–10 years in robotics or automation applications, including at least 2 years leading engineers or projects.

• Hands-on robot/cobot or mobile robot commissioning, with PLC, servo and machine vision integration.

• Proven experience delivering demos, technical presentations and customer training.

• Strong customer-handling skills and willingness to travel to customer sites.

Good to Have

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV fleet deployment, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus.

• Robot cell layout, simulation or offline programming.

• Exposure to safety standards and risk assessment for robot cells and mobile robots.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work directly with our design and manufacturing teams, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity.

• Real ownership: build your team, set the standards and make fast calls, with direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: as the robotics vertical scales, your role grows into senior technical and business leadership.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, manufacturer certifications, and new tech in mobile robotics, vision and motion control.

• High-impact projects: lead flagship deployments in factories, warehouses and new applications for key customers.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives and a supportive, growing team.

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners.

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "FAM – Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi).

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services**
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and technical tax resources to comply with reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy smarter approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
  
  
You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter-personal skills to build the required relationships.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities -**

* Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
* Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
* Code Python is a plus.
* Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API-calls and MCP- servers is key.
* Build end-to-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
* Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
* Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).
* Implement Fiori-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable).
* Integrate with SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
* Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
* Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in-app/extensibility, key-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean-core approach where applicable).
* Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
* Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root-cause analysis

**Qualification And Experience Required -**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
* Hands-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
* SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
* SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
* Strong hands-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
* Proven delivery experience with:
* RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
* CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
* OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
* Strong understanding of HANA-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT-in-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
* Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
* Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).
* BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.
* Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.

title: Field Application Manager – Robotics
description:
Field Application Manager – Robotics (Pune)

Lead field applications at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. Based at our Pune factory, you will lead our Field Application Engineers and own the technical success of every robotics project across industrial robots, cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs. Our range includes Yasaka industrial robots, FAIRINO cobots, and new-age Unitree humanoid robots and robot dogs (quadrupeds).

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. provides industrial automation, robotics, motion control, mechatronics and pneumatics solutions to OEMs and manufacturers across India. It is headquartered in Navi Mumbai and has offices across the country.

What You Will Do

• Lead, coach and plan the work of the FAE team.

• Own application success by validating feasibility, cycle time, cell layouts and AMR/AGV fleet concepts before commitment.

• Plan and deliver high-impact demos and proof-of-concept projects for robot arms, mobile robots, and Unitree humanoid robots and robot dogs.

• Lead the installation and commissioning of AMRs (autonomous mobile robots) and AGVs (automated guided vehicles) at customer sites, from site survey and mapping to fleet go-live and handover.

• Set and enforce standards for commissioning, programming, service, documentation and handover.

• Act as the senior technical contact for key accounts and the sales team, and lead escalations to fast resolution.

• Build training programmes for FAEs, sales engineers, partners and customer teams.

• Feed field insight to our in-house robot design team, our principals and management.

Products You Will Work With

Yasaka industrial robots, FAIRINO cobots, and new-age Unitree humanoid robots and robot dogs (quadrupeds).

Must Have

• BE/BTech in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical or Automation Engineering.

• 6–10 years in robotics or automation applications, including at least 2 years leading engineers or projects.

• Hands-on robot, cobot or mobile robot commissioning, with PLC, servo and machine vision integration.

• Proven experience delivering demos, technical presentations and customer training.

• Strong customer-handling skills and willingness to travel to customer sites from the Pune base.

Good to Have

• Hands-on experience with Yasaka, FAIRINO, Unitree or other industrial robots, cobots, humanoids or quadruped robots.

• AMR/AGV fleet deployment, mapping and navigation; ROS experience.

• Robot cell layout, simulation or offline programming.

• Exposure to safety standards and risk assessment for robot cells and mobile robots.

What We Offer

The chance to build and lead the field team, direct work with our in-house design and manufacturing teams, principal and OEM training and certifications, a growth path into senior technical and business leadership, performance incentives, travel support as per policy, paid leave, and statutory benefits.

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: NPDI Lead Engineer - Liquid Cooling (TCS/SFN)
description:
**Job Description**
**NPDI Lead Engineer - Liquid Cooling (TCS/SFN)**
Seeking a NPDI Lead Engineer - Liquid Cooling (TCS/SFN) with expertise in Technical Cooling Systems (TCS) / Secondary Fluid Networks (SFN) or broader piping and fluid systems to lead NPDI projects for TCS/SFN and drive the development of next-generation liquid cooling distribution solutions. The role is responsible for setting design standards, leading the team and projects globally, ensuring integration across NPDI, Application Engineering, and ETO, and mentoring engineers to build global consistency. The position requires deep technical skills in fluid and piping systems, expert proficiency with Creo, strong PLM experience, and the ability to define and own tools and processes that streamline layout creation, quoting, and product development.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead TCS/SFN design deliverables through all NPDI stages, from concept to product launch, ensuring technical robustness and manufacturability.
* Define and develop standard TCS/SFN modules (headers, manifolds, valves, fittings, hoses, expansion tanks, filters, quick disconnects) for reuse across platforms. Create and manage PTC Creo models, design libraries, and assemblies for TCS/SFN components and systems.
* Perform system sizing and validation, flow balancing, pressure drop, NPSH margin, valve Cv selection, and pump/loop analysis.
* Oversee prototype builds, validation test plans, and test execution (pressure, leak, flow/thermal, cleanliness, condensation/dew point).
* Work in PLM systems (e.g., Oracle PD Cloud, Windchill) to manage BOMs, drawings, engineering changes, and product documentation.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with global engineering, operations, supply chain, and quality to align TCS/SFN design with product roadmap goals.
* Ensure integration across Application Engineering, NPDI, and ETO projects to drive consistency, reuse, and customer alignment.
* Drive supplier engagement, define specifications, support RFQs, and validate supplier designs for manufacturability and cost effectiveness.
* Provide technical ownership of future configurator and rapid layout tools (e.g., CPQ-Creo integration, Revit) to streamline quoting and design processes.
* Mentor mechanical engineers and review custom order learnings to feed back into NPDI modules and roadmap planning.
* Ensure adherence to ASME/ASHRAE standards and internal design guidelines for liquid-cooled piping systems.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.
* 10+ years of experience in piping and fluid systems, preferably in data center liquid cooling, HVAC, hydronics, or process cooling, with direct experience in Technical
* Cooling Systems (TCS) / Secondary Fluid Networks (SFN) highly desirable.
* Expert proficiency with PTC Creo for assemblies, layouts, routing, and detailed drawings.
* Strong working knowledge of PLM systems (e.g., Oracle PD Cloud, Windchill) for BOM management, engineering change control, and design lifecycle management.
* Proven record of leading NPDI projects using Stage Gate or equivalent processes, ensuring integration across application engineering, NPDI, and ETO workflows.
* Hands-on validation experience including pressure/leak testing, flow and thermal testing, cleanliness protocols, and condensation/dew point checks.
* Knowledge of ASME and ASHRAE guidelines for liquid cooling and piping systems.
* Deep expertise in DFM/DFA principles, weld/braze methods, and supplier fabrication processes.
* Strong documentation skills, including preparation of PFDs, P&IDs, test reports, engineering change orders, and sustaining handoffs.
* Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with global engineering teams across regions.
* Strong leadership, organizational, and collaboration skills.
* Proven ability to define and own engineering tools and configurators that enable rapid layout creation, quoting, and design reuse.

**Preferred Skills**

* Direct experience with TCS/SFN systems for high-density data centers, AI, or HPC applications.
* Experience with hydraulic modeling for loop balancing, pressure-drop analysis, and system sensitivity studies.
* Exposure to CFD or other thermal/fluid simulation tools.
* Experience with sanitary or high-cleanliness stainless-steel piping, orbital welding, flushing, passivation, and contamination control.
* Experience with PP-R/PP-RCT or other engineered polymer piping systems.
* Experience overseeing prototype builds, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and validation reporting.
* Experience with modular/prefabricated liquid-cooling systems, CPQ tools, Creo automation, or Revit workflows.

title: BIM Lead Architect
description:
**Company Description**
Kshitij3 is a BIM consultancy focused on helping general contractors deliver complex data centre projects on schedule by closing coordination gaps early. The team has coordinated multiple large-scale data centres exceeding 100+ MW and specializes in resolving issues such as stalled shop drawings, unowned coordination meetings, and looping CDR processes. Kshitij3 stands out by using structured coordination SOPs, rigorous QC checks on every deliverable, and a dedicated team that stays engaged through project handover. The company offers practical, time-bound BIM audits, providing ranked lists of coordination gaps and clear readouts that help reduce rework. Kshitij3 is driven by a commitment to move beyond “good enough” and deliver reliable, high-quality outcomes for India’s data centre and construction ecosystem.

**Role Description**
The BIM Lead Architect is a full-time, on-site role based in the Pune Division, responsible for leading BIM-driven architectural coordination on data centre and similar complex projects. This role oversees the development, review, and integration of architectural BIM models, ensuring they are clash-resolved, aligned with client requirements, and ready for timely shop drawing production. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing multidisciplinary coordination meetings, maintaining structured issue lists, enforcing SOPs and QC processes, and working closely with project managers, engineers, and contractors to keep deliverables on track. The BIM Lead Architect will guide the team in implementing best practices for model integration, documentation standards, and version control, while supporting continuous improvement of Kshitij3’s coordination workflows. The role also involves mentoring junior team members, supporting client readouts, and contributing to solution design that reduces rework and enhances project predictability.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Architecture and Architectural Design, with proven experience on complex commercial or data centre projects.
* Candidates should possess skills in Project Management, including coordination of multidisciplinary teams, scheduling, and issue tracking within BIM-based workflows.
* Candidates should possess skills in Software Development and Integration as applied to BIM environments, such as scripting, automation, and connecting BIM tools with other project systems.
* Proficiency in leading BIM platforms (e.g., Revit, Navisworks, or comparable tools) and experience with clash detection, model federation, and drawing production.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Architecture or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated ability to run coordination meetings, communicate clearly with clients and contractors, and document decisions and action items effectively.
* Experience in data centre or mission-critical facilities is highly beneficial, along with familiarity with quality control processes for BIM deliverables.
* Ability to work on-site in the Pune Division

Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. Identify Program quality methodologies, define and track quality metrics and ensure continued process quality improvement within the program.

Champion in tracking initiatives progress/reports using Agile project management tools such as Jira, Rally.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision.
