Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.
  
  
If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
  
  
For more information, visit https://legion.co
  
  
**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

title: Account Executive - New Business & Client Partnerships
description:
ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE - NEW BUSINESS & CLIENT PARTNERSHIPS

Pune | Full-time | On-site | Freshers to 3 years | Immediate / earliest joining preferred

Compensation: Up to INR 30,000 per month + 5% recurring commission on eligible net agency revenue from clients you personally acquire.

ABOUT AIDEATORS & CO.

AIDEATORS & Co. is an AI-first creative and technology company. We build AI-powered advertising, video production, digital storytelling, AI influencers, lead-generation systems, marketing automation and business solutions.

YOUR MISSION

Find the right lead. Start the right conversation. Get us into the room. Build a relationship worth keeping.

You will work with the founder across the full client journey: prospect research, outreach, qualification, meeting preparation, client communication, account retention and growth.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

New business and lead generation

• Research brands, founders, marketing leaders and agencies that could benefit from AIDEATORS.

• Identify relevant decision-makers and understand their business, audience, requirements and buying signals.

• Build a qualified pipeline and assess leads for fit, need, authority, budget and timing.

• Use personalised LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, calls and referrals to start conversations.

• Handle early questions and objections, follow up professionally and secure qualified Google Meet calls.

• Prepare prospect research, meeting notes, next steps and handover context for the founder.

Client partnerships and account management

• Become a dependable point of contact once an account is onboarded.

• Understand briefs, expectations, feedback and business priorities.

• Coordinate clearly between the client and our creative and production teams.

• Track commitments, approvals, risks and next steps.

• Identify concerns early, resolve communication gaps and help retain client trust.

• Spot repeat-project, renewal, referral, cross-sell and upsell opportunities.

CRM, pipeline and AI automation

• Maintain accurate CRM records for leads, conversations, follow-ups, meetings and account activity.

• Build a disciplined follow-up system so no opportunity or client request is missed.

• Use AI and automation to research leads, enrich data, personalise outreach and improve sales operations.

• Help improve the systems through which AIDEATORS finds, qualifies, serves and retains clients.

The founder will initially lead major pitches, final pricing and commercial negotiations. You will support those conversations and grow into greater ownership.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Clear spoken and written English.

• Strong persuasion, negotiation, listening and relationship-building skills.

• A go-getter who creates opportunities, follows through and stays composed around rejection.

• Commercial curiosity to understand how a brand works before pitching it.

• Strong organisation and attention to detail across multiple prospects, clients and internal teams.

• Basic understanding of AI and how it supports content, advertising, sales and business workflows.

• Comfortable working from our Pune office.

FRESHERS ARE WELCOME

You do not need a traditional sales title. College societies, sponsorships, internships, freelancing, client-facing projects, side businesses and personal ventures count if they show initiative, persuasion or relationship ownership.

PREFERRED BACKGROUND

Experience of 1-3 years in business development, account management, client servicing, sales or partnerships is valuable.

Prior work with an advertising agency, creative agency, digital agency, media house, production house, content studio, SaaS company or marketing team is a major advantage.

Experience in media, advertising or production is preferred because you will speak credibly about creative work and production delivery.

TOOLS

Experience with ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, n8n, Zapier, Make, email outreach tools, Google Sheets or Google Workspace is valuable but not mandatory.

We can teach tools. We are looking for hunger, judgment, integrity and discipline.

COMPENSATION

• Fixed salary up to INR 30,000 per month, based on ability, experience and selection performance.

• 5% recurring commission on eligible net agency revenue collected from clients you personally acquire.

• The commission continues while the client remains active and pays AIDEATORS, you remain employed with AIDEATORS, and you own or actively support the account.

• Commission is paid after AIDEATORS receives payment. GST, refunds, unpaid invoices, pass-through expenses and vendor costs billed at cost are excluded. Full terms will be stated in the offer.

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

You will work alongside the founder and learn how to research and approach decision-makers, sell AI-powered creative and technology services, prepare pitches, manage client relationships, improve sales systems and grow accounts.

SELECTION PROCESS

Shortlisted applicants may complete a prospect-research exercise, personalised outreach task, live sales role-play, client-retention scenario and final founder conversation.

If you can find the opportunity, make the conversation happen and build the trust to keep it going, we would like to meet you.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and target-driven Sales Executive to identify new business opportunities, generate leads, develop customer relationships, and drive sales of Professional AV solutions. The candidate will be responsible for managing customer interactions, understanding business requirements, presenting suitable AV solutions, achieving assigned sales targets, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Lead Generation**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities for Professional AV solutions, including projectors, Interactive Flat Panels (IFPs), sound systems, professional audio solutions, conferencing systems, and control systems.
* Generate leads through market research, networking, client visits, referrals, and other business development activities.
* Identify potential customers across corporate, institutional, educational, and other relevant market segments.
* Develop and maintain relationships with channel partners, dealers, system integrators, consultants, and corporate clients.

**2. Sales & Revenue Generation**

* Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* Drive revenue growth through new customer acquisition and repeat business.
* Follow up on prospective customers, negotiate commercial terms, and convert leads into confirmed orders.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and ensure timely follow-ups to improve lead conversion.
* Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities within existing accounts.

**3. Product Presentation & Solution Selling**

* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable Professional AV solutions.
* Conduct product demonstrations, presentations, and client meetings to showcase product features and benefits.
* Explain technical specifications and translate product features into relevant business benefits.
* Prepare and share quotations, techno-commercial proposals, and tender documents in coordination with the HOD and Head Office team.
* Maintain updated knowledge of company products, industry developments, competitor offerings, and emerging AV technologies.

**4. Customer Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Regularly follow up with clients regarding enquiries, quotations, negotiations, and order status.
* Understand customer expectations and provide appropriate product and solution recommendations.
* Ensure a positive customer experience and maintain long-term business relationships.
* Coordinate with the relevant teams to address customer queries and resolve concerns.

**5. Payment Follow-up & Commercial Coordination**

* Follow up with customers for timely payment collection as per agreed credit terms.
* Monitor pending payments and outstanding receivables for assigned accounts.
* Coordinate with the Finance and Accounts team to resolve billing, payment, and reconciliation issues.
* Ensure adherence to company pricing, credit, and commercial policies.

**6. Internal Coordination & Sales Reporting**

* Coordinate with technical support, logistics, operations, and finance teams for smooth order processing and project execution.
* Work closely with the Head Office team for product availability, pricing, technical assistance, and proposal preparation.
* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales activity reports covering client visits, calls, meetings, demonstrations, quotations, and order status.
* Maintain updated customer databases, sales records, lead status, and follow-up details.
* Provide regular feedback on customer requirements, market trends, and competitor activities to the reporting manager.

**7. After-Sales Support**

* Coordinate with the service and technical support teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.
* Follow up with customers after order delivery and installation to ensure satisfaction.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and customer referrals.

title: Parts Sales (New Aftermarket) - Pune
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**
The Key Account Manager (KAM) is the dedicated owner of aftermarket revenue and customer relationships for a defined set of strategic accounts that collectively represent a large share of addressable AM revenue in the region. The KAM is the single commercial point of contact at these accounts for spare parts, M-Powered contracts, retrofits and any other new AM offerings, and is responsible for converting whitespace into recurring aftermarket revenue.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Account Ownership & Revenue Growth**

* Manage assigned strategic accounts end-to-end for all aftermarket revenue streams
* Deliver the assigned account-level AM revenue target across spares, M-Powered, retrofits and new AM products
* Convert whitespaces in assigned regions – identify under-penetrated SKUs, machines and product categories and activate them
* Build and protect Milacron's entitlement value (SOM) capture at each account

**Customer Engagement & Coverage**

* Maintain a structured visit / call plan (PJP) across assigned accounts – minimum weekly customer visits and calls per defined cadence
* Build relationships across plant-level and corporate-level decision-makers (maintenance, procurement, plant heads)
* Handle commercial and service-related escalations in coordination with the Regional Service team (Regional Service Managers and Service Engineers)

**Contracting & Upsell**

* Push Milacron spare part sales, consumable kits, and structured replacement programs
* Drive M-Powered contract closures; build the pipeline at the account level
* Coordinate with Service Engineers to convert any SE-flagged upsell opportunities in their accounts into closed orders

**Reporting & Governance**

* Maintain accurate account, opportunity and visit data in CRM / MIS
* Submit weekly coverage reports and monthly account reviews to the Regional Aftermarket Head

**SUCCESS METRICS / KPIS**
**Revenue & Growth**
**Customer Coverage**
**Operational Discipline**

* Account AM revenue vs. target (primary KPI)
* SOM capture % at assigned customers
* M-Powered penetration in assigned accounts
* Customer visits per week / calls per week (PJP adherence %)
* Customer NPS at assigned accounts
* Whitespace accounts activated
* CRM data hygiene (% complete records)
* On-time submission of weekly / monthly reports

**Key Skill Requirements**
**Skill Dimension**
**What We Are Looking For**
**Technical & Commercial**

* B2B field sales and account management in capital goods or industrial equipment
* Strong product and spare-parts knowledge (injection moulding preferred)
* Account mining, negotiation and deal closing

**Analytics & Planning**

* Account revenue analysis and visit planning (PJP)
* Sales forecasting and pipeline tracking
* Proficiency in Excel / MIS reporting, CRM and PJP / route-planning tools

**Interpersonal**

* Customer relationship management at plant and corporate levels
* Cross-functional coordination with service teams

**Behavioural**

* Customer-first mindset
* Hunter mentality and self-motivation
* Strong communication skills and resilience

**Experience Profile**

* 4-5 years of B2B sales / key account management experience in capital goods, industrial equipment or aftermarket
* Demonstrated record of growing account-level revenue and converting whitespace opportunities
* Exposure to spare-parts or aftermarket selling preferred
* Engineering background (Mechanical / Production) preferred

**Who We Are**
Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company’s 1,900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27,000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron’s global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America.

title: Recruiter
description:
We are seeking an energetic and results-driven Automobile Dealership Recruiter to lead talent acquisition for our growing dealership group. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and hiring top-tier automotive professionals—ranging from high-performing sales consultants to certified service technicians. You will partner closely with the General Manager and department heads to keep our dealership fully staffed with talent that drives sales and delivers exceptional customer service.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Dealership Talent Sourcing: Proactively source active and passive candidates for critical dealership roles, including Sales, Service & Support functions.
* High-Volume Recruiting: Manage high-volume recruitment cycles, particularly for sales and service departments, ensuring a continuous pipeline to minimize empty floor slots or open service bays.
* Technical & Trade Outreach: Build relationships with local automotive trade schools, technical colleges, Professional courses college, ITI etc
* Hiring Manager Collaboration: Partner with the General Manager, Service Director, and Sales Managers to understand seasonal hiring spikes, technical certification requirements, and personality alignments for the floor.
* Screening & Assessment: Review resumes, conduct initial phone screenings, and evaluate candidates for key automotive traits like strong communication, work ethic, technical aptitude, and clean driving records.
* Brand Ambassadorship: Promote the dealership’s culture, commission structures, and growth paths

* Active Headhunting: Map local and regional competitors to directly source and approach passive talent, including top-producing Sales Consultants and Finance & Insurance (F&I) Managers.
* Technical Service Pipeline Sourcing: Build and maintain direct pipelines for skilled labor by recruiting from independent repair shops, competing OEM dealerships, and establishing relationships with automotive trade schools & colleges.
* Digital Sourcing Strategies: Utilize advanced Boolean search strings, LinkedIn Recruiter, specialized automotive networks, Facebook Jobs, and local community forums to uncover hidden talent pools.
* Grassroots & Local Networking: Attend local car shows, automotive trade expos, and community job fairs to build a physical network of prospective dealership talent.

* Employee Referral Programs: Drive and optimize internal referral campaigns to leverage the personal networks of our current technicians, mechanics, and sales staff.

Requirements
  
  

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

* Experience: 2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience. Experience in the automotive retail or dealership sector is highly preferred (or experience in high-turnover industries like retail, hospitality, or commission-based sales).

title: Principal Engineer Software (Full Stack)
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**Job Summary**
Prisma Access™ (formally GlobalProtect Cloud Service) provides protection straight from the cloud to make access to the cloud secure. It combines the connectivity and security you need and delivers it everywhere you need it. Using cutting-edge public and private cloud technologies extending the next-generation security protection to all cloud services, customers on-premise remote networks and mobile users.
  
  
As a Principal Full Stack Engineer on the Prisma Access team, you will be instrumental in developing our next-generation security offerings. You will focus on creating advanced visualization, monitoring, configuration, and analytics solutions. This role involves designing and implementing new UI web services, managing complex backend deployments, and handling integrations with both public and private cloud environments to protect our digital way of life.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement scalable, modular full-stack architectures, ensuring seamless data flow between high-performance frontend interfaces and robust backend microservices.
* Actively participate in the full product development lifecycle, from API contract definition and schema design to implementation, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment.
* Develop and maintain high-concurrency UI web services and RESTful/gRPC APIs that integrate with public (AWS, GCP) and private cloud infrastructures.
* Optimize data fetching, caching, and state management strategies to handle massive security datasets from distributed systems like BigQuery or Snowflake.
* Proactively collaborate with design, product, and platform engineering teams to ensure frontend requirements are supported by backend capabilities.
* Continuously identify, suggest, and implement improvements to development processes, including containerization (Docker/K8s) and server-side performance tuning.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related equivalent field.
* Minimum of 10 years of professional programming experience with a demonstrated track record of building complex, data-driven web applications.
* Expert-level proficiency with ReactJS and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems in high-scale production environments.
* Strong professional experience in at least one backend language such as GoLang, Python, or Java, with a deep understanding of asynchronous programming and concurrency.
* Proven experience designing and building scalable microservices and modular architectures for complex systems.
* Hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes (K8s), and cloud provider services (e.g., AWS Lambda, S3, or DynamoDB).
* Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a dynamic, fast-paced setting.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, as well as distributed data processing (e.g, Redis).
* Deep knowledge of API design principles (REST, GraphQL, or gRPC) and experience with authentication protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML).
* AI first approach to coding and problem solving. Experience with AI based coding tools such as Claude code, codex, cursor, co-pilot (GitHub).
* Experience working within the cybersecurity industry or on security-focused products (e.g., SASE, SSE, or Firewall management).

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Lead Software Engineer (Java Full stack developer)
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Software Engineer (Java Full stack developer)
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
Mastercard’s Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth & innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a ‘Lead Software Engineer’ for Payment Reconciliation Intelligence Program, within B&MI group, to design scalable architecture and lead development of the new business requirements for product used by global B2B customers.
  
  
Role and Responsibility
  
  
As a Lead SDE you will design, develop and lead full-stack Java scalable applications with React or Angular as the frontend.
  
  

* Act as senior most engineers in the team to determine everything from design choices to technical standards, such as platforms and coding standards.
* Design and implement software aligned with Mastercard’s Enterprise Architecture and services.

Write high-quality, maintainable code that meets business needs and adheres to timelines.
  
  

* Collaborate with cross functional teams - Product teams to understand the requirements, define product, identify solution, propose ideas and provide technical thought leadership.
* Provide detailed cost and time estimates, define technical scope and requirements, and assist project managers in managing scope throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure system design supports zero downtime in production.
* Address operational and business concerns to ensure consistent delivery of quality services.
* Lead highly focused team of engineers with an eye on innovation and AI adoption

-All About You-
  
  
Education and professional experience
  
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple organizational levels.
  
  
Around 9 years of work experience in the software engineering role.
  
  
Technical Expertise
  
  
Strong proficiency in Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Hibernate, and modern database technologies including Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch.
  
  
Proven experience designing, developing, and leading applications built on microservices-based architectures.
  
  
Hands-on experience with messaging and event-driven platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, or other cloud-native messaging solutions.
  
  
Front-end development experience using React JS (16+) or Angular (14+).
  
  
Experience designing and developing APIs using OpenAPI specifications and RESTful best practices.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, Node.js, UNIX shell scripting, Python, and Groovy scripting.
  
  
Understanding of modern application security, scalability, resiliency, and performance engineering practices.
  
  
Tools & Methodologies
  
  
Proficiency with build and dependency management tools such as Maven and Gradle.
  
  
Experience with automation and configuration management tools including Chef and Ansible.
  
  
Hands-on experience with Jenkins, SonarQube, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile software development methodologies.
  
  
Strong understanding of release management practices including Canary, Blue-Green, and Rolling deployments.
  
  
Infrastructure & Cloud
  
  
Extensive experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native application development.
  
  
Strong expertise in containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
  
  
Deep understanding of DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, deployment strategies, and operational excellence in cloud environments.
  
  
Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, ELK Stack, and related logging platforms.
  
  
AI & Emerging Technologies
  
  
Exposure to Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) based solutions, including integrating AI services through APIs and leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and enterprise AI platforms.
  
  
Familiarity with AI-driven application patterns such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent workflows, agentic solutions, and prompt engineering concepts for enterprise applications.
  
  
Good to have Skills
  
  
Experience working across multiple programming languages such as Java, Scala, C#, and Python.
  
  
Familiarity with workflow orchestration and automation platforms including Netflix Conductor, Apache Airflow, Camunda, and N8N.
  
  
Knowledge of OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing concepts.
  
  
Familiarity with business rules engines such as Drools and EasyRules.
  
  
Strong understanding of cryptographic concepts including PKI infrastructure, hashing, encryption, consensus algorithms, and virtual machine architectures.
  
  
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and infrastructure automation frameworks.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Lead, Software Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
We are a small engineering team inside Northern Trust's cybersecurity organization, and we'll be building modern agentic solutions: AI agents and the harnesses that connect large language models to tools, data and workflows. We are looking for a senior software engineer who still loves to write code. You will own the design and delivery of major parts of these solutions, set the engineering bar for the team and mentor other engineers.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Design and build significant components of our agentic solutions, from architecture through production.
* Write production code every week, mostly in Python, and review the code of others.
* Design APIs, data models and integrations with internal platforms and third-party tools.
* Build AI agents and the harness code around them, including tool calling, retrieval, context management and evaluation.
* Set team standards for testing, CI/CD, observability and code quality.
* Mentor engineers and help break large problems into well-scoped work.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 12+ years of professional software development experience, including leading the design of applications or services that run in production.
* Expert skills in Python, or another modern language such as TypeScript, Java, C# or Go.
* Strong experience with backend architecture: REST APIs, microservices or event-driven design, and database design.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS), containers and CI/CD.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical work across a small team.
* A product or major component you designed and built that you can walk us through in detail.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience building production applications with LLMs (for example RAG, agents or model APIs).
* Familiarity with security concepts such as identity, access control, threat modeling and secure coding.
* Experience in financial services or another regulated industry.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Principal Pre-Silicon Firmware Lead
description:
**Description**
**Invent the future with us.**
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a
**Principal Pre-Silicon Firmware Lead**
to architect and implement low-level software for our next-generation microcontrollers/ SoCs. You will bridge the gap between hardware architecture and final software delivery. You will own the pre-silicon development lifecycle—including driver development for CAN/CAN-FD/CAN XL stacks —using high-performance enterprise emulation environments and ensures hardware-software co-design that satisfies strict ISO 26262 safety and high-quality engineering frameworks up to ASIL-D.
  
  
**What You’ll Achieve**
**Technical Leadership & Hardware Co-Design**

* Drive firmware architecture and technical roadmaps for in-house microcontroller/ SOCs.
* Align development milestones with SoC architecture, RTL design, verification, and post-silicon validation teams.
* Provide technical mentorship and enforce rigorous coding standards (MISRA C/C++).
* Author comprehensive design specifications, firmware architecture documentation, and test strategies.

**Pre-Silicon Validation & Emulation**

* Develop early boot code, low-level drivers, and runtime firmware targeting pre-silicon environments.
* Lead virtual bring-up and hardware-software co-verification using both enterprise emulation platforms like Cadence Palladium/ Synopsys ZeBu.
* Optimize firmware execution speed
* Debug complex, deep-silicon anomalies using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers, and internal emulator trace features.

**Communication Drivers & Protocols**

* Design, implement, and optimize highly robust peripheral drivers for CAN, CAN-FD, and CAN XL.
* Develop and maintain critical application layer protocols, featuring standard diagnostics (ISO 14229), network management, and heavy-duty diagnostic framing fault handling.
* Design, implement and Integrate communication driver stacks into industry standard layers (e.g., AUTOSAR MCAL interfaces).
* Deep knowledge of priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and cyclical redundancy check (CRC) validation

**Safety & Quality Compliance**

* Enforce absolute compliance with ISO 26262 safety requirements.
* Participate in safety analyses (FMEA, root cause analysis) to ensure driver-level fault-handling routines are deterministic.

**About You**

* Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master’s degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware development, specifically within the embedded semiconductor or safety-critical industry
* 3+ years acting as a Technical Lead or Principal Engineer guiding architectural decisions and mentoring engineering teams.
* Expert proficiency in Embedded C with strict adherence to MISRA guidelines.
* Deep knowledge of embedded MCU/SoC architectures, including ARM Cortex-M/R or multi-core safety architectures.
* Direct hands-on experience with hardware emulation platforms, specifically Cadence Palladium and/or Synopsys ZeBu systems
* Authoritative understanding of industrial fieldbus architectures (ISO 11898 standard family), physical/data link layers, priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and diagnostic implementations
* Proficient with professional embedded pipelines, including ARM compiler toolchains, JTAG debuggers (e.g., Lauterbach), and emulation control scripts
* Experience with ISO 26262 functional safety requirements up to ASIL-D
* Understanding of HSM/SHE concepts and secure boot requirements
* Experience building automated testing setups using Python and continuous integration tools (e.g., Jenkins)

**What We’ll Offer**
At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.
  
  
**Benefits Highlights Include**

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Technical Support Manager — D365 CE or FNO
description:
**Description**
Company Overview:
  
  
When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end-to-end service offerings, there’s really only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM
  
  
Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end-to-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud & Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a committed and hands-on Technical Support Manager to lead our Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (D365 CE or FNO) support function. The successful candidate will manage a team of more than ten support engineers and maintenance staff, work across multiple rotational shifts to ensure round-the-clock coverage, and serve as the first point of escalation for SLA breaches and production outages.
  
  
This role combines deep functional expertise in D365 CE and sales processes (Order-to-Cash) with strong people leadership, process governance, and a continuous-improvement mindset. The Technical Support Manager will also oversee 2 to 5 short-term initiatives (1 to 6 months in duration) focused on bug fixes, technical-debt reduction, and incremental enhancements.
  
  
What you’ll do as the Technical Support Manager — D365 CE or FNO :
  
  
Support Operations and SLA Management
  
  

* Operate the D365 CE support function and ensure all support tickets are resolved within agreed SLAs.
* Act as the first point of escalation for SLA breaches, P1/P2 incidents, and production outages.
* Govern the support playbook; continuously improve processes through automation and root-cause prevention.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on critical issues and drive permanent fixes.
* Define, track, and report on key support metrics and KPIs (MTTR, first-response time, ticket aging, CSAT).

Team and Project Management
  
  

* Lead and mentor a team of 10+ support engineers and maintenance staff across multiple shifts.
* Manage 2 to 5 short-term projects (1 to 6 months) covering bug fixes, technical debt, and minor enhancements.
* Run scrum ceremonies — sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives — and deliver high-quality fixes on schedule.
* Conduct performance reviews, capacity planning, and skills development for the team.

Quality and Knowledge Management
  
  

* Ensure quality checks on knowledge-base articles and ticket-closure documentation.
* Develop new runbooks and update existing ones based on incident learnings and data-driven decisions.
* Promote a culture of documentation, peer review, and continuous learning within the team.

D365 CE and Sales Process (Must Have)
  
  

* D365 CE: Hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (D365 CE) as an end-user, support engineer, or developer.
* Sales Process: Strong understanding of the sales process — Sales Orders, Pricing, Quotes, Opportunities, and Accounts.
* O2C / P2P: Proficiency in Order-to-Cash (O2C) and/or Procure-to-Pay (P2P) flows, with depth in one or more of: Sales Order, Pricing, Finance O2C, P2P, Tax.
* Modules: Good to moderate proficiency across D365 CE modules with the ability to navigate, troubleshoot, and configure as needed.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Intermediate to advanced SQL — writing queries, analyzing data, and supporting incident investigation.
* Strong troubleshooting skills with attention to detail and the ability to apply learnings across issues.
* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Azure Monitor, Application Insights).

Leadership and Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven ability to manage and motivate teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Excellent oral and written communication; able to brief executives and engage with business stakeholders.
* Fast learner with strong problem-solving instincts and a bias for action.
* Calm under pressure during outages and high-severity incidents.

**What You Will Bring To The Team**

* 12+ years of overall IT experience, 5+ years of hands-on D365 CE or FNO experience (end-user, support, or developer role).
* 5+ years managing teams of 10 or more members, with proven team-building track record.
* Demonstrated experience supporting users and systems across multiple geographies.

Zones offers a comprehensive Benefits package.
  
  
While we’re committed to providing top-tier solutions, we’re just as committed to supporting our own teams. We offer a competitive compensation package where our team members are rewarded based on their performance and recognized for the value they bring into our business. Our team members enjoy a variety of comprehensive benefits, including Medical Insurance Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover to handle the uncertainties of life, flexible leave policy to balance their work life.
  
  
At Zones, work is more than a job – it's an exciting career immersed in an inventive, collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you!
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

* Drive growth in national account room nights, revenue, ADR and market share.

* Hold regular account performance reviews, identifying gaps and implementing corrective action plans.
* Work with Revenue Management and hotel teams to ensure profitable business conversion and appropriate pricing strategies.

Sales Organisation & Productivity
  
  

* Build a high-performance national sales organisation with clearly defined roles, responsibilities and KPIs.
* Establish a strong performance management culture with regular reviews and accountability.
* Develop talent, strengthen sales capabilities and build a succession pipeline.
* Improve productivity through effective deployment of resources, sales calls, client engagement and account coverage.
* Drive consistent adoption and utilisation of Salesforce and other Accor sales platforms.

* Work closely with Revenue Management, Digital, Marketing, Loyalty, L&L, PME and Global Sales for an integrated commercial approach.
* Strengthen collaboration with GMs and DOSMs so national account opportunities translate into actual hotel production.
* Hold a structured monthly national sales performance review with clear actions, ownership and timelines.

* National account revenue and room-night growth

* Growth in production from existing strategic accounts
* National account market share and share of wallet
* LNR / RFP conversion and retention rates
* ADR and profitability of contracted business
* Sales pipeline development and conversion
* Sales team productivity and achievement of individual targets

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or Hospitality (MBA preferred)

title: Client Experience & Travel Consultant
description:
WE'RE GROWING - AND WE'RE LOOKING FOR THE KINDEST PERSON IN THE ROOM

At DillyDally Trails, we believe that a great travel experience starts long before someone gets on a flight. It starts with the first conversation.

We're looking for a 
**Client Experience & Travel Consultant**
 to join our growing team in Gurgaon.

This is a great role for someone early in their career who is looking to learn, take ownership and grow with a young travel company. You don't need to know everything about travel.

We're much more interested in 
**how you communicate, how you treat people and how much you care about doing things well.**

**What we offer - kindly apply only if you are comfortable with the salary.**

₹15,000 – ₹20,000/month, depending on experience and fit

Performance-based incentives

📍 Gurgaon

We work from the office when the founders are in India, with flexibility to work remotely when we're in South Korea.

**What you'll be doing:**

**Talking to travellers**

You'll be one of the first people our customers interact with.

You'll:

* Speak to prospective travellers over calls, WhatsApp and email
* Understand what they're looking for and recommend the right trip
* Answer questions and help first-time travellers feel comfortable
* Follow up with enquiries
* Confidently guide interested customers towards booking
* Build relationships with our travellers rather than simply answering messages

**Coordinating trips**

Once someone books, you'll help make sure everything stays on track.

You'll:

* Coordinate traveller requirements and documents
* Keep track of payments, confirmations and deadlines
* Coordinate with our internal team and Korean partners
* Keep travellers updated before their journey
* Make sure no important detail or follow-up gets missed

**Over time:**

**Learning & contributing to growth**

As you understand the business, you'll also get the opportunity to work on things beyond day-to-day client servicing, including:

* Influencer & creator collaborations
* Brand partnerships
* Korean café and cultural organisation partnerships
* Community events and PR activities
* Lead-generation initiatives
* Travel awards and industry opportunities

You don't need experience in all of these.
**We want someone curious enough to learn and proactive enough to eventually take ownership of them.**

Who would be a great fit?

You might be the person we're looking for if:

* People naturally feel comfortable talking to you
* You're warm without being overly casual
* You communicate professionally without sounding robotic
* You genuinely enjoy helping people
* You're confident speaking on the phone
* You can sell without being pushy
* You're organised and good at following through
* You stay calm when there are multiple things happening at once
* You have good written and spoken English
* You love travel and are curious about South Korea

Travel, hospitality, customer service or sales experience is a 
**plus, not a requirement**
.

**What you'll get to do here**

DillyDally is still a small team. That means you won't be one person among hundreds doing one tiny part of a process. You'll work closely with the founders and get to see how a travel company is actually built — from speaking to the first customer to creating partnerships and improving the experience we deliver.

And as we grow, 
**we want you to grow with us.**
Our goal isn't for you to remain an Executive forever.

As you become more experienced, we'd like you to take ownership of the client experience function, eventually mentor new team members and build a team of your own.

If you're ambitious, dependable and willing to learn, there is plenty of room to grow with us.

**And most importantly...**

We're not looking for someone who simply knows how to answer a WhatsApp message.

We're looking for someone who can make a nervous first-time traveller feel:

**"Okay. I'm in good hands."**

If that sounds like something you'd be good at, we'd love to hear from you.

To apply:

Send us your 
**CV + a short introduction about yourself and why you'd like to work with DillyDally**
 
**Trails**
at hello@dillydally.in

Please don't send only your CV. 
**We'd genuinely like to know a little about you.**

Know someone who would be perfect for this? Send this post their way.

title: (Senior) Workday Consultant — Automation & AI (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
  
  
You will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team as a bridge between HR and technology — deeply understanding how HR works end to end and translating business challenges into scalable technology, automation and AI solutions.You will work across the hire-to-retire employee lifecycle, partnering with HR teams to challenge existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement and turn business needs into clear functional and technical requirements. You will then help take those solutions from idea through design, build and implementation — using our HR technology landscape, automation platforms and AI.
  
  
The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation, who is part of the HR Senior Leadership Team, and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams across all regions.
  
  
This role is based in Gurugram or Bangalore (India), with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. Given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Act as a trusted technology partner to HR teams across the end-to-end employee lifecycle — conduct process and technology gap analyses, challenge existing ways of working, identify improvement and automation opportunities, and translate business needs into functional and technical requirements implemented through HRIS, AI or automation solutions.
* Help build, deploy and maintain Claude-based applications and AI-powered internal tools, working with our cloud and technology teams to ensure appropriate authentication (RBAC/ABAC), governance and HRIS-aligned access controls including MCPs, APIs and custom connectors that securely connect AI applications with the wider HR Tech landscape.
* Design and build AI and automation workflows using technologies such as n8n, UiPath, Python-based automation and GenAI/LLMs, creating scalable solutions with appropriate orchestration, exception handling, monitoring and governance.
* Drive HR Tech initiatives end to end, from requirements engineering and process/solution design through build, SIT/UAT, implementation and go-live across areas such as HR service delivery model, HRIS security model improvements, payroll transformations, HRIS revamp or migration.
* Bring a strong product mindset to HR technology — turning business problems into scalable products and frameworks, including Jira-based HR service desks, Rovo Agents and AI-enabled employee/HR experiences, and continuously improving them based on user needs and business value.

**About You**

* 6+ years of experience as an HR Tech Analyst, HR Business/Process Analyst, AI & Automation Analyst or similar role, with deep, demonstrable HR & Workday domain knowledge across hire-to-retire processes. This is a must-have for the role. A degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, HR Technology, Business Technology or a related field is preferred.
* Strong ability to analyse HR processes, translate business problems into functional and technical requirements, and implement solutions across a complex Workday technology landscape.
* Hands-on experience building AI and automation solutions using technologies such as n8n, Python scripts, UiPath and GenAI/LLM tooling. n8n certification is a plus.
* Experience building and deploying internal applications in cloud environments, including working with APIs, MCPs, custom connectors and integrations to securely move data between enterprise systems.
* Hands-on understanding of Claude/GenAI application deployment and enterprise security, including RBAC/ABAC, authentication, access governance and protection of sensitive HR data.
* Strong working knowledge of Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Rovo Agents and BPMN, with the ability to build service desks, portals, workflows, process frameworks and technology-enabled HR services.
* Fluency in English. Mandatory Workday experience is essential; certifications in Workday, business/process analysis, automation or agile delivery (e.g. Six Sigma, SAFe, Scrum, PMP, Archimate) are a plus.
* Comfort working across European, APAC and US time zones, with a primary collaboration focus on a Berlin-based team.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career
  
  
**Why Join Flix?**
At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
  
  
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
  
  
If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Training And Quality Manager
description:
**About Virohan**

Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an education–to-industry partner building the workforce powering Indiaʼs healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real-world employability. At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms. Our model combines academic learning with hands-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles.

Today, Virohan has trained 13,000+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country. Backed by global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan), we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare — two of Indiaʼs fastest-growing sectors.

At our core, we are guided by a strong set of values that define how we work, build, and grow together — from ownership and bias for action to empathy, continuous learning, and raising the bar. If youʼre excited about building something meaningful at scale and solving real-world problems, youʼ l find yourself at home at Virohan.

**What youʼll do:**

**Accelerate new-hire readiness:**
Own New-Hire Training (NHT) across program knowledge, needs discovery, pitch, objection handling, CRM/tools, processes and responsible selling.

**Build structured ramp-up journeys:**
Establish role-plays, assessments, supervised selling and certification milestones that help new hires reach sustained productivity faster.

**Standardise the counselling experience:**
Develop sales playbooks, objection-handling guides and approved communication frameworks that support accurate, effective and conversational selling.

**Lead quality assurance:**
Build and run audit frameworks across relevant sales channels, with clear scorecards, sampling methods, critical-error definitions and escalation processes.

**Safeguard responsible selling:**
Identify inaccurate claims, overpromising and missed disclosures. Ensure communication about fees, eligibility, programs, internships and placement-related commitments follows Virohan-approved information.

**Drive targeted coaching:**
Translate audit findings into individual and team development plans through call reviews, refreshers, role plays and one-to-one coaching.

**Improve conversion:**
Analyse won and lost interactions, identify effective selling behaviours and measure the impact of training and coaching interventions.

**Maintain objective evaluation**
: Run calibration sessions and resolve scoring disagreements while preserving the independence of quality assessments.

**Keep knowledge current:**
Maintain a reliable knowledge repository and drive timely training and certification for program, pricing, offer and policy updates.

**Close the business feedback loop:**
Share recurring candidate objections, competitor insights and process gaps with relevant teams, and help address the causes of sales-related complaints, cancellations and refunds.

**Build and lead the team:**
Hire, coach and develop trainers and quality analysts, with clear goals, accountability and operating rhythms.

**What Youʼll Need to have:**

* Demonstrated experience owning both sales training and quality assurance, including people management.
* A track record of improving measurable outcomes such as ramp time, sales proficiency, conversion, critical-error rates or sales related complaints.
* Experience building onboarding programs, practical certification frameworks, audit scorecards and structured coaching processes.
* A strong understanding of consultative sales and the ability to balance commercial outcomes with accurate, candidate-first counseling.
* The ability to work effectively with sales leaders, influence cross-functional stakeholders and uphold standards under target pressure.
* A hands-on approach—you should be comfortable listening to calls, facilitating training, coaching representatives and reviewing performance data.

**Whatʼs in it for you:**

**End-to-end ownership:**
Shape Virohanʼs sales training and quality function, from strategy to frontline execution.

**Visible business impact:**
See your work translate into faster ramp-up, stronger sales capability and better candidate experiences.

**A meaningful mandate:**
Help prospective candidates receive clear, accurate information to make informed education and career decisions.

**Cross-functional exposure:**
Partner with Sales, Marketing and Operations to address challenges beyond the training room.

**The opportunity to build:**
Develop a team, establish scalable systems and create a culture of continuous coaching and responsible selling

**Company: Muditam**

Muditam is a growing D2C health and wellness brand focused on developing and marketing innovative nutraceutical products for Indian and international markets.

We are looking for a creative, research-driven
**Meta Ads Scriptwriter / Performance Creative Strategist**
who understands what makes people stop scrolling, watch an advertisement, connect with a product, and ultimately make a purchase.

We need someone who can research successful advertisements, identify new creative angles, develop compelling hooks, write high-converting video scripts, and work closely with our marketing and creative teams to produce performance-driven advertisements.

* Research advertisements across Meta Ad Library, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.

* Identify interesting hooks, storytelling techniques, messaging angles, and visual styles.
* Maintain a library of competitor ad references and creative inspiration.
* Convert research findings into original advertising concepts for Muditam.

* Develop compelling video ad scripts for Facebook and Instagram campaigns.

* Create UGC-style, product demonstration, storytelling, educational, and direct-response video scripts.
* Develop multiple creative angles for the same product.
* Write scripts in Hindi, Hinglish, and English as required.
* Create multiple hook and script variations for creative testing.

* Research customer motivations, product-related concerns, objections, and purchasing behaviour.
* Develop fresh advertising concepts instead of repeatedly using the same messaging.
* Identify opportunities for creative diversification.
* Brainstorm new advertising approaches with the performance marketing team.
* Review existing advertisements and identify opportunities for improvement.

**4. Script Direction & Production Coordination**

* Prepare detailed scene-by-scene scripts.
* Provide visual references, shot lists, dialogues, voiceovers, and on-screen text.
* Give clear instructions for video shooting and editing.
* Coordinate with photographers, videographers, and video editors.
* Review edited advertisements and suggest improvements before launch.

**5. Performance-Based Creative Improvement**

* Work closely with the performance marketing team to understand campaign results.
* Study winning and underperforming advertisements.
* Identify patterns in hooks, storytelling, messaging, and creative formats.
* Develop new concepts based on actual campaign learnings.
* Maintain a structured creative testing and iteration process.

What We're Looking For

* Proven experience in Meta Ads scriptwriting or performance creative strategy.
* Strong understanding of direct-response advertising and D2C marketing.
* Ability to research competitors and identify creative opportunities.
* Excellent storytelling and copywriting skills.
* Understanding of hooks, audience psychology, customer objections, and conversion-focused messaging.
* Experience writing UGC and short-form video advertisements.
* Ability to translate a creative idea into a detailed production-ready script.
* Good understanding of current Instagram and Facebook advertising formats.
* Ability to collaborate with marketing, design, and video production teams.
* Strong research skills and an experimental mindset.

**Preferred:**

* Experience working with D2C, e-commerce, nutraceutical, health, or wellness brands.
* Experience developing advertisements that have delivered measurable advertising results.
* Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and creative performance metrics.
* Understanding of AI-assisted creative research and content production.

What You'll Get to Work On

* Multiple products and advertising campaigns.
* Indian and international markets.
* Continuous creative experimentation.
* Collaboration with an in-house design, video production, and performance marketing team.
* Opportunity to take ownership of Muditam's performance creative strategy.

**Experience:**
2–5 years preferred, with flexibility for exceptional candidates who can demonstrate strong work.

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Compensation:**
Competitive, based on experience and capabilities.

How to Apply-

Interested candidates can directly send their
**CV and Portfolio**
to:

tejasv@muditam.com

Please include examples of video advertisements or scripts you have developed.

We would particularly like to see:

* 3–5 examples of Meta video ad scripts.
* Examples of advertisements you have researched or developed.
* Any available examples of creative performance or campaign results you have contributed to.

We value practical creative thinking, research ability, and execution skills more than theoretical knowledge.

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.

Revenue Management

Assistant/ Deputy Manager

Gurgaon

**About the Function**

Being the largest online travel aggregator in India, MMT witnesses a sizeable number of users visiting the app and transacting every day.

The Ground Transport(GT) business offers an unmatched booking experience to this vast user base, with the widest range of Bus, Rail, and Cab booking options—also playing a crucial role in acquiring new users, especially from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across India.

This is further complemented by a world-class post-booking experience—whether it's through the app's numerous self-help features or our hand-picked executives who strive to deliver customer delight at every step. The Ground Transport SBU embraces a strong innovation mindset and has consistently launched industry-first features that make the booking experience truly seamless and delightful.

At MMT, the Ground Transport unit takes immense pride in its team members who work tirelessly to champion the best possible experience for our users. An orchestra of product managers, tech developers, designers, researchers, and revenue managers comes together to ensure we continue to lead and differentiate ourselves in the industry.

As part of the GT Online Revenue function, you will join a whip-smart team responsible for managing revenue, driving growth, and increasing profitability. You will embody our values of consumer focus, commitment to results, and continuous improvement by developing innovative solutions that raise challenging questions and demand both creative and practical answers.

The ideal candidate is an independent, self-starting, quick-witted, entrepreneurial, and intellectually curious individual. This person must excel at cross-functional collaboration, blend creativity with strong organizational skills, manage deliverables under tight deadlines, and consistently produce high-quality work under pressure.

**What will you be doing**

* Own and manage the business P&L, working with internal stakeholders to devise strategies aimed at achieving revenue goals.
* Closely monitor performance parameters, ensuring tight control over key business KPIs such as conversions, transactions, and margins.
* Conduct deep dives into competitor pricing data and use insights to inform category pricing strategies.
* Adjust pricing strategies based on demand signals and market conditions to maintain competitiveness and maximize revenue.

* Define annual and quarterly plans based on short- and long-term growth strategies, influencing key cross-functional teams to align on common objectives.
* Develop and implement initiatives focused on customer acquisition.
* Analyze demand signals and traffic data to understand business and marketing trends.

**Customer Engagement & Marketing Collaboration**

* Work closely with the marketing team to develop and execute customer engagement strategies and campaigns that maximize customer lifetime value.
* Lead tactical initiatives around active revenue drivers such as pricing, seasonal trends, and topical promotions using relevant marketing channels.

**Collaboration with Product & Operations Stakeholders**

* Partner with product teams to develop first-class, customer-centric experiences.
* Work with operations teams to streamline processes that drive strong NPS and CSAT scores.

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Create and maintain rich, interactive visualizations through effective data interpretation and analysis.
* Integrate reporting components from multiple data sources to provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Apply statistical methods to analyze data and answer key business questions, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and performance.

**Qualification & Experience**

* MBA from a reputed institute with 2–5 years of experience in a revenue or category management role within a consumer-facing, technology-enabled business—preferably in the e-commerce industry.
* Proven track record of working in high-growth, data-driven environments with a strong understanding of business levers and consumer behavior.
* Advanced proficiency inMS Excel and MS PowerPointfor data analysis and business storytelling.

* A mindset that consistently focuses on return on investment, business outcomes, and revenue growth.
* High energy, team-oriented, and brings a positive, can-do attitude.

* Proven track record of driving business growth through both tactical and strategic initiatives.
* Excellent communication skills and strong stakeholder management capabilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

title: Field Application Manager – Robotics
description:
Location for this opening: Delhi region

Field Application Manager – Robotics

Lead field applications at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. It is a priceless opportunity to shape robotics in India.

Own applications, demos and commissioning for cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with regular travel to customer sites

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 6–10 years

The Role

You will lead Luna's Field Application Engineers and own the technical success of every robotics project across our Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree range: industrial robots and cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoid robots and quadruped robot dogs. You will be the senior technical partner for key accounts and the sales team, and set the standards our field team works to.

What You Will Do

• Lead, coach and plan the work of the FAE team across sites.

• Own application success by validating feasibility, cycle time, cell layouts and AMR/AGV fleet concepts before commitment.

• Plan and deliver high-impact demos and proof-of-concept projects for robot arms, mobile robots, humanoids and robot dogs.

• Set and enforce standards for commissioning, programming, service, documentation and handover.

• Act as the senior technical contact for key accounts, and lead escalations to fast resolution.

• Build training programs for FAEs, sales engineers, partners and customer teams.

• Feed field insight to our in-house robot design team, principals and management.

Must Have

• BE/BTech in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical or Automation Engineering.

• 6–10 years in robotics or automation applications, including at least 2 years leading engineers or projects.

• Hands-on robot/cobot or mobile robot commissioning, with PLC, servo and machine vision integration.

• Proven experience delivering demos, technical presentations and customer training.

• Strong customer-handling skills and willingness to travel to customer sites.

Good to Have

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV fleet deployment, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus.

• Robot cell layout, simulation or offline programming.

• Exposure to safety standards and risk assessment for robot cells and mobile robots.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work directly with our design and manufacturing teams, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity.

• Real ownership: build your team, set the standards and make fast calls, with direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: as the robotics vertical scales, your role grows into senior technical and business leadership.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, manufacturer certifications, and new tech in mobile robotics, vision and motion control.

• High-impact projects: lead flagship deployments in factories, warehouses and new applications for key customers.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives and a supportive, growing team.

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners.

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "FAM – Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi).

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Senior Medical Planner
description:

 Your impact
   

  

 As a Senior Medical Planner, you will play a key role in shaping healthcare environments that directly influence patient care, staff workflows, and clinical outcomes. You'll lead the planning and design of complex healthcare facilities ranging from 80,000 to more than 800,000 sq. ft., working across outpatient, acute care, post\-acute, and specialty healthcare settings.
