You'll have visible impact on project outcomes while helping to guide and develop junior healthcare planners within the team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead medical planning, master facility planning, and functional space planning for healthcare projects ranging from 80,000 to 800,000\+ sq. ft.
* Develop clinical planning solutions across the continuum of care, including outpatient, acute care, post\-acute, and specialty healthcare services.
* Apply evidence\-based design principles and healthcare planning best practices to support positive patient outcomes and efficient clinical operations.
* Collaborate with architects, engineers, and specialist consultants to integrate medical planning requirements into the overall facility design.
* Facilitate user group meetings with healthcare stakeholders to gather operational requirements and validate planning solutions.
* Develop and oversee functional programs, space matrices, and departmental planning layouts.
* Review medical planning deliverables to ensure quality, accuracy, and compliance with FGI, ADA, and applicable local building codes.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior planners, supporting team capability development.
* Utilize Revit, AutoCAD, and healthcare planning tools to develop and communicate planning and design solutions.


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

**Essential Requirements**
* Demonstrated ability to lead healthcare planning and design activities for complex healthcare facility projects.
* Typically demonstrated through 10\+ years of healthcare planning and design experience on complex healthcare facility projects.
* Ability to translate clinical and operational requirements into effective facility planning solutions.
* Knowledge of clinical operations, healthcare regulations, and medical equipment planning principles.
* Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills, including leading user group meetings and workshops.
* Ability to develop functional programs, medical planning, space planning documentation, and departmental layouts.
* Strong quality review skills with the ability to ensure planning deliverables meet regulatory and project requirements.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills when working with multidisciplinary project teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across concurrent healthcare projects.
* Collaborative leadership skills, including mentoring and supporting the development of junior team members.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Degree in Architecture, Healthcare Design, or a related discipline.
* Professional certification in healthcare planning (e.g., ACHA, EDAC).
* Experience contributing to international healthcare projects.
* Passion for improving healthcare environments and patient\-centered design outcomes.

To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

title: Operations Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Operations Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Support the operations and/or manage delivery for production systems and services based on operational requirements and service agreement.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Oracle Database Administration (DBA)
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
**Summary**

* The Scrum Master — Core Infrastructure serves as the agile delivery lead and servant-leader across the Compute & OS, Storage & Backup, Database & Middleware, and Cloud Platform engineering towers. The role is responsible for facilitating agile ceremonies, removing delivery impediments, co-ordinating cross-tower dependencies, and embedding a culture of continuous improvement across infrastructure engineering teams in a regulated financial services environment.
* Core infrastructure delivery has distinct characteristics that separate it from software development — change control windows, vendor hardware lead times, patching freeze periods, DR testing cycles, and regulatory maintenance obligations all shape sprint cadence and capacity. This role demands works within them effectively, and continuously drives the team toward greater delivery predictability and operational efficiency.

**Roles & Responsibilities**
Agile Delivery & Sprint Management
  
  
– Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives across all four infrastructure towers — ensuring ceremonies are purposeful, time-boxed, and produce actionable outcomes
  
  
– Own and maintain the infrastructure delivery backlog in collaboration with platform owners and technical leads — ensuring stories are well-defined, technically scoped, and sprint-ready with clear acceptance criteria
  
  
– Track and report sprint velocity, delivery metrics, and team capacity — producing transparent, accurate reporting for engineering management and programme governance forums – Manage cross-tower dependencies — Compute, Storage, Database, and Cloud workstreams frequently intersect on major programmes (server builds, DR tests, cloud migrations) the Scrum Master ensures these are visible, sequenced, and resolved before they impact sprint outcomes
  
  
– Drive backlog refinement sessions — translating infrastructure work items (server builds, patching cycles, storage migrations, DR rehearsals) into sprint-deliverable stories with measurable done criteria
  
  
– Facilitate continuous improvement through structured retrospectives — capturing actions, tracking follow-through, and promoting a culture of accountability across all towers
  
  
Impediment Removal & Stakeholder Management
  
  
– Proactively identify, escalate, and remove delivery blockers — spanning procurement, vendor lead times, change approval delays, resource constraints, and cross-team dependencies
  
  
– Serve as the primary delivery status contact for all four towers — communicating sprint progress, risks, and dependencies clearly to programme managers, infrastructure leadership, and senior stakeholders
  
  
– Co-ordinate with ITSM change management, CAB, and release management teams to align sprint deliverables with approved change windows, maintenance schedules, and freeze periods
  
  
– Manage vendor, OEM, and TAC engagement timelines where they create sprint dependencies — escalating when resolution SLAs are at risk and tracking through to closure
  
  
– Shield sprint commitments from unplanned scope injection — managing stakeholder expectations proactively when operational incidents, emergency changes, or business-critical requests compete with planned work
  
  
– Support major incident and problem management co-ordination as a delivery resource when infrastructure events impact sprint workstreams or require engineering team engagement
  
  
Infrastructure-Specific Delivery Practices
  
  
– Maintain awareness of infrastructure delivery constraints — hardware lead times, firmware and OS patching schedules, DR testing windows, licence renewals, and end-of-life milestones — and factor these into sprint planning and capacity management
  
  
– Co-ordinate multi-tower programme delivery — cloud migrations, data centre refreshes, DR rehearsals, and platform upgrades — ensuring sequencing is logical, dependencies are tracked, and no tower is blocked waiting on another
  
  
– Support audit, regulatory, and compliance delivery activities — ensuring infrastructure change evidence, configuration documentation, and operational records are produced, traceable, and audit-ready within sprint timelines
  
  
– Track and report on infrastructure-specific KPIs — patching compliance rates, change success rates, DR test outcomes, platform availability, and incident-driven sprint disruption — as inputs to programme governance and continuous improvement– Maintain accurate sprint boards, delivery dashboards, and programme-level reporting across Jira, ServiceNow, or equivalent ITSM tooling — integrated with change management workflows
  
  
– Drive operational efficiency and automation adoption across infrastructure teams — identifying toil reduction opportunities, supporting IaC and runbook automation initiatives, and tracking delivery benefit realisation
  
  
People, Capability & Continuous Improvement
  
  
– Champion the adoption of agile delivery standards, tooling, and best practices across all four infrastructure towers – Support onboarding of new team members into delivery norms, tooling, and sprint processes
  
  
– Identify and promote opportunities to improve cross-tower collaboration, reduce silos, and build shared delivery culture across Compute, Storage, Database, and Cloud teams
  
  
**Professional & Technical Skills**
Must-Have Skills– Proven Scrum Master experience delivering infrastructure engineering programmes — server builds, storage migrations, database upgrades, DR rehearsals, or cloud platform delivery — not solely software development– Deep understanding of infrastructure delivery constraints — change freeze windows, CAB processes, vendor lead times, patching cycles, and their impact on sprint planning and velocity– Backlog management — Jira, ServiceNow, or Azure DevOps ability to translate infrastructure work into well-formed stories with technical acceptance criteria and realistic effort estimates
  
  
– Cross-tower dependency management — ability to map, track, and resolve sequencing dependencies across Compute, Storage, Database, and Cloud workstreams on concurrent programmes
  
  
– Stakeholder communication — clear, concise sprint reporting and risk escalation to infrastructure engineering leads, programme managers, and senior FSI leadership
  
  
– Working knowledge of core infrastructure domains — sufficient understanding of server, storage, database, and cloud platform operations to facilitate technical conversations, challenge estimates, and identify hidden dependencies
  
  
– ITSM integration — experience aligning agile delivery with ITIL-based change management, release management, and CAB governance in enterprise environments
  
  
– Metrics and reporting — velocity tracking, sprint burn-down, change success rates, patching compliance, and escalation-ready risk dashboards
  
  
– FSI delivery environment — comfortable operating in a heavily governed, audit-conscious environment with change control obligations, regulatory maintenance windows, and multiple stakeholder layers
  
  
– Continuous improvement — structured retrospective facilitation with measurable follow-through, particularly on sprint disruption caused by operational incidents and emergency changes
  
  
**Preferred / Advantageous**
– Experience supporting data centre refresh, cloud migration, or platform consolidation programmes across multiple infrastructure towers simultaneously
  
  
– Familiarity with IaC and automation delivery (Terraform, Ansible) — understanding how automation workstreams differ from operational change in sprint planning
  
  
– Prince2 Practitioner or equivalent project delivery certification — useful for hybrid agile/waterfall infrastructure programme delivery
  
  
**Additional Information**
— with transparent reporting, minimal unplanned carry-over, and clear impediment resolution records
  
  
– Agile maturity grows across the infrastructure function — engineers write better stories, ceremonies produce real outcomes, and retrospective actions are followed through consistently rather than repeated sprint-on-sprint

title: Head – Retention Marketing | D2C
description:
**Head – Retention Marketing | Muditam**

**Location:**
Chhatarpur, Delhi

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Work Schedule:**
Monday–Friday from office; Saturday work from home

**About Muditam**

Muditam is a diabetes management nutraceutical brand combining Ayurveda-inspired supplements with personalised diet plans, healthy habits, and access to wellness experts. We help customers build consistent routines around their everyday diabetes management needs.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Head of Retention Marketing to own customer retention, repeat purchases, and customer lifetime value at Muditam.

You will lead our retention strategy and execution across WhatsApp, email, SMS, and other relevant channels. From helping first-time buyers establish a routine to bringing overdue customers back, you’ll build personalised journeys that strengthen customer relationships and generate profitable repeat revenue.

This role requires strong analytical thinking, commercial ownership, and hands-on experience building campaigns and automations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own retention strategy and revenue:**
  Build the retention roadmap, campaign calendar, budgets, and revenue targets. Increase repeat purchase rates, purchase frequency, and customer lifetime value while protecting margins.
* **Build customer lifecycle journeys:**
  Develop and optimise onboarding, post-purchase education, replenishment reminders, second-purchase journeys, cross-sell, upsell, and win-back programmes.
* **Lead WhatsApp, email, and SMS marketing:**
  Own audience selection, messaging, creative briefs, automation, campaign execution, and reporting. Coordinate channels and contact frequency to keep communication relevant.
* **Create actionable customer segments:**
  Use purchase history, product preferences, pack duration, engagement, and expected replenishment dates to deliver the right message at the right time.
* **Improve the post-purchase experience:**
  Work with customer experience, wellness experts, and operations teams to understand why customers reorder, delay, or stop purchasing. Turn those insights into better communication and journeys.
* **Run structured experiments:**
  Test messaging, offers, timing, segmentation, and creative approaches. Use holdout groups where appropriate to measure additional sales generated by retention activity.
* **Own reporting and profitability:**
  Track customer cohorts, repeat revenue, time to second purchase, reactivation, campaign costs, and contribution after discounts. Translate findings into clear actions.
* **Strengthen systems and execution:**
  Improve Shopify and CRM integrations, automation logic, data quality, consent records, and suppression rules. Manage platform partners and build clear processes for the retention team.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Proven experience owning retention, CRM, or lifecycle marketing for a D2C or ecommerce business.
* Demonstrated improvements in repeat purchases, customer lifetime value, or profitable retention revenue.
* Hands-on experience building and running WhatsApp campaigns, email journeys, customer segments, and marketing automations.
* Strong understanding of cohort analysis, replenishment cycles, retention economics, and campaign attribution.
* Confidence working with Shopify, CRM platforms, and Excel or Google Sheets.
* Ability to turn customer insights into persuasive messaging and clear creative briefs.
* Experience leading teams, agencies, or platform partners while staying involved in execution.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritise opportunities based on business impact.

Experience with nutraceuticals, healthcare, or other products with regular replenishment cycles would be an advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

More first-time customers making a second purchase, more customers reordering when their packs run out, stronger customer engagement, and measurable growth in profitable repeat revenue.

**Why Join Muditam?**

Own a business-critical growth function, work closely with the leadership team, and shape how Muditam builds lasting relationships with its customers.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION

Brand & Growth Manager – Sassoon

Location: Delhi NCR (Full-time, office-based)

Experience: 5–8 years

Joining: Immediate / Within 15 days preferred

Reporting: Directly to Founder

Probation: 90 days

About Sassoon

Sassoon is an emerging consumer lifestyle brand with products across multiple categories and ambitions to build a strong, recognised consumer brand across D2C, marketplaces and retail channels.

We are looking for a commercially driven Brand & Growth Manager to lead Sassoon’s brand strategy, marketing initiatives and online business growth across existing and future product categories.

Key Responsibilities

1. Brand Strategy & Business Growth

\* Develop Sassoon’s overall brand positioning and growth strategy.

\* Build product-wise marketing and revenue plans.

\* Identify new product and category opportunities.

\* Drive brand awareness, customer acquisition and retention.

2. Digital Marketing & Agency Management

\* Lead Meta and Google marketing strategy.

\* Manage performance marketing, social media, influencer and marketplace agencies.

\* Set campaign objectives, budgets and performance targets.

\* Monitor CAC, ROAS, conversion and marketing profitability.

\* Ensure agencies deliver measurable business results.

3. E-commerce & Marketplace Growth

\* Drive Shopify website revenue and conversion improvements.

\* Work with the existing E-commerce Manager and team.

\* Improve product listings, AOV, customer retention and repeat purchases.

\* Develop Amazon and other marketplace growth strategies.

4. Content & Creative

\* Lead content, campaign and creative strategy.

\* Guide the two in-house graphic designers.

\* Coordinate product shoots, social media and advertising creatives.

\* Develop product launches and brand communication.

5. General Trade Coordination

\* Coordinate with Area Sales Managers on product campaigns, promotions and brand-building initiatives.

\* Support retail demand generation and product launches.

\* General Trade field-sales management will remain with the existing sales team.

6. Team & Budget Management

\* Lead existing marketing and e-commerce resources.

\* Manage external agencies and vendors.

\* Prepare marketing budgets and business forecasts.

\* Review performance and report directly to the founder.

Candidate Requirements

\* 5–8 years of experience in brand management, D2C, e-commerce or consumer marketing.

\* Experience managing multiple products or categories.

\* Strong understanding of Shopify, Meta Ads and Google Ads.

\* Knowledge of CAC, ROAS, AOV, conversion and contribution margins.

\* Experience managing agencies, creative teams and marketing budgets.

\* Strong analytical, strategic and execution capabilities.

\* Experience in beauty, personal care, lifestyle, FMCG or consumer brands preferred.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who thinks like a business owner, understands both brand building and sales growth, can independently manage agencies, and takes responsibility for measurable business outcomes.

Candidates with experience limited to social media management, content coordination or performance marketing alone will not be suitable.

Key Performance Indicators

\* Brand and product portfolio growth.

\* D2C website revenue and conversion.

\* Customer acquisition cost and marketing efficiency.

\* Marketplace sales and profitability.

\* Customer retention and repeat purchases.

\* Creative and agency performance.

\* New product launch success.

\* Team productivity and budget management.

Existing Resources

The manager will coordinate with:

\* E-commerce Manager and E-commerce Executives.

\* In-house Graphic Designers.

\* Social media and shoots agency.

\* Influencer marketing and PR freelancer.

\* Performance marketing agency.

\* Marketplace advertising agency.

The role will also coordinate with the existing General Trade sales team.

Compensation & Employment

\* Salary: Negotiable

\* Performance-linked incentives.

\* 90-day probation.

\* Full-time, office-based role in Delhi NCR.

\* Direct reporting to the founder.

This is an opportunity to build a growing, multi-category consumer brand while taking ownership of its overall brand and marketing growth.**

title: User Experience Designer
description:
**Requisition ID:**
73946
  
  
**About Whirlpool India**
Whirlpool of India Limited, headquartered in Gurugram, is a leading home appliances company dedicated to enhancing life at home and inspiring generations through its trusted brands. The company operates three state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Faridabad, Pune & Puducherry, each reflecting Whirlpool’s commitment to providing best-in-class consumer solutions. Further driving innovation, the company has a Technology & Engineering Center, where India's world-class talent architects the next generation of home innovation. In the 2024-25 fiscal year, Whirlpool of India reported approximately INR 8110 Cr in annual revenue and employed 2193 people. More information is available at www.india.whirlpool.in
  
  
**The Team You Will Be a Part Of**
The Product Design team designs, validates and brings new products to market; designs, tests and integrates components to produce final designs; and evaluates the design's overall effectiveness, cost, reliability and safety. Collaborates with internal partners to optimize designs for manufacturability. Uses CAD/CAE systems to model new designs and produce detailed engineering drawings.
  
  
**This Role In Summary**
Currently, we are seeking a passionate and creative candidate for an UX Design opening to join our Design Team at Whirlpool of India Ltd-Gurugram.
  
  
At Whirlpool of India Ltd, people are the heart of our mission – our valued customers and dedicated employees. Our User Experience team seeks to understand the changing needs of
  
  
our users and to combine that knowledge with the latest in technology. You will be an integral part of the team, designing experiences that make people’s homes more convenient and joyful,
  
  
and in doing so, improving the lives of millions of people.
  
  
In this role you will be able to Research, Design and innovate in the areas of Digital and Physical User experience, Work on behavior specification of products, benchmarking in Appliance Industry and other parallel industries, home immersions to useful insights and come up with harmonious and holistic solutions.
  
  
If you’re passionate about developing experiences like this and tick most of the boxes for this role, we would be delighted to hear from you.
  
  
A comprehensive portfolio demonstrating direct, individual contributions to both physical and digital design execution is required for consideration. Proven experience designing HMI/
  
  
physical-digital products / appliances, grounded in Human centred ways of designing HMI, Usability research, Market trend and Benchmarking studies.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities Will Include**

* Field Research & Generative Research : Conduct deep qualitative user research , ethnography and home immersions to capture authentic consumer behaviors and pain points. Translate raw research data into core insights that feed directly into Design Team
* UX Strategy (Physical-Digital ): Design seamless end-to-end user experiences that merge physical HMI (dials, tactile buttons, touch screens, LED indicators) with digital ecosystems (mobile applications, IoT controls and smart home systems).
* Evaluative Research / Usability Research & Validation: Design, plan, and conduct qualitative and quantitative usability studies for planned projects in execution, context of use testing, and ergonomic assessments to iteratively validate physical and digital design concepts with real users.
* Interaction Documentation & Team Collaboration: Document precise interaction behaviors and logic flows for the software development team. Drive continuous refinement of the user experience through heavy cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, Hardware, Mechanical Engineering, and other key stakeholders.
* Market & Trend Benchmarking: Perform constant local (India) & global market research, India White goods space and parallel Industry competitive audits, IoT trend analysis to uncover unmet customer demands and inform the product experience roadmap for planning cycles
* Perceived Quality & Execution Excellence: Benchmark and evaluate perceived quality to ensure top-tier standards in overall product , physical control feel, surface finish, UI responsiveness, visual elegance and overall product elegance.
* Human Factors & Ergonomics: Apply core principles of physical ergonomics and cognitive workload to optimize control panel layouts, display visibility, reachability, and overall product interaction across diverse user demographics.
* Foster the future: Actively seek and share design and digital inspiration. Be on top of understanding new innovations and to keep a check on the market trends. Cross Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Industrial Designers, Software/Firmware Engineers, Product Managers and external Design Agencies from concept through to launch.

You will be a key member of the UX team that’s responsible for driving Digital and Physical experience strategy by collaborating effectively with the Engineering and Marketing teams to align on experience/product roadmaps Championing the UX processes and projects, ensuring that each project consistently expresses the intended brand personality and delivering an intuitive and delightful experience.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor's or Master’s in Industrial Design, Interaction Design, Service Design, Visual Design, HCI or related human center degree
* Experience: 2-5 years of experience planning, conducting, and communicating the findings from user research for products and services
* Strong Design / User Research / User Insight / Visual design skills required, including the use of a diverse set of tools, e.g. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Generative AI tools, and the ability to adapt to new and evolving software based on existing design methodology, principles and practices
* Experience planning and conducting Research (quantitative /qualitative/ usability user research) at all stages of product development
* Ability to direct clear and creative artifacts (e.g., task flows, wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to guide consistency across teams)
* Seasoned design expertise with deep insight into the newest methods, trends, and design operations
* Ability to frame key questions, create research plans to address those, conduct research, and synthesize the findings into meaningful, actionable insights
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate and optimize design based on the value to the user and the business
* Strong communication skills with the ability to align the organization on complex product decisions while advocating the voice of the customer
* Ability to effectively document, present and gather feedback from peers, stakeholders and others in order to inform and align
* Ability to scope product and service projects strategically and effectively with a deep understanding of product development processes
* Passion to challenge the status quo find new solutions and drive out-of-the-box ideas – loves and embraces change
* Visible passion for the subject area, participation in domain activities and groups
* Experimental mindset to drive innovation

**Preferred Skills And Experiences**

* Developing design systems for apps or embedded UIs for each brand to guarantee a consistent application and following the Product Organisation process, working closely with process partners
* You will work in tandem with the Industrial Designers to enable an efficient iterative design process that constantly strives to leading product portfolio the industry
* Leading with rapid prototyping, ranging from quick paper mockups to interactive prototypes developed in conjunction with engineering teams – targeting the right fidelity at the right time
* Aligning key leaders and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure meeting the brand goals and to align with them on the design direction
* Understanding business goals, making them meaningful and actionable for the team.

**What We Offer**
Whirlpool has big plans for the future, just like you. We understand that it takes preparation and hard work to get there. So, we offer great teams and tools to build your capability. In our
  
  
performance-based setting, you can take your career in exciting new directions - and as far as you want to go.
  
  
Connect with us and learn more about Whirlpool India. See what it's like to work at Whirlpool by visiting Whirlpool Careers. Additional information about the company can be found on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.
  
  
At Whirlpool India, we value and celebrate diversity. Whirlpool India is committed to equal employment opportunity and prohibits any discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.

**Job Title:** Restaurant Steward

**Location:** Koyikkoden's - Mahipalpur, Delhi

**About Us**

We are an authentic Kerala restaurant dedicated to bringing the rich culinary heritage and warm hospitality of God's Own Country to our guests. From traditional *Sadyas* served on banana leaves to coastal seafood specialties and Malabar delicacies, we pride ourselves on exceptional food, impeccable hygiene, and attentive service.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a reliable, energetic, and detail-oriented **Restaurant Steward** to join our front-of-house and dining operations team. You will play a vital role in ensuring our dining room runs smoothly, tables are turned efficiently, and every guest enjoys a clean, welcoming, and authentic Kerala dining experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Table Setup & Maintenance:** Prepare dining tables before service, including arranging cutlery, glassware, traditional banana leaves (for *Sadya* service), and condiments. Clear, sanitize, and reset tables promptly between guests.

* **Hygiene & Sanitation:** Maintain high cleanliness standards across the dining area, service stations, and restrooms. Ensure strict adherence to food safety and FSSAI hygiene guidelines.

* **Guest Assistance:** Greet guests warmly with traditional hospitality, respond promptly to basic requests (e.g., extra water, napkins, or condiments), and communicate special guest needs to the floor supervisor or server.
* **Team Coordination:** Work closely with kitchen staff, servers, and restaurant managers during peak hours, weekend rushes, and special festive events (such as Onam and Vishu).

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Previous experience as a steward, busser, or dining assistant in a restaurant or hospitality setting is preferred (freshers with a strong work ethic are welcome to apply).
* Basic understanding of food hygiene, safety, and sanitation standards.
* Ability to stay calm, polite, and efficient in a fast-paced dining environment.
* Physical stamina to stand, walk, and carry trays/dishware for extended periods.
* Good communication skills; proficiency in **Malayalam** and basic **English** or **Hindi** is a strong advantage.
* A team-first attitude, punctuality, and neat personal grooming.

* Competitive monthly salary + tips
* Complimentary staff meals during shifts
* Structured shift schedules with weekly off
* Opportunities for growth into Senior Steward or Server roles

title: Project Engineer
description:
**Job Title**
Project Engineer
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
This role is responsible for leading end-to-end project planning and controls, from baseline development through monitoring and close-out, ensuring alignment with project scope, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and statutory requirements.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**

* Serve as the focal point for all civil engineering and construction activities, coordinating with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams to ensure project execution aligns with approved designs, quality standards, schedules, budgets, and statutory requirements.
* Lead the development of the project baseline, including scope breakdown, work sequencing, schedule preparation, cost planning, and resource loading—to establish a robust execution roadmap.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure all design, procurement, and construction activities are accurately reflected in integrated project schedules and aligned with project objectives.
* Conduct regular Planning Review Meetings to track schedule performance, monitor critical paths, assess variances, and ensure timely incorporation of approved changes.

**General Responsibilities**

* Evaluate project schedules, work programs, resource plans, and cost estimates for feasibility, constructability, and compliance with contractual and statutory requirements.
* Monitor project progress using earned value metrics, dashboards, and MIS tools to identify delays, risks, and deviations from the baseline, and recommend corrective actions.
* Support procurement planning by tracking long-lead items, vendor timelines, and material delivery schedules to ensure seamless construction sequencing.
* Conduct periodic site visits to validate reported progress, assess productivity, identify bottlenecks, and synchronize site execution with approved schedules.
* Prepare and maintain planning documentation—including baseline schedules, look-ahead programs, progress reports, S-curves, recovery schedules, and risk registers—to support informed decision-making and project governance.

**About You**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering
* 4-6 years of experience in project management for large-scale, Commercial projects within a PMC, developer, or consulting environment.
* Strong understanding of project planning, cost control, contract administration, construction methodologies, and regulatory compliance.
* Proficiency in project management software, scheduling tools (MSP/Primavera), and MIS/reporting systems.

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.
  
  
OneSpan is building an internal ServiceNow capability to support Customer Support, Professional Services, Revenue Operations, and IT. We are seeking a ServiceNow Administrator who is passionate about platform excellence, user experience, process improvement, and operational support.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working directly with business users, configuring platform capabilities, supporting day-to-day operations, and helping drive adoption of ServiceNow across the organization.
  
  
You will work closely with ServiceNow Developers, Business Analysts, business stakeholders, and global teams across North America, Europe, and India. This position combines platform administration, user support, reporting, and process improvement activities in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
This is primarily an administration and platform support role with an expected focus of approximately:
  
  

* 60% Platform Administration & Support
* 20% Configuration & Continuous Improvement
* 20% Stakeholder Collaboration, Reporting & Documentation

**What You'll Do**
*Platform Administration & Support (Approximately 60%)*

* Administer and maintain the ServiceNow platform and related modules.
* Manage users, groups, roles, permissions, and access requests.
* Support Customer Service Management (CSM), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM/PPM), Service Catalog, Customer Portal, Knowledge Management, and ITSM processes.
* Investigate and resolve user issues, data discrepancies, platform questions, and configuration-related problems.
* Monitor platform health and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
* Assist with system upgrades, patches, regression testing, and release activities.
* Maintain service catalogs, forms, workflows, notifications, and portal content.
* Support queue management, assignment groups, SLAs, workflows, and operational processes.
* Ensure system configurations follow established governance and platform standards.
* Partner with developers when issues require scripting, integrations, or custom development.

*Configuration & Continuous Improvement (Approximately 20%)*

* Configure forms, fields, views, notifications, dashboards, reports, catalog items, knowledge bases, and platform settings.
* Build and maintain Flow Designer automations and no-code/low-code solutions where appropriate.
* Support enhancement requests and platform optimization initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve user experience.
* Participate in testing and validation of platform changes.
* Assist with documentation of configurations and support procedures.

**Reporting, Documentation & Stakeholder Support (Approximately 20%)**

* Create and maintain ServiceNow reports, dashboards, and KPIs.
* Support business users with questions, training, and platform adoption.
* Document system processes, support procedures, configuration decisions, and operating standards.
* Assist Business Analysts in validating requirements and testing solutions.
* Participate in backlog reviews, enhancement planning, and support prioritization discussions.
* Help communicate platform updates and process changes to users.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of ServiceNow administration experience.
* Hands-on experience administering ServiceNow in an enterprise environment.
* Experience with:
* User Administration
* Roles & Security
* Service Catalog
* Knowledge Management
* Reports & Dashboards
* Flow Designer
* Forms, Views, and Configuration Management
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform navigation and administration.
* Experience supporting business users and troubleshooting platform issues.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* Experience supporting CSM, ITSM, SPM/PPM, or Service Catalog implementations.
* Experience working with Agile delivery teams.
* Familiarity with Jira and Salesforce.
* Exposure to integrations and APIs.
* Experience supporting platform upgrades and release management.
* Experience creating executive and operational reporting dashboards.
* AI and automation experience is considered an asset.

**What Will Make You Successful**

* You take ownership and follow through on issues until they are resolved.
* You are comfortable working directly with business users and stakeholders.
* You look for ways to simplify processes rather than add complexity.
* You balance operational support with continuous improvement.
* You are detail-oriented and maintain high standards for data quality and platform governance.
* You enjoy learning new platform capabilities and driving adoption across the organization.
* You can work effectively with global teams across multiple time zones.

**Why Join OneSpan?**

* Help build OneSpan's first internal ServiceNow team in India.
* Gain broad exposure across Customer Support, Professional Services, Revenue Operations, and IT.
* Work directly with business stakeholders and platform leadership.
* Influence platform standards, governance, and future roadmap decisions.
* Grow your career into senior administration, platform ownership, business analysis, solution consulting, or development paths.

title: GRC-SAP-Security-Senior

**SAP Security**

Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

description:

AstroGyan108 is a premium digital platform that brings together some of India’s most renowned astrologers on a single, unified destination. The company is building an integrated astrology and spiritual ecosystem where users can access personalized consultations, expert-led courses, spiritual products, and a wide range of astrology and spiritual services. The platform empowers astrologers with dedicated digital storefronts and technology infrastructure to showcase their expertise, grow their personal brands, and directly offer consultations, courses, and products. For users, AstroGyan108 provides convenient access to multiple reputed astrology experts in one place, supported by technology-enabled solutions that make discovery and engagement seamless. The organization aims to become India’s leading destination for authentic astrology and spirituality, connecting millions of people with meaningful guidance and experiences.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Noida, offering multiple positions across functions such as operations, content, marketing, customer experience, and astrologer relations. Team members will support day-to-day platform activities, including managing astrologer profiles, coordinating consultations and courses, updating content and listings, and ensuring a smooth user journey across the website and app. Depending on the specific role, responsibilities may include handling customer queries, assisting with digital campaigns, maintaining spiritual product catalogues, generating reports on platform performance, and collaborating with technology and business teams to improve services. All roles require close coordination with astrologers and internal stakeholders to maintain high-quality standards, timely execution, and a professional, user-centric experience. Successful candidates will contribute to the growth of AstroGyan108 by helping scale its ecosystem and supporting both astrologers and users in their interactions on the platform.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, including clear spoken and written English and Hindi, active listening, and professional client-facing behavior.
* Candidates should possess organizational and operational skills, such as attention to detail, task prioritization, basic documentation, and the ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously.
* Candidates should possess customer service and relationship management skills, including handling queries, resolving issues, maintaining empathy, and building long-term trust with users and astrologers.
* Candidates should possess basic digital and technical skills, such as proficiency with office productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, documents), comfort with web and mobile platforms, and the ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Candidates should possess analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret basic data, identify process improvements, and suggest practical solutions.
* Relevant experience in e-commerce, online marketplaces, edtech, wellness, or spiritual services is beneficial.
* A graduate degree in any discipline is preferred; diplomas or certifications in business, marketing, operations, or related fields are an advantage

title: Messaging Services Senior Specialist
description:
**Req ID:**
379064
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Messaging Services Senior Specialist to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
Role and Responsibilities:
  
  

* Malware & Phishing Defense: Manage Cisco Talos threat intelligence feeds to block spam, viruses, and malicious attachments. Utilize Advanced Malware Protection (AMP) for file reputation and sandboxing.
* Connection & Reputation Filtering: Adjust IP, domain, and sender reputation parameters to drop malicious connection attempts.
* Outbreak Filters: Configure real-time outbreak rules to protect against new, zero-day threat campaigns
* Content Filtering: Create custom message filters to block specific file types, strip harmful scripts, or enforce company-wide disclaimers
* Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Set up policies to scan outbound traffic and prevent the leakage of sensitive data (e.g., PII, financial information)
* Domain Security: Enforce Sender Policy Framework (SPF), DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM), and Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting, and Conformance (DMARC) to prevent domain spoofing
* Message Tracking & Analytics: Track message dispositions, investigate delivery failures, and generate executive reports on threat trends using centralized management dashboards
* Quarantine Management: Review, release, or delete quarantined emails, and address false positives to prevent business disruption
* Monitor Sender Ecosystem: Regularly review Valimail Monitor or Enforce reports to identify and track all third-party services sending emails on your domain's behalf
* Monitoring & Visibility: Review the Valimail Monitor dashboard to identify unapproved third-party services and unauthorized IP addresses
* Monitor system performance, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions for email security incidents.

Compliance Doctor is a digital-first compliance expert focused on simplifying complex legal, financial, and tax decisions for businesses and individuals across India. The organization blends human expertise from certified professionals such as CAs, CSs, CMAs, and Advocates with an intuitive, paperless online platform to deliver end-to-end compliance management. Clients receive personalized guidance with expert responses in under 24 hours through multiple channels including website, WhatsApp, chat, and email, supported by transparent and affordable pricing. Compliance Doctor serves startups to large enterprises at every stage of the business lifecycle and offers subscription-based Concierge Compliance services with proactive regulatory alerts. Its mission, “Simplifying Compliance, Empowering Growth,” reflects a commitment to building long-term compliance health and acting as a trusted growth partner.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales Executive role at Compliance Doctor is a contract, on-site position based in Noida. The Sales Executive will identify and qualify potential clients, conduct outbound calls and meetings, and present Compliance Doctor’s services and digital platform to decision-makers. This role involves managing the sales pipeline, preparing proposals, negotiating terms, and closing deals in alignment with company guidelines. The Sales Executive will collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding, maintain accurate records in CRM tools, and provide regular reports on sales activities and market feedback. The position requires a proactive approach to relationship building, participation in local networking events, and continuous learning about regulatory and compliance offerings to effectively communicate value to clients.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong consultative sales skills, including prospecting, lead qualification, and deal closure.
* Experience in B2B sales, preferably in compliance, legal, financial, or SaaS-based services.
* Ability to build and manage client relationships, with effective negotiation and presentation skills.
* Comfort with using CRM systems, digital communication tools, and basic data analysis for sales reporting.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in Hindi or other regional languages is an advantage.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple opportunities and deadlines simultaneously.
* Understanding of compliance, taxation, or corporate governance concepts is beneficial, with willingness to learn more.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Previous experience in on-site field sales in the Noida/Delhi NCR region is preferred.

title: Data & Archiving Analyst
description:
**Position Title:**
Data & Archiving Analyst
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
43460
  
  
**In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.**
**About The Role.**
As part of McCain’s digital transformation, we are investing significantly in our data platforms, governance practices, and enterprise information management capabilities. We are seeking an experienced
**Data Archiving Analyst**
to join our Data Platform Governance team and lead the development, implementation, and ongoing operation of McCain’s global data archiving and retention framework.
  
  
This role serves as the enterprise subject matter expert for data retention, archiving, and disposal across McCain’s global technology landscape, with a particular focus on
**SAP S/4HANA**
,
**SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM)**
, and the
**Databricks Enterprise Data Platform**
. The successful candidate will help ensure that data is retained appropriately, archived efficiently, and disposed of in compliance with legal, regulatory, and business requirements while reducing organizational risk and storage costs.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing.**

* Own and evolve McCain’s global data archiving and retention strategy, policies, standards, and operating procedures.
* Develop and maintain enterprise-wide data retention schedules aligned to legal, regulatory, and business requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
* Define and implement data disposal and defensible deletion processes that are auditable and compliant.
* Establish and manage legal hold processes in collaboration with Legal, Privacy, and Compliance teams.
* Lead the design, configuration, governance, and operation of SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM) within McCain’s RISE with S/4HANA environment.
* Govern SAP archiving objects across key functional domains including Finance, Controlling, Materials Management, Sales & Distribution, Production Planning, Quality Management, and Plant Maintenance.
* Partner with SAP Basis teams and managed service providers to monitor archiving activities, content server capacity, and archiving performance.
* Ensure ILM residence and destruction rules are properly configured to support retention and automated disposition requirements.
* Define and enforce data lifecycle management policies within Databricks, including Delta Lake retention controls, VACUUM schedules, and time-travel management.
* Collaborate with data platform teams to apply data classifications, retention tags, and access controls using Unity Catalog.
* Design storage tiering and archival strategies that transition inactive data to cost-effective storage while maintaining recoverability and compliance.
* Serve as the primary escalation point and subject matter expert for enterprise data archiving and retention matters.
* Partner with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and business stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into practical governance controls.
* Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary data accumulation, associated costs, and regulatory risks.
* Maintain data archiving and retention risk registers and communicate priorities, risks, and roadmap updates to senior stakeholders.
* Represent the archiving and retention function in governance forums, steering committees, and cross-functional initiatives.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful.**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in data management, data governance, enterprise data architecture, or a related discipline with a strong focus on data retention and archiving.
* Deep hands-on expertise with SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM), SAP archiving objects (SARA), residence rules, and destruction rules within large-scale S/4HANA environments.
* Experience working with SAP RISE with S/4HANA or comparable SAP cloud-managed service environments.
* Understanding of shared responsibility models associated with SAP cloud services and ILM operations.
* Knowledge of Databricks technologies including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, VACUUM operations, and data lifecycle management concepts.
* Experience developing and operationalizing enterprise-wide data retention policies across multiple business domains and jurisdictions.
* Knowledge of storage tiering strategies and archival storage solutions.
* Strong understanding of global regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, SOX, tax retention requirements, and related regulations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across technical, legal, compliance, and business audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical governance controls and technical implementations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
* SAP ILM, data governance, privacy, or information management certifications.
* Certifications such as CDMP, CIPM, SAP certifications, or equivalent.
* Experience within food manufacturing, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or related industries.
* Knowledge of industry-specific data governance and regulatory requirements.

**About The Team.**
The Data Platform Governance team is a global function responsible for enabling trusted, secure, and governed data across McCain’s enterprise technology ecosystem. The team works closely with business functions, regional teams, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, SAP technology teams, and data platform stakeholders to establish governance standards that maximize business value while reducing risk. As the Data Archiving Analyst, you will play a critical role in shaping McCain’s enterprise data lifecycle strategy and ensuring governance practices support long-term growth and digital transformation objectives.

At McCain, our leadership principles guide how we engage with customers, collaborate as a team, and achieve success. We focus on understanding customer needs, driving innovation, empowering people, and taking ownership to clear obstacles and deliver results.

At McCain, AI and digital capabilities are part of how we work and innovate. We value curiosity toward emerging technologies and the thoughtful, responsible use of AI-enabled tools to improve outcomes as part of our future-ready culture.

title: S&C GN - TS&T – AI & Data - Analyst
description:
**AI & Data Strategy — Analyst**
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients to realize exceptional business value from AI and Data.
  
  
**Practice**
: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
  
  
**Areas of Work**
: AI & Data Strategy
  
  
**Level**
: Analyst
  
  
**Location**
: Bangalore / Gurugram / Mumbai / Pune / Chennai / Kolkata / Hyderabad
  
  
**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
  
  
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation.
  
  
**The Practice — A Brief Sketch**
The Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on the clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
  
  
As part of this high-performing team, you will work on scaling AI — and the data that fuels it — to power every single person and every single process. You will be part of our global team of experts who work on the right scalable solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives faster.
  
  

* Business Transformation: Assessment of AI & Data potential, identification of high-value AI use cases, and development of solutions that can transform business operations.
* Transforming Businesses: Envisioning and designing customised, next-generation data and AI products and services that help clients shift to new business models for today's connected landscape.
* Formulation of Guiding Principles and Components: Assessing impact to client's technology landscape/architecture and ensuring formulation of relevant guiding principles and platform components.
* Product and Frameworks: Evaluate existing AI & Data products and frameworks and develop options for proposed solutions.

**Bring Your Best Skills Forward to Excel in the Role**

* AI Value Assessment & Opportunity Identification: Leverage your knowledge of technology trends across AI & Data and conduct structured AI opportunity assessments — including AI use case identification, value mapping, industry benchmarking, and AI value diagnostics — to identify where AI creates real, measurable value for clients.
* Data & AI Readiness Assessment: Interact with client stakeholders to conduct data maturity assessments and AI readiness reviews, including data infrastructure review, gap analysis, and current-state diagnosis to set the foundation for AI adoption.
* AI Foundation Architecture: Design & guide development of enterprise-wide AI & Data strategy for clients, covering AI architecture design, platform strategy, data architecture, PDLC, foundation design, and cloud architecture to enable AI at scale.
* Strategic Roadmap & Business Case: Develop AI roadmaps, build quantitative and qualitative business cases, lead executive stakeholder engagement, and define value frameworks and prioritisation approaches to establish a fundable, board-level AI strategy.
* Data Governance & Quality: Establish frameworks for effective Data Governance across multi-speed implementations. Define data ownership, standards, policies, and associated processes; drive Data Capability Maturity Assessments and Data Operating Model design.
* Data Platform Strategy: Demonstrate a fair understanding of data platform strategy for cloud migrations, big data technologies, large-scale data lakes, and DW-on-cloud solutions leveraging platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS, Snowflake, or Databricks.
* Stakeholder & Client Engagement: Conduct discovery workshops and design sessions to elicit AI & Data opportunities and client pain areas. Use advanced presentation, public speaking, and content creation skills for C-level discussions.
* Benchmarking & Industry Expertise: Benchmark against global research and leading industry peers to understand current state and recommend AI & Data solutions. Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry — Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecom, Life Sciences, or equivalent.
* Responsible AI: Have a deep understanding of Responsible AI frameworks and tools to engage clients in meaningful discussions and steer towards the right recommendations, including regulatory compliance and ethical AI considerations.
* Budgeting & Financial Proposals: Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and build financial proposals for AI & Data transformation engagements.

**Read More About Us.**

* The rise of forerunners
* Recent Blogs

**Your Experience Counts!**

* MBA from a tier 1 institute preferred.
* 1 – 3 years of Strategy Consulting experience at a consulting firm.
* 1+ years of experience on projects showcasing skills across: AI use case identification, AI value diagnostic, data maturity assessment, AI readiness, AI opportunity assessment, data infrastructure review, gap analysis, AI foundation architecture, AI roadmap, business case development, and executive stakeholder engagement.
* 1+ years of experience in designing end-to-end Enterprise AI & Data Strategic Solutions leveraging cloud and non-cloud platforms such as GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery), Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Snowflake, Databricks, or Palantir.
* Understanding of Traditional AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Advanced Cognitive methods to derive insights and actions.
* Good understanding of data supply chain and building value realization frameworks for AI & Data transformations.
* 1+ years of experience leading or managing teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing Data & AI strategy recommendations as well as developing POCs.
* Knowledge in one or more technologies in the data governance space: Collibra, Talend, Informatica, SAP MDG, Alteryx, Alation, etc.
* Knowledge of IT & Enterprise architecture concepts through practical experience and knowledge of technology trends e.g. Cloud, API-first, Data Mesh, Digital Core.
* Foundational understanding of data privacy and Responsible AI frameworks is desired.
* CDMP Certification from DAMA preferred. Cloud AI/Data Practitioner Certifications (Azure, AWS, Google) desirable but not essential.

**What's in It for You?**

* An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients

title: Quality & MIS Executive – Operations
description:
**About the Role**
: We are looking for a detail-oriented professional to support operational quality, reporting, process monitoring and documentation. The role will involve analysing operational data, conducting process checks, maintaining records and supporting continuous improvement initiatives. Monitor operational quality, maintain accurate records, and prepare MIS reports.

This is
**not a Software QA / Testing role**
. The position primarily involves operational quality checks, MIS reporting, data analysis, process audits and documentation.

**Key Responsibilities**
:

1. MIS & Data Reporting

* Prepare and publish daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports on quality metrics, audit findings and operational performance.
* Consolidate data from multiple sources, clean and validate it, and ensure accuracy before sharing with stakeholders.
* Build and maintain dashboards, trackers and summary views for management review.
* Analyze trends, identify deviations and highlight areas needing corrective action.

2. Quality Assurance Activities

* Conduct routine quality checks and audits of processes, transactions or outputs as per defined SOPs and checklists.
* Log non-conformities, track corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and follow up until closure.
* Support internal and external audits by preparing the required data and evidence.
* Assist in identifying process gaps and recommending improvements.

3. Documentation & Record Keeping

* Create, update and maintain SOPs, work instructions, checklists, formats and audit reports.
* Ensure version control and proper filing of all quality and operational records.
* Maintain audit trails and make documents readily retrievable.
* Prepare clear minutes, reports and summaries of quality reviews.

4. Operations Support

* Coordinate with operations, production/process and support teams for day-to-day quality-related activities.
* Track operational activities, timelines and deliverables, and escalate delays or issues in time.
* Support process improvement initiatives and operational reviews.

5. Communication & Coordination

* Communicate audit findings, observations and reports clearly to team members and management.
* Conduct feedback and follow-up discussions with process owners.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, vendors or clients as required.

**Required Skills & Competencies:**

Technical Skills

* **Basic Excel:**
  formatting, sorting, filtering, data entry, basic formulas (SUM, IF, COUNTIF, AVERAGE).
* **Advanced Excel:**
  VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Pivot Tables and Pivot Charts, conditional formatting, data validation, text and date functions, charts and dashboards. Knowledge of Macros / Power Query is an added advantage.
* Working knowledge of MS Word and PowerPoint for reports and presentations.

Soft Skills

* **Communication:**
  clear written and verbal communication in English and Hindi; able to explain findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Documentation:**
  strong attention to detail, structured writing and accuracy in record keeping.
* Analytical mindset, problem-solving ability and ownership of deliverables.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines and work with minimal supervision.

**Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline (B.Com / BBA / B.Sc / B.Tech preferred).
* 1–3 years of experience in MIS, quality assurance, operations or a similar role.
* Certification or training in Advanced Excel, Six Sigma or ISO standards is a plus.

title: Pre-Sales & Tender Bidding Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Pre\-Sales \& Tender Bidding Specialist / Manager with strong expertise in government and enterprise tendering, RFP/RFQ responses, proposal management and business development support.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in identifying relevant tender opportunities, understanding client requirements, preparing technical and commercial proposals, coordinating with internal technology and digital marketing teams, and ensuring timely and compliant submission of bids.
   

  

 This role will focus on opportunities across digital marketing, website and software development, IT services, digital transformation and AI\-led solutions.
   

  

 The candidate should be able to independently manage the complete tender lifecycle, from opportunity identification and bid qualification to proposal submission and post\-bid coordination.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3 \- 6 Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kolkata (Onsite)
   

  

**‍Key Responsibilities**
 ‍
   

  

**Tender \& Bid Management**
* Identify and track relevant government, PSU, enterprise and private\-sector tenders, RFPs, RFQs and EOI opportunities.
* Monitor tender portals, procurement platforms and other relevant sources for digital marketing and software project opportunities.
* Review tender documents, eligibility criteria, scope of work, technical specifications, evaluation criteria and submission requirements.
* Conduct bid qualification and feasibility analysis based on project scope, capabilities, eligibility, timelines and commercial viability.
* Prepare tender calendars, bid trackers, submission schedules and compliance checklists.
* Ensure all tender submissions are accurate, complete, compliant and submitted within the defined deadlines.
* Coordinate pre\-bid queries, clarifications, corrigenda, extensions and other tender\-related communications.


 ‍
   

  

**Pre\-Sales \& Proposal Development**
* Understand client requirements and translate them into structured technical and business proposals.
* Prepare RFP/RFQ responses, technical proposals, solution write\-ups, capability documents, company profiles and presentations.
* Develop project understanding, proposed approach, implementation methodology, deliverables, timelines and resource plans.
* Coordinate with Technology, Project Management, Digital Marketing, Creative and other internal teams to gather inputs.
* Support the preparation of Statements of Work (SOW), scope documents, assumptions, exclusions and project plans.
* Ensure proposals clearly communicate Web Spiders' capabilities, relevant experience, value proposition and proposed solution.


 ‍
   

  

**Digital Marketing \& Software Project Expertise**
**Support Proposals And Tenders Related To**
* Digital marketing and performance marketing.
* SEO, SEM, social media marketing and content marketing.
* Website design, development and maintenance.
* Web portals, CMS and e\-commerce solutions.
* Mobile application development.
* Custom software development and enterprise applications.
* AI\-powered solutions, chatbots and conversational AI.
* Cloud, DevOps, application support and digital transformation.
* Creative design, branding and multimedia solutions.
* Work with internal experts to understand technical requirements and prepare relevant, client\-focused proposals.


 ‍
   

  

**Technical \& Commercial Coordination**
* Coordinate with technical leads, project managers, solution architects and business stakeholders for proposal inputs.
* Support effort estimation, resource planning, costing and commercial proposal preparation.
* Work with Finance / Accounts and Business Development teams to finalize pricing and commercial terms.
* Review proposal assumptions, dependencies, payment terms, SLAs and contractual requirements.
* Maintain consistency between technical scope, resource estimates, pricing and delivery commitments.
* Escalate risks, deviations, missing information and commercial concerns before submission.


 ‍
   

  

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Participate in pre\-bid meetings, client discussions, clarification calls and presentations.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of bid deliverables.
* Support client presentations, solution walkthroughs and tender\-related meetings.
* Maintain professional communication with prospective clients, partners and consortium members where applicable.
* Track bid outcomes, feedback, negotiation status and next steps.


 ‍
   

  

**Proposal Documentation \& Knowledge Management**
* Maintain a centralized repository of proposals, tender documents, case studies, credentials and reusable bid content.
* Develop and maintain proposal templates, capability decks, company profiles and solution libraries.
* Track submitted bids, win/loss outcomes, reasons for rejection and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure all bid documentation follows company standards and approval requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality of client information, pricing, business proposals and internal documents.


 ‍
   

  

**‍Required Skills \& Experience**
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Pre\-Sales, Tender Management, Bid Management, Proposal Management or IT Business Development.
* Should have experienced with any one of the tender platforms (GeBiz/Tender24x7,Gems, any other Gov portals) for the Digital Marketing \& Software Projects.
* Proven experience in handling government / PSU / enterprise tenders, RFPs, RFQs and EOIs.
* Strong knowledge of the complete tender bidding lifecycle.
* Experience in preparing technical and commercial proposals for software, IT services or digital marketing projects.
* Good understanding of website development, software engineering, digital marketing and digital transformation solutions.
* Strong technical writing, documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to read and interpret tender documents, eligibility criteria and technical requirements.
* Experience coordinating with technical, project delivery, finance and business development teams.
* Strong attention to detail, deadline management and compliance tracking.
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace, Excel / Google Sheets and PowerPoint / Google Slides.


 ‍
   

  

**Interview Process**
* Application review
* 5–10 minute initial screening call with the TA team
* Technical interviews {Domain specific}
* ‍Practical test conducted in the presence of a panel member
* ‍Role match \& offer

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
