title: Application Architect-AI Integration
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Application Architect for AI Integration, this role is responsible for designing and governing end-to-end architectures that embed AI capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows. The Application Architect collaborates with stakeholders to translate business objectives into scalable designs, balancing vendor-managed services with custom development, and drives governance for AI integration.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Designing Architectures: defining reference patterns for AI services, models, and orchestration layers to integrate seamlessly with existing systems, APIs, and data platforms.
* Collaborating with Stakeholders: translating business objectives into scalable, resilient, and policy-compliant designs, ensuring performance, security, compliance, and cost objectives are met.
* Governing AI Integration: driving governance for prompts, guardrails, and lifecycle management, ensuring observability, privacy, and responsible AI principles are embedded from design through operations.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* AI Architecture Design: Experience with designing end-to-end architectures that embed AI capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems, APIs, and data platforms.
* Technical Governance: Experience with driving governance for prompts, guardrails, and lifecycle management, ensuring observability, privacy, and responsible AI principles are embedded from design through operations.
* Reference Pattern Development: Experience with defining reference patterns for AI services, models, and orchestration layers, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and hybrid reasoning.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Experience with collaborating with stakeholders to translate business objectives into scalable, resilient, and policy-compliant designs, balancing vendor-managed services with custom development.
* AI Service Integration: Experience with integrating AI services, models, and orchestration layers with existing systems, APIs, and data platforms, meeting performance, security, compliance, and cost objectives.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Advanced AI Concepts: Experience with emerging AI technologies and trends, such as explainable AI and edge AI, can be beneficial.
* Cloud Native Services: Knowledge of cloud-native services and serverless architectures can be advantageous in designing scalable AI integrations.
* Data Platform Integration: Familiarity with integrating AI services with various data platforms and APIs can be useful.

title: System Engineer L2 - Linux Systems & Storage/ Kolkata
description:
**Job Title: System Engineer L2 – Linux System & Storage**

**Location: Kolkata DC**

**Type: Onsite, Rotational Shift (24×7)**

**Job Level: L2 Reporting to: Team Lead – Systems & Storage**

**Our Purpose**
India is in the middle of an extraordinary AI revolution, powered by a young, tech-savvy generation and visionary leaders who see the future in code and creativity. Across industries—from healthcare to finance to education—AI adoption is accelerating at record speed. Over 90% of business leaders are now reimagining their processes through AI, while developers and students across the country are building tools that are transforming the way India works and lives. At the heart of this movement stands

Neysa, India’s trusted AI Acceleration Cloud Provider. Neysa exists to democratize AI. Built in India for the world, Neysa carries the credibility of a leadership team that created Netmagic (now part of NTT Data). With a fully integrated system and deep local market insight, Neysa helps organizations across sectors confidently adopt, accelerate, govern, and scale AI. The Future of AI, Built on Trust and Expertise. Hence, Neysa understands and builds the Home for Your AI.

**Who We Are**

Co-founded by industry pioneers Sharad Sanghi and Anindya Das, Neysa combines deep expertise in cloud, AI infrastructure, and cybersecurity to empower the builders of the future. Its flagship product, Neysa Velocis, is a full-stack system built for modern AI—from training and fine-tuning to inference. It streamlines compute, orchestration, security, and observability, helping organizations in high-growth markets like India adopt AI faster, safer, and more cost-efficiently.

**The Opportunity**

Join Neysa as a System Engineer – Linux System & Storage, where you will take ownership of advanced system administration, troubleshooting, and infrastructure reliability in a 24×7 environment. You will act as a key escalation point for critical issues, drive resolution of high-severity incidents, and contribute to improving system performance, automation, and operational excellence across data center and office environments.

**What You’ll Achieve In This Role**

* Lead resolution of critical incidents and complex infrastructure issues
* Ensure high availability, performance, and security of Linux and storage systems
* Strengthen operational maturity through process adherence and documentation
* Drive automation and efficiency across infrastructure management
* Act as a technical mentor and escalation point for L1 and L2 teams

**Roles And Responsibilities: As a Senior System Engineer – Linux System & Storage, you will:**

* Perform advanced configuration, administration, and troubleshooting of Linux systems, storage, backup, hardware, and applications
* Provide technical support and guidance to L1 teams and clients across communication channels
* Be available for 24×7 operational support in rotational shifts
* Handle escalations, severity incidents, and critical projects
* Respond to and resolve incidents, requests, changes, and problems within SLA
* Work on service improvement plans (SIPs) and assigned initiatives
* Ensure adherence to defined processes and operational procedures
* Maintain high availability and uptime of infrastructure systems
* Prepare handover checklists, plans of action (POA), shift reports, SOPs, and KEDB documentation
* Ensure all activities are logged and updated in ticketing systems
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive faster resolutions and improvements

**Required Qualifications**

* 4 to 8 years of experience in Linux System Administration & Storage
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field (preferred)
* Strong experience working in enterprise or data center environments
* Proven ability to handle critical incidents and escalations

**Primary Skills (Must Have)**

* Strong expertise in Linux OS and infrastructure management
* In-depth knowledge of networking concepts: DNS, DHCP, SSH, TCP/IP, SMTP, IP, Iptables/Firewalld
* Experience with web servers and load balancers: Apache, Nginx, HAProxy
* Advanced troubleshooting and analytical skills (logs analysis, event correlation)
* Strong knowledge of storage technologies: LVM, RAID, SAN, NAS, iSCSI
* Proficiency in scripting and automation: Python, Shell scripting, Ansible, Terraform
* Experience with containerization and orchestration: Docker, Containers, Kubernetes
* Hands-on experience with backup technologies: Bacula, Commvault, Veeam

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools: Prometheus, Grafana
* Exposure to provisioning tools like Foreman and MAAS
* Understanding of virtualization platforms: KVM, Proxmox
* Basic knowledge of AI model deployment and fine-tuning
* Experience in driving automation and infrastructure optimization initiatives

**Why This Role is a Unique Opportunity at Neysa**

This role offers the opportunity to work on complex, large-scale infrastructure systems that power AI-driven platforms. You will play a critical role in maintaining system reliability, handling high-impact incidents, and shaping operational excellence in a fast-growing AI ecosystem. You’ll gain deep exposure to enterprise infrastructure, automation practices, and next-generation AI workloads while contributing to a high-performance environment.

**Team Culture and Inclusion**

* Work in a collaborative, high-impact, and fast-paced environment
* Be part of a culture that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning
* Thrive in an inclusive workplace where diverse ideas and perspectives are encouraged

title: Senior Admissions & Student Counselling Executive
description:
**Senior Admissions & Student Counselling Executive**

**Organisation:**

Kaavaach Academy

**Department:**

Admissions & Student Relations

**Location:**

Kolkata, West Bengal

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

**Work Mode:**

On-site

**Experience Required:**

3–5 years of relevant experience

**Compensation:**

Up to ₹25,000 per month (Fixed + Performance-Linked Variable)

**About Kaavaach Academy**

Kaavaach Academy is an educational institution focused on structured learning in traditional knowledge systems and spiritual studies. Our programmes are designed to provide students with organised learning experiences through expert-led instruction, practical engagement and a disciplined academic approach.

We are looking for an experienced admissions professional who can independently manage the student enquiry-to-enrolment process and contribute to the Academy's admissions growth.

**Role Overview**

The Senior Admissions & Student Counselling Executive will be responsible for managing prospective student enquiries, conducting programme counselling, maintaining consistent follow-ups and converting qualified prospects into paid admissions.

The role requires strong communication, consultative selling, relationship management and the ability to manage an admissions pipeline independently.

This is a target-oriented position suited to a professional with prior experience in education sales, admissions counselling or EdTech business development.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enquiry Management**

* Manage incoming enquiries received through WhatsApp and other approved channels.
* Respond to prospective students promptly and professionally.
* Understand student interests, learning objectives and programme suitability.
* Maintain accurate records of all enquiries and interactions.

**2. Student Counselling**

* Explain programme structure, curriculum, duration, faculty, learning format and fee details.
* Guide prospective students in selecting suitable programmes.
* Address questions, concerns and objections with clarity and professionalism.
* Maintain a consultative, student-focused approach throughout the counselling process.

**3. Admissions & Conversion**

* Manage the complete admissions funnel, from initial enquiry to payment confirmation.
* Conduct structured follow-ups with interested and qualified prospects.
* Share application forms, brochures, payment instructions and other approved information.
* Drive application completion and convert qualified enquiries into paid admissions.
* Coordinate with the operations team to ensure a smooth student onboarding experience.

**4. Pipeline & Performance Management**

* Maintain and update the admissions tracker and lead pipeline.
* Track enquiry status, follow-ups, applications, payment confirmations and conversions.
* Submit daily activity updates and periodic performance reports.
* Identify conversion bottlenecks and recommend improvements to the admissions process.

**Candidate Profile & Requirements**

* 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in admissions, education sales, student counselling, EdTech or course sales.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage enquiries and close paid admissions.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Strong counselling, negotiation, objection-handling and follow-up skills.
* Experience managing leads through WhatsApp Business.
* Familiarity with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel and lead management systems.
* Strong ownership, accountability and professional conduct.
* Ability to work towards monthly admission and revenue targets.

**Preferred Experience**

Candidates with prior experience in the following sectors will be preferred:

* EdTech and online education
* Professional training institutes
* Coaching and educational institutions
* Online certification and skill-development programmes
* Premium or high-involvement course sales

**Key Competencies**

* Consultative Selling
* Student Relationship Management
* Admissions Funnel Management
* Lead Qualification & Conversion
* Negotiation & Objection Handling
* Follow-up Discipline
* Performance Reporting
* Ownership & Accountability

**Application Process**

Interested candidates should share their updated CV along with the following details:

1. Total years of relevant experience.
2. Previous organisation and designation.
3. Experience in education sales or admissions counselling.
4. Average number of paid admissions achieved per month in the previous role.
5. Experience handling WhatsApp-based enquiries.
6. Current and expected monthly compensation.
7. Notice period and availability to join.

**Important:**

Candidates should be prepared to participate in a practical counselling and admissions-conversion assessment during the selection process.

**Position:**

Senior Admissions & Student Counselling Executive

**Organisation:**

Kaavaach Academy

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

title: Doctoral Researcher In Structural Health Monitoring And Bridge Rating
company: Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology (IIEST), Shibpur
description:
**Company Description**
Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology (IIEST), Shibpur is a national engineering and research institution located in Shibpur, Howrah, West Bengal. Recognized as an Institute of National Importance, it has a long history dating back to 1856, focused on training scientists and engineers. IIEST Shibpur offers bachelor’s, master’s, and doctoral programs in engineering and architecture. The institute also provides advanced degrees in science and management, fostering interdisciplinary research and innovation. Applicants can expect an academically rigorous environment with strong emphasis on research, collaboration, and societal impact.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, hybrid role for a Doctoral Researcher in Structural Health Monitoring and Bridge Rating, based in Howrah with some flexibility for remote work. The researcher will conduct experimental and analytical studies on bridge structures, including monitoring structural performance, identifying damage indicators, and assessing load-carrying capacity. Daily tasks include designing and executing research methodologies, collecting and analyzing data from sensors and monitoring systems, and developing models and algorithms for structural health assessment and rating. The role involves reviewing technical literature, preparing research reports and publications, assisting in academic presentations, and collaborating with faculty, research teams, and industry partners. The researcher may also support teaching-related activities, supervise student projects, and contribute to the development of tools and guidelines for practical bridge evaluation.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Analytical Skills and Data Analysis capabilities to interpret structural behavior, monitoring data, and bridge rating outcomes.
* Proven Research experience, including experimental design, field or laboratory work, and scholarly writing in engineering or related domains.
* Effective Communication skills for technical documentation, publication preparation, and collaboration with academic and industry stakeholders.
* Awareness of Healthcare-related considerations in infrastructure resilience and public safety is beneficial, along with broader societal impact perspectives.
* Master’s degree with valid GATE score (or equivalent) in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a closely related discipline; eligibility and motivation to enroll in a doctoral program at IIEST Shibpur.
* Knowledge of structural health monitoring techniques, sensor technologies, signal processing, and bridge engineering principles.
* Familiarity with engineering software and programming tools (e.g., MATLAB, Python, finite element analysis packages) is an advantage.
* Ability to work independently and in teams, manage research timelines, and adhere to ethical and safety standards in field and laboratory environments.

title: Medical Officer (Shift Duty)
description:
**Night Medical Officer (MO) – ICU & Emergency (Cancer Hospital)**

* **Overnight ICU Monitoring:** Track vitals, ABGs, intake/output, and organ function for critically ill medical and surgical oncology patients.
* **Ventilator & Hemodynamic Care:** Manage mechanical ventilation settings and titrate vasopressors/inotropes under intensivist guidance.
* **Post-Op Oncology Management:** Monitor post-surgical cancer patients for bleeding, airway patency, drain output, and pain control.
* **Emergency Triage & Resuscitation:** Stabilize walk-in/ambulance oncology casualties using BLS/ACLS protocols.
* **Oncological Emergencies:** Treat acute crises including febrile neutropenia, tumor lysis syndrome, SVC obstruction, cord compression, and tumor bleeding.
* **Bedside Procedures:** Perform or assist with intubation, central/arterial lines, tapping, catheterization, and NG tube insertion.
* **Code Blue Leadership:** Respond immediately to hospital-wide cardiopulmonary arrests and rapid response calls during night shifts.
* **Consultant Escalation & Handover:** Report critical lab/imaging changes to on-call consultants and deliver structured morning handovers.
* **Palliative Care & Counseling:** Manage acute cancer pain/symptoms per protocol and update families empathetically on critical status.
* **Documentation & Infection Control:** Maintain accurate EMR notes, MLC/consent records, and strict aseptic precautions for immunocompromised patients.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

title: IT Lead -IT Engineering
description:
**Job Title:**
IT Lead -IT Engineering

**Location:**
Coimbatore

**Immediate joiners or notice period of less than 10 days are needed**

**This Role:**

The IT Lead, IT Engineering leads the engineering of LogixHealth's Microsoft cloud and workplace platforms: Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Azure including Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft Purview data protection, ITSM tooling and automation. The role owns everything beyond day-to-day operations in a healthcare technology environment that handles Protected Health Information (PHI).

This is a strategic and technical leadership role. The Lead sets the standards and roadmap for these platforms, is the technical authority on design decisions and major incidents, stays hands-on for the most complex work, and leads and mentors the IT engineers who deliver the rest. The Lead turns business and security requirements into a practical platform plan with costs, risks and timelines for the IT Infrastructure Leadership, and serves all LogixHealth locations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Strategy, Standards and Roadmap***

* Own the architecture, design standards and 12 to 24 month roadmap for identity, endpoint management, data protection, cloud and virtual desktop and IT tooling; translate business, security and compliance requirements into options and investment cases with cost, risk and timeline.
* Provide input to budgeting, Azure forecasts, Microsoft licensing and tooling decisions; lead projects end to end (requirements, design, pilot, phased rollout, handover) and act as technical approver in design and change reviews.

***Platform Ownership (Entra ID, Intune, Purview, Azure, AVD)***

* Own Entra ID standards: Conditional Access framework, MFA and authentication strategy, Privileged Identity Management, access reviews, application integration and hybrid identity (Entra Connect).
* Own endpoint and data protection standards: Autopilot, Autopatch, configuration and compliance policies, Defender for Endpoint, application deployment, Purview DLP and encryption, for Windows and macOS.
* Own Azure Virtual Desktop design and operation (host pools, image strategy, FSLogix, autoscaling, capacity, cost and monitoring) and the supporting Azure resources.

***Security Hardening, Patch and Vulnerability Management***

* Own the hardening standard (Microsoft or CIS baselines, Defender for Endpoint and ASR rules, Credential Guard, firewall, device control, encryption, Windows LAPS) and the patch programme: policy and SLAs by severity, monthly cycle, third-party patching, maintenance windows, exception governance and zero-day response.
* Own the vulnerability management programme: intake from Defender Vulnerability Management or scanners, prioritisation, remediation SLAs, exception and risk-acceptance register with Security, verified closure and monthly posture reporting with owners and dates for gaps.

***ITSM Tooling and Automation***

* Own the engineering of IT tooling, including ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus design and its integrations with Intune, Entra ID and Microsoft 365, plus monitoring, reporting and self-service automation.
* Set automation and documentation standards for the team (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Azure DevOps or Git) and introduce Infrastructure as Code where it adds value.

***Incident, Compliance and Team Leadership***

* Act as technical lead on major incidents affecting these platforms and on the technical response to security incidents with Information Security; manage Microsoft and vendor escalations; own ISO 27001, SOC 2 and HIPAA evidence for the platform controls.
* Lead, mentor and develop the IT engineering team: allocate work, review designs, provide escalation support and build capability across the platforms.

**Qualifications:**

The following requirements are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required to perform this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the duties.

***Required (Mandatory):***

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or a related engineering discipline.
* 9 to 12 years in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 2 to 3 years as technical lead, with at least 4 years hands-on on Microsoft 365 and Azure in a design and build (engineering) capacity rather than support-only roles.
* Strong hands-on Microsoft Entra ID: Conditional Access design, MFA and authentication methods, PIM, access reviews, enterprise application SSO and hybrid identity.
* Strong hands-on Microsoft Intune: Autopilot, compliance and configuration policies, Autopatch or update rings, Defender for Endpoint, macOS management.
* Strong hands-on Azure Virtual Desktop: architecture, host pools, image lifecycle, FSLogix, autoscaling, security and monitoring, with working knowledge of the Azure platform (networking, storage, monitoring, RBAC, cost).
* Proven ownership of patch and vulnerability management for an endpoint or VDI estate: hardening standards, Defender Vulnerability Management or Tenable, Rapid7 or Qualys, SLA-based remediation, exception governance and reporting.
* PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; proven ability to define a roadmap, lead major incidents, run design reviews and explain architecture, cost and risk to senior management.
* Work from office; shifts and on-call as required for a 24×7 healthcare operation; travel between Coimbatore and Bangalore when needed.

***Preferred (Good to Have):***

* Infrastructure as Code: owning a Terraform (azurerm, azuread) or Bicep practice with module standards, remote state, Git pull-request workflow, pipeline deployment and drift detection, including identity objects managed as code.
* Deeper Azure platform design (vNets, NSGs, private endpoints, Azure Files, Compute Gallery, Log Analytics) and Azure DevOps or GitHub CI/CD; Windows 365, Nerdio, Citrix or VMware Horizon to AVD migration.
* Microsoft Purview DLP and Defender XDR depth; ITSM tool design or integration (ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus, ServiceNow or similar); experience moving from AD-dependent estates to cloud-native Entra ID and Intune; healthcare, HIPAA or other regulated environment.

***Preferred Certifications (Good to Have):***

Microsoft AZ-104 or AZ-305, MD-102, SC-300, AZ-140; ITIL Foundation; HashiCorp Terraform Associate.

title: Senior Quality Control Engineer for Steel Foundry
description:
**Company Description**
ULTIMATE ALLOYS PRIVATE LIMITED is a steel-focused manufacturing company based in Tamil Nadu, India, with operations in Coimbatore. The company specializes in alloy and steel foundry products that serve industrial and engineering applications. ULTIMATE ALLOYS emphasizes consistent product quality, reliable delivery, and adherence to industry standards. Team members work in a collaborative environment with a focus on safety, process improvement, and long-term customer relationships.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated
**Senior Quality Control Engineer**
to lead and strengthen quality assurance activities in our steel foundry operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and internal quality requirements throughout the manufacturing process, from raw materials to final inspection and dispatch.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, implement, and monitor quality control procedures for steel castings and foundry processes.
* Review customer specifications, quality plans, inspection requirements, and technical standards.
* Conduct stage-wise inspections including pattern, molding, melting, pouring, heat treatment, machining, and final inspection.
* Lead dimensional inspections, visual inspections, and non-destructive testing (NDT) activities such as RT, UT, MT, and PT.
* Ensure compliance with ASTM, ASME, API, NACE, PED, ISO, and customer-specific requirements.
* Review and approve quality documentation including ITPs, QAPs, MTCs, inspection reports, and final quality dossiers.
* Coordinate with customers, third-party inspection agencies, and certification bodies during inspections and audits.
* Investigate quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Monitor process capability, rejection trends, and quality KPIs to drive continuous improvement.
* Support new product development, qualification trials, and process validation activities.
* Lead internal quality audits and support external customer audits.
* Mentor and guide QC inspectors, NDT personnel, and quality engineers.
* Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality management systems.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, or related discipline.
* 8-15 years of experience in quality control within a steel foundry, valve casting, pump casting, or heavy engineering casting environment.
* Strong knowledge of steel casting manufacturing processes and metallurgy.
* Hands-on experience with NDT methods, dimensional inspection, and interpretation of engineering drawings.
* Familiarity with international codes and standards such as ASTM, ASME, API, ISO 9001, and PED.
* Experience in handling customer inspections, third-party inspections, and quality audits.
* Proficiency in quality tools such as RCA, 8D, FMEA, SPC, and CAPA.

Preferred Skills

* Certification in NDT Level II/III (RT, UT, MT, PT) is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of ERP systems and quality management software.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and leadership skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

title: Commission Sales Associate
description:
**Company Description**
NowOrCry is a hyperlocal commerce network that connects neighborhood shoppers with nearby shops through real-time, location-based offers. Shoppers can discover what is worth buying around them, claim offers to a digital wallet, and redeem coupons at the counter. Merchants use the platform to fill quiet hours, publish offers in minutes, alert followers and nearby shoppers, and track in-store visits generated by campaigns. Brands and franchise groups can run unified campaigns across partner stores using localized catalogues. The platform operates in 191 countries and 56 territories, and is accessible via web, iOS, and Android.
  
**Role Description**
The Commission Sales Associate is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi. In this position, the associate will actively identify and approach local merchants and brands, explain NowOrCry’s value proposition, and onboard them to the platform. The role involves conducting in-person meetings, demos, and follow-ups to convert leads into active partners and support them in setting up offers and campaigns. The associate will monitor merchant performance, gather feedback, and collaborate with internal teams to improve engagement and retention. Daily activities include prospecting in designated areas, maintaining accurate records of interactions, and meeting sales and activation targets tied to commission-based earnings.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to close deals and meet or exceed targets.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with merchants, brands, and internal stakeholders.
* Basic digital literacy and comfort working with web, iOS, and Android applications; ability to demonstrate platform features to clients.
* Solid organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple leads, visits, and follow-ups efficiently.
* Prior experience in field sales, retail partnerships, or business development, ideally in technology, commerce, or retail sectors.
* Knowledge of the Kochi market and local business landscape; fluency in English and relevant local language(s).
* Ability to work independently, travel within assigned areas, and adapt in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; a bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is an advantage.

title: Sales Associate
description:
About NowOrCry

NowOrCry connects neighbourhood shoppers with the shops around them. Shoppers see what is worth buying nearby right now, claim the offer to a wallet in the app, and show the coupon at the counter. Shops post an offer in a minute, alert shoppers nearby, and see who walked in because of it. We are starting our on-the-ground launch in Kochi.

About the role

This is a full-time, on-site role in Kochi. You will visit local shops (cafes, bakeries, restaurants, salons, groceries, fashion and electronics stores), show them NowOrCry on your phone, sign them up and help them post their first offers. Pay is a fixed monthly amount plus commission for every shop you bring on board.

What you will do

* Visit shops in your assigned Kochi areas and explain how NowOrCry brings in walk-in customers
* Give short demos on the web, Android and iOS apps
* Sign up shops and help them create their first offers
* Follow up with shops so they keep posting offers
* Keep simple, accurate records of every visit and follow-up
* Share what shop owners say with our team so we can improve the product
* Meet weekly sign-up and activation targets

What we are looking for

* Fluent Malayalam and good English
* Good knowledge of Kochi and its local shops
* Confident talking to shop owners face to face; field sales or retail experience is a plus
* Comfortable using smartphone apps and showing them to others
* Organised, self-driven and happy to travel within Kochi every day
* Own two-wheeler preferred
* Freshers with the right attitude are welcome to apply

Pay

Fixed monthly pay plus commission on every shop signed up and active. Details will be discussed at the interview.

title: Optometrist
description:
**Company Description**
TB Yenu Opticals is a growing eye care and optical retail business serving the community in and around Thrissur. The organization is committed to providing high-quality vision care, including comprehensive eye examinations and customized eyewear solutions. TB Yenu Opticals focuses on a patient-centered approach, ensuring that each individual receives clear information, attentive service, and appropriate eye care recommendations. Team members collaborate closely to maintain professional standards, reliable service, and a welcoming environment for all visitors. The company values ethical practice, continuous learning, and long-term relationships with patients.

**Role Description**
The Optometrist will perform comprehensive eye examinations, including refraction, assessment of ocular health, and prescription of corrective lenses. Day-to-day responsibilities include diagnosing common vision problems, recommending appropriate treatment or eyewear options, and referring patients to ophthalmologists or other specialists when necessary. The role involves educating patients on eye health, contact lens care, and preventive measures, as well as supporting the optical team in lens selection, fitting, and troubleshooting. The Optometrist will maintain accurate clinical records, ensure adherence to professional and regulatory standards, and contribute to the smooth operation of the practice. This is a full-time, on-site role based at TB Yenu Opticals in Thrissur.

**Qualifications**

* Recognized Optometry degree or diploma, with valid registration or eligibility to register with relevant professional bodies.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct comprehensive eye examinations, including refraction, binocular vision assessment, and basic ocular health evaluation.
* Experience prescribing and fitting spectacles and contact lenses, with strong attention to accuracy and patient comfort.
* Good knowledge of common eye conditions and appropriate referral pathways for advanced medical or surgical care.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to explain clinical findings and treatment options clearly to patients.
* Commitment to ethical practice, patient confidentiality, and compliance with applicable clinical and safety guidelines.
* Ability to work collaboratively with optical staff and management, contributing to a supportive, inclusive work environment.
* Willingness to engage in continuous professional development and stay updated on advances in optometry and eyewear technology.
* Prior experience in a retail optical or clinical eye care setting is an advantage, though motivated early-career professionals are also encouraged to apply.

title: Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeon
description:
**Company Description**
Self-employed oral and maxillofacial surgeons in Chavakkad typically operate independent practices, providing specialized surgical care to patients with complex dental, oral, and facial conditions. Working as a self-employed professional offers flexibility in scheduling, case selection, and practice management, while maintaining direct relationships with patients and referring clinicians. Surgeons can shape their own clinical environment, adopt preferred treatment protocols, and invest in modern equipment and technologies. This setting suits practitioners who value autonomy, patient-centered care, and the ability to build a strong local reputation in the community.
  
**Role Description**
The Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeon will provide comprehensive surgical care, including routine and complex oral surgery procedures, dental extractions, and management of facial trauma. Daily responsibilities include examining patients, diagnosing oral and maxillofacial conditions, developing treatment plans, administering local and general anesthesia as appropriate, and performing surgical interventions such as bone grafting and dental implant placement. The role also involves collaborating with dental and medical professionals, conducting post-operative follow-up, monitoring healing, and providing patient education on treatment options and preventive care. Additional duties include maintaining accurate medical records, ensuring adherence to clinical standards and safety protocols, and overseeing basic practice operations. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Chavakkad.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong clinical expertise in Oral Surgery and Dentistry.
* Candidates should possess solid knowledge of Medicine and Anesthesiology relevant to oral and maxillofacial procedures.
* Candidates should possess advanced skills in Dental Implants, including planning, placement, and restoration coordination.
* Candidates should possess excellent diagnostic, treatment planning, and patient communication abilities.
* Candidates should possess a recognized dental degree (BDS/DDS or equivalent) and specialist qualification in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery.
* Candidates should possess valid professional licensure and certifications required to practice surgery and administer anesthesia in the region.
* Candidates should possess strong infection control knowledge and commitment to quality and patient safety.
* Candidates should possess the ability to work independently, manage a busy clinical schedule, and collaborate effectively with referring providers.

You will collaborate across Product, Business, and Technology teams to create trusted insights and scalable analytics solutions. * Experience partnering with data architects and engineers to develop scalable analytics solutions
* Demonstrated ability to identify appropriate data sources, validate business outputs, and resolve data quality issues

* Experience automating manual processes and designing maintainable analytics workflows
* Experience with business intelligence tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent
* Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation
* Experience with agile project management tools such as Jira

title: IT Lead, IT Operations and Service Delivery
description:
**Job Title:**
IT Lead, IT Operations and Service Delivery

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Immediate joiners or notice period of less than 10 days are needed**

**This Role:**

The IT Lead, IT Operations and Service Delivery owns the day-to-day running of IT operations at LogixHealth: the IT Service Desk and desk-side support team, adherence to the ITSM process, end-to-end IT asset lifecycle management, major incident management and operational reporting, in a healthcare technology environment that handles Protected Health Information (PHI). This is an operations leadership role, accountable for service quality, SLA performance, major incident ownership and an accurate, audit-ready asset register. The role is based in Bangalore with oversight of Coimbatore operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Service Delivery and ITSM Process***

* Run the IT Service Desk and desk-side support operation for Bangalore and Coimbatore with shift coverage aligned to business hours.
* Own the execution of incident, request, change and problem management in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus: correct logging, categorisation, prioritisation and closure; queues, backlog, ageing, SLA adherence and customer satisfaction managed daily.
* Represent IT Operations in the Change Advisory Board; run problem management with RCA and corrective actions; maintain the knowledge base, SOPs and user guides and drive self-service.

***Major Incident Management***

* Act as Major Incident Manager: open and run the MI bridge, coordinate technical teams and vendors, maintain the timeline, drive restoration and own stakeholder communication and escalation to the Director, IT Infrastructure and senior leadership.
* Lead post-incident reviews, publish incident reports and track follow-up actions to closure.

***IT Asset Lifecycle Management***

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of end-user IT assets (laptops, desktops, monitors, peripherals, printers, mobile devices, meeting-room AV): request, procurement, tagging, allocation, moves, repairs, warranty and AMC, returns, secure wipe and certified disposal.
* Maintain an accurate asset register and CMDB in the ITSM asset module; reconcile against Intune, Entra ID and procurement records; run periodic physical audits and resolve discrepancies.
* Manage spares and stock, warranty and AMC expiry and end-user software licence tracking; provide refresh forecasts to the Director, IT Infrastructure.

***User Lifecycle, Office IT and Vendors***

* Own the joiner, mover and leaver process: device provisioning via Autopilot, access requests through the approved workflow, account and access removal on exit, asset recovery.
* Coordinate office IT with Facilities and vendors (meeting rooms and Microsoft Teams Rooms, printing, network links and ISP escalations, UPS) and manage vendor and AMC relationships: SLAs, quotes, invoices, renewals.

***Patch, Vulnerability and Security Operations***

* Drive patch compliance from the operations side: chase non-compliant, offline and long-unrebooted devices from Intune and Autopatch reports, schedule maintenance windows with the business, log and track exceptions.
* Coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities on end-user and office IT assets within SLA with IT Engineering, Security and vendors, including firmware currency through AMCs; track to verified closure.
* Run day-to-day security hygiene (Defender and encryption gaps, unmanaged or non-compliant devices, unauthorised software, lost or stolen device process, removable media) and act as operational point of contact for security incidents: triage, isolation, user communication, evidence.

***Governance, Reporting and Team Leadership***

* Produce weekly and monthly operational reports (ticket volumes, SLA performance, backlog and ageing, major incidents, asset status, procurement pipeline) and a monthly patch and security compliance report (patch compliance, open vulnerabilities by severity and ageing, encryption and Defender coverage, non-compliant devices).
* Maintain operational evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2 and HIPAA audits (asset registers, disposal, access request and removal, incident and change records) and enforce IT policies on the floor with Information Security.
* Lead, mentor and manage the service desk and desk-side engineers across Bangalore and Coimbatore: rosters and shift planning, performance reviews, skill development and clear accountability for ticket ownership and user communication.

**Qualifications:**

The following requirements are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required to perform this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the duties.

***Required (Mandatory):***

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field (B.E./B.Tech preferred).
* 8 to 10 years in IT operations, service desk or end-user support, including 2 to 3 years leading a support team.
* Hands-on experience running ITSM processes in an enterprise tool (ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management or similar): queue management, SLA configuration and reporting.
* Proven experience as Major Incident Manager: running bridges, coordinating technical teams and vendors, communicating with senior stakeholders under pressure.
* Demonstrated ownership of IT asset lifecycle management (asset register and CMDB accuracy, physical audits, warranty and AMC tracking, secure disposal) and of hardware vendor, AMC and procurement coordination.
* Working knowledge of Windows 11, Microsoft 365, Intune and Autopilot and Entra ID from a support perspective, and of patch and vulnerability management from the operations side (reading Intune, Autopatch and vulnerability reports, chasing remediation, exceptions, compliance reporting).
* Excellent English communication with stakeholders at all levels; strong documentation and reporting discipline.
* Work from office; shifts with a 24×7 support roster; travel between Bangalore and Coimbatore when required.

***Preferred (Good to Have):***

* Working knowledge of server administration and troubleshooting (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS and DHCP, Group Policy, virtualisation basics) for first-level diagnosis and coordination with the engineering team.
* Working knowledge of networking (LAN and WAN, VLANs, Wi-Fi, firewall and ISP troubleshooting basics) to isolate site connectivity issues and coordinate with network vendors.
* ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus administration; Azure Virtual Desktop and Microsoft Teams Rooms support exposure; ISO 27001, SOC 2 or HIPAA audit evidence experience; healthcare, BPO or other 24×7 regulated operation.

***Preferred Certifications (Good to Have):***

ITIL 4 Foundation (required) or higher; Microsoft MD-102 or MS-900; ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus; CompTIA Network+ or Server+ or CCNA; IAITAM CAMP/CHAMP or equivalent.

title: Manager (IFM - Technical Services & Sustainable Operations) — Campus Development
description:
**About the IIHS Campus Development**

The IIHS campus is located on a 54-acre site at Kengeri, Bengaluru, located between a 500-acre reserve forest and a 800-year old 150-acre lake. Its digitally augmented buildings and facilities, slated to be built over multiple phases, will enable interdisciplinary teaching-learning, research and practice, and demonstrate the best examples of Indian design and crafts. The campus will provide faculty, students and researchers with the opportunity to immerse themselves in and innovate around India’s core urban challenges.

The campus features a robust integrated infrastructure and services network supported by various sensors and other IoT devices to enable cost-effective high performance and long-term sustainability. This will be enabled via an intelligent digital twin to integrate all MEP services at site and building level to help in optimised predictive operations and maintenance.

The IIHS Campus Development team focuses on design, procurement, execution, and

documentation of the development of the IIHS Kengeri Campus. Joining the Campus Development team at IIHS offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of building one of India’s most ambitious, sustainable and climate-resilient campuses. Situated in the upcoming Kengeri area of Bengaluru, it is deeply rooted in principles of net neutrality and long-term environmental stewardship targeting Factor two to four infrastructure and services.

As part of this fast-paced and dynamic team, you will gain hands-on experience and

unparalleled exposure to interdisciplinary planning, design and implementation spanning various technology domains, architecture, urban design, planning and environmental design, . The role is designed to accelerate your professional development, offering meaningful engagement with cutting-edge practices in sustainable development. We are looking for candidates passionate about building a better future and eager to shape a living, learning campus from the ground up. Join this team if you are interested in a purpose-driven career.

**Job Description**

IIHS is looking to hire an experienced Integrated Facility Management (IFM) Manager – Technical Services & Sustainable Operations to assume direct operational accountability for mission-critical MEP infrastructure and sustainable campus operations across IIHS facilities. The incumbent will manage internal technical engineering staff while providing rigorous contractual governance over external IFM service providers, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), and Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs). This role demands strict alignment with green campus benchmarking, net-zero resource targets, high-voltage asset uptime, and robust Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) regulatory compliance.

**Activities and Tasks**

Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to, the following:

* Hard services and critical infrastructure governance:
* Operations & maintenance:
  Overseeing routine and specialised O&M of high-voltage/ low-voltage (HT/LT) electrical systems, transformers, DG sets, HVAC central chillers, STP/ WTP facilities, and Fire & Life Safety (FLS) networks;
* BMS & IoT monitoring: Managing Building Management Systems (BMS) and IoT-enabled digital twin frameworks for real-time asset tracking and predictive fault detection;
* Preventive maintenance: Establishing and executing strict Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) schedules to ensure maximum equipment lifecycle and zero unplanned downtime;
* Sustainability and resource optimization:
* Green campus initiatives: Driving initiatives targeting net-zero energy, water efficiency, carbon footprint reduction, and campus zero-waste goals;
* Resource conservation: Monitoring and optimising energy/ water baselines through intelligent sub-metering, STP recycled water utilisation, and waste segregation protocols;
* Auditing and reporting: Conducting regular energy and environmental audits, tracking performance against institutional sustainability targets;
* Internal staff leadership & vendor/ AMC governance:
* In-house crew management: Directing, scheduling, upskilling, and evaluating performance standards for in-house technicians, electricians, and shift engineers;
* Contractual SLA enforcement: Drafting technical SOWs/ RFPs, tracking performance scorecards, and enforcing strict SLAs/ KPIs for external IFM service providers and OEM AMC partners;
* Compliance & risk control: Ensuring 100% adherence to statutory EHS guidelines, Electrical Inspectorate norms, local municipal rules, and leading disaster management emergency response drills;
* Financial budgeting: Formulating and tracking OPEX/ CAPEX budgets for hard services, utility bills, spare parts inventory, and engineering repairs;
* Institutional:
* Providing support to other IIHS activities including academics, research, training, practice, operations and others;
* Participating in all activities of Institution-Building at IIHS; carrying out tasks as assigned by IIHS; and traveling on IIHS work within or outside the country as and when needed.

**Structure and Reporting**

The Manager (IFM – Hard Technical Services & Sustainable Operations) will report directly to the Head – Campus Development or to any other person designated by the
Head at IIHS. The incumbent will need to collaborate effectively with the Campus Development Team, internal engineering staff, and external IFM/ AMC vendors.

**Person Specification**

The ideal candidate should possess:

* Bachelor’s degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Electrical or Mechanical; professional certifications such as LEED AP, IGBC AP, or Certified Energy Manager (CEM) are highly desirable;
* Minimum 9 years of hands-on experience managing hard technical services, mission-critical infrastructure, and sustainable operations within complex campus environments;
* In-depth operational knowledge of BMS/IoT integrations, predictive maintenance models, Computer-Aided Facility Management (CAFM)/CMMS software, and energy management systems;
* Proven vendor negotiation expertise, crisis management composure, strong leadership of blue-collar and engineering teams, and executive-level reporting.

This offer is on an exclusive basis, which implies that other professional assignments (whether compensated or not) that bear a potential conflict of interest with IIHS cannot be undertaken.

The search will remain open until the position is filled.

**Location**

This position is based in Kengeri, Bengaluru and may entail travel to other locations in India.

**Review and Assessment**

The role and performance of the incumbent shall be subject to normal review and assessment systems at IIHS.

**Diversity Policy**

IIHS is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions.

**Contact**

Please write to us at careers@iihs.co.in if you need any clarifications while filling the online application form.

title: Collections Supervisor
description:
**About PayJoy**

  
  

PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success.  Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system.  Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life.  PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth.

  
  

**This role**

The Collections Supervisor will manage and implement PayJoy's collections operations mandate in India from launch. The role sets up the first processes, agencies and strategies, then runs day-to-day recovery to keep the portfolio healthy and support PayJoy's growth in the market.

  

All collection activity must be fair, ethical and fully compliant with Indian law and regulation. This includes the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) rules on loan recovery and the conduct of recovery agents, effective 1 January 2027, and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. The focus is on preventing delinquency early, recovering overdue amounts efficiently, and treating every customer with dignity.

**Responsibilities**
  

Launch and setup

  

  
* Run the launch collections operation: Run PayJoy India's collections processes from as per approved template, including workflows, scripts, contact strategy and escalation paths
  
* Write the recovery policy: Implement the collections and recovery policy required by the RBI, with Legal and Compliance. This covers recovery triggers, an escalation matrix, a code of conduct, financial distress and deceased-borrower procedures, and borrower compensation
  
* Select and onboard recovery agencies: Run due diligence on prospective agencies, check that their agents hold IIBF Debt Recovery Agents certification, and agree contracts, performance standards and audit rights
  
* Manage the first strategy: Define the initial portfolio segmentation, agency allocation and control groups so results can be measured from day one
  
  

  

Operations

  

  
* Early delinquency: Run the contact/digital  strategy for accounts 1–30 days past due and monitor results daily
  
* Agency coordination: Allocate accounts to recovery agencies as directed and follow up on their activity
  
* Agency performance: Track agency recovery, cost and ROI, and flag underperformance
  
* Treatment vs control: Report monthly results for the treatment and control groups
  
* Recovery tests: Run approved tests and report the results
  
* Device restrictions: Follow the device-restriction process in line with RBI rules
  
* Payment channels: Help resolve customer payment issues
  
* Credit reporting: Prepare collections data for monthly credit bureau reporting
  
* Reporting: Produce daily, weekly and monthly performance reports
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance or a related field
  
* 3–5 years' experience in collections management, team leadership and customer service, ideally in consumer lending, NBFCs or fintech
  
* IIBF Debt Recovery Agents certification and applicable regulatory compliance for debt recovery
  
* Working knowledge of RBI fair practices and loan recovery rules, including recovery agent conduct and device-restriction requirements
  
* Experience managing external recovery agencies and IIBF-certified recovery agents
  
* Knowledge of credit reporting to Indian credit information companies and related compliance standards
  
* Proficiency with collection management software and Google Workspace or Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  
* Strong analytical skills, with experience measuring performance and evaluating strategies
  
* SQL for data analysis and reporting is a plus
  
* Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work closely with internal teams and external agencies
  
* Empathy and a supportive approach with customers, plus clear, assertive communication in writing and speech
  
* Fluent in English and conversant in Kannada, Hindi a plus
  
  

  
**Benefits**

  
* 100% Company Funded : Private Health Insurance for employee and immediate family
  
* Company-funded employee life and disability insurance
  
* 20 days vacation, unlimited sick leave
  
* $2,000 USD annual Co-working Travel perk
  
* $2,000 USD annual Professional Development perk
  
* Phone Finance, headphone benefit, home office equipment allowance and wellness perks

  

PayJoy is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and we welcome and encourage people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

  
  

**PayJoy Principles**

  
  

Finance for the next billion \* Ownership \* Break Through Walls \* Live Communication \* Transparency & Directness \* Focus on Scale \* Work-Life Balance \* Embrace Diversity \* Speed \* Active Listening

title: AI Experience Builder
description:
**AI Experience Builder**
: A product-minded frontend engineer: React and Next.js, about 70% engineering and 30% design

Bengaluru, India

· Hybrid, 3 days a week

· Full-time

· 3 to 7 years of experience

· Start: Jan 2027

**You own how delightful Rapidflare is to use. You're the first to imagine new ways to create impact, spot roadblocks and papercuts, and fix them before anyone asks.**

**What we're building**

Millions of times a day, the world asks questions about electronics. Too often, the answers are inaccurate, incomplete, inefficient or low quality. Rapidflare builds AI agents for the electronics industry that deliver delight to humans and agents in these moments of truth.

Engineers, sales teams and support teams use our agents to find the right part, get deep technical questions answered from datasheets and documentation, compare products, and reach a design decision faster. The agents run on our customers' websites, in our admin dashboard, in Slack and Discord, and in a Chrome extension.

Behind those surfaces is a lot of hard backend work: ingestion, product catalogs, retrieval, evaluation. Our customers rarely see any of it. What they see is the experience, and for an AI product, the experience is most of what they judge us on.

**Why this role exists**

AI has changed how fast we build. Anyone on our team can take an idea to a working prototype in a day. Our designer edits the frontend codebase directly; our AI engineers build the UI for the features they ship. That velocity is real, but it has a cost. Prototypes arrive unpolished, patterns drift between codebases, and small papercuts pile up faster than anyone owns them. Today too much of that lands on two people: our frontend lead, who has carried the frontend codebase largely alone for a long time, and our design lead, whose time is better spent on where the product goes next than on the next UI request.

You would close that gap. Not a designer who codes a little, and not a frontend engineer who takes tickets. A builder, roughly 70% engineering and 30% design, who cares about the product the way a founder does.

**What you will own**

* **The main product experience.**
  You use Rapidflare every day from the customer's seat. You find the papercuts and the big opportunities, bring them to the team, and are usually the first one out of the gate to fix them.
* **Our frontend, together with our frontend lead.**
  You co-own our frontend monorepo: the admin dashboard, the embedded agent, our embed SDK and the Chrome extension, built on Next.js, React and TypeScript. You review frontend contributions from across the team, make and maintain framework choices, and help start the frontend rotation we don't have yet.
* **Prototype to product.**
  Engineers and designers hand you rough proofs of concept, often built with AI in an afternoon. You turn them into something customers love, without breaking what's around them.
* **The system that lets the team scale.**
  If frontend contributions double or triple, the codebase should get more consistent, not less. You build and maintain our component library with our design lead, and make components shareable across our split codebases.
* **Full-stack work in lockstep with the AI team.**
  Many of our biggest features cross the stack: streaming agent answers, product catalogs, search. You understand the backend side well enough to know what your change touches.
* **Several features at once.**
  That's normal here. You juggle them, sequence them, and say plainly what's slipping.

**Who you are**

**How you think.**
You start from the user. You think in flows, states and feedback before pixels, and you care about polish, fit and finish because you notice them in the products you use. You hold strong opinions about UX and frontend architecture, and you change them when someone shows you something better.

**How you work.**
You use AI relentlessly, and agents write a lot of your code, but you stay in charge of it. You read what the agent produced, catch what it got wrong, and can explain every line you ship. You would rather talk to a customer than guess what they want. You write and speak clearly.

**What you've built.**
Three to seven years building frontends, most of it in React, with real depth in Next.js: server and client components, rendering and hydration, performance with large amounts of data. You learned the fundamentals before AI wrote code for you, and it shows. You've shipped features people use, working alongside designers, backend engineers and product people. Visual design skills, AI product experience, a frontend operations mindset and experience running experiments are all welcome; none of them is required.

**Where this can go.**
This role can grow into owning an entire product surface at Rapidflare: its users, its roadmap and its outcomes.

**Who this isn't for.**
It isn't for you if you prefer to work alone, or if you need a finished spec before you start. It isn't for you if all of your development experience is AI-driven and you haven't built without it. It isn't for you if you'd rather be right than get it right; we give each other direct feedback, often, and that includes feedback to the founders. And if your next step is managing a team, this isn't that role. It is an individual builder role with a lot of ownership.

**What it's like to work here**

We're a small team punching above its weight class. Every person carries a lot of ownership, makes decisions daily and drives impact on their own. The AI space changes daily, and our team has learned to deal with ambiguity and rapidly evolving priorities. We move quickly and expect you to as well. If that sounds draining, it's better that you know now. If it sounds like the place you've been looking for, keep reading.

We hire based on demonstrated capability and potential, not your pedigree. If what we described is not exactly your profile, but it is how you envision yourself, we encourage you to apply.

**To apply and to learn more about how interviews will look, go to:**
https://www.rapidflare.ai/careers/role-2026Q4-1/experience-builder

description:
**Why Harvey**
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
  
  
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
  
  
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
  
  
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Staff Software Engineer on the Product team at Harvey, you'll play a critical role in designing and building new backend systems while equally scaling and strengthening our existing infrastructure. Our backend infrastructure is the foundation that powers every user interaction with Harvey — processing billions of prompt tokens and millions of daily requests across our global legal AI platform.
  
  
You'll work in an environment balanced between innovation — building new systems — and operational excellence, ensuring that Harvey remains resilient and efficient as it scales products, regions, customers, and usage. Your contributions will directly impact the reliability, scalability, and security of our platform as we serve the world's leading law firms and professional service providers.
  
  
This role is based in Bengaluru, India.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and build scalable, fault-tolerant backend infrastructure systems that power Harvey's AI platform across multiple cloud regions
* Own and evolve our multi-cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP), including Kubernetes orchestration, networking, and container management
* Lead technical initiatives around observability, incident response, and operational excellence — building systems that enable rapid detection and resolution of issues
* Architect and optimize our distributed systems for reliability, including load balancing, quota management, and failover mechanisms
* Partner with Product Engineering and Security teams to ensure our infrastructure is an accelerant, not a constraint
* Drive infrastructure-as-code practices using tools like Terraform and Pulumi to enable reproducible, auditable deployments
* Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization through code reviews, design reviews, and technical leadership
* Representative Projects

+ Design and implement a next-generation model proxy architecture that routes millions of daily inference requests while maintaining model API compatibility and enabling seamless model integration
+ Build distributed rate limiting and quota management systems using Redis-backed algorithms to handle bursty traffic patterns without degrading user experience
+ Architect multi-region deployment strategies that meet strict data residency requirements for global enterprise customers
+ Develop comprehensive observability infrastructure with granular SLA monitoring, burn rate alerts, and detailed token attribution for cost tracking
+ Lead the evolution of our CI/CD pipelines to improve developer velocity while maintaining production stability

**What You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering or Platform Engineering in a production environment
* Long track record building and scaling complex, large-scale distributed systems
* Deep proficiency with cloud infrastructure platforms (Azure preferred; GCP or AWS experience transfers well)
* Strong fluency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools — Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation
* Solid understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, networking, and cloud security at scale
* Experience with observability tools (Datadog, Sentry) and incident response practices (PagerDuty, Incident.io)
* Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or similar languages
* Excellent problem-solving skills, a "spidey sense" of where things could go wrong, and a commitment to operational excellence

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building infrastructure for AI/ML workloads or high-throughput inference systems
* Background with distributed rate limiting, load balancing, or quota management systems
* Experience operating multi-tenant platforms with strict security and compliance requirements
* Track record of leading complex cross-functional projects and delivering measurable impact

**Additional Information**

* Work eligibility: Must be authorized to work in India. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
Amex GBT is a place where colleagues find inspiration in travel as a force for good and – through their work – can make an impact on our industry. We’re here to help our colleagues achieve success and offer an inclusive and collaborative culture where your voice is valued.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**

* Design and develop end-to-end web applications using React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and Express.js with modern best practices
* Build high-performance RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints with advanced optimization techniques and proper versioning
* Develop scalable microservices architectures with event-driven patterns, real-time features, and horizontal scaling capabilities
* Implement CI/CD pipelines, containerize applications with Docker, and orchestrate infrastructure using Kubernetes
* Design and maintain systems with 99.9%+ uptime, including fault tolerance, failover mechanisms, and multi-region deployments
* Conduct performance profiling, memory optimization, implement auto-scaling solutions, and optimize for mobile performance
* Create responsive, accessible UIs using advanced CSS3, state management, PWA features, and WCAG compliance standards
* Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, lead technical initiatives, and ensure security best practices across the development lifecycle

**What We're Looking For:**

* Advanced proficiency in Node.js with expertise in memory profiling, event loop optimization, clustering, and performance tuning techniques
* Proven experience designing 99.9%+ uptime systems with failover mechanisms, disaster recovery, and multi-region deployments
* Strong background in microservices decomposition, horizontal scaling, load balancing, and massive-scale design patterns
* Expert-level knowledge of React 18+, Next.js 14+, TypeScript, and advanced performance optimization techniques
* Deep expertise in PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis with sharding strategies, query optimization, and connection management
* Strong experience building RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and tRPC with proper authentication, authorization, and versioning
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD), AWS services, and infrastructure as code
* Demonstrated expertise in security scanning, vulnerability management, and monitoring tools like DataDog and Sentry with comprehensive logging practices

**Location**
Bangalore, India
  
  
**The #TeamGBT Experience**
Work and life: Find your happy medium at Amex GBT.
  
  

* Flexible benefits are tailored to each country and start the day you do. These include health and welfare insurance plans, retirement programs, parental leave, adoption assistance, and wellbeing resources to support you and your immediate family.
* Travel perks: get a choice of deals each week from major travel providers on everything from flights to hotels to cruises and car rentals.
* Develop the skills you want when the time is right for you, with access to over 20,000 courses on our learning platform, leadership courses, and new job openings available to internal candidates first.
* We strive to champion Inclusion in every aspect of our business at Amex GBT. You can connect with colleagues through our global INclusion Groups, centered around common identities or initiatives, to discuss challenges, obstacles, achievements, and drive company awareness and action.
* And much more!

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to age, sex, gender (and characteristics related to sex and gender), pregnancy (and related medical conditions), race, color, citizenship, religion, disability, or any other class or characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Click Here for Additional Disclosures in Accordance with the LA County Fair Chance Ordinance.
  
  
Furthermore, we are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the hiring process. For details regarding how we protect your data, please consult the Amex GBT Recruitment Privacy Statement.
  
  
**What if I don’t meet every requirement?**
If you’re passionate about our mission and believe you’d be a phenomenal addition to our team, don’t worry about “checking every box;" please apply anyway. You may be exactly the person we’re looking for!
