title: Sr Web Developer- Webflow & Marketo
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.
  
  
Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
  
  
**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
Candescent is seeking an experienced Senior Web Developer to lead our Webflow development efforts from one of our India office locations. This role combines hands-on technical work with technical leadership. You will set technical direction, own the build quality, performance, and scalability of our web presence, and oversee the work of other developers and designers.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. You will personally build and troubleshoot complex work while also raising the standard of everything the team produces through review, documentation, and shared practices.
  
  
In addition to individual craft, this role carries senior leadership responsibility for the India-based web development team, including accountability for the team’s collective output and close coordination with the US-based Digital Experience lead.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Technical Ownership & Architecture**

* Own the technical architecture of our Webflow sites, including CMS structure, custom code integrations, and third-party API and app integrations.
* Lead the design-to-development process, translating Figma mockups into responsive, accessible, high-performance pages.
* Manage Webflow site settings, hosting, staging environments, versioning, and publishing workflows.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, including custom interactions and animations built with Webflow native tools or GSAP.

**Standards, Quality & Performance**

* Establish and enforce best practices for site structure, SEO markup, page speed, accessibility (WCAG), and cross-browser and device compatibility.
* Conduct code and design reviews and lead QA before launches.
* Optimise pages for Core Web Vitals and overall site performance.
* Maintain documentation of site structure, components, integrations, and workflows so knowledge is shared rather than held individually.

**Marketing Systems Integration**

* Own the integration of Marketo forms, landing pages, and tracking within the website, ensuring accurate lead capture and clean data flow into marketing automation.
* Oversee implementation of tracking and analytics tags including GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Marketo Munchkin.
* Support experimentation by ensuring test variants and experiment code can be implemented reliably.

**Team Leadership & Oversight**

* Serve as the senior technical lead for web in India, overseeing the day-to-day work of other developers and designers and setting the quality bar.
* Be accountable for the collective deliverables of the India web development team, including prioritisation, workload balancing, timelines, and consistent quality.
* Coordinate closely with the US-based Digital Experience lead on priorities, intake, status, escalations, and technical direction.
* Coach and develop team members on Webflow craft, standards, and production discipline.
* Manage relationships with external agencies or freelance contractors when needed.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.

**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*

* 6–9 years of web development experience, including at least 3 years building and maintaining production sites in Webflow.
* At least 2 years in a senior, lead, or management capacity, overseeing the work of other developers or designers.
* Proven portfolio of complex Webflow builds, such as CMS-driven sites or app-like interactions.
* Strong command of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including custom code embeds within Webflow.
* Experience integrating and troubleshooting Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform on a website.
* Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards, and cross-browser and device testing.
* Experience implementing tracking and analytics tags such as GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
* Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals as they relate to site markup, structure, and performance.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

**Qualifications & Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Design, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio will be considered.
* Familiarity with version control such as Git for managing custom code is preferred.
* Experience with A/B testing and optimisation tooling is preferred.
* Experience with project management tools such as Smartsheet or Jira is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.

**What Success Looks Like**

* The website is fast, stable, accessible, and free of recurring defects.
* Builds match design intent closely and require minimal rework.
* Forms and tracking reliably capture and pass lead data into Marketo without errors.
* Webflow CMS and components are organised, documented, and maintainable by others.
* The India web team delivers consistently, with quality that does not depend on one individual.
* Technical standards are clear, followed, and improving over time.

**What Will Make You Successful**

* Genuine technical depth paired with the willingness to review, teach, and unblock others.
* Pragmatism about when to build custom and when to keep things simple and maintainable.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow-through, and accountability in a global, fast-paced environment.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
description:

With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.
  
  
Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.

These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.
  
  
**Description**

* Collaborate with business users, business analysts, and project managers to understand and interpret business requirements, ensuring alignment with technical capabilities and system constraints.
* Coordinate with system architects and other stakeholders to develop comprehensive solution designs that meet business needs and technical requirements.
* Write clear and detailed technical design documents, outlining system configurations, customizations, and development processes.
* Conduct functional testing to ensure the solution meets business requirements and perform user acceptance testing (UAT) support to ensure successful implementation.

* Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JSON, and XML for data structuring and custom styling.
* Deep understanding of configuring robust data-level security and access controls.
* Have a basic understanding of Dev Ops and Agile Methodologies.
* Proficiency in using GitHub and Copilot for development.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
About PSG-CP

  
  

Pearson is the world's lifelong learning company, and PSG-CP (Pearson Software Group - Content Platform) is the organization powering how that learning gets created, enriched, delivered, and measured. PSG-CP's focus is on content. We handle authoring, semantic enrichment, transformation, delivery, assessment, and analytics, serving every Pearson line of business and millions of learners worldwide. We are reshaping the platform around AI in a serious way, and this Principal Engineer role is pivotal in shaping the vision, strategy, and execution of technology and architecture.

  
  

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role focused on improving engineering effectiveness, accelerating delivery, and ensuring technical excellence across the organization. You will not be embedded within a single team; instead, you will work across teams on PSG-CP initiatives, complex technical challenges, and architectural decisions.

  
  

You will partner closely with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product, and DevOps to assess technical feasibility, and drive architecture decisions for future high-impact, AI-native PSG-CP capabilities.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

  
* Lead technical feasibility reviews and share architecture for enterprise-scale AI-native PSG-CP capabilities
  
  
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across multiple squads, focusing on high-impact initiatives and critical path work
  
  
* Unblock complex technical challenges that span systems, teams, or domains
  
  
* Lead and contribute to architecture and system design decisions, ensuring scalability, simplicity, and long-term maintainability
  
  
* Drive technical consistency and best practices across teams (design patterns, standards, tooling)
  
  
* Partner with the Engineering Manager and Staff Engineers to support delivery without taking on people management responsibilities
  
  
* Contribute directly to code when needed, especially in high-risk or high-priority areas
  
  
* Mentor and guide senior engineers and technical leads through coaching, design discussions, and knowledge sharing
  
  
* Partner with internal and external stakeholders to identify, assess, and co-develop Ai-native innovative capabilities to PSG-CP
  

  

**Required Skills and Competencies:**

  

  
* Prior experience building content authoring / management platforms is a must
  
  
* **Full-Stack Engineering, Modern Development Tools (Advanced):**
  Build and prototype end-to-end across frontend, backend, and infrastructure. Experience with at least one of the following: Front End like React, Angular; Back End like Java, Spring, Node JS, Python
  
  
* **Cloud Computing, API Management, DevOps, Data Security, Information Security (Advanced):**
  Lead technical execution and ensure compliance. Prior working experience in a cloud computing environment like AWS/GCP is highly desired
  
  
* **Collaboration, Innovation, Cross-Functional Working, Technical Acumen, Problem Solving (Advanced):**
  Influence across teams and partners, shape ideas, and drive differentiated solutions.
  
  
* **Comfort with Ambiguity, Builder Mindset (Advanced):**
  Operate effectively in undefined, fast-moving, early-stage environments.
  
  
* Ability to operate as a force multiplier across teams, elevating overall engineering quality and speed
  
  
* Strong architectural thinking with a focus on scalability, simplicity, and business impact
  
  
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence without authority both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  
  
* Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, and evolving environment
  
  
* Demonstrated ability to work with global teams across time zones
  

  

**Qualifications (Education & Experience):**

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience
  
  
* 15+ years of experience building and scaling full-stack applications
  
  
* Proven experience operating at a staff or principal level, influencing multiple teams or large systems
  
  
* Strong background in system design, distributed systems, and API architecture using event driven microservices
  
  
* Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous, cross-cutting technical problems
  
  
* Experience driving technical strategy, standards, and architecture across teams

Key Responsibilities

–Evaluate whether systems are meeting nonfunctional scalability requirements, and proactively anticipate growing business needs within the business unit.

–Guide the optimization of advanced mechanisms to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Drive the creation and customization of highly complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms, proactively ensuring system health and reliability.

–Develop advanced strategies for data replication and synchronization, ensuring robust data integrity and availability

–Maintain expertise in dependencies, dependents, and owned systems to drive effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Set standards for operational readiness and standard operating procedures within the department, and hold third-party partners accountable for meeting those standards.
  
  
–Oversee operational support rotations, providing expert guidance in incident response and leading root cause investigations to prevent future occurrences.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Architect advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, and lead initiatives to enhance data and application protection.
  
  
–Guide the execution of comprehensive remediation plans to address identified security vulnerabilities.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations, and guide documentation efforts across projects.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop enterprise-level automation tools and strategies (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) and oversee their implementation.
  
  
–Drive alignment of change management plans and organizational initiatives for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and design interdependent systems to allow for automation of these processes.

Planning & Execution:

Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

title: Software Engineer 3 – Platform Security
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
****Software Engineer 3 – Platform Security****
**Location: Bengaluru
  
  
Team: Cloud Platform Security**
**About The Team**
**eBay’s Cloud Security Engineering team builds foundational security services that protect our global marketplace. The team designs and operates secure, scalable cryptographic platforms that enable trusted transactions, secure communications, and strong identity guarantees across millions of users and services.**
****Role Summary****
**We are seeking a Software Engineer 3 (T24) to join our Bengaluru team with strong hands-on experience in cryptography, encryption, and public key infrastructure (PKI). In this role, you will design, build, and maintain secure, maintainable software components and services in the cryptography and platform security domain, working on production-ready systems with a strong focus on quality, reliability, and operational excellence.**
****What You’ll Do****

* Build and enhance cryptographic libraries, integrations, and service components that support encryption, digital signatures, and secure key management.
* Develop and maintain software systems that use public key cryptography, including RSA, ECC, and digital signature workflows.
* Contribute to PKI, certificate-management capabilities, and trust frameworks used by internal platforms and services.
* Implement extensible, maintainable software solutions for secure service integrations and platform capabilities.
* Support production readiness through testing, monitoring, operational improvements, and continuous integration practices.
* Translate feature requests into design options, engineering tasks, and effort estimates for the team.
* Participate in threat modeling, security reviews, and validation of cryptographic designs and implementation choices.
* Improve the performance, scalability, and resilience of cryptographic operations in distributed, high-throughput systems.
* Stay current with modern cryptographic standards, vulnerabilities, and secure development best practices.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful hands-on work in security, cryptography, or secure platform development.
* Strong programming skills in Go, Java, or C++, with the ability to build production-quality backend software.
* Hands-on experience with cryptographic concepts and algorithms such as AES, RSA, ECC, DSA, and digital signatures.
* Strong understanding of PKI, certificate management, and secure key handling concepts.
* Experience with secure application development using technologies such as JCA, JCE, or similar security libraries and frameworks.
* Familiarity with PKCS#11, KMIP, or similar key management protocols and integrations.
* Good understanding of distributed systems, secure service design, and secure coding practices, including common cryptographic pitfalls.
* Experience working independently on components or sub-systems, with accountability for delivery, quality, and production support.

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* Experience with hardware-backed security, HSM integrations, or TPM-related capabilities.
* Exposure to modern cryptographic evolution areas such as post-quantum cryptography.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude, with sound judgment around code quality, security, and performance.

****Why This Role Matters****
**This role is an opportunity to help build and evolve the security foundations that underpin eBay’s marketplace at scale. As a Software Engineer 3, you will own meaningful technical scope within the team, deliver secure and reliable software end to end, and contribute to the continued strength of eBay’s cryptographic and platform security capabilities.**
**Additional Details**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. description: Role DescriptionWe are seeking a high-output Software Engineer to build production-grade AI agents, agent connectors, and supporting infrastructure for enterprise workflows. We are not looking for someone who merely builds AI systems in a traditional way. We want an engineer who already uses AI to perform 80-90% of the software engineering workflow - requirements shaping, design, code generation, debugging, testing, documentation, and iteration while applying engineering judgment to validate, correct, and productionize the output. This role is about speed, leverage, and practical delivery.Role ObjectiveDesign and deliver agentic systems that can perform meaningful work with minimal human intervention, while enabling the engineer to use modern AI tooling to compress end-to-end engineering cycle time. The engineer will build agents that can reason over context, use tools, call enterprise systems, persist state, learn from prior interactions, and operate safely inside governed cloud environments. Modern agent implementations now commonly rely on handoffs, tools, traces, sessions, and controlled sandboxes to do exactly this.Key ResponsibilitiesDesign and build AI agents that automate meaningful end-to-end workflowsEngineer agent body components including:enterprise connectors and APIstool calling layerspersistent memory and session/state handlingcontext management, retrieval, and skills/pattern librariesorchestration across single-agent and multi-agent flowsevaluation, tracing, and guardrailsBuild connectors to enterprise platforms, data stores, documents, and operational systems using standardized tool and protocol patterns where appropriate, including MCP-style integrations. MCP is an open protocol for exposing tools, resources, and prompts to LLM applications.Create robust cloud-native services to support agent execution, logging, observability, access control, and controlled deployments.Implement persistent and short-term memory patterns so agents can retain useful context without becoming noisy or brittle. OpenAI s current guidance explicitly highlights sessions, trimming, and compression as important context-engineering patterns for long-running agents.Build and refine workflows for agent handoffs, tool selection, safe action execution, and human-in-the-loop approval where required. Both OpenAI and Anthropic now describe simple, composable agent workflows and tool-based systems as the practical path to effective agents.Prototype quickly, test aggressively, and move the strongest agent patterns into stable internal use.Use AI directly in your own engineering workflow to accelerate requirements interpretation, system design, coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and iteration.Required QualificationsStrong experience in software engineering, with a track record of building production-quality systems.Demonstrated hands-on experience building AI agents or agentic applications with tools, workflows, orchestration, or autonomous execution patterns.Strong experience with Python and/or TypeScript for backend or agent-system development.Experience with cloud infrastructure and modern deployment patterns across one or more major cloud platforms.Experience building connectors to APIs, databases, file systems, enterprise tools, or SaaS products.Experience with memory/state handling, context engineering, retrieval, or knowledge-grounded agent behavior. Persistent context and memory management are now treated as core implementation concerns in production agent systems.Experience with observability, debugging, tracing, or evaluation of complex application behavior. Agent tracing is now a formal capability in current agent SDKs.Strong judgment in separating what should be handled by prompts, retrieval, deterministic code, memory, or workflow design.Critical Capability: AI-Augmented EngineeringThe successful candidate must already operate as an AI-augmented engineer. We expect the engineer to:use AI for the majority of day-to-day engineering workmove from concept to prototype rapidly using AI-assisted design and implementationvalidate, correct, and productionize AI-generated output rather than handcrafting everything from scratchtreat AI as a force multiplier in coding, testing, debugging, and documentationThis is not optional. The role is explicitly intended for someone whose working style reflects the future operating model we are trying to build.Preferred QualificationsExperience with OpenAI Agents SDK or similar agent frameworks, including tools, handoffs, tracing, and sandboxed execution. OpenAI s latest SDK capabilities include file inspection, command execution, code editing, and controlled sandbox workspaces.Familiarity with MCP or equivalent agent/tool interoperability standards.Experience with multi-agent or workflow-based patterns, evaluator-optimizer flows, or modular agent architectures. Anthropic s current guidance recommends simple, composable agent patterns over overly abstract frameworks.Experience with secure execution environments, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop safeguards. MCP guidance also emphasizes visible tool invocation and the ability for humans to deny tool actions.Exposure to ML engineering is helpful, but this is not primarily a model-training position.What Success Looks LikeAgent prototypes can be built in days, not months.Connectors and tools are reliable enough that agents can do useful work, not just generate text.Memory and context are engineered so agents stay coherent over long-running workflows.The engineer personally demonstrates exceptional productivity by using AI as the primary development accelerator.Internal users begin to see real autonomous or semi-autonomous outcomes, not just demos.Skillsai agent,software engineering,cloud infrastructure,database,

title: Senior Software Engineer - Product Data Gateway
description:
**About The Role**
At Abnormal AI, we are on a thrilling mission to safeguard the world's largest enterprises against a vast range of relentless email and collaboration application cyber security attacks. Our relentless pursuit involves crafting an exceptional suite of products that empowers customers to seamlessly visualize, expertly control, and fearlessly combat cyber-security threats.
  
  
The Multi-Product Platform (MPP) organization owns the product platform that enables scalable product development, helping the business build and launch enterprise-grade products with a consistent customer experience.
  
  
This is a chance to build the data backbone that every Abnormal product depends on. As a Senior Software Engineer on MPP and founding engineer of the team, you'll create the standardised data layer that becomes our single source of truth — the one governed path through which any system, agent, or interface can reach data from across every product, from a single record to cross-product aggregates, online or offline, in whatever shape it needs. A hard, high-leverage problem: serve the whole platform at high throughput and low latency without becoming the bottleneck, while enforcing tenant isolation, auth, and fine-grained access control so every team gets security and reliability for free — built AI-native from day one.
  
  
You won't be maintaining someone else's system — you'll be defining the foundation every product is built on, where getting it right compounds across the whole company.
  
  
If you're energized by 0→1 platform work, driving cross-team standards, and owning a system end-to-end, this role is built for you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, build, and iterate on the APIs and services that make up the standardized data access layer.

* Own reliability, latency, and operational excellence for a high-throughput, low-latency system on the critical request path.

**Teamwork & Collaboration**

* Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and participate in professional development activities.

**Must Have Skills**


* Experienced Sr Software Engineer with 7+ years of industry experience and strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Futuristic, with the ability to look at the bigger picture and anticipate growing system needs.
* Growth-oriented, looking to increase impact, responsibility, and ownership over time.
* Proven ability to own and drive complex systems end-to-end, with strong knowledge of team-owned services and the ability to collaborate and influence cross-team goals and roadmaps.
* Strong experience writing production Python and Golang code and working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Solid experience in system design and building resilient, scalable applications with an emphasis on operational excellence.
* Detail-driven and cares about code quality, testing, and performance.
* Ability to make practical trade-offs and propose technical solutions, including writing technical design documents and leading their adoption.
* Strong understanding of service health, monitoring, fault tolerance, and incident response practices.
* Strong communication skills and proven ability to work autonomously and asynchronously with remote collaborators and stakeholders.

title: Software Engineer - AI Accelerated Development
description:
**About Signant Health**

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

**Location - Bangalore, Hyderabad OR Noida**

**About The Role**

Signant Health is looking for a Software Engineer – AI Accelerated Development to build AI-powered, agentic features into our clinical trial platforms. Working across the .NET stack, you will take AI capabilities from backend LLM integration through to a usable front-end — designing agents and agentic workflows, not just prompting a model. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who works with agentic tooling every day and wants to ship production AI in a regulated, high-impact environment. We weigh the depth of your AI and agentic build experience more heavily than years of general experience: a developer with one to three years of substantive, hands-on agentic work is exactly the profile we are targeting.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Function**

* 1-4 Years of experience in AI, .NET and Fullstack.
* Design and build AI agents and agentic workflows — tool-use/function calling, multi-step task orchestration, and agent loops — that power Signant Health's clinical trial platforms.
* Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI) into .NET application code, handling authentication, streaming, error handling, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
* Deliver AI features end-to-end, taking them from backend integration through to a usable, production-ready front-end.
* Build custom agents and tools with the Claude Agent SDK, wiring and steering agent loops.
* Author custom skills and slash commands for Claude Code to codify team-specific workflows.
* Implement RAG pipelines and integrate vector stores (e.g. Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone) to ground agent outputs in trusted data.
* Instrument agents for evaluation and observability so their outputs can be verified, measured, and audited.
* Apply AI-specific risk controls appropriate to a regulated clinical environment, addressing hallucination, determinism, and auditability of agent decisions.
* Use Claude Code (or an equivalent agentic CLI) daily as a primary development tool, reviewing and steering AI-generated diffs.

**Knowledge, Skills & Attributes**

**Essential:**

* Full-stack .NET development — C#/ASP.NET Core on the backend paired with a modern front-end framework.
* Hands-on agentic development experience — building AI agents or agentic workflows (tool-use/function calling, multi-step task orchestration, agent loops); not just prompting an LLM, but building systems around one.
* Practical LLM API integration (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI), including authentication, streaming, error handling, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
* Proven full-stack delivery of AI features — able to take an agentic/AI feature from backend integration through to a usable front-end, not just a notebook prototype.
* Daily, hands-on use of Claude Code (or an equivalent agentic CLI) as a primary development tool — comfortable working through multi-step agentic sessions and reviewing and steering AI-generated diffs, rather than occasional autocomplete-style use.
* Prompt engineering — designing and iterating on system prompts as production software contracts, not one-off experiments.
* Python proficiency as the preferred language for AI/agent tooling; comfort with async patterns a plus.
* Evaluation and observability literacy — able to reason about whether an agent's output is correct and instrument it to prove so.

**Desirable:**

* Claude Agent SDK experience — building custom agents, defining tools, and wiring agent loops.
* Working knowledge of agent primitives: hooks (deterministic pre/post-tool-call controls), skills (progressive-disclosure, load-on-demand instructions), subagents/multi-agent delegation, and session/state management.
* Experience authoring custom skills or slash commands for Claude Code to codify team-specific workflows.
* Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) for connecting agents to internal tools and data sources.
* Working knowledge of RAG patterns and vector store integration (e.g. Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone).
* Awareness of AI-specific risk areas relevant to a regulated environment (OWASP LLM Top 10, hallucination/determinism concerns, and auditability of agent decisions).

**Why Signant Health?**

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.

Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: Associate, SW Eng
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Developer to design, build, integrate, and support enterprise solutions using Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, and emerging Microsoft AI technologies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and customize Dynamics 365 solutions using C#, .NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, plug-ins, Web API, custom APIs, and Dataverse.
* Build model-driven Power Apps and automated business processes using Power Apps and Power Automate.
* Develop integrations between Dynamics 365 and enterprise systems using APIs, Azure services, and standard Microsoft integration patterns.
* Build and extend Copilot Studio agents, including actions, topics, connectors, and integrations with enterprise data and processes.
* Apply generative AI and AI capabilities to Dynamics and Power Platform business scenarios.
* Develop Dynamics plug-ins, client extensions, business process flows, and reusable components.
* Configure Dataverse tables, relationships, forms, views, security roles, and solutions.
* Participate in technical design, coding, unit testing, code reviews, deployment, and production support.
* Diagnose and resolve application, integration, data, and performance issues.
* Implement solutions using appropriate ALM, source control, CI/CD, security, and development standards.
* Collaborate with architects, product owners, analysts, and engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

**Required Skills**

* 3–5 years of programming/software engineering experience.
* Hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 development experience.
* Strong knowledge of C#, .NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST/Web APIs, and Dataverse.
* Experience with Power Apps and Power Automate.
* Experience with or strong working knowledge of Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Understanding of generative AI concepts and their application to business applications.
* Experience developing Dynamics plug-ins, integrations, and customizations.
* Familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, and Dynamics/Power Platform ALM.
* Strong debugging, problem-solving, and software engineering skills.

**Preferred**

* Dynamics 365 Sales / Sales Hub experience.
* Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, or Azure integration experience.
* AI Builder or Azure OpenAI experience.
* Experience developing custom connectors or integrating external APIs with Power Platform.
* Microsoft PL-400 Power Platform Developer Associate or equivalent certification.
* Experience working in Agile engineering teams.

**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Bangalore Office**
The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**
We are building a culture of innovators, risk-takers, and imaginative thinkers. To become AI-native, we look for "builders" who use AI and emerging technologies to solve customer problems quickly and well.
  
  
Join The Data Reliability Team As a Senior Staff Software Engineer. Our Mission Is To Make Intuit's Business-critical Data Trusted, Observable, And AI-ready. We Build The Platforms That Measure And Enforce Data Quality, Detect Data And Data Pipeline Failures Early, And Turn Them Into Actionable Alerts & Incidents. Our Work Includes
  
  

* Data Quality Monitoring : Profiling the Data and automate schema based Data Quality checks, execute and calculate Data Quality score, Maturity Score Calculation, and Data Parity validation between each hop of the data lifecycle for critical business use cases covering Lake Tables, Kafka Topics and Data Pipeline health.
* Data Observability and Alert 2 Incident (A2I): a self-serve detect-and-act capability. Owners onboard Tier 1 assets through a UI or an agentic experience, choose pipeline and data quality signals and thresholds, tune them during an observation period, and get paged through automated incidents before downstream users feel the impact. 1500+ Data assets are managed and monitored under this capability.
* Data Observability Dashboard the Intuit-wide command center that gives leaders a single view of Data health. It covers clean-data standards, availability, A2I incident effectiveness, cost and consumption, and the verified or potential business impact of unhealthy data.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader and domain expert across multiple teams, responsible for multiple capabilities of a composite platform. You will apply master-level software engineering to design, build, and run backend systems that process high-volume data and operational signals reliably. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You will typically drive work across multiple scrum teams (15 to 20+ engineers), influence technology and product direction, tactically strong to deal with conflicts and drive alignments to unblock technical direction of the platform capabilities and balance short-term delivery with long-term business impact.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Technical Leadership and Execution
  
  

* Spend 70–85% of your time hands-on across the full software lifecycle: design, build, test, deploy, and operate.
* Architect and build scalable, secure, highly available backend services and APIs that power data quality evaluation, signal detection, incident creation, and impact analysis.
* Drive the next phase of A2I: Lead the evolution of the Data Observability platform. This includes simplifying the overall Platform and coming up with end to end system for intelligently connecting the issues in one hop of the data lifecycle to consolidate the Incident creation and avoid noise across the entire data lifecycle causing churn for all data producers and consumers across the chain.
* Data Observability Dashboard: Create a technical vision for the health observability essentials (logs, traces and metrics) and how to use those to create insightful actionable KPIs for Data Producers and consumers to increase the confidence on the Data Quality and Reliability.
* Build reliable data and event pipelines (Spark, Databricks, Kafka) that feed health, availability, cost, and incident metrics into Data 360 and other leadership views.
* Define the technical strategy, design specifications, and estimates for large, cross-capability initiatives, and manage conflicts and alignments to see them through to delivery.
* Diagnose and resolve complex, cross-system production issues. Lead RCA and drive durable fixes that raise the platform's own reliability and cut noise and false positives.

Domain Expertise & Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Act as the domain authority on Data quality, Observability, and Incident management. Set standards for signal design, SLO and threshold models, alerting hygiene, and detection metrics such as MTTD, MTTR, and false-positive rate.
* Design for the five pillars: Operational excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance efficiency, and Cost optimization.
* Integrate with enterprise systems such as the data catalog and lineage, pipeline platforms, incident management, and paging tools.
* Find opportunities to apply AI in the product, such as anomaly detection, smart threshold recommendation, automated triage, and RCA. Ship AI integrations to production and measure their impact.

Mentorship and Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Raise the technical bar through design reviews, tech talks, and mentoring. Coach and assess engineers, and support calibrations and talent development.
* Partner with product managers, TPMs, designers, data stewards, and platform teams across data, pipeline, and ITSM organizations to align roadmaps and unblock delivery.
* Explain complex architectures and trade-offs clearly to engineers, business partners, and senior leaders, and drive decisions.
* Work effectively with global teams across time zones
* Define principles for the Capability offerings (Incident Management, Platform boundaries etc) to increase the efficiency of the platform operations

**Qualifications**

* 12+ Years of Software Engineering experience delivering enterprise class, high scale backend systems including significant experience in Multi Tenant Data Platforms and Observability.
* Expert in Java and Spring/Spring Boot for building microservices and APIs.
* Experience in Observability Stack Prometheus/Mimir, Splunk, ELK / Grafana
* Experience with Big data and streaming technologies: Spark (batch and streaming), Databricks, and Kafka is a plus.
* Deep experience and expertise with Data observability concepts: monitoring and alerting design, Golden signals, SLOs/SLAs and thresholds, anomaly detection, incident management, and paging workflows.
* Strong knowledge of Data quality and Data reliability: DQ checks, data Parity, Data reconciliation at scale and Data lineage.
* Expertise in Data Mesh concepts, Data warehousing and handling large data volumes.
* Experience building and operating services in the cloud (AWS preferred) using containers and Kubernetes.
* Solid foundation in algorithms, design patterns, and distributed systems design, including scalability, fault tolerance, and idempotency.
* Experience with test automation (TDD, unit, integration, functional, and performance testing) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience using or integrating AI/LLM technologies, including AI-assisted development tools, and evaluating their performance in production.
* Proven ability to lead complex, multi-team technical initiatives and influence without authority.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, product partners, and executives.
* Strategic mindset. Uses data to shape technology and product decisions. Comfortable entering new areas, understanding them quickly, and driving immediate impact.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

.

Join us as we scale a cloud-native platform that runs transformer-based Large Language Models rigorously fine-tuned on millions of clinical notes and claims every month, powering autonomous coding pipelines across ICD-10-CM, CPT®, and HCPCS with sub-second latency and high accuracy.

Role Overview

We are looking for enthusiastic Software Development Engineer Interns who are passionate about software development, backend engineering, and solving real-world technical challenges.

You will work closely with our engineering team to design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems for our healthcare technology platform. The internship will provide hands-on exposure to building APIs, working with databases, understanding distributed systems, and contributing to live product development.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend applications and services.
* Build and maintain RESTful APIs and support seamless integration across different system components.
* Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to develop, manage, and optimize data operations.
* Contribute to backend development using programming languages such as Python, Node.js, or Go.
* Understand and work with microservices-based architectures and distributed systems.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices.
* Debug technical issues, troubleshoot applications, and identify opportunities for performance improvements.
* Participate in code reviews and collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders.

What You'll Learn

* Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-level backend systems.
* Designing and developing APIs and working with microservices architecture.
* Database management, query optimization, and data handling.
* Software engineering best practices, code reviews, and debugging.
* Exposure to cloud technologies, distributed systems, and AI-powered healthcare applications.
* Working in a fast-paced engineering environment alongside experienced developers.

Qualifications

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* **Must be in the final year of graduation/post-graduation.**
* Strong understanding of programming fundamentals and Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA).
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of at least one programming language: Python, Node.js, or Go.
* Understanding of database concepts, including SQL and NoSQL.
* Familiarity with REST APIs and backend development fundamentals.
* Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong willingness to learn, collaborate, and work on real-world engineering challenges.

**Good to have:**

* Familiarity with frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Express.js.
* Exposure to Git, GitHub, Docker, Kafka, or cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Experience with academic, personal, or open-source software development projects.
* Interest in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs).

title: Principal Network Developer
description:
**Job Description**
Designs and develops advanced network systems for scalable enterprise, data center, or cloud-based environments, ensuring alignment with existing infrastructure patterns and collaborating with vendors and internal stakeholders for comprehensive validation. Designs and builds advanced modules within automation frameworks to support testing, operations, and service reliability, automating high-impact network tasks and developing proactive monitoring systems. Designs advanced test strategies and reusable test cases, leading cross-functional collaboration, refining validation methods, and ensuring systems meet compliance and deployment standards. Designs advanced systems for network health monitoring, partners with teams to refine anomaly detection, leads incident response and root cause analysis, and builds efficient tools for frontline support teams. Drives milestone achievements with project managers, mentors junior engineers, leads customer engagements and root cause analysis (RCA) documentation, and ensures integration meets technical standards. Leads network performance analysis to drive scalable improvements and forecasts infrastructure needs for growth.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Network Design, Development, and Validation:**

* Designs and develops advanced network systems that support scalable enterprise, data center, or cloud environments, ensuring alignment with existing infrastructure patterns.
* Validates production networks and develops scaling strategies for diverse and evolving use cases across systems or services.
* Participates in solution architecture discussions, providing technical guidance on network requirements, tradeoffs, and design decisions.
* Identifies and assesses complex risks in network design and recommends mitigation strategies before deployment.
* Collaborates with vendors and internal stakeholders to align on hardware, firmware, software, and cloud network code requirements.
* Designs playbooks for resolving common and uncommon network issues involving moderately complex systems.
* Analyzes network workflows to identify inefficiencies and proposes scalable solutions to improve performance.

**Automation and Scripting:**

* Designs and builds advanced modules within automation frameworks to support testing, operations, and service reliability across multiple environments.
* Automates high-impact network tasks for production and lab environments, and optimizes repetitive, cross-team workflows to improve operational efficiency.
* Develops and maintains advanced dashboards, telemetry tools, and alerting systems to enable proactive monitoring and faster issue resolution.
* Writes, enhances, and documents reusable scripts that streamline routine network operations across teams and product domains.
* Modifies and extends infrastructure pipelines and configuration management tools to meet evolving requirements using existing playbooks and custom logic.
* Independently configures and extends tools to support new products or services, ensuring alignment with platform standards and integration best practices.

**Testing and Quality Assurance:**

* Designs and develops advanced test strategies and reusable test cases that validate complex network systems and enhance long-term network integrity and reliability.
* Leads team-level test practices and cross-functional collaboration, helping define robust testing protocols and ensuring consistency in execution across environments.
* Implements and refines post-incident validation methods, integrating break-fix outcomes and lessons learned into continuous test improvements.
* Reviews and approves L1 and L2 network changes, and presents high-impact changes to cross-team change management boards, ensuring risks are understood and mitigated.
* Partners with cross-functional teams to drive pre-production validation efforts, ensuring systems and environments meet compliance and deployment-readiness criteria.
* Prepares and delivers audit documentation and test evidence to support internal Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes, maintaining alignment with security and policy requirements.

**Monitoring and Reliability:**

* Works with others (e.g. monitoring teams) to customize dashboards, telemetry pipelines, and alerting systems, defining service level objectives (SLOs) based thresholds and metrics to monitor network health.
* Partners with monitoring and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to refine alerting systems and enhance early detection of network anomalies and degradation.
* Leads incident response during support rotations, driving root cause analysis and coordinating cross-team resolution for escalated issues.
* Builds and improves internal tools that enable frontline support teams to efficiently respond to network failures and recurring operational issues.

**Cross-Team Collaboration and Leadership:**

* Drives test and deployment milestones in collaboration with project/program managers, adapting plans to address risks and ensure cross-team alignment.
* Mentors junior engineers and acts as a technical SME, providing hands-on guidance in resolving complex issues.
* Leads customer engagements on technical escalations and delivers clear, actionable root cause analysis (RCA) documentation.
* Influences team-level roadmap and architecture decisions, contributing solutions that align with broader engineering goals.
* Coordinates with vendors and internal teams to resolve standards misalignment, ensuring integration meets technical and operational expectations.

**Performance and Capacity Management:**

* Leads analysis of network performance metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, packet loss) to identify systemic inefficiencies and drive scalable improvements.
* Forecasts infrastructure needs using performance and capacity data, ensuring systems are prepared for anticipated traffic and service growth.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem-solving strategies.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

* Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

**Qualifications**
Career Level - IC4
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

description:
Freelance Technical Support – ML360 Zerodha App Configuration & Troubleshooting (Mac)Company Description

ML360 Educations is an education-focused organization working at the intersection of financial technology, investment analytics, machine learning, and data science. Through its technology-driven initiatives, ML360 develops practical tools and solutions to support financial learning, investment research, and analytics.

Role Description

ML360 Educations is looking for an experienced freelance technical professional who can configure, troubleshoot, and fix the
**ML360 Zerodha App on a Mac machine**
.

The assignment involves setting up the application, resolving existing technical issues, ensuring proper connectivity and functionality, and making the application operational. The selected professional will also provide technical assistance and troubleshooting support for one month after successful configuration.

This is a short-term freelance assignment involving a few hours of initial technical work, followed by one month of remote support.

Key Responsibilities

* Configure and set up the ML360 Zerodha App on a Mac machine.
* Troubleshoot and resolve existing application or installation issues.
* Check compatibility with the macOS environment and required dependencies.
* Verify Zerodha API integration and connectivity, wherever applicable.
* Ensure the application runs smoothly and its essential features work correctly.
* Fix bugs, configuration errors, and other technical issues identified during testing.
* Provide remote technical support for one month after the initial setup.
* Document the configuration steps and any fixes implemented.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Strong experience working with macOS and Mac-based application configuration.
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with Python environments and dependencies.
* Experience with API integration, preferably Zerodha Kite Connect API.
* Knowledge of debugging, troubleshooting, and resolving software compatibility issues.
* Familiarity with Git, terminal commands, package management, and application deployment.
* Prior experience with financial applications, trading platforms, or Zerodha integrations will be an advantage.
* Ability to independently diagnose issues and deliver a working solution.

Engagement Details

* **Engagement Type:**
  Freelance / Short-term Technical Assignment
* **Initial Work:**
  A few hours for configuration, troubleshooting, and testing.
* **Support Period:**
  One month after successful configuration.
* **Work Mode:**
  Remote, with access to a Mac machine as required.
* **Maximum Budget:**
  ₹5,000 (fixed, inclusive of configuration and one-month support).
* **Payment:**
  Upon successful configuration and verification of the application, as mutually agreed.

Ideal Candidate

A Python developer or technical support professional who has hands-on experience with Mac systems, API integrations, and financial technology applications, and can quickly diagnose and resolve application configuration issues.

**Interested candidates can share their relevant experience, previous Zerodha API integration work, and availability.**

title: Management Trainee Program - Sales and Marketing
description:
**Company Description** 
 Chain Reaction Co. (Chain Reaction Consulting) is a dynamic sales and marketing organization specializing in face\-to\-face customer acquisition and brand promotion. The company helps clients grow through innovative direct marketing strategies that drive measurable results. Team members benefit from comprehensive training, mentorship, and clear pathways for career advancement into leadership and management roles. The culture emphasizes performance, leadership, teamwork, and continuous professional growth, offering a fast\-paced environment for driven individuals. This setting is well\-suited for those seeking hands\-on experience and rapid development in business, sales, and marketing.

 The Management Trainee Program is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru. Management Trainees will rotate through key business functions, including sales, marketing, customer service, and basic program management, to gain a broad understanding of operations. Daily responsibilities include engaging with customers face\-to\-face, supporting brand promotion activities, assisting in planning and executing marketing campaigns, and tracking performance metrics under the guidance of senior team members. Trainees will participate in classroom and on\-the\-job training, shadow experienced leaders, contribute to team projects, and prepare reports that support decision\-making and process improvement. The role is designed to build future supervisors and managers who can lead teams, drive results, and uphold the company’s performance and service standards.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Program Management and Training skills to coordinate initiatives, follow structured development plans, and support team learning.
* Strong Communication and Customer Service skills to interact professionally with customers, colleagues, and mentors in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work on\-site in Bengaluru, adapt quickly, and collaborate effectively in a goal\-oriented team setting.
* Demonstrated interest in sales, marketing, or leadership roles, with a willingness to learn and take on increasing responsibility.

title: Core Team – Strategy & Growth
description:
**An Opportunity to Build, Lead & Grow with ComplyPlanet**

**Company:**
ComplyPlanet Private Limited

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)

**Engagement:**
Full-time

About the Opportunity

ComplyPlanet is entering an exciting phase of growth, expanding its presence across technology, data privacy, cybersecurity and regulatory compliance.

We are looking for an ambitious, entrepreneurial and driven individual to join our Core Team – Strategy & Growth and work directly with the Founder & CEO.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to go beyond a conventional corporate career and experience what it takes to build, scale and lead an organisation.

You will be closely involved in strategic decision-making, business development, international expansion, partnerships and organisational growth.

We are particularly interested in MBA graduates with international exposure, a global outlook and a strong desire to build something meaningful.

What You Will Be Doing

**1. Business Strategy & Growth**

* Work closely with the Founder on business strategy and organisational priorities.
* Identify new business opportunities, markets and revenue streams.
* Develop and execute growth strategies.
* Research industry trends, competitors and emerging opportunities.
* Contribute to the company's long-term vision and business planning.

**2. Business Development & International Expansion**

* Develop strategic relationships with clients, partners and industry stakeholders.
* Explore international markets and expansion opportunities.
* Participate in business meetings, negotiations and strategic discussions.
* Drive partnerships and new business initiatives.
* Support the development of new service offerings and business verticals.

**3. Organisational Leadership & Operations**

* Take ownership of key business initiatives and drive them to completion.
* Coordinate with internal teams, consultants and external partners.
* Help establish scalable processes and organisational structures.
* Monitor business performance, operational priorities and execution.
* Participate in management decisions and organisational development.

**4. Entrepreneurship & New Initiatives**

* Explore new business models, products and opportunities.
* Participate in building new business verticals from the ground up.
* Work on strategic projects involving technology, consulting, privacy and cybersecurity.
* Translate ideas into actionable business plans and measurable outcomes.

Who We Are Looking For

* MBA graduates from globally recognised universities and leading business schools, such as Stanford, Oxford, Cambridge, Harvard, the University of Nottingham, INSEAD and London Business School.
* Candidates with outstanding academic credentials, international exposure, demonstrated leadership potential and a strong entrepreneurial mindset will be particularly preferred.
* Individuals who aspire to build and scale a business, take ownership of strategic initiatives and grow into senior leadership roles are especially encouraged to apply.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Interest in technology, consulting, data privacy and cybersecurity.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and navigate ambiguity.
* A global mindset and willingness to work across international markets.

**Most importantly, we are looking for someone who thinks like a builder, takes responsibility like a leader and approaches opportunities with an entrepreneurial mindset.**

What Makes This Opportunity Different?

You will not be joining as just another employee.

You will work directly with the Founder & CEO, participate in important business decisions and contribute to shaping the direction of ComplyPlanet.

You will have the opportunity to:

* Be part of the organisation's core leadership team.
* Take ownership of strategic business functions.
* Build relationships with international clients and partners.
* Develop and lead new business initiatives.
* Grow into senior executive and leadership responsibilities.
* Explore potential long-term equity participation based on performance, contribution and mutual alignment.

Career Growth

We believe in building leaders from within.

The right individual will have the opportunity to progressively take on greater responsibilities, independently lead business functions and potentially grow into an executive leadership or equity-partner position as the organisation scales.

A Note from the Founder

We are at a stage where the next chapter of ComplyPlanet will be shaped by the people who join us today.

We are looking for someone who sees the opportunity in building an organisation from the ground up, is comfortable taking ownership and wants to be part of something beyond a conventional job.

If you have an entrepreneurial mindset, a global outlook and the ambition to build something meaningful, we would like to hear from you.

**Join the Core Team. Help Build the Next Chapter of ComplyPlanet.**

* **ComplyPlanet – Comply with Confidence.**

description:
**Req ID:**
379781
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Data Engineer Sr. Consultant to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
Role Overview
  
  

* The Senior Data Migration Engineer serves as a hands-on technical contributor and delivery anchor, responsible for designing and implementing Python-based extract/load pipelines, dbt-based transformations, and Airflow-based orchestration for a large-scale migration from Informatica PowerCenter to a modern data stack.
* This role requires deep expertise in converting complex Informatica workflows into Python, dbt, and Airflow, and the ability to deliver production-quality, functionally equivalent output at enterprise scale.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Assess complex Informatica workflows including sessions, mappings, and parameterizations and translate them into equivalent Python EL scripts and dbt transformation models.
* Develop and maintain Python EL pipelines to land high-volume data, including billion-row tables, into the target warehouse using SQLAlchemy, cx\_Oracle, pyodbc, and bulk export tools such as Oracle Data Pump and SQL Server BCP.
* Design and develop dbt transformation models based on Informatica mapping logic, incorporating dbt best practices including model layering, macros, incremental strategies, and snapshot patterns.
* Develop dbt-native tests as well as custom Python unit tests to validate transformation correctness and data quality.
* Develop Airflow DAGs to orchestrate Python EL and dbt scripts end-to-end, producing output that is functionally equivalent to the source Informatica workflows.
* Contribute to GitLab CI/CD pipeline for dbt and Airflow code, including lint gates, automated testing, and deployment to shared NAS.
* Perform peer code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to fellow engineers.
* Troubleshoot performance issues and data discrepancies during SIT and UAT, including row-count reconciliation between source Oracle/SQL Server systems and the target warehouse.
* Contribute to technical documentation, runbooks, and handover materials.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of Informatica PowerCenter experience - mappings, sessions, workflows, and parameterization
* 3+ years of hands-on dbt Core experience - model layering, macros, tests, incremental materializations
* Any number of years of Airflow experience - DAG authoring, task dependencies, and incorporation with scheduling tool
* 5+ years of Python experience, including production use of parallelism and batch data processing
* 5+ years of SQL experience - complex joins, window functions, aggregations across large datasets
* Experience with Oracle Data Pump (expdp/impdp) or SQL Server BCP / BULK INSERT for high-volume data movement

**Preferred**

* Experience with SQLAlchemy, cx\_Oracle, or pyodbc for Python-based database connectivity
* Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers in offshore delivery models..

title: STAFF, DATA ENGINEER
description:
**About Team**
GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and operate large-scale batch and streaming data pipelines using Spark, Java, and Python, processing data at Walmart scale.
* Apply strong software engineering fundamentals - clean architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, code review discipline - to data engineering work; this is a software engineering role that specializes in data, not a script-writing role.
* Apply domain-oriented design, system design, and low-level design (LLD) rigor to ambiguous data and platform problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, cost, and long-term durability before writing a line of code.
* Flex into platform/software engineering work when needed: build and maintain services, APIs, and distributed systems that data pipelines depend on, contributing directly to GDF's broader platform codebase.
* Integrate AI, GenAI, and agentic capabilities directly into the data platform: embeddings/vector search for data discovery, LLM-assisted data quality and anomaly detection, agentic pipeline monitoring and self-healing, AI-assisted schema and lineage documentation.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to build feature pipelines, model-serving data paths, and the data infrastructure that MLOps depends on.
* Own data quality, observability, and governance for the pipelines and datasets you build, with a strong Operational Excellence / Engineering Excellence discipline.
* Participate in and lead architecture and design reviews spanning both data engineering and platform engineering domains.
* As a Staff engineer, set technical direction and best practices within your team and technical domain without needing a management title - mentor other engineers and influence GDF's broader data engineering standards.
* Continuously evaluate emerging Big Data, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, adopting them pragmatically where they improve reliability, productivity, or business value.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Genuinely hands-on coding: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with significant hands-on data engineering at scale; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required, and strong working knowledge of Spark for distributed data processing is required, not optional. Additional experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus.
* Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not bolted on afterward.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Deep experience with the Big Data ecosystem - Spark, Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, Kafka, workflow orchestration (Airflow or equivalent) - including batch and streaming processing, and large-scale data transformation.
* Strong data platform fundamentals: data modeling, ETL/ELT pipeline design, data quality and observability, data governance, and integration with lakehouse architectures (e.g., Delta Lake, BigQuery, Databricks).
