title: Staff Streaming/Messaging Infra Engineer
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the Team and the Role**
Join the infrastructure engineering team responsible for building, scaling, and operating eBay’s core messaging and real-time streaming platforms. Our infrastructure powers mission-critical, high-throughput applications across eBay's global ecosystem.

In this role, you will act as a core developer and architect, taking full ownership of both the
**control plane and data plane**
for our distributed streaming platforms—including Apache Flink and Apache Kafka—deployed across multiple private cloud Kubernetes clusters spanning various Availability Zones (AZs) and Data Centers (DCs). You will also play a key role in designing and evolving our next-generation streaming lakehouse storage systems.

**What You'll do**

* Build a cloud-native distributed systems
  **:**
  Design and develop core Streaming components, supporting independent scaling, high availability, and fault tolerance.
* Solve distributed systems challenges
  **:**
  Design and implement replication, consistency, crash recovery, failover, and distributed coordination mechanisms.
* Build Streaming Lakehouses: Lead the design and development of our real-time streaming lakehouse storage architecture, enabling low-latency analytical workloads at massive scale.
* Ensure Operational Excellence: Drive high availability, automated fault recovery, and zero-downtime operations for large-scale production streaming topologies.
* Enhance System Observability: Advance enterprise monitoring, distributed tracing, automated alerting, and failure-diagnosis tooling to maximize platform uptime.
* Collaborate Globally: Partner with cross-functional architecture and platform teams worldwide to shape the future of eBay's real-time data ecosystem.
* Leverage AI-assisted engineering
  **:**
  Use modern AI coding agents to accelerate development, testing, debugging, and validation while maintaining high engineering standards.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **8+ years of experience**
  building production-grade systems software, databases, storage engines, or large-scale distributed systems, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
* Core Distributed Systems Experience: Deep hands-on background in computer science fundamentals (data structures, concurrency, OS internals, and networking) with strong expertise in Java, Rust, or C++.
* Stream Processing Engine Expertise: Strong hands-on experience developing, tuning, and operating Apache Flink at scale (e.g., state backend management, checkpointing tuning, custom operators, Flink Kubernetes Operator).
* Distributed Messaging Deep-Dive: Proven experience with Apache Kafka (or Pulsar/RocketMQ), including core broker architecture, partition strategy, and control/data plane management.
* Container & Multi-Cluster Orchestration: Solid experience running high-throughput stateful workloads on Kubernetes across hybrid or private cloud environments.

**Nice to Have**

* Deep knowledge of embedded storage engines (RocksDB, LevelDB) and memory management.
* Active contributions to open-source projects in the streaming ecosystem (e.g., Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Apache Paimon).

**Why Join Us?**

* Build at hyperscale
  **:**
  Solve challenging distributed systems problems that directly impact eBay's global commerce platform.
* Work on deep systems engineering
  **:**
  Go beyond application development and work on messaging internals, distributed storage, replication, and fault tolerance.
* Shape the architecture
  **:**
  Make meaningful technical contributions to a next-generation cloud-native streaming platform.
* Own what you build
  **:**
  Take projects from architecture and implementation through production deployment and operations.
* Innovate with AI
  **:**
  Explore modern AI-assisted development practices to accelerate complex systems engineering.

**Additional Details**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. title: SENIOR, DATA ENGINEER
description:
Skillset: Python, PySpark, SQLExperience range: 6 to 10 years
  
  
**About The Team**
Walmart’s Corporate Tech and Services is a powerhouse of several exceptional teams delivering world-class technology solutions and services making a profound impact at every level of Walmart.
  
  
As a key part of Walmart Global Tech, our teams set the bar for operational excellence and leverage emerging technology to support millions of customers, associates, and stakeholders worldwide. Each time an associate turns on their laptop, a customer makes a purchase, a new supplier is onboarded, the company closes the books, physical and legal risk is avoided, and when we pay our associates consistently and accurately, that is Corporate Tech. Joining this team means embarking on a journey of limitless growth, relentless innovation, and the chance to set new industry standards that shape the future of Walmart.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
As a Senior Data Engineer on the Post Payment Audit team, you will design, build, and operate scalable data products that improve payment accuracy, identify overpayment and reconciliation opportunities, and help recover value across supplier payment workflows. You will partner with Finance, Audit, Operations, Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams to transform complex invoice, purchase order, receiving, supplier, claims, pricing, and payment data into reliable pipelines, curated datasets, and production-ready analytics foundations.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who combines deep data engineering expertise with strong business problem-solving and practical GenAI enablement skills. You should be comfortable working across messy enterprise data, designing resilient batch, streaming, and CDC workflows, implementing data quality and observability patterns, managing lakehouse-style data products, supporting analytics and machine learning use cases, and making trusted data easier for audit teams and stakeholders to use.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable batch, streaming, and near-real-time data pipelines that support post-payment audit, payment integrity, supplier reconciliation, recovery operations, and finance analytics workflows.
* Create reliable curated datasets, semantic data models, feature-ready tables, and reusable data products from invoice, purchase order, receiving, supplier, claims, pricing, and payment systems.
* Develop robust ELT/ETL and streaming workflows using SQL, Python, PySpark, Apache Flink, DBT, orchestration tools, event streaming platforms, and cloud data platforms, with a focus on maintainability, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Build streaming and change data capture pipelines that support event-time processing, late-arriving data, replayability, idempotency, backfills, and reliable recovery from failures.
* Design and manage lakehouse data products using table formats such as Apache Hudi, Apache Iceberg, or Delta Lake to support ACID transactions, incremental reads, upserts, time travel, and efficient auditability.
* Implement data quality checks, reconciliation controls, schema validation, lineage, monitoring, alerting, and observability practices to ensure trusted and repeatable data outputs.
* Partner with audit operations, finance stakeholders, product managers, data scientists, analysts, and engineers to turn business requirements into production-grade data solutions.
* Support anomaly detection, exception prioritization, audit rules, ML scoring, and GenAI workflows by delivering high-quality source data, feature engineering pipelines, and operational datasets.
* Build data services and automation patterns that help audit teams summarize evidence, triage exceptions, generate investigation context, and reduce repetitive manual review.
* Apply practical GenAI data engineering patterns such as retrieval-ready document stores, embeddings pipelines, vector database integrations, metadata enrichment, and governed knowledge retrieval.
* Optimize large-scale batch and streaming data processing jobs for reliability, freshness, latency, state management, compute efficiency, and downstream usability across enterprise data platforms.
* Perform root-cause analysis on data discrepancies, pipeline failures, reconciliation mismatches, and source-system issues across large and imperfect datasets.

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field with 6+ years of relevant experience; or Master’s degree with 4+ years of relevant experience; or PhD with 3+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with SQL, Python, PySpark, Apache Flink or equivalent stream processing frameworks, and large-scale distributed data processing.
* Experience with DBT or equivalent transformation frameworks, orchestration tools such as Airflow, event streaming platforms such as Kafka or equivalent, and cloud or enterprise data platforms such as BigQuery, Hive, Spark, or similar technologies.
* Experience designing, building, deploying, and supporting production batch and streaming data pipelines, ELT/ETL workflows, data models, and reusable data products.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, partitioning, performance tuning, incremental processing, CDC, schema evolution, data contracts, metadata management, lineage, and lakehouse table formats such as Apache Hudi, Apache Iceberg, or Delta Lake.
* Experience implementing data quality checks, reconciliation logic, validation frameworks, observability, monitoring, alerting, and incident resolution for production batch and streaming pipelines.
* Experience building streaming data solutions with concepts such as event-time processing, stateful transformations, checkpointing, watermarking, exactly-once or effectively-once processing, and replay/backfill strategies.
* Experience working with large structured and semi-structured datasets from multiple source systems, including messy operational data with inconsistent business definitions.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across Finance, Audit, Operations, Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams.

**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer

That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

title: Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer (12 PM â 9 PM)
description:
**What We’re Looking For**
We are on the hunt for a Technical Builder – someone who doesn’t just move data around, but understands how to architect it for impact on Microsoft Fabric. You are a problem-solver who enjoys the “heavy lifting” of untangling complex raw data from many sources and turning it into a reliable, governed, analytics-ready asset in OneLake.
  
  
**Microsoft Fabric is the #1 essential skill for this role.**
Snowflake experience is an added advantage.
  
  
We’re less about ticking boxes and more about whether you’d thrive in this environment:
  
  

* The “Translator” Mindset: Can you sit in a workshop with a business leader, understand their pain points, then design the lakehouse, pipeline or SQL solution that solves them?
* Modern Engineering Passion: Do you get excited about PySpark notebooks, Delta Lake, Git, CI/CD and the shift toward “Analytics Engineering”?
* Architectural Curiosity: Do you enjoy debating medallion layers, Lakehouse vs. Warehouse or Kimball vs. Data Vault to find the right fit for the business’s scale?
* Ownership & Accountability: Do you own your pipelines from design to production, and hold yourself accountable for data quality, SLAs and trust in the numbers?
* Adaptability: Are you comfortable adapting to changing business needs without losing quality?
* The Consultant’s Edge: Do you enjoy working across different domains and helping businesses navigate their data journey?
* The Standard-Setter: Do you enjoy turning what works into repeatable standards, templates and accelerators that make the whole team faster

**The Essentials**

* Experience: 7+ years in Data Engineering on the Microsoft data platform (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Synapse, SQL Server, SSIS, Azure Databricks, Power BI), including 1–2 years of hands-on Microsoft Fabric with at least one production implementation.
* Advanced SQL & Python: Expert SQL (T-SQL and Spark SQL) and strong Python/PySpark for large-scale transformation.
* Hands-on Fabric Setup & Operation: Workspaces, OneLake and shortcuts, Lakehouse and Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks, mirroring, connections, gateways and permissions. You can configure an approved environment and build an end-to-end proof of concept without a separate platform engineer.
* A Proven Builder: Data modelling (Kimball, Data Vault or Inmon) on a medallion architecture, and modern ELT pipelines with incremental loads, CDC, metadata-driven frameworks and monitoring. Strong Delta Lake skills: MERGE, SCD Type 2, partitioning, V-Order, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM and Spark tuning.
* Standards & Frameworks: Proven experience defining data engineering standards, reference architectures and reusable accelerators that other engineers have adopted.
* Governance, Security & DevOps: Workspace roles, OneLake security, row- and column-level security, sensitivity labels, Purview lineage, Git integration, deployment pipelines and CI/CD across Dev / Test / Prod.
* Communication & Teamwork: Run requirement workshops, explain trade-offs in plain language and document clearly, within agile, multidisciplinary teams.
* Working Hours & Location: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM (IST) shift to overlap with global stakeholders.
* Tool-Agnostic Learner: Fabric is our core platform, but you’re eager to learn others, such as Databricks and Google BigQuery, as business needs evolve.

**Nice to Have**

* DP-700 certification: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate.
* Snowflake: Foundational Snowflake engineering, such as SQL, data engineering, semantic views and Cortex (Snowflake’s AI features).
* Real-Time Intelligence: Eventstream, Eventhouse and KQL for streaming and near-real-time analytics.
* Fabric migrations: Moving workloads from Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, SSIS or on-premises SQL Server to Fabric.
* dbt: Building tested, documented transformation models.
* Capacity, cost & observability: The Fabric Capacity Metrics app, data quality frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations) and pipeline alerting.
* AI-ready data: Fabric Data Science, Copilot in Fabric, or preparing data for ML models and AI agents.
* Sales collateral: Solution one-pagers, case studies and pitch decks that show the value of data solutions to clients and prospects.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own Microsoft Fabric engineering standards & best practices (an essential part of the role): Develop, document and continuously improve enterprise data engineering standards and architectural patterns for Fabric, with complementary Snowflake expertise, including:
* Frameworks & guidelines: Reference architectures, ingestion and transformation patterns, medallion and semantic modelling standards, performance optimisation, and security and governance best practices.
* Accelerators & templates: Reusable accelerators, deployment templates, automation scripts and reference implementations that speed up client delivery.
* Demos & proofs of value: Demonstrations, POCs and proofs of value that promote engineering excellence, consistency and scalability across the organisation's data platform solutions.
* Be the Fabric release champion: Be the point person for new Fabric, OneLake and AI-enabled data engineering capabilities: track GA vs. preview, assess capacity and tenant impact, and advise on what to adopt.
* Discover and translate: Run stakeholder workshops and turn requirements into scalable data solutions.
* Architect and build: Design medallion Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions in OneLake, ingesting from databases, APIs, files and SaaS apps with the right pattern (pipelines, shortcuts, mirroring or streaming).
* Transform and model: Turn raw data into clean, well-tested datasets with PySpark and SQL (dbt where applicable), and design dimensional models for analytics and reporting.
* Serve analytics-ready data: Deliver trusted, well-documented Gold-layer and semantic-ready datasets for Power BI (including Direct Lake) and self-service users.
* Ensure quality and performance: Implement data tests, monitoring and alerting, and optimise Delta tables, Spark jobs and capacity usage.
* Own production: Take accountability for pipeline SLAs, troubleshoot failures quickly, find root causes and prevent repeat issues.
* Collaborate across disciplines: Work with BI, Cloud and AI/ML engineers to deliver end-to-end data products.

**Perks & Benefits**
Your work matters—and so do you. That’s why we back your skills with a structure that supports your development, celebrates your wins, and helps you keep growing – professionally and personally.
  
  
**Here’s What’s Waiting For You**

* Articulate – our public speaking & communication program.
* Mentoring Program – with a Senior Support Lead.
* 360° Progress Reviews – honest feedback, not fluff.
* Guilds & Weekly Training – learn from your peers.
* Paid Certifications – across all major technologies.
* Hackathons & Innovation Days – challenge yourself, build cool stuff.
* Kudos & Recognition Programs – great work doesn’t go unnoticed.
* Socials & Team Days – team building days and regular team events.

**Final Word**

* If you're looking for the place where your growth will go into overdrive, where you'll work with great humans, get access to cutting-edge tools and genuinely enjoy the ride?

Skills:- Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python, Data modeling, Delta Lake, Lakehouse, OneLake, PySpark, Azure Data Factory, CI/CD and ETL

title: Lead AI Engineer - Generative AI & Agentic AI: Cogentiq
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
  
  
*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced
**Lead AI Engineer - Generative AI & Agentic AI**
to design, build and productionize enterprise-scale AI solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs and modern AI architecture.

**experimentation to production**
, working across models, data, APIs, cloud infrastructure and enterprise applications, while providing technical leadership to engineering teams.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Architect, build and productionize AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for complex enterprise use cases.
* Design and develop LLM-powered applications using RAG, AI agents, tool/function calling, orchestration and multi-agent workflows.
* Build scalable AI services and backend applications using Python, REST APIs and modern microservices architectures.

* Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks and technologies and translate them into practical enterprise solutions.
* Drive technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions across AI platforms and products.
* Establish engineering best practices for building secure, scalable and maintainable AI applications.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across AI engineering initiatives.
* Partner with product managers, data scientists, architects and business stakeholders to convert business problems into scalable AI solutions.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering or related technology roles.
* Strong hands-on development experience in Python, with excellent software engineering and system-design fundamentals.
* Strong understanding of Machine Learning, Generative AI and Large Language Models.
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM applications into production.
* Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, LLM orchestration and AI agents.
* Experience designing agentic AI workflows, including tool/function calling and complex or multi-agent orchestration.
* Experience working with at least one major LLM ecosystem such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, databases and enterprise application architecture.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Experience with LLM evaluation, monitoring, observability, responsible AI and guardrails.
* Ability to independently own the technical architecture and implementation of complex AI solutions.
* Strong problem-solving, communication and technical leadership skills.
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing engineering/architecture decisions.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic layers or GraphRAG.
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, CI/CD and AI observability platforms.
* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Redis or equivalent.
* Experience with fine-tuning, model adaptation and open-source LLMs.
* Experience with AI security, governance, privacy and enterprise AI architecture.
* Hands-on exposure to PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or similar frameworks.
* Experience leading small engineering teams or mentoring senior engineers.
* Understanding of data engineering, streaming, distributed data processing and modern cloud data platforms.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related quantitative/technical discipline.
* Strong academic background, preferably from a premier engineering/technology institution with a demonstrated record of academic and technical excellence.

What Will Make You Stand Out
  
  
We are particularly interested in engineers who can demonstrate that they have
**personally architected and built production GenAI systems**
, rather than simply experimented with LLMs.
  
  
Strong candidates will be able to discuss real-world experience around:
  
  

* Production RAG and Agentic AI architectures
* Building scalable Python/API-based AI services
* LLM evaluation and observability
* Enterprise data and application integration
* Security and guardrails
* Latency and inference-cost optimization
* Taking an AI solution from prototype → production → scale

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
  
  
Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking
*Introduce Yourself*

title: Senior AI Engineer - Enterprise Agentic Systems
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join Rubrik's Applied AI Apps org, building production-grade, full-stack applications and APIs for our internal Business teams while embedding AI-agentified capabilities into these internal platforms. This is a hands-on build role: you will own features end to end from database schema through backend services and distributed systems to the user interface and bring practical, hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents, tool-calling workflows along with the right AI evals or LLM-powered features into production systems that our business stakeholders rely on.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering fundamentals with a systems mindset for reliability and scale, and has spent meaningful hands-on time (1–2 years) building AI-agentified applications not just experimenting with AI tools, but shipping agentic features in production. We are targeting 8+ years of overall software engineering experience; this is flexible for candidates who demonstrate strong depth across full-stack, distributed systems, and applied AI engineering skills during technical evaluation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build and productionize agentic workflows, LLM-powered automation, and AI-assisted tooling having hands-on experience with these systems.
* Design and build end-to-end agent evaluation frameworks that measure correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate, including synthetic test environments that stress-test agents built on Google ADK and Google AI/ML services (Vertex AI, Gemini) under diverse real-world conditions.
* Curate golden datasets and test harnesses for our Rubrik enterprise use cases and contribute to an eval-as-a-service platform that IT teams can self-serve against standard and custom benchmarks.
* Automate regression and drift detection with CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployments
* Architect for distributed systems concerns: scalability, fault tolerance, data consistency, and service boundaries across backend and data layers.
* Build full-stack web applications and own features end to end be it database schema, backend services, APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and webhooks), and frontend (React/Next.js) user interface
* Design and build APIs and services that are consumed by applications, internal tools, and AI agents/LLMs, including tool-calling interfaces
* Apply reliability engineering practices — observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, incident response, and post-incident reviews — to keep production systems healthy.
* Clarify requirements upfront, surface blockers early, and communicate progress proactively without being asked.

Telence Solutions is a multi-vendor network engineering, cybersecurity and AI operations partner for service providers and mission-critical industries. * Own the architecture of new products from scaffolding to production, including tech stack selection and architecture decision records

* Lead, mentor and review the work of distributed engineering and data teams, and agree roadmaps with product managers and architects across time zones
* Write reference architectures, runbooks and decision records, and present them to technical and non-technical audiences

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Experience: 10+ years in software engineering, including several years as an architect or technical lead delivering products from scratch
* Languages: JavaScript and TypeScript on Node.js; familiarity with Java
* Backend and APIs: Express, NestJS, GraphQL (fragments, directives, subscriptions), REST and WebSockets
* Cloud: hands-on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, SageMaker, Bedrock, OpenSearch, DynamoDB, S3, ECS/EKS) and Azure (Functions, DevOps)

* Data: Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB and DynamoDB, including ACID, CAP, replication and sharding
* Architecture patterns: microservices, DDD, CQRS, event sourcing, serverless and twelve-factor
* DevOps: Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines
* Front end: React (hooks, Redux), React Native and Next.js
* Communication: clear documentation and experience leading distributed teams

**CERTIFICATIONS**

* Preferred: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
* Valued: Apollo GraphQL Professional

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Real-time systems with WebSockets and WebRTC
* IoT data integration
* Regulated domains such as healthcare (HIPAA compliance)
* Computer vision with TensorFlow or OpenCV

Telence Solutions is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
description:
Content Creation, Content Marketing, Creative Content Production, Design, Digital Marketing, Social Media, Social Media Marketing
  
  
**Remote | Full-Time | Eastern Time Availability | C$12,000 Annually**
Royal York Property Management is looking for a creative and highly organized professional to produce marketing content for residential rental properties.
  
  
You will take property details, photographs, and video clips and turn them into polished listings, improved images, virtually furnished rooms, and short videos that help available properties stand out.
  
  
This is a hands-on production position. It is not a senior marketing-strategy, social-media-management, or paid-advertising role.
  
  
Your Work
  
  
Property Positioning and Listings
  
  
You will identify each property’s strongest selling points, write engaging titles and descriptions, and publish accurate listings across approved rental websites and online platforms.
  
  
You will adjust content to meet different platform requirements and keep prices, availability, photographs, and property details current.
  
  
Photography and AI Editing
  
  
You will select the strongest property photographs and complete light editing such as cropping, resizing, lighting improvements, and appropriate cleanup.
  
  
When needed, you will use AI tools to remove temporary clutter or virtually furnish empty rooms.
  
  
AI may improve the presentation, but it must never change permanent property features, room dimensions, layouts, or amenities.
  
  
Short-Form Video Content
  
  
You will create short property videos using photographs and video clips.
  
  
You may also create AI-assisted content using presenters, avatars, or voiceovers.
  
  
**Tools May Include**

* Canva
* CapCut
* HeyGen
* AI virtual-staging platforms
* AI object-removal tools
* Comparable image and video applications

You will be responsible for reviewing AI-generated content and correcting visual, factual, pronunciation, or branding errors before publication.
  
  
Organization and Quality Control
  
  
You may manage content for several properties at the same time.
  
  
**You Will Need To**

* Track every active listing and its current status
* Complete urgent price and availability corrections
* Remove or update properties that are no longer available
* Manage competing deadlines
* Identify missing information or materials
* Coordinate with Royal York’s leasing and property-management teams
* Respond professionally to feedback and complete revisions promptly

What You Should Bring
  
  
**We Are Looking For Someone With**

* Two to three years of experience in digital marketing, content creation, online listings, real-estate marketing, marketplace content, or a comparable field
* Experience producing online listings, graphics, edited photographs, or short videos
* Strong writing skills and the ability to identify a property’s strongest selling points
* Experience with Canva, CapCut, or comparable editing tools
* Experience using AI for photo editing, object removal, virtual furnishing, or virtual staging
* Experience with HeyGen or another AI presenter, avatar, voice, or video-generation tool
* Strong creative and visual judgment
* Excellent organization and attention to detail
* The ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines
* The ability to receive feedback and revise work without becoming defensive
* Strong written and spoken English
* The ability to work independently
* Reliable internet, a suitable computer, and a professional remote-work environment
* Full-time availability with regular overlap during Eastern Time business hours

Candidates with less experience may be considered when their portfolio demonstrates strong ability.
  
  
Experience in residential leasing, property management, PropTech, real estate, or property-listing platforms is preferred but not required.
  
  
A Bachelor’s degree is not required. Your demonstrated ability, relevant experience, and portfolio quality are more important.
  
  
**You’ll Do Well Here If You Are**

* Creative without sacrificing accuracy
* Organized enough to manage repetitive, high-volume work
* Comfortable improving imperfect source material
* Curious about new AI and editing tools
* Careful not to create misleading property content
* Responsive to deadlines and feedback
* Able to work without constant supervision

How to Apply
  
  
Submit your résumé and an accessible portfolio or work-sample link.
  
  
Your portfolio must include examples from at least two of these areas:
  
  

* Graphics or edited photographs
* AI-edited or virtually furnished rooms
* Short-form videos
* AI-generated presenter or voice content

The link must work without a password or access request.
  
  
Candidates whose experience and portfolio align with the position will receive an email invitation to complete a short pre-recorded video interview.

title: Research Engineer (Process)
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Process & Chemical Engineer to lead the development, assessment, and scale-up of advanced treatment solutions for complex water, wastewater, and industrial effluents. The role combines deep chemical engineering fundamentals with strong process engineering capabilities to design, validate, and deploy innovative treatment solutions across physico-chemical, biological, thermal, membrane, and electrochemical domains.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for conducting detailed treatability studies, developing integrated flowsheets, and implementing pilot- and field-scale systems for diverse industrial sectors including petrochemicals, refineries, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and heavy manufacturing. The role requires a strong grasp of contaminant behaviour, reaction engineering, separation processes, and system optimization. The candidate will work across laboratory testing, simulation, bench-scale experimentation, and on-site troubleshooting to deliver high-value treatment strategies. Close collaboration with chemical, biological, thermal, desalination, and digital teams is essential to ensure end-to-end technology development and deployment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end treatability studies covering characterization, experimental design, optimization, and performance validation of water, wastewater, and industrial effluents.
* Develop integrated flow sheets using physico-chemical, chemical, biological, electro-chemical, membrane, and thermal processes based on effluent characteristics.
* Conduct lab-scale and pilot-scale experiments, analyze results, and refine process conditions for scale-up.
* Simulate and model processes using tools such as ASPEN Plus, HYSYS, GPS-X, or equivalent to support design and optimization.
* Work closely with technologists, mechanical engineers, and field teams to translate laboratory findings into deployable pilot systems and field-scale implementations.
* Evaluate external technologies (both mature and early-stage innovations) and assess their applicability, differentiation, and integration potential.
* Support ZLD, high-TDS effluent treatment, and industrial sludge management programs, including development of novel chemical/physical treatment strategies.
* Generate mass balance, energy balance, and kinetic models to inform design and scale-up decisions.
* Assist in techno-economic analyses, benchmarking, cost estimation, and feasibility assessments for treatment technologies.
* Prepare detailed engineering documents, SOPs, experimental logs, and technical reports for internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaborate with digital teams to incorporate data analytics, process monitoring, and modelling improvements.
* Contribute to publications, patents, and standardization initiatives emerging from successful R&D programs.
* Provide field troubleshooting support for treatment failures, optimization needs, or performance deviations at customer plants.

**Qualifications**

* Education: PhD or M.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Biotechnology, Industrial Chemistry, or related disciplines.
* Experience: ~10 years total, with a minimum of 5 years in water, wastewater, or industrial effluent treatment.
* Strong knowledge of reaction engineering, separation processes, mass transfer, and water chemistry.
* Experience with lab-scale experimentation, pilot testing, and field implementation.
* Familiarity with process simulation tools (ASPEN, HYSYS, GPS-X, BioWin, or equivalent).
* Publications: Minimum 3–5 publications in peer-reviewed journals; patents or book chapters preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work with cross-functional R&D teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Location**
Water Technology Centre, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu

title: Software Dev Engineer
description:
**Description**
Amazon Customer Service (CS) is hiring a Software Development Engineer II to join the Associate Experience team. Our organization is at the forefront of customer experience — seeking to delight our customers in every interaction they have, whether through self-serve technology and tools (e.g., chatbots), or by interacting directly with our Customer Service Associates (CSA).
  
  
Customer Service works to offer effective, empathetic, and efficient issue resolution when our customers need us, and we are also champions of driving defects out of customer experiences across the entire company, relentlessly advocating on behalf of customers and keeping them at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer II on this team, you will design, develop, and own comprehensive customer engagement services and solutions that anticipate and resolve customer questions at global scale. You will partner with cross-functional teams to drive technical strategy and improvements to our technology platform, owning systems that power the ultimate customer service experience. You will also contribute to engineering best practices and mentor junior engineers on the team. You should be somebody who thrives on solving difficult technical problems, designing scalable solutions, and feels strongly about building reliable software with a customer-centric mindset.
  
  
We use Scrum, test-driven development, and continuous deployment to deliver projects by making effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources. If you are results-oriented, data-driven, and passionate about creating innovative customer experiences through technology, we would love to connect with you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design, develop, and own software services and tools that solve difficult business and operational problems, delivering with a focus on simplicity and scalability
  
  
Optimize and enhance existing systems for performance, reliability, and maintainability at Amazon scale
  
  
Make informed technical decisions on system design, technology selection, and problem-solving approaches with limited guidance
  
  
Identify and mitigate technical risks early in the development lifecycle, escalating when appropriate
  
  
Partner with engineers and cross-functional teams to contribute to design reviews, align on technical direction, and drive improvements across team boundaries
  
  
Make effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to deliver high-quality results within project timelines
  
  
Track, analyze, and act on key metrics to optimize system performance and drive continuous improvement
  
  
Identify and implement engineering process improvements, contributing to operational excellence and best practices across the team
  
  
Mentor junior engineers by providing technical guidance, conducting code reviews, and fostering a culture of learning and high standards
  
  
Write clear technical documentation, including design documents and operational runbooks, to support system ownership and team knowledge sharing
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer II on the Associate Experience team, no two days look exactly the same — but each one centers on building technology that makes a real difference for Customer Service Associates (CSAs) and the customers they serve. You might start your morning reviewing metrics from a recent deployment, analyzing how a feature you own is performing at scale and identifying areas for optimization. Then you could be deep in a design review with your team, debating trade-offs between approaches for a new generative AI-powered automation feature. After that, you shift to hands-on coding — writing, testing, and shipping production-quality code using test-driven development and continuous deployment practices. Throughout the day, you collaborate with product managers and other SDEs to shape technical direction and translate customer needs into scalable solutions. You also make time to review pull requests from teammates and mentor junior engineers on best practices. Some days involve investigating and resolving production issues, making quick decisions to mitigate risks and keep systems running reliably. By end of day, you have contributed meaningfully to services that touch millions of customer interactions worldwide.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Associate Experience team develops products to support Amazon's Customer Service Associates (CSAs) in delivering seamless customer service. Our mission is to empower CSAs with intelligent solutions — powered by generative AI, machine learning, and automation — that anticipate customer needs and accelerate issue resolution at global scale. We build AI assistants, contact automation, and real-time insight tools that reduce CSA effort and improve the customer experience with every interaction. Our team values innovation, ownership, and collaboration, and you will have the opportunity to work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about using cutting-edge technology to make a meaningful impact on how millions of customers experience Amazon support.

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like
  
  
**what we’re saying, keep reading!**
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will act as a technical authority across one or more Product Areas, guiding the direction of our Azure-based SaaS platform and Site Reliability strategy. You will lead complex initiatives related to platform reliability, observability, onboarding automation, and incident response across product boundaries, while advancing our overall cloud capability.
  
  
This role goes beyond hands-on engineering. You will play a key architectural and leadership role in designing scalable systems, mentoring senior engineers, and shaping our Azure governance models. With deep expertise in SRE and ITIL practices, you will elevate platform resilience and client experience across both onboarding and ongoing operations.
  
  
Your impact will be felt across departments, helping SimCorp become a fully cloud-native SaaS provider with high-performing, secure, and automated service delivery.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Act as the technical lead on SRE initiatives across multiple Product Areas
* Drive forward our strategic use of Microsoft Azure in onboarding and site reliability disciplines
* Architect scalable, secure, and automated solutions for client onboarding and live operations
* Lead the design and evolution of cross-cutting platform capabilities (e.g., observability, CI/CD pipelines, IaC standards, DR frameworks)
* Shape and govern Azure implementation patterns to ensure platform standardization, reliability, and cost-efficiency
* Solve the most complex and business-critical reliability challenges involving distributed cloud systems
* Advise engineering leads and product owners on cloud platform decisions, including trade-offs and risk mitigation
* Collaborate with Information Security, Platform Engineering, and Architecture teams on compliance and cloud controls
* Guide the definition of SLOs, SLIs, and other reliability metrics across departments
* Lead root cause analysis, major incident postmortems, and reliability retrospectives across teams
* Provide thought leadership, mentoring, and coaching to senior and lead engineers
* Build communities of practice to strengthen SRE principles and knowledge sharing within the organization
* Represent the SRE function in executive-level planning, roadmap definition, and technical due diligence
* Contribute to SimCorp’s overall transformation into a SaaS-first, cloud-native company
* You share our values: Caring, Customer Success Driven, Collaboration, Curious, Courageous

**What We Value**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or Platform Architecture roles
* Extensive expertise in Microsoft Azure, including architecture, deployment, automation, and cost optimization
* Strong grasp of cloud-native and hybrid architectures, distributed systems, networking, and security
* Mastery in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, ARM, Bicep, and related tooling
* Deep knowledge of observability stacks (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Grafana, Application Insights)
* Experience leading complex incident and problem management efforts at scale
* Broad technical skillset including Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, SQL, APIs, and scripting
* Strong foundation in ITIL processes with a strategic mindset for operational excellence
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead through ambiguity, and align engineering with business needs
* Experience working in or guiding teams within regulated, security-conscious environments (e.g., financial services)
* Demonstrated passion for mentorship, knowledge sharing, and building engineering culture
* Ability to think strategically while delivering pragmatic, hands-on solutions

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
* Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually
**. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.**
At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
For any questions you are welcome to contact
**Shweta Goyal (Shweta.goyal@simcorp.com)**
, Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

a career where ambition meets innovation?
  
  
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

is a hands-on technical role focused on designing, implementing, and enhancing automation solutions across enterprise storage and cloud environments. * Ability to work independently and a part of a global team.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and skills quickly.
* Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to solve complex issues

**If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic overachievers, you’ll enjoy**

* Experience with enterprise tools such as Solarwinds, Dynatrace, ServiceNow,Jira.
* Experience automating storage and data services in AWS, including EBS, EFS, S3, Glacier, Storage Gateway
* Familiarity with enterprise backup and recovery solutions such as Cohesity
* Exposure to CI/CD tooling and configuration management, including GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Atlassian tools and JSON, YAML, Puppet, Ansible, Terraform, CloudFormation

* Ability to understand and work across diverse storage and backup technologies

title: DevOps engineer (AWS Networking & Security) IRC307662
description:
**Description**
The Client is one of the majour insurance companies in the UK.
  
  
This role supports a high-priority risk reduction programme for the MyCro Platform, a complex technology estate built on AWS. Platform SMEs have already designed remediation plans and started putting them into effect. The DevOps engineer we’re looking for will lock down subnet-level access to internal OpenSearch indexes and reconfigure the platform’s VPC and subnet design so egress from hosted Lambda functions and ECS clusters can be controlled. These are complex, platform-wide network changes that must be delivered with zero downtime. You will join a new squad led by a Platform SME.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Essential experience**

* Deep, hands-on AWS networking: VPC and subnet design, routing, security groups
* Delivering network re-architecture on live production platforms with zero downtime
* Controlling egress for serverless and container workloads
* Securing data stores at the network layer

**Technologies and tools**

* Networking: Amazon VPC, subnets, route tables, NAT gateways, Internet gateways, Transit Gateway (if in use)
* Network security: Security groups, network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall
* Private connectivity: VPC endpoints (gateway and interface / PrivateLink)
* Data stores: Amazon OpenSearch Service (VPC domains, access policies)
* Workloads: AWS Lambda (VPC-attached), Amazon ECS (awsvpc networking)
* Observability: VPC Flow Logs, Reachability Analyzer, CloudWatch
* Infrastructure as code: AWS CloudFormation and/or AWS CDK, or Terraform

**Desirable**

* Amazon OpenSearch Service security configuration
* AWS Network Firewall or equivalent egress filtering
* AWS certification (e.g. Advanced Networking – Specialty)

Job responsibilities
  
  
  

* Restrict network access to internal Amazon OpenSearch domains using VPC placement, security groups and access policies
* Redesign VPC and subnet layout so Lambda and ECS workloads route through controlled egress points
* Implement egress controls such as NAT gateways, AWS Network Firewall, VPC endpoints (PrivateLink) and route table changes, per the agreed design
* Tighten security groups and network ACLs to least privilege
* Plan and execute zero-downtime migrations: staged cutovers, traffic validation, tested rollback
* Use VPC Flow Logs and Reachability Analyzer to baseline traffic before change and verify it after
* Deliver all network changes as infrastructure as code with peer review
* Produce network diagrams and runbooks for the platform team

What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Senior Principal - SRE Principal, Automation & Toil Reduction
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The SRE Principal, Automation & Toil Reduction leads the engineering of automation that removes repetitive operational work and improves the reliability, resilience and efficiency of GSK platforms. The role acts as a hands-on principal SRE, shaping reusable automation patterns, enabling safe autonomous operations and embedding measurable toil reduction across platform domains.
  
  
The role sits in Reliability Engineering & Operations and works across platform domains through a hub-and-spoke model. It owns the enterprise approach for identifying, baselining and prioritising toil, and converts high-value candidates into production-grade automation for diagnostics, remediation, recovery, fulfilment and compliance workflows. Platform build direction remains with Principal Engineers and Engineering Directors, major incident command remains with the Major Incident Manager, and the central reliability and automation standard is set by the Reliability Engineering Senior Director. Automation outcomes and priorities are agreed jointly with Platform Managers and Product Owners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and evolve the enterprise SRE automation and toil-reduction strategy, roadmap, reference patterns and engineering standards.
* Establish a consistent toil taxonomy and measurement approach using operational data, service-management evidence, task frequency, effort, risk and business impact.
* Prioritise automation candidates by hours avoided, repeatability, reliability risk, human-error exposure, control value, delivery complexity and reuse potential.
* Design and build secure, reusable automation for provisioning, diagnostics, incident triage, remediation, recovery, capacity, patching, service requests and compliance evidence.
* Create APIs, event-driven integrations, workflows, infrastructure-as-code modules, runbook automation and self-service capabilities rather than isolated scripts.
* Engineer closed-loop and AI-assisted operations with strong telemetry, policy controls, confidence thresholds, auditability and human approval for higher-risk actions.
* Establish production guardrails covering identity, least privilege, secrets, testing, change integration, release, rollback, failure containment and support ownership.
* Instrument automation to measure success, failure, latency, coverage, adoption, exceptions, cost and reliability impact end to end.
* Integrate automation with observability, ITSM, CI/CD, configuration, orchestration and knowledge platforms to reduce hand-offs and context switching.
* Use incident, problem and post-incident evidence to identify recurring failure modes and convert them into permanent engineering fixes or automated prevention.
* Partner with service and platform owners to define SLOs for automation-enabled services and use error-budget and risk evidence to prioritise reliability work.
* Lead technical design reviews for high-impact automation and prevent unsafe, brittle or low-value automation from becoming operational debt.
* Coach engineers, publish reusable patterns and grow an automation community of practice across internal and supplier teams.
* Provide technical oversight of supplier-delivered automation and ensure GSK retains maintainable code, documentation, telemetry, security evidence and knowledge.
* Track outcomes including toil ratio, capacity returned, automation adoption, cycle time, repeat incidents, MTTR, human-error reduction and control effectiveness.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience, such as Computer Science or Software Engineering.
* Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE, security, IT service management or automation certifications are desirable.

**Area of Specialisation**

* Site reliability engineering, toil management and operations automation at enterprise scale.
* Software engineering for production operations, including APIs, event-driven integration, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, testing and observability.
* AIOps and safe autonomous operations, including anomaly detection, decision support and governed remediation.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical engineering experience.
* Typically 8 or more years of experience in software, platform, infrastructure or reliability engineering, with substantial hands-on ownership of production services and automation.
* Demonstrated experience converting recurring operational work into reliable, reusable automation with measurable adoption and benefits.
* Advanced programming and automation engineering using Python or an equivalent language, including
* APIs, testing, packaging, error handling and secure coding.
* Deep coding or scripting capability, plus practical experience with APIs, source control, automated testing and CI/CD.
* Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code, configuration management or enterprise orchestration.
* Experience instrumenting distributed systems and automation workflows using metrics, logs, traces and events.
* Experience applying SRE practices including SLOs, error budgets, incident management, postmortems, resilience and toil reduction.
* Experience designing safe production automation controls for access, secrets, approvals, change, rollback, audit and ongoing support.
* Experience leading technical design across multiple teams, mentoring experienced engineers and influencing without formal authority.
* Platform engineering depth in at least one domain such as cloud, hosting, networks, containers, databases or digital workplace.

**Desirable requirements:**

* Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE, security, IT service management or automation certifications.
* Experience with AIOps, generative AI or agentic operations, including evaluation, confidence thresholds, guardrails and human-in-the-loop approval.
* Experience creating self-service platforms, service catalogues, golden paths or reusable automation products.
* Experience with chaos engineering, game days, automated recovery testing, progressive delivery and pre-change or post-change validation.
* Experience integrating observability, ITSM, CMDB, CI/CD and orchestration platforms to reduce operational hand-offs.
* Experience operating in a global, multi-supplier environment and assuring supplier-delivered code, documentation, telemetry and knowledge transfer.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare or another regulated industry, including GxP or validated systems.
* Experience measuring capacity returned, repeat-incident reduction, automation execution success, exception rates, control effectiveness and reuse.

**Skills/Background**

* Principal-level judgement to distinguish genuine toil from valuable engineering work and to know when simplification is better than automation.
* Ability to influence platform, product, operations, security, quality and supplier teams without formal authority.
* Product mindset for automation, including users, SLOs, ownership, documentation, lifecycle, support and decommissioning.
* Composure during live incidents and discipline to convert restored service into permanent prevention.
* Ability to explain complex technical decisions to engineers and senior stakeholders in outcome-oriented language.
* Commitment to automate work away rather than becoming indispensable to recurring manual activity.
* Learning mindset toward evolving AIOps, agentic automation and platform engineering practices, without adopting technology ahead of control maturity.

**Preferred Skills**

* Production-grade software engineering in Python (or equivalent): APIs, testing, packaging, error handling and secure coding, with 8+ years of hands-on production ownership
* Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and orchestration with CI/CD: Terraform/Ansible, event-driven integrations, automated testing, release and rollback
* SRE practices: SLOs, error budgets, incident management and postmortems, converting recurring failure modes into permanent engineering fixes
* Toil identification and measurable automation: baselining, prioritising by hours avoided, risk and reuse, and evidencing adoption and capacity returned
* Safe production automation controls: least privilege, secrets management, approvals, change integration, audit trail, rollback and failure containment
* Observability and instrumentation of distributed systems and automation workflows: metrics, logs, traces and events
* Platform engineering depth in at least one domain (cloud, hosting, network, containers, databases or digital workplace) plus technical leadership: design reviews, mentoring and influence without authority

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
Automation, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Configuration Management (CM), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), Disaster Recovery (DR), Financial Operations, Identity Access Management (IAM), Incident Management, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Operating Systems (OS), Performance Tuning, Python (Programming Language), Scripting, Software Engineering, SRE Observability, System Monitors, Vulnerability Management
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. title: Plumbing Design Engineer
description:
About us

Raywell Technologies is an MEP engineering and BIM services firm based in Ahmedabad. We deliver engineering design for US consulting firms on commercial, institutional and multifamily buildings. Our East Coast work is growing and we are adding engineers who can carry the design, not just the model.

The role

You will own the plumbing and fire protection engineering on US projects, from system sizing and code analysis through construction documents and construction administration, working with and reviewed by US licensed engineers. We are looking for someone who can size a system from first principles and knows which code governs where.

What you'll do

•    Size domestic cold and hot water systems using fixture units and pressure-loss calculations, and size water heaters, recirculation and booster pumps

•    Design and size sanitary, vent and storm drainage systems, including roof drains and secondary overflow

•    Size natural gas piping, and design grease interceptors and other special waste systems

•    Apply the IPC and UPC, the Florida Building Code – Plumbing, the NYC Plumbing Code and other local amendments, and identify the governing code for each project

•    Establish occupancy hazard classifications and design sprinkler systems to NFPA 13, standpipes to NFPA 14 and fire pumps to NFPA 20

**Wind Turbine Generator (WTG)**
**:**
Adani Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) is a leading player in the renewable energy sector, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of high-performance wind turbine systems. With a commitment to sustainability, Adani WTGs deliver efficient and reliable energy solutions, contributing to clean power generation across global markets.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Lead - Electrical drives the design, integration, and validation of turbine electrical systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, and compliance with industry standards. The role focuses on SCADA integration, subsystem validation, thermal management, and power quality optimization, addressing compatibility challenges and ensuring efficient load distribution. It leads the testing and maintenance of critical components like converters, transformers, and generators to align with performance goals. The role supports field operations, conducts root cause analyses for subsystem failures, and implements corrective actions to improve reliability. Additionally, it collaborates with cross-functional teams to refine designs and ensure manufacturability, contributing to long-term operational efficiency.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Subsystem-Level Electrical Design**

* Lead the end-to-end design and optimization of turbine electrical subsystems, focusing on high-performance inverters, control circuits, and transformer interfaces for reliable grid integration.
* Optimize nacelle cabling layouts to reduce electromagnetic interference (EMI), minimize power losses, and improve thermal management in compact spaces.
* Design redundant electrical pathways to enhance fault tolerance and ensure continuous turbine operation under extreme conditions.

**Integration of Electrical and SCADA Systems**

* Coordinate the seamless integration of electrical components with SCADA platforms, ensuring real-time data capture, fault detection, and rapid response mechanisms.
* Resolve compatibility issues between SCADA software and electrical subsystems, focusing on synchronization of monitoring with turbine control logic.
* Develop protocols for optimized data flow, ensuring minimal latency and reliable system feedback loops.

**Component Validation and Testing**

* Manage comprehensive testing protocols for turbine electrical components, including insulation resistance, power converter efficiency, and transformer load handling.
* Collaborate with instrumentation teams to ensure accurate sensor placement and calibration, capturing critical performance metrics.
* Supervise fault simulation tests, such as grid fault ride-through (FRT) events, to validate subsystem behavior under adverse conditions.

**Power Conversion Optimization**

* Oversee optimization of power conversion systems by implementing harmonic distortion mitigation strategies and fine-tuning inverter control parameters.
* Analyze power quality metrics to ensure adherence to grid compliance standards, focusing on voltage stability and transient response performance.

**Failure Analysis and Corrective Actions**

* Conduct root cause failure analysis (RCFA) for electrical subsystem failures, such as converter overheating or generator insulation breakdown.
* Define and implement corrective actions, including design modifications for improved thermal management and enhanced material selection for reliability.
* Develop reliability improvement plans, integrating predictive maintenance schedules into operational workflows.

**Collaboration with Instrumentation Teams**

* Work closely with instrumentation engineers to configure and validate sensors for monitoring voltage, current, and thermal performance across components.
* Ensure SCADA-integrated data acquisition systems provide accurate and actionable insights into subsystem performance.
* Lead troubleshooting efforts for sensor-related issues, ensuring minimal disruption to turbine monitoring and control.

**Grid Interface and Compliance**

* Analyze grid connection points to validate voltage stability and ensure compliance with international standards, such as IEC 61400-21.
* Develop real-time voltage and frequency regulation algorithms to support grid stability during transient and steady-state operations.

**Thermal and Power Loss Analysis**

* Conduct detailed thermal performance studies for converters, transformers, and cabling, focusing on heat dissipation efficiency and thermal stability under varying loads.
* Analyze power loss patterns in nacelle wiring, identifying hotspots and proposing improved layouts or materials to enhance efficiency.
* Validate thermal simulations with field data to ensure subsystem performance aligns with design expectations.

**Technical Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare detailed technical reports highlighting subsystem performance evaluations, failure analyses, and actionable recommendations for improvement.
* Document testing procedures, validation protocols, and outcomes for traceability during audits and certifications.

**Mentorship and Guidance**

* Mentor junior engineers in advanced topics, such as harmonic distortion analysis and thermal management in high-voltage systems.
* Conduct regular technical reviews of team deliverables to ensure alignment with project requirements and quality standards.
* Develop training modules focusing on the latest advancements in electrical engineering and renewable energy technologies.

**Key Stakeholders - Internal**

* Head - Engineering
* Head - Electrical Engineering
* Electrical Engineer
* OMS Engineering & Support - Electrical
* Nacelle Plant Support Engineer - Electrical
* Lead - Blade Process Engineering
* Lead - Testing & Certification
* Lead - Grid Compliance
* Lead - Performance Management
* Lead - Load Simulation
* Lead - Mechanical Drive Train
* Manufacturing Teams
* QA Teams

**Key Stakeholders - External**

* Electrical Component Suppliers
* Testing and Commissioning Agencies
* Grid Compliance Consultants
* Certification Bodies

**Qualifications**
**Educational Background:**

* BE in Electrical Engineering or related discipline.

**Work Experience**

* 8+ years in designing, testing, and optimizing electrical systems, including power converters and transformers. Experience with failure analysis, thermal management, and compliance verification is essential.

**Industry Knowledge**

* Expertise in load management, harmonics mitigation, and SCADA systems. Familiarity with IEC standards and advanced simulation tools is required.
