title: Spa Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Position: Spa Manager – Ayurveda Doctor

**Property:** Rhythm Kumarakom Resort  
**Department:** Spa & Wellness  
**Reports To:** General Manager / Director of Operations  
**Location:** Kumarakom, Kerala

1. Job Purpose

To lead and manage the Spa & Wellness Department, ensuring the delivery of authentic, safe and high-quality Ayurvedic treatments and wellness experiences to resort guests.

The Spa Manager must be a qualified Ayurveda Doctor (BAMS) with sound clinical knowledge, practical experience in Ayurvedic therapies, and the ability to manage spa operations, therapists, treatment protocols, guest consultations, revenue and departmental profitability.

The role combines Ayurveda medical expertise with hospitality management to position the resort as a preferred destination for authentic Ayurveda and wellness experiences.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Ayurveda Consultation & Guest Wellness**

* Conduct initial health consultations and wellness assessments for guests.
* Understand guests' medical history, lifestyle, health concerns and wellness objectives.
* Recommend suitable Ayurvedic treatments and wellness programmes based on individual requirements.
* Prescribe and supervise Ayurvedic therapies within professional scope and applicable regulations.
* Monitor guest progress and ensure appropriate follow-up consultations.
* Maintain individual guest consultation and treatment records with confidentiality.
* Identify contraindications and refer guests for appropriate medical attention whenever necessary.

**B. Spa Operations Management**

* Manage the day-to-day operations of the Spa & Wellness Centre.
* Ensure smooth scheduling of consultations, treatments and therapy sessions.
* Establish and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure proper maintenance, hygiene and ambience of treatment rooms.
* Monitor treatment quality and guest satisfaction.
* Ensure adequate availability of Ayurvedic oils, medicines, herbs, consumables and equipment.
* Maintain proper inventory and stock control.

**C. Ayurvedic Treatment & Therapy Supervision**

* Ensure authenticity and quality of traditional Ayurvedic treatments, including:
* Abhyanga
* Shirodhara
* Pizhichil
* Njavarakizhi
* Podikizhi
* Elakizhi
* Udwarthanam
* Kati Vasti and other applicable therapies.
* Supervise therapists to ensure correct treatment techniques and protocols.
* Ensure appropriate selection of oils, herbal preparations and treatment duration.
* Monitor treatment safety, hygiene and guest comfort.
* Ensure that all treatments are delivered according to the doctor's recommendations.

**D. Team Management & Training**

* Recruit, train and supervise Ayurvedic therapists and spa personnel.
* Conduct regular training on Ayurvedic treatments, hygiene, guest handling and service standards.
* Prepare staff duty rosters and monitor attendance.
* Evaluate staff performance and maintain professional discipline.
* Ensure therapists follow prescribed treatment protocols.

**E. Guest Experience & Hospitality**

* Deliver personalised wellness experiences for domestic and international guests.
* Ensure professional and courteous guest interactions.
* Handle guest feedback, concerns and complaints.
* Coordinate with Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage and other departments.
* Develop customised Ayurveda wellness packages for resort guests.
* Maintain a calm, relaxing and premium spa environment.

**F. Revenue Generation & Business Development**

* Develop attractive Ayurveda and wellness packages.
* Promote spa services through the resort's sales and marketing channels.
* Identify opportunities to increase spa revenue and treatment occupancy.
* Recommend seasonal wellness programmes and special packages.
* Monitor treatment pricing, revenue and profitability.
* Encourage repeat visits and positive guest reviews without compromising clinical suitability.

**G. Hygiene, Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure strict hygiene and sanitation standards throughout the spa.
* Ensure safe storage and handling of Ayurvedic oils, medicines and herbal products.
* Maintain treatment registers, consultation records and consent forms.
* Ensure compliance with applicable healthcare, professional, labour and hospitality regulations.
* Maintain emergency response procedures and incident reporting systems.
* Ensure patient confidentiality and ethical medical practices.

**H. Financial & Administrative Responsibilities**

* Prepare and monitor the annual spa operating budget.
* Control departmental expenses and consumable costs.
* Monitor stock consumption and prevent wastage.
* Coordinate procurement of Ayurvedic medicines, oils and other supplies.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly operational reports.
* Monitor spa revenue, treatment utilisation and departmental profitability.

3. Educational Qualification & Experience

* Mandatory: BAMS (Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery) from a recognised institution.
* Valid registration with the relevant State Medical Council / authorised professional registration body, as applicable.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Ayurveda clinical practice, preferably in a reputed Ayurveda hospital, wellness centre or luxury resort.
* Previous experience managing an Ayurveda spa or wellness centre will be an added advantage.
* Practical knowledge of traditional Kerala Ayurvedic therapies is essential.
* Experience in managing therapists and spa operations is preferred.

4. Essential Skills & Competencies

* Strong clinical knowledge of Ayurveda and Panchakarma.
* Expertise in Ayurvedic consultation and treatment planning.
* Knowledge of Kerala traditional Ayurvedic therapies.
* Spa operations and team management.
* Excellent guest relationship and communication skills.
* Good understanding of hospitality service standards.
* Revenue management and cost control.
* Staff training and performance management.
* Professional ethics and patient confidentiality.
* Ability to interact with international guests.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Guest satisfaction and spa experience ratings.
* Spa revenue and achievement of monthly targets.
* Treatment room utilisation and therapist productivity.
* Quality and consistency of Ayurvedic treatments.
* Guest consultation and treatment record maintenance.
* Compliance with hygiene, safety and clinical protocols.
* Staff productivity, training and retention.
* Inventory management and control of consumable expenses.
* Guest complaints and resolution turnaround time.
* Repeat spa bookings and wellness package sales.

6. Authority & Accountability

The Spa Manager will be responsible for:

* Overall management and performance of the Spa & Wellness Department.
* Clinical supervision of Ayurvedic treatments within professional scope.
* Treatment recommendations and wellness programme planning.
* Staff supervision, training and performance monitoring.
* Spa revenue, operational expenses and inventory control.
* Guest safety, satisfaction and service quality.

7. Personal Attributes

* Passion for Ayurveda, wellness and holistic healing.
* Professional and compassionate approach towards guests.
* Strong leadership and decision-making abilities.
* High standards of personal hygiene and professional conduct.
* Ability to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
* Willingness to work flexible hours as required by resort operations.

**Overall Objective:** To establish and operate a professionally managed Ayurveda Spa at Rhythm Kumarakom Resort, combining authentic Kerala Ayurvedic traditions, qualified medical supervision and exceptional hospitality standards to deliver a memorable and safe wellness experience to every guest.

title: Head of Human Resources
company: Design Walls The Wallpaper Company (DV Design Private Limited)
description:
We're Hiring | Head of Human Resources (HR Head)

**Company:**
Design Walls – The Wallpaper Company

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Experience:**
8–12 Years

**Position:**
Head of Human Resources

About Design Walls

Design Walls is a growing furnishing company specialising in wallpapers, curtains, blinds, upholstery, wooden flooring, and other interior furnishing solutions.

With a team of 80+ employees, we are on an ambitious growth journey. Our vision is to build a ₹500 crore organisation within the next six years.

We are looking for a smart, proactive, and business-oriented HR Head who can understand our business requirements, build a strong workforce, and develop HR systems that support our long-term growth.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Strategic Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Understand business requirements and identify the right manpower for every department.
* Plan and execute recruitment for sales, marketing, operations, finance, design, manufacturing, and management roles.
* Build a strong recruitment pipeline and reduce hiring turnaround time.
* Identify candidates with the right attitude, skills, and cultural fit.
* Develop an effective employee referral and recruitment strategy.

**2. HR Operations & Systems**

* Establish structured HR policies, procedures and employee guidelines.
* Implement effective attendance, leave, payroll, and performance management systems.
* Develop proper onboarding, induction, and employee exit processes.
* Maintain employee records and ensure statutory and labour law compliance.

**3. Performance Management**

* Establish KRAs and KPIs for every department and employee.
* Monitor employee performance and productivity.
* Implement appraisal, incentive, and reward systems.
* Identify underperforming employees and develop improvement plans.

**4. Employee Engagement & Culture**

* Build a disciplined, accountable, and performance-driven work culture.
* Improve employee retention and reduce unnecessary attrition.
* Conduct employee engagement activities and regular feedback sessions.
* Handle employee grievances, conflicts, and disciplinary matters professionally.

**5. Training & Development**

* Identify skill gaps across departments.
* Organise regular training programmes for sales, marketing and operations teams.
* Develop leadership capabilities and succession plans.
* Build a structured training and development framework.

**6. HR Leadership & Business Growth**

* Work directly with the Managing Director to understand business goals and manpower requirements.
* Prepare annual manpower budgets and recruitment plans.
* Build scalable HR systems to support business expansion.
* Develop a strong second-line leadership team.
* Ensure the organisation has the right people in the right positions at the right time.

Candidate Profile

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification.
* 8–12 years of HR experience, preferably with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
* Experience handling 75–200+ employees.
* Strong expertise in recruitment, performance management, and HR operations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Strong knowledge of HR policies, labour laws, and statutory compliance.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, and HRMS tools.
* Experience in retail, interior design, furnishing, manufacturing, or other growth-oriented businesses will be an advantage.

What We Are Looking for...

We are not looking for someone who only manages attendance, payroll, and employee records.

We need a hands-on HR leader who:

* Understands business requirements before recruiting.
* Can independently identify and recruit the right talent.
* Is smart, practical, solution-oriented, and proactive.
* Can take ownership of HR challenges and solve problems.
* Has the ability to build systems rather than depend on existing processes.
* Can work closely with the MD and department heads.
* Has the vision and capability to build an HR department for a ₹500 crore organisation.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The HR Head will be evaluated on:

1. Quality of recruitment and employee retention.
2. Recruitment turnaround time.
3. Employee productivity and performance.
4. Reduction in avoidable employee attrition.
5. Implementation of HR systems and policies.
6. Training effectiveness and leadership development.
7. Manpower planning and budget management.

Career Opportunity

This is an opportunity to become a key member of the leadership team and play an important role in building a ₹500 crore organisation.

Preferred Industry Background

We are particularly interested in candidates with HR leadership experience in established or fast-growing organisations across the following industries:

**1. Interior Design & Home Improvement**

* Livspace
* HomeLane
* Asian Paints

**2. Retail & Home Furnishing**

* IKEA
* Pepperfry
* Organised retail and furnishing companies

**3. Printing, Signage & Visual Communication**

* Pragati Printers
* Macro Media
* Large-format printing and digital printing companies
* Signage, branding and advertising production companies

**4. Manufacturing & Distribution**

* Building materials
* Textile and furnishing manufacturing
* Consumer products and distribution companies

**What We Expect:**

* Experience managing 75–200+ employees across multiple departments.
* Strong recruitment capabilities across sales, marketing, production, design and operations.
* Experience building HR policies, performance management systems and organisational structures.
* Ability to understand business requirements and recruit the right talent.
* Proven ability to build HR systems in growing organisations, not just manage routine HR activities.

Candidates from other industries with strong HR leadership capabilities and experience in scaling organisations are also encouraged to apply.

title: Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Spiti Lifespace connects real estate developers with homebuyers by offering a curated portfolio of premium residential properties from trusted developers. The company specializes in new project launches, exclusive inventory access, and personalized sales support tailored to each buyer’s needs. Spiti Lifespace focuses on seamless transaction management, guiding clients through every step from property search to handover. Its mission is to deliver a smooth, transparent, and consultative experience that helps individuals and investors realize their real estate goals.

**Role Description**
The Sales Manager role at Spiti Lifespace is a full-time, on-site position based in Goregaon. The Sales Manager will oversee the end-to-end sales cycle, including lead generation, qualification, property presentations, site visits, and closing transactions. This role involves building and maintaining relationships with homebuyers and investors, understanding their requirements, and recommending suitable projects from the company’s portfolio. The Sales Manager will coordinate with developers for inventory updates, pricing, and offers, and ensure accurate documentation and smooth transaction processing. Daily activities include managing a sales pipeline, tracking performance against targets, preparing sales reports, and collaborating with marketing to support campaigns and events that drive qualified leads.

* Strong sales and negotiation skills, with proven ability to close real estate or high-value transactions.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to conduct property walkthroughs and explain project details clearly.
* Ability to manage multiple leads and opportunities, maintain organized records, and use CRM or sales tracking tools effectively.
* Knowledge of local real estate market dynamics, residential project lifecycles, and basic property documentation requirements.
* Comfort working on-site in Goregaon, conducting regular site visits, and coordinating with developers and internal teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Real Estate, or a related field preferred; relevant experience in property sales or brokerage is a strong advantage.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and able to work with minimal supervision while adhering to ethical and transparent sales practices.

Machine Minds delivers custom automation solutions and control panel manufacturing that help industrial clients modernize their operations. The company focuses on using up-to-date technology tailored to each customer’s needs, improving competitiveness in demanding markets. By optimizing operational efficiency, Machine Minds enables clients to increase productivity and reduce downtime. Its solutions also help organizations stay better connected to their manufacturing processes, creating greater visibility and control across production environments.

**Role Description**
This full-time Sales and Marketing Intern role is a hybrid position based in Pune, with flexibility for some work-from-home tasks. The intern will support sales outreach by researching potential clients, preparing presentations, and assisting with follow-ups to nurture leads. Daily responsibilities include helping manage customer inquiries, updating CRM or sales tracking tools, and coordinating with internal teams to understand product offerings. The intern will contribute to basic marketing activities such as drafting social media posts, assisting in campaign execution, and gathering market insights. The role also involves supporting sales training sessions, documenting processes, and preparing reports on sales and marketing performance.

**We are looking for an ambitious, energetic, and result-oriented MBA Marketing Intern to join our Business Development team. This role covers the entire sales lifecycle—from identifying prospective clients and generating leads to conducting customer meetings, preparing detailed techno-commercial quotations, and closing deals.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Development & Lead Generation

• Research potential markets, industries, and target clients to build a robust sales pipeline.

• Generate qualified B2B leads via cold calling, email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, and digital networking.

• Identify customer pain points and pitch our products/services effectively.

2. Customer Meetings & Relationship Management

• Schedule and participate in virtual or in-person customer meetings, product demonstrations, and presentations.

• Understand client technical and commercial requirements thoroughly.

• Build and maintain long-term, professional relationships with prospective and existing clients.

3. Techno-Commercial Quotations & Proposals

• Collaborate with internal technical/pricing teams to draft customized proposals.

• Prepare comprehensive techno-commercial quotations, balancing technical scope, pricing, and terms & conditions.

• Handle pricing discussions, negotiations, and follow-ups on submitted proposals.

4. Deal Closing & Sales Conversion

• Negotiate contract terms, address client objections, and drive deals to closure.

• Coordinate with internal operations, finance, and delivery teams to ensure smooth order execution.

• Maintain and update daily sales reports, pipelines, and customer records in the CRM system.**

description:
**Job Summary**
Assists in the accurate preparation, processing, and balancing of time and attendance system to support compensation processes and play a vital role in ensuring compliance with various legislations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Assists with the proper operation of the time and attendance system; understands time reporting rules and requirements; monitors the system for proper functioning.
  
  
Initiates and monitors helpdesk inquiries; escalates for appropriate resolution
  
  
Troubleshoots and resolves basic issues.
  
  
Contributes to the timely and accurate resolution of time and attendance system issues which may include historical edits, password resets, access requests, time management reporting.
  
  
Serves as an internal resource on payroll and time management topics.
  
  
Provide superior customer service—respond courteously, accurately and in a timely fashion to time and attendance questions and requests.
  
  
Provides input to continuous improvement projects and initiatives; supports the development and maintenance of time and attendance process documentation.
  
  
Ensures data completeness and accuracy that meets pay cycle deadlines including required approvals.
  
  
Ensures data meets all legal, contractual, and governance requirements.
  
  
**Competencies**
Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Demonstrates self-awareness - Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.
  
  
Instills trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
  
  
Human Resources Business Process Execution - Manages the execution of Human Resources business processes, seeking efficiency, accuracy, positive business performance outcomes and operational agility; integrates activities across processes as needed; assures compliance with process and legal requirements; effectively balances process requirements and business leader needs.
  
  
Human Resources Consulting - Collaborates with partners to observe the environment and apply sound judgment informed by knowledge, skills, and experiences to diagnose, identify and optimize opportunities to provide holistic solutions, while balancing the needs of stakeholders, primarily employees, with those of the organization.
  
  
Human Resources Data Management - Acts on people data to ensure completeness, accuracy and compliance with company policy and legislative requirements.
  
  
Payroll Administration - Translates company policies, tax and legislative requirements in the delivery of accurate and timely employee payments and reporting; ensures compliance with applicable regulations and internal control procedures.
  
  
Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
  
  
**Experience**

3 + years of UKG Pro WFM/ Kronos experience. 1-2 years of customer service experience for a large organization and/or in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Proficient in Microsoft Excel.
  
  
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Commitment to continuous learning and understanding of work and leave regulations.
  
  
Professional attitude and strong communication skills.
  
  
Demonstrate time management and organizational skills to work efficiently while maintaining quality standards.
  
  
Able to prioritize workload and meet payroll processing deadlines.

title: E-Commerce Executive
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on E-commerce Executive to run our online store operations end to end. You will manage product listings, daily order operations, safety claims, returns and customer support so that our marketplace accounts stay healthy and customers stay happy.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Listing Management**

* Create, update and optimize product listings (title, bullet points, description, images, pricing, keywords).
* Upload products in bulk using templates and catalog files.
* Keep stock, price and offers updated across all platforms.
* Fix listing errors, suppressed listings and catalog issues.
* Track competitor pricing and listing quality.

**2. Order and Operations Management**

* Process orders daily and coordinate with the warehouse for packing and dispatch.
* Manage inventory levels and flag low stock.
* Handle courier coordination, pickup issues and delayed or stuck shipments.
* Track dispatch SLAs, cancellations and order defect rates.
* Maintain daily MIS reports on orders, dispatches, returns and sales.

**3. Safety Claim Management (e.g. SAFE-T / marketplace claims)**

* Raise and follow up on claims for damaged, lost, wrong or missing items.
* Collect and submit proof: unboxing videos, images, invoices, return tracking, and warehouse and courier reports.
* Respond to claim rejections with appeals and escalations.
* Track claim status and payouts, and reconcile with settlements.

**4. Return Management**

* Monitor RTO and customer returns daily.
* Inspect returned products and record condition (sellable, damaged, wrong item).
* Update inventory after return QC and coordinate restocking or disposal.
* Analyze return reasons and suggest fixes (packaging, listing accuracy, sizing, quality).

**5. Customer Support**

* Respond to customer queries, complaints and messages on marketplace portals, email, chat and phone.
* Resolve issues related to delivery, refunds, replacements and product information.
* Maintain a polite, professional tone and meet response-time targets.
* Escalate unresolved cases to the concerned team.

Requirements

* Graduate in any stream (Commerce/BBA/IT preferred).
* Working knowledge of at least one marketplace seller panel.
* Good command of MS Excel/Google Sheets (VLOOKUP, filters, pivot tables).
* Good written and spoken communication in English and [Hindi/regional language].
* Strong attention to detail, with good follow-up and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work **9 to 10 hours a day** and manage a high-volume workload.

Good to Have

* Experience with claim filing and reverse logistics.
* Knowledge of Shopify, WooCommerce, or an ERP/OMS tool.
* Basic image editing (Canva/Photoshop) and SEO knowledge.

Pay: ₹9,700.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**Company Description**
COOL METALS is a manufacturing organization focused on delivering high-quality metal products to industrial and commercial customers. The company emphasizes operational efficiency, safety, and continuous improvement across its plants. Team members collaborate closely across production, finance, and operations to support sustainable growth and reliable output. COOL METALS offers opportunities to contribute to core business performance, develop specialized skills, and grow within a structured, process-driven environment.
  
**Role Description**
The Plant Controller at COOL METALS is a full-time, on-site role based in Faridabad, responsible for overseeing all financial activities of the plant. The role includes managing plant-level financial reporting, preparing and analyzing monthly financial statements, and ensuring accurate tracking of costs and fixed assets. The Plant Controller partners with operations, production, and management teams to develop budgets, monitor variances, and support cost-control initiatives. Daily tasks include reviewing transactions, validating inventory and production data, supporting audits, and implementing internal controls to ensure compliance with company policies and relevant regulations. The individual in this role provides clear financial insights and recommendations to improve plant performance and profitability.

* Experience managing fixed assets, including capitalization, depreciation, asset tracking, and compliance with relevant accounting standards.
* Solid background in cost accounting, including standard cost development, variance analysis, inventory valuation, and product costing for a manufacturing environment.
* Advanced analytical skills and finance knowledge, with the ability to use data to support decision-making and drive operational and financial improvements.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional certifications (such as CA, CMA, or CPA) are an advantage.
* Experience working in a plant or manufacturing setting, with familiarity in ERP systems and MS Excel for financial modeling and reporting.
* Strong attention to detail, integrity, and adherence to internal controls, along with effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work on-site in Faridabad, managing deadlines in a dynamic production environment and partnering with cross-functional teams.

title: Beckhoff PLC Programmer
description:
**Company Description**
Hanoch Automations Pvt Ltd provides standardized and custom automation solutions for a wide range of industries. The company focuses on modularity and expandability, allowing flexible integration of diverse production processes. This approach enables Hanoch Automations to tailor systems to individual customer requirements and deliver efficient, scalable automation. Team members work on solutions that directly impact manufacturing performance and innovation across multiple sectors.
  
**Role Description**
The Beckhoff PLC Programmer will design, program, test, and commission automation solutions using Beckhoff PLCs and TwinCAT software for various industrial applications. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing control logic, creating HMI interfaces, integrating field devices, troubleshooting system issues, and optimizing machine performance. The role also involves collaborating with mechanical, electrical, and project teams, preparing technical documentation, and supporting installation and maintenance activities at customer sites. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Kochi, requiring hands-on work in workshop and plant environments as well as occasional customer visits.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Proficiency in Beckhoff PLC programming and TwinCAT, including structured text and ladder logic, with strong control system design skills.
* Experience in industrial automation, including motion control, fieldbus communication (e.g., EtherCAT), and integration of sensors, actuators, and drives.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, P&IDs, and technical drawings, and collaborate effectively with engineering and project teams.
* Strong troubleshooting, diagnostic, and problem-solving skills for PLC, I/O, and communication-related issues in live systems.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document programs, prepare test reports, and explain technical concepts clearly.
* Relevant technical degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or related engineering discipline.
* Experience with other PLC platforms, HMIs, SCADA systems, or robotics is an advantage.
* Willingness to work on-site in Kochi, travel to customer locations when needed, and adhere to safety and quality standards.

We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.As a Data Architect at Empower, you will be a hands-on technical expert and solution shaping architecture contributor, helping design the company’s cloud and data architecture. Partnering with enterprise architects, senior architects, business leaders, and IT teams, you will define solution architectures and support modernization initiatives aligned with Empower’s vision for performance, efficiency, and cost optimization. You will also partner with Empower’s Innovation Lab to explore emerging technologies including Generative AI and Advanced Analytics, translating experimentation into practical patterns and recommendations for delivery teams. You will influence architectural decisions, contribute to team standards and governance, and help elevate technology excellence through consistent, high quality designs.ResponsibilitiesPartner with Enterprise Architects, Senior Architects, and cross functional teams including business stakeholders to shape solution architectures aligned to a unified IT data strategy. Contribute to Empower’s technology roadmap by documenting target state architectures, reference architectures, and key dependencies for supported initiatives. Design and support modernization and migration of complex systems to scalable, secure, and cost optimized cloud architectures, working with delivery teams through implementation. Evaluate and prototype new technologies and applications, challenge existing approaches constructively, and provide input into business cases and recommendations. Apply and help operationalize architectural standards, best practices, and governance expectations, supporting consistent adoption through guidance and enablement. Collaborate closely with business and engineering teams to design end to end solutions that meet strategic, technical, and operational objectives. Provide architectural guidance in process design, system orchestration, and enterprise integration to enable cohesive and efficient technology ecosystems. Champion security, resilience, and scalability as core design principles across data platforms and data solutions. Contribute to architecture discipline maturity by producing reusable patterns, decision documentation, and lessons learned that improve consistency and delivery speed. Support full stack development teams through solution design and implementation, improving long term scalability, performance, and cost outcomes. Required SkillsAt least 5 years of experience delivering data-intensive solutions (for example in data engineering, analytics engineering, data platforms, BI, or related roles). At least 1 year of demonstrated solution design ownership for moderately complex initiatives, gained as an architect or as a senior engineer/technical lead responsible for end-to-end design, architectural trade-offs, and guiding implementation. Proven experience in multiple data focused roles including Data Engineer (ETL/ELT), Data Architect, Database Administrator, BI or Analytics Engineer, Data Science, data governance, or a similar field. Competency in architecture frameworks, performance optimization, and addressing cross cutting concerns including availability, caching, monitoring, scalability, and security. Strong problem solving and strategic thinking, with the ability to influence cross functional teams and communicate architecture decisions clearly in distributed environments. Strong expertise in designing data and cloud architecture, AWS preferred, supporting scalability, performance, and security with systems such as Snowflake or Redshift. Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights and reporting solutions that provide comprehensive and up to date information to business users. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Nice To Have QualificationsData engineering experience designing and delivering ETL and ELT pipelines, including orchestration, data quality controls, and reliable operations for batch and near real time workloads. Streaming and event driven data experience building and operating Kafka or Kinesis based architectures including ordering, replay, schema evolution, and real time observability. API and integration experience designing API first data access patterns, API lifecycle governance, versioning, security, and developer enablement, plus event driven integration patterns to reduce point to point complexity. Data platform modernization experience designing large scale ingestion and processing platforms using Spark or comparable distributed compute and orchestrating reliable batch and near real time pipelines. Data security and privacy experience implementing encryption, masking or tokenization, access controls, and auditability patterns for sensitive data and regulated environments. Cloud cost and performance experience applying FinOps practices, workload right sizing, storage optimization, and performance engineering for cloud data platforms. DevOps for data experience building CI/CD for data pipelines, infrastructure as code practices, and container platforms such as Kubernetes or EKS for data workloads. Applied AI and GenAI experience designing safe enterprise patterns for retrieval, evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI adoption. Broad polyglot engineering experience with Java, microservices patterns, and third party API integrations that support data intensive services. Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional). EducationBachelor’s and/or master’s degree in computer science or related field (information systems, mathematics, software engineering, etc.) Physical Requirements/Working ConditionsNormal Office Working Conditions We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

title: MTS 2 - Distributed Databases
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.**
**Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.**
**Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.**
**About The Team And Role**
**Our NuData team at eBay brings together exceptional engineers who are pushing the boundaries of distributed systems to build the next generation of database platforms powering eBay’s global marketplace. NuData builds and operates petabyte-scale, highly available distributed data platforms supporting some of eBay’s most critical workloads.**
**We are seeking an experienced
**Member of Technical Staff 2 (MTS 2)**
to join the NuData team in
**Bengaluru**
. You will work closely with NuData engineers, technical leads, and architects in
**Bengaluru, the U.S., China, and Ireland**
to design, build, and operate highly scalable distributed database systems.**
**In this role, you will take ownership of significant components and capabilities within NuData’s distributed database platforms. You will solve challenging engineering problems involving scalability, availability, performance, consistency, and operational efficiency and contribute to the design and evolution of systems operating at eBay scale.**
**This is a
**highly hands-on engineering role**
. You will design and implement production software, write and review code, develop prototypes, benchmark solutions, debug complex system and production issues, and work with other engineers to deliver reliable distributed systems. You will participate in architectural and design discussions and help turn technical requirements into robust production solutions.**
**You will also work directly with NuData customers when needed to understand workloads, troubleshoot technical issues, and help ensure our platforms meet their performance, reliability, and scalability requirements.**
****What you will accomplish****

* Design, develop, test, and operate critical components and capabilities within NuData’s large-scale distributed database platforms.
* Take end-to-end ownership of significant features and components—from requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
* Write high-quality, production-grade code and actively participate in design and code reviews.
* Solve complex engineering problems across areas such as storage, transactions, replication, distributed consensus, partitioning, geo-distribution, and high-concurrency systems.
* Contribute to technical designs and architectural decisions by evaluating alternatives, identifying tradeoffs, and working with senior engineers and architects to select effective solutions.
* Improve the scalability, latency, availability, reliability, and infrastructure efficiency of systems operating at eBay scale.
* Diagnose and resolve complex production issues across software, storage, networking, and distributed-system boundaries and implement solutions that prevent recurrence.
* Build prototypes and conduct performance benchmarks to evaluate new designs, algorithms, and technologies before bringing them into production.
* Partner with engineers, technical leads, product managers, and NuData customers to understand requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.
* Contribute to strong engineering practices around design, code quality, testing, observability, automation, deployment, and operational readiness.
* Share technical knowledge and provide guidance to other engineers through design discussions, code reviews, documentation, and collaborative problem solving.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and open-source solutions and apply them where they can improve NuData’s architecture, performance, or engineering efficiency.
* Effectively use AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development velocity while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, security, and maintainability.

****What you will bring****

* Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field with 6+ years of experience, or a Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of experience building large-scale software systems.
* Strong hands-on experience designing, developing, and operating distributed systems, databases, storage systems, or large-scale data infrastructure.

****Core Technical Expertise****

* Strong understanding of distributed-systems concepts, including replication, consistency, partitioning, fault tolerance, high availability, and distributed consensus.
* Strong understanding of database and storage-system fundamentals, including areas such as storage management, write-ahead logging (WAL), transactions, concurrency control, indexing, caching, and query processing.
* Understanding of transaction-management concepts, including isolation levels, concurrency control, locking, crash recovery, replication, and failover.
* Understanding of distributed-system failure modes, including network partitions, partial failures, and consensus protocols such as RAFT/PAXOS.
* Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, networking, operating systems, and software design.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as C++, Java, Python, Scala, or equivalent languages, with experience developing and debugging production software.
* Experience with Object-Oriented Design, distributed programming, and relational and/or NoSQL database systems.
* Experience with modern infrastructure technologies and cloud-native environments, including technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker.
* Ability to analyze and diagnose complex performance and production issues across multiple layers of a distributed system.

****Engineering Ownership & Collaboration****

* Demonstrated ability to independently own significant software components and features from design through production.
* Ability to break down complex technical problems, evaluate alternatives, and develop high-quality engineering solutions.
* Ability to contribute effectively to architecture and design discussions and clearly explain technical decisions and tradeoffs.
* Strong engineering discipline around code quality, testing, observability, automation, reliability, and operational readiness.
* Ability to write clear technical designs and documentation for significant features and components.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, technical leads, product teams, and customers.
* Demonstrated proficiency building production-grade software with AI coding agents, improving engineering velocity while maintaining high standards for quality, availability, and maintainability.
* Ability to decompose problems and provide agents with the right context, specifications, constraints, and validation criteria.
* Ability to capture and express business, architecture, codebase, and operational knowledge so AI coding agents can execute complex tasks accurately and autonomously.
* Hands-on experience delivering complex, production-quality software using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, etc.

****Global Collaboration****

* Ability to work effectively in a globally distributed engineering organization and collaborate with teams in Bengaluru, the U.S., China, and Ireland.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively using both synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.

**Additional Details**

**At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.**
**Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.**
**Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.**
**About The Team And Role**
**Our NuData team at eBay brings together exceptional engineers who are pushing the boundaries of distributed systems to build the next generation of database platforms powering eBay’s global marketplace. NuData builds and operates petabyte-scale, highly available distributed data platforms supporting some of eBay’s most critical workloads.**
**We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Member of Technical Staff (Senior MTS)**
to join the NuData team in
**Bengaluru**
. This individual will be a key technical contributor and hands-on engineering leader for the local team, partnering closely with NuData architects, technical leads, and engineers in the
**U.S., China, and Ireland**
.**
**In this role, you will help design and build critical capabilities across NuData’s distributed database platforms. You will own complex technical initiatives, contribute to key architectural decisions, and solve challenging problems involving scalability, availability, performance, consistency, and operational efficiency.**
**This is a
**hands-on technical role**
. You will stay deeply engaged with the technology—designing and implementing critical components, writing and reviewing production code, prototyping new approaches, debugging complex system and production issues, and working alongside engineers to solve challenging distributed-systems problems. You will also engage directly with NuData customers to understand their workloads, address technical challenges, and ensure our platforms continue to meet their evolving needs.**
**You will also contribute to strengthening NuData’s engineering organization in Bengaluru by mentoring engineers, raising the technical bar, promoting strong engineering practices, and sharing expertise across the team.**
****What you will accomplish****

* Own and drive major technical initiatives within NuData, contributing to the architecture and evolution of eBay’s distributed database platforms.
* Take end-to-end ownership of critical distributed database components and capabilities—from design and implementation through testing, production rollout, and ongoing operational excellence.
* Remain hands-on with design and development, implementing critical database components and production-quality code while tackling complex problems across storage, transactions, replication, consensus, geo-distribution, and high-concurrency systems.
* Contribute to architectural decisions for complex technical problems, evaluating tradeoffs and developing pragmatic solutions that meet platform, customer, and business requirements.
* Drive improvements in scalability, latency, availability, reliability, and infrastructure efficiency across systems operating at eBay scale.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, helping improve engineering judgment, technical skills, and overall engineering quality within the Bengaluru organization.
* Advocate for high standards in architecture, design, code quality, testing, observability, automation, and operational readiness. Participate in and lead design and code reviews for significant platform capabilities.
* Partner closely with engineers, architects, engineering leaders, product managers, and NuData customers to understand workloads, requirements, and technical challenges and translate them into effective platform solutions.
* Drive projects from early exploration through production—including brainstorming, prototyping, benchmarking, design, implementation, deployment, and production support.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and open-source solutions and identify opportunities to improve NuData’s architecture and capabilities. Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools where they improve engineering velocity and quality.
* Communicate technical designs, architectural decisions, and tradeoffs clearly to engineers, architects, and engineering leadership.

****What you will bring****

* Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field with 10+ years of experience or a PhD with equivalent experience building large-scale distributed systems.
* Significant hands-on experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed databases, storage systems, or data infrastructure, with demonstrated ownership of technically complex systems and initiatives.

****Core Technical Expertise****

* Strong expertise in distributed systems and database architecture, including distributed consensus, replication, consistency models, partitioning, fault tolerance, high availability, and geo-distributed systems.
* Strong understanding of database internals such as storage and buffer management, write-ahead logging (WAL), multi-version concurrency control (MVCC), lock management, query planning/execution, indexing, and database engines.
* Strong transaction-management expertise, including isolation levels, concurrency control, deadlock detection, crash recovery, physical/logical replication, and HA/failover strategies.
* Strong understanding of distributed-system failure modes, including network partitions, partial failures, consensus protocols such as RAFT/PAXOS, and the tradeoffs required to maintain availability, consistency, and performance at scale.
* Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, networking, operating systems, and software architecture.
* Advanced programming experience in one or more languages such as C++, Java, Python, Scala, or equivalent languages, with a track record of developing and debugging complex production systems.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Object-Oriented Design, distributed programming, and large-scale relational and/or NoSQL database systems.
* Experience with modern infrastructure technologies and cloud-native environments, including technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose difficult production issues across software, storage, networking, and distributed-system boundaries and drive problems through root cause and long-term resolution.

****Technical Leadership & Collaboration****

* Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership for significant components and projects, contribute to architectural direction, and make sound technical tradeoffs.
* Proven ability to lead technically complex initiatives spanning multiple components and collaborate effectively across teams.
* Ability to operate at multiple levels—from designing systems and reviewing architecture to writing code, debugging production systems, and helping engineers solve difficult implementation problems.
* Strong track record of mentoring engineers, raising engineering standards, and contributing to a culture of technical excellence.
* Ability to produce clear, high-quality architecture and design documents and drive alignment around important technical decisions.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, architects, engineering leaders, product teams, customers, and other stakeholders.
* Proven ability to navigate complex technical tradeoffs and build consensus across globally distributed teams.
* Demonstrated proficiency building production-grade software with AI coding agents, improving engineering velocity while maintaining high standards for quality, availability, and maintainability.
* Ability to decompose problems and provide agents with the right context, specifications, constraints, and validation criteria.
* Ability to capture and express business, architecture, codebase, and operational knowledge so AI coding agents can execute complex engineering tasks accurately.
* Hands-on experience delivering complex, production-quality software using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools.

****Global Collaboration****

* Ability to thrive in a globally distributed engineering organization and build strong technical partnerships across teams in Bengaluru, the U.S., China, and Ireland.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across organizational and geographic boundaries, using both synchronous and asynchronous communication to drive technical work and maintain alignment.

Work across the full stack - frontend and backend systems - to deliver end-to-end features

Mentor and provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team
  
  
Optimize system performance, identify bottlenecks, and improve operational excellence
  
  
Participate in on-call rotations to ensure system reliability and availability

* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

title: Specialist
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a hands-on Test Specialist to own the testing of assigned product areas end-to-end and to bring an AI-first way of working into every part of the QA lifecycle. This is an individual contributor role.
  
  
The successful candidate will run sprint testing for their assigned areas, engage directly with Product Management (PMG) on requirements, and partner with the automation team to define what should and should not go into the automation suite for every meaningful change.
  
  
AI-first thinking is a non-negotiable for this role. We expect the person to actively apply AI across requirement analysis, test case generation, test data creation, defect triage, and reporting — in line with our Innovate for Growth 2027 mandate.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Area Ownership & Sprint Testing
* Own end-to-end testing of assigned product areas across the sprint lifecycle — from grooming to sign-off.
* Design and execute test cases (with AI assistance wherever it accelerates the work), maintain them in QMetry, and drive defects through to closure in Jira.
* Ensure adequate coverage of functional, integration, and regression scenarios within sprint timelines.
* Maintain low defect slippage to UAT and production for the areas you own — quality of your area is your accountability, not the team's.

Requirement Discussions with PMG
  
  

* Partner with Product Management (PMG) during grooming and requirement discussions to clarify scope, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Convert requirements into testable scenarios using AI-driven tooling as a first pass, then refine with domain judgement.
* Raise gaps or ambiguities early — before they become defects in later sprints or production incidents.

Automation Scope Discussions
  
  

* Partner with the automation team to define automation scope for every significant sprint change — what to automate, at what level (API, UI, integration), and when.
* Provide well-defined scenarios and expected outcomes so automation engineers can build reliable, low-flake tests.
* Review automated coverage for the areas you own and flag missing coverage or over-testing.
* AI-First Testing Practices
* Treat AI as a default tool, not a novelty — apply it to requirement analysis, test case generation, test data creation, defect triage, and reporting.
* Contribute AI use cases back to the wider QA team — share what works, what doesn't, and where the efficiency gains come from.

**Required Skills & Experience**
Must-Have Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong experience in functional and system testing across web-based products.
* Hands-on experience with test management tools (QMetry preferred) and defect tracking tools (Jira).
* Working knowledge of SQL for backend validation and data reconciliation testing.
* Familiarity with API testing tools (Postman, Rest Assured, or equivalent) for backend verification.
* Understanding of how automation frameworks fit into the QA lifecycle — enough to have informed discussions with automation engineers about scope, coverage, and trade-offs.
* Comfort using AI-assisted testing tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as part of day-to-day work.

**Must-Have Domain Knowledge**

* Solid understanding of the capital markets domain — trade lifecycle, order management, commissions, and/or post-trade workflows.
* Prior experience in investment banking or buy-side / sell-side technology.

Must-Have Soft Skills
  
  

* AI-first mindset — defaults to AI as the starting point for any repeatable task, actively looks for efficiency and quality gains, and encourages the rest of the team to do the same.

Strong ownership of assigned product areas — accountable for quality outcomes, not just execution.
  
  
Confident stakeholder engagement with PMG, Development, and Automation teams; comfortable pushing back on requirements or scope where quality is at risk.
  
  

* Clear communication — can explain testing decisions, defect impact, and coverage trade-offs to both technical and business audiences.
* Individual contributor maturity — delivers reliably in an IC role without heavy oversight, and knows when to escalate.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Exposure to BDD / Cucumber for shared understanding with the automation team.
* Familiarity with mobile testing workflows.
* Prior experience testing commission management, order management, or post-trade platforms.

**Euronext Values**
**Unity**

* We respect and value the people we work with
* We are unified through a common purpose
* We embrace diversity and strive for inclusion

**Integrity**

* We value transparency, communicate honestly and share information openly
* We act with integrity in everything we do
* We don’t hide our mistakes, and we learn from them

**Agility**

* We act with a sense of urgency and decisiveness
* We are adaptable, responsive and embrace change
* We take smart risks

**Energy**

* We are positively driven to make a difference and challenge the status quo
* We focus on and encourage personal leadership
* We motivate each other with our ambition

**Accountability**

* We deliver maximum value to our customers and stakeholders
* We take ownership and are accountable for the outcome
* We reward and celebrate performance

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, gender, age, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, or any other legally protected factor. We value the unique talents of all our people, who come from diverse backgrounds with different personal experiences and points of view and we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect.
  
  
**Additional Information**
This job description is only describing the main activities within a certain role and is not exhaustive. It does not prevent to add more tasks, projects.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with strong Python backend expertise to build scalable, AI-powered enterprise applications. You'll own features end-to-end- from React UI to Python services and data-using modern cloud-native technologies in a fast-paced, AI-first engineering environment.

What You'll Do

* Build end-to-end features across Python, React, APIs, messaging, and data.
* Develop scalable Python backend services and microservices.
* Work with Neo4j, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, ClickHouse, and Kubernetes.
* Integrate AI/LLM capabilities into products and use AI tools for development, testing, and automation.
* Write secure, high-quality code, mentor engineers, and drive engineering best practices.

What We're Looking For

* 10+ years of enterprise SaaS development experience.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Python (mandatory) and React/JavaScript.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Neo4j, Redis, RabbitMQ/Kafka, and ClickHouse.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native architecture, and OWASP.
* Experience building AI-enabled applications and using AI coding tools.

Nice to Have

* IAM/Cybersecurity domain experience.
* Experience with AI agents, LLM integrations, AWS/Azure.

Why Join Tuebora

* Build AI-first enterprise software.
* Work with Python, React, Neo4j, Kubernetes, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, ClickHouse, andLLMs.
* High ownership, technical growth, and the opportunity to shape engineering standards.

title: Staff, Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose:**

* Enterprise AI (EAI) builds AI products that combine real modelling work with user-facing applications, and ships them to production. Full Stack Engineers move across data, models, platforms, APIs and interfaces in a single workflow. In our operating model, digital workers do much of the hands-on build. They generate services, APIs, interface components and tests, run evaluations and monitor what is in production. Our engineers set the architecture and standards that work is built to, and own the quality of what ships.
* EAI products and agents draw on a governed context layer that makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed. Full Stack Engineers build the products and agents that consume it, and decide how that context reaches users.
* The Full Stack Engineer II independently builds and ships AI-integrated features, working closely with GSK business teams to prototype against real data and workflows at a days-to-weeks cadence. The role owns the quality of what digital workers deliver in those features, makes evidence-based calls on what to continue or stop, and contributes reusable components others adopt.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own use cases from problem framing through working prototype and first production version, at a days-to-weeks cadence and without close supervision.
* Qualify incoming asks: challenge underspecified problems, assess feasibility and define scope before committing to work. At the end of each piece of work, form and defend an evidence-based recommendation to continue or stop, presented clearly to business and EAI leadership.
* Work closely with business teams, prototyping against real data and workflows and building trusted relationships with product owners and engineering leads.

**Required skills:**

* 16+ years of overall professional experience & 10+ years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, including production deployments.
* Demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software at speed, independently and under time pressure. A startup, lab or innovation-team background is an advantage.
* Strong proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, Go or similar, with experience designing and shipping backend services and complete UI features.
* Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, tool use, prompt engineering and evaluation, including evaluation pipelines and LLM-specific monitoring in production.
* Daily use of AI coding agents as the primary mode of development, with sound judgement on what to accept, change or reject.
* A track record of raising team standards through code review and documentation, and of contributing reusable engineering patterns that others adopted.

**Education :**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred skills:**

* Prior experience as a Full Stack Engineer, Customer Engineer or Solutions Architect, ideally at an AI-native company or hyperscaler.
* Experience in regulated industries, such as life sciences, healthcare or financial services, and familiarity with GxP, GDPR and SOX.
* Working knowledge of fine-tuning fundamentals and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.

**Skills**
AI Platforms, AI Systems, Data Analysis, Full Stack Development, Machine Learning (ML), ML Platforms, Model Evaluation, Performance Analysis, Product Delivery, Product Design, Roadmap Development, Statistical Analysis
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
  
  
It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. You will be at the forefront of innovation, developing and implementing cutting-edge solutions that drive client success. Within our Software Engineering practice, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems and deliver impactful results.
  
  
As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections and navigate complex situations to deliver quality work. You will mentor junior team members, fostering their growth while enhancing your own personal brand and technical skills. Embracing ambiguity, you will use critical thinking to anticipate client needs and guide projects to successful outcomes.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to create software solutions that meet client objectives. Your ability to interpret data and provide insights will be crucial in shaping strategies and delivering value. This position offers a unique opportunity to deepen your understanding of business contexts and contribute to the firm's overall success.

* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to design and integrate enterprise application architectures
* Managing the application lifecycle, including development, testing, and deployment, to deliver quality software
* Utilizing microservices and API management to enhance system integration and functionality
* Conducting code reviews and adhering to coding standards to maintain software quality
* Applying analytical thinking to troubleshoot and resolve software issues efficiently
* Leading business process improvement initiatives through the application of digital tooling and software engineering methodologies
* Engaging in continuous integration and delivery practices to streamline software development processes
* Designing and executing quality assurance testing to validate software performance and reliability
* Building client relationships by effectively managing client requirements and expectations

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 4 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
* Demonstrating proficiency in Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD)
* Utilizing AI fluency and AI-human collaboration in projects
* Applying analytical thinking to solve complex software engineering challenges
* Developing applications using Java, Python, and C++ programming languages
* Managing continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) processes
* Excelling in client management and business process improvement strategies

title: Internship for Creative WordPress Developer
description:

* Create interactive website elements, animations, motion effects, and engaging visual experiences.
* Learn and work with 3D elements, animated objects, and interactive website components.
* Develop scroll-based animations, parallax effects, transitions, and micro-interactions.
* Explore and implement creative website experiences using GSAP, Three.js, WebGL, and Spline.
* Use Claude AI and Google Antigravity for AI-assisted coding, website development, prototyping, and debugging.
* Work on custom website sections, creative layouts, and interactive front-end functionalities.
* Convert design references and creative concepts into functional web experiences.
* Assist in WordPress development, Elementor customization, and front-end development.
* Learn website optimization, responsive design, performance improvement, and best development practices.
* Collaborate with designers and developers on real client projects.

* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Basic understanding of WordPress or website development.
* Interest in website animations, motion graphics, 3D design, and interactive experiences.
* Interest in AI-powered development tools such as Claude AI and Google Antigravity.
* Creative thinking, curiosity, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail.
* Passion for experimenting with new technologies and creating visually impressive websites.

**Who Can Apply?**

* Students, fresh graduates, or aspiring web developers.
* Candidates pursuing computer science, IT, web development, multimedia, design, or related fields.
* Beginners who have basic coding knowledge and a strong interest in creative web development.
* Candidates with personal projects, practice websites, or portfolios are encouraged to apply.

**What You Will Gain:**

* Hands-on experience working on real-world website projects.
* Practical exposure to interactive web development, 3D, animations, and motion graphics.
* Experience using AI-powered coding tools such as Claude AI and Google Antigravity.
* Opportunity to learn modern web technologies and creative development workflows.
* Mentorship and guidance from an experienced digital team.
* Internship certificate upon successful completion.
* Opportunity for a full-time position based on performance and available opportunities.

**How to Apply:**

Interested candidates can send their CV, portfolio, GitHub profile, or sample projects showcasing their website development, coding, creative designs, animations, or personal projects.

If you are passionate about creating websites that are interactive, animated, creative, and different from the ordinary, we would love to hear from you!
