title: Software Engineer
description:
**Security Engineer (Lead) — Own the Security Charter**

**Team:**
Engineering Platform ·
**Location:**
Gurgaon ·
**Level:**
Senior / Staff

**Why this role exists**

We run a consumer platform at scale: millions of logins a month, a large microservice fleet, sensitive customer PII under DPDP, an active HackerOne program, and a live cat-and-mouse with bots and scrapers. We also carry growing compliance obligations, from DPDP to IT general controls and external audits. Security and compliance today are spread across many hands. We want one owner who holds the charter, sets the standard, and builds both security and audit-readiness as a platform rather than a queue of tickets. You will lead from the front, write code, and be the person the org and the auditors trust.

**What you will own**

* **The security charter end to end.**
  Application security, cloud and infrastructure security, identity and access, data protection, and abuse and fraud defense. You set the roadmap and the bar.
* **Compliance and governance.**
  DPDP, IT general controls (ITGC), and the external audit and certification roadmap including ISO 27001 and SOC 2. You own control design, evidence, and audit outcomes, and make compliance a byproduct of good engineering rather than a parallel paperwork track.
* **The HackerOne program.**
  You own the metrics and the researcher relationship. Keep time-to-triage fast, decouple bounty payout from fix resolution, run a published severity-to-reward table, and turn findings into systemic fixes.
* **The application security toolchain.**
  SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, and secrets scanning, wired into CI as secure-by-default guardrails rather than blocking noise.
* **Vulnerability management.**
  A single pane for findings across sources, with severity-based remediation SLAs and honest reporting on what is open and aging.
* **Detection and incident response.**
  Security monitoring, alerting, and the playbooks to run a real incident calmly end to end.
* **Data protection and access governance.**
  PII decryption rights, access recertification, least-privilege, and blast-radius reduction, in step with the DPDP build. Turn today's manual access reviews into automated, auditable controls.
* **Abuse and bot defense.**
  Login and OTP abuse, credential stuffing, scraping, and the anti-bot stack. Keep legitimate users frictionless and attackers expensive.

**What you will do**

* **Platformise and solve.**
  Replace recurring manual work with durable systems. If a control is run by hand today, make it run itself, observably and reliably, including continuous control monitoring and automated evidence collection instead of a quarterly fire drill.
* **Threat-model and test.**
  Drive threat modeling for new systems, run security reviews across the SDLC, and commission or run penetration tests, so risk is found before it ships, not after.
* **Own audits and certifications.**
  Drive ISO 27001 and SOC 2 readiness and surveillance, run the ITGC control set across access, change management, and operations, and be the engineering face in front of auditors. Map every control to a real technical guardrail so evidence is a query, not a screenshot hunt.
* **Use GenAI aggressively.**
  Build AI into the function: LLM-assisted triage of reports and alerts, agentic detection and response, automated code review for vulnerability classes, AI-driven config and policy checks, and automated mapping of controls to audit frameworks and evidence. Treat GenAI as a force multiplier, and secure our own growing use of it.
* **Grow a security culture.**
  Run a security-champions model across engineering, raise the baseline through training and paved roads, and influence teams you do not own.
* **Lead from the front.**
  Write the hard code, run the tough incident, set the review standard.
* **Solve for the modern day.**
  Cloud-native and API-first security, mobile and OTP auth flows, event-driven systems, supply-chain integrity, and AI-era threats.
* **Measure and report.**
  Define the security and compliance SLOs and tell leadership the honest number: program health, risk posture, audit status, and where the gaps are.

**What makes you a fit**

* **6+ years in security engineering,**
  with real ownership of an application or product security function at scale.
* **You ship code**
  in a modern language such as Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript, and can read and fix real services, not just file findings.
* **Depth across the modern surface:**
  web and API security, authentication and session design, cloud security on AWS, GCP, or Azure, containers and Kubernetes, and secrets and identity.
* **Hands-on AppSec craft:**
  threat modeling, secure code review, and the SAST, DAST, SCA, and secret-scanning toolchain.
* **You have taken an org through audits:**
  ISO 27001, SOC 2, and ITGC, including control design, evidence, and sitting across the table from auditors.
* **You understand a privacy regime**
  such as DPDP or GDPR and its engineering implications, not just its legal text.
* **You have run or deeply engaged with a bug bounty program**
  and understand its metrics and economics.
* **You build platforms, not tickets,**
  and you already use GenAI to do security and compliance work faster.
* **You communicate to engineers, leadership, and auditors**
  with equal clarity, and you are calm and decisive in an incident.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with consumer-scale abuse, bot, and fraud defense.
* Prior work securing AI and LLM systems.
* A relevant certification such as OSCP, CISSP, CSSLP, or an ISO 27001 lead-implementer or lead-auditor credential.
* Exposure to PCI DSS, RBI norms, or other regulated-data standards.
* Experience automating a compliance program, such as continuous control monitoring or evidence-collection tooling.

**What success looks like**

* **90 days:**
  you own the charter, the HackerOne program, and the compliance roadmap; you have the real risk and audit picture; and program metrics are trending the right way.
* **6 months:**
  the top manual controls, security and compliance alike, are platformised and self-running, and the next audit cycle is on a continuous-evidence footing.
* **12 months:**
  security is a paved road engineers reach for by default, audits are routine rather than disruptive, and our posture, program metrics, and certifications are best-in-class for our peer set.

* Monitoring: Application and system performance metrics
* Alerting \& Incident Management: PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Slack integrations
* Logging: Centralized log management (ELK, Fluentd, Splunk)


 Bonus / Emerging Skills
   

  

* Serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions)
* GitOps (Flux, ArgoCD)
* AIOps and observability automation
* SRE principles (Service Level Indicators/Objectives)


 Cloud Observability Skills: Multi\-cloud monitoring, Cloud cost optimization, Cloud performance analysis, Cloud\-native troubleshooting, Cloud security observability
   

  

 Tools: Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, Azure Application Insights, AWS CloudWatch, AWS X\-Ray, GCP Operations Suite, Datadog Cloud Monitoring, Dynatrace Cloud Automation
   

  

 Skills: Network flow analysis, Packet analytics, WAN observability, SD\-WAN monitoring, Network performance management, Network anomaly detection
   

  

 Tools: ThousandEyes, SolarWinds NPM, Cisco AppDynamics Network Monitoring, Riverbed
   

  

 Observability: SCOM, SolarWinds, Datadog Infrastructure Monitoring, Dynatrace Infrastructure, VMware Aria Operations, Turbonomic
   

  

**Additional Information**
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills
* Collaboration with developers, QA, and IT teams
* Understanding agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
* Continuous learning and adapting to new tools and cloud services
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment

We are seeking an AI-Centric Full Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and support modern software solutions with a strong focus on AI-enabled applications and intelligent automation. This role goes beyond simply using AI coding assistants. You will have strong understanding of Prompt Engineering, Vibe Coding, Rework Rate Reduction and leverage Custom Agents, and integrations built around the Model Context Protocol (MCP). You will apply strong software engineering fundamentals to assemble, integrate, and operationalize AI capabilities into real production systems being accountable for Full-Stack solutions.

The goal of this role is to significantly shorten development and feedback cycles by automating routine engineering work, augmenting human decision-making, and embedding intelligence directly into our development workflows and the applications we deliver!

**What You’ll Do:**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable full stack applications and platform services. Own software solutions end-to-end, including system design, architecture, implementation, testing, observability, deployment, and lifecycle support.
* Develop and implement custom AI agents to support workflow automation, decision support, summarization, and multi-step reasoning capabilities.
* Integrate AI services, large language models (LLMs), embeddings, search technologies, and external tools through secure and scalable APIs.
* Build and maintain MCP-based integrations to enable structured communication between AI models, tools, and business systems.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable, maintainable, and scalable solutions.
* Apply AI-assisted development practices while ensuring code quality, architectural integrity, security, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
* Harden AI components for 24x7 critical physical manufacturing systems with attention to reliability and resiliency, latency and performance, security, permissions, and data boundaries, and observability and maintainability

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* 3+ years of experience developing production grade full stack or backend software applications, including API design, service integration, and data persistence.
* Hands on experience with cloud-native technologies, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and Kubernetes based deployments.
* Experience working with both relational and NoSQL databases, including data modeling and storage architecture design.
* Proven experience designing, developing, and deploying AI-enabled applications, including custom AI agents and RAG-based systems.
* Demonstrated experience with prompt engineering and Vibe Coding Prototypes, AI tool integration, and evaluating AI system reliability, security, and failure modes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience building enterprise-scale distributed applications in cloud environments.
* Experience building and integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable: Structured context sharing between models, tools, and agents; Tool and capability exposure to LLM‑based agents; Interoperability across AI components without hard‑coded integrations
* Proficiency with modern technology stacks such as C#, ASP.NET, Angular, SQL, NoSQL, and Kubernetes.
* Experience developing AI agent skills, tool invocation frameworks, and multi-agent workflow solutions.
* Strong understanding of prompt engineering, context window management, chain-of-thought design, and AI workflow optimization.
* Experience architecting highly available, critical systems with focus on performance, resiliency, observability, and security.
* Track record of leading architecture discussions, conducting code reviews, and establishing engineering standards and guidelines.

Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. * Automate provisioning, configuration, deployment, and operational processes.
* Contribute to platform engineering standards, reference architectures, and technical roadmaps.
* Support onboarding of applications and workloads onto Azure platform services.

DevSecOps & Cloud Security
  
  

* Embed security controls and practices across the software development and delivery lifecycle.
* Design and maintain security guardrails for Azure workloads and platform services.

* Azure Policy
* Management Groups
* Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
* Landing Zones
* Compliance and regulatory controls

* Implement and maintain security benchmarks and standards (e.g., Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark, CIS Azure Foundations Benchmark, industry best practices).
* Partner with security, architecture, and engineering teams to continuously improve cloud security posture.

DevOps & Automation
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and related tooling.

* Promote Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and automation-first operating models.
* Support development teams in adopting DevSecOps practices and secure engineering standards.
* Evaluate and introduce new tools and technologies to improve platform capabilities and developer experience.

Operations & Service Management
  
  

* Participate as a member of the L4 support team for Azure platform services, including ticket dispatching and resolution activities.
* Occasionally perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
* Collaborate with support and operations teams to maintain platform reliability and service excellence.
* Contribute to operational documentation, knowledge management, and continuous service improvement initiatives.

Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineers within the team.
* Support capability development through coaching, knowledge sharing, and best practices.
* Collaborate effectively with stakeholders across Europe, India, and other global locations.
* Participate in Agile delivery frameworks, including Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid operating models.

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.

title: Senior Principal - Platform Architect Segmentation
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Platform Architect owns the technical design of GSK's network segmentation and security platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations.
  
  
The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Platform architecture in the relevant domain, covering reference architecture, patterns, standards and design assurance.
* Security and resilience by design, including AI reference patterns and GxP considerations where applicable.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 yearsTypically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace.
* Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard.
* Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context.
* Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet.
* Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations.
* Extensive experience designing enterprise network security and segmentation services.
* Deep knowledge of identity based access, firewalls, microsegmentation and secure zones across information and operational technology.
* Evidence of defining segmentation architectures that improved control coverage, risk reduction or secure access.

**Skills/Background**

* Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented.
* Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard.
* Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them.
* Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome.
* Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright.
* Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform.

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
Automation Technology, AWS Security Services, Cloud Based Services, Cloud Network Architecture, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Enterprise Network Security, Enterprise Security Architecture, Identity Governance, IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Network Architecture, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust, Zero Trust Architecture
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

title: CTO
description:
**Join as CTO**

**Location:**
Mumbai, India (Work from Office)

**Engagement:**
Full-time

**Compensation:**
Meaningful Equity Participation

We're building Oohpoint, AdTech platform, connecting real-world consumer attention with measurable digital engagement, attribution and audience intelligence.

I'm looking for a young, ambitious technology builder who wants to take ownership of a startup's entire technology journey - from architecture and engineering to product innovation and scaling.

This is not a managerial position. I'm looking for someone who loves building, solving complex problems, experimenting with technology and taking products from 0 to 1.

The Opportunity

You'll take complete ownership of Oohpoint's technology and work directly with the founder to build and evolve the platform into scalable AdTech infrastructure.

I'm particularly interested in:

* Founding engineers and early-stage startup builders.
* Developers who have independently built and shipped products.
* Engineers with strong full-stack or backend expertise.
* Young technical entrepreneurs looking to build something of their own.

**Ideal experience: 4–5 years.**
Strong builders with exceptional independent projects or startup experience are also encouraged to apply.

What You'll Own

**1. Technology & Architecture**

* Own technology vision, architecture and engineering roadmap.
* Design scalable, secure and reliable systems.
* Strengthen existing product architecture.
* Make decisions around infrastructure, databases, APIs and technology choices.

**2. Product Engineering**

* Take ownership of the existing platform and its evolution.
* Build campaign engines, integrations and core product capabilities.
* Lead frontend, backend and application development.
* Ensure performance, reliability and scalability.

**3. Data, AI & AdTech Innovation**

* Explore AI/ML-driven targeting and campaign optimisation.
* Build audience intelligence, attribution and measurement capabilities.
* Experiment with advertising technology formats and integrations.

**4. Infrastructure & Engineering**

* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment, monitoring and security.
* Establish engineering standards and development processes.
* Build reliable systems for growing campaign volumes and users.

**5. Technical Leadership**

* Work directly with the founder on product strategy and execution.
* Take independent technical decisions and accountability.
* Build and mentor the engineering team as we grow.
* Stay hands-on with development while owning the larger technology vision.

What I'm Looking For
  

* 4–5 years of hands-on technology experience.
* Strong understanding of system design and application architecture.
* Experience with full-stack development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
* Ability to independently build and ship production-ready products.
* Strong problem-solving and engineering fundamentals.
* Interest in AI, data systems, analytics and emerging AdTech.
* Comfortable working in an early-stage startup with ownership and accountability.

**A strong preference for builders over managers.**

AdTech / MarTech / SaaS experience is a plus, particularly in campaign management, audience targeting, attribution, analytics or marketing technology.

What We Offer

* Founding CTO position with ownership of the entire technology direction.
* Meaningful equity participation.
* Direct collaboration with the founder on business and product strategy.
* Opportunity to build technology from an early stage.
* A chance to build something ambitious in India's evolving AdTech ecosystem.

How to Apply
  

If you've built something independently, shipped a product, experimented with technology or always wanted to build a startup, I'd love to hear from you.

Please share:

* LinkedIn profile and CV.
* GitHub / portfolio / products you've built.
* One or two examples of products or systems you've personally built and taken to production.
* Your technical strengths and experience.
* Why you want to build Oohpoint.

**Email:**
pankaj@oohpoint.com

Or DM me directly on LinkedIn

description:

Technical Support Engineer (Inference)
  
  
Pune or Bangalore, India
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Technical Support Engineer at a pioneering AI company, you'll be the first line of defense to support customers as they build out training, fine tuning, and inference solutions with Together AI. You'll dive deep into complex technical challenges, providing swift and effective solutions while serving as a product expert. As a part of the Customer Experience organization, you will collaborate closely with product and sales, driving continuous improvement of our offerings. This is an exciting opportunity for a deeply technical professional passionate about AI and customer success to make a significant impact in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
  
  
**Required Hours**

* This is a fulltime position working India daytime hours, from Monday-Friday.

**Responsibilities**

* Engage directly with customers to tackle and resolve complex technical challenges involving our cutting-edge GPU clusters and our inference and fine-tuning services; ensure swift and effective solutions every time.
* Act as a customer facing SRE to ensure our customer’s Inference endpoints (running on Kubernetes) remain healthy, stable, and performant
* Become a product expert in all of our Gen AI solutions, serving as the last line of technical defense before issues are escalated to Engineering and Product teams.
* Assist with hardware and platform migrations by validating system health and traffic routing. Monitor dashboards to detect anomalies and escalate with data-backed analysis
* Manage customer-facing communications during incidents and degradations; translate deep technical findings (latency regressions, provider issues, network reachability drops) into clear, evidence-backed updates without exposing platform internals
* Contribute infrastructure changes for model deployment, capacity rebalancing, and cluster configuration. You will execute infrastructure changes via pull requests (infra-as-code) for tasks such as endpoint configuration, model bringup/bringdown, and capacity scaling
* Flag engine-level bugs with logs and reproduction steps for engineering
* Collaborate seamlessly across Engineering, Research, and Product teams to address customer concerns; collaborate with senior leaders both internally and externally to ensure the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
* Transform customer insights into action by identifying patterns in support cases and working with Engineering and Go-To-Market teams to drive Together’s roadmap (e.g., future models to support)
* Maintain detailed documentation of system configurations, procedures, troubleshooting guides, and FAQs to facilitate knowledge sharing with team and customers.
* Be flexible in providing support coverage during holidays, nights and weekends as required by business needs to ensure consistent and reliable service for our customers.

**Requirements**

* 6+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, with at least 1 year in a support role for an AI service
* Strong technical background, with knowledge of AI, ML, GPU technologies and their integration into high-performance computing (HPC) environments.
* Advanced, production-level experience with infrastructure services (e.g., Kubernetes, SLURM), infrastructure as code solutions (e.g., Ansible) high-performance network fabrics, NFS-based storage management, and container infrastructure
* Familiarity with operating storage systems in HPC environments such as Vast and Weka
* Proven ability to diagnose complex network-layer issues and read traces
* Strong knowledge of Python, TypeScript, and/or JavaScript with testing/debugging experience using curl and Postman-like tools
* Demonstrated expertise with observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) at scale
* Deep familiarity with REST API debugging and HTTP semantics
* Experience with LLM inference frameworks and LoRA fine-tuning and common training failure modes
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and Git-based workflows
* Background in GPU cluster management
* Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure)
* Foundational understanding in the installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, and securing of compute clusters.
* Complex technical problem solving and troubleshooting, with a proactive approach to issue resolution
* Ability to work cross-functionally with teams such as Sales, Engineering, Support, Product and Research to drive customer success.
* Strong sense of ownership and willingness to learn new skills to ensure both team and customer success.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to operate in dynamic environments, adept at managing multiple projects, and comfortable with frequent context switching and prioritization.

**About Together AI**
Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.
  
  
**Compensation**
We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and other benefits, as well as flexibility in terms of remote work for the respective hiring region. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.
  
  
**Application Policy**
Please read each role carefully and apply to the position best suited to you. Candidates are limited to 6 applications within a 90-day period, and applications beyond that limit will be automatically rejected. You may apply to additional roles 90 days after your last application.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

title: Subject Matter Expert, ETM Connectors & Integrations
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
Job Title
  
  
Subject Matter Expert (SME) - Connectors and Integrations, Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM)
  
  
**Job Summary**
Qualys Connectors and Integrations Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) are the product experts on how Qualys Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) connects with third-party applications. You will bring extensive knowledge of the Qualys platform and of integration technologies, and use it to show customers how connectors bring cloud, endpoint, identity, application security, ITSM and CMDB data into the Qualys Risk Operations Center (ROC), and how that risk data flows back to the tools they already run. Your guidance supports strategic and operational business requirements across asset and vulnerability management, remediation and threat intelligence on the Qualys Enterprise TruRisk Platform.
  
  
This is a highly visible role and an excellent opportunity for career advancement and significant impact. It requires close collaboration with customers, sales and product management. In the post-sales segment, you will support Account Managers with in-depth platform expertise, strengthening customer relationships and fostering upsell opportunities. A core part of the role is working extensively with customers on ETM proofs of concept (POCs) and implementations, bringing data in from their external tools into Qualys ETM and showing how Qualys fits into their existing security and IT stack. In pre-sales, you will also run demos that show the value of these integrations. Your command of Qualys solutions and integration technologies will let you propose tailored solutions that drive renewals and wider use of the platform.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Integration expertise**

* Deep understanding of integration: APIs, authentication protocols and integration security best practices
* Hands-on experience using APIs
* Knowledge of data normalization, transformation and sync mechanisms in connector development
* Experience with integration platforms (for example MuleSoft, Boomi, Jitterbit or custom integration frameworks)

**Connector domains (working knowledge of several)**

* Cloud security: CSPM connectors for AWS, Azure, GCP and OCI, and cloud security platforms such as Wiz and Prisma Cloud
* Endpoint, EDR and identity: CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Microsoft Entra ID and Okta
* AppSec, DAST and CI/CD: Snyk, Checkmarx, Veracode, Burp Suite, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins and Azure DevOps
* ITSM, CMDB, SIEM and SOAR: ServiceNow, Jira, BMC Helix and Splunk

**Customer engagement and communication**

* Direct customer engagement experience, including technical workshops, demos and solution/architecture discussions
* Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills; a strong communicator in writing, speech and presentations
* Background in solution engineering, product development, business analysis, integration architecture or implementation consulting

**Responsibilities**
A core part of this role is working extensively with customers on Qualys ETM proofs of concept (POCs) and implementations, bringing data in from external tools into Qualys ETM through connectors.
  
  
**ETM POCs and implementations (core focus)**

* Work extensively with customers throughout ETM POCs and implementations to bring data in from their external tools into Qualys ETM
* Scope each POC or implementation with the customer: which external tools to onboard (cloud, endpoint and EDR, identity, application/mobile security and CI/CD, ITSM, CMDB, SIEM), what data to bring in, success criteria and timelines
* Guide customers hands-on through connector setup, including authentication, API access, permissions and integration security

title: Sr Data Scientist
description:
**This is where**
your work makes a difference.
  
  
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
  
  
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
  
  
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. 
  
  
**Your role at Baxter**

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Data Scientist to join Baxter’s Enterprise Data Analytics team. This strategic role will help transform business functions through advanced analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and data-driven decision-making.
  
  
 
  
  
As a senior member of the Enterprise Data Science team, you will lead the end-to-end design, development, deployment, and adoption of scalable data science and AI solutions across multiple business domains. You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to frame high-value opportunities, translate business needs into analytical solutions, and deliver measurable outcomes while promoting responsible AI, engineering excellence, and reusable capabilities.
  
  
 
  
  
**What you’ll be doing**


* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of advanced analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions—from opportunity identification and experimentation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into well-defined data science hypotheses, solution designs, success metrics, and scalable implementation roadmaps.
* Develop and maintain advanced predictive /forecasting models for sales, revenue, expense management, and cash-flow forecasting.
* Design, architect, train, and deploy advanced machine-learning frameworks and traditional time-series models to improve forecast accuracy for sales, revenue, operating expenses, and cash flow.
* Own model validation, explainability, reliability, documentation, monitoring, and governance in line with responsible AI and regulatory expectations.
* Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, standards definition, and hands-on resolution of complex analytical challenges.
* Communicate analytical findings, business implications, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.
* Foster a mindset of active learning and innovation by exploring emerging AI technologies and adopting solutions that deliver business value.

**What you’ll bring**

Experience
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in data science, machine learning, or applied AI, including experience leading complex enterprise initiatives.
* Strong hands-on record of designing, developing, and deploying production-grade machine learning, Generative AI, or Agentic AI solutions.
* Experience working with large, complex, and distributed datasets in enterprise environments.

Core Technical Skills
  

* Programming and distributed computing: advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark, with strong expertise in relevant libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and NLP libraries.
* Machine learning and statistics: regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, time-series analysis, experimentation, optimization, ensemble methods, and model evaluation.
* Deep learning and Generative AI: hands-on experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, LLM application patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, evaluation, guardrails, and agentic workflows.
* Hands-on experience building autonomous AI agents and implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool-integration patterns.
* Cloud and AI platforms: strong hands-on experience with AWS machine-learning services, including Amazon SageMaker and Amazon Bedrock.
* ML engineering and operationalization: experience packaging, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining production models and AI services using APIs, containers, model registries, automated testing, observability, and retraining workflows.

Domain Experience
  

* Experience applying data science and AI across Finance, FinTech, Sales, Supply Chain, and Healthcare; ability to transfer methods and insights across domains is essential.
* Ability to explain complex machine-learning outputs, financial drivers, and business implications to cross-functional teams and stakeholders without “black box” ambiguity.

Good to Have
  

* Experience in healthcare, commercial, supply chain, or financial analytics environments.
* Good understanding of statistical forecasting methodologies, time-series analysis, and error metric evaluations.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models and contributing to product-oriented data science teams.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to translate technical concepts into clear decisions, trade-offs, and outcomes for non-technical stakeholders.
* Certifications: An industry-recognized professional certification in data science or AI, or completion of a top-tier data science executive program, is a strong advantage.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

* Seeks opportunities to gain knowledge and learn new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices. Utilizes feedback and training to improve skills. Participates in a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.

title: IT Solution Architect – SAP Plant Maintenance (PM)
description:

As a key architecture partner for Global Process Owners, business stakeholders, and delivery teams, you will provide technical leadership and architectural governance across projects, enhancements, and strategic transformation initiatives. You will work across SAP Plant Maintenance and Enterprise Asset Management (PM/EAM), SAP Service and Asset Manager (SSAM), scheduling, calibration, and related technologies, ensuring solutions support long-term business objectives, operational efficiency, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
This is an office-first role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).
  
  
**What You Will Get**

* An agile career and dynamic working culture.
* An inclusive and ethical workplace.
* Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
* Opportunities to shape solution architecture across Lonza's global Acquire to Retire landscape.
* Exposure to global SAP transformation, S/4HANA modernization, asset management, maintenance, and manufacturing initiatives.
* Opportunities to work with business-critical solutions supporting Plant Maintenance, Calibration, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality processes.
* Professional growth through architecture leadership, business transformation, and complex solution design initiatives.
* Collaboration with Global Process Owners, business stakeholders, Enterprise Architects, Quality teams, and leading technology partners.
* A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

**What You Will Do**

* Define, maintain, and evolve solution architectures supporting the Acquire to Retire (A2R) process landscape.
* Design end-to-end application, integration, data, and technology solutions that align with business requirements, enterprise architecture principles, and target-state technology landscapes.
* Evaluate solution alternatives and recommend optimal architecture approaches considering scalability, maintainability, security, performance, compliance, and long-term business value.
* Develop solution architecture roadmaps that support business strategy, technology modernization, and process transformation objectives.
* Provide architectural leadership for high-impact and complex applications supporting business-critical processes including Plant Maintenance, Calibration, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality.
* Assess the efficiency and business impact of end-to-end process designs, including dependencies and implications across connected business processes and technology platforms.
* Review and approve solution designs for projects, enhancements, integrations, and technology changes, ensuring adherence to architecture standards and design principles.
* Identify and mitigate architecture risks, integration challenges, and technical debt while supporting sustainable technology lifecycle decisions.
* Provide architecture governance for complex solutions within regulated environments, ensuring alignment with GxP requirements and Computer System Validation practices.
* Partner with Global Process Owners and business leaders to translate strategic priorities and business capabilities into technology solutions and architecture roadmaps.
* Act as a subject matter expert for SAP PM/EAM and SAP Service and Asset Manager (SSAM), advising stakeholders on relevant SAP ECC and S/4HANA capabilities and their impact on business processes.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand processes and operational challenges, providing thought leadership on how SAP solutions and industry best practices can support business transformation.
* Drive the adoption of SAP best practices, standardized solutions, and modern technology capabilities across the A2R landscape.
* Lead the design of integrated solutions within the SAP landscape, including SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori, SAP Business Technology Platform, mobile technologies, and related enterprise applications.
* Define and maintain solution architecture artifacts, process flows, functional specifications, interface requirements, and supporting design documentation.
* Lead architecture activities throughout project and enhancement lifecycles, supporting estimation, planning, design reviews, implementation, deployment, and transition into operations.

* Resolve complex technical, integration, and cross-functional architecture issues across the A2R ecosystem.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and architecture patterns and recommend adoption where they can deliver measurable business and technology value.
* Provide architectural direction to external service providers, implementation partners, and solution vendors.
* Review partner deliverables to ensure alignment with architecture standards, regulatory requirements, quality expectations, and target-state designs.
* Support technology selection and vendor evaluation activities and influence external partners to achieve desired architectural outcomes.
* Leverage internal and external technology knowledge to benchmark solution designs and identify opportunities to continuously improve architecture practices.

**What We Are Looking For**

* At least 10 years of experience designing, implementing, and evolving SAP solutions within SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments, with significant experience in SAP Plant Maintenance / Enterprise Asset Management (PM/EAM).
* Strong experience with SAP Service and Asset Manager (SSAM) and mobile maintenance solutions.
* Deep understanding of asset management, plant maintenance, maintenance execution, and associated end-to-end business processes.
* Hands-on experience across key SAP PM/EAM capabilities, including: Equipment Functional Locations Notifications Work Orders Preventive Maintenance Plans Asset Hierarchies SAP S/4HANA Asset Management Fiori Apps for Maintenance SAP S/4HANA Asset Management for Resource Scheduling (RSH) Mobile Maintenance Solutions
* Strong understanding of integration between SAP PM/EAM and other SAP modules, including Materials Management (MM), Asset Accounting, Project Systems (PS), Production Planning (PP), and Environment, Health and Safety (EHS).
* Knowledge of SAP Fiori, SAP Business Technology Platform, and other modern SAP technologies supporting asset and maintenance management.
* Strong background in SAP configuration, solution enhancement, troubleshooting, and application lifecycle management.
* Experience designing end-to-end SAP solutions and integrations that enable seamless data flow and sustainable business processes.
* Proven ability to analyze complex business processes and requirements and translate them into scalable, practical, and sustainable technology solutions.
* Experience leading solution architecture and design governance across complex projects, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, architecture governance, security, integration, and target-state technology landscapes.
* Experience working with business-critical applications supporting Manufacturing, Plant Maintenance, Calibration, Supply Chain, and Quality processes.
* Knowledge of Computer System Validation (CSV), GxP processes, and validation lifecycle activities within regulated environments, including IQ, OQ, and PQ.

* Strong experience providing architectural direction to implementation partners, technology vendors, and external service providers.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to assess complex technical and business dependencies.

* Ability to collaborate effectively with Global Process Owners, business stakeholders, technology teams, Quality functions, and external partners in a global environment.

title: R And CT-RCT-FRONTEND JAVA ENGINEER-SENIOR
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Career Family**
Full-stack Engineer
  
  
**Role Type**
Full Time
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Risk and Compliance Engineering Team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Risk Management, Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. Through diverse experiences, world-class learning and individually tailored coaching you will experience ongoing professional development. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
  
  
We’re lookin
**g**
for a Full-stack Engineer (front-end focussed) at EY GDS. You will work on designing and implementing modern web applications with a focus on front-end development using Angular or React.js with TypeScript. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build, deploy, and manage scalable back-end services, APIs, and database integrations that meet business needs and leverage best practices in full-stack development and cloud technologies. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering. We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial and non-financial services marketplace. Join Digital Engineering team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective.
  
  
EY Risk and Compliance Engineering is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Risk and Compliance Engineering (RCE) practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also have a unique ability to help our clients translate strategy into actionable technical design, and transformation planning/mobilization. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY’s RCE team helps our clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Front-End Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using React, TypeScript and Java-based technologies.
* API Integration: Work with REST APIs and GraphQL services for data integration.
* Back-End Development: Develop and maintain backend services and APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture.
* CI/CD Management: Manage and optimize CI/CD pipelines, preferably using Azure DevOps.
* Collaboration: Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Technology Updates: Stay updated with emerging web technologies and apply best practices in performance and security.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Required Skills:**

* 4+ years of experience in full-stack application development with strong expertise in React and Java technologies.
* Strong hands-on experience with React.js, TypeScript, and modern front-end development practices.
* Deep understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), responsive design, and browser compatibility.
* Experience with state management libraries, component-driven architecture, reusable UI development, and front-end performance optimization.
* Strong proficiency in Core Java (Java 8+) and object-oriented programming principles.
* Hands-on experience with Multithreading, Concurrency, Collections Framework, Java Streams, and Functional Programming concepts.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous programming using CompletableFuture, Executor Framework, and Thread Pools.
* Good knowledge of JVM internals, memory management, garbage collection, and performance tuning.
* Extensive experience in developing enterprise applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Data JPA.
* Experience in designing and developing Microservices-based architectures.
* Strong understanding of RESTful Web Services, API design standards, and integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience implementing application security using OAuth2, JWT, and role-based access controls.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar technologies.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Strong proficiency with Git and modern source control practices.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Domain: Prior experience in the Financial Services / FS Risk domain.
* Agile Methodologies: Familiarity with Agile development practices and methodologies.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues
* Familiarity with AI/GenAI concepts, such as LLM fundamentals and prompt engineering. Ability to work with AI APIs or AI-powered components in application development.

**Education:**
**Degree:**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr. Staff AI Architect
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
**About Company:**
ThermoFisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with revenues of more than $25 billion and approximately 1,30,000 employees globally. We help our customers accelerate life sciences research, solve elite analytical challenges, improve patient diagnostics, deliver medicines to market, and increase laboratory efficiency.
  
  
Through our world-class brands—Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, and Unity Lab Services—we offer an unmatched combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience, and comprehensive services.
  
  
**About Team:**
We are the Digital Foundation Platform team - the software center of excellence (CoE) for Thermo Fisher Scientific. We are responsible for developing and delivering foundational components and SaaS-based applications and digital lab (Cloud-based) tools, foundational AI and AI agentic solutions, to help scientists do their work more efficiently and with precision, enabling them to make our world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Our elite software products and solutions accelerate scientific discovery and lab productivity. These solutions
  
  

* Provide rich content, selection tools, teamwork tools, and scientific apps that allow our customers to focus on innovation and the complexities of their science.
* Build a connected world for our customers where discoveries happen in a thoughtful way — where every device/product is connected, self-aware, and self-healing—thereby enabling efficient workflows and collaborative science.
* Enable our customers to efficiently handle their labs by providing them with insight into workflow processes, asset uptime, and product availability.

We give them the flexibility to access what they need when they need it, allowing them to select and receive products and services across multiple channels. We apply industry-standard methodologies to the design, development, and deployment of best-in-class software products built to demonstrate the power and scalability of the cloud.
  
  
**Purpose:**
The Senior Staff Architect provides
**enterprise-wide architectural, design, and technical leadership**
for Generative AI and agentic AI solutions across multiple Scrum teams. As a strategic technical leader and hands-on architect, you will define the architecture, standards, and roadmap for an enterprise
**agentic harness**
that enables agents to reason, plan, use tools, access knowledge, maintain state, collaborate, and operate safely at scale.
  
  
The role requires deep expertise in designing
**production-grade agentic systems**
, cloud-native platforms, RAG architectures, LLM integrations, and AI engineering practices. You will influence platform strategy, mentor architects and engineers, and ensure AI-driven systems are
**scalable, secure, resilient, observable, governable, and production-ready**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership, Architecture & Design**

* Provide enterprise architecture leadership for Generative AI and agentic AI platforms across multiple teams.
* Define the architecture and roadmap for a reusable agentic harness and runtime platform.
* Own high-level and low-level system design, including component architecture, data flows, integration patterns, deployment topologies, and runtime interactions.
* Design and evolve cloud-native, event-driven, API-first, and distributed architectures for AI-enabled products.
* Define reference architectures, design standards, and best practices for:

+ Agentic systems
+ Multi-agent orchestration
+ RAG and knowledge-grounded agents
+ Tool and function execution
+ Agent memory and state management
+ Human-in-the-loop workflows
+ Agent-to-Agent communication

* Define architecture patterns for agent planning, task decomposition, reasoning, execution, retries, timeouts, compensation, and failure recovery.
* Establish standards for agent lifecycle management, including agent creation, versioning, testing, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retirement.
* Act as the go-to authority for architecture, design trade-offs, scalability decisions, and complex implementation challenges.
* Ensure architectural decisions address Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs), including performance, scalability, security, reliability, privacy, governance, cost, and observability.
* Lead architecture reviews, design reviews, technical investigations, and architecture decision records.

**Agentic AI and Generative AI Engineering**

* Design and implement agentic systems using LangGraph, LangChain, and comparable orchestration frameworks.
* Architect the core capabilities of an agentic harness, including:

+ Agent runtime and execution management
+ Planning and task orchestration
+ Tool registry and tool discovery
+ Function calling and API integration
+ Agent memory and context management
+ Workflow state persistence
+ Multi-agent collaboration
+ Human approvals and intervention
+ Guardrails and policy enforcement
+ Execution tracing, auditability, and replay

* Design model-agnostic architectures supporting Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and local models using Ollama.
* Define model routing, fallback, provider abstraction, latency optimization, token management, and cost-control strategies.
* Architect and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and response synthesis.
* Integrate agents with APIs, enterprise systems, scientific applications, structured data, knowledge graphs, and domain ontologies.
* Apply advanced prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool-calling, memory patterns, and context optimization techniques.
* Define safe and reliable patterns for autonomous and semi-autonomous agent execution.

**Agent Evaluation, LLMOps & Production Excellence**

* Define automated testing and evaluation strategies for agentic and GenAI systems.
* Establish evaluation frameworks for:

+ Task completion
+ Tool-use accuracy
+ Response correctness
+ Grounding and retrieval quality
+ Safety and policy compliance
+ Robustness and recovery
+ Latency and cost

* Design regression testing for prompts, models, tools, workflows, and agent behaviors.
* Define observability standards using execution traces, agent steps, tool calls, model interactions, latency, token usage, cost, and failure metrics.
* Establish mechanisms for agent debugging, replay, inspection, and root-cause analysis.
* Define secure deployment, monitoring, governance, and operational practices for AI systems.
* Ensure production systems support reliability, scalability, disaster recovery, data protection, and compliance requirements.

**Development Excellence**

* Actively contribute to hands-on development using Python and modern backend frameworks such as FastAPI.
* Build reference implementations and reusable platform components for the agentic harness.
* Design and build well-structured, maintainable, and extensible APIs supporting AI, agent, and data-driven workloads.
* Define service boundaries, integration contracts, data models, workflow interfaces, and event schemas.
* Implement performance, scalability, security, and observability patterns for distributed AI services.
* Guide the use of PostgreSQL, pgvector, Qdrant, event streaming, caching, and persistent workflow storage.
* Promote clean code, automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, and engineering quality standards.

**Collaboration, Mentorship & Culture**

* Mentor and guide architects, staff engineers, and senior engineers on:

+ Agentic architecture
+ Distributed systems
+ System design
+ GenAI engineering
+ Evaluation and observability

* Influence technical direction across multiple Scrum teams and product areas.
* Lead Communities of Practice focused on agentic AI, GenAI architecture, and AI engineering excellence.
* Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders through clear documentation, architecture diagrams, design reviews, and technical presentations.
* Partner with product, security, platform, data, and engineering leadership to align agentic AI capabilities with business and scientific objectives.
* Anticipate architectural risks and opportunities and guide the organization through technology evolution.

**Candidate Requirements**
**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Master’s degree in Computer Science with
**15+ years of proven industry experience**
, including significant experience in software architecture, platform engineering, and technical leadership.
  
  
**Mandatory Skills, Knowledge & Experience**
**Core Engineering and Architecture**

* Enterprise Architecture: Proven experience defining architecture and technical strategy across multiple products or engineering teams.
* Python Backend Development: 8+ years of experience building scalable backend systems and RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI.
* Distributed Systems: Strong knowledge of microservices, event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, messaging, caching, and workflow orchestration.
* API Design & Integration: Strong experience with API lifecycle management, authentication, authorization, service-to-service communication, and integration patterns.
* Cloud-Native Architecture: Experience designing scalable and resilient solutions on Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Version Control & CI/CD: Proficiency with Git, automated delivery pipelines, infrastructure automation, and release management.
* Testing & Automation: Experience with pytest, unittest, integration testing, contract testing, and automated quality strategies.
* Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and engineering decisions across multiple teams without relying solely on organizational authority.

**Agentic AI, RAG & LLMs**

* Deep hands-on experience designing and implementing agentic AI systems and agentic harnesses.
* Strong experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or comparable agent orchestration frameworks.
* Practical experience with:

+ Agent planning and task decomposition
+ Tool and function calling
+ Multi-agent coordination
+ Agent memory and state management
+ Human-in-the-loop workflows
+ Guardrails and policy enforcement
+ Retry, recovery, and failure handling
+ Agent execution tracing and replay

* Experience integrating LLMs using Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and local inference platforms such as Ollama.
* Strong prompt engineering skills, including structured prompting, few-shot learning, prompt versioning, context management, and output validation.
* Experience implementing RAG architectures, embeddings, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, grounding, and citation patterns.
* Hands-on experience with vector databases such as PostgreSQL with pgvector and Qdrant.
* Experience with model routing, fallback strategies, token optimization, latency management, and LLM cost control.

**Agent Evaluation, Observability & Governance**

* Experience evaluating nondeterministic AI and agentic systems in production-like environments.
* Knowledge of evaluation-driven development, golden datasets, regression testing, and quality metrics for agents.
* Experience implementing observability for prompts, model calls, tool calls, agent steps, workflow state, latency, token usage, and cost.
* Understanding of AI security, data privacy, access control, responsible AI, auditability, and governance.
* Experience with LLMOps, model gateways, prompt management, model evaluation, monitoring, and deployment governance.

**Data Engineering & Knowledge Systems**

* Design and manage data stores and vector indexes supporting GenAI and RAG workloads using PostgreSQL, pgvector, and Qdrant.
* Strong data engineering skills, including ETL pipelines, data ingestion, preprocessing, metadata management, and large-scale data processing.
* Experience integrating structured data, knowledge graphs, and domain ontologies with agentic systems.
* Expertise in Pandas, NumPy, and Python data-processing libraries.

**Ways of Working**

* 5+ years of experience working in Agile/Scrum or comparable product development environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex architecture and AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring senior engineers, architects, and technical leads.

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Cloud Platforms: Azure preferred, including AKS, managed identity, Azure AI services, eventing, security, and monitoring.
* Agent Protocols: Experience with MCP, Agent-to-Agent communication protocols, or comparable tool and agent interoperability standards.
