title: Lead Engineer - Ad Tech
description:
**About Us**
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.
  
  
Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.
  
  
**Overview About TII**
At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.
  
  
**Team Overview**
Roundel is Target’s entry into the media business with an impact of $1B+; an advertising sell-side business built on the principles of first-party, people-based data, brand-safe content environments and proof that our marketing programs drive business results for our clients.
  
  
We are here to drive business growth for our clients and redefine “value” in the industry by solving core industry challenges rather than simply replicating existing industry methods of operation. Roundel is a key growth initiative for Target and aims to lead the industry toward a better way of operating within the media marketplace.
  
  
Target Tech is on a mission to offer the systems, tools and support that our clients, guests and team members need and deserve. We drive industry-leading technologies in support of every angle of the business and help ensure that Target operates smoothly, securely and reliably from the inside out.
  
  
As part of this evolution, we are building intelligent platforms for retail media space like ad decisioning, bidding, ad explanations etc. that combine traditional software engineering with Large Language Models, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs and agentic architectures to solve complex business and engineering problems at scale.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a
**Lead Engineer (Ad Tech & Applied AI)**
, you will provide technical leadership across backend platforms and emerging AI-powered capabilities.
  
  
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to help define the technology strategy for Ad Tech platforms, including DSP, SSP and Ad Servers, supporting self-service advertising needs. You will assess build-versus-buy decisions for new capabilities through POCs and prototypes while considering long-term architecture, scalability, reliability and operational trade-offs.
  
  
A key part of this role will be designing and buildin
**g production-grade applications powered by Large Language Models and agentic systems from experimentation through production operation and continuous evaluation**
. We are looking for engineers who have moved beyond conversational AI prototypes and have experience engineering LLM-powered systems that operate reliably within real business workflows.
  
  
You will design architectures that combine deterministic software components with probabilistic AI capabilities, making deliberate decisions about where traditional code, rules and workflow engines should be used versus where LLM-driven reasoning and autonomous agents provide value.
  
  
You will lead engineering efforts to meet functional and non-functional requirements and assist teams in solving complex business challenges through scalable technical solutions.
  
  
You will work closely with engineering managers to build high-performing engineering teams and provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, coaching and mentoring. You will also participate in the selection of technical talent and contribute actively to Target’s broader technical community.
  
  
**About You**
You have
**8+ years of software development experience**
, with experience designing, building and operating complex distributed systems through at least one complete implementation lifecycle.
  
  
You have strong backend engineering fundamentals and are comfortable designing scalable APIs, microservices, asynchronous systems and data-intensive applications.
  
  
You are fluent in
**Java / Spring and microservices architecture**
, with experience building highly available production systems.
  
  
You have experience working with databases including
**RDBMS and NoSQL technologies such as Cassandra and MongoDB**
, and understand data modeling and storage trade-offs.
  
  
You have experience building distributed event-driven architectures using technologies such as
**Kafka**
.
  
  
You understand Ad Tech business fundamentals and how technology supports business objectives, and can translate business vision into technical strategy while understanding architectural and financial trade-offs.
  
  
Experience building or integrating
**DSP, SSP or Ad Server technology platforms**
in support of self-service advertising is preferred.
  
  
**Applied AI & LLM Engineering**
You have hands-on experience
**designing, building and operating production applications using LLMs**
, beyond chat interfaces, prompt experimentation and proof-of-concept applications.
  
  
You have designed and optimized production-grade
**RAG systems**
, with strong understanding of
**data ingestion and chunking, retrieval and ranking, context and grounding, hybrid retrieval, and evaluation**
.
  
  
You have experience with
**knowledge graphs and graph-based retrieval**
, and understand when to use vector search, Graph RAG, structured queries, traditional search or hybrid approaches based on the problem and data.
  
  
You understand the engineering trade-offs of production LLM systems, including
**quality, latency, cost, reliability, observability, security and failure handling**
, and can systematically improve retrieval and overall system performance rather than relying primarily on prompt engineering.
  
  
**Agentic Systems**
You have designed or built
**agentic applications or orchestration frameworks**
where LLM-powered components interact with tools, APIs, retrieval systems and other agents to accomplish multi-step tasks.
  
  
**You Understand Concepts Such As**

* Tool/function calling
* Agent planning and execution
* Workflow and state management
* Multi-agent orchestration
* Agent memory and context management
* Routing and delegation
* Human-in-the-loop workflows
* Guardrails and policy enforcement
* Retry, timeout and fallback strategies
* Agent observability and traceability
* Evaluation of agent behavior and task completion

You understand the distinction between
**deterministic and non-deterministic execution paths**
and can design systems that deliberately combine both.
  
  
You know when a business workflow should remain deterministic and testable using conventional software and when probabilistic reasoning using an LLM or agent is appropriate.
  
  
You design AI systems assuming that model outputs can be incorrect or unpredictable and therefore incorporate appropriate
**validation, constraints, structured outputs, fallbacks, idempotency, observability and human intervention**
where required.
  
  
**AI Quality & Evaluation**
You understand that production AI systems require rigorous
**quality and evaluation practices**
beyond model selection and prompting.
  
  
You have experience establishing
**offline and online evaluation strategies**
for LLM-powered systems, covering retrieval and response quality, factual grounding, task completion, reliability, latency and cost.
  
  
You can build
**evaluation harnesses and regression tests**
with representative datasets, metrics and quality thresholds, and integrate them into
**CI/CD as deployment and quality gates**
.
  
  
You can use evaluation, observability and tracing to diagnose quality issues across
**data, retrieval, context, prompts, models and orchestration**
, and drive systematic improvements.
  
  
**Engineering Leadership**
You can translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical architectures and incrementally deliver solutions from experimentation through production.
  
  
You make architecture decisions based on measurable trade-offs rather than technology trends and are comfortable challenging unnecessary complexity.
  
  
You can lead

title: Associate, SW Eng
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Developer to design, build, integrate, and support enterprise solutions using Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, and emerging Microsoft AI technologies.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and customize Dynamics 365 solutions using **C#, .NET,** **JavaScript/TypeScript,** **plug-ins, Web API, custom APIs, and Dataverse**.
* Build model-driven Power Apps and automated business processes using **Power Apps and Power Automate**.
* Develop integrations between Dynamics 365 and enterprise systems using APIs, Azure services, and standard Microsoft integration patterns.
* Build and extend **Copilot Studio agents**, including actions, topics, connectors, and integrations with enterprise data and processes.
* Apply **generative AI and AI capabilities** to Dynamics and Power Platform business scenarios.
* Develop Dynamics plug-ins, client extensions, business process flows, and reusable components.
* Configure Dataverse tables, relationships, forms, views, security roles, and solutions.
* Participate in technical design, coding, unit testing, code reviews, deployment, and production support.
* Diagnose and resolve application, integration, data, and performance issues.
* Implement solutions using appropriate **ALM, source control, CI/CD, security, and development standards**.
* Collaborate with architects, product owners, analysts, and engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

**Required Skills**

* 3–5 years of programming/software engineering experience.
* Hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 development experience.
* Strong knowledge of **C#, .NET,** **JavaScript/TypeScript,** **REST/Web APIs, and Dataverse**.
* Experience with **Power Apps and Power Automate**.
* Experience with or strong working knowledge of **Microsoft Copilot Studio**.
* Understanding of generative AI concepts and their application to business applications.
* Experience developing Dynamics plug-ins, integrations, and customizations.
* Familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, and Dynamics/Power Platform ALM.
* Strong debugging, problem-solving, and software engineering skills.

**Preferred**

* Dynamics 365 Sales / Sales Hub experience.
* Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, or Azure integration experience.
* AI Builder or Azure OpenAI experience.
* Experience developing custom connectors or integrating external APIs with Power Platform.
* Microsoft **PL-400 Power Platform Developer Associate** or equivalent certification.
* Experience working in Agile engineering teams.

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

Kinaxis RapidResponse Author Certification or equivalent Kinaxis certified professional credential

title: SAP ABAP+ PLM – Consultant, Technical Transformation
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP ABAP+PLM – Consultant, Technical Transformation**
Join Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Consultant, SAP PLM, where you will support digital transformation initiatives across product lifecycle management environments. In this role, you will contribute to the design, customization, deployment, and support of SAP PLM solutions for complex client needs. You will work with cross-functional teams to translate functional requirements into technical solutions, deliver quality work products within project timelines, and support implementation activities across the solution lifecycle.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Consultant, Technical Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for supporting SAP Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) data transformation and migration activities, including:
  
  

* Executing documented, repeatable data extracts from source systems.
* Collecting, consolidating, cleansing, and transforming structured and unstructured data for migration readiness.
* Supporting extract, transform, and load (ETL) processing, including rule application, data enrichment, mapping transformation, and load preparation.
* Supporting SAP PLM data migration cycles through data extraction, profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, and loading.
* Building, reviewing, and maintaining data-mapping specifications, transformation rules, data lineage records, and load templates.

**The team**
The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirements**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 3-6 years of experience in Systems, Applications, and Products in Data Processing (SAP) Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP), object-oriented ABAP (OOABAP), and Web Dynpro and Floorplan Manager (FPM) development.
* Experience with SAP Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Recipe Development or Discrete Manufacturing.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, Core Data Services (CDS) views, and Open Data Protocol (OData) services.
* Experience with Windows Wordprocessor Integration (WWI) reporting, Adobe Forms, and SAP workflows.
* Experience with extract, transform, and load (ETL) processing for SAP PLM data migration.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP).
* Experience developing SAP Fiori applications.
* Experience with Syniti.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

description:
**Job Title: Project Coordinator – Fire Protection Systems**

**Department:** Projects  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Qualification:** Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, or Civil Engineering preferred  
**Industry Preference:** Fire Protection, MEP, or Building Services

**IMMEDIATE JOINERS PREFERABLE**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Project Coordinator to coordinate fire protection projects from planning through execution, testing, commissioning, and handover. The role involves tracking schedules, materials, manpower, costs, and quality to support timely completion within approved budgets.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical understanding, stakeholder coordination skills, and proficiency in digital project management tools.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Planning & Execution**

* Coordinate installation activities for hydrant, sprinkler, fire pump, fire detection, and suppression systems.
* Prepare and maintain project schedules, milestones, resource plans, and activity trackers.
* Review drawings, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), and specifications with relevant teams before execution.
* Coordinate with design, procurement, stores, and site teams to resolve dependencies and maintain progress.

**2. Material Planning & Management**

* Plan material requirements based on approved BOQs, drawings, and execution schedules.
* Follow up with procurement and stores to ensure timely delivery, including long-lead items.
* Track material receipts, issues, consumption, and balances across project sites.
* Monitor consumption against planned quantities and highlight discrepancies.
* Coordinate proper storage and handling to minimize damage, wastage, and pilferage.
* Support material reconciliation and closure of outstanding material records at project completion.

**3. Budget & Profitability Tracking**

* Track project expenditure against approved budgets, including materials, labour, subcontracting, and logistics.
* Identify potential cost overruns and coordinate corrective actions with management.
* Support cost optimization and efficient resource utilization without compromising quality.
* Maintain records of scope changes, variations, and additional work.
* Coordinate pricing and approval of variation orders with authorized stakeholders.
* Prepare cost reports and profitability analysis for finance and management reviews.

**4. Manpower & Site Coordination**

* Coordinate deployment and rotation of engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and workers across sites.
* Monitor manpower availability, productivity, and work progress.
* Communicate daily and weekly priorities to site teams.
* Follow up on site discipline, safety observations, and workmanship issues.

**5. Progress Monitoring & Reporting**

* Track actual progress against project schedules and milestones.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports covering progress, costs, resources, risks, and pending actions.
* Identify delays and bottlenecks, escalate concerns, and follow up on recovery plans.
* Maintain project documentation, meeting minutes, approvals, and action trackers.

**6. Client & Stakeholder Communication**

* Coordinate project communication with clients, consultants, architects, contractors, and internal departments.
* Share progress updates and ensure timely resolution of queries.
* Organize review meetings and track agreed actions.
* Coordinate handover activities and closure of outstanding commitments.

**7. Quality, Safety & Project Closure**

* Coordinate inspections to verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and applicable fire safety requirements.
* Follow up on quality observations and corrective actions.
* Coordinate testing, commissioning, and resolution of outstanding defects.
* Compile inspection records, test reports, handover documents, and project closure files.

**8. Digital Project Management**

* Use **Powerplay or similar project management software** to assign and track tasks, schedules, resources, and progress.
* Maintain accurate project information and supporting documents in internal systems.
* Support site teams in adopting digital reporting tools.
* Provide reliable project data for management reviews and decision-making.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Knowledge of **fire hydrant, sprinkler, pump room, fire detection, and suppression systems**.
* Ability to interpret **technical drawings, BOQs, and project specifications**.
* Experience in **project scheduling, material planning, cost tracking, and manpower coordination**.
* Strong **client communication, vendor coordination, and subcontractor follow-up** skills.
* Ability to coordinate multiple project sites and manage competing priorities.
* Understanding of installation quality, safety practices, testing, and commissioning.
* Proficiency in **MS Excel, MIS reporting, project documentation, and Powerplay or similar software**.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Mechanical, Electrical, or Civil Engineering** preferred.
* **5–8 years of experience** in project execution or coordination.
* Experience in **Fire Protection, MEP, or Building Services projects** preferred.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

* **Evaluative Research / Usability Research & Validation:** Design, plan, and conduct qualitative and quantitative usability studies for planned projects in execution, context of use testing, and ergonomic assessments to iteratively validate physical and digital design concepts with real users.

Drive continuous refinement of the user experience through heavy cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, Hardware, Mechanical Engineering, and other key stakeholders.
* **Market & Trend Benchmarking**: Perform constant local (India) & global market research, India White goods space and parallel Industry competitive audits, IoT trend analysis to uncover unmet customer demands and inform the product experience roadmap for planning cycles
* **Perceived Quality & Execution Excellence:** Benchmark and evaluate perceived quality to ensure top-tier standards in overall product , physical control feel, surface finish, UI responsiveness, visual elegance and overall product elegance.
* **Human Factors & Ergonomics:** Apply core principles of physical ergonomics and cognitive workload to optimize control panel layouts, display visibility, reachability, and overall product interaction across diverse user demographics.
* **Foster the future:** Actively seek and share design and digital inspiration. Be on top of understanding new innovations and to keep a check on the market trends. Cross Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Industrial Designers, Software/Firmware Engineers, Product Managers and external Design Agencies from concept through to launch.

You will be a key member of the UX team that’s responsible for driving Digital and Physical experience strategy by collaborating effectively with the Engineering and Marketing teams to align on experience/product roadmaps Championing the UX processes and projects, ensuring that each project consistently expresses the intended brand personality and delivering an intuitive and delightful experience.

**Minimum requirements:**
-------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master’s in Industrial Design, Interaction Design, Service Design, Visual Design, HCI or related human center degree
* **Experience:** 2-5 years of experience planning, conducting, and communicating the findings from user research for products and services
* Strong Design / User Research / User Insight / Visual design skills required, including the use of a diverse set of tools, e.g. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Generative AI tools, and the ability to adapt to new and evolving software based on existing design methodology, principles and practices
* Experience planning and conducting Research (quantitative /qualitative/ usability user research) at all stages of product development
* Ability to direct clear and creative artifacts (e.g., task flows, wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to guide consistency across teams)
* Seasoned design expertise with deep insight into the newest methods, trends, and design operations
* Ability to frame key questions, create research plans to address those, conduct research, and synthesize the findings into meaningful, actionable insights
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate and optimize design based on the value to the user and the business
* Strong communication skills with the ability to align the organization on complex product decisions while advocating the voice of the customer
* Ability to effectively document, present and gather feedback from peers, stakeholders and others in order to inform and align
* Ability to scope product and service projects strategically and effectively with a deep understanding of product development processes
* Passion to challenge the status quo find new solutions and drive out-of-the-box ideas – loves and embraces change
* Visible passion for the subject area, participation in domain activities and groups
* Experimental mindset to drive innovation

**Preferred skills and experiences:**
-------------------------------------

* Developing design systems for apps or embedded UIs for each brand to guarantee a consistent application and following the Product Organisation process, working closely with process partners
* You will work in tandem with the Industrial Designers to enable an efficient iterative design process that constantly strives to leading product portfolio the industry
* Leading with rapid prototyping, ranging from quick paper mockups to interactive prototypes developed in conjunction with engineering teams – targeting the right fidelity at the right time
* Aligning key leaders and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure meeting the brand goals and to align with them on the design direction
* Understanding business goals, making them meaningful and actionable for the team.

**What we offer:**
------------------

Whirlpool has big plans for the future, just like you. We understand that it takes preparation and hard work to get there. So, we offer great teams and tools to build your capability. In our
  
performance-based setting, you can take your career in exciting new directions - and as far as you want to go.

title: Lead Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
description:
The **Distributed Database team** is responsible for *a globally distributed, elastic, cloud-native relational database* . This database combines the best of NoSQL and NewSQL technologies with the enterprise capabilities of Oracle RDBMS.
  
  
Our projects span all layers of the database kernel, such as parallel query execution, transaction management, replication, etc., and external components, such as client-side drivers, intelligent query routers, and load balancers. We are also responsible for supporting emerging technologies in the distributed database, such as Vector and Text Search, Microservices, Machine Learning, Blockchain, and Graphs.
  
  
We are looking for motivated and talented system engineers who want to make significant contributions to highly visible and strategic projects by solving challenging problems in distributed computing, high availability, and extreme scalability. Join our team of exceptional engineers in building a transformative database solution that is reshaping how enterprises handle data at a global scale.
  
  
As a member of the software engineering division, you will take an active role in the definition and evolution of standard practices and procedures. You will be responsible for defining and developing software for tasks associated with the developing, designing and debugging of software applications or operating systems.
  
  
Work is non-routine and very complex, involving the application of advanced technical/business skills in area of specialization. Leading contributor individually and as a team member, providing direction and mentoring to others. BS or MS degree or equivalent experience relevant to functional area. 10 years of software engineering or related experience.

Career Level - IC5

  

Experience and/or interest in **database internals, distributed systems, replication technologies** , load balancing algorithms, and design trade-offs among consistency, availability, and performance in distributed systems is required, as are the following skills:

* Expert-level proficiency in C programming
* Fluency in SQL; PL/SQL
* Solid background in relational database and operating system concepts
* Expert-level in query processing and distributed query processing.
* Good understanding of concurrent programming concepts
* Strong software engineering and debugging skills
* Track record of delivering high-quality software under time constraints
* Strong collaboration skills, particularly in geographically distributed team

**About This Role**
You can work with us at one of top FinTech companies. We sell our Aladdin platform to over 200 of the top global corporations, in total managing about quarter of all the world’s money under management.
  
  
BlackRock is global but close-knit team of individuals who share a common goal of providing the very best possible level of support to our business partners and customers. From the top of the firm down, we embrace the diversity of values, identities and ideas brought by our employees. We are serious about our people and offer Flexible Time Off, collaborative working spaces and several other benefits.
  
  
An individual selected in this position will have the responsibility to cover business-critical computing workloads, real-time / interactive processing, data transfer services, application and new technology on-boarding and upgrades, and recovery procedures. The international team is split into 4 global regions to provide 24\*7\*365 support.
  
  
This role is accountable for enterprise‑scale reliability, risk posture, and operational resilience through the adoption of AI‑enabled, autonomous infrastructure and service operations.
  
  
The leader transitions the organization from human‑driven, reactive operations to AI‑supervised, self‑healing systems, ensuring technology platforms scale safely, predictably, and in alignment with business growth and regulatory expectations.
  
  
The role owns strategy, outcomes, and governance, if any of these excites you, we want to talk to you.
  
  
**Team Overview**
The Service Management Operations Group is responsible for monitoring, supporting, and administering production environments for all BlackRock businesses (including subsidiaries and BlackRock Solutions) acting as a first responder relative to troubleshooting, problem resolution, and escalation.
  
  
Collaborating with skilled professionals across the globe and managing a broad range of technologies and applications, the Operations Group delivers service quality and excellence through teamwork, innovating operational processes, and being part of the One BlackRock culture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own reliability outcomes
* Deliver measurable improvements in availability, latency, recovery time, and incident recurrence for critical workloads.
* Establish and mature SRE practices: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, and reliability governance.
* Build AI‑enabled, signal‑driven operations
* Replace alert volume with AI‑correlated signals that prioritize true business impact and early risk indicators.
* Implement and improve detection, correlation, and routing workflows integrated into operational processes and tooling.
* Engineer self‑healing systems (automation-first)
* Design, implement, and govern automated remediation for known failure patterns (with safe guardrails and audit trails).
* Maintain structured human oversight for novel scenarios and ensure continuous learning feeds back into automation.
* Embed reliability and operability into engineering lifecycle
* Partner with Engineering/Architecture/Product to build operability, observability, resilience-by-design into services.
* Drive root-cause elimination and reduce recurrence through systemic fixes, not repetitive recovery.
* Change-aware resilience + risk posture
* Own change-aware operations: use AI risk signals to anticipate failures based on historical data, dependency graphs, and weak points.
* Support production readiness: capacity planning, disaster recovery exercises, and disciplined change governance.
* Evidence, auditability, and resilience expectations
* Ensure AI-driven systems are observable, explainable, and auditable, meeting operational and regulatory expectations.
* Develop and lead high performing global team, fostering strong ownership, technical depth, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications / Competencies**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science /engineering (or equivalent practical experience).
* 10+ years across Service Management, DevOps, SRE, Product Engineering, and/or large-scale production operations.
* Strong hands-on experience with observability/monitoring/telemetry platforms, focused on actionable insights and reliability outcomes.
* Proven experience transitioning environments from reactive support to proactive, signal-driven / AI-assisted operations.
* Designed/tuned/governed automation and AIOps workflows, enabling automated remediation while retaining structured human oversight for exceptions.
* Experience implementing change-aware operations, drift detection/correction, and data-driven reliability governance to reduce incident recurrence.
* AI-assisted capacity forecasting and proactive scaling for performance predictability and cost efficiency.
* End-to-end operational fluency: telemetry → ITSM integration → automated execution.
* Experience sponsoring or governing AI-assisted/autonomous operational platforms.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. description:
**About This Role**
The Team:
  
  
The Global Marketing & Digital Wealth organization at BlackRock is a forward-looking, globally connected team at the center of the firm’s most high-impact priorities. We are architects of growth, working across functions and markets to unlock opportunities and accelerate outcomes for the business. In collaboration with both internal and external partners, we design the conditions for success—delivering next-generation campaigns, brand platforms, communications, training, and client experiences. Our work is powered by world-class centers of excellence spanning content strategy, research & analytics, and digital platforms & experiences.
  
  
Within Global Marketing & Digital Wealth, the Global Digital team owns and transforms BlackRock’s client-facing digital properties—including BlackRock.com, iShares.com, and Advisor Center—as well as our email marketing channels. The team brings together product, design, engineering, and digital expertise to create connected, personalized experiences that help clients discover, understand, and engage with BlackRock.
  
  
**Role And Impact**
As more clients hold iShares and engage with BlackRock digitally, the quality of our client experiences matters more than ever. We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our global Digital Experiences team and help ensure that the experiences we build—guiding users through the purchase funnel, personalizing to their needs, and encouraging ongoing engagement—are reliable, accurate, and release-ready.
  
  
The successful candidate will own quality across the delivery lifecycle, from test planning and preparation through execution, automation, and CI/CD integration. They will bring a development-minded approach to testing and help evolve our QA practice toward an AI-assisted model that increases coverage and speed while reducing manual effort.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Planning
  
  

* Understand requirements and Jira stories; create test plans, assess test automation feasibility, and estimate, schedule, and plan testing activities.
* Use AI tools to analyze requirements and user stories, identify gaps or ambiguities early, and propose risk-based test coverage.

Test Preparation
  
  

* Analyze and understand scenarios and application flows, and prepare test scenarios and test cases for new functionality.
* Prepare test data and manually execute test cases to understand application flows.
* Use AI-assisted tools to generate and refine test scenarios, test cases, and synthetic test data, applying human review to validate accuracy and completeness.

Test Execution
  
  

* Execute new functional test cases for the current release, as well as manual and automated regression packs.
* Log defects and retest fixed defects.
* Apply AI to triage test failures, cluster related defects, and draft clear, reproducible defect reports.
* Leverage AI-enabled visual, accessibility, and content checks to catch regressions across pages, markets, and devices.

Test Scripting & Integration
  
  

* Develop test scripts according to the BlackRock framework and perform dry runs of automation scripts.
* Integrate automation with the CI/CD pipeline and complete a full run of automated scripts.
* Use AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test script development, refactoring, and maintenance, including self-healing of brittle locators.
* Help build reusable prompts, agent workflows, and standards that scale AI-assisted QA across the team, and measure their impact on coverage, cycle time, and defect leakage.

User Documentation
  
  

* Create and update user manuals.

**Core Skills**

* Quality mindset with a development background.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to grasp complex concepts easily.
* Comfortable working in an agile environment, fluent in English.
* Interested in continuously extending testing know-how.
* Curious and pragmatic about AI—applies it to improve quality and speed, while exercising sound judgment on AI-generated output.

**Qualifications**
Essential Skills and Experience
  
  

* 3-7 years of working experience in software testing or QA.
* Technology-based university degree or equivalent experience.
* Proven ability to assure the quality of developed software and code.
* Experience with at least one of the following frameworks: Playwright, Cypress, or Puppeteer.
* Experience with CI/CD environments.
* Experience with Jira/Azure Boards, Confluence, and Git.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) in testing or development workflows.

**Desirable Skills And Experience**

* Practical knowledge of designing and developing test automation solutions.
* Experience with Azure DevOps.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of TypeScript and Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development.
* Familiarity with AI-native testing tools, Playwright MCP, or agent-based test generation and execution.
* Experience testing AI-powered features (e.g., chatbots or generative content), including evaluation of output accuracy and consistency.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. **guidance**

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. **Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services**
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and technical tax resources to comply with reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy smarter approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
  
  
You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter-personal skills to build the required relationships.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities -**

* Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
* Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
* Code Python is a plus.
* Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API-calls and MCP- servers is key.
* Build end-to-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
* Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
* Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).
* Implement Fiori-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable).
* Integrate with SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
* Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
* Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in-app/extensibility, key-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean-core approach where applicable).
* Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
* Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root-cause analysis

**Qualification And Experience Required -**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
* Hands-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
* SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
* SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
* Strong hands-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
* Proven delivery experience with:
* RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
* CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
* OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
* Strong understanding of HANA-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT-in-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
* Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
* Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).
* BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.
* Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.

**Company Description**
YesMadam is a tech-enabled home salon and spa platform in India that delivers beauty and wellness services directly to customers’ homes. Since 2017, the company has grown to serve over 12 million customers with 10,000+ beauty professionals across more than 55 cities, using transparent mono-dosage products and a unique per-minute pricing model. YesMadam operates an asset-light franchise model that has enabled partners to be profitable from day one, including in tier-three cities. The company is now building YesMadam 2.0, an AI-driven personalized Beauty + Wellness experience, supported by a diverse team of IIT graduates, MBAs, and experienced professionals. Its vision is driven by the combination of strong operations, advanced technology, domain expertise, and deep customer trust.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Senior DevOps Engineer role based in Noida. The Senior DevOps Engineer will design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure to support YesMadam’s technology platforms. Responsibilities include building and managing CI pipelines, automating deployments using Infrastructure as Code, and monitoring system performance, reliability, and security. The role involves collaborating closely with software engineering, QA, and product teams to streamline release processes, optimize environments, and resolve production issues. The Senior DevOps Engineer will also contribute to architecture decisions, implement best practices for observability and incident response, and mentor team members on DevOps tools and methodologies.

* Strong Infrastructure as Code (IaC) skills (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar) and configuration management tools.
* Experience in Software Development (preferably with scripting or backend languages) to build automation, tools, and integrations.
* Expertise in Continuous Integration and delivery pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or comparable platforms).
* Solid System Administration skills with a focus on Linux, including performance tuning, networking, and security hardening.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and monitoring/logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar).
* Knowledge of security best practices for infrastructure, secrets management, and compliance in production environments.
* Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams, communicate clearly, and take ownership of complex technical problems.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; prior experience in a senior DevOps or SRE role is strongly preferred.

* A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

  **.**

title: Senior / Principal ML Engineer, Social Listening
description:
Senior / Principal ML Engineer, Social Listening

**SPIRE Lab (https://spire.ee.iisc.ac.in/), Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru**
· Full-time at IISc · 5+ years of experience

About Social Listening

SPIRE Lab at IISc is hiring a senior individual contributor to build the AI, data and evaluation backbone of a two-year, Gates Foundation-funded research programme in rural Bihar.

The programme asks a simple question: can voice AI help a state government genuinely listen to rural women? Women in self-help groups (Didis) have views on livelihoods, nutrition and local services, but little of it reaches decision makers in a usable form.

In partnership with the Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society (BRLPS / JEEViKA), we will build and field-test a voice AI system that lets SHG women and field cadres ask questions, share feedback and raise grievances over basic and shared phones, in Hindi, Bhojpuri and Magahi. A sense-making layer turns those calls into structured insights JEEViKA can act on. Alongside it, we will build an open evaluation sandbox that tests how voice AI actually performs in the field, with rural accents and real phone lines, rather than only in the lab. The baseline solution, evaluation framework and technical guidelines are intended to be published so other programmes can reuse them.

A field implementation partner will run the voice platform and field operations under IISc's technical oversight. This role owns the AI, data and evaluation work on the IISc side.

Gender-intentional design runs through the work.

**About the team**

You will work inside SPIRE Lab as a senior individual contributor. You set technical direction through the quality of your work, not by managing a team.

You will sit with speech and AI researchers at IISc, work closely with the Head of Program and a Program Manager who owns operations and partner coordination, and collaborate with government, civil society and research partners on field operations, data governance and evaluation.

**About IISc / SPIRE Lab**

The Signal Processing, Interpretation and REpresentation Laboratory (SPIRE Lab) is part of the Department of Electrical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru. Founded in May 2015 and directed by Dr. Prasanta Kumar Ghosh, the lab works on signal processing, speech processing, representation learning and machine learning, with a focus on human-centred signals such as speech and audio.

The lab publishes widely, works with government, industry and civil society partners, and is releasing public datasets for Indian accents and languages. It is also a pioneer of speech datasets for Indian languages, having began work on datasets in 2020, followed by founding Project Vaani in collaboration with Google Deepmind in 2023. It actively works on speech datasets, model development and model evaluations, apart from smaller projects focussed on atypical speech.

This role is an IISc position within SPIRE Lab.

**The role**

You are the senior technical owner of the social listening machinery: the pipeline that turns raw call recordings into trustworthy, structured, actionable signal, and the evaluation that tells us whether it works for the women it is meant to serve.

You will be IISc's technical counterpart to the implementation partner, and you will ship work that can be published and reused. This is a hands-on individual contributor role.

***What you'll do***

* Design and own the end-to-end pipeline: ingestion of call recordings and metadata from the partner's voice platform, speech recognition for Bihar's languages and dialects, translation, classification, theme and grievance extraction, and insight reporting.
* Build the evaluation program for voice AI in real conditions: noisy shared feature phones, code-mixing, and low-resource dialects. Define metrics with research collaborators, build eval datasets and harnesses, and report honestly on where models fail and for whom, including gender and subgroup analysis.
* Be IISc's technical counterpart to the implementation partner: review platform architecture, data export and integration interfaces, consent and data-protection practices, and service levels, so the platform meets research and evaluation needs.
* Design the human-in-the-loop layer with the cadre contextualization and case-management workflow, so AI output is checked and acted on, not only dash-boarded.
* Own data governance in practice: consent, de-identification, secure storage and access, aligned with India's DPDP Act.
* Ship open technical frameworks, documentation and implementation guidelines so other programmes can replicate the work.
* Write clearly for government, funder and research audiences. Work in the field when needed.

**What we're looking for**

* At least 5 years building and shipping ML or speech systems in production, with real ownership of a pipeline end to end.
* Strong computer science fundamentals, and fluency in Python. This role is hands-on.
* Experience with, or a demonstrated interest in, voice-based AI for Indic languages. Judgement to choose between open models, fine-tuning and vendor APIs.
* Strong evaluation instincts: you have built eval sets and harnesses, and you distrust a single headline metric.
* Comfort with messy real-world data, and with working alongside field teams and government partners.
* Clear writing, first-principles thinking, and the ability to lead technically without being managed closely. You are an individual contributor, not a people manager.

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on work with ASR, TTS or real-time voice agents, especially in low-resource or code-mixed settings.
* Experience with social listening, IVR or voice platforms, feedback or grievance systems, or public-health or livelihoods programmes in rural India.
* Familiarity with gender-intentional design, survey methodology or social-science collaborators.
* Hindi, plus Bhojpuri, Magahi or Maithili.
* An open-source or publication track record.
* Comfort with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP or Azure).

**Contract & logistics**

Location: SPIRE Lab, IISc Bengaluru, with travel to Bihar

Type: Full-time IISc

**How to apply**

[Apply via this
Form
. (https://forms.gle/3yArL6GrkBxKFfph8) Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.]

title: Sr Serviceability Engineer - Life Cycle Manager (LCM)
description:
About Nutanix
-------------

Nutanix is building a world where infrastructure is invisible, and organizations can focus on the work that matters. Our hybrid multicloud platform helps customers run applications and manage data across private, public, and distributed clouds with simplicity and control.

About the Team
--------------

The Serviceability Engineer role is part of the Service Strategy & Enablement team at Nutanix, based in Bangalore. The team is made up of engineers who improve product serviceability, diagnostics, reliability, and the overall customer experience.

Serving as a critical bridge between Support and Engineering, the team ensures that serviceability and usability are considered throughout the product lifecycle. By analyzing customer issues, monitoring field performance, validating releases, and incorporating customer feedback, the team drives improvements that make Nutanix products easier to deploy, upgrade, troubleshoot, and operate.

You will report to the Manager, Service Strategy & Enablement. The team works in a hybrid environment that encourages collaboration, technical learning, and ownership.

Your Role
---------

As a **Senior Serviceability Engineer for Life Cycle Manager (LCM)**, you will help make upgrades predictable, diagnosable, and safe across Nutanix software and hardware environments. You will work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Quality Assurance, Release Management, and Support to improve the serviceability of LCM from product definition through release and post-deployment adoption.

LCM provides a cluster-aware framework for inventorying and updating software and firmware across a Nutanix environment. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys understanding complex distributed systems, investigating customer-impacting failures, improving product diagnostics, and influencing teams to prevent recurring issues.

The role involves performing duties requiring the application of professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making in carrying out responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements. Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities.

What You’ll Do
--------------

* Define and maintain serviceability requirements for LCM features, upgrade workflows, inventory, prechecks, compatibility validation, recovery, and diagnostics.
* Partner with Product Management and Engineering during product planning and development to ensure customer troubleshooting and operational needs are addressed early.
* Lead serviceability validation for LCM releases, including upgrade-path testing, upgrade and inventory workflows, precheck coverage, failure and recovery scenarios, interoperability, scale, and upgrade resiliency.
* Build and maintain representative test matrices across Nutanix software, hypervisors, server platforms, firmware components, cluster configurations, and supported deployment models.
* Review field issues, support cases, telemetry, and diagnostic data to identify trends, customer impact, recurring failure modes, and opportunities for product improvement.
* Investigate complex LCM failures by correlating application logs, task and workflow data, cluster state, system events, network behavior, and firmware or hardware-management responses.
* Work with Engineering to isolate root causes, reproduce issues, define corrective actions, and drive critical and deferred defects to closure.
* Review precheck and compatibility behavior to ensure that failures are actionable, accurately classified, and supported by clear remediation guidance.
* Evaluate upgrade rollback, recovery, and partial-failure scenarios and help define safe customer outcomes when an upgrade does not complete as expected.
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance and test automation teams to improve coverage for upgrade paths, dependency conflicts, hardware variants, network conditions, disconnected or restricted environments, and negative scenarios.
* Partner with Release Management and Documentation teams on release readiness, known issues, upgrade guidance, troubleshooting content, and Support enablement.
* Translate complex technical findings into clear requirements, defect reports, troubleshooting guides, executive summaries, and customer-safe recommendations.
* Represent the customer and Support perspective in design reviews, technical discussions, defect triage, and release decisions.
* Mentor engineers and promote serviceability practices that reduce customer effort, support case volume, time to resolution, and avoidable upgrade risk.

What You’ll Bring
-----------------

* 5+ years of experience in enterprise software, platform engineering, systems engineering, quality engineering, technical support, or serviceability.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* Experience working with complex infrastructure products, distributed systems, virtualization platforms, cloud infrastructure, or data-center operations.
* Strong experience troubleshooting customer-impacting issues across multiple layers of a technology stack and converting investigation findings into durable product improvements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Support without relying solely on formal authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, technical support teams, product leaders, and executive stakeholders.

Technical Requirements
----------------------

### Life Cycle Management and Upgrade Workflows

* Strong understanding of software and firmware lifecycle management, including inventory, repositories, package or bundle management, prechecks, dependencies, compatibility, upgrade sequencing, and post-upgrade validation.
* Experience testing or troubleshooting upgrade workflows involving failure handling, partial completion, recovery, retry, and resumption scenarios.
* Understanding of the operational risks associated with infrastructure upgrades and the importance of clear customer-facing diagnostics and remediation guidance.

### Virtualization and Nutanix Technologies

* Hands-on experience with one or more virtualization or hypervisor technologies, such as Nutanix AHV/KVM or VMware ESXi.
* Familiarity with enterprise infrastructure concepts such as clusters, controllers, virtual machines, storage, networking, high availability, and rolling maintenance.
* Experience with Nutanix technologies such as AOS, Prism, AHV, or LCM is a plus.

### Systems and Infrastructure Troubleshooting

* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including process, service, filesystem, permissions, networking, and system-resource analysis.
* Ability to analyze logs, task histories, service states, configuration files, alerts, and diagnostic bundles to identify failure patterns.
* Familiarity with server hardware, firmware, boot processes, out-of-band management, and hardware-management interfaces such as Redfish or IPMI is preferred.
* Understanding of network fundamentals relevant to infrastructure upgrades, including DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, TLS certificates, repositories, and connectivity validation.

### Automation, APIs, and Diagnostics

* Proficiency in Python, Shell, or another scripting language for test automation, log analysis, data extraction, and operational tooling.
* Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, error handling, and API-driven infrastructure workflows.
* Familiarity with observability, telemetry, log collection, diagnostic bundles, and metrics used to detect and troubleshoot product issues.
* Experience building or improving automated validation for upgrade, compatibility, failure-injection, or recovery scenarios.

### Serviceability and Quality Engineering

* Experience defining test strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, release gates, and validation metrics for complex products.
* Proven ability to review and prioritize defects using customer impact, frequency, severity, reproducibility, and business risk.
* Ability to create high-quality defect reports with clear symptoms, impact, reproduction steps, evidence, suspected scope, and validation criteria.
* Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent systems for defect tracking, documentation, and cross-functional execution.
* Experience using AI to automate workflows, build task-oriented agents, or analyze defects, bugs, and diagnostic data.

Preferred Qualifications
------------------------

* Experience with infrastructure lifecycle management, firmware orchestration, server vendors, or data-center management platforms.
* Experience supporting or validating air-gapped, dark-site, proxy-based, or restricted-network environments.
* Knowledge of upgrade compatibility models, dependency graphs, release branches, backward compatibility, and interoperability testing.
* Experience with CI/CD, test frameworks, continuous validation, or quality dashboards.
* Background in technical support, escalation engineering, site reliability engineering, or customer-facing engineering for enterprise infrastructure products.
* Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge base content, troubleshooting guides, or Support readiness material.

Why This Role Matters
---------------------

Infrastructure upgrades are high-trust operations for customers. In this role, you will help ensure that LCM does more than execute an upgrade: it should explain what is happening, identify risks early, recover safely when conditions change, and give customers and Support a clear path to resolution.

If you enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems, working across product boundaries, and turning field experience into better engineering outcomes, this is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the reliability and usability of Nutanix products.

Nutanix is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

* Deep dive into our business metrics, analyze data, trends, and reviewing dashboards

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of data scientist experience
* 3+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience

* Experience with SQL and statistical/mathematical programming software packages like R, SPSS, CPLEX, LONDO or Xpress

* Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company

* Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
* Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

We are looking for a Data Scientist to help us achieve our bold goals in the Modern Commerce journey. The ideal candidate combines strong statistical and machine learning skills with solid engineering fundamentals, a customer-obsessed mindset and a drive to turn data into measurable business outcomes. In this role, you will:

* Own end-to-end data science projects, from framing the business problem and exploring data through modelling, validation, deployment and monitoring in production.
* Build, evaluate and operationalize machine learning and statistical models for commerce scenarios such as forecasting, anomaly detection, fraud and risk signals, pricing, customer segmentation and recommendations.
* Apply generative AI and large language models (for example, Azure OpenAI) to improve customer, partner and engineering experiences, including evaluation of model quality, safety and responsible AI considerations.
* Design and analyse experiments (A/B tests) and causal studies to measure the impact of product and platform changes.
* Develop scalable data pipelines and feature sets on big-data platforms, working with engineering partners to ensure data quality, reliability and privacy compliance.
* Define, track and explain key business and platform metrics, and build dashboards and reports that drive data-informed decisions.
* Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for engineering, product and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with engineers, PMs and partner teams to shape roadmaps and share reusable code, models and best practices.

  
**Qualifications**  

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in data science, machine learning or applied analytics, with a track record of shipping models or insights that drove business decisions.
* Strong programming skills in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) and SQL; familiarity with R or Scala is a plus.
* Solid foundation in statistics, probability, hypothesis testing and machine learning algorithms (regression, classification, clustering, time series).
* Experience working with large-scale datasets and big-data technologies such as Spark, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric or Kusto (KQL).

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and with building LLM-based or generative AI solutions.
* Experience deploying and monitoring models in production using MLOps tools such as Azure Machine Learning or MLflow, along with Git and CI/CD practices.
* Experience with A/B testing and causal inference, and with data visualization tools such as Power BI.
* Domain exposure to commerce, billing, licensing or payments data, with strong problem-solving, communication, ownership and a growth mindset.
