title: Network Engineer/ Administrator
description:
**Build What Matters at Model N**

At Model N, we help life sciences companies solve complex revenue challenges so they can operate smarter and bring important innovations to market faster. We are looking for people who like practical problem solving, cross-functional work, and seeing the impact of what they build.

If you enjoy keeping networks fast, secure, and reliable for the people who depend on them, this could be a great fit.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Network Engineer to join our Global Technology team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will **install, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain network infrastructure across corporate** and cloud environments. You will work primarily on cloud networking, along with enterprise switching, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, and secure remote access technologies. You will work closely with senior engineers, IT teammates, cross functional teams, customers and vendors to ensure our network environment remains secure, reliable, and highly available.

This role matters because our employees and customers depend on a fast, secure network to do their work, and reliable network engineering is what keeps everything connected.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure, and maintain cloud network infrastructure, including AWS VPCs, subnets, route tables, Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, Security Groups, NACLs, VPNs, Transit Gateway, and VPC Peering.
* Support and maintain enterprise switching infrastructure, primarily Cisco and Juniper switches, including VLANs, trunking, routing, and network connectivity.
* Support Palo Alto firewalls and Panorama, including firewall rule management, VPN connectivity, traffic analysis, and basic troubleshooting.
* Support Zscaler technologies, including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and troubleshoot connectivity and access-related issues.
* Support Aruba wireless infrastructure, including wireless connectivity, authentication, and troubleshooting.
* Monitor network performance and availability, and respond to alerts and incidents within agreed timelines.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity, routing, switching, DNS, latency, and security issues across corporate and cloud environments, and escalate complex problems to senior engineers when needed.
* Implement network changes through planned change requests, with documented configurations and rollback steps.
* Maintain network documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures, and share knowledge with the team.

**What Success Looks Like**

***First 60 days***

* Learn Model N's network architecture, monitoring tools, and change and incident processes.
* Build working relationships with senior network engineers, IT teammates, and vendors.
* Resolve assigned incidents and perform routine changes with guidance and peer review.

***First 3–6 months***

* Handle routine incidents and planned changes independently, with few escalations.
* Improve network monitoring or documentation to reduce repeat incidents.
* Support projects such as office expansions, network upgrades, or cloud connectivity work.

**How You Will Grow and Make an Impact**

At Model N, our competency model helps us talk about growth, impact, and how work gets done.

* **People Leadership –** You take ownership of your development and apply feedback, such as asking senior engineers to review your configurations and acting on their input.
* **Problem-Solving Leadership –** You solve routine problems independently using standard approaches, such as isolating a DNS or VPN fault during an outage.
* **Thought Leadership –** You apply growing knowledge to contribute informed ideas, such as noticing a recurring performance issue and sharing the pattern with the team.
* **Entrepreneurial Leadership –** You take initiative to improve your work, such as documenting a fix so the team can reuse it.
* **Operational Leadership –** You consistently manage your work and priorities to deliver reliable results, such as meeting incident response timelines.
* **AI Leadership –** You use AI tools to improve efficiency and quality, such as drafting configuration checks or troubleshooting runbooks.

We do not expect every person to be perfect in every area. We look for strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to keep growing.

**Qualifications**

***Required***

* Typically 2-4 years of relevant experience.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including OSI and TCP/IP models, IPv4, subnetting, routing, switching, VLANs, and TCP/UDP protocols.
* Good understanding of routing concepts and protocols, including static routing and BGP.
* Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of enterprise network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless networks.
* Good understanding of network security concepts, including firewalls, ACLs, NAT, IPsec VPNs, and network segmentation.
* Working knowledge of DNS, DHCP, ARP, ICMP, and network troubleshooting tools such as Ping, Traceroute, Nslookup, Dig, and Wireshark.
* Good understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPC, subnets, route tables, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway, Security Groups, NACLs, Private link and VPN connectivity.
* Experience with network monitoring tools and incident/change management processes.
* Ability to troubleshoot network connectivity issues methodically and work independently as well as part of a team.
* Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini) to improve productivity, decision-making, or problem solving in a professional or personal context.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* **Key skills: Network Administration & Troubleshooting · Cloud Network & Network Security**

***Preferred***

* Relevant certifications, such as CCNA or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
* Experience with hybrid cloud connectivity.
* Familiarity with Zscaler ZIA/ZPA
* Scripting experience, such as Python or Terraform, for network automation.
* Interest in leveraging AI, automation, or modern technologies to improve outcomes.

#### **How We Work**

**Our DARE core values** - **D**REAM**, A**LIGN**, R**ESPECT, and **E**XCEL - shape how we work together.

* We solve practical problems that matter to our customers and teams.

* We work across functions and value clear, respectful communication.

* We recognize good work and support growth over time.

* We are curious about better ways to work, including thoughtful use of AI and modern tools.

We do not expect every person to be perfect in every area. We look for strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to keep growing.

#### **Compensation, Benefits, and Inclusion**

At Model N, your well-being and growth matter. We offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support employees personally and professionally.

Benefits and compensation for this position will be provided in accordance with Model N’s India programs and applicable local requirements.

#### **Bring Your N Factor**

We are not just looking for a checklist of skills. We are looking for people who bring ideas, curiosity, and a point of view.

If this role sounds interesting and you can see yourself adding value, we would love to hear from you.

**About Model N**

Model N is transforming how Life Sciences companies manage revenue, commercialization, and compliance.

For more than **25 years,** Model N has been the leader in end-to-end commercialization, revenue optimization, and compliance for pharmaceutical and medical technology companies.

Our intelligent, cloud-based platform combines technology, data, analytics, AI, and industry expertise to help leading Life Sciences organizations **optimize revenue, navigate complex regulations, improve decision-making,** and bring life-changing products to market faster.

Today, **150+ leading companies** across the globe trust Model N to optimize growth and transform critical commercial processes. Our solutions manage approximately **$1.3 trillion in gross revenue**, helping customers reduce complexity, strengthen compliance, and unlock new opportunities for growth.

At Model N, we are building the next generation of **Life Sciences revenue management**—where technology, data, AI, and human expertise come together to create meaningful business impact.

Join us to build technology that powers innovation in Life Sciences and makes a difference at global scale.

For more information, visit www.modeln.com.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**The Opportunity:**

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Engineer to join our Security Engineering team. This role is responsible for designing, deploying, and optimizing the enterprise security technology stack - spanning endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and data security platforms. The ideal candidate has 9+ years of progressive cybersecurity engineering experience and deep technical knowledge across a broad range of modern security platforms. This is a hands-on engineering role offering a growth path toward Senior Cybersecurity Engineer or Lead Cybersecurity Engineer

* **remediate misconfigurations and emerging risk across cloud and AI environments.**

* **Contribute to security design reviews and help define technical standards for new projects and**
* **initiatives.**

* **Participate in an On-Call rotation to support critical security incidents outside of business hours.**

**Why Choose Ensemble India?**

People First, Last + Always

We believe in putting people at the heart of everything. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth and innovation—where your contributions are valued, your voice is heard and your potential is nurtured.

**A Place to Thrive**

Whether you're just starting out or looking to grow your career, Ensemble India is a place where you can do your best work and be your best self. We offer structured career paths, paid professional certifications, tuition reimbursement and mentorship opportunities to help you advance.

**Comprehensive Total Rewards**

We support the physical, emotional and financial well-being of you and your family. Our Total Rewards package include:

* Market competitive pay rates

**Inclusive Culture**

Our organization is deeply committed to fostering a positive environment and culture where we celebrate and reward merit and contribution and where every associate feels valued, included, and empowered to succeed.

**Purpose-Driven Impact**

We proudly partner with local communities through philanthropic initiatives—from school supply drives to health awareness campaigns—because giving back is part of who we are.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
Use analytical and quantitative methods to understand, predict, and enhance supply chain processes. Responsible for analyzing performance, identifying problems, and developing recommendations to improve the organization's Supply Chain.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Provide analytical support to one or more functional areas Use common processes tools, and information systems to enable supply chain analysis. Ensure data integrity of all analytics and reports. Analyze and interpret Key Performance Indicators to identify areas for improvement and action plans. Participate in six sigma and supply chain improvement projects Use existing business systems to provide analytics and reporting that are capable and repeatable.
  
  
**Competencies**
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
  
  
Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.
  
  
Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.
  
  
Analysis and Troubleshooting - Extracts, transforms, models, interprets, and presents planning data with the goal of mining useful information, troubleshooting, suggesting conclusions, and supporting value creating decision making.
  
  
Inventory Management and Optimization - Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end-to-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins' strategy and not just a business unit strategy.
  
  
Material Planning - Uses advanced tools (e.g. Advanced Planning Command Centre, Business Intelligence (BI) Dashboards etc.) to take a decision related to parts availability, inventory optimization and root cause analysis.
  
  
Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent degree required.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Minimal to intermediate level of experience required.

* Strong knowledge of Supply Chain Management concepts
* Hands-on experience in SQL (intermediate level)
* Proficiency in Power BI (dashboarding, DAX, data modeling)
* Experience working with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Data Lakes

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
* Good project management & communication skills to interact with cross-functional teams

You will report to senior R&D leadership and partner daily with Product, Design, and the partnerships team driving CRM/EHR/FSM/DMS alliances. You lead from the front: deeply technical, close to the code where it matters — architecture decisions, critical-path reviews, and agent-quality evals.What You Will OwnVoice agent platform: real-time conversational pipeline (telephony, ASR, LLM orchestration, TTS), sub-second latency, barge-in handling, graceful human handoff, and per-vertical conversation design for appointment booking, rescheduling, and reminders.Integrations & data sync: bidirectional sync of business contacts, calendars, and appointments with EHR/PMS (e.g., Epic, Dentrix, Eaglesoft), FSM (e.g., ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro), DMS (e.g., CDK, Reynolds, Tekion), and horizontal CRMs — reliable at tens of millions of records with conflict resolution, idempotency, and audit trails.Conversation dashboard & analytics: the customer-facing surface for full conversation history, transcripts, booking outcomes, containment/conversion metrics, and agent-quality analytics across locations.The team: lead the existing engineering team (voice/ML, backend/integrations, frontend, QA) through managers and senior ICs; shape team structure around the platform/integrations / dashboard pillars, develop and hire leaders, and establish on-call, quality bars, and eval-driven development for agent behavior.Execution & operating cadence: fast, predictable release cycles — planning, weekly reviews, and retrospectives that drive improvement; clear technical plans and milestones with trade-offs made explicit.Trust & compliance: HIPAA (BAAs), SOC 2, telephony/TCPA compliance, and safe-AI guardrails for autonomous customer-facing conversations.What success looks like:GA voice agent live in at least two verticals with measurable booking-conversion and call-containment targets.Certified, bidirectional integrations with the top systems of record in each launch vertical.Conversation dashboard adopted as a daily surface by customers; analytics driving retention and upsell.The team operating as a high-performing unit: clear team charters, a strong manager bench, predictable delivery, and production-grade reliability (99.9%+ voice uptime).What we're looking for:15+ years in software engineering, 6+ years leading large engineering teams through managers of managers, including inheriting and re-aligning an existing team.A blend of large-scale engineering rigor and startup speed — e.g., senior tenure at a global-scale technology organization plus experience at a high-growth startup.Leadership at an AI-native product company (agents, enterprise search/RAG, conversational AI, or ML-heavy consumer platforms) — you have shipped AI products to demanding users, not just prototyped them.Shipped and operated real-time and/or high-scale distributed systems in production — voice/video, telephony, streaming, or large-scale data synchronization.Hands-on familiarity with the modern LLM/voice stack (ASR/TTS, agent orchestration, evals, prompt/tool design) and pragmatic judgment on build-vs-buy (e.g., Retell/Vapi-class infra vs. in-house).Experience integrating with third-party systems of record (CRM, EHR/PMS, FSM, or DMS) and running partner-facing engineering relationships.0-to-1 product instincts at scale: comfort with ambiguity, fast iteration against real customer calls, and shipping before everything is perfect — while keeping a large org focused.Strong cross-functional operator: partners tightly with Product, Design, GTM, and external partners; communicates crisply with executives.Nice to Have:Domain experience in healthcare, dental, home services, or automotive software; HIPAA/SOC 2 exposure.Prior experience at a vertical SaaS or SMB-focused platform company.Experience with contact-center or CCaaS technology, SIP/WebRTC, or conversational analytics.Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in Computer Science or a related field; publications or patents in search, ML, or distributed systems.Experience leading India-based engineering orgs building for US/global customers, and operating across India–US time zones.A visible commitment to building inclusive teams — e.g., mentoring, women-in-tech advocacy, or community leadership.AI First Mindset:AI fluency is core to how we work. title: Compensation Advisor
description:
**Role Overview**
**Compensation Adviser – Global Compensation, Market Pricing & Analytics**
The
**Compensation Adviser**
will support the
**Global Compensation, Recognition and Tools COE**
through compensation analytics, market intelligence, market pricing, survey administration, and project support across NTT DATA's global organization.
  
  
The role will work closely with Global Reward COE colleagues, Regional and Country Total Reward Partners, and external compensation survey providers to support compensation initiatives across Consulting, Specialty Businesses, Business Services, and corporate functions.
  
  
A key focus of the position will be translating complex compensation and market data into
**clear, actionable insights**
. The successful candidate will be expected to go beyond data reporting by identifying anomalies, testing assumptions, assessing market relevance, and highlighting issues requiring further review.
  
  
The role requires strong analytical capability, advanced Excel and data-management skills, attention to detail, and a solid understanding of compensation fundamentals. The individual should be comfortable working with broad direction, managing multiple priorities, and progressively taking ownership of defined analytical and operational activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Market Pricing & Benchmarking**

* Conduct market pricing and benchmarking for jobs across multiple countries, job families, and business areas using approved compensation survey sources.
* Analyze job content, responsibilities, organizational scope, talent group, and career level to support appropriate survey job matching.
* Compare market data across multiple survey providers and identify material differences, anomalies, or questionable observations.
* Support the development and validation of market reference points, salary range midpoints, and supporting range analytics.
* Perform level-to-level progression, range-width, internal-pay, and market-positioning analyses.
* Document market-pricing recommendations, assumptions, data sources, and rationale to maintain a clear audit trail.

**Compensation Surveys & Market Intelligence**

* Coordinate annual and ad hoc compensation survey activities, including data preparation, submission, validation, and quality checks.
* Work with compensation survey providers such as Mercer, Aon Radford, WTW, and other relevant market-data vendors.
* Analyze survey participant populations, peer groups, industry cuts, and other market segments to assess relevance for NTT DATA.
* Maintain survey inventories, participation information, effective dates, aging assumptions, and supporting documentation.
* Monitor relevant compensation-market developments and identify insights that may influence benchmarking or market-pricing decisions.

**Compensation Analytics & Quality Assurance**

* Analyze large compensation and employee datasets to identify trends, anomalies, inconsistencies, and data-quality issues.
* Develop structured analyses supporting compensation decisions, market competitiveness, and internal consistency.
* Build and maintain Excel-based analytical tools, dashboards, review files, and management reports.
* Perform quality assurance across compensation outputs, including job matches, market values, salary ranges, and progression relationships.
* Investigate unusual results and determine whether issues arise from data quality, survey matching, methodology, or genuine market conditions.

**Project & Stakeholder Support**

* Support global compensation projects through data analysis, documentation, project tracking, and preparation of stakeholder materials.
* Prepare structured review packs for Total Reward Partners and consolidate market-pricing feedback and exceptions.
* Conduct first-level analysis of compensation questions raised by Total Reward Partners and escalate complex methodology or policy matters to the appropriate COE lead.
* Collaborate with global and regional colleagues to resolve data issues and ensure consistency of analysis.
* Coordinate with external vendors on survey participation, data requests, and analytical requirements.

**Technology & Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive compensation processes and improve data quality, reporting, and analytical efficiency.
* Use advanced Excel, analytics tools, and approved AI technologies to support analysis, quality assurance, documentation, and reporting.
* Support the development and testing of compensation tools and standardized analytical processes.
* Maintain clear process documentation and version-controlled working files.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 8-10 years of relevant experience in Compensation, Total Rewards, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, or a comparable analytical role.
* Demonstrated experience working with compensation data, salary benchmarking, or market-pricing analysis.
* Strong Microsoft Excel capability, including:

+ Pivot Tables
+ XLOOKUP and INDEX-MATCH
+ Advanced formulas
+ Data validation and reconciliation
+ Large dataset manipulation
+ Power Query
+ Reporting and dashboard development

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify data anomalies and investigate root causes.
* Ability to interpret data and develop meaningful conclusions rather than simply producing reports.
* High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work with broad direction.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working across countries, regions, or business units.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within Technology, IT Services, Consulting, or Professional Services.
* Exposure to global compensation programs and multi-country market pricing.
* Experience with compensation survey platforms such as Mercer, Aon Radford, WTW, Comptryx, Remchannel, or equivalent providers.
* Experience with Power BI or comparable data-visualization tools.
* Exposure to AI-enabled analytical tools, automation, or workflow improvement.
* Familiarity with job architecture, career frameworks, and salary-range design.

**Key Success Factors**
The successful candidate will:
  
  

* Demonstrate curiosity and challenge questionable data rather than accepting outputs at face value.
* Understand that job content and scope, not job title alone, drive market matching.
* Distinguish between a market data point and a compensation recommendation.
* Identify inconsistencies across survey sources, jobs, levels, and countries.
* Produce analysis that is accurate, traceable, and easy for another compensation professional to understand.
* Make sensible recommendations within defined methodology and escalate appropriately where policy or senior judgement is required.

title: Global HR Operations Senior Specialist – Contingent Workforce
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
BCG’s central Contingent Workforce team, branded as Contingent IQ, supports the engagement and onboarding of contingent workers and client-facing contractors across BCG. As part of the Concierge support model, the team partners closely with senior stakeholders, vendors, Procurement, Finance, and other internal teams to deliver a high-touch, compliant, and operationally effective onboarding experience.
  
  
The HR Operations Senior Specialist - Concierge Operations will be part of the regional structure for the front-facing Concierge team. This role is accountable for the day-to-day management of Concierge operations within the EMESA region, including oversight of intake, stakeholder coordination, approvals follow-up, contracting coordination, vendor engagement, and handoff into downstream operational processes. The role will also act as a key escalation point for the back-office team and support region-specific CIQ operational questions, helping ensure consistent service delivery and strong operational alignment across the global model.
  
  
Key role & responsibilities
  
  

* Leading the day-to-day front-facing Concierge operations for an assigned region, with accountability for service quality, stakeholder experience, and case progression across that regional portfolio.
* Managing the stakeholder-facing Concierge process across intake, kickoff coordination, approvals follow-up, contracting coordination, vendor engagement, and lifecycle case progression.
* Acting as the primary regional point of accountability for Concierge operations within EMESA while working closely with peers to provide cross-regional coverage and continuity of service.
* Comfortable working independently in shifts
* Serving as an escalation point within the region for complex, sensitive, or high-priority cases arising from the front-facing Concierge team, back-office team, or local CIQ operational activity.
* Supporting the back-office team on escalations, exceptions, and region-specific questions that require judgment, stakeholder coordination, or local operational context.
* Providing guidance on local or regional CIQ operational questions and helping connect stakeholders and teams to the right process path or resolution approach.
* Partnering closely with internal stakeholders including senior business sponsors, MDPs, HR, Procurement, Finance, EP&P, Risk, and vendors to progress cases and resolve issues.
* Ensuring the team provides clear guidance to stakeholders on process requirements, documentation, approvals, timelines, and next steps.
* Driving strong case management discipline across regional mailboxes, intake channels, trackers, and team workflows.
* Monitoring service quality, responsiveness, and operational performance across the assigned region and identifying issues, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Using operational judgment to resolve issues, remove blockers, and make informed decisions within established policies, guidelines, and precedents.
* Supporting the implementation of process updates and helping embed changes to governance, service delivery, and ways of working across the team.
* Contributing to the refinement of process documentation, operating procedures, templates, and service guidance materials, particularly where regional considerations or recurring escalations identify improvement needs.
* Partnering with leadership on regional workload management, prioritization, and coverage planning to ensure continuity across the global Concierge model.
* Supporting operational projects and value-added initiatives that enhance the Concierge model, regional service delivery, and stakeholder experience.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* A Graduate degree or equivalent.
* Significant experience in HR operations, contingent workforce operations, shared services, stakeholder operations, procurement coordination, or a related operational environment.
* Proven ability to manage complex operational workflows involving multiple stakeholders, regional variation, and multiple handoffs.
* Flexibility to work in shifts, as needed, to provide effective coverage across the EMESA region.
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience working with senior internal stakeholders.
* Strong professional judgment, attention to detail, and ability to manage sensitive information.
* Proficiency in MS Office, especially Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Experience working in a matrix organization is preferred.
* Demonstrated integrity, professionalism, and a strong service mindset.
* Desirable: Experience with contingent workforce processes, supplier onboarding, contractor lifecycle operations, shared mailboxes, service management, Coupa, Workday, Fieldglass, or related tools.

Additional info
  
  
YOU'RE GOOD AT
  
  

* This role requires someone who can lead regional operations in a complex, matrixed global organization while maintaining strong service quality and stakeholder confidence:
* Work effectively within a global, cross-cultural, and virtual environment.
* Lead day-to-day operational activity within a defined regional remit with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Build credibility with a wide range of stakeholders, including senior stakeholders, through sound judgment and strong delivery.
* Communicate complex or sensitive information clearly, tactfully, and with appropriate stakeholder buy-in.
* Take a solution-oriented approach and resolve problems while navigating ambiguity, regional nuance, and competing priorities.
* Apply policies, guidelines, and precedent thoughtfully in both routine and non-routine situations.
* Drive a high standard of operational quality, responsiveness, and consistency across regional team outputs.
* Develop effective working relationships across functions and use those relationships to move work forward.
* Act as a trusted escalation point for operational issues requiring coordination, judgment, and stakeholder management.
* Identify process gaps and regional improvement opportunities and help embed changes successfully within the team.
* Balance stakeholder service, operational execution, escalation support, and regional team leadership in a fast-paced environment.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork

description:
As our AI Engineering Intern, you will work closely with our team to design, build and evaluate this agent from early prototype to a working pilot used by real project teams.

* Design clarifying-question flows so the agent can interview stakeholders and fill gaps.
* Build retrieval (RAG) over project documents and domain glossaries so outputs are grounded and cite their sources.
* Create traceability links between requirements, design items and test cases.
* Integrate with tools teams already use, such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, GitHub or Notion, via APIs or MCP connectors.
* Set up an evaluation framework: build test datasets, define metrics (precision/recall of extracted requirements, quality scores, reviewer acceptance rate) and track improvements over time.

* Final-year undergraduate, postgraduate, or recent graduate in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, AI/ML or a related field.

* Understanding of prompt engineering, tool/function calling and the basics of agent design.
* Familiarity with RAG concepts: embeddings, chunking, vector databases (e.g. FAISS, Chroma, pgvector, Pinecone).
* Basic understanding of the software development lifecycle and what good requirements look like.
* Comfort with Git, REST APIs and working on Linux/command line.
* Clear written and spoken communication in English.

Good to have

You will partner closely with product, engineering, and business leaders to translate ambiguous problems into scalable ML models, experimentation frameworks, and data-driven product decisions. In this role, you will design and deploy advanced ML and statistical models for capabilities such as prioritization, intent detection, and proactive action recommendations. You will analyze large-scale datasets and run rigorous experiments, including A/B testing and causal analysis, to measure impact and continuously improve customer engagement and product performance. * Partner with product, engineering, operations, and security teams to translate complex business problems into scalable, production-ready data science and ML solutions.

* Develop ML-powered systems supporting key business areas.
* Lead research and analysis to understand customer interactions with Alexa, and enhance overall customer experience.

* 3+ years of data scientist experience

description:
**Purpose of this position / Position summary**

The Engineering Product Owner - Lifecycle owns requirement clarity, backlog readiness, and cross-functional execution for Refraction Product lifecycle management and sustaining-engineering topics in a regulated medical-device environment at Vision Care Solutions.

The role consolidates customer, service, quality, regulatory, product-management, UX, software, hardware, and systems-engineering inputs into traceable requirements, prioritized backlogs, and measurable lifecycle outcomes that improve product quality, usability, serviceability, and installed-base performance.

**Primary duties and responsibilities**

**Lifecycle ownership and installed-base improvements**

• Own engineering coordination for lifecycle initiatives, installed-base enhancements, technical escalations, issue resolution, upgrades, and end-of-life actions.

• Translate field feedback, complaint trends, CAPA inputs, service data, customer needs, and product priorities into clear lifecycle scope, milestones, risks, and success criteria.

• Track closure effectiveness, customer impact, serviceability improvements, lessons learned, and benefit realization through agreed lifecycle metrics.

**Requirement engineering and backlog ownership**

• Lead end-to-end requirement engineering, including elicitation, analysis, refinement, validation, signoff, and audit-ready documentation.

• Convert high-level business, clinical, user, and technical needs into clear functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and definition-of-ready expectations.

• Maintain feature-to-user-story-to-acceptance-criteria traceability and ensure alignment with product intent, risk controls, verification strategy, design-transfer impact, and QMS expectations.

• Own and prioritize the product/lifecycle backlog by balancing customer value, regulatory commitments, technical debt, security, usability, resource constraints, and delivery priorities.

• Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum/SAFe, sprint planning, backlog grooming, traceability, verification evidence, defect management, dashboards, and cross-functional delivery governance.

• Ability to work with architecture and development teams, translate complex requirements, clarify legacy-system gaps, and drive development-ready backlog quality.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and influencing skills across global and cross-functional teams.

**Education, experience and job specifications**

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM discipline.

• Typically 10 to 12 years of experience in software/product engineering, technical product development, lifecycle engineering, sustaining engineering, or regulated technology execution.

This is an engineering ownership role accountable for lifecycle execution, requirement quality, backlog readiness, product-owner discipline, and cross-functional delivery clarity. title: Product Value Consultant
description:
**Company Overview**
Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively.
  
  
As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution.
  
  
Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifth consecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000 customers globally, including 45% of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide.
  
  
**Why Join Planview?**
At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works.
  
  
Discover more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for a Product Value Consultant to join our team in Bangalore.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Product Strategy & Customer Insight**

* Lead customer discovery, executive briefings, workshops, product deep dives, and advisory conversations, client demos to understand business objectives, workflows, pain points, success measures, and buying criteria.

* Analyse different areas of the business, identify opportunities to apply expertise to build stronger solutions. Drive end-to-end feature development, translating customer needs into prioritized requirements and partnering with design and engineering to deliver valuable product improvements.

**Pre Sales & Client Engagement**

* Partner with Account Executives and Solution Consultants to prioritize strategic opportunities and act as the product lead on complex pursuits, including discovery, tailored demonstrations, proof-of-value engagements, RFP/RFI responses, and proposal content.

* Lead use case workshops, translating functional and non-functional requirements into clear, deliverable use cases, and build executive confidence through client-focused demonstrations and reference solutions that prove ROI.
* Move customers from high-level strategy to tangible outcomes through rapid prototyping, proof-of-concept configurations, and AI-assisted solution scenarios.
* Act as a trusted product expert in customer conversations and help create confidence in the solution, implementation approach, and path to value.
* Support customer escalations and complex solution discussions by aligning customer needs, product capabilities, feasibility, and commitments.

**Product & Go to Market Enablement**

* Create reusable demo storylines, use-case maps, value narratives, solution briefs, competitive insights, workshop playbooks, and customer-facing product materials.
* Partner with Product Marketing and Sales Enablement to strengthen positioning, messaging, field readiness, launch communications, and competitive differentiation.
* Represent Retain in customer webinars, industry events, advisory programs, and executive briefings.

**Business Outcomes & Cross Functional Execution**

* Partner with Retain leadership to improve bookings, retention, adoption, expansion, customer value, and margin through better product and customer decisions.
* Provide structured voice-of-customer feedback to Product, Design, Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Support.
* Ensure clear handoffs from pre-sales to implementation and customer success, including use cases, success measures, product commitments, risks, and dependencies.
* Track customer and commercial signals and use them to recommend improvements to product priorities, enablement, adoption, and customer experience.

**What You'll Bring**
**What You Bring**

* 8–10 years of experience in product management, solution consulting, presales, enterprise consulting, implementation consulting, preferably in the PPM domain.
* Experience with complex enterprise software, ideally in portfolio management, work management, resource management, transformation, or adjacent domains.
* Working understanding of the AI and GenAI landscape and how AI capabilities can be applied to automate and improve enterprise workflows.
* Strong customer discovery, product judgement, executive communication, storytelling, workshop facilitation, and product demonstration skills.
* Ability to distill complex technical and product concepts into compelling, value-driven narratives, moving seamlessly between detailed working sessions with practitioners and strategy briefings with C-level executives.
* Ability to translate ambiguous customer needs into clear problems, use cases, requirements, decisions, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience partnering with Sales, Solution Consulting, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Customer Success, and Professional Services in a matrix organization.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of how product decisions influence bookings, adoption, retention, expansion, and margin.
* Prior customer-facing presales, technical sales, or field experience, ideally gained at a leading enterprise SaaS, cloud, or consulting firm.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites and events as needed.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; relevant product, Agile, consulting, or domain certifications are a plus.

**Success Measures**

* Success in this role will be measured primarily by its impact on Net Revenue Retention (NRR), through features that strengthen customer adoption, retention, and expansion.
* Influence on strategic opportunity progression, product or technical wins, and quality of customer commitments.
* Quality and reuse of discovery, solution, demonstration, value, and enablement assets.
* Speed and quality of the customer-insight-to-product-feedback loop.
* Improved adoption, retention, expansion, customer value, and pre-sales-to-delivery handoffs.
* Evidence that customer and market insights improve Retain product priorities and P&L outcomes.

**Benefits At Planview**
At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:
  
  

* Unplugged Days: 4 company-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
* Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
* Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
* Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
* Employee Referral bonus program.
* Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
* Flexible work hours/environment.

Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!

Planview is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Reasonable accommodations for the interview process can be requested by emailing recruitment@planview.com.

Planview may employ AI-based tools to support certain recruiting activities, however all decisions affecting a candidate's application are made by a human recruiter or hiring manager. title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Now Assist-HRSD
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Now Assist & HRSD)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
  
  
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
* Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
* Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
* Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

. Serves as the enterprise technical product ownership lead for major cross-domain products, platforms, or strategic initiatives that span multiple functions, product areas, or delivery organizations.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
Operating as an individual contributor, leads execution of enterprise initiatives and transformation efforts, partnering with Product Management, business, engineering, architecture, security, data, QA, and operations teams to drive roadmap commitments to successful outcomes across organizational boundaries. Accountable for coordinated delivery readiness, product quality, and business outcome achievement across the teams and domains an initiative touches, and for maintaining trusted product knowledge assets that enable effective human and AI-assisted development at enterprise scope. Applies product ownership standards and practices consistently across the initiatives led, mentors less experienced Technical Product Owners, and serves as the primary business and delivery lead for the most complex products, including those operating without dedicated Product Manager support. Leads initiatives and drives outcomes; does not own the enterprise standards, governance frameworks, or long-term technology direction that define the Principal role
  
  
**Roadmap Execution & Product Ownership**

* Leads execution of enterprise and cross-domain roadmap initiatives spanning multiple products, platforms, functions, or delivery organizations, partnering with Product Managers where assigned.
* Serves as the primary business and delivery lead for the most complex products or capabilities operating without dedicated Product Manager support.
* Coordinates multiple teams and domains on backlog strategy, prioritization inputs, delivery sequencing, release scope, and product quality expectations for the initiatives led.
* Guides decisions that balance business value, delivery feasibility, operational impact, risk, and product quality across the organizational boundaries an initiative spans.
* Communicates initiative execution strategy, risks, tradeoffs, and multi-year outcome progress to senior and executive stakeholders.

**Delivery, Quality & Maintenance**

* Directs roadmap execution, release readiness, quality improvement, dependency management, and stakeholder alignment across the teams and domains an initiative touches.
* Resolves the most complex escalated product issues, systemic delivery gaps, requirement ambiguity, and enterprise outcome or quality risks within the initiatives led.
* Ensures delivered capabilities align with enterprise business intent, approved requirements, operational needs, and expected product outcomes.
* Leads transformation and capability-improvement initiatives that raise delivery effectiveness across multiple teams.

**Knowledge Management & AI-Assisted Development**

* Applies and reinforces enterprise product-ownership and knowledge standards (defined at the Principal level) consistently across the initiatives led.
* Builds and curates product knowledge articles, reusable business context, prompts, business rules, and decision records for the products and initiatives owned.
* Reviews AI-generated planning outputs, requirements, implementation context, and release documentation for business accuracy, product quality, traceability, and alignment to intended outcomes.
* Champions adoption of artifact-driven delivery, lifecycle traceability, and human review of AI-assisted development outputs across the teams an initiative spans.
* Mentors Lead and senior Technical Product Owners on maintaining durable product knowledge assets that support quality delivery and responsible use of AI-assisted development.

**Collaboration & Agile Delivery**

* Mentors Lead and senior Technical Product Owners and guides product ownership execution across the initiatives led while remaining an individual contributor.
* Coordinates cross-team and cross-domain refinement, dependency management, release sequencing, and product quality validation.
* Partners with Product Management, engineering, QA, architecture, security, data, operations, and executive business stakeholders to drive successful enterprise delivery outcomes.

Collaborates across executive-level stakeholders and enterprise organizations to align initiative outcomes with strategic priorities
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and 8+ years of related product, technology, delivery, business analysis, product ownership, or product management experience; or
* Master's degree in a relevant discipline and 6+ years of related experience
* Extensive technical product ownership experience leading enterprise and cross-domain initiatives across complex products, platforms, integrations, or strategic programs.
* Experience leading enterprise roadmap and transformation initiatives, aligning stakeholders across multiple functions or organizations, and leading without authority at scale.
* Experience partnering with Product Managers where assigned and serving as the primary business and delivery lead where dedicated Product Manager support is not available.
* Experience building and curating durable product knowledge artifacts, context repositories, reusable prompts, knowledge articles, and decision records for owned products and initiatives.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development, human-in-the-loop review, product quality validation, and lifecycle traceability at enterprise scope.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor Lead and senior practitioners and drive initiative outcomes across organizational boundaries.
* Relevant educational backgrounds may include business, healthcare, technology, engineering, analytics, product management, project management, or related disciplines.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and 8+ years of related product, technology, delivery, business analysis, product ownership, or product management experience

title: Director - AI Delivery Product
description:
**About Firstsource**
Firstsource Solutions Limited, an RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group company (NSE: FSL, BSE: 532809, Reuters: FISO.BO, Bloomberg: FSOL:IN), is a specialized global business process services partner, providing transformational solutions and services spanning the customer lifecycle across Healthcare, Banking and Financial Services, Communications, Media and Technology, Retail, and other diverse industries. With an established presence in the US, the UK, India, Mexico, Australia, South Africa, and the Philippines, we make it happen for our clients, solving their biggest challenges with hyper-focused, domain-centered teams and cutting-edge tech, data, and analytics. Our real-world practitioners work collaboratively to deliver future-focused outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a commercially astute and technically visionary Director to own and scale Firstsource's AI & Cloud product portfolio across multiple product lines. You will set product strategy, engineering standards, and investment priorities across the portfolio, while mentoring a team of Associate Directors and engineering leaders. With 18+ years of experience, you bring deep Python and Generative AI expertise, enterprise cloud architecture mastery, and the executive presence to shape AI product strategy at the CXO level.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio Strategy & Architecture**

* Define multi-year product strategy and investment roadmap across the AI product portfolio.
* Set enterprise architecture standards and reference patterns embedding Generative AI and agentic workflows across all product lines.
* Approve major architecture decisions and technology bets across product engineering teams.
* Represent product strategy to executive leadership and, where relevant, the board.

**Engineering Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead a portfolio of product engineering teams (20–40 engineers) across geographies via Associate Directors and Senior Managers.
* Own portfolio-level P&L, resourcing, and executive-level roadmap reporting.
* Establish org-wide delivery governance, quality, and risk frameworks.
* Champion enterprise-wide adoption of AI coding agents and agentic delivery practices.

**Generative AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Set enterprise policy for Generative AI governance, safety, and model observability across all products/programmes.
* Sponsor evaluation and adoption of emerging agentic frameworks (LangChain, Agent Core, CrewAI, etc.) at an organizational level.
* Own the AI technology vision presented to clients, analysts, and partners.
* Champion responsible AI practices across the portfolio.

**People & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and mentor a leadership bench of Associate Directors, Senior Managers, and technical architects.
* Own executive stakeholder relationships with CXOs, business unit heads, and board-level sponsors.
* Drive an org-wide culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Represent the AI Delivery organization in strategic planning and partnership discussions.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 18+ years in software / AI engineering; 8+ years at Director or senior leadership level.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Demonstrated track record of building and shipping end-to-end applications across the full SDLC.
* Full lifecycle ownership: ideation → architecture → engineering → production → optimisation, at portfolio scale.
* Proven enterprise cloud architecture and deployment leadership across at least one hyperscaler.
* Demonstrable track record of scaling multiple AI products from concept to sustained, adopted production use.
* Strong commercial acumen: portfolio P&L ownership, investment business-case development, and roadmap governance.
* ⚠️ Disclaimer: Firstsource follows a fair, transparent, and merit-based hiring process. We never ask for money at any stage. Beware of fraudulent offers and always verify through our official channels or @firstsource.com email addresses.

title: Digital Solutions Manager (Recruiting Tech & Learning Platforms)
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**Digital Solutions Manager**
**(Recruiting Tech & Learning Platforms)**

This role sits within People Experience & AI transformation and serves as the strategic technical and functional capability lead for Okta's Recruiting and Learning ecosystem. As a Digital Solutions Manager with deep expertise in enterprise systems, integrations, automation, data architecture, and AI, you will define and execute the technology vision that enables scalable hiring, workforce development, and organizational growth.

In this role, you will establish the long-term technical and technical strategy for recruiting and learning systems, ensuring our platforms, integrations, data architecture, and AI capabilities work together seamlessly to support global operations. You will translate business priorities into scalable technical solutions, balancing user experience, operational efficiency, governance, and future-state innovation.

You will operate at the intersection of systems architecture, automation, and user experience—building solutions that improve efficiency, enable better decision-making, and support global growth. This role also requires strong AI fluency, with a focus on leveraging AI-driven capabilities to enhance recruiting processes, learning experiences, and operational automation.

**What You'll Own**

* **Roadmap & Systems**
  : Define & execute the roadmap for Recruiting and Learning systems, ensuring alignment with business goals. Serve as the primary SME across ATS, CRM, LMS and AI tools. Design scalable, future-ready architectures, evaluate emerging technologies, and translate complex business needs into strategic technical solutions through partnership with People Technology and Business leaders.
* **Integrations, Automation & Optimization:**
  Partner with Technology teams to define requirements for integrations across systems using APIs, middleware, and data pipelines. Drive automation of manual processes across recruiting and learning workflows to improve efficiency and reduce operational overhead. Lead the business side of system implementations—including requirements gathering, process mapping, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and change management/readiness—while partnering with the technology team for solution design, configuration, and deployment. Continuously identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve system performance.
* **Data Integrity, Reporting & Insights:**
  Establish and maintain data integrity standards, validation rules, and monitoring processes. Ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and consistency across systems. Partner with analytics teams to align on reporting frameworks and enable actionable insights.
* **AI Enablement & Innovation:**
  Leverage AI-enabled capabilities (e.g., candidate matching, chatbots, recommendations, content generation) to optimize recruiting and learning processes. Evaluate and implement AI-driven tools and features across systems. Identify high-impact use cases for AI to improve efficiency, personalization, and decision-making. Partner with stakeholders to drive responsible and scalable adoption of AI solutions.
* **Troubleshooting, Governance & Best Practices:**
  Troubleshoot complex system issues and perform root cause analysis using structured problem-solving approaches. Partner with IT and Security to ensure system reliability, compliance, and scalability. Establish and document best practices for system configuration, usage, and maintenance. Maintain comprehensive technical documentation (system architecture, data flows, configurations).
* **Leadership & Cross-Functional Impact:**
  Act as a technical subject matter expert for recruiting and learning systems within People. Partner with Recruiting and Learning & Development teams to translate business needs into technical solutions. Collaborate with Business Technology / IT on integrations, architecture, and system performance. Engage with vendors and external partners to support implementations and roadmap alignment. Support global users through issue resolution, training, and documentation to drive adoption and effectiveness.

**What You Bring**

* Deep expertise in recruiting systems (ATS, CRM, interview platforms) and Learning Management Systems (LMS)
* Strong experience in system configuration, architecture, and administration
* Experience leading system implementations and managing medium-to-large complexity technical initiatives
* Strong understanding of data models, reporting, and system governance
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex issues and perform root cause analysis
* Experience leveraging automation to improve operational efficiency
* AI fluency, including familiarity with AI/ML applications and AI-enabled features in recruiting and learning platforms
* Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments and translate business needs into technical solutions

**Why This Role Matters**

This role is foundational to how Okta scales its recruiting and learning capabilities. You will build and maintain the systems that enable efficient hiring, effective learning, and data-driven decision-making across the organization. Your work will directly impact operational efficiency, user experience, and the company's ability to grow with the right talent and capabilities.

**The Okta Experience**

* Supporting Your Well-Being
* Driving Social Impact
* Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + Community

We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.
  
  
Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, or status as a protected veteran. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and convictions records, consistent with applicable laws.
  
  
If reasonable accommodation is needed to complete any part of the job application, interview process, or onboarding please use this Form to request an accommodation.
