In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, if you are an applicant or employee residing in New York City, please click here to view our full NYC AEDT Notice.

title: Senior Manager / P2P Technology & Digital Transformation Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Senior Manager leads the technology strategy, solution architecture, implementation, and continuous modernization of the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) ecosystem across entities and clients. The role is technology-led and requires strong working knowledge of finance, accounting, and P2P controls to translate business requirements into secure, scalable, and measurable digital solutions.
  
  
The P2P Technology & Digital Transformation Lead is accountable for designing and scaling an integrated technology landscape spanning intelligent document processing, ERP platforms, workflow orchestration, automation, analytics, process mining, and AI. A core focus is Hypatos, including platform configuration, document model enablement, extraction and validation design, exception handling, workflow integration, performance monitoring, and production support.
  
  
This role owns the P2P technology roadmap, target architecture, solution standards, integration patterns, data flows, non-functional requirements, and technology governance. It ensures alignment with finance policies, accounting requirements, regulatory expectations, information security, access controls, auditability, and client outcomes.
  
  
The Senior Manager acts as a technology product owner and transformation architect, leading multidisciplinary teams across Hypatos, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Ariba, Power Platform, UiPath, Power BI, Celonis, APIs, cloud services, and AI Agents. The role uses finance and P2P knowledge to ensure that technology solutions correctly support invoice capture, validation, coding, matching, approvals, posting, payments, reconciliation, tax, and period-end requirements.
  
  
**Job Goals**

* Deliver a Future-Ready P2P Technology Architecture
* Define and maintain the target architecture across Hypatos, ERP, procurement, workflow, payment, analytics, process-mining, and AI platforms.
* Build modular, API-enabled, secure, and scalable solutions that can be reused across clients and geographies.
* Maximize Hypatos Platform Value

* Establish Hypatos as a strategic intelligent document processing capability for invoice ingestion, classification, extraction, validation, enrichment, and exception routing.
* Deliver measurable Hypatos outcomes such as:

+ Higher extraction accuracy and confidence levels
+ Lower manual validation and exception volumes
+ Faster model tuning, deployment, and production stabilization
+ Advance AI, Automation & Touchless Processing
+ Increase straight-through invoice processing using Hypatos, AI, workflow automation, ERP integration, and intelligent matching.
+ Deliver measurable outcomes:
+ Touchless-processing and straight-through-posting rates at or above agreed targets

- Reduction in manual interventions, rework, and avoidable exceptions
- Improved automation reliability, adoption, and user experience

* Enable Secure, Reliable & Scalable Technology Delivery
* Improve platform availability, integration stability, release quality, monitoring, and incident resolution.
* Design solutions that support growth without linear increases in manual effort or technology support cost.
* Strengthen Technology Governance, Risk & Controls
* Embed role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails, data protection, AI governance, and change controls into solution design.
* Ensure technology configurations correctly enforce finance policies, tax rules, approval limits, and accounting controls.
* Use Data & Process Intelligence to Drive Decisions
* Create real-time visibility using Power BI, Celonis or equivalent process-mining and analytics capabilities.
* Use operational data to identify root causes, prioritize automation, predict exceptions, and optimize technology performance.
* Build & Retain High-Performing Technology Talent
* Develop capability across Hypatos, solution architecture, integration, AI, automation, analytics, testing, DevOps, and finance-process knowledge.
* Create succession plans and specialist career pathways for technology product owners, architects, developers, analysts, and platform SMEs.
* Position EY as a P2P Technology Transformation Leader
* Build reusable reference architectures, Hypatos implementation accelerators, integration patterns, controls, and deployment playbooks.
* Enable client expansion by demonstrating proven technology outcomes, scalable assets, and measurable value realization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Technology Product Ownership & Architecture
* Define and maintain the global P2P technology architecture, product roadmap, solution standards, integration principles, and platform lifecycle plans.
* Translate finance and P2P requirements into user stories, solution designs, data models, interface specifications, security requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Lead architecture and design reviews covering ERP, Hypatos, procurement platforms, workflow, automation, analytics, process mining, and AI services.
* Oversee technology discovery, proof of concept, configuration, build, integration testing, UAT, deployment, hypercare, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the final escalation point for critical platform, integration, data, security, performance, and production issues.
* Ensure end-to-end technology alignment across upstream Procurement and vendor-master solutions and downstream Accounting, Payments, Treasury, and R2R platforms.

Own vendor and platform governance, including roadmaps, release management, service levels, technical debt, licensing considerations, and value realization.
  
  
**Digital, Analytical**
**& Transformation**
**Enablement**

* Hypatos, AI, Automation & Analytics Enablement
* Own the Hypatos strategy and implementation approach, including document ingestion, classification, extraction schemas, validation rules, confidence thresholds, human-in-the-loop design, exception queues, model improvement, and ERP/workflow integration.
* Lead technical integration of Hypatos with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Business Central, Ariba, email channels, scanning solutions, approval workflows, master data, tax engines, and downstream accounting systems using APIs, middleware, or approved integration services.
* Design and deploy AI-assisted invoice coding, exception prediction, duplicate detection, vendor-query automation, intelligent matching, and agentic workflows with appropriate human oversight and controls.
* Ensure disciplined engineering practices across environments, versioning, release management, testing, monitoring, logging, incident management, model performance, and production support.

Build Power BI dashboards and Celonis/process-mining views to monitor extraction accuracy, touchless rates, exception drivers, cycle time, interface failures, and automation value.
  
  
Evaluate emerging technologies through structured architecture assessment, proof of concept, security review, finance-control validation, and business-value measurement.
  
  
**Capability Building & People Leadership**

* Technology Capability Building & People Leadership
* Establish role-based capability frameworks for Hypatos specialists, solution architects, integration engineers, automation developers, data analysts, product owners, and finance-technology SMEs.
* Mentor technology teams on solution architecture, secure design, API integration, AI governance, testing, observability, DevOps practices, and P2P process implications.
* Partner with HR and L&D to develop certification and learning pathways covering Hypatos, Microsoft Power Platform, Azure AI, UiPath, Power BI, Celonis, SAP, D365, and finance fundamentals.
* Create hands-on labs, reference solutions, reusable components, coding standards, design templates, and communities of practice.

Build blended teams that combine deep technology expertise with sufficient accounting, controls, tax, and P2P process knowledge.
  
  
Manage technology capacity, succession, specialist career paths, and deployment readiness in alignment with the future finance-technology strategy.
  
  
**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the strategic technology advisor to client CFO, CIO, Finance Transformation, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Procurement, and P2P leadership teams.
* Lead technology discovery workshops, architecture reviews, platform assessments, vendor evaluations, transformation steering committees, and technology-focused QBRs.
* Support solution design, effort estimation, technology due diligence, transition planning, integration assessment, and implementation roadmap development for new and existing clients.
* Partner with Hypatos and other technology vendors to resolve product gaps, align roadmaps, manage releases, and improve implementation outcomes.

Coordinate with cross-tower technology leads across O2C, R2R, Treasury, Tax, and reporting to ensure common data, integration, security, and AI architecture standards.
  
  
Communicate complex technical choices in business and finance language, clearly explaining value, risk, cost, dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
  
  
**Functional & Technical Skills**

* Deep expertise in finance technology transformation, solution architecture, intelligent document processing, automation, integration, analytics, and AI-enabled workflow design.
* Advanced practical knowledge of Hypatos, including platform architecture, Studio or configuration capabilities, document classification, field extraction, validation logic, confidence thresholds, model training and tuning, exception handling, workflow orchestration, ERP integration, monitoring, and production support.
* Strong experience integrating Hypatos or comparable IDP platforms with:
* SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Business Central, Ariba, or comparable ERP/procurement platforms
* Email, supplier portals, scanning channels, master-data services, approval workflows, tax engines, and payment systems
* APIs, middleware, web services, data pipelines, identity services, and enterprise integration platforms
* Hands-on understanding of Power Platform, UiPath, Power BI, Celonis/process mining, Azure AI or comparable cloud and AI services, and AI Agent orchestration.
* Knowledge of solution architecture methods, data models, API design, security architecture, role-based access, segregation of duties, logging, monitoring, testing automation, DevOps, release management, and service operations.
* Strong finance and accounting knowledge covering AP accounting, vendor master data, PO and non-PO invoices, 2-way and 3-way matching, GR/IR, accruals, tax, payments, reconciliations, financial controls, audit requirements, and period-end close.
* Ability to translate finance rules and control requirements into system configurations, validation logic, workflows, integrations, test scenarios, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Proven track record delivering multi-country technology transformation in shared services, global delivery, or complex client environments.
* Experience managing technology vendors, product roadmaps, platform performance, technical debt, licensing, service levels, and value realization.

Practical knowledge of responsible AI, data privacy, cybersecurity, model governance, human-in-the-loop controls, and auditability in finance solutions.
  
  
**Future-Ready & Behavioural Competencies**

* Technology Leadership: Sets a clear architecture vision and drives adoption of scalable, secure, supportable technology platforms.
* Solution Thinking: Converts finance and P2P requirements into practical designs, integrations, configurations, and implementation roadmaps.
* Hypatos Product Mindset: Treats Hypatos as an enterprise capability, continuously improving models, workflows, integrations, controls, and user experience.
* Innovation Mindset: Runs disciplined experiments and pilots across IDP, GenAI, AI Agents, process mining, and intelligent automation.
* Change & Adoption Leadership: Leads technology rollout, training, operating-model transition, and stabilization with minimal business disruption.
* Collaboration & Influence: Aligns Finance, Technology, Security, Data, Procurement, vendors, and delivery teams across geographies.

Capability Building: Develops teams with deep technology specialism and sufficient finance-process knowledge to deliver reliable outcomes.
  
  
**Performance Metrics / KPIs**

* Hypatos extraction accuracy, confidence distribution, validation effort, exception rate, and model-improvement velocity
* Touchless-processing, straight-through-posting, automation adoption, and manual-intervention reduction
* Integration reliability, interface success rate, platform availability, incident volume, and mean time to resolution
* Release quality, test coverage, defect leakage, deployment frequency, and hypercare stabilization
* Security, access-control, segregation-of-duties, auditability, data-privacy, and responsible-AI compliance
* Technology cost efficiency, reuse of common components, technical-debt reduction, and scalability
* User adoption, platform satisfaction, technology-team capability, certification, and retention

Finance outcomes enabled by technology, including invoice accuracy, cycle time, on-time payment, control effectiveness, and value realization
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, Data/AI, or a related discipline. A CA, CPA, ACCA, MBA (Finance), or equivalent finance qualification is advantageous but not mandatory where strong applied finance-process knowledge is demonstrated.
* Experience: 15–20 years of progressive experience in finance technology, enterprise applications, intelligent automation, solution architecture, product engineering, or digital transformation, including at least 4–5 years leading complex P2P or accounts-payable technology programs.
* Demonstrated experience owning technology architecture and delivery across discovery, design, configuration, development, integration, testing, deployment, hypercare, support, and scale-up.
* Direct hands-on or leadership experience with Hypatos in a P2P or accounts-payable environment is strongly preferred. Experience should include document model configuration or training, extraction validation, workflow and ERP integration, exception design, performance monitoring, and production optimization.
* Proven experience with ERP ecosystems, APIs, middleware, cloud services, automation platforms, analytics, process mining, AI solutions, cybersecurity, data governance, and technology-service management. Strong working knowledge of finance and accounting processes and controls, with prior exposure to multi-country delivery, client technology governance, platform migrations, and enterprise transformation programs highly preferred.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Your role**
=============

General - Data Analytics - P4 - IND

**What you'll be doing**
========================

• Lead development of dashboards, forecasting models, and diagnostic analyses to support decisions • Validate and reconcile data from multiple systems to ensure insight quality • Collaborate with stakeholders to interpret insights and refine business questions • Improve data structures, models, and automation supporting analytics efficiency • Prepare executive-ready visuals and narratives summarizing trends and drivers • Mentor junior analysts and review deliverables for accuracy and clarity

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Senior Data Scientist to join the Risk Analytics team supporting Credit, Treasury, Liquidity, and Cash Management. Reporting to the Risk Analytics Lead, you will play a hands-on role in maintaining and enhancing operational reports, performing data analysis, and improving automated reporting processes that support business decision-making. This role is ideal for an experienced analyst ready to take ownership of high-impact deliverables and collaborate across global teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and deliver complex business-as-usual (BAU) reports supporting Credit, Treasury, Liquidity, Cash Management, and Operations.
* Analyze large datasets to extract insights, identify trends, validate outputs, and recommend reporting or process improvements.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders and internal business partners to gather requirements and deliver reliable data-driven reporting solutions.
* Use SQL, Python, Excel, and related data tools for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, and reporting automation.
* Work with internal partners to resolve data issues, improve data quality, and ensure accurate and timely reporting.
* Proactively troubleshoot reporting anomalies, document root causes, and communicate findings and resolutions to stakeholders.
* Support data integration and standardization from new sources, and adapt reporting solutions to evolving business needs.
* Contribute to continuous improvements in reporting efficiency, accuracy, automation, documentation, and control measures.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 6-7 years of experience in data analytics, reporting, business intelligence, data engineering, or a related role.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.

* Proficiency in **SQL, Python, and Excel**.
* Working knowledge of VBA, Power BI or other data-visualization tools, and AI-enabled analytics tools is an advantage. Exposure to machine learning or model development is desirable but not required.
* Strong attention to detail and data quality.
* Interest in learning about Risk operations, including Credit, Treasury, Liquidity, and Cash Management, in a data context.
* Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and collaborate effectively.
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

title: Senior Principal - RTE
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Release Train Engineer is a servant leader and delivery coach for the Agile Release Train delivering GSK's network and connectivity platforms, applying SAFe practices within GSK's Technology operating model to coordinate the flow of value across the teams building and running those platforms. Operating consistently with the BCG platform operating model, the role treats the platform as a product delivered by a durable, cross-functional team, and is accountable for facilitating Programme Increment planning, coordinating dependencies and risks across teams, and driving predictable, high quality delivery through Agile ceremonies, flow metrics and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Facilitate Programme Increment planning and Agile Release Train execution**

* Plan, prepare and facilitate PI Planning, System Demos, Inspect and Adapt workshops and other Agile Release Train events for the platform's teams.
* Coordinate Scrum of Scrums, ART sync and cross-team ceremonies to maintain alignment on scope, sequencing and delivery against the Programme Increment.
* Build and maintain the ART's Programme Board, tracking major milestones, cross-team dependencies and feature delivery against the Programme Increment.
* Support Product Management and Product Owners in refining the Programme Backlog and preparing content for Planning Interval events.

**Manage dependencies, risks and impediments across the train**

* Identify, track and resolve cross-team and cross-platform dependencies and risks using ROAM (Resolved, Owned, Accepted, Mitigated).
* Escalate and remove impediments to flow that individual teams cannot resolve themselves, including supplier, platform or portfolio level blockers.
* Coordinate with other Release Train Engineers, Solution Train Engineers and Platform Managers to sequence work across dependent platforms and domains.

**Drive flow, predictability and continuous improvement**

* Track and report flow metrics including velocity, programme predictability, cycle time and quality trends, and use them to drive improvement actions.
* Coach teams, Scrum Masters and Product Owners in Lean-Agile and SAFe practices, building local capability rather than acting as a single point of control.
* Partner with Portfolio, Solution and Platform stakeholders to continuously improve the ART's ways of working, tooling and use of automation or AI-assisted delivery practices.

**Key Relationships/Customers**
**Business Stakeholders**

* Product teams and business technology groups whose network or platform capability delivery depends on a predictable, well coordinated Agile Release Train.
* Business service owners and key users where delivery sequencing, dependencies or timelines affect service quality or adoption.
* Business service owners and key users where engineering quality, resilience or change risk directly affects business outcomes.

**Tech Stakeholders**

* Product Owners, Scrum Masters/Team Coaches, Principal Engineers and Platform Managers for the teams on the train.
* Solution Train Engineers, other Release Train Engineers, Domain Portfolio Managers and Platform Architects across dependent platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Reliability Engineering and Operations Excellence where dependencies or risks touch their domains.
* Reliability Engineering, Operations Excellence, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Data Privacy, Quality and Compliance teams.
* Modern Engineering, DevSecOps, Observability, Automation Acceleration Hub, Automation Acceleration team and Agile/Delivery governance teams.

**Other**

* Strategic partners, managed service providers, system integrators and specialist suppliers whose teams participate in or are coordinated by the Agile Release Train.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience delivering Agile technology programmes.
* SAFe Release Train Engineer (or Advanced RTE) certification, or a recognised equivalent, is expected.
* Additional Agile certifications such as SAFe Program Consultant, Certified ScrumMaster or PMI-ACP support the role but do not replace demonstrated RTE experience.
* Relevant examples may include SAFe, Scrum/Agile, ITIL, Lean Portfolio Management or programme and change management qualifications.
* For regulated or GxP-impacting platforms, awareness of applicable quality, validation and compliance expectations is desirable.

**Area of Specialisation**

* Deep knowledge of SAFe practices, including Programme Increment planning, System Demos, Inspect and Adapt, ART sync and flow based metrics.
* Knowledge of AI-enabled delivery tooling, including responsible use for backlog analysis, reporting and dependency tracking.
* Understanding of platform operating models and product-aligned delivery across engineering teams.

**Related Experience Required**

* Significant experience facilitating Agile Release Trains or large scale agile delivery using the SAFe framework.
* Proven experience coordinating dependencies, risks and impediments across multiple teams, suppliers or platforms.
* Experience facilitating Programme Increment planning, System Demos, Inspect and Adapt and other core Agile Release Train events.
* Experience using flow metrics such as velocity, predictability and cycle time to drive delivery improvement.
* Experience coaching teams, Scrum Masters and Product Owners in Lean-Agile practices without acting as a single point of control.
* Significant experience coordinating Agile delivery across multiple technology teams or a release train.
* Strong capability in Planning Interval facilitation, dependency and risk management, coaching, and flow metrics.
* Evidence of improving delivery predictability, cycle time, quality or stakeholder alignment.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Release Train Engineer qualification, such as SAFe Release Train Engineer.
* Experience coordinating network or infrastructure transformation delivery.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, portfolio tools or AI assisted delivery practices.

**Skills/Background**

* Strong facilitation and conflict-resolution skills, able to align teams and stakeholders without formal authority.
* Ability to interpret flow, quality and delivery metrics and convert insight into improvement actions.
* Skilled at managing risk and dependency logs (ROAM) and escalating effectively when blockers cannot be resolved at team level.
* Strong stakeholder management across business, technology and supplier organisations.
* Commitment to continuous learning, AI fluency and adoption of modern Agile and delivery tooling.

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
Agile Coaching, Arts Facilitation, Automation Technology, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Defense Management, Flow Meter, IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Senior Risk Manager - Inspection, Finance Operations Risk, Governance, & Experience, Finance Operations Risk, Governance & Experience (FORGE)
description:
****DESCRIPTION****
Designation: Senior Risk Manager - Inspection, Finance Operations Risk, Governance, & Experience
  
  
Team: Finance Operations Risk, Governance and Experience (FORGE), Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership
  
  
Location: Hyderabad, India (Work from Office)
  
  
Level: L6
  
  
Job Type: Full Time, Regular
  
  
**Overview**
Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to join the Finance Operations Risk, Governance and Experience (FORGE) team within Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership. This is a strategic, high ownership risk leadership role that strengthens Amazons risk and control environment across complex, global Finance Operations processes, with a primary focus on Accounts Receivable (AR) and Payroll.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of risk management, internal audit, controllership, process transformation, technology, and business operations. You will assess processes end to end, identify emerging and material risks, evaluate control effectiveness, and partner with senior stakeholders to design and implement sustainable solutions.
  
  
This role is built for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The risks are not always obvious, ownership often spans multiple organizations, and the right answer frequently requires connecting data, processes, systems, policies, and controls across the company. You will not just identify problems. You will architect solutions, influence stakeholders, and drive measurable risk reduction.
  
  
**Key Job Responsibilities**
Lead the scoping, planning, and execution of complex audits, inspections, and risk assessments across Finance Operations, with particular focus on Accounts Receivable and Payroll.
  
  
Conduct end to end assessments spanning process design, policy, organization structure, systems, technology, regulatory requirements, and internal controls.
  
  
Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of controls, identify control gaps, and quantify the potential impact of identified risks.
  
  
Identify emerging and material risks across Finance Operations and develop data driven recommendations to mitigate them.
  
  
Own the full lifecycle of high impact, cross functional risk and governance programs from problem definition through implementation, measurement, and closure.
  
  
Define program objectives, success criteria, and risk reduction metrics, and establish mechanisms to measure the effectiveness of remediation.
  
  
Partner with Finance, Controllership, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and Internal Audit to prioritize risks and drive sustainable remediation.
  
  
Influence senior stakeholders to adopt scalable, automated, and sustainable controls rather than manual or recurring interventions.
  
  
Evaluate policy and process exceptions, determine the associated risk, and recommend appropriate mitigation.
  
  
Perform deep dives into complex processes and data to identify root causes, systemic risks, control weaknesses, and process improvement opportunities.
  
  
Produce clear, data driven audit reports, risk assessments, executive narratives, and recommendations for senior leadership.
  
  
Support external regulatory, statutory, and internal audit requests, including evidence gathering, issue resolution, and remediation tracking.
  
  
Build and deliver training and awareness programs that raise the bar on controllership, risk management, policy adherence, and control ownership across Finance Operations.
  
  
Leverage data analytics, automation, and technology to improve risk identification, continuous monitoring, audit efficiency, and control effectiveness.
  
  
Establish mechanisms that prevent recurring risks and embed remediation into business processes and operating routines.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* You will own the questions that matter most to the health of Finance Operations.
* Where are the material risks within complex Finance Operations processes?
* Are existing controls appropriately designed to mitigate those risks, and are they operating effectively in practice?
* What breaks when a process spans multiple systems, teams, or geographies?
* Are recurring issues being resolved at the root cause, or simply remediated repeatedly?
* How can technology, automation, and data detect and prevent risks earlier?
* What mechanisms can make risk management scalable as Finance Operations grows?
* You will turn these questions into actionable insights, sustainable mechanisms, and measurable risk reduction.

A DAY IN THE LIFE
  
  
A typical day might start with leading a risk assessment of a complex Accounts Receivable or Payroll process, analyzing operational and financial data to identify control weaknesses, reviewing findings with process owners, and working with Technology and Finance teams to design an automated control.
  
  
You may also prepare an executive level risk narrative, challenge a remediation plan, review policy exceptions, facilitate a cross functional risk review, or support a statutory auditor request.
  
  
The role moves fluidly between deep process analysis and senior level stakeholder influence. Some days will be highly analytical, while others will require aligning multiple teams on a risk response and executing against it.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Finance Operations Risk, Governance and Experience (FORGE) team strengthens the risk, governance, control, and operational mechanisms that enable Finance Operations to scale.
  
  
FORGE partners across Finance Operations and the broader Amazon organization to identify risks, strengthen controls, improve governance, and drive sustainable process transformation.
  
  
We combine risk expertise, operational understanding, data, technology, and durable mechanisms to build a Finance Operations environment that is resilient, scalable, and ready for the future.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Risk Management, or a related field.
  
  
10 or more years of experience in risk management, internal audit, controllership, finance operations, compliance, or a related field.
  
  
Experience leading complex audits, risk assessments, control assessments, or large scale process improvement programs.
  
  
Experience with Accounts Receivable, Order to Cash, O2C, OTC, Payroll, Hire to Retire, H2R, Finance Operations, or Controllership processes.
  
  
Experience identifying control gaps, assessing risk, developing recommendations, and driving remediation.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to work across complex data and processes.
  
  
Experience influencing cross functional stakeholders and operating effectively in a matrixed environment.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Masters degree, MBA, or a professional certification such as CA, CPA, CMA, CIA, or CISA.
  
  
Experience with global Finance Operations or multinational organizations.
  
  
Experience with finance, process, or controllership transformation initiatives.
  
  
Experience designing or implementing automated and technology enabled controls.
  
  
Experience applying data analytics, automation, or continuous monitoring techniques to risk identification and audit.
  
  
Experience supporting regulatory, statutory, or external audit engagements.
  
  
Strong track record creating executive level presentations, risk narratives, and data driven recommendations.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to operate independently in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
  
  
Experience leading large, cross functional programs from strategy through execution.
  
  
Knowledge of financial systems, ERP environments, and integration between finance and operational systems.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex risk clearly to senior leadership.
  
  
AMAZON LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES
  
  
The successful candidate will demonstrate strength across Amazons Leadership Principles, particularly Ownership, Dive Deep, Deliver Results, Earn Trust, Invent and Simplify, Think Big, Have Backbone, Disagree and Commit, and Customer Obsession.
  
  
This role is ideal for a risk professional who can dive deep into complex problems, challenge existing mechanisms, influence without authority, and turn risk insights into scalable business solutions.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Successful candidates should have strong audit and risk management capabilities, excellent problem solving skills, and a deep understanding of Finance Operations processes, systems, and controls.
  
  

* Perform risk assessments across Finance Operations services, functions, and processes.
* Lead end to end audits, including scoping, fieldwork, reporting, and remediation follow up.
* Evaluate the design and effectiveness of Finance Operations controls and identify control gaps.
* Assess policy and process exceptions and recommend appropriate risk mitigation.
* Identify root causes and develop sustainable recommendations to address recurring risks.
* Partner with cross functional stakeholders to drive remediation and strengthen the control environment.
* Develop and deliver training to improve controllership, policy adherence, and risk awareness.
* Support external regulatory, statutory, and internal audit requirements.
* Prepare clear, data driven risk assessments, audit reports, and recommendations for senior leadership.
* Leverage data, automation, and technology to improve risk detection, audit efficiency, and control effectiveness.

A day in the life
  
  

* Lead scoping, planning, and execution of complex audits & risk assessments across FinOps processes.
* Own end to end delivery of high impact, cross functional risk programs.
* Identify control gaps, assess control effectiveness, & drive sustainable remediation.
* Define program objectives, success criteria, and measurable risk reduction metrics.
* Partner with cross functional stakeholders to prioritize risks, influence decisions, & drive execution.
* Develop data driven audit reports & executive communications with clear findings and recommendations.
* Drive adoption of scalable and automated controls to mitigate recurring risks.
* Leverage data, automation, and technology to strengthen risk detection, monitoring, and audit efficiency.

****BASIC QUALIFICATIONS****

* 7+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Experience in internal audit and risk management or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion
* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Risk Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

****PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS****

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
* Experience at consulting firms or equivalent
* Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
* Experience in relevant finance roles, or experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes
* Experience working with Finance Operations processes, preferably Order-to-Cash (O2C), Hire-to-Pay, or other financial transaction processes.

title: Partner Operations Manager (Partner Integration Manager)
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
  
  
**Role & Responsibilities**
Partner Operations is obsessed with making direct delivery simpler for new content partners and the Netflix teams who receive and launch their titles day-to-day. We evaluate what the partner can deliver, how those assets might move through fulfillment and launch systems, and what it takes to support the deal day to day.
  
  
As a Partner Operations Manager, you will be the operational lead across an assigned slate of deals. You will assess what a partner can deliver, decide the appropriate delivery path, guide the partner through first deliveries and set up a process that Operations teams can run day to day. You will balance the partner experience with the work required of Netflix teams and vendors, and make the important decisions and handoffs clear.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Clarify deal goals, asset and localization needs, timing, partner contacts and open questions with Business Development, Regional Merchandising and Content teams as deals move into delivery planning.
* Assess the partner’s ability to meet our specs. Compare their needs with Netflix’s current system and operational capabilities; identify what is missing, what may need to be built and the effort required from integration through stable operations.
* Apply gateway eligibility criteria agreed with Engineering to determine delivery through UI, API or a vendor route. Work with Ops Vendor Management on the vendor model and cost, considering the effort for the partner and Netflix teams.
* Lead pre-qualification across long-form and promotional assets. Coordinate sample and quality reviews, then determine which assets Netflix can accept or conform, what the partner must change and whether vendor or post-vendor QC is needed.
* Turn partner context and deal nuance into clear technical and operational requirements for Product and Engineering. Frame the problem, define the workflow and write user stories where useful, making timing, constraints and trade-offs clear. Work with PACT and Solution Engineering on configuration and integration questions.
* Prepare partners to meet spec, coordinate tests and work through first deliveries. Answer delivery and spec questions clearly, bring in technical specialists when needed and remove early blockers.
* Keep partners, vendors and internal teams aligned on decisions, risks, owners and next steps. Communicate early and on time, and anticipate what each team will need before it becomes a problem.
* Hand off the partner profile, setup and open risks to the Launch Ops project manager once delivery is reliable.

**Requirements**

* Substantial experience independently leading complex partner onboarding, post-production, content operations, or product launches. This is a role for someone who has taken ambiguous, multi-team work from planning through launch and stable operations.
* Proven project or technical program management experience, with strong judgment on priorities, dependencies, risk and when to escalate.
* Excellent partner management. You build trust, set expectations, navigate difficult conversations and stay several steps ahead of partners and internal teams.
* Clear, timely written and verbal communication. You can explain technical and operational issues in plain language and turn them into decisions, owners and next steps.
* Strong experience coordinating Product, Engineering, Operations, business teams and external vendors toward a common launch outcome.
* Confidence working directly with Product and Engineering. You can turn partner context into clear problem statements, workflow requirements and user stories; discuss APIs and configurations; and understand engineering roadmap priorities and trade-offs.
* An understanding of the Netflix product or comparable streaming products, the content delivery and fulfillment ecosystem, and how delivery choices affect the member experience. Familiarity with media specifications, media processing, QC and direct delivery tools is helpful.
* The ability to move comfortably between detail and the end-to-end picture, making the partner experience simpler while keeping ongoing operational work sustainable.

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.
  
  
We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

title: Product Manager, Input Zone
description:
**About our Team:-**
DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.
  
  
The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.
  
  
**About the Role:-**
The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.
  
  
**Responsibilities:-**
**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.
* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.
* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.
* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).
* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.
* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.
* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.
* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.
* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.
* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.
* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).
* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.
* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).
* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Contributes to the strategy and development plans for ingestion and technical onboarding, shared across the roles carrying the Onboarding Technical Liaison responsibility.
* Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source.
* Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy.

**Technical Skills**

* Understands the Input Zone's data and technical architecture — publisher drop zones, ingestion validation, and the downstream handoff — well enough to liaise credibly with engineering.
* Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones).
* Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling.
* Ability to engage developers to understand technology constraints.

**Focus on Results**
**Drives for Results**

* Works with others to achieve joint goals.

**Requirements:**
-
  
  
**Suggested minimum years of PM experience:**
4-6 years
  
  
**Critical Experiences**

* Recognised as full owner of a technical onboarding, ingestion, or comparable technical-liaison feature area.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, projects, and priorities, and to work with engineers, content providers, publishers, or negotiation teams to modify or maintain a product and identify technology challenges.
* Hands-on experience applying AI tools in product management work, such as specification writing, analysis, or prototyping.
* Experience writing or working from specifications in a spec-driven or specification-first delivery model (preferred).

title: Automation Engineer
description:
Job Description

**Congratulations, you have taken the first step towards bagging a career-defining role. Join the team of superheroes that safeguard data wherever it goes.**

**Test Automation Engineer – Playwright / TypeScript**

**Location:** Mumbai / Pune (Hybrid)
  
**Experience:** 2–4 Years
  
**Department:** Engineering / QA
  
**Employment:** Contract

**About Seclore:**

Seclore is a data security company that takes a data-centric approach to protection – embedding intelligence directly into data so that trust and control persist wherever it travels, across users, systems, partners, and AI agents. Our platform gives enterprises complete visibility and control over their most sensitive information, helping them prevent data breaches, achieve compliance, and confidently collaborate and innovate without compromising security.

For more information, visit www.seclore.com.

**You would love our tribe:**

If you are a risk-taker, innovator, and fearless problem solver who loves tackling data security challenges, this is the place for you!

**A sneak peek into the role:**

At Seclore, we are all Entrepreneurs, not employees. Ours is a tribe of risk-takers, innovators, and fearless problem solvers. We appreciate people who are fuelled by passion, curiosity, and a hunger to learn and grow.

You'll be joining the Test/QA Automation team within Seclore's ARMOR DSPM (Data Security Posture Management) product, also referred to internally as Discovery.

ARMOR DSPM is a multi-tenant, multi-region platform that helps enterprises find, classify, and reduce risk around sensitive data spread across their cloud and on-prem environments – including cloud storage and IaaS (AWS), SaaS collaboration suites (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 – OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams), and structured data stores (Snowflake, SQL Server/RDS).

The product scans and catalogs data at scale, applies sensitivity classification and labeling, and integrates with Seclore's EDRM (Enterprise Digital Rights Management) suite to trigger remediation on what it finds – so a single discovery can lead directly to a protection action, not just a report.

The platform ships on a fast, continuous release cadence (monthly feature releases), so test automation is directly on the critical path for shipping confidently and catching regressions before customers do.

We are looking for a passionate and skilled Automation Engineer with 2–4 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining automated test solutions for modern web and API applications. The ideal candidate should possess strong programming skills, hands-on experience with automation frameworks, and a quality-first mindset.

You will work closely with Product Managers, Developers, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams to deliver high-quality software through continuous testing and automation.

title: Senior CQV Engineer
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area.
  
  
The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals.
  
  
The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations.
* To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan.
* Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level.
* Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities.
* Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards.
* Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met.
* Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success.
* Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management.
* Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule.
* Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e.g., ASTM E2500, ISPE)
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies.
* Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q.
* Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.
* Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems.
* Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design.
* Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements.
* Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner.
* Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews.
* Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site.
* Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction.
* System Startup activities

**Working Conditions**

* The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements.
* Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 10-15 year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.
* Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects.
* Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.
* In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations.
* Experience with process validation and computer system validation.
* Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc.
* Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage.
* Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

title: Assistant Vice President, Specialist, Operational Risk Management, Firm-Wide, Technology and Operations
description:
**Business Function**
Technology and Operations (T&O) enables and empowers the Bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality and control, technology, people capability and innovation.
  
  
The Regulatory Governance role provides end-to-end oversight of the Regulatory Review Group (RRG) governance framework for T&O. The role is accountable for translating regulatory expectations into actionable requirements, driving implementation and regulatory reporting governance, and providing transparent management reporting on risks, dependencies, timelines and closure readiness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* End-to-end regulatory governance: Take end-to-end ownership of regulatory requirements applicable to T&O, from interpretation, impact assessment and implementation planning through submission, evidence validation and sustainable closure.
* RRG governance: Drive the Regulatory Review Group governance process for T&O, including agenda setting, status consolidation, decision tracking, action follow-up and escalation with accountable units.
* Regulatory circular interpretation: Analyse and interpret regulatory circulars, directions, advisories, correspondence, supervisory observations and commitments. Translate regulatory expectations into clear, actionable requirements for Technology and Operations stakeholders.
* Impact assessment: Lead and challenge impact assessments across processes, systems, products, controls, people, data and third-party arrangements, ensuring all affected areas and dependencies are identified.
* Regulatory reporting oversight: Oversee governance of regulatory reporting obligations applicable to T&O, with focus on completeness, accuracy, timeliness, data lineage, control effectiveness and adherence to regulatory expectations.
* Implementation governance: Maintain a robust implementation plan covering accountable owners, milestones, dependencies, target dates, submission requirements, closure evidence and residual risks.
* RAG and escalation: Apply clear Red-Amber-Green status based on delivery progress, timeline risk and unresolved dependencies. Escalate emerging delays, compliance concerns and decisions required through appropriate governance forums.
* Executive communication: Prepare concise, executive-ready papers, dashboards and presentations that clearly articulate regulatory risks, overdue actions, implementation bottlenecks, decisions required and matters requiring escalation.
* Senior stakeholder engagement: Engage and influence senior stakeholders across Technology, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk, Finance, Internal Audit and business units to align interpretation, ownership, implementation approach and closure expectations.
* Stakeholder challenge: Constructively challenge incomplete assessments, weak remediation plans, unsupported status updates and inadequate closure evidence, while enabling timely resolution.
* Audit readiness: Maintain an auditable repository of regulatory communications, assessments, approvals, submissions, implementation evidence, governance decisions and minutes.
* Continuous improvement: Identify recurring weaknesses and drive improvements in regulatory governance, reporting controls, tracking discipline, documentation quality and sustainability of implementation across T&O.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Law, Risk Management, Technology or a related discipline.
* Typically 12-15 years of relevant experience in banking operations, regulatory reporting, regulatory governance, compliance, operational risk, audit or control functions.
* Strong working knowledge of the Indian banking regulatory environment, including RBI circulars and regulatory expectations relevant to Technology and Operations.
* Proven experience in interpreting regulatory communications and translating requirements into practical implementation plans, controls and accountable actions.
* Demonstrated experience managing regulatory reporting, regulatory submissions, regulatory commitments or supervisory observations within a banking environment.
* Proven ability to drive end-to-end governance, including impact assessment, implementation tracking, evidence validation, escalation and closure sign-off.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage senior management, facilitate governance forums, prepare executive-ready papers and simplify complex regulatory matters.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to independently drive outcomes across functions, including constructively challenging stakeholders and influencing without direct authority.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability to identify control implications, delivery risks, data or process gaps and potential compliance exposure.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver with precision within time-sensitive regulatory timelines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word for governance trackers, analysis, executive reporting and documentation.

**Core Competencies**

* End-to-end ownership and disciplined follow-through
* Regulatory interpretation and circular understanding
* Regulatory reporting and submission governance
* Executive communication and management reporting
* Senior stakeholder engagement, influencing and constructive challenge
* Impact assessment and control-oriented thinking
* Risk-based judgement, decision-making and timely escalation
* Attention to detail, documentation quality and audit readiness
* Ability to operate independently in a complex, cross-functional environment

**Work Relationships**
Partner with Technology, Operations, Business and support units, Compliance, Legal, Risk Management, Finance, Internal Audit and other relevant stakeholders to coordinate regulatory interpretation, impact assessment, implementation, reporting and evidence-based closure.
  
  
Engage accountable owners and subject-matter experts to resolve dependencies, validate status, challenge delivery risks and escalate matters through the appropriate governance channels

Vikhroli
  
  
**Job:**
Risk Management
  
  
**Schedule:**
Regular

Full time

title: Senior Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – GCP builds and runs the foundation of Google Cloud platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.
  
  
This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Experience deploying landing zones and services in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
* Knowledge of Cloud Cost methodology
* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda,
* GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.
* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Related Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

#AGTech

API Management, Artificial Intelligence Techniques, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Cost Optimization, Database Management, Deployment Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Container, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Virtualization

description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
Are you a skilled Java engineer with a passion for building platforms that empower other developers? The eBay Global Platform team is looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Bangalore team.
  
  
In this role, you'll be a core part of the Frameworks team, which is responsible for the Java frameworks that power all of eBay's site-facing REST, GraphQL, and Batch traffic. You'll work on features of Raptor.io, eBay’s Spring Boot-based Java Developer Platform. Your "customers" will be your fellow eBay developers, and you'll play a critical role in their success.
  
  
You'll partner closely with your US-based counterparts to deliver on the product roadmap and enhance our developer platforms.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Build & Deployment Automation: Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins and Tekton to ensure fast, reliable, and automated software builds and deployments.
* Release Management: Coordinate software releases across multiple teams, managing dependencies and aligning with the product roadmap.
* Platform Development & Maintenance: Build, maintain, and improve our Spring Boot framework, ensuring its robust and scalable for thousands of internal applications.
* AI Powered Tooling: Identify problems and develop AI powered solutions to platform engineering problems.
* Docker & Containerization: Build and maintain optimized Docker images, run automated vulnerability scans, and manage our image repositories and registries.
* Infrastructure Management: Set up and maintain our development, staging, and production environments, and monitor system performance to ensure stability.
* Security & Compliance: Ensure the platform is secure by regularly patching images, handling sensitive data properly, and maintaining audit logs.
* Documentation & Collaboration: Document processes, guidelines, and guides for developers while collaborating with infrastructure and SRE teams.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 3+ Professional experience in Java development
* Strong expertise in Maven, Spring Boot and version control systems such as Git.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins and Tekton.
* Strong knowledge of containerization technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes.
* A collaborative mindset with a desire to work with cross-functional teams.

If you're passionate about platform engineering and eager to contribute to the tools used by eBay's software engineers, we'd love to hear from you.
