title: AWS Devops
description:
**About The Role**
**Location - Bangalore/ Gurgaon**
We are seeking a skilled AWS DevOps & Cloud Platform Engineer to design, build, and scale our core cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for automating deployments, managing containerized workloads, and building a resilient, self-service cloud platform. Experience with AWS generative AI services is a strong plus as we integrate intelligent workflows into our ecosystem.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Cloud Platform Engineering: Architect, build, and maintain a scalable, secure, and reliable cloud platform on AWS using core services including S3, EFS, and AWS Lambda.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop, modularize, and manage automated infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform.
* CI/CD Automation: Design, implement, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable, and zero-downtime application deployments.
* Container Orchestration: Deploy, manage, and scale production Kubernetes (K8s / EKS) clusters, ensuring high availability, observability, and security best practices.
* Security & Governance: Implement IAM policies, network security, secrets management, and automated compliance checks across all cloud environments.
* Monitoring & Incident Response: Establish comprehensive logging, monitoring, and alerting frameworks to proactively identify performance bottlenecks and minimize downtime.

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven hands-on experience as a DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, or Platform Engineer working extensively in AWS environments.
* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Deep experience managing production Kubernetes (K8s) clusters (e.g., Amazon EKS), including networking, ingress, and Helm charts.
* Practical experience building and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or AWS CodePipeline).
* Solid working knowledge of core AWS services, specifically Amazon S3, Amazon EFS, and AWS Lambda, along with VPC networking and IAM.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., Python, Bash, or Go).

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have)**

* Hands-on experience deploying, integrating, or managing generative AI workloads using Amazon Bedrock.
* Familiarity with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (agentic AI runtime, memory, and tool-use orchestration services) to support autonomous AI agents in production.
* AWS Certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, Certified Kubernetes Administrator).

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to architect a modern cloud platform from the ground up with exposure to cutting-edge AI infrastructure.
* Competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible working arrangements.
* Dedicated budget for certifications, conferences, and continuous learning.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will solve complex problems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, supporting transformational projects in cloud technologies and automation for a leading SaaS product in the healthcare industry. You will drive reliability, scalability, and performance across applications, microservices, and infrastructure, partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure a highly available, resilient, and efficient platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Monitoring & Alerting**

* Develop and maintain comprehensive monitoring for system health, applications, microservices, dependencies, and infrastructure.
* Establish baseline metrics and set up customized alerts for deviations, collaborating with development teams to define key indicators and thresholds.
* Manage alert routing to appropriate audiences to prevent alert fatigue.
* Monitor and debug Microsoft Azure resources and assist support teams with technical troubleshooting.

**Incident Management & Response**

* Oversee incident management processes, including triage, severity assessment, and coordination of war rooms with relevant stakeholders (DevOps, development, QA, customer service).
* Maintain on-call rotation to monitor, analyze, and resolve critical infrastructure issues and incidents, including emergency response.
* Document incidents and perform root cause analysis (RCA), ensuring thorough follow-up and continuous improvement.
* Lead postmortem reviews and drive action items to completion.

**Proactive Reliability & Disaster Recovery**

* Design and execute tabletop exercises and disaster recovery simulations (e.g., service/region interruptions, failover testing, traffic management) to validate high availability and resiliency.
* Document outcomes and collaborate with DevOps and development teams to implement infrastructure and application improvements.
* Create standard procedures for incident scenarios where fixes cannot be immediately implemented.

**Continuous Feedback & Reporting**

* Develop dashboards and reports to monitor system performance, error rates, resource consumption, latency, and other key indicators.
* Establish consistent reporting schedules for SLA, system utilization, and customer metrics.
* Provide feedback to development and DevOps teams to drive improvements in application and infrastructure performance.

**DevOps Pipeline & Automation**

* Analyze and optimize DevOps pipelines for efficient and reliable deployment operations.
* Drive automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
* Experience with progressive rollout strategies and canary deployments.

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Work closely with cross-functional teams across the organization, including QA, development, DevOps, and customer service.
* Clearly articulate technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and stakeholders.
* Foster a culture of accountability, respect, excellence, and customer service.
* Contribute to documentation and knowledge sharing across teams.
* Advocate for reliability and operational excellence in architecture and design discussions.

**Capacity Planning & Scalability**

* Participate in capacity planning and scalability assessments to ensure systems can meet future growth and demand.

**Required Qualifications**
*Education & Experience Guidelines*

* Bachelor’s Degree in computer science or relevant field
* 8-10 years of relevant work experience
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Azure, and AWS.
* Significant experience with database technologies, especially Microsoft SQL.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, ARM templates).
* Familiarity with observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
* Scripting skills (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash) for automation and tooling.
* Security best practices for cloud environments.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Excellent self-management and time management abilities.
* Creative problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to a rapidly changing environment.
* Technology certifications (e.g., Azure DevOps Engineer) or willingness to obtain.
* Occasional travel may be required.

**Other Preferred Knowledge, Skills, Abilities Or Certifications**

* Security Certifications: HITRUST CSF Practitioner, CISSP
* AI/ML Integration Awareness: Supporting ML pipelines in DevOps workflows
* Policy-as-Code Tools: Open Policy Agent (OPA), HashiCorp Sentinel
* Disaster Recovery Planning: High-availability architecture and recovery strategies
* Cloud Cost Optimization: Performance tuning and resource efficiency
* Multi-Cloud Experience: Supporting hybrid or multi-cloud environments

title: Staff  Engineer
description:
This role is responsible for two things that are more connected than they first appear: (1) making production deployments safe enough that rollback is the default response to a problem, and (2) making configuration changes safe, audited, and AI-supervised so that bad configuration is caught before it reaches production. Both are fundamentally release-safety problems.
  
  
GreyOrange operates a platform that multiple enterprise customers (DHL, XPO, Continental, others) run in production warehouses. A bad deployment or a bad configuration change is a customer-visible incident. The infrastructure you build is what stands between a code change and a customer outage. The company's ability to keep all customers on the same major platform version — rather than maintaining separate branches per customer — depends entirely on whether rollback is fast, trustworthy, and routine.
  
  
After establishing the deployment and configuration management foundations, you expand into data and messaging engineering — specifically Kafka schema contracts and the Redis claim-check pattern for payload management. The overlap between distributed delivery systems (Kubernetes + Kafka both require schema and contract thinking) makes this a natural progression.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**First Six Months - Deployment Safety & Configuration**

* Take ownership of the deploy and release engineering domain. Audit the existing Spinnaker pipelines and ArgoCD application definitions to understand the starting point.
* Conduct a Consul configuration inventory — catalog every human-edited key, identify overlaps with the existing configuration management system, and publish a written boundary document clarifying which configs live where.
* Design and ship blue-green progressive delivery for the top three critical stateless services using ArgoCD Rollouts. Write a shared Rollout template that all subsequent services follow.
* Standardise Spinnaker pipeline templates for VM-deployed services. Define smoke-test requirements as a mandatory promotion gate.
* Ship the Java/Spring feature-flag SDK, piloted against one service. Then Erlang and React SDKs.
* Implement Consul-as-backend: bring human-edited Consul keys behind the configuration management UI. Remove direct write access for humans.

**Next Six Months - Configuration Intelligence & Messaging**

* Ship AI-supervised configuration: train or fine-tune a model on historical incident data, surface risk warnings in the configuration UI. First version can be rule-based with an LLM layer on top.
* Wire the configuration audit log into the compliance evidence pipeline so configuration changes become part of the joined audit trail alongside access events and incident records.
* Own Kafka schema contract rollout: Schema Registry adoption and Avro migration for the highest-traffic topics. Partner with service teams through the migration.
* Build and ship the Redis claim-check SDK. Monitor payload-size distribution and consumer lag. Demonstrate measurable reduction in Kafka payload sizes on the pilot topics.

**Ongoing**

* Run rollback drills on a regular cadence — each customer environment should execute at least one controlled rollback per half so the process is practised before it is needed under pressure.
* Maintain the deployment and configuration systems as production services — they are part of the platform team's on-call rotation.
* Contribute to cross-team architecture reviews with a deployment safety and release-engineering lens.
* Write and maintain design documents and runbooks for everything you build.

**Requirements**

* 8+ years of backend or platform engineering with strong Kubernetes and GitOps depth
* Production experience with ArgoCD, ArgoCD Rollouts, Flagger, or comparable progressive-delivery tooling — has configured traffic shifting, canary analysis, and automated rollback in a real production environment
* Has built or substantially extended a feature-flag or runtime configuration management system — not just used a commercial tool, but understood or built the machinery underneath
* Familiarity with Consul, Vault, or the broader HashiCorp ecosystem at an engineering level
* Experience with Spinnaker or a comparable continuous delivery platform for VM-based deployments
* Uses deployment frequency, change failure rate, and mean time to restore as engineering metrics — not just awareness of what DORA is, but a track record of using it to prioritise engineering investment
* Comfortable with heterogeneous deployment environments - both Kubernetes and traditional VMs as first-class production targets in the same organisation

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Apache Camel or Apache Flink - relevant for future work in integration and streaming engineering
* Background with Kafka Connect, schema registries, or MQTT integration - the platform bridges Kafka and MQTT for robot communication
* Multi-tenant SaaS background where customer-segmented feature rollouts are standard practice - GreyOrange deploys to multiple enterprise customers with different risk tolerances and release windows
* Familiarity with LLM APIs (Vertex AI, OpenAI) and retrieval-augmented generation - the AI configuration risk-detection work uses an LLM layer on top of historical incident data
* Erlang/OTP experience or genuine curiosity about it - the Erlang feature-flag SDK requires understanding how OTP applications load and manage configuration at runtime

title: Senior Principal - Principal RE, Cloud & Hosting
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Site Reliability Engineer improves the reliability, resilience and observability of GSK's platforms as a hands-on engineer, reducing toil, preventing incidents and meeting agreed reliability targets. The role defines and monitors SLOs, instruments platforms for observability, leads incident response through to permanent prevention, and applies AI and automation for anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing. It also coaches platform engineering teams in reliability practice and error-budget discipline.
  
  
The role sits in Reliability Engineering & Operations and is deployed into a platform domain while drawing on the central capability, so it holds the central reliability standard inside a team it does not report to. Platform build and engineering direction sit with the Principal Engineers and the Engineering Director, the major incident process sits with the Major Incident Manager, and the reliability standard itself is set by the Reliability Engineering Senior Director. Reliability targets are held jointly with the Platform Manager rather than imposed on them.
  
  
**ROLE SCALE AND COMPLEXITY**
This is a senior enterprise reliability leadership role operating across globally distributed, business-critical cloud and hosting services. The post holder is accountable for setting technical direction, resolving systemic and ambiguous reliability risks, and influencing prioritisation across multiple platform teams, suppliers and geographies without relying on direct line authority.
  
  
The role manages a portfolio of interdependent services with material operational, regulatory, cyber, resilience and financial consequences. It shapes investment and supplier decisions and may influence or govern an annual technology and service portfolio of up to approximately GBP 23 million, where applicable to the assigned scope.
  
  
**MARKET SCOPE**
Global scope, supporting business operations across regions, countries and markets in which GSK operates. The role establishes consistent reliability outcomes across regional delivery teams while accommodating local regulatory, data-residency, business-continuity and market-criticality requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and monitor SLOs for the platforms served, and instrument those platforms for observability so reliability is measured rather than assumed.
* Apply AI and automation for anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing, so that recurring conditions are handled without human intervention.
* Lead incident response for the platforms served, and drive root-cause resolution through to permanent prevention rather than closing on restoration.
* Improve resilience through capacity, failover and recovery engineering, and test recovery rather than documenting it.
* Reduce operational toil through automation and reusable tooling, working the identified manual task and toil candidates and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platforms served, prioritising by the reliability risk each gap leaves unmeasured.
* Coach platform engineering teams in reliability practice and error-budget discipline, so reliability is built in rather than inspected in.
* Track reliability metrics against SLOs and team OKRs, and act on the trend rather than only reporting it.
* Support reliability oversight of supplier-run services, holding partner-operated components to the same SLOs as internal ones.
* Hold the central reliability standard while deployed in a platform domain, escalating to the Reliability Engineering Senior Director where local pressure would erode it.
* Feed reliability evidence into the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, so that resilience work competes on stated risk rather than on goodwill.
* Hold the boundaries with the Principal Engineers on platform build, the Major Incident Manager on the major incident process, and the Platform Manager on the reliability targets the platform commits to.
* Set the multi-year reliability strategy and engineering roadmap for the assigned cloud and hosting portfolio, translating enterprise risk and business priorities into funded reliability outcomes.
* Own cross-platform reliability governance, including service tiering, SLO policy, error-budget decisions, resilience exceptions and common engineering standards across internal and supplier-operated services.
* Lead resolution of complex, high-impact and systemic failure modes spanning cloud, hosting, network, security, applications and third-party dependencies, with authority to convene senior technical and service leaders.
* Provide evidence-based recommendations for investment, risk acceptance and supplier performance decisions, including prioritisation across a material service portfolio and, where delegated, spend of up to approximately GBP 25 million.
* Represent Reliability Engineering in Director, Senior Director and VP-level governance, communicating service risk, business impact, trade-offs and required decisions in clear executive terms.
* Mentor Principal and Senior Engineers, build communities of practice and raise engineering capability across regions rather than delivering only through individual contribution.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering).
* Reliability or platform certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or ITIL 4 for incident and problem practice).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Site reliability engineering, covering SLOs, observability instrumentation, error budgets and toil reduction.
* AIOps and operations automation, covering anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing.

**Why is this level of Education Required?**

* An engineering grounding is needed because the role writes the automation and instrumentation itself and must be credible to platform engineers whose systems it is changing.

**Job-Related Experience**

* Overall 15 Years and typically 10-12+ years in infrastructure, cloud, platform or reliability engineering, including significant experience leading enterprise-scale reliability outcomes across multiple teams or service domains.
* 5+ years of hands-on SRE, Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Operations experience.
* Experience supporting large-scale production cloud and hosting environments.
* Experience owning operational reliability for critical business services.
* Proven record of improving service availability, resiliency, and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrated accountability for globally distributed, 24x7, business-critical services and for decisions with material operational, regulatory, customer or financial impact.
* Proven ability to influence Directors, Senior Directors and VP-level stakeholders, including presenting options, quantified risk, trade-offs and investment recommendations.
* Experience governing strategic suppliers and complex service ecosystems, with exposure to substantial technology budgets or portfolios; direct budget ownership is desirable but not mandatory where strong investment influence is evidenced.
* Track record of setting technical direction, leading through ambiguity and developing senior engineering capability across organisational and geographic boundaries.

**Requirements**
**Technical Requirements**

* Strong experience with: Azure and/or GCP, Linux and Windows Server platforms, Containers and Kubernetes, Cloud networking fundamentals, Infrastructure as Code , Cloud observability platforms
* Hands-on proficiency in: Terraform, Ansible, Python , CI/CD pipelines, Monitoring and telemetry solutions.

**Reliability & Operations**

* Experience defining and operating: SLIs , SLOs, Error Budgets, Operational KPIs
* Experience leading: Major incident response, post-incident reviews, Root-cause analysis , Capacity management, Resiliency and recovery testing.

**Operational Excellence**

* Demonstrated experience in: Runbook development, Operational readiness reviews, Service transitions, Continuous service improvement, Automation-led toil reduction

**Skills/Background**

* Comfort operating inside a team that is not the reporting line, holding a central standard without formal authority.
* Composure in live incidents, including deciding when to stop investigating and restore.
* Discipline to pursue root cause after service is restored and attention has moved on.
* Ability to coach engineers into reliability practice rather than policing them into it.
* Judgement about which observability gaps matter and which are noise.
* Willingness to automate away the work rather than becoming indispensable to it.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Hands-on SRE practice: defining and governing SLIs, SLOs and error budgets for global, business-critical 24x7 cloud and hosting services (5+ years hands-on SRE/cloud operations)
* Azure and/or GCP production depth: Linux and Windows Server, containers and Kubernetes, cloud networking and landing-zone design at enterprise scale
* Hands-on coding and Infrastructure as Code: writes Python, Terraform and Ansible personally and ships through CI/CD pipelines (not just reviews others' code)
* Observability and AIOps: telemetry/monitoring platforms, closing coverage gaps by reliability risk, anomaly detection, predictive alerting and guarded self-healing
* Major incident leadership: RCA, blameless post-incident reviews and driving root cause through to permanent prevention
* Resilience engineering: capacity management, failover/DR design, and proven recovery and resiliency testing
* Executive influence and supplier governance: influencing Director/VP stakeholders and holding managed service/cloud providers to SLOs without line authority; mentoring senior engineers

title: DevOps engineer (AWS Networking & Security) IRC307662
description:
**Description**
The Client is one of the majour insurance companies in the UK.
  
  
This role supports a high-priority risk reduction programme for the MyCro Platform, a complex technology estate built on AWS. Platform SMEs have already designed remediation plans and started putting them into effect. The DevOps engineer we’re looking for will lock down subnet-level access to internal OpenSearch indexes and reconfigure the platform’s VPC and subnet design so egress from hosted Lambda functions and ECS clusters can be controlled. These are complex, platform-wide network changes that must be delivered with zero downtime. You will join a new squad led by a Platform SME.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Essential experience**

* Deep, hands-on AWS networking: VPC and subnet design, routing, security groups
* Delivering network re-architecture on live production platforms with zero downtime
* Controlling egress for serverless and container workloads
* Securing data stores at the network layer

**Technologies and tools**

* Networking: Amazon VPC, subnets, route tables, NAT gateways, Internet gateways, Transit Gateway (if in use)
* Network security: Security groups, network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall
* Private connectivity: VPC endpoints (gateway and interface / PrivateLink)
* Data stores: Amazon OpenSearch Service (VPC domains, access policies)
* Workloads: AWS Lambda (VPC-attached), Amazon ECS (awsvpc networking)
* Observability: VPC Flow Logs, Reachability Analyzer, CloudWatch
* Infrastructure as code: AWS CloudFormation and/or AWS CDK, or Terraform

**Desirable**

* Amazon OpenSearch Service security configuration
* AWS Network Firewall or equivalent egress filtering
* AWS certification (e.g. Advanced Networking – Specialty)

Job responsibilities
  
  
  

* Restrict network access to internal Amazon OpenSearch domains using VPC placement, security groups and access policies
* Redesign VPC and subnet layout so Lambda and ECS workloads route through controlled egress points
* Implement egress controls such as NAT gateways, AWS Network Firewall, VPC endpoints (PrivateLink) and route table changes, per the agreed design
* Tighten security groups and network ACLs to least privilege
* Plan and execute zero-downtime migrations: staged cutovers, traffic validation, tested rollback
* Use VPC Flow Logs and Reachability Analyzer to baseline traffic before change and verify it after
* Deliver all network changes as infrastructure as code with peer review
* Produce network diagrams and runbooks for the platform team

What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum**
is looking for a
**Lead DevOps Engineer**
to join our team full-time in India.
  
  
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Lead DevOps Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Set up dev, test and prod environments in the client’s AWS accounts, working with cloud governance on network paths and standards
* Build CI/CD pipelines for the gateway, adapters and supporting services
* Configure secrets management, service accounts and credential rotation
* Implement logging, tracing and observability baselines with correlation IDs
* Deploy the API gateway (AWS API Gateway or Kong) using vendor-neutral policies
* Produce the deployment view, environment and connectivity matrix, and credentials request
* Build monitoring, alerting, runbooks, rollback plans and the operational handover pack
* Support production releases through change control and hypercare

**Requirements**

* 4+ years in DevOps or platform engineering on AWS
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar)
* Experience with AWS API Gateway or Kong, Lambda or containers (ECS/EKS), and VPC networking
* Secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager or Vault) and IAM best practice
* Observability tooling such as CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry or Datadog
* Experience writing runbooks and handing over to client operations teams
* Comfortable working within enterprise change control and cloud governance
* Nice to have: AWS certification, or experience supporting conversational AI or contact centre platforms

**What’s in it for you?**

* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

**About Us**
At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
  
  
India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
  
  
**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**
Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

* Deep, hands-on AWS networking: VPC and subnet design, routing, security groups

* Data stores: Amazon OpenSearch Service (VPC domains, access policies)

* Redesign VPC and subnet layout so Lambda and ECS workloads route through controlled egress points
* Implement egress controls such as NAT gateways, AWS Network Firewall, VPC endpoints (PrivateLink) and route table changes, per the agreed design
* Tighten security groups and network ACLs to least privilege
* Plan and execute zero-downtime migrations: staged cutovers, traffic validation, tested rollback

title: DevOps engineer (AWS Networking & Security) IRC307662
description:
**Description**
The Client is one of the majour insurance companies in the UK.
  
  
This role supports a high-priority risk reduction programme for the MyCro Platform, a complex technology estate built on AWS. Platform SMEs have already designed remediation plans and started putting them into effect. The DevOps engineer we’re looking for will lock down subnet-level access to internal OpenSearch indexes and reconfigure the platform’s VPC and subnet design so egress from hosted Lambda functions and ECS clusters can be controlled. These are complex, platform-wide network changes that must be delivered with zero downtime. You will join a new squad led by a Platform SME.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Essential experience**

* Deep, hands-on AWS networking: VPC and subnet design, routing, security groups
* Delivering network re-architecture on live production platforms with zero downtime
* Controlling egress for serverless and container workloads
* Securing data stores at the network layer

**Technologies and tools**

* Networking: Amazon VPC, subnets, route tables, NAT gateways, Internet gateways, Transit Gateway (if in use)
* Network security: Security groups, network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall
* Private connectivity: VPC endpoints (gateway and interface / PrivateLink)
* Data stores: Amazon OpenSearch Service (VPC domains, access policies)
* Workloads: AWS Lambda (VPC-attached), Amazon ECS (awsvpc networking)
* Observability: VPC Flow Logs, Reachability Analyzer, CloudWatch
* Infrastructure as code: AWS CloudFormation and/or AWS CDK, or Terraform

**Desirable**

* Amazon OpenSearch Service security configuration
* AWS Network Firewall or equivalent egress filtering
* AWS certification (e.g. Advanced Networking – Specialty)

Job responsibilities
  
  
  

* Restrict network access to internal Amazon OpenSearch domains using VPC placement, security groups and access policies
* Redesign VPC and subnet layout so Lambda and ECS workloads route through controlled egress points
* Implement egress controls such as NAT gateways, AWS Network Firewall, VPC endpoints (PrivateLink) and route table changes, per the agreed design
* Tighten security groups and network ACLs to least privilege
* Plan and execute zero-downtime migrations: staged cutovers, traffic validation, tested rollback
* Use VPC Flow Logs and Reachability Analyzer to baseline traffic before change and verify it after
* Deliver all network changes as infrastructure as code with peer review
* Produce network diagrams and runbooks for the platform team

What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Senior Full Stack Web Developer
description:
Senior Full-Stack Developer (MERN + MySQL)

Sector 63, Noida | 3–5 years | Full-time | Up to ₹55,000/month

ABOUT IBN BATUTTAH

Ibn Batuttah (ibnbatuttah.com) is a travel platform in its pre-launch stage. Travellers build their own holiday day by day (flights, hotels, sightseeing, meals, transport), see the full cost, and compare it with travel agent packages. Travel agents get a portal to list live packages and serve their own customers. Admin manages bookings, payments and disputes.

The platform is built and currently in testing. A few features are still being completed, and we are fixing issues found in testing before launch. We need a developer who will take ownership, finish what's left and get it launch-ready.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Complete the remaining features and fix issues found in testing

• Build and maintain features across React + Vite + Redux Toolkit and Node.js + Express + Sequelize (MySQL)

• Keep live flight and hotel supplier connections reliable: search, prebook, booking status, cancellations, sync jobs (node-cron + Redis)

• Look after Razorpay payments, markup and GST, vendor wallets and security deposits, and PDF vouchers/e-tickets (Puppeteer)

• Keep real-time chat and dispute flows (Socket.IO) working without lost messages

• Cut third-party API usage and cost, especially Google Maps/Places

• Speed up slow queries, APIs and pages

• Set up error monitoring, basic tests, database backups and safe releases

• Write clear documentation and guide junior developers

MUST-HAVE

• 3–5 years building and running live products with Node.js, Express and React

• Good MySQL and Sequelize: indexes, joins, migrations, transactions

• Redux Toolkit or React Query, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs

• At least one payment gateway integration (Razorpay or similar), including webhooks and failed payments

• Hands-on with Redis, cron jobs and basic Socket.IO

• Strong debugging of live production issues

• Comfortable deploying on Linux (Nginx, PM2)

GOOD TO HAVE

• Travel-tech or booking-platform experience (flights, hotels, OTA/GDS suppliers)

• Google Maps/Places, Mapbox or HERE APIs

• Puppeteer, Firebase, OpenAI API

• Marketplace, wallet or escrow-style payments

• Sentry or similar monitoring, automated testing

AN HONEST NOTE FROM THE FOUNDER

I want you to know exactly what you are joining.

The risks:

• We have not launched yet. The platform is in testing, with a few features still being finished. No customers, no revenue, no guarantee of success.

• We are self-funded so far and raising investment. Nothing is certain.

• No perks at the start: no bonuses, no fancy office. A fair monthly salary, paid on time.

• Small team, and plans change fast.

Why join anyway:

• Real ownership of the whole platform, not one small part

• Learning you won't get elsewhere: live flights and hotels, payments, a marketplace, real-time chat and maps in one product

• You grow as the company grows: your salary, title and responsibility rise with it

• Direct access to the founder, with no layers

• A new idea the big travel sites don't offer

If you want a safe job with perks from day one, this isn't for you, and that's fine. If you want to build something from the ground up and grow with it, I'd like to talk to you.

— Aman Choudhary, Founder, Ibn Batuttah

DETAILS

• Salary: up to ₹55,000/month based on experience and test results, with a review after 6 months linked to launch and performance

• Location: Sector 63, Noida ([Office / Hybrid])

• Working days: [Monday–Saturday, 10 am – 7 pm]

• Joining: immediate or within a week

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here on LinkedIn or email [email address] with:

1. Resume and GitHub/portfolio link

2. Current salary, expected salary and notice period

3. Two live projects you built or scaled, and your exact role

4. A few lines on the hardest production bug you fixed

Shortlisted candidates will have a short call, a technical discussion and a practical coding test based on our real product.

title: Principal Security Engineer, Cloud Security
description: OverviewWorking at AtlassianAtlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, as part of being a distributed-first company.About TeamThe Product Security team at Atlassian is committed to ensuring the delivery of secure products. These teams are geographically distributed, with a presence in the USA, Australia, and India. Each team is structured uniformly to provide comprehensive product security services tailored to their respective time zones. These services include security consulting, risk identification, and mitigation consulting for all products within their purview.Recognising the critical importance of product security as a customer necessity and a competitive edge, our team holds a pivotal position within the organisation. With Atlassian's strong engineering focus and emphasis on autonomous teams, maturing the security of this complex environment stands as our core duty. Our tasks encompass identifying potential security threats in our products, devising suitable mitigation strategies, and evaluating their effectiveness on a large scale. It is imperative to execute these responsibilities in a scalable manner, allowing us to adapt to the evolving landscape shaped by changes in our business, global dynamics, adversarial strategies, customer requirements, technological advancements, and other factors.OverviewAs a Principal Security Engineer, Cloud Security at Atlassian, you will be the technical architect and engineer driving the architecture and technical vision across our cloud platforms, infrastructure, and software supply chain. You will partner closely with engineering leadership, platform teams, and principal architects to define secure-by-default standards, architect scalable guardrails, and lead cross - organisational initiatives that protect Atlassian’s cloud environments at global scale.In this role, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical leadership and strategic influence - diving hands-on into complex architectural designs, critical codebases, and high-severity escalations, while steering long-term security roadmaps and mentoring senior engineers across the organization. You will systematically identify systemic risks, design resilient mitigations, and ensure our cloud platforms deliver world-class security, reliability, and trust for over 300,000+ customers.ResponsibilitiesAs a Principal Product Security Engineer, Cloud Security, you will be the technical architect and engineer driving the architecture and and strategic SME driving cloud security architecture, automation, and secure-by-default platforms across Atlassian's global footprint. You will define the technical vision, establish architectural standards, and lead cross-organizational initiatives that equip engineering teams with state-of-the-art tools, patterns, and guardrails to build secure products by default. Partnering closely with security leadership, principal architects, and platform engineering teams, you will champion strategic programs that uplift and scale our security posture across multi-cloud environments. Some of your key responsibilities will include:Strategic Architecture & Secure Design: Define and steer the overarching security architecture for multi-cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), setting company-wide secure-by-default standards, architectural patterns, and guardrails for cloud-native services and core platforms.Complex Threat Modeling & High-Impact Assessments: Drive advanced threat modeling and deep-dive security assessments across critical, complex systems, distributed microservices, and high-assurance environments (such as Isolated, Private, and Regulated/FedRAMP offerings).Platform Automation & Guardrails at Scale: Architect, champion, and scale automated security controls, detection capabilities, and self-healing guardrails embedded directly into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (IaC), systematically eliminating classes of vulnerabilities.Continuous Posture Optimization & CSPM Strategy: Set the technical direction for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and posture analytics, driving continuous compliance, maturing security baselines, and providing leadership visibility into systemic risk.Operational & Architectural Excellence: Establish company-wide reusable security frameworks, engineering guidelines, and operational standards that improve resilience, reliability, and security performance across Atlassian products.Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a technical sponsor and mentor for security and software engineers across the organization, fostering an inclusive culture of engineering excellence, security advocacy, and cross-team capability uplift.Critical Incident Advisory & Architectural Remediation: Act as the principal cloud security authority during high-severity security incidents, partnering with Incident Response to conduct root-cause investigations, formulate long-term architectural mitigations, and prevent recurrence.Executive & Stakeholder Influence: Translate complex cloud security risks and technical roadmaps into strategic priorities for executive and non-technical stakeholders, driving consensus and cross-functional alignment on mission-critical security initiatives.On Your First Day, We'll Expect You To Have10+ years of experience in security engineering with deep specialization in cloud security, secure architecture, and platform security at enterprise or hyper-growth SaaS scale.Proven track record as a technical authority or principal engineer driving large-scale security architectures, risk mitigations, and threat modeling initiatives across complex SaaS and cloud-native systems.Deep, hands-on expertise in multi-cloud security (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure) and container orchestration ecosystems (Docker, Kubernetes, service mesh).Extensive experience designing, securing, and conducting comprehensive architectural reviews for highly regulated, high-assurance cloud environments (such as Isolated, Private, Government, and FedRAMP offerings).Demonstrated experience guiding broad architectural transformations, including overseeing security strategy for monolith-to-microservices migrations.Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language (such as Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript) and proven experience authoring scalable security automation, tooling, and infrastructure as code (IaC).Deep experience embedding automated security controls, policy-as-code, and compliance gates into modern CI/CD pipelines.Exceptional technical communication and executive influence, with a demonstrated ability to align diverse engineering teams, architects, and senior leadership around strategic security goals.Proven track record of mentoring and coaching senior engineers and cultivating an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture.CompensationAt Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.QualificationsRequired:Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).Deep architectural mastery of cloud security, zero trust architecture, tenant data isolation, cryptographic systems/encryption, and multi-tenant SaaS environments at enterprise scale.Proven track record designing and driving infrastructure as code (IaC) governance, centralised secrets management, and embedding automated security guardrails across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC).Deep understanding of cloud detection engineering, distributed telemetry/logging, IAM graph analysis, least-privilege policy automation, and enterprise alert optimisation.Demonstrated ability to champion developer velocity and engineering experience (DevEx) while establishing robust, non-negotiable security guardrails.Exceptional communication, technical leadership, and stakeholder influence across both executive leadership and engineering teams.It's Great, But Not Required If You Have:Extensive experience architecting and building scalable internal software platforms or developer tooling that automate security and compliance workflows.Discovered and disclosed notable CVEs, or active maintainership/contributions to open-source security tooling and frameworks.Delivered presentations at recognized industry security conferences (e.g., Black Hat, DEF CON) or published security research.Deep hands-on experience securing modern serverless architectures, service meshes, and large-scale container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes).Experience architecting security controls for highly regulated cloud environments (such as FedRAMP, Isolated, or Sovereign Cloud offerings).You’ll Thrive Here If YouTake ownership of outcomes and drive projects to completion.Are proactive in identifying and mitigating security risks.Enjoy collaborating across teams and mentoring others.Communicate clearly and adapt your message to your audience.Are passionate about scaling security through automation and best practices.Benefits & PerksAtlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits .About AtlassianAt Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. description:

title: Senior Staff Network Security Engineer
description:
**About Marvell**
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.
  
  
At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.
  
  
**Your Team, Your Impact**
Be part of the team that’s redefining how a global technology leader secures its cloud and AI future. At Marvell, our Enterprise Security Engineering & Compliance group is where innovation meets protection — building and deploying next-gen security architectures that safeguard data across dynamic cloud, SaaS, and AI environments. From designing CASB strategies to securing the latest GenAI tools, you’ll work at the intersection of cutting-edge tech and real-world impact. If you’re passionate about staying ahead of evolving threats and enabling secure innovation at scale, this is where your expertise will make a difference.
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated SaaS and Cloud Access Security Platform Engineer to join our Information Security team. This role will be pivotal in ensuring secure access to SaaS applications and safeguarding organizational data in the context of AI technologies. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in CASB solutions, SaaS access security, data loss prevention, and developing robust security strategies to enable safe technology adoption.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Design, implement, operate, and support enterprise network security solutions across traditional, virtualized, and cloud environments, including routing, switching, segmentation, and traffic filtering technologies.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for network security technologies, including firewalls, remote access solutions, IPSec VPNs, IDS/IPS, web application firewalls, proxies, DLP, CASB, NAC, micro-segmentation, wired and wireless security, SIEM, and next-generation breach detection platforms.
* Design, deploy, and operate Palo Alto Networks SaaS Inline Security capabilities to provide real-time inspection, threat prevention, and data protection for SaaS application traffic.
* Implement and manage Palo Alto Networks AI Access Security controls to secure enterprise usage of AI-driven and generative AI platforms, including policy enforcement, data loss prevention, and visibility into AI application usage and risk.
* Integrate SaaS Inline Security and AI Access Security with existing Palo Alto Networks firewall platforms, CASB, DLP, and SIEM solutions to deliver a cohesive, end-to-end security architecture.
* Define and enforce security policies for SaaS and AI application access aligned with corporate risk tolerance, data protection requirements, and industry best practices.
* Monitor, analyze, and respond to security events and alerts related to SaaS and AI application traffic, performing investigation, tuning, and continuous optimization of controls.
* Evaluate emerging SaaS and AI security features within the Palo Alto Networks ecosystem, advising on adoption, roadmap alignment, and operationalization across the enterprise.
* Lead and contribute to network security initiatives from concept and architecture through implementation, testing, and production rollout, ensuring solutions align with business and security requirements.
* Perform day-to-day operational support for network security infrastructure, including monitoring, troubleshooting, break-fix remediation, ticket handling, and change management in accordance with established processes and SLAs.
* Provide expert-level troubleshooting of complex network and security issues at the protocol level (TCP/UDP, IP, ARP, DNS, HTTP/S), identifying root causes and implementing sustainable corrective actions.
* Design, deploy, and maintain IPSec VPN solutions, including site-to-site and remote access, with a focus on scalability, security, and operational reliability.
* Administer, design, and support Palo Alto Networks firewalls in on-premises, virtualized, and cloud-based environments; perform policy optimization, threat prevention tuning, upgrades, and lifecycle management.
* Support and integrate complementary security platforms such as F5 WAF and McAfee CASB, ensuring seamless interoperability within the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.
* Develop and maintain detailed technical documentation, network diagrams, security standards, and operational runbooks that reflect best practices and reference architectures.
* Apply security control frameworks and methodologies (e.g., NIST, Cybersecurity Kill Chain) to architecture decisions, threat modeling, and remediation strategies.
* Evaluate emerging cybersecurity technologies and vendors, objectively assessing technical capabilities versus marketing claims, and recommending solutions that provide measurable value and integrate effectively with existing systems.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including IT operations, cloud engineering, application teams, and security leadership, to ensure secure-by-design network architectures.
* Use scripting and automation (Python required; Perl and Java a plus) to improve operational efficiency, enhance visibility, and reduce manual effort in network security operations.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and oversight for assigned projects or junior team members, promoting best practices and continuous improvement.
* Stay current with evolving threat landscapes, attack vectors, and next-generation security platforms, proactively adapting defenses to address new risks.
* Participate in on-call rotations and provide after-hours support as required to ensure the availability, integrity, and security of critical network infrastructure.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong understanding of enterprise level network operations including but not limited to route, switch, segmentation and filtering technologies in traditional, virtualized and cloud environments
* Proven track record of successful IT project contribution from concept to completion
* 6+ years of specialization in Network Security technologies including firewall, remote access and IPSec VPN
* 6+ years of successful network-level troubleshooting and break-fix implementations
* 6+ years of experience with day-to-day network support, ticketing and change management.
* Experience in network security solutions design, documentation and best practices.
* Proven experience working in engineering capacity supporting network security and capabilities such as Firewalls, Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems, Proxies, DLP, Network Deception, micro-segmentation, Network Access Control (NAC), wired and wireless security, SIEM, Next Gen Breach Detection Systems, Cloud Access Security Brokers(CASB).
* Hands on experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls, F5 WAF, and CASB is highly desired.
* Expert-level understanding of network protocols (TCP/UDP, IP, ARP, DNS, HTTP(S), etc.)
* Detailed understanding of attack vectors, current threats, and their remediation strategies.
* Strong time management skills planning, organizing, and leading architecture development efforts.
* Strong interpersonal and communications skills to build and maintain ongoing business relationships.
* Self-Starter that requires minimal supervision, multi-tasks effectively, and can provide oversight and coaching to others for any assigned projects or tasks.
* Detailed understanding of control frameworks and reference architectures such as NIST, Cybersecurity kill chain, etc.
* Able to stay on top of latest cybersecurity developments and next gen platforms.
* Available for on call after hours support as required
* Additional Knowledge:
* Demonstrable experience with IPSEC VPN design, implementation, troubleshooting
* Expert level knowledge of Palo Alto Networks firewalls, including administration, operations, design, deployment, troubleshooting
* Demonstrable experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls in virtual and cloud environments
* Demonstrable experience with Palo Alto Networks SaaS Inline Security and AI Access Security capabilities
* Able to work with suppliers and vendors to assess a true value of cybersecurity capabilities vs what they are offering as a sales pitch and how those capabilities would apply to the company as a whole, from integrations to existing cybersecurity eco-system to their operationalization.
* Experience with various languages (perl, python required, Java) a plus.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.
  
  
**Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements**
With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.
  
  
**Interview Integrity**
To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.
  
  
These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.
  
  
**This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.**

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
**About Marvell**
Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.
  
  
At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.
  
  
**Your Team, Your Impact**
At Marvell, we are looking for a Cloud Security Professional who will be instrumental in protecting the company’s digital assets. The individual shall come with proven strong technical competence and leadership capability to contribute towards the success to secure our multi cloud environment across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. You will design and implement security controls, drive posture management through CNAPP platforms, and work with engineering, DevOps, and compliance teams to embed security across the cloud lifecycle, from code to runtime.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Design, implement, and maintain security controls across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI, including IAM, network segmentation, encryption, key management, and logging.
* Own the deployment, tuning, and day-to-day operation of CNAPP platforms (such as Palo Alto Cortex Cloud, Wiz and/or Orca)
* Assessment, development & implementation, operationalization and documentation of a comprehensive and broad set of security, data protection, cryptography, key management, identity and access management (IAM), network security) within IaaS and PaaS, and other cloud environments.
* Manage CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, DSPM, vulnerability management, and container/Kubernetes security capabilities.
* Triage and prioritize findings by risk and attack path; drive remediation with application and platform teams, and track SLAs and risk reduction metrics.
* Build custom policies, detection rules, and automated remediation workflows.
* Integrate security into CI/CD pipelines: IaC scanning (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM), SAST/SCA, secrets detection, and container image scanning.
* Integrate cloud-native telemetry with the SIEM/SOAR platform.
* Map cloud controls to frameworks and standards such as CIS Benchmarks, NIST, ISO 27001/27017 and other applicable regulations
* Support audits and produce evidence, and maintain security documentation, standards, and runbooks.
* Report on security posture, risk trends, and KPIs
* Partner with cloud platform, DevOps, SRE, and application teams as a trusted security advisor.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience in cloud security.
* Hands-on experience in at least one cloud - AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI, with knowledge of the others.
* Experience with at least of the leading CNAPP tools - Cortex Cloud, Wiz, Prisma Cloud or Orca to safeguard the cloud environment
* Strong understanding of cloud IAM, network security, encryption/KMS, secrets management, and logging/monitoring.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred) and security scanning of IaC.
* Scripting/automation skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell; familiarity with APIs and event-driven automation.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and benchmarks (CIS, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud).
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills; ability to work in a team environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal direction; self-starter/self-motivated

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, AZ-500, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, OCI Security Professional, CCSP and/or CISSP.
* Strong expertise in GCP services (i.e. Cloud Services Platform, Google Kubernetes Engine, Compute Engine, Cloud Interconnect)
* Experience with SIEM/SOAR tools (XSOAR, Splunk, Sentinel, Chronicle).
* Exposure to containers and Kubernetes security.
* Exposure to Zero Trust, data security/DSPM, and API security.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.
  
  
**Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements**
With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.
  
  
**Interview Integrity**
To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.
  
  
These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.
  
  
**This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.**

title: Archt II-Solutions Archt (INTL)
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Type of Work: Highly consultative, collaborative with internal Sales and architectural . The daily focus is on independently leading technical pre-sales for mid-to-large enterprise accounts, leading whiteboarding sessions, and designing hybrid telecom/cloud networks. You will also play a critical role in identifying and scoping automation opportunities within customer deployments.
* Expected Volumes: Managing a robust pipeline of concurrent enterprise deals independently, while partnering with Architect IIIs on specific components of global strategic accounts. You will oversee technical discovery, design full network topologies, and guide Architect Is in building the corresponding lab/PoC environments.
* Risk & Criticality: Moderate-to-High commercial risk. You are independently designing solutions and scoping out automation requirements for significant revenue-generating accounts. Inaccurate scoping, missed requirements during discovery, or flawed architectural designs can lead to delivery delays, margin erosion, or lost competitive bids.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Mid-to-Large Deal Ownership: Act as the primary technical lead for mid-to-large enterprise deals. Take full ownership of the technical sales cycle, from initial discovery and requirements gathering to the final solution presentation.
* Automation Scoping & Strategy: Move beyond basic scripting to identify strategic automation opportunities. Assess customer environments and internal workflows to scope out where zero-touch provisioning, API integrations, or RPA can be applied. Define these requirements clearly for the Automation Team or Architect I to execute.
* Technical Discovery & Whiteboarding: Lead interactive customer workshops and whiteboard sessions with IT Directors and Network Managers. Uncover deep technical pain points and map them directly to our SD-WAN, cloud, and modern telecom portfolio.
* Solution Architecture & Validation: Design comprehensive, scalable network architectures. Oversee the generation of accurate Bill of Materials (BOMs) and technical RFP responses, ensuring everything is technically viable and aligned with delivery capabilities.
* Mentorship: Guide the Architect I in understanding the actual customer requirement and solution design
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as a bridge between Sales, Delivery, and Product. Ensure the solutions you architect are deployable by the delivery team and provide structured feedback to Product Management on mid-market feature requests.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.
* 4 to 6 years of relevant experience in the telecom or tech industry, with at least 2-3 years in a customer-facing pre-sales, systems engineering, or solutions architecture role.
* Advanced Networking Knowledge: Deep understanding of enterprise architectures, including SD-WAN, complex routing/switching (BGP, OSPF), firewalls, VPNs, and legacy telecom transitions.
* Automation Acumen: Strong ability to identify automation scope. You must understand how APIs work (REST/JSON) and how tools like Python, Terraform, or Ansible integrate into a network, even if you are no longer writing the code from scratch every day.
* Cloud Integration: Practical experience designing networks that connect securely to public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and understanding cloud-native networking constructs.
* Presentation Skills: Proven ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value for mid-level technical decision-makers (Directors of IT, Network Managers).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Mid-level industry certifications such as Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Security), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, MEF SD-WAN Professional, or equivalent.
* Experience navigating the transition of legacy MPLS networks to modern, internet-first SD-WAN or SASE architectures.
* Experience managing or orchestrating vendor relationships (OEMs) for specific components of a larger deal.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

* AI Access Security: Establish visibility, risk scoring, and security policy tuning

specifically for corporate generative AI applications.
  
  

* Migrations & Lifecycle Management: Provide guidance on hardware refreshes, legacy port-to-App-ID policy transitions, and Panorama-to-SCM platform migrations.
* Network & VPN Operations:
* Deploy, optimize and maintain secure connectivity solutions, including GlobalProtect

VPN for remote workforce access and Site-to-Site IPsec/SSL tunnels.
  
  

* Configure and Troubleshoot routing (BGP, OSPF, static routing) and high-availability

(HA) failovers.

* Must include a minimum of 2–3 years of direct, hands-on experience in deployment and troubleshooting live production environments for enterprise firewall customers.
* Deep technical mastery of NGFW architectures, various form factors, PAN-OS features and functionalities including deep understanding of Panorama and Strata Cloud Manager (SCM).
* Extensive hands-on experience with IPsec VPNs, Quality of Service (QoS) traffic prioritization, dynamic routing protocols (BGP/OSPF), Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) workflows, and Public Ke Infrastructure (PKI) certificate validation.
* Experience in configuring SAML/RADIUS/LDAP integrations, and endpoint compliance (GlobalProtect/Host Information Profiles (HIP)).
* Familiarity with deploying and configuring Cloud Access Security Brokers (CASB), Enterprise DLP engines, and IoT Security platforms.
* Exceptional ability to translate highly complex Technical and architectural blueprints into digestible training sessions, workshops, or strategic roadmaps.
* Proven capability to establish strong technical credibility and build relationships across diverse customer personas.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior work experience within a Technical Assistance Center (TAC) environment at the top tier is strongly preferred. Experience in security operations or firewall operations will be beneficial.
* Certifications such as PCNSE (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer) or equivalent expert-level network security credentials.
* Prior experience working with AI-driven security dashboards, AIOps, or automated configuration baseline evaluation suites (e.g., Best Practice

title: Ralph Lauren Technology Business Management Associate
description:
**Company Description**
Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands. At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Purpose & Scope: We are actively seeking a highly motivated and enthusiastic recent graduate to join our team as a Technology Operations and Support Associate. This role is an excellent opportunity for new graduates who possess outstanding communication skills, a collaborative mindset to partner with regional business teams, and a strong desire to develop their skills in business operations. As a Technology Operations and Support Associate, you will play a pivotal role in our Information Technology Department's initiatives and activities, with a specific focus on portfolio analysis, reporting, and department governance.
  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
What you will be doing (responsibilities):
  
  

* Work collaboratively within a small team to manage tasks related to the Information Technology Department's portfolio of initiatives and activities.

* Provide support for contract management and maintenance in coordination with Legal and Procurement teams.
* Facilitate all aspects of technology procurement, including purchase order placement and invoice processing.
* Assist in organizing departmental reviews of the Technology portfolio.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across the company in non-technical roles to ensure smooth operations.
* Perform ad-hoc analysis, reconciliations, or special projects as required.
* Fulfill additional duties or tasks as assigned by management.

**Experience, Skills & Knowledge**
What you bring (Qualifications):
  
  

* Location: Bengaluru, IN
* Qualification: Recent graduate preferably in Information Technology or Business.
* Strong proficiency in MS Suite, particularly Excel.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively with regional business teams.
* Ability to conduct research and analysis into hardware and software products as required.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute multiple tasks in a high-pressure environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Must have "can do" attitude and be able to work independently.
* Strong time management skills.

title: P2P Customer Support Analyst

* Excellent communication skills (English)
