title: Customer Operations Lead Specialist
description:
****Overview****
WELCOME TO SITA
  
  
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a
**Great Place to Work**
® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
  
  
Are you ready to love your job?
  
  
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
PURPOSE
  
  
The Customer Operations Lead Specialist serves as the primary operational point of contact for assigned customers, ensuring service excellence, operational stability, and customer satisfaction. The role is responsible for managing customer relationships, driving service improvement initiatives, coordinating resolution of operational issues, and proactively identifying opportunities to enhance the customer experience.
  
  
Working closely with internal stakeholders, technical teams, and customer-facing account teams, the Customer Operations Lead Specialist acts as a trusted advisor, ensuring customer commitments are achieved while supporting business growth, retention, and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Customer Relationship Management
  
  

* Build and maintain strong working relationships with assigned customers.
* Act as the primary operational contact for customer service-related matters.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer environments, business objectives, and operational requirements.
* Conduct regular service reviews and operational meetings with customers.
* Support customer retention through proactive engagement and issue management.
* Ensure customer concerns and escalations are addressed in a timely and professional manner.

Service Delivery & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Monitor service performance against agreed service levels and contractual commitments.
* Analyze operational performance metrics and identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Coordinate resolution of customer-impacting incidents and service issues.
* Drive root cause investigations and corrective action plans for recurring issues.
* Manage customer change requests and support implementation activities.
* Ensure compliance with operational processes and governance standards.

Customer Success & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Create and maintain customer success plans for assigned accounts.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and service quality.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives through collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* Utilize customer feedback, service data, and performance insights to recommend enhancements.
* Support customer adoption of new services, tools, and capabilities.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Collaborate with Technical Support, Engineering, Service Delivery, Sales, and Account Management teams.
* Coordinate internal resources to deliver customer commitments.
* Communicate customer priorities, risks, and opportunities to business stakeholders.
* Participate in customer business reviews and executive presentations when required.

Reporting & Analysis
  
  

* Prepare and deliver operational reports, service reviews, and performance updates.
* Track customer health indicators and operational KPIs.
* Provide recommendations based on data analysis and customer insights.
* Maintain accurate customer records and documentation.

Subject Matter Expertise
  
  

* Act as a subject matter expert for customer operations processes and best practices.
* Support knowledge sharing and mentoring within the team.
* Contribute to process development and operational standardization initiatives.
* Assist in onboarding and coaching new team members.

****Qualifications****
EXPERIENCE
  
  

* 7-8 years of experience in Customer Operations, Customer Success, Service Delivery, Technical Support, or Account Operations.
* Experience managing customer relationships in a B2B environment.
* Experience conducting service reviews and handling customer escalations.
* Experience working with cross-functional global teams.

**Preferred**

* ITIL Foundation Certification.
* Customer Success, Service Management, or Project Management certifications.
* Experience in telecommunications, aviation technology, managed services, or enterprise support environments.

**Required**
KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS
  
  

* 4-6 years of experience in Customer Operations, Customer Success, Service Delivery, Technical Support, or Account Operations.
* Experience managing customer relationships in a B2B environment.
* Experience conducting service reviews and handling customer escalations.
* Experience working with cross-functional global teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting enterprise or strategic customers.
* Experience with service governance and operational performance management.
* Exposure to ITIL processes including Incident, Problem, and Change Management.

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Customer Focus
  
  

* Builds credibility and trust with customers.
* Demonstrates commitment to delivering positive customer outcomes.

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Manages multiple priorities effectively.
* Ensures high-quality execution and attention to detail.

Collaboration & Influence
  
  

* Works effectively across matrix organizations.
* Influences stakeholders without direct authority.

Problem Solving
  
  

* Identifies root causes and develops practical solutions.
* Utilizes data and insights to drive decision-making.

Communication
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Confident presenter with the ability to engage diverse audiences.

**Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Telecommunications, or related discipline.
* Strong understanding of customer service and operational management principles.

**What We Offer**
We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
  
  
⏰
**Flex Day:**
Make your workday suit your life and plans.
  
  
🌎
**Flex-Location:**
Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
  
  
🌿
**Employee Wellbeing:**
We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
  
  
🚀
**Professional Development:**
At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From
**LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,**
and
**Airport Council International**
-available to all employees-to specialized solutions like
**Pluralsight**
for technology upskilling,
**Harvard Business Publishing**
for people leadership,
**Stanford**
for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.
  
  
🙌
**Competitive Benefits:**
Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

title: Purchase Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Artech Furniture Private Limited specializes in designing, manufacturing, and supplying a wide range of furniture items. The company focuses on functional, durable, and aesthetically appealing products for residential, commercial, and institutional spaces. Artech Furniture aims to combine quality materials with efficient production processes to deliver value to customers. The organization emphasizes reliability, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement in its product offerings and services.

**Role Description**
The Purchase Manager role at Artech Furniture Private Limited is a full-time position based in Ahmedabad with a hybrid work model, allowing some work-from-home flexibility. The Purchase Manager oversees procurement of raw materials, components, and finished furniture items, ensuring timely availability and cost-effective purchasing. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying and evaluating suppliers, negotiating contracts and pricing, issuing purchase orders, and monitoring inventory levels in coordination with production and warehouse teams. description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Analyst, Risk Management
  
  
Senior Analyst, IT Risk Management – Individual Contributor
  
  
**Overview**
The Senior Analyst, IT Risk Management, will support our SOX Compliance program within the Finance Organization and will report into the US-based Manager, Risk Management. This position will primarily focus on scoping and evaluation of general and application IT controls. The Senior Analyst will be responsible for managing and executing various aspects of the program including IT scoping, delivery of the program, and reporting of results. The Senior Analyst will work closely with the US-based SOX team, worldwide IT departments, regional controllership, our shared services center, business owners, and our internal and external auditors, with the expectation of some overlap in the working hours.
  
  
Requirements for this position include extensive knowledge of IT general and application controls, strong understanding of IT control frameworks (e.g., COBIT, NIST Cybersecurity, NIST SP 800-53, CIS/SANS Top 20), familiarity with SEC/PCAOB regulations, COSO and US GAAP, as well as the demonstrated ability to monitor an effective global risk-based IT control environment.
  
  

* Are you looking to join a fast-paced, collaborative environment supporting a world class growing organization?
* Do you have the ability to think strategically and execute a complex project?
* Do you have a risk-based mindset?
* Are you IT savvy?
* Do you have the ability to drive change and improve awareness across the organization?

Role
  
  
**Job Description**

* Support the execution of various SOX program components, including IT scoping, IT risk assessment, training of stakeholders on IT control-related best practices, IT control testing and review, remediation recommendations, deficiency evaluations and reporting
* Report to a US-based Manager, Risk Management
* Assess and determine design effectiveness of internal controls
* Experience covering multiple technology environments such as Mainframe, UNIX/Linux, Cloud and Windows environments
* Work with business owners to address any potential control gaps that may require remediation
* Partner with various business owners and IT teams including technology compliance, operations, development, and application support to provide expertise in assessing the design and effectiveness of IT controls
* Liaise with regional finance and IT stakeholders as well as internal and external auditors
* Ensure the delivery of high quality, timely work products
* Continuously identify efficiencies in the SOX program and opportunities for optimization of the financial and operational processes and controls through interaction and partnership with management
* Exhibit strong project management skills with the ability to hold self and others accountable to internal and external deadlines
* Ability to effectively manage international time-zone differences in communication globally
* Demonstrate the ability to exercise judgment and display a high standard of ethics and professionalism
* Demonstrate exceptional communications skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to understand complexities of the business

**All About You**

* Bachelor Degree Accounting, Business, Management Information Systems or equivalent, a CPA/CA, CISA or similar certification required
* Has a strong understanding of IT control concepts and framework such as COBIT, NIST Cybersecurity, NIST SP 800-53, CIS/SANS Top 20, Sarbanes Oxley, COSO, and leading business practices
* Recent experience providing IT auditing or IT advisory-type services
* Knowledge of best practices around IT controls
* Working knowledge of current PCAOB Auditing and Accounting Standards
* Experience with the IT external audit or risk advisory services or an in-house Technology Risk Management (first/second line of defense) or equivalent experience in a large, regulated organization with exposure to both infrastructure and applications
* Knowledge of common enterprise and web application technologies
* Familiarity with audit automation preferred
* Proven ability to manage complex engagements or programs
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and interpersonal skills with emphasis on building strong, longer-term relationships worldwide across varying geographies and functions
* Detail oriented, self-motivated with the ability to meet project deadlines and deliverables in a fast-paced environment
* Experience in risk management field (e.g., risk management, audit, compliance) desired
* Effective ability to influence, drive change and resolve conflicts
* Strong analytic, logical reasoning and problem-solving skills
* Strong project management skills to lead and prioritize multiple projects
* Demonstrated ability to drive change and continuous improvement
* Some travel may be required in the future, up to 10% travel

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

* Drive customer success by integrating advanced simulation tools into their engineering workflows, enabling efficient and accurate design outcomes.
* Enhance Synopsys’ reputation for technical excellence and customer-centric innovation through tailored solution delivery.
* Accelerate the adoption of high-frequency simulation technologies, supporting the development of next-generation products in automotive, communications, and IoT industries.
* Foster lasting customer relationships by providing exceptional technical support and consulting, ensuring satisfaction and loyalty.
* Influence product development by capturing and translating customer feedback into actionable improvements and new features.
* Contribute to industry advancements by sharing expertise at events, expanding Synopsys’ thought leadership and market presence.

**What You’ll Need:**

* MS/PhD in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or equivalent, with specialization in electromagnetics.
* 4–7 years of experience in the high-frequency domain, using simulation tools for real-world applications.
* Expertise with Ansys HFSS, SIwave, Q3D Extractor, or comparable industry simulation software.
* Familier with SI, PI, RF and Microwave concepts. Basic-intermediate level of understanding of signal and power integrity.
* Ability to research, debug, and resolve software-related issues efficiently.

* Knowledge of commercial packages such as ADS, MATLAB, Python, and CST.
* Measurement & Lab Skills, Analysis and Problem-Solving skills, Hardware / System Knowledge.

**Who You Are:**

* Highly organized and adept at time management, possessing a sense of urgency.
* Professional, business-oriented, and driven to succeed in fast-paced environments.
* Customer-focused and committed to delivering outstanding service and support.
* Collaborative team player who thrives in multi-disciplinary, cross-functional settings.
* Adaptable, eager to learn, and ready to travel up to 25% of the time.

**The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:**
You will join the Electronics High Frequency team within the Ansys Customer Excellence group. This team is comprised of experts in RF, signal integrity, and simulation technologies, working collaboratively across disciplines and regions to deliver innovative solutions. The team is dedicated to advancing engineering capabilities, supporting customer success, and driving business growth through technical leadership and continuous learning.

title: Senior QA / SDET Engineer
description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
   

  

 TTEC Digital seeks a Sr. QA/SDET Engineer to join our team. This role is a full\-time and fully remote opportunity!
   

  

**The work:**
 We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early\-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982\.
   

  

 This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
   

  

**Who We Hire — The DNA**
* Self\-starters and do\-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show\-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI\-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed\-systems literate. High\-efficiency, event\-driven, low\-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well\-rounded, smart people who move fast


**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**
* Automation\-first quality engineering for a platform combining voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI
* We emphasize AUTOMATION — we do not do manual QA here
* Weekly code deploys are the heartbeat: when a QA branch is ready, regressions run fast, results report fast, and the train doesn't wait
* Startup environment: 1\-week sprints, fail fast, move forward.


**What you'll own:**
* Automation coverage for your squads' services
* Fast\-turnaround regression suites gating weekly deploys
* Rapid detection and reporting
* Quality signal in minutes, not days
* Load/stress coverage for your services' latency budgets
* Your committed timelines.


**Who you are:**
* Self\-starter with grit and a show\-me mentality
* You consider yourself exceptional, love new technology, adapt fast when the stack changes under you, and use AI tools daily to multiply velocity — including AI\-assisted test generation
* A team player who likes winning, and a partner to dev, not a gate: when something breaks, you help the dev team isolate it fast


**What You Will Bring:**
* 5\+ years SDET; writes real automation code (Go / Python), not manual scripts. Automation\-first is a conviction, not a preference.
* Master issue\-isolator and root\-cause debugger — you narrow a failure to the service, the commit, the event; dev teams love your bug reports because they're half the debugging done.
* Fast regression discipline — parallelized suites, smart test selection, results in minutes; quality at weekly\-deploy speed without becoming the bottleneck.
* Comfortable in high\-load testing environments — load, stress, and soak testing of high\-throughput, low\-latency systems; you know how to find the knee of the curve.
* Experience testing event\-driven systems, WebSocket flows, and browser extensions — ordering, race conditions, real\-time state.
* CI\-native mindset — tests wired into trunk\-based CI/CD; flake management as a first\-class discipline (a flaky suite is a broken suite).
* Contract/API testing between services; synthetic data and traffic generation (simulated calls, event streams, audio) for repeatable real\-time testing.
* Testing AI outputs — eval\-style assertions for non\-deterministic LLM/ML features — a strong plus.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Finance & Accounts Intern
description:
**Finance & Accounts Intern**

**Triomics | Bengaluru | Internship (flexible duration, minimum 3 months)**

**About Triomics**

Triomics is building AI-powered software to accelerate oncology clinical trials and cancer care. Backed by YC, Lightspeed, Nexus Venture Partners, General Catalyst, and Battery, we work directly with cancer centers and health systems to bring our platform into live clinical workflows. As we scale from ~50 to 100+ people, the money moving through the company grows with us: cloud and software vendors, recruiting partners, office operations, and team expenses. Keeping that flow accurate, documented, and on time is what lets the rest of the company move fast. That’s where you come in.

**About the Role**

We’re hiring a Finance & Accounts Intern to support the day-to-day financial operations of our Bengaluru team: raising purchase orders, verifying vendor invoices, tracking what we’re owed and what we owe, and keeping our books clean. You’ll work on live vendor accounts and real company spend from your first week, and own the paper trail from order to payment.

This is a hands-on, detail-heavy role: part billing operator, part reconciler, part follow-up owner who makes sure pending payments actually close.

**What You’ll Do**

* Prepare and manage Purchase Orders (POs) for vendors and partners, such as cloud and software providers, recruiting agencies, and office and facilities vendors, with correct amounts, terms, and approvals
* Create, verify, and maintain invoices and billing records, cross-checking each vendor invoice against its PO and agreed terms
* Track payments received and payments due to vendors and partners
* Reconcile payments, invoices, and outstanding balances so receivables and payables reflect reality, and trace mismatches to their source rather than patching them
* Follow up with vendors and partners on pending payments and invoices until they are closed
* Maintain daily expense records and basic bookkeeping, including team expense and reimbursement entries
* Keep financial records, spreadsheets, and supporting documents organised and audit-ready
* Assist with monthly financial reports and other routine accounting tasks

**Why Triomics**

* See how finance runs inside a fast-growing Series B startup, from purchase order to vendor payment to monthly close
* High ownership from day one, with real company spend rather than simulated exercises
* Fast-growing Series B startup (YC, Lightspeed, Nexus, General Catalyst, Battery-backed), scaling from ~50 to 100+ people
* Steep learning curve across bookkeeping, reconciliation, and monthly reporting, with direct exposure to leadership

description:

Role Description
  
  
We are seeking an experienced FI Specialist to lead the design, implementation, enhancement, and support of SAP Finance solutions within a complex S/4HANA landscape.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep functional expertise across Record-to-Report processes with strong technical acumen, integration experience, and the ability to influence business and technology stakeholders. This role will act as a trusted advisor to Finance, lead complex initiatives, and drive solution excellence across SAP and connected enterprise platforms.
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

* Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of SAP Finance processes across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Financial Closing, and Reconciliation processes.
* Own end-to-end solution design for Finance initiatives, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards, business objectives, and SAP best practices.
* Partner with Finance leadership and business stakeholders to understand strategic requirements and translate them into scalable SAP solutions.
* Drive business process harmonization and standardization across legal entities, business units, and geographies.
* Lead fit-gap workshops, solution design discussions, and architecture reviews for complex Finance transformation initiatives.
* Act as the primary functional lead for SAP Finance-related projects, enhancements, production support, and system integrations.
* Review and approve functional specifications, technical designs, testing strategies, and deployment plans.
* Lead month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close process improvements, ensuring system stability and process efficiency.
* Provide leadership during critical production incidents, driving root-cause analysis, remediation plans, and long-term corrective actions.
* Collaborate closely with Enterprise Architecture, Integration, Data, Treasury, Tax, Controlling, Procurement, and Engineering teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Mentor junior consultants and specialists, providing guidance on SAP Finance design principles, troubleshooting techniques, and delivery best practices.
* Support roadmap planning and continuous improvement initiatives across Finance systems and processes.

What You’ll Be Bringing
  
  

* 8–12 years of hands-on SAP Finance experience with multiple end-to-end implementation, migration, or transformation programs.
* Deep expertise in: General Ledger Accounting (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), Intercompany Accounting, Financial Close and Reconciliation Processes, Foreign Currency Valuation, Accruals and Provisions
* Strong understanding of: Universal Journal (ACDOCA), Ledger Architecture and Parallel Accounting, Document Splitting, Financial Statement Reporting, Validations, Substitutions, S/4HANA Finance innovations and SAP best practices
* Experience designing scalable solutions in global and complex business environments. Ability to challenge requirements and drive adoption of SAP standard functionality where appropriate.
* Strong understanding of SAP Finance architecture, data models, and end-to-end transaction flows.
* Proven experience integrating SAP Finance with:

+ Data warehouses
+ Middleware solutions
+ Legacy ERP and non-SAP applications (Blackline, OneStream, etc.)

* Experience working with integration technologies such as: SAP CPI, SAP PI/PO, MuleSoft, REST APIs, Web Services, IDocs
* Ability to lead troubleshooting efforts across multiple systems and technology layers.
* Ability to bridge discussions between functional and technical teams and ensure solution quality.
* Lead delivery of complex Finance projects, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Own functional workstreams and coordinate activities across multiple teams and vendors.
* Prepare, Review and Approve (as needed): Solution Designs, Functional Specifications, Technical Specifications, Test Strategies, Cutover Plans
* Drive SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, deployment planning, and hypercare support.
* Manage competing priorities and provide clear status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
* Build strong relationships with Finance leadership, Product Managers, Architects, and Engineering teams.
* Influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations and solution expertise.
* Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Act as a trusted advisor for SAP Finance processes and system capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Controlling (CO), Profitability Analysis (COPA), Group Reporting, Treasury, Tax, or Revenue Accounting.
* Experience leading global Finance transformation or ERP modernization programs.
* Experience mentoring team members and acting as a technical lead within a delivery organization.
* SAP S/4HANA Finance certification is an advantage.
* Experience with SAP FICA (good to have)

Where You’ll Be
  
  
This role offers a flexible hybrid model.

Navigating increasingly complex situations, you are growing your personal brand, deepening technical expertise and awareness of your strengths. * Support transformation initiatives including offshore delivery expansion, control rationalization, and data analytics adoption.
* Qualifications & Experience
* Bachelor’s or master's degree in accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA / Chartered Accountant qualification preferred.
* 4 - 7 years of accounting experience, including time in public accounting (Big 4 or equivalent) and corporate controllership or financial operations within large enterprises.
* Proven expertise in Workday Financials (core accounting, reporting, and integrations).
* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and exposure to financial services or real estate accounting (mortgage servicing, lending, securitization preferred).
* Demonstrated experience managing or supervising accounting staff.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Proficiency with Excel, AI-driven finance tools, and automation platforms; demonstrated interest in applying digital solutions to accounting.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, global delivery environment with cross-border teams.
* Preferred Attributes
* Experience supporting outsourced or managed service delivery models.
* Familiarity with loan servicing systems, subledgers, and agency reporting processes.
* Comfort navigating complex stakeholder environments and tight reporting deadlines.
* Continuous improvement mindset, with focus on control, efficiency, and scalability.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**The Opportunity**

As a
**Senior Program Manager**
for the Productivity Engineering team at
**Okta**
, you will be at the heart of driving strategic business programs, bridging the gap between high-level business strategy, technology execution, and organizational goals. Your primary focus will be leading end-to-end program lifecycles, managing cross-functional delivery, and optimizing performance across the entire enterprise portfolio.

In this role, you will actively lead cross-functional program management initiatives, define core project requirements, and drive complex strategic programs to timely completion. You will align key program metrics with leadership objectives, oversee portfolio health, and support secondary operational areas such as productivity tooling and SaaS license oversight where needed.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* **End-to-End Program  and Project Leadership:**
  Lead complex, multi-stream programs  and projects from initiation through execution and delivery, ensuring clear scope alignment, timeline tracking, and milestone achievements.
* **Portfolio Management & Alignment:**
  Oversee the overall project portfolio, maintaining roadmap visibility, aligning resources, and balancing business priorities across cross-functional teams.
* **Program Analytics & Reporting:**
  Define and track core program performance metrics, key health indicators, and business ROI, presenting executive dashboards and status updates to leadership.
* **Cross-Functional Stakeholder Alignment:**
  Collaborate with business leaders, engineering teams, and global stakeholders to gather strategic requirements, resolve trade-offs, and drive enterprise alignment.
* **Risk & Issue Management:**
  Proactively identify program bottlenecks, dependencies, and risks, implementing mitigation strategies to ensure predictable program delivery.
* **Process Optimization & Governance:**
  Establish robust program governance framework, standardize delivery methodologies, and streamline execution workflows across global teams.
* **Change Management & Operational Enablement:**
  Drive change management, communication plans, and training programs for newly rolled-out enterprise initiatives to maximize user adoption and operational success.
* **Secondary Operations & Resource Planning:**
  Support partner functions including Procurement, Finance, and Security with contract reviews, resource optimization, and operational compliance as necessary.
* **Executive Escalations & Support:**
  Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation for strategic program roadblocks, scope changes, and executive alignment.

**What You’ll Bring to the Role**

* **Program Leadership Expertise:**
  5+ years of experience leading complex strategic programs or PMO portfolios in enterprise IT, SaaS, or high-growth technology environments.
* **Strategic Execution & Planning:**
  Proven track record of managing end-to-end program delivery, risk mitigation, resource allocation, and multi-stream project roadmaps.
* **Data-Driven Insights:**
  High proficiency in tracking program KPIs, performance dashboards, and executive reporting tools (e.g., Jira, Tableau, Power BI, Excel/Sheets) to support decision-making.
* **Stakeholder Influence:**
  Excellent verbal and written communication skills to lead alignment and use persuasion to align senior business partners and external vendors on new processes and business impacts.
* **Program Governance & Methodology:**
  Deep experience with project and program management frameworks (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) and PPM/ITSM tooling (Jira, ServiceNow, Asana).
* **Global Operational Agility:**
  Proven experience working autonomously and effectively in a fast-paced environment supporting a distributed, global company across time zones (particularly US hubs).

**License Management, Renewals & Automation**

* **SaaS License Oversight:**
  Oversee enterprise SaaS applications, monitoring seat utilization, provisioning metrics, and deployment health to optimize software spend.
* **Contract Renewals & Vendor Strategy:**
  Partner with Procurement and IT leadership to manage renewal timelines, evaluate vendor commitments, and align contract terms with operational needs.
* **Workflow & Provisioning Automation:**
  Identify opportunities to automate license request workflows, deprovisioning processes, and compliance tracking using enterprise orchestration tools.

**Why Join**

* **Drive Strategic Enterprise Impact:**
  Directly shape and execute core business programs that influence global strategy and organizational efficiency.
* **Cutting-Edge Stack:**
  Work with the latest from Google’s AI suite (Gemini) as well as other AI tools, functionality, and workflow automation.
* **Growth & Culture:**
  Join a collaborative, high-caliber global team that values operational excellence, strategic innovation, and continuous personal and professional development.

**The Okta Experience**

* Supporting Your Well-Being
* Driving Social Impact
* Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + Community

We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.

title: Product Manager – VFD
description:
Product Manager – VFD

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a leading provider of mechatronics, linear motion systems, industrial automation, robotics, motion control, machine vision and Industry 4.0 solutions, headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane). We partner with globally recognised technology manufacturers to deliver products and solutions that improve productivity, precision and manufacturing efficiency. In automation, Luna works with Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem and Fatek.

Location

Koparkhairane, Navi Mumbai

Key Responsibilities

• Define and own the VFD product vision, strategy, roadmap and lifecycle management for the Indian market.

• Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities, customer needs and emerging applications.

• Develop product positioning, value propositions and go-to-market strategies for existing and new VFD offerings.

• Work closely with sales, application, marketing and service teams for successful product launches, funnel growth and account penetration.

• Monitor product performance, customer feedback and market trends to drive continuous improvement and portfolio optimisation.

• Manage pricing, cost optimisation and profitability of the VFD product line; support annual and long-term business planning.

• Drive product documentation, training content, application notes and best-practice guides for internal and external stakeholders.

• Enable the sales team with technical content, presentations, demos and key customer engagements, including solution proposals and techno-commercial discussions.

• Collaborate with global principals/partners and internal engineering teams to align on product plans, localisation needs and field feedback.

• Forecast revenue, prepare business plans and track KPIs such as revenue growth, market share, profitability and pipeline health.

Required Knowledge & Experience

• Experience in product management, product marketing or application management in VFD / AC drives.

• Strong knowledge of AC drive technologies, control methods, applications and relevant industry standards.

• Experience with leading VFD brands (for example Shihlin or similar) is desirable.

• Good understanding of customer types and industrial segments such as OEMs, HVAC, water & wastewater, oil & gas, cement, metals and material handling.

• Hands-on experience in product lifecycle management from introduction to phase-out.

• Proficiency in MS Office; familiarity with CRM and ERP tools is an added advantage.

Key Competencies

• Strong understanding of VFD technology, industrial processes and energy-efficiency applications.

• Strategic thinking with a customer-first, solutions-oriented approach.

• Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.

• Analytical mindset with data-driven decision making and comfort with quantitative KPIs.

• Ability to collaborate across functions, influence stakeholders and drive initiatives to closure.

What You Will Learn at Luna

• End-to-end VFD product management, from roadmap definition and localisation to lifecycle and portfolio management in the Indian market.

• Applying VFDs across industries (HVAC, water, metals, material handling), including energy-saving and process-optimisation case building.

• Working with global technology partners on how product strategies are adapted for India.

• Commercial acumen through pricing, profitability management, business planning and KPI tracking.

• Broader industrial automation exposure beyond VFDs, including control systems, industrial networking and smart automation solutions.

Why Join Luna

• Fast-track career advancement based on performance, with a path to Senior Sales, Business Development, Product Management or leadership roles.

• Continuous technical and sales training, manufacturer certification programmes and mentorship.

• Performance-linked incentives, annual appraisal, paid leave and employee recognition programmes.

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Product Manager, Learner Products
description:

A product management course is a plus, but your shipped work matters more.

Apply on LinkedIn using the Apply button.

You will collaborate closely with engineering users, business representatives, IT colleagues and external partners to ensure solutions are well supported, aligned with business needs and delivered effectively.
  
  
You will build trust as a practical, knowledgeable adviser to engineering, business and IT stakeholders. By identifying needs and risks early, you will help shape initiatives from idea to implementation and ensure engineering solutions remain stable, fit for purpose and aligned with business priorities. You will work independently, build alignment, challenge constructively and take ownership of outcomes that create value.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities Will Include**

* Acting as a liaison for engineering applications, particularly Autodesk solutions.
* Helping turn business initiatives into clearly defined, implementable solutions.
* Contributing to or leading project management activities for engineering IT solutions and initiatives.
* Supporting the development of business architecture, ensuring alignment between processes, systems and business objectives.
* Conducting business analysis and facilitating requirements gathering, documentation and stakeholder alignment.
* Working with business stakeholders to understand their needs, challenges and opportunities.
* Connecting engineering stakeholders, business functions and IT to enable effective cross-functional collaboration.
* Helping ensure engineering applications are maintained, supported and continuously improved.
* Coordinating with internal teams, vendors and other stakeholders to support successful delivery and ongoing operations.
* Promoting structured governance, clear documentation and best practices throughout the solution lifecycle.

* Hands-on experience with Autodesk solutions such as Autodesk Inventor, AutoCAD and Vault.
* A strong background in project management, business architecture and business analysis.
* A structured, solution-oriented approach to working across technical and business domains.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, paired with a proactive, collaborative mindset.
* Strong analytical, coordination and prioritisation skills, with the ability to balance strategic and operational topics.
* A high level of ownership and accountability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in an engineering-intensive or industrial environment.
* Familiarity with application lifecycle management, governance, cybersecurity and continuous improvement practices.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in global or complex organisations.
* Experience implementing and supporting business-critical applications.
* A relevant degree in IT, engineering, business or a related field.

**Key competencies**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication.
* A proactive and collaborative approach.
* Structured thinking, sound analysis and effective prioritisation.
* The ability to translate business needs into practical, usable solutions.

description:
#### **Job ID**

67989

Office Worker

HSBC

Full Time

**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

**Business Description**

  

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra-high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

  

**Role Purpose**

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the **Premier Banking** team.

  

As a Premier Relationship Manager or Senior Premier Relationship Manager at HSBC, you will be at the forefront of our flagship "Premier Banking" offering, serving as a vital link to our high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients. Your primary responsibility is to cultivate and expand HSBC Premier relationships, aligning with business targets and strategic plans. You will act as a single point of contact for Premier customers, anticipating their needs and delivering comprehensive banking and financial advisory services. Your role involves ensuring exceptional customer service in accordance with Global Premier Service Standards, identifying opportunities for wealth reviews, and providing tailored wealth solutions. Success in this role requires maintaining the highest standards of integrity, adhering to regulatory requirements, and fostering trust with both the bank and our clients.

  

**Principal Responsibilities**

  

**Business Impact:**

* Maximize profit and growth of Premier client portfolios by developing new and existing relationships.
* Achieve financial targets through effective client engagement and service delivery.
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services. Cross sell products.
  

**Client Management:**

* Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure retention and satisfaction. Need based selling.
* Utilize client relationship management tools to keep client information accurate and up to date.
* Develop strategies to increase wallet share and manage a prospect pipeline effectively.
  

**Team Collaboration:**

* Work as part of an integrated branch management team to meet standards and deliver operating models.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the business to support client needs and achieve performance measures.
  

**Operational Excellence:**

* Ensure compliance with HSBC's policies, including KYC, AML, and sanctions guidelines.
* Manage operational risk and adhere to sales quality requirements.
* Attend mandatory training and report any unusual activities promptly.
  

**Leadership & Development:**

* Support team members and contribute to a positive work environment.
* Establish a network of internal relationships and gather feedback from colleagues and clients.
  

**Knowledge & Experience**

* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* For GCB 6: 3 to 5 years of Retail/Premier Banking segment as Relationship Manager
* For GCB 5: More than 5 years of Retail/Premier Banking segment as Relationship Manager.
* Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Sales Achievements: Demonstrated success & experience in Wealth products.
* Client Relationship Management: Proven experience managing relationships with high-net-worth clients.
* Wealth Management Expertise: Strong technical skills in wealth management.
* Communication & Influence: Excellent communication skills with a focus on client engagement and influence.
* Sales & Networking Skills: Strong orientation towards sales, networking, and portfolio management.
* Product Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of financial services products, services, and client relationship management systems.
* Business Banking Insight: Familiarity with business banking client segments and related products and services.
* Regulatory Compliance: Possession of valid licenses and accreditations in wealth management as required by local regulations.
* Risk Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with Compliance, Credit & Risk, and Internal Control teams to maintain a balanced risk environment.
* Language Proficiency: Proficient in English and local languages.
  

**Accreditations**

* Professional Qualifications: Obtain necessary professional and regulatory certifications such as AMFI, IRDA, NISM XXI A (PMS Certification), and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) as per market requirements.
  

**Additional Notes :**

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required
  

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable*.*

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Project Coordinator – Rake Logistics
description:
**Job Title:** Project Coordinator – Rake Logistics  
**Location:** Chennai  
**Experience:** 7–10 Years

**Language:** Hindi and English  
**Industry:** Logistics / Transportation / Infrastructure / Mining / Power & Industrial Projects

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Project Coordinator – Rake Logistics** to manage and coordinate rake logistics and transportation activities across multiple project sites. The candidate will be responsible for identifying and onboarding new transporters, negotiating competitive transportation rates, monitoring daily rake loading and disposal activities, and ensuring smooth coordination between site teams, vendors, and transporters.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in rake loading and transportation of coal, fly ash, bottom ash, gypsum, or similar bulk materials.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and monitor daily rake loading, transportation, disposal, and trip activities across multiple assigned sites.
* Identify potential transporters and logistics vendors for different project locations.
* Negotiate transportation rates and commercial terms with transporters to ensure cost-effective operations.
* Evaluate, finalize, and onboard new transporters as per project requirements.
* Maintain regular coordination with site heads, operations teams, railway authorities (where required), and transporters.
* Monitor daily rake movement, loading schedules, vehicle deployment, and disposal performance.
* Ensure timely availability of transporters and vehicles to avoid operational delays.
* Track daily transportation performance, rake-wise movement, trip details, and disposal reports.
* Resolve day-to-day operational issues related to transportation, vehicle availability, and vendor coordination.
* Prepare and share regular MIS reports on rake loading, transportation, disposal, and vendor performance.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with transporters and logistics partners.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Graduate in any discipline; candidates with a qualification in Logistics or Supply Chain Management will be preferred.
* 7–10 years of experience in logistics, transportation, and bulk material handling operations.
* Must have hands-on experience in **rake loading and transportation of coal, ash, gypsum, or similar bulk materials.**
* Experience in handling logistics operations across multiple project sites.
* Strong experience in transporter identification, rate negotiation, vendor finalization, and onboarding.
* Good coordination, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and preparation of daily MIS reports.

**Key Skills**

* Rake Logistics & Coordination
* Bulk Material Transportation
* Coal / Ash / Gypsum Handling
* Transporter Management & Development
* Rate Negotiation & Vendor Onboarding
* Multi-Site Operations Management
* Daily Operations Monitoring & MIS Reporting

**Work Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Interested candidates** with relevant experience in rake logistics and bulk material transportation are encouraged to apply.

Our team is growing, and we’re looking for people like you to help us make a global impact.
  
  
As the leading cloud business system, NetSuite includes financials, inventory management, HR, professional services automation, commerce, and more. Tens of thousands of customers all over the world trust NetSuite to give their businesses the visibility, agility, and control needed to make data-informed decisions quickly. NetSuite is a place where you can build your career and have fun while doing so! We’re invested in our people, our customers, and the community. As part of Oracle, our benefits are second to none. Joining our passionate team means that you’re ready to take your career to the next level. With priceless learning opportunities, strong support, incredible innovation, and volunteer opportunities, NetSuite is committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered and set up for success.
  
  
**Our company culture:**

* We help each other and foster collaboration across roles and teams.
* We lift each other up. We know how to celebrate our successes and learn from our failures.
* Ideas are fragile and we consider them no matter how simple or outlandish.
* We always try to do the right thing – for ourselves, for the product and ultimately for our customers.

**How will you crush it?**
You'll work with awesome people that care about their craft and what they deliver. Your efforts will contribute to making things better for thousands of our customers.
  
  
You will collaborate strongly with our partners in Product Management, Security and Compliance – we’re all pulling in the same direction to deliver the secure, reliable software our customers want and need.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**You will fit perfectly if you share these values**

* People first.
* Manage a team of 7+ Engineers.
* Being open-minded for discussions and promoting team collaboration.
* Taking initiative, responsibility, and ownership of the projects.
* Driving continuous improvement of the team's productivity, product, and processes.

* Experience working with Quality Leads.
* Responsible for hiring of software engineers for agile development teams.
* Mentor, train and motivate software engineers to increase overall technical skillsets and stay current with technology trends.
* Drive the annual performance reviews and appraisal process for the team.
* Participate in the campus / Industry hiring drives.
* Work with team to resolve customer issues as per defined service level agreements.
* Able to successfully deliver committed features on time and meeting project objectives/deadlines.
* Participate in various scrum ceremonies such as Daily scrum calls , Sprint Planning, Sprint Retrospection

**Qualifications/Skills**

* Bachelor/Master degree in computer engineering or equivalent.
* 12+ years of software development experience in a technical capacity and minimum 3 years of managerial experience.
* Expertise in any of the development technologies : Java or C#.
* Expertise in designing complex solutions, code reviews, providing architectural input on team-wide/cross-location projects, defining branching strategies and able to drive cross-team initiatives.
* Good familiarity with testing pyramid, test plans, automation, code coverage, continuous integration, performance and security testing.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. title: Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director
description:
**Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director - Digital Project Delivery**
**(This role can be based in any global Worley office)**
**About Worley**
Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets.
  
  
With more than 40,000 employees in over 40 countries, we specialise in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**The role**
Shape how the world's energy, chemicals and resources projects are built and brought to life. As our Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director, you'll lead the team that digitally enables successful Construction and Commissioning (C&C) delivery across Worley's global project portfolio.
  
  
**Why this role matters**
At Worley, digital enablement spans the full stack of people, process and technology a global EPC company needs. Reporting to the Global Head of Digital Project Delivery (DPD) and joining the DPD leadership team, you'll set the direction for C&C digitalisation and have the authority and autonomy to make it happen. You will own the strategy, technology and corresponding processes that help our project teams deliver better outcomes for our customers.
  
  
DPD is part of Digital Operations at Worley and exists to support Operations, so your work in this global role will have impact across the organisation.
  
  
This is where deep digital expertise meets senior leadership. Rather than writing code yourself, you'll set the technical direction and lead a talented team across multiple locations, bringing them together to turn that vision into results on our projects. You'll engage with functional representatives in Operations to ensure C&C project needs are understood and delivered.
  
  
Worley has placed Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) at the centre of project execution. A key part of this role is supporting the seamless digital enablement of AWP on projects. AI is also central to our digital strategy, and this role will help shape how we adopt AI across C&C delivery.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Set the strategy: Define the strategy for digital enablement of C&C as part of the wider DPD strategy, build the plans to deliver it, and develop strategic relationships with external technology partners that support our DPD ambition.
* Own the solution: Take ownership of the C&C technology stack, including tools, integrations, automation, AI, data management and reporting, across its full build-operate-support-retire lifecycle, partnering closely with other parts of the Worley digital team.
* Own the approach: Define the end-to-end C&C workflow for digitally enabled projects in collaboration with the project delivery function.
* Lead implementation: Drive adoption of the C&C digital way of working, collaborating with the DPD People and Processes team to ensure a consistent approach across project delivery.
* Enable our people: Contribute to organisational change management, define the digital competency requirements for project personnel, and support the governance framework that embeds the Worley digital approach.
* Deliver standout support: Build a support culture focused on keeping our people productive, using service metrics to drive continuous improvement.
* Lead and grow the team: Manage geographically dispersed direct and indirect reports, including subcontractors, and develop and manage the team budget in line with company delegation of authority requirements.

**What You Will Bring**

* Demonstrated experience in construction and commissioning.
* Strong digital execution expertise and AI capability.
* A proven record of directly leading and managing teams.
* A relevant university degree.
* Experience collaborating across teams to deliver practical solutions.
* Experience developing strategies, operating models and frameworks, with a track record of successfully implementing new ways of working.
* Experience with digital solutions on projects and awareness of software commonly used for C&C delivery. Knowledge of O3 is preferred.
* Thought leadership, with the ability to move between strategic and tactical thinking and work comfortably with new concepts and complexity.
* Strong relationship and influencing skills across all levels, cultures and external parties, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly and facilitate discussions with large groups.

**What's In It For You**

* A senior leadership role on the DPD leadership team, with genuine authority and autonomy over C&C digitalisation.
* The opportunity to shape how digital technology is used to build and commission projects globally.
* The opportunity to build capability in deploying digital solutions across a large multinational organisation.
* Latitude to explore emerging C&C digital technologies with technology providers that could shape the future of project delivery at Worley.
* Applicants must possess valid working rights for the country in which the role will be based.

title: Manager, Customer Service
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Manager, Customer Service provides operational leadership for the India-based Customer Success team within a global, matrixed Customer Success & Operations organization, with primary responsibility for quote-to-order and order-related customer Success activities. The role oversees the day-to-day execution and resolution of customer requests related to quotes, orders, order changes, order status, fulfillment, pricing, and other transactional activities across the customer journey. Working closely with the US-based Senior Manager, Customer Success, the Manager translates global strategy and Success standards into effective local execution, while leading team performance, workforce management, escalations, process adherence, and continuous improvement to drive timely, accurate, and consistent customer outcomes.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**The Manager, Customer Service Has The Following Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership & Capability Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop the India Customer Service team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, engagement, and succession readiness.
* Build workforce capability through effective hiring, onboarding, performance management, targeted development, and cross-training that supports business continuity.
* Create an inclusive, customer-focused culture that reinforces quality, integrity, collaboration, sound judgment, and readiness for change.

**Customer Operations & Service Excellence**

* Own the consistent delivery of quote-to-order and order-related customer service outcomes, ensuring customer needs are addressed accurately, promptly, and in accordance with established service standards.
* Provide leadership for complex or high-impact customer issues and escalations, maintaining clear ownership, communication, and follow-through to resolution.
* Use service, quality, productivity, and customer feedback insights to set priorities, manage risk, and improve the customer experience.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Execution**

* Partner with the Senior Manager, Customer Service to translate global strategy, priorities, and performance expectations into clear plans and measurable outcomes for the India team.
* Build effective partnerships across Finance, Distribution, Trade Compliance, Quality, IT, Sales, Account Management, Product, and other global teams to resolve dependencies and deliver customer and business outcomes.
* Represent Customer Service requirements and customer impact in cross-functional initiatives, system changes, business reviews, and implementation activities.

**Operational Excellence, Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure team execution complies with applicable policies, procedures, quality requirements, and controls related to orders, documentation, controlled substances, permits, customs, licensing, and shipments.
* Lead improvements that strengthen service quality, efficiency, data accuracy, productivity, cost effectiveness, process consistency, and organizational readiness.
* Serve as the lead for ISO audits within the India Customer Service department, coordinating audit readiness, compliance documentation, corrective actions, and adherence to established quality management standards.

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Education & Experience**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required in a business, sales or related field.
* Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in customer Success, sales, or related field in a multi-cultural environment, preferably for a global organization
* Minimum of three (3) years of people management experience
* In depth knowledge of customer Success principles and practices
* Previous experience in a customer Success environment required.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Fluency in English required, and a second language strongly preferred.
* Customer Success focused and ability to provide a high degree of customer Success.
* Must possess ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with a high level for stress tolerance while maintaining composure and enthusiasm.
* Excellent organization, problem analysis, problem solving and decision-making skills, and attention to details required.
* Excellent communication skills (written and oral) and presentation skills are a must.
* Individuals must possess the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Results driven with demonstrated successful outcomes.
* Excellent supervisory skills with a history of building high performing and motivated teams.
* Strong team builder and people leader with the ability and desire to work well with diverse employees and customers in a cooperative and friendly manner.
* Must be able to work independently and in a team environment.
* Must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft software (word processing, email, spreadsheet, database, and Internet).
* Proficiency in Oracle and CRM systems desired.
* Familiarity with automated order entry systems, Ariba or other EDI processes a plus.
* Good understanding of complaint handling and resolution management.
* Familiarity with imports, exports, customs, and business with other countries strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with the culture(s) in the applicable geography(s) is strongly preferred.
* Candidates must be able to work flexible hours, when needed.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
Yes
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
  
  
**Job Category**
Customer Service
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time
