title: Sr Manager- Security
description:
**Overview**
The Security Manager’s primary purpose is the protection of PepsiCo’s people, assets, and objectives at GCC Hyderabad and GCC Gurugram, with a secondary responsibility of supporting the India Foods Security Lead and foods business, in the south of India, including but not limited to, the new greenfield site at Mannaparai, Tamil Nadu.
  
  
The Security Manager, who will be based primarily at the strategically critical GCC Hyderabad facility, is responsible for the day-to-day management of the contracted guard force, Video Surveillance Systems (VSS), Control room, Visitor Management System (VMS). This role is responsible for overseeing critical security functions including 24x7 CCTV monitoring, badge data administration, visitor management, female associate security transportation and the management of the iLobby application. Additionally, the role supports broader site operations, including employee travel risk management, security supplier billing, and the execution of office infrastructure projects.
  
  
Under Global Security guidance, the role will also support the conduct of incident response and investigations. The Security Manager is also part of the GCC crisis management and business continuity teams. They are responsible for the liaison between PepsiCo and the local police, emergency services and key stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* The principal accountabilities of the GCC Hyderabad & India Foods (South) is driving the implementation and execution of security, crisis management and business continuity management strategies, plans and protocols, and best practices across the GCC Hyderabad facility, as well as supporting the India Security Lead at outlying Foods manufacturing sites. Additional accountabilities include, but are not limited to:
* In line with the broader EMEA security strategy, implement Facility security plan to identify, assess and mitigate reasonably foreseeable security risks to PepsiCo’s People, Assets and Objectives.
* As a strategically important site to the entire PepsiCo business, oversee and facilitate the ongoing strengthening of a sustainable, Crisis Management and Business Continuity Planning and capability program at GCC Hyderabad.
* Through training and audit, develop and validate GCC Hyderabad’s Crisis Management and Business Continuity program and plans are current and functional.
* Maintain strong working relationships with, and provide consultation to, Facility and OU leadership teams.
* Plan and oversee security risk assessments and annual security audits at GCC Hyderabad (and outlying Foods sites) to identify, analyse and evaluate critical vulnerabilities, and to assist in closing these risks through cost-effective, best practice security controls.
* Analyse security threats and risks inherent in undertaking new business ventures and offer risk-informed mitigation measures.
* Develop and maintain working relationships with national and local security, emergency response, law enforcement, and regulatory authorities as well as with security directors of other large multinational companies.
* Deliver a Facility-aligned CAPEX security business plan that ensures effective security spend.
* Develop and deliver security awareness and training programs.
* Advise and assist before, during, and after security incidents, including on-the-spot risk assessments and security advice to business travellers.
* Implement operational plan to strengthen the protection of our supply chain at India Foods (South) sites.
* Conduct and coordinate investigations to include counterfeit, extortion, contamination of our products, loss reduction, kidnapping, robberies, Speak Up, fraud, corruption, and security threats against the Region’s interests and associates.
* As necessary and required, support the Corporate Security Executive Protection program by providing pre-travel logistical assistance and direct operational support to impacted members of executive leadership when they are present within the Sector.
* Work closely with Internal stakeholders, PGRE, S&T and LT to ensure strong communication and execution of programs.

**Qualifications**

* Understanding of threat actor profiling and assessment.
* Comprehensive knowledge of the ISO 31000 Risk Management standard and risk assessment process.
* Comprehensive knowledge of the ISO 22301 Business Continuity standard.
* Working knowledge of the ISO 28000 Security Risk Management standard.
* Comprehensive knowledge of guard force management, industry regulation and associated labour law.
* Practical working knowledge of video surveillance systems (demonstrable knowledge of Honeywell ProWatch).
* Practical working knowledge of access control systems.
* Practical working knowledge of visitor management systems (with demonstrable knowledge of iLobby).
* Practical working knowledge (and experience) of legally compliant workplace investigations and interviewing.
* Experience in the planning and execution of travel risk management (journey management) and associated Duty of Care obligations.
* Practical working knowledge (and experience) of data privacy compliance and privacy impact assessments.
* A minimum of 9-11 years of experience, with a mix of public and/or private sector exposure.
* Experience of securing major finance or technical (FinTec) hubs.
* Experience of securing manufacturing sites and associated supply chains.
* Experience in the planning and delivery of executive protection and event security.
* Capital and operational budget formulation and administration.
* Extensive knowledge of national and local security legislation and regulations

title: Senior Principal - Principal RE, Cloud & Hosting
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Site Reliability Engineer improves the reliability, resilience and observability of GSK's platforms as a hands-on engineer, reducing toil, preventing incidents and meeting agreed reliability targets. The role defines and monitors SLOs, instruments platforms for observability, leads incident response through to permanent prevention, and applies AI and automation for anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing. It also coaches platform engineering teams in reliability practice and error-budget discipline.
  
  
The role sits in Reliability Engineering & Operations and is deployed into a platform domain while drawing on the central capability, so it holds the central reliability standard inside a team it does not report to. Platform build and engineering direction sit with the Principal Engineers and the Engineering Director, the major incident process sits with the Major Incident Manager, and the reliability standard itself is set by the Reliability Engineering Senior Director. Reliability targets are held jointly with the Platform Manager rather than imposed on them.
  
  
**ROLE SCALE AND COMPLEXITY**
This is a senior enterprise reliability leadership role operating across globally distributed, business-critical cloud and hosting services. The post holder is accountable for setting technical direction, resolving systemic and ambiguous reliability risks, and influencing prioritisation across multiple platform teams, suppliers and geographies without relying on direct line authority.
  
  
The role manages a portfolio of interdependent services with material operational, regulatory, cyber, resilience and financial consequences. It shapes investment and supplier decisions and may influence or govern an annual technology and service portfolio of up to approximately GBP 23 million, where applicable to the assigned scope.
  
  
**MARKET SCOPE**
Global scope, supporting business operations across regions, countries and markets in which GSK operates. The role establishes consistent reliability outcomes across regional delivery teams while accommodating local regulatory, data-residency, business-continuity and market-criticality requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and monitor SLOs for the platforms served, and instrument those platforms for observability so reliability is measured rather than assumed.
* Apply AI and automation for anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing, so that recurring conditions are handled without human intervention.
* Lead incident response for the platforms served, and drive root-cause resolution through to permanent prevention rather than closing on restoration.
* Improve resilience through capacity, failover and recovery engineering, and test recovery rather than documenting it.
* Reduce operational toil through automation and reusable tooling, working the identified manual task and toil candidates and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platforms served, prioritising by the reliability risk each gap leaves unmeasured.
* Coach platform engineering teams in reliability practice and error-budget discipline, so reliability is built in rather than inspected in.
* Track reliability metrics against SLOs and team OKRs, and act on the trend rather than only reporting it.
* Support reliability oversight of supplier-run services, holding partner-operated components to the same SLOs as internal ones.
* Hold the central reliability standard while deployed in a platform domain, escalating to the Reliability Engineering Senior Director where local pressure would erode it.
* Feed reliability evidence into the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, so that resilience work competes on stated risk rather than on goodwill.
* Hold the boundaries with the Principal Engineers on platform build, the Major Incident Manager on the major incident process, and the Platform Manager on the reliability targets the platform commits to.
* Set the multi-year reliability strategy and engineering roadmap for the assigned cloud and hosting portfolio, translating enterprise risk and business priorities into funded reliability outcomes.
* Own cross-platform reliability governance, including service tiering, SLO policy, error-budget decisions, resilience exceptions and common engineering standards across internal and supplier-operated services.
* Lead resolution of complex, high-impact and systemic failure modes spanning cloud, hosting, network, security, applications and third-party dependencies, with authority to convene senior technical and service leaders.
* Provide evidence-based recommendations for investment, risk acceptance and supplier performance decisions, including prioritisation across a material service portfolio and, where delegated, spend of up to approximately GBP 25 million.
* Represent Reliability Engineering in Director, Senior Director and VP-level governance, communicating service risk, business impact, trade-offs and required decisions in clear executive terms.
* Mentor Principal and Senior Engineers, build communities of practice and raise engineering capability across regions rather than delivering only through individual contribution.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering).
* Reliability or platform certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or ITIL 4 for incident and problem practice).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Site reliability engineering, covering SLOs, observability instrumentation, error budgets and toil reduction.
* AIOps and operations automation, covering anomaly detection, predictive alerting and self-healing.

**Why is this level of Education Required?**

* An engineering grounding is needed because the role writes the automation and instrumentation itself and must be credible to platform engineers whose systems it is changing.

**Job-Related Experience**

* Overall 15 Years and typically 10-12+ years in infrastructure, cloud, platform or reliability engineering, including significant experience leading enterprise-scale reliability outcomes across multiple teams or service domains.
* 5+ years of hands-on SRE, Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Operations experience.
* Experience supporting large-scale production cloud and hosting environments.
* Experience owning operational reliability for critical business services.
* Proven record of improving service availability, resiliency, and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrated accountability for globally distributed, 24x7, business-critical services and for decisions with material operational, regulatory, customer or financial impact.
* Proven ability to influence Directors, Senior Directors and VP-level stakeholders, including presenting options, quantified risk, trade-offs and investment recommendations.
* Experience governing strategic suppliers and complex service ecosystems, with exposure to substantial technology budgets or portfolios; direct budget ownership is desirable but not mandatory where strong investment influence is evidenced.
* Track record of setting technical direction, leading through ambiguity and developing senior engineering capability across organisational and geographic boundaries.

**Requirements**
**Technical Requirements**

* Strong experience with: Azure and/or GCP, Linux and Windows Server platforms, Containers and Kubernetes, Cloud networking fundamentals, Infrastructure as Code , Cloud observability platforms
* Hands-on proficiency in: Terraform, Ansible, Python , CI/CD pipelines, Monitoring and telemetry solutions.

**Reliability & Operations**

* Experience defining and operating: SLIs , SLOs, Error Budgets, Operational KPIs
* Experience leading: Major incident response, post-incident reviews, Root-cause analysis , Capacity management, Resiliency and recovery testing.

**Operational Excellence**

* Demonstrated experience in: Runbook development, Operational readiness reviews, Service transitions, Continuous service improvement, Automation-led toil reduction

**Skills/Background**

* Comfort operating inside a team that is not the reporting line, holding a central standard without formal authority.
* Composure in live incidents, including deciding when to stop investigating and restore.
* Discipline to pursue root cause after service is restored and attention has moved on.
* Ability to coach engineers into reliability practice rather than policing them into it.
* Judgement about which observability gaps matter and which are noise.
* Willingness to automate away the work rather than becoming indispensable to it.

**Preferred Skills**

* Hands-on SRE practice: defining and governing SLIs, SLOs and error budgets for global, business-critical 24x7 cloud and hosting services (5+ years hands-on SRE/cloud operations)
* Azure and/or GCP production depth: Linux and Windows Server, containers and Kubernetes, cloud networking and landing-zone design at enterprise scale
* Hands-on coding and Infrastructure as Code: writes Python, Terraform and Ansible personally and ships through CI/CD pipelines (not just reviews others' code)
* Observability and AIOps: telemetry/monitoring platforms, closing coverage gaps by reliability risk, anomaly detection, predictive alerting and guarded self-healing
* Major incident leadership: RCA, blameless post-incident reviews and driving root cause through to permanent prevention
* Resilience engineering: capacity management, failover/DR design, and proven recovery and resiliency testing
* Executive influence and supplier governance: influencing Director/VP stakeholders and holding managed-service/cloud providers to SLOs without line authority; mentoring senior engineers

CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Configuration Management (CM), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), Disaster Recovery (DR), Financial Operations, Identity Access Management (IAM), Incident Management, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Major Incident Management, Operating Systems (OS), Performance Tuning, Resilience Engineering, Scripting, SRE Observability, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Vulnerability Management

title: Procurement Manager – Interior Fit-out & Turnkey Projects
description:
**Company:** Westbridge Turnkey DPE LLP  
**Location:** Chandivali, Mumbai (office-based, with site and vendor visits)  
**Experience:** 5–6 years  
**Reports to:** Projects Head / Director  
**Employment type:** Full-time  
**Also searched as:** Purchase Manager, Procurement Lead, Sourcing Manager (Construction / Interiors)

About Westbridge

Westbridge Turnkey DPE LLP is a Mumbai-based turnkey design, project and execution firm delivering interior fit-out and build projects end to end, from concept and drawings to procurement, site execution and handover. We are building out a procurement function that buys well, protects project margins and keeps sites supplied on time.

Role summary

You will own procurement across all Westbridge projects: what we buy, who we buy from, at what price and when it reaches site. You will build a dependable vendor base, run sourcing and negotiation for major packages, and make sure procurement supports project timelines and margins.

Key responsibilities

**Procurement strategy and planning**

* Build a procurement plan for each project, aligned with the design release and site execution programme, and identify long-lead items early.
* Decide the sourcing approach for each package (direct material purchase, supply-and-install, labour contract) together with the Projects Head.
* Set and track procurement KPIs: cost savings against budget, on-time delivery, vendor performance and payment-term improvements.

**Vendor management**

* Develop and maintain an approved vendor and subcontractor base across civil, interiors, MEP, joinery, loose furniture, lighting, flooring and finishes.
* Onboard new vendors: capability checks, factory/site visits, commercial and compliance documentation.
* Run periodic vendor performance reviews on quality, timeliness, pricing and responsiveness.

**Sourcing, negotiation and contracting**

* Run RFQs and tenders, and lead commercial negotiations for high-value packages.
* Finalise POs and work orders with clear scope, specifications, delivery schedules, payment terms, warranties and penalties.
* Manage rate contracts for high-frequency items to cut lead times and lock in pricing.

**Execution and control**

* Track orders through to delivery, and expedite or escalate when they slip so that sites are never held up for material.
* Coordinate with design, site and accounts teams on approvals, samples, specifications, deliveries and payments.
* Review costing outputs, approve comparative statements and sign off procurement-related cost reports for management.
* Ensure compliance with company procurement policy, approval limits and documentation standards.

**Team leadership**

* Lead and develop the Quantity Surveyor and any future procurement team members.
* Set up procurement processes, templates and systems as the function scales.

Requirements

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil or Mechanical Engineering, or a degree in Supply Chain / Construction Management. An MBA in Operations or Supply Chain is a plus.
* 5–6 years of procurement experience at an interior fit-out, turnkey, construction or real estate company, with at least 2 years owning procurement for complete projects or major packages.
* A strong vendor network in Mumbai/MMR across interiors and MEP.
* Proven negotiation skills, with measurable savings delivered.
* Solid commercial understanding of POs, work orders, contract terms, GST, freight and payment structures.
* Able to read drawings and specifications well enough to challenge scope and substitutions.
* Advanced Excel; experience with an ERP or procurement system.
* Experience managing or mentoring at least one team member.

Good to have

* Experience procuring for corporate offices, retail or hospitality fit-outs.
* Exposure to imports or sourcing outside Mumbai for specialised materials.
* Experience setting up procurement processes from scratch at a growing firm.

What success looks like in the first 6 months

* An approved vendor list with at least 2–3 qualified vendors for every major package.
* A procurement plan in place for every live project, and no site stoppages caused by material delays.
* Clear, documented savings against budget on major packages.
* A standard procurement workflow (RFQ → comparative → approval → PO → delivery → bill check) running across projects.

How to apply

Apply through Indeed, or email your CV to shikhar@meridiancs.in with "Procurement Manager – Westbridge" in the subject line. Please include your current CTC, expected CTC and notice period.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

You will not just design architectures; you will help to deploy end-to-end AI solutions that drive actual AI usage such as API consumption and business ROI. You will own the customer's technical success from the initial scoping phase through to live production deployment, post-sales adoption and growth.

Coordinate specialist input where needed and follow through on agreed actions

About the Company

Madhavan Buildcon Private Limited is a newly established infrastructure construction company focused on road development and civil infrastructure projects.

We are currently building our core technical and operational team before undertaking our first projects.

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager who will work closely with management to establish the company's construction capabilities, build its technical team, implement operational systems and prepare the organization for upcoming projects.

**This is not merely a site-supervision position.** We are looking for a technically competent, hands-on professional who can take ownership of project execution and grow into a senior leadership role as the company expands.

* Independently plan, execute and manage road and infrastructure construction projects.

* Ensure compliance with applicable IS, IRC and MoRTH specifications.

**2. Concrete Quality & Technical Management**

* Monitor concrete mix design, workability, slump, temperature, placement, compaction and curing.
* Identify and resolve concrete quality issues arising from high temperatures, extended transportation distances and transit delays.
* Supervise batching plant operations, quality testing and material inspection.
* Implement effective quality assurance and quality control procedures.

**3. Machinery & Productivity Management**

* Plan deployment and utilization of construction machinery.
* Monitor productivity of batching plants, pavers, graders, rollers, excavators, transit mixers and other equipment.
* Optimize manpower, machinery and material utilization.
* Minimize equipment downtime, wastage and execution costs.

* Prepare project execution plans, schedules and resource requirements.
* Monitor daily progress, project budgets, productivity and construction costs.
* Coordinate with subcontractors, vendors, consultants and clients.
* Review measurements, quantities, billing requirements and site documentation.

**5. Team Building & Operational Development**

* Assist management in recruiting site engineers, supervisors and technical personnel.
* Establish site reporting, quality control and execution procedures.
* Develop efficient systems for manpower, machinery, material and project monitoring.
* Help build the company's technical and operational capabilities from the initial stage.

Candidate Requirements

* B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Civil Engineering.
* 10–15 years of relevant experience in road and infrastructure construction.
* Strong practical knowledge of PQC, DLC, GSB, WMM, bituminous roads and RCC works.
* Proven experience independently managing construction sites and execution teams.
* Sound understanding of concrete technology, quality control

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Title: Sr. Project Manager**

**Position Summary:**

  

A project manager is responsible for delivering IT projects to schedule, budget and quality. The role requires mastery of the technical knowledge of project management inter-related process stages i.e., initiate, plan, execute, monitoring & control and close, and the supporting processes e.g., scope, cost, time, issue, risk, resource, communication, stakeholder management. Proficiency in related processes such as portfolio management, program management, methods and tools and quality assurance are also required. Senior project manager must have excellent stakeholder relationship management skills to successfully lead and manage the project team and project stakeholders, and have expertise recognized and requested by customers.

  

**Essential Functions of the Job:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget, and scope
* Perform the relevant project management processes - i.e., initiate, plan, execute, monitor and control and close, and the supporting processes e.g., scope, cost, time, issue, risk, resource, communication, stakeholder management
* Plan the project based on a defined need – results in detailed scope/budget/schedule baseline
* Monitor and control the work to ensure that the project remains on track and in control
* Plan for and manage change
* Reports on variances to the approved project baseline
* Close the project to formalize acceptance of the project result and release project resources
* Interface and communicate with project team, management and stakeholders
* Manage project work and resources to enable successful and timely completion of the project
* Performs gate reviews and quality assurance reviews with all aspects of IT organization and business sponsors
* Delivery of projects aligned to overall business and technology strategies and architectures
* Work within defined governance processes
* Manage external contracts and suppliers where required
* Support development of business cases with the customer team including leading on the solutions estimate
* Lead the development of the project charter and scope, and ensure delivery of the solution to schedule, budget and scope
* Develop objectives, phasing and content of the project to deliver on the business case benefits, budget and timescales
* Manage to the objectives and plan by thorough risk, issue and change management across both business and IT parts of the project
* Ensures that quality project standards are met as prescribed by IT Services through the effective implementation or use of approved processes, methodologies and deliverables

  

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**

* Monitors and manages project baseline to ensure activities are occurring as planned - scope, budget and schedule – manages variances
* Proactively performance monitoring and reporting on project/program scope, time, cost, quality, risks and overall project/program health.
* Leading the project/program team, working with global executives, management teams and IT Services Teams to ensure project/program success.
* Proactively identify risks and issues on projects - leading team to develop risk management and issues management plans
* Identifies potential points of contention for missed deliverables; creates and implements strategy to mitigate shortfalls in timeline and budget
* Anticipates problems before they occur; defines the problem or risk; identifies possible causes; works with team to identify solutions; selects and implements most appropriate solution
* Develop and manage plans to address project strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats
* Ability to balance both the "science" of how to perform project management and the "art" of project management, which is learned through experience and skill training/application
* Analytical skills and problem-solving skills needed to manage multiple factors on a project simultaneously
* Demonstrate business analytics to manage and meet sponsor and customer needs

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Experience of managing IT projects with personal accountability for delivering to time and cost for large, complex projects typically from $100,000 up to $5 M in value and 6 to 18 months in duration
* IT Infrastructure Management Knowledge – Networking, Sever Management, End User Computing, Voice & VoIP, etc.
* Mastery of project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Track record of customer focus, based on openness, trust, and delivering on promises
* Not mandatory but desirable - management skills to manage one or more large, complex projects simultaneously
* IT background with experience across the systems development life cycle with experience in all project phases – plan, initiate, elaborate, design, build, test, implement.
* Knowledge and use of industry-standard project methods, tools, and techniques e.g., RAIDS, budget, communication
* Strong team working skills across matrixed client, supplier, and geographically dispersed virtual teams
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills (including negotiation)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills – must be able to communicate fluently in English both verbally and in writing
* Leader in the use of IT methodologies, processes, and standards for project management
* Experience in working with Global teams – internal resources, contracting resources, suppliers/hardware & software vendors
* Not mandatory but desirable - experienced in managing to contract; ensuring clients and suppliers alike perform in accordance with original agreement

  

**Supervision Responsibilities:**

* Direct supervision provided by an experienced program manager or sub-lead; frequency on a weekly or as needed basis
* Project manager is expected to act independently to deliver project to schedule, budget and scope; support provided as required and requested, and is self-driven and motivated
* The project manager leads project teams consisting of cross functional, global, and virtual groups; assigns responsibility to members; monitors progress; no direct supervision responsibility.

  

**Job Requirements:**

**Education:**

A degree in Computer Science or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience

  

**Experience:**

* 12 – 18 years of working experience in the IT industry.
* 5 to 10 years of experience in project management
* Other relevant experience in a related technical field (application development, deployment/implementation, and infrastructure)
* Work experience in a professional services industry, and in multinational company/global firm is preferred

  

**Certification Requirements:**

* Project management certification is preferred (PMI/PMP - PMI/CAPM )
* Agile certification would be advantageous
* Familiarity with ITIL v3 or v4 would be advantageous

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: CSR Consultant
description:
**Job Summary:**

ClimaCrew is working towards scaling seaweed production through data, technology, and social sciences. Our mission is to make India a significant player in the global seaweed space. Through our technology platform, we connect suppliers and buyers of diverse seaweed products to meet worldwide demand. Our work focuses on creating livelihood opportunities and strengthening marine resilience.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a CSR & Grants Consultant to identify, pitch, and secure CSR partnerships and grant funding for ClimaCrew. The ideal candidate has strong funder networks and proven experience in the marine and ocean sector, ideally working with coastal or fishing communities. This is a consulting  engagement, and your compensation will be based on success.

**Role and Responsibilities**

:

·        Identify relevant CSR and grant opportunities (India & international); track deadlines

·        Draft and submit proposals, pitch decks, and applications

·        Build relationships with CSR heads, foundations, and institutional funders

·        Pitch and represent ClimaCrew in funder meetings

·        Coordinate with ClimaCrew's team for impact data and documentation

·        Manage post-award reporting and compliance

 

**Work Experience:**

·        3-5+ years in CSR fundraising / grant writing

·        Experience in the marine, coastal, or fisheries sector, with direct community engagement

·        Existing network of CSR/foundation contacts (climate, environment, or marine focus preferred)

·        Strong proposal-writing skills; familiarity with India's CSR framework (Schedule VII)

**Fee structure:**

A success fee of the value of each CSR or grant award secured by ClimaCrew, payable within [30] days of ClimaCrew receiving the funds.

What counts as “won”: A signed award letter, MoU, or grant agreement with ClimaCrew as the recipient.

Multi-year awards: Fee applies to the first year only / to each annual tranche.

Time commitment: flexibility around deadlines.

Expenses: Reimbursed with prior approval / Not reimbursed

**Non-exclusivity:**

 The consultant may take on other clients, provided there is no conflict of interest with ClimaCrew’s funders or sector.

Ownership: Proposals, pitch materials, and funder relationships developed for ClimaCrew remain ClimaCrew’s property.

Compliance: The consultant must not offer or accept inducements to funders. Please have counsel confirm that a success fee is compatible with the CSR Rules, including implementing-agency requirements, before finalizing this structure.

**Apply:**

Please provide your CV, cover letter, and references to careers@climacrew.in

Regional Customer Support Manager
  
  
  
  
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
In this role, you will have the opportunity to support and expand the B&R Education Network by collaborating with technical training centers, colleges, and universities to integrate advanced automation technologies into academic programs. Each day, you will work closely with educational institutions to enhance industry-academia engagement, support learning initiatives, and promote technology adoption. You will also showcase your expertise by helping develop industry-ready engineering talent and contributing to programs that bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world industrial requirements.
  
  
The work model for the role is: – Onsite
  
  
This role is contributing to the machine automation within ABB's Automation division in Pune-India region. Main stakeholders include educational institutions, faculty members, students, B&R sales and engineering teams, industry partners, and training organizations.
  
  
**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Developing and executing initiatives to grow the B&R Education Network, enhancing brand visibility and promoting collaboration with colleges, universities, and technical training institutes.
* Delivering technical presentations, seminars, workshops, and training programs to promote automation technologies and engage students, educators, and academic stakeholders.
* Building and maintaining relationships with educational institutions, supporting student projects, practical learning programs, and national-level automation competitions.
* Identifying partnership opportunities, expanding the Education Network ecosystem, and maintaining accurate engagement data and reports within CRM platforms.
* Bridging the gap between academia and industry by promoting emerging automation technologies, industry trends, and skill-development initiatives that prepare students for real-world engineering careers.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 1–4 years of experience in application development and technical support within industrial automation environments.

* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage customers, partners, and stakeholders in a professional environment.
* Proficiency in spoken and written English, with a willingness to travel up to 40–50% for customer support, training, and business engagement activities.

B&R Industrial Automation is a manufacturer of automation technology and ABB's global center for machine and factory automation. B&R was founded in 1979 by Erwin Bernecker and Josef Rainer and has its headquarters in Eggelsberg, Upper Austria. Today, B&R is a leading global solution provider for automating machines and factories and is responsible for machine automation in ABB's Robotics & Discrete Automation division.

Walmond Realty Dart Pvt. Ltd. is a real estate company focused on providing property consulting and real estate solutions. **1. SEO Strategy & Planning**

* Optimise website pages, landing pages, meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal linking.

* Implement image SEO, alt tags, and content structuring.
* Optimise property listing pages and location-specific landing pages.

* Conduct regular website audits and identify technical SEO issues.

**4. Off-Page SEO & Link Building**

* Develop quality backlink strategies through guest posting, outreach, and relevant industry websites.
* Improve domain authority and website credibility through ethical link-building practices.
* Monitor backlink profiles and identify toxic or spammy links.
* Build relevant brand mentions and improve online reputation.

**5. Local SEO & Real Estate SEO**

* Manage and optimise Google Business Profile.
* Improve local search visibility for Noida, Greater Noida, and other target locations.
* Optimise location-based keywords and property-related searches.
* Develop strategies to rank for high-intent searches such as property dealers, flats for sale, luxury apartments, and real estate consultants.
* Improve local business visibility, reviews, and location-specific search performance.

**6. AI SEO, GEO & AEO**

* Understand and implement Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) strategies.
* Improve brand visibility across AI-powered search experiences, including Google AI Overviews and AI Mode.
* Optimise content for conversational, voice, and question-based searches.
* Use AI tools to support keyword research, content planning, competitor analysis, and SEO reporting while maintaining content quality and originality.

**7. Content & Performance Management**

* Coordinate with content writers and digital marketing teams to develop SEO-friendly blogs, articles, and landing pages.
* Identify content gaps and build topical authority through relevant content clusters.
* Track organic traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and lead-generation performance.
* Prepare weekly and monthly SEO performance reports.
* Monitor Google algorithm updates and implement necessary optimisation strategies.

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, or a related field.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reporting skills.

* Increase in qualified organic leads and enquiries.
* Improvement in local search visibility and Google Business Profile performance.
* Growth in quality backlinks and referring domains.
* Improvement in website health and technical SEO scores.
* Better organic conversion rates and landing-page performance.

Why Join Walmond Realty Dart?

* Exposure to performance-driven SEO strategies.
* Opportunity to implement modern SEO and AI-driven search practices.
* Growth-oriented and collaborative working environment.

title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
description:
i47 Labs (i47.in) is a Bengaluru-headquartered sustainable infrastructure intelligence company specializing in in-house R&D, patented hardware manufacturing, and intelligent telemetry platforms for water and energy management. Through our flagship smart water metering and management platform, Aegir (aegir.in), we deliver end-to-end ultrasonic sub-metering, leak detection, consumption analytics, and automated supply control to apartments, villa communities, real estate developers, and industrial spaces. Currently saving over a million liters of water daily, we are scaling rapidly toward our mission of saving a billion liters every week before 2030.

**Job Description 1: Senior Business Development Executive – Real Estate & Builders**  
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka (Field Sales)  
Experience: 3+ Years (Mandatory experience in Real Estate, PropTech, Building Materials, or MEP/Utility Sales)  
Employment Type: Full-Time

**Role Overview**  
We are looking for a seasoned Business Development Executive with strong relationships across the real estate ecosystem to drive B2B adoption of i47 Labs’ Aegir smart water metering and energy telemetry solutions. You will own the end-to-end enterprise sales cycle with real estate builders, developers, MEP consultants, and project management consultants (PMCs) for upcoming and ongoing residential and commercial projects.

**Key Responsibilities**  
*Builder & Developer Acquisition*: Identify, pitch, and onboard Tier-1 and Tier-2 real estate builders and developers for bulk smart sub-metering and water-balancing deployments.  
*Consultant & Spec-In Engagement*: Build strong working relationships with MEP consultants, architects, and project teams to get i47 Labs’ patented ultrasonic meters (US-20 Series) and telemetry gateways specified early in project designs.  
*End-to-End Deal Closure*: Lead technical-commercial presentations, coordinate site surveys with our engineering team, negotiate commercial contracts/BOQs, and close high-value CAPEX/OPEX deals.  
*Pipeline & Account Management*: Maintain a structured sales pipeline, forecast quarterly closures, and ensure smooth handover to the deployment and operations teams.

**Requirements**  
3+ years of proven B2B sales experience selling into real estate developers, builders, or construction/infrastructure ecosystems.  
Existing network of decision-makers across procurement, projects, and engineering teams at real estate firms in Bengaluru.  
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to read BOQs, negotiate enterprise contracts, and manage multi-stakeholder sales cycles.  
Self-driven, comfortable with extensive field travel, and passionate about sustainable infrastructure and IoT hardware.

**Job Description 2: Business Development Executive – Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs)**  
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka (Field Sales)  
Experience: 0–2 Years (Freshers with strong communication skills or early-career field sales professionals)  
Employment Type: Full-Time

**Role Overview**  
We are hiring energetic, target-driven Business Development Executives to drive smart water management adoption across existing apartment complexes and gated communities. You will work directly with Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), Managing Committees (MCs), and Facility Managers to help communities eliminate water wastage, automate billing, and retrofit legacy plumbing with Aegir smart meters.

**Key Responsibilities**  
Community Prospecting & Field Outreach: Conduct structured territory mapping and field visits to apartment complexes and villa communities across Bengaluru to generate leads.  
RWA & Committee Pitches: Schedule and present product demos of the Aegir platform, ultrasonic meters, and old-meter retrofit solutions to RWA board members and facility teams.  
Weekend AGM & Committee Meetings: Attend RWA committee meetings (often held on evenings or weekends) to address resident queries, explain ROI/water savings, and drive consensus.  
Onboarding & Handover: Coordinate initial site assessments with technical teams, assist with proposal documentation, and ensure seamless onboarding once approved.

**Requirements**

title: General Manager - Sales & Operations
description:
A **General Manager (GM) of Sales in the Packed LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) industry** oversees the entire commercial, distribution, and revenue-generation strategy for cylinder-based LPG (domestic, commercial, and industrial segments).In India—where the market is split between Public Sector Undertakings (IOCL, BPCL, HPCL) and private Parallel Marketers (like TotalEnergies, Reliance, Super Gas, or regional bottlers)—the role bridges high-volume supply chain logistics with strict safety compliance and aggressive B2B/B2C channel management.1. Sales Strategy & Business Development

* **Revenue & Volume Growth:** Formulate and execute annual sales plans to achieve metric tonnage (MT) targets across domestic (14.2 kg / 5 kg) and commercial/industrial (19 kg, 35 kg, 47.5 kg, 425 kg) cylinder segments.
* **Market Expansion:** Identify underserved geographical territories, expand market share against competitors, and tap into new industrial verticals (e.g., hospitality, metallurgy, ceramics, textiles, and commercial kitchens).
* **Pricing & Margin Management:** Monitor international LPG benchmark prices (such as Saudi Aramco CP) and domestic market dynamics to structure competitive pricing, dealer margins, and bulk discount slabs without eroding profitability.

2. Distribution & Channel Management

* **Network Expansion:** Appoint, onboard, and manage a robust network of distributors, dealers, franchisees, and Direct Selling Agents (DSAs).
* **Channel Profitability & Retention:** Ensure distributors maintain healthy Return on Investment (ROI) by optimizing delivery routes, managing credit limits, and designing effective incentive schemes.
* **Cylinder Rotation & Asset Tracking:** Maximize cylinder turnaround time (reducing idle inventory at customer or dealer premises) to optimize capital expenditure on cylinder procurement.

3. Key Account Management (B2B / Industrial)

* **Institutional Sales:** Directly negotiate and close long-term supply contracts with large commercial clients, including hotel chains, hospitals, corporate cafeterias, and manufacturing plants.
* **Technical & Value-Added Selling:** Work alongside technical teams to help industrial clients convert from alternative fuels (like diesel, furnace oil, or electricity) to packed LPG by demonstrating cost savings and efficiency.

4. Supply Chain & Bottling Plant Coordination

* **Demand Forecasting:** Provide accurate rolling forecasts to bottling plants and supply chain teams to prevent stockouts during peak seasons (e.g., winter or festive months).
* **Logistics Optimization:** Oversee primary and secondary transportation (trucking contracts for packed cylinders) to minimize freight costs per metric ton and ensure timely delivery.

5. Regulatory Compliance & Safety Governance

* **Statutory Adherence:** Ensure 100% compliance with the **Gas Cylinders Rules**, **Liquefied Petroleum Gas (Regulation of Supply and Distribution) Order**, and **PESO (Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation)** guidelines across all distributor godowns and retail points.
* **Safety Audits:** Enforce strict safety protocols regarding cylinder storage, handling, leak testing, and customer safety education to prevent accidents and protect brand reputation.
* **Anti-Diversion Control:** Prevent unauthorized diversion of domestic subsidized/non-subsidized cylinders into commercial markets, ensuring strict KYC and regulatory adherence.

6. Team Leadership & Performance Monitoring

* **Team Management:** Lead, mentor, and set KPIs for Regional Sales Managers (RSMs), Area Sales Managers (ASMs), and field sales executives.
* **Data & MIS Reporting:** Track daily dispatch numbers, collection efficiency (Accounts Receivable / DSO), distributor secondary sales, and competitor activity to report directly to the Managing Director or VP of Operations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Volume & Revenue:** Monthly/Annual sales volume in Metric Tons (MT) and gross margin realization.
* **Cylinder Turnaround Ratio:** Frequency of cylinder rotation per month.
* **Network Growth:** Number of new active dealerships and commercial customer acquisitions.
* **Financial Health:** Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and zero bad-debt write-offs.
* **Safety:** Zero safety incidents or regulatory violations across the distribution network.

title: Professional Services Consultant - India
description:
**We're looking for a**

**Professional Services Consultant - India**
============================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office**

**Professional Services Consultant - HCM ( SaaS ) | Hyderabad | EMEA & AMER Shifts**

The Consultant role exists to help customers turn business priorities into scalable solutions, measurable outcomes, and faster time to value. The role independently drives cross- functional customer and technical workstreams; shapes, delivers across business and technical domains, strengthens solution and delivery decisions; and delivers quality from discovery through transition to support. It requires and applies recognized subject-matter depth in either business and industry consulting or technical and integration delivery, with working breadth across. The role operates on strong consulting methods, reusable assets, approved job level and team capability does not redefine its ownership, autonomy, scope, or complexity.

**Position Overview and enticement**

Delivers on customer business outcomes from the initial discovery through go-live and adoption. Combines sound business consulting with hands-on technical and integration capability, while developing deeper expertise to support long term value realization. Works both independently on standard scenarios and offers and seeks guidance for high-risk or complex scenarios.

**In this role you will…**

Conduct discovery and workshops; document outcomes, processes, requirements, use cases, decisions, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
  
Configure and validate product capabilities; support data, integrations, migration, identity, reporting, testing, cutover, training, and handover activities.
  
Analyze issues across business process and technology boundaries; perform structured troubleshooting and coordinate resolution.
  
Prepare demonstrations, functional and technical documentation, test scenarios, readiness evidence, and customer enablement materials.
  
Maintain delivery artifacts, communicate status and risks, and contribute to estimates, change requests, reusable assets, and lessons learned.
  
Own the end-to-end connection between customer outcomes, business processes, product capabilities, data, integrations, migration, security, testing, adoption, and operational readiness.
  
Maintain working capability across both functional and technical domains. Apply deeper expertise as either a business and industry SME or a technical and integration SME without becoming limited to that specialization.
  
For a business/industry specialization: bring strong market understanding, cross-industry use cases, operating-model insight, process expertise, value framing, adoption, and outcome design beyond product features.
  
For a technical/integration specialization: solve complex architecture, integration, data, migration, identity, performance, security, troubleshooting, and critical delivery scenarios.
  
Translate between executives, business owners, administrators, architects, developers, partners, and delivery teams using clear, outcome-oriented language.
  
Apply business, market, and industry knowledge to understand customer priorities, use cases, processes, constraints, and expected outcomes, and reflect that context in recommendations and delivery decisions.
  
Analyze new information and dynamically adjust discovery, solution recommendations, workstream plans, risk responses, and adoption actions within assigned scope.
  
Deliver across Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Small Business customers by adapting workshop depth, documentation, configuration guidance, technical execution, pace, and enablement to customer scale, maturity, and complexity.
  
Begin with measurable customer outcomes and critical use cases, then define success measures, assumptions, evidence, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
  
Prioritize the minimum viable path to value, challenge avoidable complexity, sequence dependencies, and recommend standardization over unnecessary customization.
  
Track value, adoption, readiness, quality, and delivery indicators throughout the engagement, not only at go-live.
  
Surface risks early, explain trade-offs, drive decisions, and use formal change control where scope or value expectations change.
  
Use approved AI and automation to improve discovery, requirements synthesis, solution analysis, documentation, testing, status insight, issue investigation, and knowledge reuse.
  
Identify practical AI-enabled customer use cases and connect them to business value, operating change, adoption, governance, and measurable outcomes.
  
Validate AI outputs for accuracy, bias, confidentiality, security, intellectual property, and customer context; retain human accountability for decisions.
  
Continuously identify repeatable delivery activities that can be automated or converted into reusable consulting assets.

**You’ve got what it takes if you have…**
  
  
Demonstrated commitment to valuing diversity and contributing to an inclusive working and learning environment
  
Consideration for privacy and security obligations
  
Typically 3+ years in enterprise SaaS, consulting, implementation, business analysis, integration, data, migration, or customer delivery within a product-based company.
  
Experience delivering customer outcomes across multiple industries and adapting to different operating models, maturity levels, and market contexts.
  
Experience combining business and functional consulting with technical delivery across configuration, integrations, data, migration, testing, release readiness, and adoption.
  
Experience with HCM, learning, talent, workforce, HR technology, or adjacent enterprise platforms is preferred.
  
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; relevant product, cloud, integration, data, agile, change, or consulting certifications are advantageous.
  
A proactive, collaborative approach, including keeping the Project Manager informed and escalating risks early.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
  
Experience with HCM, learning, talent, workforce, HR technology, or adjacent enterprise platforms.
  
Relevant product, cloud, integration, data, agile, change, or consulting certifications.
  
AI LLMs along with experience leveraging AI to introduce efficiencies
  
  
**You’ll put your skills into action by…**
  
Using consultative discovery, workshop facilitation, structured problem solving, executive communication, negotiation, and decision support.
  
Applying business process analysis, requirements engineering, value realization, change management, adoption planning, and industry awareness.
  
Working across enterprise SaaS architecture, integrations, APIs, data mapping, migration, identity, security, reporting, testing, cutover, and support transition.
  
Applying commercial awareness across scope, estimates, Statements of Work, assumptions, utilization, margin, change control, and expansion opportunities.
  
Collaborating across Sales, Success, Product, Engineering, Support, Cloud Operations, partners, and customer teams.
  
Using business acumen, market awareness, and industry knowledge to translate context into customer outcomes, solution choices, dynamic plans, risk responses, and value decisions.
  
Adapting your consulting approach across Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Small Business segments based on customer scale, complexity, maturity, pace, and enablement needs.
  
Preparing customer workshops and demonstrations thoroughly, using the customer’s own use cases, data and end-user journeys where possible.
  
Providing alternatives to product limitations and clearly and honestly explaining to customers and internal teams, the practical workarounds or next steps.

  
  

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

Check us out on LinkedIn, Comparably, Glassdoor, and Facebook!

title: Senior Manager Business Development
description:
**Senior Manager Business Development**  
Intelligent Business Solutions | vSplash  
Base Location: Hyderabad  
Role: Sales and Business Development, Individual Contributor  
Experience: 15+ years of experience, combining B2B software solutions sales with a strong understanding of business processes and workflows.

**Why This Role Matters**
=========================

Businesses often have software in place, yet people still spend their day chasing updates, reconciling reports, checking documents and moving work between systems.  
vSplash builds intelligent business operations, operational intelligence and AI systems tailored to each business to solve their operational challenges.  
Your responsibility includes identifying and prospecting the right businesses, understanding their business problems and turning qualified conversations into paying engagements. You will work directly with senior leadership on discovery, demonstrations, proposals and closing. Your first responsibility is to create opportunities through your own prospecting.

**What You Will Do**
====================

* Build opportunities by identifying relevant businesses, mapping decision makers and prospecting them.
* Create conversations through industry associations, events and referral partners. Build relationships with people who already advise or serve our prospective customers.
* Lead initial discovery. Understand the current workflow, recurring problems, business impact, existing systems, buying process, budget and urgency before recommending a solution.
* Coordinate relevant demos and solution discussions with technical leaders. Develop proposals with clear scope, commercials, responsibilities and next steps; own follow-up, negotiation and contract progression.
* Coordinate the handover to delivery, follow through on agreed commercial milestones and identify expansion opportunities after customer value is established.
* Bring market learning back to the team. Explain which problems recur, what buyers value, which alternatives they consider and why opportunities move forward or stall.
* Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain accurate sales forecasts, track key performance metrics (KPIs), and regularly report pipeline progress to executive leadership.

**Who You Are**
===============

You are proactive and have zeal to succeed. You have the knack of getting into conversations without a warm introduction. You listen closely, ask practical questions and earn the attention of senior business leaders. You can work through ambiguity, seek technical help when needed and keep an opportunity moving without overstating what a solution can do.

**Skills and Experience to Have**
=================================

Must have

* A demonstrated record of prospecting for new B2B customers and progressing opportunities through discovery, proposal, negotiation and closure.
* Experience selling technology services, enterprise software, ERP or CRM solutions, business automation, analytics or comparable consultative solutions where requirements vary by customer.
* Ability to discuss operating problems and business value with owners, finance leaders and operations teams, and translate those conversations into a useful brief for technical colleagues.
* Experience understanding and mapping business workflows, identifying operating problems and connecting them to suitable software solutions.
* Strong written and spoken communication, proposal presentation and disciplined follow-up. Explain complex solutions in clear business language.
* Independently manage accounts, meetings and follow-through.

Nice to have

* Experience with distributors or C&F businesses, retail chains, independent hospitals, specialist manufacturers, poultry or seed businesses.
* Familiarity with the Hyderabad and Telangana business environment, industry associations or relevant technology partners. Telugu communication skills would be useful.
* Exposure to dashboards, integrations, document processing or AI-enabled workflows.

**What Good Performance Looks Like**
====================================

You create and own a qualified pipeline and convert opportunities into paying engagements. Your forecasts reflect evidence, and your feedback sharpens customer selection, offers and messaging. Consistently achieve milestones and targets for qualified opportunities, conversions, revenue and commercial follow-through.

**Why Join vSplash**
====================

Build a new business alongside senior leaders. Earn satisfaction of overcoming market dynamics and be part of building something from scratch. You will have working solutions to demonstrate, room to shape the market approach and a visible contribution to customer outcomes.

**Ready to Apply**
==================

Share your resume and two examples of B2B opportunities you originated and helped close. Describe your approach, the customer’s problem, approximate deal value and your contribution. Anonymize confidential details. Show us how you create business and earn trust.  
  
\*\***Only candidates currently residing in Hyderabad may apply.**

description:
**Accounts Executive – Finance & Accounts**

**Location:** Vittal Rao Nagar, Madhapur, Hyderabad, Telangana

**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Shift Timing:** 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM  
**Benefits:** Provident Fund (PF) and Employee State Insurance (ESI)

**Job Description:**

We are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented Accounts Executive to manage day-to-day accounting and finance operations.

The candidate should have practical experience in Tally Prime, general accounting, GST, TDS, invoicing, bank reconciliation, accounts payable and accounts receivable.

The ideal candidate should be capable of maintaining accurate financial records, handling accounting transactions, coordinating with vendors and customers, and supporting monthly financial reporting and statutory compliance activities.

Key Responsibilities

**1. General Accounting & Bookkeeping:**

* Handle day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities.
* Maintain books of accounts, including sales, purchases, receipts, payments and journal entries.
* Record financial transactions accurately in Tally Prime.
* Prepare payment vouchers, receipt vouchers, journal entries and contra entries.
* Maintain cash books, bank books and general ledgers.
* Verify bills, invoices and expense documents before recording transactions.

**2. Accounts Payable & Vendor Management:**

* Verify vendor invoices, purchase bills and supporting documents.
* Process vendor payments after necessary approvals.
* Maintain vendor ledgers and outstanding payment records.
* Perform vendor statement reconciliation.
* Monitor pending payments and follow up with vendors.
* Handle debit notes, credit notes and invoice discrepancies.

**3. Accounts Receivable & Customer Billing:**

* Prepare and generate sales invoices and GST invoices.
* Record customer receipts and payment transactions.
* Maintain customer ledgers and outstanding balances.
* Follow up with customers for pending payments.
* Prepare outstanding and collection reports.
* Handle billing discrepancies and customer account reconciliation.

**4. GST, TDS & Statutory Compliance:**

* Handle routine GST-related accounting activities.
* Verify GST details in purchase and sales invoices.
* Assist in preparing GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B returns.
* Perform GST input tax credit reconciliation with GSTR-2B.
* Calculate applicable TDS deductions and maintain records.
* Assist with TDS payments and quarterly return preparation.
* Maintain GST and TDS documentation.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants and auditors for compliance-related activities.
* Assist with e-invoices and e-way bills wherever applicable.

**5. Bank Reconciliation & Cash Management:**

* Prepare Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS).
* Reconcile bank statements with accounting records.
* Maintain cash books and petty cash records.
* Verify bank receipts, payments and expense transactions.
* Identify and resolve accounting and bank reconciliation differences.

**6. Financial Reporting & MIS:**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly accounts reports.
* Prepare accounts payable and receivable ageing reports.
* Maintain sales, purchase and expense summaries.
* Assist in monthly and year-end account closing.
* Prepare Excel-based financial reports and MIS.
* Assist management with financial data and accounting summaries.

**7. Audit & Documentation:**

* Maintain proper records of invoices, bills, vouchers and financial documents.
* Support internal and external audit activities.
* Coordinate with banks, vendors, customers and internal departments.
* Maintain confidentiality of financial information.
* Follow company accounting procedures and internal financial controls.

**Mandatory Qualifications & Skills:**

* B.Com / M.Com / BBA (Finance) or equivalent qualification in Commerce or Accounting.
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in Accounts & Finance.
* Hands-on knowledge of Tally Prime is mandatory.
* Good understanding of accounting principles and bookkeeping.
* Working knowledge of GST and TDS.
* Practical understanding of Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
* Knowledge of Bank Reconciliation Statements.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel.
* Good numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

**Required Technical Skills:**

* Tally Prime / Tally ERP.
* MS Excel and MS Office.
* GST and TDS accounting.
* Bank and ledger reconciliation.
* Purchase and sales accounting.
* Vendor and customer account management.
* Invoice processing and billing.
* Financial reporting and MIS preparation.

Knowledge of Zoho Books, SAP or other ERP/accounting software will be an added advantage.

* Monthly CTC equivalent: ₹15,000 – ₹25,000.

* Employee State Insurance (ESI), subject to applicable eligibility.

title: Cataloging and Inventory Executive (Data management or Warehouse operations)
description:
Cataloging and Inventory Executive

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 3-5 years

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organised Cataloging and Inventory Executive to manage our cataloging and inventory operations. Our business involves thousands of unique designs, intricate materials and big seasonal volume spikes, so this role needs exceptional attention to detail. You will handle SKU creation from start to finish, maintain digital and physical catalogues, and make sure physical warehouse stock always matches system records. If you love data, are strong in Excel and ERP systems, have basic product photography skills and enjoy a fast-paced manufacturing environment, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Cataloging and Master Data Management

* Product photography and asset management: Take clear, high-quality photos of new products and designs, and organise these assets across the ERP, PDF brochures and internal drives

* Catalogue management: Own the creation and upkeep of digital and physical catalogues, keeping them accurate, current and ready for B2B buyers and internal sales teams

* SKU creation: Create and manage accurate SKU codes, product names, descriptions and packaging hierarchies for thousands of new and existing designs

* ERP updates: Maintain flawless master data in the ERP (Tally, SAP or custom software), keeping pricing, barcodes, images and product attributes in sync

Inventory and Stock Management

* Stock tracking: Monitor daily inwarding of finished goods from the factory and outwarding of dispatches to ensure zero leakage

* Reconciliation: Conduct regular physical stock audits and reconcile them with system records, investigating and resolving discrepancies immediately

* Packaging and raw material tracking: Monitor boxes, labels and primary packaging so dispatch is never delayed by stock-outs

* Seasonal load management: Organise warehouse binning and storage so high-demand items are easy to reach during peak dispatch months

Cross-Functional Coordination

* Production alignment: Work with the Factory/Production team to track manufacturing schedules and warehouse arrival times

* Dispatch and sales support: Coordinate with Sales and Dispatch so the right SKUs are picked, packed and billed exactly as per client orders

What We're Looking For

* 3-5 years of experience in inventory management, cataloging, master data management or warehouse operations

* Proven experience in industries with very large SKU counts (such as apparel, jewelry, footwear or seasonal gifting)

* Exceptional skills in Advanced Excel/Google Sheets (VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, pivot tables and conditional formatting are mandatory)

* Strong hands-on experience with ERP systems (Tally ERP 9 / Prime or similar inventory modules) and barcoding systems

* Basic photography and PDF creation skills

* Fluent Hindi and English, to communicate clearly with both corporate teams and warehouse staff

* High analytical ability, so you spot stock mismatches or catalogue errors before they become business problems.

Pay: Up to ₹38,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have expertise in cataloging and inventory management?
* Have you worked with amazon, blinkit or flipkart?
* Are you currently living in Kolkata?
* What was the maximum/highest SKU that you maintained?
