**Company:** Solar4Ever Private Limited  
**Job Location:** Howrah Maidan, West Bengal  
**Department:** Operations & Administration  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 1–3 years  
**Qualification:** Graduate in any discipline  
**Salary:** As per experience and industry standards

1. About the Company

Solar4Ever Private Limited is a growing Solar EPC and Distribution company focused on delivering sustainable, affordable and innovative solar energy solutions across residential, commercial, industrial, government and railway sectors.

We are looking for a proactive, responsible and detail-oriented Back Office Executive to manage customer documentation, government portal applications, order processing, operational coordination and administrative activities to ensure seamless business operations.

2. Key Roles & ResponsibilitiesCustomer Documentation & Data Management

* Collect, verify and maintain all required customer documents.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of customer application forms.
* Maintain customer records, agreements, quotations and order confirmations.
* Maintain organized digital and physical documentation.
* Ensure confidentiality and secure handling of customer information.
* Coordinate with CRM and sales teams to obtain pending documents.

PM Surya Ghar Portal & DISCOM Coordination

* Manage customer applications under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana.
* Process customer registrations and vendor-related activities on the National Portal.
* Coordinate technical feasibility applications and track approval status.
* Process net-metering applications through WBSEDCL and other applicable DISCOM portals.
* Upload required documents, installation photographs and technical information.
* Coordinate inspection, commissioning and net-meter installation formalities.
* Track subsidy applications and disbursement status.
* Coordinate with DISCOM officials for pending approvals and application-related issues.
* Maintain an application-wise tracker covering the entire process from registration to subsidy disbursement.
* Stay updated on government guidelines, documentation requirements and portal changes.

Order Processing & Management

* Process confirmed customer bookings and sales orders.
* Verify order details, system capacity, commercial terms and payment status.
* Prepare customer agreements, work orders and related documentation using approved templates.
* Coordinate with accounts for invoice generation and payment confirmation.
* Maintain updated records of confirmed, pending and completed orders.
* Monitor order execution timelines and escalate operational delays.
* Ensure accurate order closure and project documentation.

Customer Financing & Loan Documentation

* Assist customers and CRM teams with solar loan application documentation.
* Coordinate with banking partners, including SBI and other financial institutions.
* Track loan applications, pending documents, approvals and disbursements.
* Maintain customer financing records.
* Coordinate with accounts and banking partners to resolve documentation-related issues.

Installation & Operations Coordination

* Coordinate with engineering, warehouse, logistics and installation teams.
* Maintain daily and weekly installation schedules.
* Track material requirements, dispatch status and delivery confirmations.
* Coordinate site readiness with concerned departments.
* Collect installation photographs, serial numbers, commissioning reports and completion certificates.
* Maintain warranty documentation for solar panels, inverters and other equipment.
* Ensure all required documentation is completed for project handover.
* Maintain a centralized tracker of ongoing and completed projects.

Tata Power Channel Partner Operations

* Support operational activities associated with Tata Power Channel Partnership, upon appointment.
* Manage relevant partner portal entries and documentation.
* Maintain purchase orders, product serial numbers, delivery records and warranty information.
* Coordinate with Tata Power representatives for operational and documentation-related requirements.
* Assist with warranty registration, service requests and product replacement documentation.
* Prepare reports and supporting documents required under channel partnership guidelines.

Dealer, Franchise & Branch Support

* Maintain dealer, retailer and franchise partner records.
* Coordinate partner registration and onboarding documentation.
* Maintain agreements and commercial documentation.
* Support branch offices with customer application processing and administrative activities.
* Monitor pending applications and operational activities across branches.
* Ensure standardized documentation and operational processes across the organization.

Office Administration

* Manage day-to-day office administrative activities.
* Maintain employee attendance, leave records and administrative documentation.
* Assist HR with employee onboarding and personnel records.
* Coordinate office stationery, consumables and administrative requirements.
* Maintain incoming and outgoing correspondence.
* Coordinate meetings, appointments and internal communications.
* Support management in preparing official letters, presentations and reports.

Government, Industrial & Railway Project Support

* Assist in preparing tender-related documentation.
* Support GeM portal registration and tender submission activities.
* Maintain company credentials, statutory certificates and eligibility documents.
* Track tender submission deadlines, EMDs, security deposits and Bank Guarantees.
* Coordinate documentation for industrial, institutional and railway projects.
* Maintain project-wise administrative records.

MIS & Reporting

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly operational MIS reports.
* Maintain booking, documentation, installation and subsidy trackers.
* Monitor pending applications, approvals and operational bottlenecks.
* Prepare branch-wise and dealer-wise operational reports.
* Ensure accurate and timely updates in the company's CRM and business management systems.
* Highlight critical pending activities and escalate delays to management.

3. Required Qualifications & Skills

* Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university.
* 1–3 years of experience in back-office operations, administration or operational coordination.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Strong computer skills and ability to work with multiple online portals.
* Good knowledge of email communication and professional correspondence.
* Strong documentation, data entry and record-management skills.
* Good analytical, organizational and problem-solving abilities.
* Communication skills in Bengali, Hindi and English.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* High level of accuracy, accountability and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate with multiple departments.
* Willingness to learn new software, government portals and operational processes.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile

* Prior experience in Solar, Renewable Energy, EPC, Electrical, Banking or Distribution industries.
* Experience in PM Surya Ghar, WBSEDCL or other government portal operations.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms, particularly SolarNeo or similar software.
* Knowledge of advanced Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.
* Experience in customer loan processing and documentation.
* Knowledge of GeM portal and government tender documentation.
* Experience in multi-branch operational support.
* Candidates residing in Howrah, Kolkata or nearby areas will be preferred.
* Immediate joiners will be preferred.
* Fresh graduates with excellent computer skills and a strong willingness to learn may also be considered.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy and completeness of customer documentation.
* Timely submission of government portal applications.
* Order processing turnaround time.
* Accuracy of CRM and operational data.
* Timely processing of net-metering and subsidy documentation.
* Reduction in application rejections due to documentation errors.
* Timely completion of project documentation.
* Effective monitoring and escalation of pending approvals.
* Timely submission of operational MIS reports.
* Adherence to company SOPs and administrative processes.

6. What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
* Professional and collaborative working environment.
* Opportunity to work in the rapidly growing renewable energy sector.
* Training on solar business operations, government portals and industry-specific software.
* Exposure to residential, industrial, government and railway solar projects.
* Long-term career growth opportunities within an expanding organization.

7. How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resume with the subject line **"Application for Back Office Executive"**.

title: Operations Executive (O2C and B2B order fulfillment Mandatory)
description:
Sales Operations Executive (B2B Order Fulfillment)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 4-6 years

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Operations Executive to take complete ownership of the Order-to-Cash (O2C) cycle for our corporate accounts. You will be the primary point of contact for our B2B clients and make sure their orders are processed, tracked and fulfilled smoothly, from placement to final delivery and payment collection. We want someone with strong commercial understanding and excellent coordination skills.

What You'll Do

* Order management: Manage the full order lifecycle for corporate customers, with accurate and on-time fulfillment

* Commercial documentation: Generate and manage Sales Orders, Proforma Invoices, Tax Invoices, Debit/Credit Notes and E-Way Bills

* Coordination: Act as the central link between Sales, Accounts, Factory and Warehouse teams for smooth production and dispatch

* Dispatch support: Visit and coordinate with the Factory and Warehouse when needed to clear bottlenecks and speed up fulfillment

* Client servicing: Manage day-to-day relationships with existing B2B clients, resolve queries and grievances, and track post-sales delivery

* Receivables: Track customer payments, coordinate with Accounts on reconciliation and ensure timely collections

* Process improvement: Use data, Excel/Google Sheets and AI tools to improve reporting, order tracking and efficiency

What We're Looking For

* 4-6 years of experience in Sales Operations, Order Management, Commercial Operations or B2B Client Servicing

* Proven experience handling end-to-end order fulfillment for corporate/B2B customers (preferably in manufacturing, trading or physical goods)

* Strong practical knowledge of commercial transactions, invoicing, E-Way Bills and receivables

* Fluent English and Hindi, with excellent communication skills for corporate clients

* Strong working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets, and comfort with modern tech and AI tools

* High ownership, strong problem-solving skills and the persistence to follow up with factories and warehouses

Pay: Up to ₹38,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Tele Caller Executive
description:
Job Title: Telecaller – Skin & Aesthetic Clinic

Company: Dermacheck Skin Clinic

Location: Angamaly, Kerala

Job Type: Full-time

Salary: ₹14000 – ₹17000 per month (based on experience) + visit-based incentives

About Us

Dermacheck is a dermatologist-led skin, hair and aesthetic clinic. We are looking for a confident, friendly telecaller to join our Angamaly team and help patients book consultations and treatments.

What You Will Do

- Make a minimum of 150 calls per day

- Call new enquiries from Google, Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp within minutes of receiving them

- Explain our treatments simply and book consultation appointments

- Follow up with enquiries who haven't booked yet, as per the daily follow-up schedule

- Send appointment reminders and make sure booked patients visit

- Call back existing patients for their next sessions and reviews

title: AVP Premier Relationship Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Description**
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra-high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the
**Premier Banking**
team.
  
  
As a Premier Relationship Manager or Senior Premier Relationship Manager at HSBC, you will be at the forefront of our flagship "Premier Banking" offering, serving as a vital link to our high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients. Your primary responsibility is to cultivate and expand HSBC Premier relationships, aligning with business targets and strategic plans. You will act as a single point of contact for Premier customers, anticipating their needs and delivering comprehensive banking and financial advisory services. Your role involves ensuring exceptional customer service in accordance with Global Premier Service Standards, identifying opportunities for wealth reviews, and providing tailored wealth solutions. Success in this role requires maintaining the highest standards of integrity, adhering to regulatory requirements, and fostering trust with both the bank and our clients.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
**Business Impact:**

* Maximize profit and growth of Premier client portfolios by developing new and existing relationships.
* Achieve financial targets through effective client engagement and service delivery.
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services. Cross sell products.

**Client Management**

* Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure retention and satisfaction. Need based selling.
* Utilize client relationship management tools to keep client information accurate and up to date.
* Develop strategies to increase wallet share and manage a prospect pipeline effectively.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work as part of an integrated branch management team to meet standards and deliver operating models.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the business to support client needs and achieve performance measures.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure compliance with HSBC's policies, including KYC, AML, and sanctions guidelines.
* Manage operational risk and adhere to sales quality requirements.
* Attend mandatory training and report any unusual activities promptly.

**Leadership & Development**

* Support team members and contribute to a positive work environment.
* Establish a network of internal relationships and gather feedback from colleagues and clients.

**Knowledge & Experience**

* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* For GCB 6: 3 to 5 years of Retail/Premier Banking segment as Relationship Manager
* For GCB 5: More than 5 years of Retail/Premier Banking segment as Relationship Manager.
* Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Sales Achievements: Demonstrated success & experience in Wealth products.
* Client Relationship Management: Proven experience managing relationships with high-net-worth clients.
* Wealth Management Expertise: Strong technical skills in wealth management.
* Communication & Influence: Excellent communication skills with a focus on client engagement and influence.
* Sales & Networking Skills: Strong orientation towards sales, networking, and portfolio management.
* Product Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of financial services products, services, and client relationship management systems.
* Business Banking Insight: Familiarity with business banking client segments and related products and services.
* Regulatory Compliance: Possession of valid licenses and accreditations in wealth management as required by local regulations.
* Risk Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with Compliance, Credit & Risk, and Internal Control teams to maintain a balanced risk environment.
* Language Proficiency: Proficient in English and local languages.

**Accreditations**

* Professional Qualifications: Obtain necessary professional and regulatory certifications such as AMFI, IRDA, NISM XXI A (PMS Certification), and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) as per market requirements.

**Additional Notes**

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable .
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India.

description:
**About us**  
Gentric AI is an AI operations studio with teams in the US and India. We design, build and run AI systems for businesses, and we grow consumer brands of our own in the US market.

**The role**  
We are looking for a hands-on growth marketer to own customer acquisition for our US consumer brands end to end, across search, paid, content, social and lifecycle. Over time, you will also lead marketing for Gentric AI itself. You will report to the founders and be measured on customers acquired, conversion and cost per acquisition, not followers or impressions.

**What you'll own**

* Growth strategy and a steady programme of experiments across channels
* SEO and AEO: technical, on-page, local and AI-search visibility
* Paid acquisition on Google and Meta, from first test to scale
* Landing pages and conversion rate optimisation
* Content and short-form video, produced with AI tools
* Email and lifecycle journeys that drive repeat purchase
* Tracking, attribution and a weekly performance report

* Tracking and reporting set up and trusted

* Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Ads and an SEO tool such as Ahrefs or Semrush

title: HR, Manager - India
description:
**About Handshake**
Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.
  
  
In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from 0to~1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.
  
  
**Why Join Handshake Now**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue.

**About Handshake AI**
Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.
  
  
We are building our India team to help accelerate the development of frontier models. This team is a critical, strategic investment for us - we have grown the team 3x in the past six months to help fuel our next phase of growth. India-based teammates will work hand-in-hand with US-based teams to scope, execute, and deliver critical human data projects to Frontier Labs and other customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
Handshake AI's Bangalore team is growing fast, and we need an HR Manager who can be the reliable first point of contact for our India-based employees - someone equally comfortable answering a benefits question, keeping us compliant with local labor law, and flexing up to help resolve a sensitive employee relations issue or support light workforce planning. This is a hands-on role with real range: mostly foundational HR work, done well, with room to stretch into higher-judgment partnering as you build.
  
  

* Own front-line employee relations and HR compliance for our Bangalore team, resolving day-to-day policy, leave, and benefits questions accurately and on the same day
* Independently triage and resolve routine employee complaints and workplace concerns, escalating complex cases to HRBP leadership with clear context and a recommended path
* Maintain HR policies, documentation, and statutory compliance (POSH, PF, ESI, Shops & Establishments Act, gratuity, etc.) that keep Handshake AI audit-ready as the India team scales
* Partner closely with recruiting on onboarding, offer logistics, and new-hire compliance, and collaborate cross-functionally with our US-based People team on shared processes and projects
* Support light workforce and team planning - tracking headcount, leave, and org changes - so managers and HRBPs have accurate, up-to-date data to plan against
* Manage the complete employee lifecycle, from onboarding through offboarding, ensuring smooth transitions, compliance, and a positive employee experience at every stage.

**You Have**

* 4-6 years of experience in an HR Manager, HR Generalist, or Associate HRBP role, ideally at a fast-growing tech or startup company
* Working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory compliance requirements (POSH, PF, ESI, Shops & Establishments Act, gratuity)
* A track record of resolving employee questions and routine ER issues independently, with good judgment on what to escalate and when
* Strong stakeholder management and partnership skills - comfortable building trust with employees, managers, recruiting, and a US-based People team
* Comfort handling sensitive employee situations with discretion, empathy, and professionalism
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate policy into plain, practical language
* Experience with HRIS, payroll/EOR, or ticketing tools (e.g., Deel, Workday, Freshservice) to manage employee inquiries at scale
* High attention to detail and comfort operating with some ambiguity in a fast-moving environment
* Genuine excitement about Handshake's mission and the AI economy.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience working cross-functionally with a US-based team, including comfort with some overlap hours
* Exposure to contractor, gig, or data-annotation workforce models
* Familiarity partnering with Employers of Record (EOR) like Deel or Rippling
* Prior experience flexing between generalist HR execution and higher-judgment HRBP-style partnering.

**Perks**

* Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years
* Housing Bonus: 1.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year
* Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 - 100% of base
* Medical Insurance Coverage
* Food credit for every in person day.

title: Compliance Analyst-TM
description:
**Your role**
Background
  
  
The Compliance Analyst, FIU position serves as an essential role in safeguarding the integrity of the organization's operations and maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements. This pivotal role requires a unique blend of aml expertise, investigative experience, analytical skills, and strategic thinking to effectively manage compliance risks in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  
  
Role Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage the FIU’s centralized intake channels, including shared mailboxes and referral queues for fraud notifications, law enforcement matters, internal referrals, business concerns, and other financial crime-related escalations.
* Review, categorize, prioritize, and assign incoming matters based on risk, urgency, subject matter, jurisdiction, and established FIU procedures.
* Monitor investigative assignments, case aging, and service-level agreements, following up with case owners and escalating overdue, high-risk, or time-sensitive matters when necessary.
* Serve as the primary coordination point between the FIU, business units, Fraud, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and other relevant stakeholders to obtain information and facilitate timely resolution of referrals.
* Maintain complete and accurate intake records, case trackers, assignment logs, supporting documentation, and audit trails while protecting confidential and sensitive information.
* Oversee various operational queues ensuring consistent adherence to internal SLAs.
* Develop and enhance FIU standard operating procedures, desktop procedures, escalation protocols, templates, and workflows, and recommend improvements to policies, systems, controls, and program practices.
* Maintain current knowledge of relevant financial crime risks, fraud trends, regulatory expectations, internal policies, and industry practices.
* Perform additional FIU, Compliance, or financial crime-related projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**Requirements**
**What you'll be doing**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Law, Criminal Justice, Compliance, or a related field; relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Three or more years of experience in financial crime compliance, fraud operations, AML investigations, case management, regulatory compliance, or a related role within financial services or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of anti-money laundering, counter-terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions, suspicious activity reporting, and other financial crime risks, including familiarity with FATF standards and applicable national or regional regulatory requirements.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating high-volume workflows, shared mailboxes, case queues, referral processes, or other time-sensitive operational activities involving multiple stakeholders.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills, with the ability to assess risk, prioritize competing demands, identify urgent matters, and escalate concerns appropriately.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across different business functions, seniority levels, jurisdictions, and cultural environments.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and relevant case-management, transaction-monitoring, fraud-monitoring, or compliance systems. Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or an equivalent regional qualification are preferred but not required.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Administrative — Knowledge of administrative and clerical procedures and systems such as word processing, managing files and records in a database, and other office procedures and terminology.
* Technology— Ability to learn Corpay’s systems and software. Use of proprietary database products, CRM software (Salesforce), Sanctions Screening software (LexisNexis), Transaction Monitoring software (NetReveal), etc.
* Idea Fluency and Originality/ Problem Solving - Exceptional problem-solving skills, with ability to identify and drive win-win solutions. The ability to come up with a number of ideas about a topic. The ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions. The ability to come up with unusual or clever ideas about a given topic or situation, or to develop creative ways to solve a problem. Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions. Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to problems.
* English Language — Knowledge of the structure and content of the English language including the meaning and spelling of words, rules of composition, and grammar. Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience. Talking to others to convey information effectively. Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work related documents. Professional-level written and verbal communication skills and exceptional relationship building skills. Exceptional written and oral expression and comprehension, including excellent presentation skills with an ability to partner with senior business leaders to understand needs and deliver solutions.
* Active Listening and Speaking— giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times. Talking to others to convey information and procedures effectively.
* Service Orientation and Social Perceptiveness— actively looking for ways to help people while being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.
* Active Learning — Understanding the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.
* Time and Task Management — Managing one's own time and the time of others.
* People and Inclusion — Always striving to drive our business forward by positive and direct communication, collaboration, respect, acceptance and professionalism. Understanding how to give and receive feedback, manage conflict positively and work productively with others to solve problems.

title: Customer Success Manager, Networks
description:
Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.
  
  
NetBrain is looking for a Customer Success Engineer (CSE) based in India to own the full lifecycle of our customer relationships, from onboarding through adoption, expansion, and renewal. At NetBrain, CSEs are strategic partners to our customers, operators of complex enterprise networks spanning thousands of devices. You'll help them unlock the full value of NetBrain's Agentic NetOps platform. You'll do this by building deep relationships, driving measurable outcomes, and ensuring every customer renews and grows, backed by your own hands-on networking and technical background, so you can speak credibly to both the business outcome and the technical reality of the customer's network.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* This is a full-ownership role. You are the primary post-sale contact for a portfolio of enterprise accounts.
* Run monthly check-ins, semi-annual QBRs, and annual Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) for strategic accounts, presenting technical use cases and adoption progress alongside business outcomes.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for your customers and the voice of the customer internally, including first-line technical triage before looping in Support or R&D.
* You own every renewal in your portfolio, from 12-month strategic planning through executed contract signature.
* GRR ≥ 90% and NRR ≥ 105% are your metrics. You run the process; Sales supports you.
* Define customer-specific success metrics at contract start and track them throughout the lifecycle.
* Monitor product health via adoption dashboards; address low-utilization signals proactively, using your own technical background to diagnose the root cause, not just flag the number.
* Deliver data-driven QBR materials that demonstrate ROI against stated business outcomes.
* Open and manage renewal opportunities in Salesforce 12 months before contract end.
* Lead the end-to-end renewal timeline: health assessment (9month), executive alignment (6month), proposal (4month), negotiation and legal coordination (2month), close (30 days out).
* Escalate at-risk accounts (churn probability > 50%) to VP CS within 24 hours with a joint recovery plan.
* Identify and qualify upsell opportunities across NetBrain modules, user seats, and new use cases, often surfaced through your own hands-on technical work inside the customer's network.

**Who You Are**

* 5+ years in a technical, customer-facing role within enterprise networking or infrastructure software e.g., Technical Account Manager, Network/Support Engineer (L2/L3), Solutions/Sales Engineer, NOC Engineer, or Post-Sales/Delivery Engineer. A generalist Customer Success or Account Management background without hands-on technical depth is not a fit for this role.
* Strong, hands-on understanding of enterprise networking, routing/switching fundamentals, troubleshooting methodology, and network diagnostics, gained through real operational or customer-facing experience (ISP, Cloud provider, MSP, or a complex enterprise network environment).
* Demonstrated ownership of renewal cycles, including negotiation and ARR accountability, or a clear, credible path to it from an adjacent technical account-ownership role.
* Experience managing a portfolio of complex enterprise accounts.
* Strong executive presence, comfortable presenting QBRs and EBRs to VP/C-level stakeholders, and equally comfortable going deep with network engineers on the technical detail.
* Working experience with Salesforce CRM, Gainsight or any other customer success platform for pipeline management, activity logging, and forecasting.
* Ability to interpret product usage and adoption data, and the underlying technical/network signals behind it, and translate both into customer-facing narratives.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; strong follow-through and organisational habits.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with Gainsight or a comparable Customer Success platform.
* Background in building multi-threaded relationships across technical and business stakeholders simultaneously.
* Track record of GRR ≥ 90% and NRR ≥ 105% over multiple fiscal years.
* Exposure to SaaS environments or to automation-driven/observability platforms.
* Willingness to travel within your territory as required.

**Nice to Have**

* Networking certifications (CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, or equivalent) — a plus.
* Experience with CRM or Customer Success platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, or HubSpot.
* Exposure to SaaS, automation-driven, or observability platforms.

You will bring extensive knowledge of the Qualys platform and of integration technologies, and use it to show customers how connectors bring cloud, endpoint, identity, application security, ITSM and CMDB data into the Qualys Risk Operations Center (ROC), and how that risk data flows back to the tools they already run. Your guidance supports strategic and operational business requirements across asset and vulnerability management, remediation and threat intelligence on the Qualys Enterprise TruRisk Platform.

This is a highly visible role and an excellent opportunity for career advancement and significant impact. It requires close collaboration with customers, sales and product management. In the post-sales segment, you will support Account Managers with in-depth platform expertise, strengthening customer relationships and fostering upsell opportunities. A core part of the role is working extensively with customers on ETM proofs of concept (POCs) and implementations, bringing data in from their external tools into Qualys ETM and showing how Qualys fits into their existing security and IT stack. In pre-sales, you will also run demos that show the value of these integrations. Your command of Qualys solutions and integration technologies will let you propose tailored solutions that drive renewals and wider use of the platform.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Integration expertise**

* Deep understanding of integration: APIs, authentication protocols and integration security best practices
* Hands-on experience using APIs
* Knowledge of data normalization, transformation and sync mechanisms in connector development
* Experience with integration platforms (for example MuleSoft, Boomi, Jitterbit or custom integration frameworks)

**Connector domains (working knowledge of several)**

* Cloud security: CSPM connectors for AWS, Azure, GCP and OCI, and cloud security platforms such as Wiz and Prisma Cloud
* Endpoint, EDR and identity: CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Microsoft Entra ID and Okta
* AppSec, DAST and CI/CD: Snyk, Checkmarx, Veracode, Burp Suite, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins and Azure DevOps
* ITSM, CMDB, SIEM and SOAR: ServiceNow, Jira, BMC Helix and Splunk

**Customer engagement and communication**

* Direct customer engagement experience, including technical workshops, demos and solution/architecture discussions
* Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills; a strong communicator in writing, speech and presentations
* Background in solution engineering, product development, business analysis, integration architecture or implementation consulting

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

A core part of this role is working extensively with customers on Qualys ETM proofs of concept (POCs) and implementations, bringing data in from external tools into Qualys ETM through connectors.

**ETM POCs and implementations (core focus)**

* Work extensively with customers throughout ETM POCs and implementations to bring data in from their external tools into Qualys ETM
* Scope each POC or implementation with the customer: which external tools to onboard (cloud, endpoint and EDR, identity, application/mobile security and CI/CD, ITSM, CMDB, SIEM), what data to bring in, success criteria and timelines
* Guide customers hands-on through connector setup, including authentication, API access, permissions and integration security
* Validate that data maps, normalizes and syncs correctly, so that asset, vulnerability and risk findings from external tools appear accurately in ETM and the Risk Operations Center and feed the TruRisk view
* Troubleshoot connector and data issues directly with customers, working with Support and Engineering to resolve them
* Carry customers from POC to production implementation, handing over to TAMs for ongoing adoption and expansion

**Pre-sales, demos and POCs**

* Deliver hands-on demos of ETM connectors and integrations to customers, prospects and the sales team
* Define POC success criteria with sellers and customers, and present POC results to customer stakeholders and decision makers
* Work with field sellers on proposals, and on RFP/RFI technical responses, that demonstrate the differentiated value of the Qualys platform

**Product feedback and enablement**

* Interface with product management to help prioritize the most impactful customer feature requests and to share ideas for new integrations
* Develop and deliver internal sales and support training on key solution uses
* Acquire in-depth knowledge of each Qualys app's functions and operational use cases
* Maintain visibility of the latest developments in the Qualys portfolio and in the wider security and compliance ecosystem

**This is a technical, hands-on individual contributor role.** This role is based in our Pune (Maharashtra) office and requires you to work from the office at least three days a week. The role may involve occasional travel to customer locations as needed.

title: Independence Compliance Manager

The Office of Risk Management (“O.R.M”) supports the implementation of programs, policies, and practices to manage RSM US (or “Firm”) risk. Visit

As a Compliance Testing and Monitoring Specialist, you will join the Core Monitoring and Testing team within Risk and Compliance. You will help us assess whether key controls are working as intended, identify potential compliance risks, and support timely escalation and remediation.
  
  
Our Testing and Monitoring team provides independent, risk-based assurance over key processes, systems, and controls. We work closely with colleagues across the business, operations, technology, and Compliance to understand risks, assess controls, and make practical improvements.
  
  
***What Will You Do?***

* Carry out compliance surveillance and monitoring across trading, investment activity, and business conduct.
* Perform risk-based testing of trade execution, allocations, conflicts of interest, and related controls.
* Review exceptions, supporting evidence, and relevant market or transaction data; investigate potential control gaps and raise issues promptly when needed.
* Help monitor regulatory obligations, employee conduct requirements, communications, and the handling of confidential information.
* Keep complete, accurate, and review-ready testing workpapers, findings, and management information.
* Work closely with front-office, operations, technology, and Compliance colleagues to clarify issues and support remediation.
* Contribute ideas and practical support to the design, improvement, validation, and oversight of data-led and automated monitoring processes.
* Spot trends, emerging risks, and opportunities to strengthen the control environment.
* Support periodic compliance reviews and follow up on agreed actions.

***What Will You Bring?***

* Experience in compliance monitoring, surveillance, internal audit, risk, or financial-services controls.
* Understanding of financial markets, investment products, and trade lifecycle processes.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to review large data sets and identify exceptions or unusual patterns.
* Confidence to exercise sound judgment, investigate issues, and communicate findings clearly.
* Strong Excel and data-analysis capability; experience with automation or technology-enabled controls is desirable.
* A strong sense of integrity, respect for confidentiality, and excellent organization and attention to detail.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* CA, CMA, CA Inter, or a relevant bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in compliance monitoring, investment compliance, trade surveillance, internal audit, risk, or financial-services operations.
* Comfort working independently under general supervision, with initiative and sound judgment.
* A collaborative approach and the ability to build strong working relationships across the business.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear, accurate, and review-ready documentation.

***How Will You Work?***

* Curiosity, analytical thinking, and a thoughtful approach to investigation.
* Sound judgment and professional skepticism.
* Care, accuracy, and attention to detail.
* Clear, respectful stakeholder management.
* The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a global team.
* A practical, continuous-improvement mindset.

title: Manager: Export Operations
description:
**ABOUT US**

Rising Tide has exported shrimp since 2014 and is India's largest exporter of tilapia by volume. We ship frozen seafood to buyers worldwide and are scaling quickly, through organic growth and acquisitions.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

You will own every export order from the day it is confirmed to the day the cash is in our account. You will track four areas: production, gross margin, shipping and receivables, and catch deviations early, before they hurt this month's numbers, next quarter's plan or our customer relationships.

**Reports to**: Director / CEO

**Key Responsibilities**

**Order to Production**

* Allocate confirmed orders to the right processing facility based on capacity, species, specification and deadline

* Track daily production against plan, from raw material intake through processing, grading, packing and freezing

* Flag slippage against dispatch deadlines early and drive recovery plans with plant heads

* Run a daily order-status dashboard for management

**Gross Margin Control**

* Track gross margin for every order, covering raw material, yield, processing, packing, freight and other costs

* Compare actual costs against budget order by order and explain every variance (yield loss, raw material price, rework, freight)

* Produce a monthly margin report by customer, product and market, with recommendations

* Give the sales team cost inputs for pricing new orders

**Shipping and Logistics**

* Keep transit times and shipping TAT within agreed standards and the approved freight cost structure

* Manage shipping lines, freight forwarders, CHAs and reefer container availability, including space booking ahead of peak periods

* Monitor every shipment from stuffing to arrival and warn customers early about delays

* Benchmark freight rates regularly and negotiate contracts that balance cost with reliability

* Assess how shipping delays and cost overruns affect next month's and next quarter's plans

**Receivables and Cargo Protection**

* Track receivables against payment terms (LC, CAD, DP, advance) for every shipment and follow up with buyers well before due dates

* Set up and maintain a network of cold stores at key destination ports

* When a buyer delays payment or tries to renegotiate price at delivery, move cargo quickly into cold storage to avoid demurrage and detention and protect our negotiating position

* Maintain a watch-list of buyers by payment behaviour and feed it into credit terms and order acceptance

**HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS**

* Orders dispatched on time

* Gross margin vs budget

* Shipments within TAT and freight cost vs budget

* DSO, overdue receivables and bad debt

* Detention and demurrage charges (target: zero)

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* 5+ years in seafood/ frozen food exports, with exposure to production planning, export logistics and trade finance

* Working knowledge of reefer logistics, Incoterms, export documentation, LCs and foreign exchange realisation

* Strong command of numbers: you can build costings and margin reports in Excel (ERP experience is a plus)

* The confidence to stay firm and diplomatic with buyers under pressure

* Graduate degree required; MBA or a qualification in international trade or logistics is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Existing contacts among shipping lines, forwarders or overseas cold storage operators

**WHY JOIN US**

* A central role in a fast-growing exporter with global operations

* Direct exposure to leadership and to decisions on the company's expansion

* Competitive pay with performance-linked incentives

Pay: From ₹100,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Site Maintenance Leader
description:
We are seeking an accomplished Sanand Site Maintenance Leader to lead the maintenance strategy, asset reliability, and infrastructure development for a large state of the art heavy manufacturing facility specializing in nuclear turbines and generators.
  
  
This executive leadership role is responsible for ensuring world-class maintenance performance across an existing brownfield manufacturing facility while supporting significant site expansion initiatives. The successful candidate will drive maintenance excellence, operational transformation, asset reliability, and organizational capability, ensuring the site is positioned for long-term growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Maintenance & Asset Management**

* Develop and execute the site's maintenance strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Lead and stretgize all maintenance functions, including mechanical, electrical, instrumentation & utilities.
* Drive preventive, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance programs to maximize equipment availability and asset performance.
* Improve overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), plant reliability, maintenance productivity, and lifecycle asset management.
* Ensure compliance with all safety, environmental, quality, and regulatory requirements, including nuclear quality standards where applicable.

**Brownfield Operations & Site Expansion**

* Lead maintenance activities within an operating brownfield manufacturing environment while minimizing production disruption.
* Support major site expansion and capital investment projects from design through commissioning and operational handover.
* Provide maintenance and reliability expertise during equipment selection, installation, commissioning, and startup.
* Develop long-term maintenance strategies for newly installed manufacturing assets and infrastructure.

**Transformation & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead enterprise-wide maintenance transformation initiatives focused on reliability, digitalization, operational excellence, and cost optimization.
* Implement best practices in Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) and Predictive Maintenance (PdM)
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance safety, quality, productivity, and operational performance.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.

**Leadership & People Management**

* Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing maintenance organization consisting of engineers, supervisors, planners, and skilled trades.
* Create a strong performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, employee engagement, and leadership development.
* Develop succession plans and strengthen organizational capability through coaching and mentoring.
* Act as a visible and influential leader who effectively manages change across the organization.
* Successfully lead within a unionized manufacturing environment, fostering positive labor relations while maintaining operational excellence.

**Financial & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage maintenance operating budgets, CAPEX investments, contractor performance, and asset lifecycle costs.
* Collaborate closely with Operations, Engineering, Quality, EHS, Supply Chain, and Project teams to achieve business objectives.
* Provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership regarding asset investments, modernization, and long-term maintenance planning.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related Engineering
* 20+ years of progressive maintenance leadership experience within heavy manufacturing or process industries.
* Demonstrated success leading maintenance organizations in industries such as nuclear, power generation, turbine manufacturing, heavy engineering, steel, mining, oil & gas, aerospace, or other capital-intensive manufacturing environments.
* Proven experience managing brownfield manufacturing facilities and supporting large-scale expansion or capital investment projects.
* Strong expertise in asset management, reliability engineering, predictive maintenance, maintenance planning, and operational excellence.
* Experience leading large multidisciplinary maintenance organizations and managing complex contractor networks.

description:
**Role title:**
IR & Compliance Lead

**Location:**
Kochi

Individual Contributor

HR Head – Spices India

**About Us:**
As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose,
*to be the change for good food and a healthy future*
. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

**Spices:**
ofi is the world’s leading producer of dried garlic and onions, and a global leader in chiles, pepper, and tropical spices. Our extensive network and presence in origin markets ensure that our spice blends and solutions are sourced from some of the finest raw ingredients year-round. We oversee growing practices and operate world-class manufacturing facilities, working directly and transparently with farmer-partners to ensure high-quality, sustainable spice solutions and reliable supply. As one of the largest global suppliers of spices and herbs, we source from all primary growing regions, offering a wide range of products including onion, garlic, chiles, pepper, parsley, and tropical spices. Our spices enhance recipes with superior provenance, taste, quality, color, and texture. Grown responsibly with our farmer partners, our spice ingredients form the foundation of flavors that delight consumers and ensure the future of our global supply chain. ofi offers a diverse portfolio of spices, herbs, and sauces, including organic options.

**Position Overview**

The IR & Compliance Lead will have two fold role – factory HR lead for Kochi factory and COE for compliance pan India. Industrial Relations, HR Audits, Contract Workforce Management, Statutory Compliance, Government Liasioning, and Factory Administration at the Kochi manufacturing facility. The role will also serve as the organization's pan-India labour law compliance SME, ensuring adherence to central and state regulations across all locations. The incumbent will drive next long term Settlement with unions, factory workforce costing, ensure statutory compliance, manage key external stakeholders, and support business continuity through effective workforce governance and risk management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Industrial Relations & Union Management:**

* Act as the primary point of contact for labour unions and workmen at the Kochi manufacturing facility.
* Handle employee grievances, workplace disputes, and conflict resolution initiatives.
* Lead next Long-Term Settlement (LTS) negotiations/ wage settlement.
* Enforce LTS terms and conditions in factory
* Facilitate disciplinary actions, domestic enquiries, and grievance redressal mechanisms in line with Standing Orders and labour laws.
* Ensure industrial harmony and minimize disruption to plant operations.
* Develop preventive IR strategies to mitigate labour disputes and productivity concerns.

**Contract Workforce Management:**

* Manage end-to-end contract labour operations, including deployment, attendance monitoring, productivity tracking, and workforce planning.
* Ensure compliance with Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act and related statutory requirements.
* Conduct periodic contractor compliance audits and evaluate performance.

**Government Liasioning & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with all local government officials, panchayats, police stations, Community Representatives
* Represent the company during statutory inspections, audits, hearings, and compliance reviews.
* Coordinate timely responses to notices, legal queries, and regulatory requirements.
* Facilitate approvals, licenses, renewals, and statutory registrations.
* Compliance Management (pan-India SME Role):
* Act as COE for statutory, labour and factory compliance for all locations
* Implementation of new Codes
* Develop and standardize compliance frameworks and audit processes.
* Monitor statutory filings and returns across locations.
* Conduct compliance reviews and risk assessments.
* Track labour law amendments and emerging regulatory requirements.
* Advise HR and business leaders on legal and compliance implications.

**Factory Administration & General Services**

* Oversee facility management activities including:
* Security Services, Housekeeping, Canteen Operations, Employee Transportation
* Monitor occupational health, hygiene, and workplace safety standards.
* Coordinate with EHS teams to ensure safe working conditions.
* Control administrative expenses through effective vendor management and cost optimization initiatives.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Zero man-days lost due to industrial disputes.
* Successful closure of employee grievances within defined timelines.
* Successful completion of wage settlements and LTS negotiations.
* 100% statutory compliance across assigned locations.
* Zero legal notices, penalties, or compliance violations.
* Timely filing of all statutory returns and renewals.
* Closure of all HR audits with zero NCs
* Contract Workforce Management
* 100% contractor compliance adherence.
* Timely contractor billing and reconciliation.
* Reduction in contract labour compliance deviations.
* Government Liasioning
* Successful closure of inspections and audits
* Timely renewal of licenses and statutory registrations.
* Administration
* Smooth operation of plant administration services.
* Employee satisfaction with administrative support services.
* Achievement of budget and cost optimization targets.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: MBA (HR) / MSW / PGDM in Human Resources, Industrial Relations.
* Experience:10 years of relevant experience in: Industrial Relations / Factory HR Operations / Labour Laws
* Preferred Industry Exposure: Manufacturing / FMCG

title: Chief Financial Officer
description:
**Company Description**
Sri Ganapathy Silks Sankarankovil is a leading clothing store recognized for offering a wide range of quality garments and traditional wear. The company focuses on providing customers with well-crafted products and a consistent retail experience. With an emphasis on customer satisfaction and product variety, Sri Ganapathy Silks serves a broad base of shoppers seeking both everyday clothing and special occasion attire. The organization values reliability, efficiency, and strong relationships with suppliers and customers.
  
**Role Description**
The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is a full-time, on-site leadership role based in Coimbatore, responsible for overseeing all financial operations of Sri Ganapathy Silks. The CFO will manage budgeting, cash flow, and long-term financial planning to support the company’s retail and inventory-driven business model. Daily responsibilities include monitoring financial performance, reviewing financial statements and reports, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations, and advising senior leadership on financial strategy and risk management. The role also involves optimizing costs, improving profitability, supervising the finance team, and collaborating with other departments to support business growth and operational efficiency.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong finance and financial planning skills, with the ability to develop budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial strategies.
* Proficiency in preparing and analyzing financial statements and financial reporting to support decision-making and regulatory compliance.
* Excellent analytical skills to interpret financial data, assess performance, and identify opportunities for cost optimization and revenue improvement.
* Experience in retail or consumer goods finance, including inventory management, pricing, and margin analysis, is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field; professional certifications (such as CA, CMA, CPA) are an advantage.
* Demonstrated leadership ability, including managing finance teams, implementing controls, and improving financial processes and systems.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with senior management and operational teams.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, and commitment to ethical financial practices.

title: Walk-in || Pharmacist
description:
Time and Venue:

Timing: 9.30 AM - 5.30 PM

Role & responsibilities Position: Pharmacist
 Department: Pharmacy (IP)
 Location: Sterling Hospitals, Sindhubhavan
 Reporting To: Pharmacy In-charge / Unit Head 
 Employment Type: Full-Time 1. Job Purpose To ensure safe, accurate, and timely dispensing of medicines to patients as per valid prescriptions and hospital protocols. The Pharmacist is responsible for medication management, inventory control, patient counselling, documentation, and compliance with applicable statutory and hospital standards. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Prescription & Medication Management Review prescriptions for completeness, dosage, frequency, route, and duration before dispensing. Dispense medicines accurately as per the prescription and established pharmacy procedures. Identify and escalate potential medication errors, drug interactions, contraindications, allergies, or unusual doses to the concerned physician/pharmacist in charge. Ensure correct medicine, strength, dosage form, quantity, and labelling before dispensing. Provide appropriate instructions to patients/attendants regarding medicine usage, storage, and precautions. Maintain confidentiality of patient and medication-related information. B. Inpatient & Outpatient Pharmacy Operations Process and dispense OPD and IPD medication orders within defined timelines. Coordinate with nursing and clinical departments regarding medication requirements. Ensure timely supply of medicines to wards, ICU, OT, emergency, and other clinical areas as applicable. Handle emergency and stat medication requirements promptly. Ensure proper documentation of issued and returned medicines. C. Inventory Management Monitor stock levels and ensure availability of essential and frequently used medicines. Follow FEFO (First Expiry, First Out) principles for inventory management. Regularly check medicines for expiry, damage, and storage conditions. Segregate expired, damaged, recalled, or quarantined medicines appropriately. Assist in stock verification and reconciliation. Maintain appropriate stock levels and communicate shortages or near-stock-out situations to the Pharmacy In-charge. Monitor and maintain records for high-value, high-alert, and controlled/scheduled medicines as applicable. D. Storage & Medication Safety Ensure medicines are stored under appropriate temperature, humidity, light, and other specified conditions. Monitor and document refrigerator/cold-chain temperatures where applicable. Ensure proper segregation and identification of look-alike/sound-alike (LASA) and high-alert medications. Follow medication safety protocols and hospital SOPs. Report medication errors, near misses, adverse drug reactions, and other medication-related incidents as per hospital policy. E. Documentation & Compliance Maintain accurate pharmacy records, registers, issue/return records, and other required documentation. Ensure compliance with applicable pharmacy, drug-control, narcotics/controlled-drug, and hospital regulations. Maintain records and documentation required for statutory inspections and hospital audits. Support compliance with NABH and other applicable quality standards. Participate in internal and external audits related to pharmacy operations. F. Patient & Customer Service Interact courteously and professionally with patients, attendants, doctors, nurses, and other hospital staff. Provide appropriate medication-related information within the scope of professional responsibilities. Address routine pharmacy-related queries and escalate clinical queries to the appropriate pharmacist/physician. Ensure a patient-centric approach while maintaining accuracy and medication safety. G. Additional Responsibilities Participate in pharmacy quality-improvement initiatives and medication-safety programs. Attend departmental meetings, training programs, and competency assessments. Maintain cleanliness, organization, and safety within the pharmacy area. Follow hospital infection-control, fire-safety, and occupational-safety guidelines. Perform other duties assigned by the Pharmacy In-charge / Pharmacy Manager. 3. Educational Qualification Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) / Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) from a recognized institution. Valid registration with the applicable Gujarat Pharmacy Council . Additional qualifications in hospital pharmacy will be an advantage. 4. Experience Relevant experience in a hospital pharmacy is preferred. Candidates with experience in IPD/OPD pharmacy operations, medication inventory, and hospital pharmacy systems will be preferred. Freshers may be considered based on organizational requirements. 5. Key Competencies Strong knowledge of medicines and dosage forms. Accuracy and attention to detail. Good understanding of prescription handling and medication safety. Inventory and stock-management skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced hospital environment. Patient-centric approach. Good documentation and record-keeping skills. Ability to work collaboratively with doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals. 6. Working Conditions Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays, as per hospital requirements. Ability to manage multiple prescriptions and medication requirements while maintaining accuracy. Ability to work in a multidisciplinary hospital environment. 7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Accuracy and timeliness of medicine dispensing. Compliance with prescription-verification and medication-safety protocols. Inventory accuracy and stock availability. Compliance with FEFO and expiry-management practices. Timely identification and reporting of medication errors/near misses. Compliance with statutory and hospital documentation requirements. Compliance with NABH and departmental quality standards. Patient/service satisfaction related to pharmacy services. 
 Preferred candidate profile Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) / Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) from a recognized institution. Valid registration with the applicable Gujarat Pharmacy Council .
